trans-unit.source: Arc accordion: a list of question rows that reveal their answers in place. The panel height follows the content on a smooth spring that never overshoots and retargets mid-flight, the answer settles down 6px out of a subtle blur as it opens, and the chevron turns on a snappy spring. Single mode (Arc) keeps one row open and lets it close; `Multiple` opens rows independently. Arrow keys move between the row triggers, Home / End jump to the ends, Enter / Space toggle. Rows are `AccordionItem`s written inline (`<arc:AccordionItem Header="Question">Answer</arc:AccordionItem>`) or generated from `ItemsSource` (`ItemTemplate` renders the question, `ContentTemplate` the answer).
trans-unit.target: Arc 手風琴：一組問題列，展開後在原位顯示答案。面板高度沿平滑彈簧跟隨內容變化，不會過衝，並且可以在動畫中途改變目標；答案展開時從輕微模糊中下落 6px；箭頭以靈敏的彈簧轉動。單選模式（Arc）保持一列展開，並允許其收合；`Multiple` 則讓各列獨立展開。方向鍵在列觸發器之間移動，Home / End 跳到首尾，Enter / Space 切換展開。列為內嵌寫入的 `AccordionItem`（`<arc:AccordionItem Header="Question">Answer</arc:AccordionItem>`），或由 `ItemsSource` 產生（`ItemTemplate` 渲染問題，`ContentTemplate` 渲染答案）。

trans-unit.source: Template for the answers of data items (the question uses `ItemTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 資料項答案的範本（問題使用 `ItemTemplate`）。

trans-unit.source: Single (Arc) or multiple open rows.
trans-unit.target: 單選（Arc）或多列同時展開。

trans-unit.source: Index of the open row; −1 closes every row (Arc defaultOpen, default 0). Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 已展開列的索引；−1 表示收合所有列（Arc 的 defaultOpen 預設為 0）。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Row size; `Large` suits page-level FAQs.
trans-unit.target: 列的尺寸；`Large` 適合頁面層級的常見問題。

trans-unit.source: One row of an `Accordion`: `Header` is the question (the whole row is the trigger) and `Content` the answer. The answer stays mounted while closed so a second click mid-flight reverses from where it is; a closed answer takes no pointer or keyboard focus.
trans-unit.target: `Accordion` 的一列：`Header` 為問題（整列即觸發器），`Content` 為答案。收合時答案仍保持掛載，因此動畫中途再次點擊會從目前位置反向；收合的答案不接收指標或鍵盤焦點。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the row opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 列展開或收合後引發。

trans-unit.source: Whether the answer is open. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 答案是否展開。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: One customer account's health on one card: the health score with its band and its trend over the last weeks, the renewal date and the days left, open tickets, a usage chart with a metric switch, the risks, and recommended actions you can tick off to see the score they are expected to win back. With no health history the block shows a built-in invented account. Give it `HealthHistory` (weekly scores, oldest first) and the other collections to show your own; `ActionToggled` reports every ticked action.
trans-unit.target: 一張卡片上的一個客戶帳戶的健康狀況：健康分數及其等級和近幾週的走勢、續約日期和剩餘天數、未關閉的工單、可切換指標的使用量圖表、風險，以及可以勾選、查看預計挽回分數的建議行動。 沒有健康歷史時，區塊顯示內置的虛構帳戶。提供 `HealthHistory`（每週分數，從早到晚）和其他集合即可顯示你自己的資料；`ActionToggled` 報告每次勾選。

trans-unit.source: The account's name; null shows the sample name while the samples are shown.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶名稱；為 null 時，顯示示例時用示例名稱。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a recommended action is ticked or cleared in the block.
trans-unit.target: 在區塊中勾選或取消一項建議行動時引發。

trans-unit.source: Days until the renewal (negative once it has passed); null without a renewal date.
trans-unit.target: 距續約的天數（過期後為負數）；沒有續約日期時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Draws a bordered card (true); false lays the block flat on the page.
trans-unit.target: 繪制帶邊框的卡片（true）；false 時區塊平鋪在頁面上。

trans-unit.source: The words the block shows and reads out.
trans-unit.target: 區塊顯示和讀出的文字。

trans-unit.source: The score expected once every done action has had its effect (never above 100).
trans-unit.target: 所有已完成的行動生效後預計的分數（不超過 100）。

trans-unit.source: When the contract renews; null shows "No date".
trans-unit.target: 合同續約的日期；為 null 時顯示 "No date"。

trans-unit.source: Within this many days of the renewal the renewal tile turns to the warning color (60).
trans-unit.target: 距續約不超過這麼多天時，續約方塊變為警告色（60）。

trans-unit.source: The health score now: the last value of the history, 0 to 100.
trans-unit.target: 目前的健康分數：歷史中的最後一個值，0 到 100。

trans-unit.source: The index of the usage metric the chart shows (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 使用量圖表顯示的指標序號（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the name (plan, yearly value, owner); null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 名稱下方的一行（方案、年度金額、負責人）；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The day the days left count from; null uses today.
trans-unit.target: 剩餘天數從哪一天算起；為 null 時用今天。

trans-unit.source: A recommended action and how many health points it is expected to win back.
trans-unit.target: 一項建議行動，以及它預計能挽回多少健康分數。

trans-unit.source: Something that could cost the renewal, with how serious it is.
trans-unit.target: 可能導致無法續約的一件事，以及它有多嚴重。

trans-unit.source: A support ticket of the account.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶的一個支援工單。

trans-unit.source: A usage measure of the account, one value per week, oldest first.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶的一個使用量指標，每週一個值，從早到晚。

trans-unit.source: A call to action for one asynchronous submit (Save, Publish): pending and success show on the button itself. The changed letters of the label rise out of a soft blur while kept letters glide (P4) and the width follows on a spring (P5); the trailing arrow leaves in the direction of the action, a spinner turns while `AsyncAction` runs, a check draws itself on success (P15), and the button returns to idle after `ResetAfter`. Pending keeps keyboard focus: activation is swallowed instead of disabling the button.
trans-unit.target: 用於一次非同步提交的行動按鈕（儲存、發布）：等待與成功狀態直接顯示在按鈕上。標籤中變化的字母從柔和模糊中升起，未變化的字母平滑滑動（P4），寬度沿彈簧跟隨變化（P5）；末尾箭頭朝操作方向離開，`AsyncAction` 執行時載入圖示旋轉，成功時勾號自行繪製（P15），並在 `ResetAfter` 之後恢復閒置狀態。等待期間保持鍵盤焦點：啟動操作會被忽略，而不是停用按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `AsyncAction` throws.
trans-unit.target: `AsyncAction` 擲出例外時引發。

trans-unit.source: The work to run. The button is pending until the task completes; a fault returns it to idle and raises `ActionFailed`. `Command` and `Click` run first and, without an async action, count as an immediate success.
trans-unit.target: 要執行的工作。在工作完成前按鈕處於等待狀態；發生錯誤會使其恢復閒置並引發 `ActionFailed`。`Command` 與 `Click` 會先執行，若沒有非同步操作，則視為立即成功。

trans-unit.source: The idle label and, always, the accessible name (default "Save").
trans-unit.target: 閒置時的標籤，同時始終作為無障礙名稱（預設為「儲存」）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while `AsyncAction` runs (default "Saving").
trans-unit.target: `AsyncAction` 執行期間顯示的標籤（預設為「儲存中」）。

trans-unit.source: How long success stays before returning to idle (default 2.4s); zero keeps it.
trans-unit.target: 成功狀態保持多久後恢復閒置（預設 2.4s）；設為零則一直保持。

trans-unit.source: Current phase: Idle, Pending while AsyncAction runs, or Success after it completes. Read-only.
trans-unit.target: 目前階段：Idle、AsyncAction 執行期間的 Pending，或完成後的 Success。唯讀。

trans-unit.source: Shown after the action succeeds (default "Saved").
trans-unit.target: 操作成功後顯示的標籤（預設為「已儲存」）。

trans-unit.source: A corner button for quick entries: it expands into a short list of actions, a chosen action reshapes the same surface into a small form, and a successful submit shrinks it back to the button, which then shows a check mark. Width, height and corner radius follow a spring from face to face; a deeper face enters from the right, Escape climbs one level, and every action holds on to its draft for as long as the control exists.
trans-unit.target: 一個用於快速新增的角落按鈕：它展開成一份簡短的動作清單，所選動作把同一塊表面變成小表單，送出成功後縮回按鈕，按鈕隨即顯示勾號。寬、高和圓角在各個面之間跟隨彈簧變化；更深的面從右側進入，Escape 往上退一層，每個動作在控制項存在期間一直保留自己的草稿。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of a form's back button.
trans-unit.target: 表單返回按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The text beside the spinner while a submission is saved.
trans-unit.target: 儲存送出內容時顯示在轉圈旁邊的文字。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the close buttons.
trans-unit.target: 關閉按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the surface folds back into the button. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 表面收回成按鈕時引發。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: The bottom corner that holds the button; the menu and forms open upward and toward the other side.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕所在的下方角落；選單和表單向上、並朝另一側展開。

trans-unit.source: The action whose form is open, or null.
trans-unit.target: 目前開啟表單的動作，沒有時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Shown under an empty field on submit, for actions without their own `EmptyHint`.
trans-unit.target: 送出空白輸入框時顯示在其下方，用於沒有自己 `EmptyHint` 的動作。

trans-unit.source: Shown under the field when `SubmitHandler` throws.
trans-unit.target: `SubmitHandler` 擲出例外時顯示在輸入框下方。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu opens from the button. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 選單從按鈕展開時引發。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Whether the menu or a form is open (two-way). Setting it opens the menu or folds back into the button.
trans-unit.target: 選單或表單是否開啟（雙向）。設定它會開啟選單或收回成按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Whether `SubmitHandler` is running.
trans-unit.target: `SubmitHandler` 是否正在執行。

trans-unit.source: The button's accessible name and the menu's title.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕的無障礙名稱，也是選單的標題。

trans-unit.source: How long the check stays on the button after a successful submit before the plus returns.
trans-unit.target: 送出成功後勾號在按鈕上停留多久，之後加號回來。

trans-unit.source: Saves a submission (for example to your server). While its task runs the form shows a spinner; when it throws, the form stays up, keeps the draft and shows `ErrorMessage`. Going back or closing cancels its token. Null accepts every submission at once.
trans-unit.target: 儲存一次送出（例如傳送到你的伺服器）。它的工作執行期間表單顯示轉圈；它擲出例外時，表單保持開啟，保留草稿並顯示 `ErrorMessage`。返回或關閉會取消它的權杖。為 null 時每次送出都會立即被接受。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a submission was accepted (after `SubmitHandler` finished). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 送出被接受後（`SubmitHandler` 完成後）引發。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: What the surface shows.
trans-unit.target: 表面目前顯示的內容。

trans-unit.source: A compact action that morphs through a small set of related states (idle, working, done, and back) and keeps its place and intent. Pressing it moves to the next state, wrapping around. Width, padding, tone and icon move together on springs (P5); only the changed letters of the label rise in out of a soft blur while the rest glide (P4); icons trade places through a blur and a success tick wipes in (P15). An action that returns a task shows a working phase (`PendingLabel`, or a round spinner without one) for at least 450ms; a fault shows `FailureLabel` for 1.8s. Every change can be interrupted mid-flight. Pending keeps keyboard focus: activation is swallowed instead of disabling the button.
trans-unit.target: 一個精簡的操作，在一小組相關狀態（閒置、進行中、完成，再回來）之間變形，並保持它的位置與意圖。按下它會進入下一個狀態，到最後繞回第一個。寬度、內距、色調、圖示與字母一起沿彈簧運動，只有變化的字母從柔和模糊中升起；圖示透過模糊換位，成功的勾號被擦入。回傳工作的動作會顯示進行中階段（`PendingLabel`，沒有時是圓形載入圈）至少 450ms；發生錯誤時顯示 `FailureLabel` 1.8 秒。任何變化都可以在途中被打斷。進行中保留鍵盤焦點：忽略啟動而不是停用按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Runs on press with the next and the current state, before the control moves on. Return a task to show the working phase, null to move on at once; a faulted task, or an exception, shows `FailureLabel` and stays on the current state.
trans-unit.target: 按下時執行，參數是下一個狀態與目前狀態，執行於控制項前進之前。回傳工作會顯示進行中階段，回傳 null 則立即前進；工作發生錯誤或擲出例外會顯示 `FailureLabel` 並停留在目前狀態。

trans-unit.source: Shown for 1.8s after a failed action (default "Try again").
trans-unit.target: 動作失敗後顯示 1.8 秒（預設 “Try again”）。

trans-unit.source: Where the control is in a press: Idle, Working while the action runs, or Failed. Read-only.
trans-unit.target: 控制項在一次按下中的位置：閒置、動作執行時的進行中，或失敗。唯讀。

trans-unit.source: Height: Small (36), Medium (44, default) or Large (50).
trans-unit.target: 高度：Small（36）、Medium（44，預設）或 Large（50）。

trans-unit.source: The states, in order; at least two are needed. A press moves to the next one and wraps around. In XAML, add `ActionSwapState` children.
trans-unit.target: 依序排列的狀態，至少需要兩個。每次按下進入下一個，到最後繞回第一個。在 XAML 中加入 `ActionSwapState` 子項。

trans-unit.source: The id of the shown state (two-way); null shows the first state. A press sets it when the next state commits.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示狀態的 id（雙向）；null 顯示第一個狀態。下一個狀態提交時，按下會設定它。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a new state commits, by a press, by its hold running out, or after its action succeeds.
trans-unit.target: 新狀態提交時觸發：由按下、停留時間結束或動作成功後引起。

trans-unit.source: One face of an `ActionSwap`. Its properties can be bound in XAML (for example localized labels); the control follows later changes.
trans-unit.target: `ActionSwap` 的一個外觀狀態。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結（例如在地化的標籤）；控制項會跟隨之後的變化。

trans-unit.source: How long to hold this state before moving on by itself, for brief confirmations such as "Sent". Zero holds it.
trans-unit.target: 停留在此狀態多久後自動前進，用於「已傳送」這類簡短確認。為零時一直停留。

trans-unit.source: A 16px Lucide-style glyph before the label (24x24 stroke path, see `ArcIcons`).
trans-unit.target: 標籤前的 16px Lucide 風格圖示（24x24 描邊路徑，見 `ArcIcons`）。

trans-unit.source: Identifies the state in `Value`.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Value` 中識別該狀態。

trans-unit.source: The label, also the accessible name while the state is shown.
trans-unit.target: 標籤文字，顯示該狀態時也是無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Shown while `AsyncAction` runs on the way into this state, such as "Sending" before "Sent". Without it the pill folds into a round spinner.
trans-unit.target: 在進入此狀態的途中 `AsyncAction` 執行時顯示，例如「已傳送」之前的「傳送中」。未設定時膠囊會收攏成一個圓形載入指示器。

trans-unit.source: The tone of the pill while this state is shown.
trans-unit.target: 顯示此狀態時膠囊的色調。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ValueChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `ValueChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Draws a row of icon buttons in the cell, such as Edit and Delete at the end of a row. A click runs the action's `Command` with the row object and raises `CellInvoked` with the action's label as the part; the cell is not selected by that click.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存格中畫一排圖示按鈕，例如列尾的編輯和刪除。點擊會帶著該列物件執行動作的 `Command`，並以動作的標籤作為部分名稱觸發 `CellInvoked`；該次點擊不會選取儲存格。

trans-unit.source: One day of an `ActivityHeatmap`.
trans-unit.target: `ActivityHeatmap` 中的一天。

trans-unit.source: What happened in a workspace, newest first and grouped by day: who did what, with an icon per kind of change, filter chips by kind and a person picker, and new items that slide in at the top while the feed is live. Pause it and new items wait behind a "new updates" pill instead of moving the list under the reader. Rows are a `Timeline`: days stay pinned while their rows scroll, and rows with a detail expand in place. A feed with no items when it first loads shows a sample.
trans-unit.target: 工作區裡發生了什麼，最新的在前並按天分組：誰做了什麼，每類變化有自己的圖標，可按類型的標籤和人員選擇框篩選，實時模式下新動態從頂部滑入。暫停後，新動態在“新動態”提示條後面等待，列表不會在讀者眼前移動。各行是一個 `Timeline`：滾動時日期保持在頂部，帶詳情的行可原地展開。首次加載時沒有動態，會顯示一個示例。

trans-unit.source: The person shown (two-way); null shows everyone.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的人員（雙向）；null 顯示所有人。

trans-unit.source: Whether pushed items go straight into the list (two-way, default true); false holds them behind the pill.
trans-unit.target: 推送的動態是否直接進入列表（雙向，預設 true）；false 時它們在提示條後面等待。

trans-unit.source: The kind shown (two-way); null shows every kind.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的類型（雙向）；null 顯示所有類型。

trans-unit.source: Items pushed while paused, waiting behind the pill.
trans-unit.target: 暫停期間推送、在提示條後面等待的動態數量。

trans-unit.source: The heading ("Activity").
trans-unit.target: 標題（“Activity”）。

trans-unit.source: Whether a feed with no items when it first loads gets the sample (default true).
trans-unit.target: 首次加載時沒有動態是否顯示示例（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: One thing that happened in a workspace, for an `ActivityFeed`: who did what to what, and when. Items are read when they are added; replace an item to change it.
trans-unit.target: 工作區中發生的一件事，用於 `ActivityFeed`：誰對什麼做了什麼，以及何時。動態在加入時讀取；要修改請替換整項。

trans-unit.source: A contribution-style calendar (Arc "Activity heatmap"): one square per day, weeks as columns, four accent tints for how busy a day was. Cells wave in once on first view; a single tooltip glides between cells on hover or keyboard focus; a new range recolors the grid in a diagonal sweep instead of redrawing it; the legend previews (hover, focus) or pins (click) one level. ↑ / ↓ move by day, ← / → by week, Home / End to the ends, Enter / Space select.
trans-unit.target: 貢獻式日曆（Arc “Activity heatmap”）：每天一個方塊，週為欄，四種強調色深淺表示當天的活躍程度。儲存格在首次顯示時依序浮入；單一提示框在滑鼠懸停或鍵盤焦點變化時在儲存格之間平滑滑動；切換範圍時以對角掃過的方式重新著色，而不是整體重繪；圖例在懸停、焦點時預覽某一級別，點選時鎖定該級別。↑ / ↓ 按天移動，← / → 按週移動，Home / End 跳到首尾，Enter / Space 選取。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Actions` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Actions` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `CountSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `CountSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Culture` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Culture` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a day is chosen with a click, Enter or Space.
trans-unit.target: 透過點選、Enter 或 Space 選取某一天時引發。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `DateSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `DateSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `FirstDayOfWeek` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `FirstDayOfWeek` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ItemsSource` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ItemsSource` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Label` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Period` property.

trans-unit.source: A week of hourly activity as a terrain: 7 × 24 bars standing on a floor in perspective, as tall and as dark as each hour was busy. Drag to orbit, Ctrl/⌘ + wheel or pinch to zoom, hover a bar for its numbers and the day's shape, click it to fly the camera there; switch the metric and the bars rise to the new values in a diagonal wave; switch to the heat map and they press flat. Under the plot, a legend and a summary: the week's total and its change, the peak hours (each flies to its hour) and the busiest day.
trans-unit.target: 一週的每小時活動以地形圖呈現：7 × 24 根柱子立在透視的底面上，每個小時越繁忙，柱子就越高、顏色越深。拖曳可環繞，Ctrl/⌘ + 滾輪或捏合可縮放，懸停柱子可查看其數值和當天的走勢，點選則將相機飛到該處；切換指標時，柱子會沿對角線波浪式升至新數值；切換到熱力圖時，柱子則壓平。圖下方有圖例和摘要：本週總量及其變化、高峰時段（點選各項會飛到對應時刻）以及最忙的一天。

trans-unit.target: 最忙那天的一行文字：{0} 為其總量，{1} 為單位，{2} 為本週工作時間所佔的比例（兩個數字都會滾動變化）。預設 "{0} {1}, {2} during working hours"。

trans-unit.source: A queue of actions AI agents want to take that need a person's approval (send an email, make a payment, deploy): the waiting requests on one side, and the selected one in full on the other, with the agent's reason, the facts of the action, its risk, an optional note and Approve / Deny. A high-risk approval asks for an extra check first. A decided request leaves the queue and the next one is selected; `Decided` reports each answer, and an optional `DecisionHandler` sends it to your backend first. Without `Requests` it shows sample requests.
trans-unit.target: AI 智慧體想執行、需要人核准的操作佇列（寄送郵件、付款、發布）：一側是等待的請求，另一側完整顯示選取的請求，包括智慧體的理由、操作的事實、風險、選填備註以及 Approve / Deny。高風險的核准需要先多做一次確認。已決定的請求離開佇列並選取下一個；`Decided` 報告每個決定，選用的 `DecisionHandler` 會先把它送到你的後端。未設定 `Requests` 時顯示範例請求。

trans-unit.target: 完整顯示的請求（雙向：清單會寫入它）。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AgentApprovals` queue shows or reads out, with English defaults. Words built from values are functions, so an app can apply its own grammar. Assign a new instance to `Labels` to change them.
trans-unit.target: `AgentApprovals` 佇列顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。由值組成的文字是函式，應用程式可以套用自己的語法。給 `Labels` 指派一個新執行個體即可修改。

trans-unit.source: A page for setting up an AI agent with a test chat beside it. The settings card has the agent's name and description, its instructions with a character and token count, the model, the tools it may use (each with a switch) and the knowledge sources it searches (add a link or upload files; each source shows its indexing). A save bar keeps the draft apart from what is saved, and Publish moves the saved settings to what people use, with a status badge (Draft, Published, Unpublished changes). The test chat answers with the settings it started with; when they change it says so and Restart starts over with the new ones. Without your own data the builder shows an invented support agent (`ShowsSampleData`). Connect `Responder` to your agent runtime for real test replies, `SaveHandler` and `PublishHandler` to your backend, and `IndexHandler` to your indexing; each is simulated when unset.
trans-unit.target: 一個用於設定 AI 智慧代理的頁面，旁邊附有測試對話。設定卡片包含智慧代理的名稱和說明、附字元數和 token 數的指令、模型、它可以使用的工具（每個都有開關）以及它搜尋的知識來源（加入連結或上傳檔案；每個來源顯示自己的索引進度）。儲存列把草稿與已儲存的內容分開，「發布」把已儲存的設定交給人們使用，並顯示狀態標籤（Draft、Published、Unpublished changes）。測試對話使用它開始時的設定來回答；設定改變後它會說明，「重新開始」會用新設定從頭開始。 沒有你自己的資料時，建構器顯示一個虛構的客服智慧代理（`ShowsSampleData`）。把 `Responder` 接到你的智慧代理執行環境以得到真實的測試回覆，把 `SaveHandler` 和 `PublishHandler` 接到你的後端，把 `IndexHandler` 接到你的索引服務；未設定時都會模擬。

trans-unit.source: One line on what the agent helps with (two-way: the description field edits it).
trans-unit.target: 一行文字，說明智慧代理能幫什麼忙（雙向：說明輸入框會修改它）。

trans-unit.source: The agent's name (two-way: the name field edits it).
trans-unit.target: 智慧代理的名稱（雙向：名稱輸入框會修改它）。

trans-unit.source: The draft: the settings as they are on screen.
trans-unit.target: 草稿：畫面上目前的設定。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the draft changes: a field, the model, a tool, a source, or Discard.
trans-unit.target: 草稿改變時觸發：一個輸入框、模型、一個工具、一個來源，或 Discard。

trans-unit.source: Culture of the counts and sizes (default "en-US").
trans-unit.target: 計數和大小使用的地區格式（預設為「en-US」）。

trans-unit.source: The instructions, the agent's system prompt (two-way: the instructions field edits it).
trans-unit.target: 指令，即智慧代理的系統提示詞（雙向：指令輸入框會修改它）。

trans-unit.source: The longest the instructions may be (8,000 characters); longer instructions cannot be saved.
trans-unit.target: 指令的最大長度（8,000 個字元）；更長的指令無法儲存。

trans-unit.source: Whether the draft differs from `SavedConfig`.
trans-unit.target: 草稿是否與 `SavedConfig` 不同。

trans-unit.source: Whether a save or a publish is running.
trans-unit.target: 是否正在儲存或發布。

trans-unit.source: Whether the draft changed after the open test chat started (the chat shows a Restart note).
trans-unit.target: 目前測試對話開始後草稿是否改變過（對話會顯示一則附 Restart 的提示）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the builder shows or reads out (see `AgentBuilderLabels`).
trans-unit.target: 建構器顯示或讀出的所有文字（見 `AgentBuilderLabels`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a publish went through, with what was published.
trans-unit.target: 發布成功後觸發，附有發布的內容。

trans-unit.source: What people use (two-way); null means the agent was never published (the badge says Draft).
trans-unit.target: 人們正在使用的內容（雙向）；null 表示智慧代理從未發布（標籤顯示 Draft）。

trans-unit.source: Draft, Published or Unpublished changes, from `SavedConfig`, `PublishedConfig` and the draft.
trans-unit.target: Draft、Published 或 Unpublished changes，由 `SavedConfig`、`PublishedConfig` 和草稿得出。

trans-unit.source: Answers the test chat; null uses `AgentBuilderSimulatedResponder`, which calls no model.
trans-unit.target: 回答測試對話；null 時使用 `AgentBuilderSimulatedResponder`，它不呼叫任何模型。

trans-unit.source: What is saved (two-way). Null when the builder first shows takes the settings on screen as saved. Discard returns to it; the save bar and `IsDirty` compare the draft with it.
trans-unit.target: 已儲存的內容（雙向）。建構器第一次顯示時如果為 null，畫面上的設定就算作已儲存。Discard 會回到它；儲存列和 `IsDirty` 用它與草稿比較。

trans-unit.source: The message of the last failed save or publish; null after a success.
trans-unit.target: 上一次失敗的儲存或發布的訊息；成功後為 null。

trans-unit.source: The id of the chosen model in `Models` (two-way: the model pill and the test chat's model button edit it).
trans-unit.target: `Models` 中所選模型的 id（雙向：模型膠囊和測試對話的模型按鈕會修改它）。

trans-unit.source: Fills an empty builder with the invented support agent of `AgentBuilderSamples` when it first shows (default true).
trans-unit.target: 空的建構器第一次顯示時，用 `AgentBuilderSamples` 中虛構的客服智慧代理填入它（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a knowledge source finished indexing or failed.
trans-unit.target: 一個知識來源完成索引或失敗時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The settings the open test chat started with; null before its first message.
trans-unit.target: 目前測試對話開始時的設定；在第一則訊息之前為 null。

trans-unit.source: A document or site the agent can search, shown as a row in the Knowledge section of `AgentBuilder`.
trans-unit.target: 智慧代理可以搜尋的文件或網站，在 `AgentBuilder` 的知識部分顯示為一列。

trans-unit.source: How many passages the index holds once ready; null hides the count.
trans-unit.target: 就緒後索引中的段落數；null 時隱藏計數。

trans-unit.source: Why indexing failed.
trans-unit.target: 索引失敗的原因。

trans-unit.source: Stable id, saved in `Sources`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id，儲存在 `Sources` 中。

trans-unit.source: A file or a website.

trans-unit.source: The name in the row: a file name or the page's address without the scheme.
trans-unit.target: 列中的名稱：檔案名稱，或不帶協定的頁面位址。

trans-unit.source: How far indexing is, from 0 to 1 (shown while `Status` is Indexing).
trans-unit.target: 索引的進度，從 0 到 1（在 `Status` 為 Indexing 時顯示）。

trans-unit.source: The file size in bytes, shown in the row; null hides it.

trans-unit.source: Where the source is in its indexing.

trans-unit.source: The page's address for a website; null for a file.
trans-unit.target: 網站的頁面位址；檔案為 null。

trans-unit.source: A capability an agent can be allowed to use, shown as a row with a switch in `AgentBuilder`.
trans-unit.target: 可以交給智慧代理使用的一項能力，在 `AgentBuilder` 中顯示為附開關的一列。

trans-unit.source: One line under the name that says what the agent can do with it.
trans-unit.target: 名稱下方的一行文字，說明智慧代理能用它做什麼。

trans-unit.source: A 24 × 24 stroke glyph (such as `ArcIcons.Globe`); null shows a wrench.
trans-unit.target: 24 × 24 的描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons.Globe`）；null 時顯示扳手。

trans-unit.source: Stable id, saved in `ToolIds`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id，儲存在 `ToolIds` 中。

trans-unit.source: Whether the agent may use the tool (two-way: the row's switch edits it).
trans-unit.target: 智慧代理是否可以使用這個工具（雙向：列中的開關會修改它）。

trans-unit.source: The name in the row, such as "Web search".
trans-unit.target: 列中的名稱，例如「Web search」。

trans-unit.source: The words the test chat shows while the tool runs, such as "Searching the web"; null uses the name.
trans-unit.target: 工具執行時測試對話顯示的文字，例如「Searching the web」；null 時使用名稱。

trans-unit.source: A live document where an AI agent edits like a collaborator (Arc Agent cursor, design reference). The agent's labeled cursor comes out of its avatar, selects a paragraph and streams in a rewrite, adds a heading and fixes a typo, while a teammate's cursor reads along. The changes stay tinted in the agent's color until someone accepts or undoes them from a floating review bar. Give it the document as `Blocks` (title, heading and paragraph blocks with stable ids) and the edits as `Edits`, or fetch them from your agent with `Run` (cancelled when someone presses Stop). Store the document from `Accepted` and pass it back as `Blocks`. With none of them it plays a `Simulation` (a document, its edits, an agent and a teammate you pass), looping; with no data at all it shows an empty document.
trans-unit.target: 一份即時文件，AI 代理像協作者一樣在其中編輯（Arc Agent cursor，設計參考）。代理帶名字標籤的游標從它的大頭貼中出來，選取一個段落並串流寫入改寫，新增一個標題並修正一個錯字，同時一位同事的游標跟著閱讀。變更以代理的顏色著色，直到有人在浮動的審閱列中接受或復原。把文件以 `Blocks`（帶穩定 id 的標題、小標題和段落區塊）交給它，把編輯以 `Edits` 交給它，或用 `Run` 從你的代理取得（有人按下 Stop 時取消）。從 `Accepted` 儲存文件，再以 `Blocks` 傳回。三者都沒有時，它循環播放 `Simulation`（你傳入的文件、編輯、代理和同事）；完全沒有資料時顯示一份空白文件。

trans-unit.source: Raised with the edited document when someone accepts the changes. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 有人接受變更時引發，參數是編輯後的文件。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The agent: its name on the cursor, its 24 × 24 stroked mark in the avatar and, from a solid `MarkBrush`, the color of its cursor, selection and change tint (the accent otherwise). Null is the `Simulation`'s agent while one plays, or an unnamed one.
trans-unit.target: 代理：游標上的名字、大頭貼中 24 × 24 的描邊標記，以及（來自純色的 `MarkBrush`）其游標、選取範圍和變更著色的顏色（否則為強調色）。為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間使用其代理，否則使用一個未命名的代理。

trans-unit.source: Starts a run as soon as the card is on screen. Off, the header shows an Ask button instead.
trans-unit.target: 卡片一出現在畫面上就開始執行。關閉時，頁首顯示 Ask 按鈕。

trans-unit.source: The document as title, heading and paragraph blocks with stable ids; null shows the `Simulation`'s while one plays, or an empty document. Compared by content, so passing back an equal list does nothing.
trans-unit.target: 文件，由帶穩定 id 的標題、小標題和段落區塊組成；為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間顯示其文件，否則顯示空白文件。依內容比較，所以傳回相同的清單不會有任何改變。

trans-unit.source: A person in the document, drawn as a second cursor with their initials and first name. Null is the `Simulation`'s teammate while one plays, or nobody.
trans-unit.target: 文件中的一個人，繪製為第二個游標，帶有其姓名縮寫和名字。為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間使用其同事，否則沒有同事。

trans-unit.source: The edits to play in order (rewrite, insert, fix); ignored when `Run` is set. Null plays the `Simulation`'s while one plays, or none.
trans-unit.target: 依序播放的編輯（改寫、插入、修正）；設定了 `Run` 時忽略。為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間播放其編輯，否則沒有編輯。

trans-unit.source: Whether the collaborator is shown; false hides their cursor and avatar.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示協作者；false 會隱藏其游標和大頭貼。

trans-unit.source: Adds "Simulated, nothing was saved" to every announcement. Null: only while a `Simulation` plays.
trans-unit.target: 在每次播報後附加 "Simulated, nothing was saved"。為 null 時只在播放 `Simulation` 時附加。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個字詞。

trans-unit.source: Replays the run: the collaborator accepts after a short pause (never while the pointer is over the card or focus is in it), then the document resets. Null loops only while a `Simulation` plays. Never loops below full motion.
trans-unit.target: 重播執行：協作者在短暫停頓後接受（指標停在卡片上或焦點在卡片內時從不接受），然後文件重設。為 null 時只在播放 `Simulation` 時循環。低於完整動態效果時從不循環。

trans-unit.source: A muted line under the title, such as the owner and a target date.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行淡化文字，例如負責人和目標日期。

trans-unit.source: How many edits are waiting for review.
trans-unit.target: 等待審閱的編輯數量。

trans-unit.source: Where the run is: idle, thinking, editing, review, accepted, reverted, stopped, empty or error.
trans-unit.target: 執行所處的階段：閒置、思考、編輯、審閱、已接受、已復原、已停止、無變更或錯誤。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Phase` changes. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: `Phase` 變化時引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Fetches the edits from your agent. The token is cancelled when someone presses Stop; a failed task shows the error with Retry.
trans-unit.target: 從你的代理取得編輯。有人按下 Stop 時權杖被取消；失敗的工作會顯示錯誤和 Retry。

trans-unit.source: A session to play while the card has no `Blocks`, `Edits` or `Run`: its document, edits, agent, teammate and meta line, looping with full motion (nothing is saved). Your own data wins over it; null stops it and shows the empty document.
trans-unit.target: 卡片沒有 `Blocks`、`Edits` 或 `Run` 時要播放的工作階段：它的文件、編輯、代理、同事和中繼資訊行，在完整動態效果下循環播放（不會儲存任何內容）。你自己的資料優先於它；為 null 時停止播放並顯示空白文件。

trans-unit.source: Playback speed multiplier for cursor travel, streaming and pauses (above zero).
trans-unit.target: 游標移動、串流寫入和停頓的播放速度倍數（大於零）。

trans-unit.source: Raised with the restored document when someone undoes the changes. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 有人復原變更時引發，參數是還原後的文件。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: One block of the document an `AgentCursor` shows: a title, heading or paragraph with a stable id.
trans-unit.target: `AgentCursor` 所顯示文件中的一個區塊：帶穩定 id 的標題、小標題或段落。

trans-unit.source: A person in an `AgentCursor` document, drawn as a second cursor with their initials and first name.
trans-unit.target: `AgentCursor` 文件中的一個人，繪製為第二個游標，帶有其姓名縮寫和名字。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Accepted` and `Undone`: the document after the change.
trans-unit.target: `Accepted` 和 `Undone` 的參數：變化後的文件。

trans-unit.source: One edit the agent makes in an `AgentCursor` document. Edits address blocks by id: a rewrite replaces a block's text, an insert adds a block after one, a fix replaces an exact word inside a block.
trans-unit.target: 代理在 `AgentCursor` 文件中進行的一次編輯。編輯以 id 指向區塊：改寫取代一個區塊的文字，插入在某個區塊之後新增一個區塊，修正取代區塊中一個確切的字詞。

trans-unit.source: Every word `AgentCursor` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; texts that hold a name or a count are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `AgentCursor` 顯示或朗讀的每一個字詞，預設是英文。取代整個物件即可在地化或改寫用語；包含名字或數量的文字是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `PhaseChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `PhaseChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: A document session an `AgentCursor` plays without an agent, from data you give it: the document, the edits the agent makes, the agent and a teammate who reads along, and the muted line under the title. Set it as `Simulation` while the card has no `Blocks`, `Edits` or `Run`: the card shows the document, plays the edits, says nothing was saved and, with full motion, loops (the teammate accepts after a short pause, then it starts over).
trans-unit.target: `AgentCursor` 在沒有代理時依你提供的資料播放的文件工作階段：文件、代理所做的編輯、代理和一位跟著閱讀的同事，以及標題下方的淺色行。在卡片沒有 `Blocks`、`Edits` 或 `Run` 時把它設為 `Simulation`：卡片顯示文件、播放編輯、說明什麼都沒有儲存，並在完整動態效果下循環（同事在短暫停頓後接受，然後重新開始）。

trans-unit.source: A browsable gallery of ready-made agents: a heading with a search field, category pills, a count with a sort switch, and a responsive grid of cards (mark, name, maker, one-line pitch, rating, installs, tags and an install button). A card opens a detail view in place of the grid with the description, what the agent can do, what it needs access to and prompts to try, where it can be installed or removed. Without data it shows an invented sample catalog. Installing goes through `InstallAsync` (a simulated 1.2 second install when it is null): the button shows progress, then the agent's id joins the two-way `InstalledIds` and `AgentInstalled` is raised; a failure shows its message with a retry and raises `InstallFailed`.
trans-unit.target: 可瀏覽的現成智慧體列表：帶搜尋框的頁首、分類膠囊、帶排序開關的數量列，以及自適應的卡片網格（標誌、名稱、作者、一句話介紹、評分、安裝數、標籤和安裝按鈕）。點開卡片會在網格的位置顯示詳情視圖：介紹、智慧體能做什麼、它需要存取什麼以及可以試問的提示，並可在其中安裝或移除。沒有資料時顯示一個虛構的範例目錄。安裝透過 `InstallAsync` 進行（為 null 時模擬一次 1.2 秒的安裝）：按鈕顯示進度，然後智慧體的 id 加入雙向的 `InstalledIds`，並觸發 `AgentInstalled`；失敗時顯示錯誤訊息並提供重試，同時觸發 `InstallFailed`。

trans-unit.source: Raised after an install finished and the id joined `InstalledIds`.
trans-unit.target: 安裝完成、id 已加入 `InstalledIds` 後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the detail view of an agent opens (a card, the keyboard or `Open`).
trans-unit.target: 打開一個智慧體的詳情視圖時觸發（卡片、鍵盤或 `Open`）。

trans-unit.source: The agents. A list that reports its changes (an `ObservableCollection`) is followed. Default: fourteen invented sample agents (`Agents`).
trans-unit.target: 智慧體列表。會跟隨能回報變化的列表（`ObservableCollection`）。預設：十四個虛構的範例智慧體（`Agents`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after an agent was removed and its id left `InstalledIds`.
trans-unit.target: 智慧體被移除、id 已離開 `InstalledIds` 後觸發。

trans-unit.source: The categories, in pill order after "All". Default: the six sample categories.
trans-unit.target: 分類，按膠囊順序排在「All」之後。預設：六個範例分類。

trans-unit.source: Culture of every count and date (default "en-US").
trans-unit.target: 所有數字和日期使用的地區（預設 "en-US"）。

trans-unit.source: The ids of the installed agents (two-way: an install adds its id, an uninstall removes it).
trans-unit.target: 已安裝智慧體的 id（雙向：安裝會加入 id，解除安裝會移除 id）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `InstallAsync` threw, with the message shown.
trans-unit.target: `InstallAsync` 擲出例外時觸發，帶有顯示的錯誤訊息。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text; replace the object to reword or translate the gallery.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字；替換這個物件即可改寫或翻譯商店。

trans-unit.source: The id of the agent whose detail view is shown (two-way); null shows the grid.
trans-unit.target: 顯示詳情視圖的智慧體的 id（雙向）；null 顯示網格。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a sample prompt in the detail view is pressed (start a chat with the agent and the prompt).
trans-unit.target: 按下詳情視圖中的範例提示時觸發（用這個智慧體和提示開始一個對話）。

trans-unit.source: How many agents the category and the search leave on screen.
trans-unit.target: 分類和搜尋之後留在螢幕上的智慧體數量。

trans-unit.source: The search text (two-way). It matches names, makers, pitches, tags and category names, ignoring case.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋文字（雙向）。比對名稱、作者、介紹、標籤和分類名，不區分大小寫。

trans-unit.source: A support conversation where an AI assistant hands off to a person (Arc Agent handoff, design reference). The assistant answers first; when it transfers, a card in the thread shows the summary it passes to the team and the typical wait. The person then joins and takes over, and a thin timeline on the left marks each step: the assistant, the handoff (with the help desk's mark), the person joining and the resolution. Drive it from your support backend: set `Stage`, keep the assistant's messages in `Messages` and everything after the handoff in `AgentMessages`, set `Typing`, `Summary` and `Agent`, and handle the events. Stream assistant text by updating a message's `Text` with `IsStreaming` set; each appended chunk fades in. Leave `Stage` unset for an empty chat, or to play a `Simulation` you pass in (`AgentHandoffSimulation`). The card fills its container up to 560px and has a fixed height (600 by default, set `Height`); the thread scrolls inside and stays pinned to the newest message, so the page never shifts and the width never follows the text.
trans-unit.target: AI 助理把對話轉交給真人的客服對話（Arc Agent handoff，設計參考）。助理先回答；轉接時，對話中的一張卡片顯示它交給團隊的摘要與一般的等候時間。接著真人加入並接手，左側一條細時間軸標出每一步：助理、轉接（附客服系統的標誌）、真人加入與問題解決。由你的客服後端驅動：設定 `Stage`，助理的訊息放在 `Messages`，轉接之後的一切放在 `AgentMessages`，設定 `Typing`、`Summary` 與 `Agent`，並處理事件。要串流輸出助理的文字，在設定了 `IsStreaming` 的訊息上更新 `Text`；每次附加的片段都會淡入。沒有設定 `Stage` 時顯示一個空對話，或播放你傳入的 `Simulation`（`AgentHandoffSimulation`）。卡片填滿容器，最寬 560px，高度固定（預設 600，可設定 `Height`）；對話在內部捲動並固定在最新訊息，所以頁面不會跳動，寬度也不會隨文字改變。

trans-unit.source: The words of the support chat an `AgentHandoffSimulation` plays, in the order they come: the customer opens, the assistant answers, the customer asks for a person, the assistant hands off with a `Summary`, the customer adds a note, the person (`Agent`) joins, greets, resolves and closes. The replies at the end answer the customer's own actions (Cancel, a typed message). A line left null is skipped. Share one script between simulations; it is only read.
trans-unit.target: `AgentHandoffSimulation` 播放的客服對話台詞，依出現順序排列：客戶開口，助理回答，客戶要求找真人，助理附上 `Summary` 轉接，客戶補充一則備註，真人（`Agent`）加入、問候、解決問題並結束。最後幾則回覆用來回應客戶自己的操作（取消、輸入的訊息）。為 null 的台詞會被略過。多個模擬可以共用同一份劇本；它只會被讀取。

trans-unit.source: A simulated support chat for `AgentHandoff` (Arc's `useHandoffSimulation`), for demos, prototypes and tests: it plays the `Script` you pass and exposes the stage, the messages, who is typing, the summary, the person and a notice, and takes the same actions as the view (talk to a person, cancel, try again, send). Set it as the card's `Simulation`: the card plays it while its own `Stage` is unset, from the top each time it is shown. The customer opens, the assistant streams its answers in chunks of 3 to 8 words about every 34ms, the customer asks for a person and the assistant hands off with a summary. In `Handoff` a person joins, resolves the issue and the chat, and the story starts over a few seconds later; in `Unavailable` nobody picks the transfer up and it waits for `Retry`. Reduced motion: replies appear whole and the story plays once. The card's clock runs at every motion level but only while the card is on screen, so the story pauses off screen. Use one simulation per card.
trans-unit.target: 為 `AgentHandoff` 提供的模擬客服對話（Arc 的 `useHandoffSimulation`），用於示範、原型和測試：它播放你傳入的 `Script`，公開階段、訊息、誰在輸入、摘要、接手的人與通知，並接受與畫面相同的動作（找真人、取消、重試、傳送）。把它設為卡片的 `Simulation`：卡片在自己的 `Stage` 未設定時播放它，每次顯示時從頭開始。客戶先開口，助理每隔約 34ms 以 3 到 8 個字詞的片段串流輸出回答，客戶要求找真人，助理附上摘要轉接。在 `Handoff` 中，真人加入、解決問題並結束對話，幾秒後故事重新開始；在 `Unavailable` 中，無人接手轉接，故事等待 `Retry`。減少動態效果時，回覆整段出現，故事只播放一次。卡片的時鐘在所有動態效果等級下執行，但只在卡片位於畫面上時執行，所以離開畫面時故事會暫停。每張卡片使用一個模擬。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the stage, the typing state, the summary, the person or the notice changes. Messages are observable on their own.
trans-unit.target: 階段、輸入狀態、摘要、接手的人或通知變化時觸發。訊息本身可以單獨觀察。

trans-unit.source: Which story to play: a handoff a person picks up, or one nobody picks up. A change starts the story over.
trans-unit.target: 要播放的故事：有人接手的轉接，或無人接手的轉接。修改會讓故事從頭開始。

trans-unit.source: The words of the chat; null plays an empty chat that still moves through the stages.
trans-unit.target: 對話的台詞；為 null 時播放一段沒有訊息、但仍會依序經過各階段的對話。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of the agent loop: a bright head with a gradient trail circles a ring past three stations (Gather context, Take action, Verify) around the model. At Gather a context block joins the stack beside the ring and the token total counts up; at Take action one to three tool calls drop out of the ring on a pin and resolve; at Verify a check passes or sends the loop round again. The run ends done (the ring draws in, a check at the center, the summary as the caption) or stopped when the last check fails. Play, pause, step, restart and a 0.5× / 1× / 2× speed control drive it; under reduced motion it opens on its end. The run is sample data: nothing calls a real service.
trans-unit.target: 代理循環的動畫講解：一個明亮的光點帶著漸層拖尾繞環而行，依序經過三個站點（收集上下文、執行動作、驗證）環繞模型。在收集上下文時，一個上下文區塊加入環旁的堆疊，token 總數逐步增加；在執行動作時，一到三個工具呼叫經由圖釘從環中落下並完成；在驗證時，檢查通過，或讓循環再次運行。運行結束時顯示完成（環線繪製收攏，中心出現勾號，摘要作為說明）或在最後一次檢查失敗時停止。播放、暫停、單步、重新開始以及 0.5×/1×/2× 速度控制項驅動演示；在減少動態效果下直接開啟結束狀態。此運行使用範例資料，不呼叫任何真實服務。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IterationsSource` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IterationsSource` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Labels` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Labels` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Phase` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Phase` 屬性。

trans-unit.target: 定義 `StationChanged` 路由事件。

trans-unit.target: 定義 `Summary` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Task` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Task` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: A tool call made at the Take action station: the tool, what it was asked to do and what came back.
trans-unit.target: 在執行動作站點發生的一次工具呼叫：呼叫的工具、請它做什麼，以及回傳了什麼。

trans-unit.source: The check at the Verify station: passed, or a retry note that sends the loop round again.
trans-unit.target: 驗證站點的檢查：通過，或一則讓循環再次運行的重試說明。

trans-unit.source: A block of context gathered at the start of a loop: a label, an optional detail and its size in tokens.

trans-unit.source: One pass round the loop: the context gathered, one to three tool calls made one after another, and the check. Calls are its content in XAML. Calls past the third are ignored; a loop with none still stops at Take action for the time of one call, with nothing dropping into the lane.
trans-unit.target: 循環的一輪：收集到的上下文、依序發出的一到三個工具呼叫，以及檢查。呼叫在 XAML 中作為其內容。超過第三個的呼叫會被忽略；沒有呼叫的循環仍會在執行動作站點停留一次呼叫的時間，且不會有任何內容落入泳道。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AgentLoop` shows or announces, in English by default (the playback buttons are named by `PlaybackLabels`). Replace the instance to translate or reword; texts with numbers or names are functions so that the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `AgentLoop` 顯示或朗讀的每一個文字，預設為英文（播放按鈕的名稱由 `PlaybackLabels` 指定）。替換整個實例即可翻譯或改寫；包含數字或名稱的文字為函數，以便調整詞序。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `StationChanged`: the head reached a station.
trans-unit.target: `StationChanged` 的參數：光點抵達了一個站點。

trans-unit.source: A card that shows what an assistant remembers about the person: a capacity meter, two switches (use saved memories, use chat history), filter pills by group, a search, and the memories themselves, which can be edited in place or forgotten with a few seconds to undo. A memory the assistant has just noted shows as a pill that files it into its group, and a field at the bottom adds one by hand and sorts it into a group. Changes are applied to `Memories` and reported through `MemoryChanged`; set `CommitAsync` to save them somewhere first (a failure shows in place and rolls the change back).
trans-unit.target: 一張卡片，顯示助手對使用者記住的內容：一個容量計量條、兩個開關（使用已儲存的記憶、使用聊天記錄）、依分組篩選的膠囊、一個搜尋框，以及記憶本身；記憶可以原地編輯，或在幾秒內復原前遺忘。助手剛記下的一則記憶會顯示為一個膠囊，點擊即可將其歸入對應分組；卡片底部的欄位可手動新增一則記憶並將其分入某個分組。變更會套用到 `Memories`，並透過 `MemoryChanged` 回報；可先設定 `CommitAsync` 將變更儲存到別處（失敗時會在原位顯示，並復原該變更）。

trans-unit.source: The assistant's name, used in the subtitle and the switches' explanations.
trans-unit.target: 助手的名稱，用於副標題和開關的說明文字中。

trans-unit.source: The capacity in characters of all the memories together; the meter shows the share used. Zero or less hides the meter and the limit.
trans-unit.target: 所有記憶合計的容量（以字元計）；計量條顯示已使用的比例。小於或等於零時隱藏計量條與上限。

trans-unit.source: The memories the assistant has just noted, when you give them as a list to follow; it wins over `Captured` when set.
trans-unit.target: 助手剛記下的記憶，以清單形式提供並需追蹤時使用；設定後優先於 `Captured`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the field to add a memory by hand is shown.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示手動新增記憶的欄位。

trans-unit.source: Whether the second switch ("Reference chat history") is on (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 第二個開關（「參考聊天記錄」）是否開啟（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the first switch ("Reference saved memories") is on (two-way). Off dims the list and pauses the captured pill.
trans-unit.target: 第一個開關（「參考已儲存的記憶」）是否開啟（雙向）。關閉時清單會變淡，並暫停已記下的膠囊。

trans-unit.source: Whether the search box is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 搜尋框是否展開（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 此區塊顯示或播報的每一個文字。

trans-unit.source: The list scrolls inside the card above this height.
trans-unit.target: 超過此高度後，清單會在卡片內捲動。

trans-unit.source: The longest a single memory may be, for editing and adding alike.
trans-unit.target: 單則記憶的最大長度，編輯與新增時皆適用。

trans-unit.source: The memories to show and change, when you give them as a list to follow; it wins over `Memories` when set.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示與變更的記憶，以清單形式提供並需追蹤時使用；設定後優先於 `Memories`。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a change is committed.
trans-unit.target: 變更提交後引發。

trans-unit.source: The text of the search (two-way). Searching covers all groups whatever the filter is.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋的文字（雙向）。無論篩選條件為何，搜尋都會涵蓋所有群組。

trans-unit.source: A lead agent delegating to sub-agents, shown live: a graph with the lead on top and a node per sub-agent, a dot on the line for every message (down for a task, back up for a result, across for a question between two sub-agents), a message log, and a detail panel for the selected agent with its task, what it is doing now and what it handed back. With no `Agents` the card plays an invented sample run (a lead and four sub-agents writing a launch brief). Give it your agents and either a `Script` to play, or drive the run from your code: `Start`, `Post` for each message, `SetStatus` and `Complete`. A message's `Kind` updates the agents: a task sets the receiver to working, a question sets the sender to waiting, a result sets it to done.
trans-unit.target: 一個主智慧體把工作分給多個子智慧體，並即時展示：圖的上方是主智慧體，下方每個子智慧體一個節點，每則訊息都會在線上顯示一個圓點（任務向下，結果向上返回，兩個子智慧體之間的問題橫向移動）；另有訊息記錄，以及顯示所選智慧體的任務、目前在做的事和交回結果的詳情面板。沒有 `Agents` 時，卡片會播放一段虛構的範例執行（一個主智慧體和四個子智慧體撰寫一份發布簡報）。傳入你的智慧體後，可以給出一個要播放的 `Script`，也可以用你的程式碼驅動執行：`Start`、為每則訊息呼叫 `Post`、`SetStatus` 和 `Complete`。訊息的 `Kind` 會更新智慧體：任務讓接收方開始工作，問題讓發送方進入等待，結果讓發送方完成。

trans-unit.source: The plan an agent writes before it acts, then works through as a live checklist (Arc Agent plan, design reference). A header shows the model's mark, "Plan · 6 steps" (the number rolls) and the goal. While `CurrentStatus` is `Draft` every step can be renamed in place (Enter saves, Escape undoes, Backspace in an empty title removes the step), dragged by its grip or moved with Alt and the arrow keys, removed or added to; Keep planning asks the agent for one more step, which streams in before the last one. Approve plan locks the plan: the grips become status marks, the header counts "3 of 6" over a thin progress line, the current step shimmers beside a spinning arc with its activity lines underneath, a finished step draws its check and settles to secondary text with its time, the agent can insert a step (a faint accent wash), a failed step offers Retry and Skip, the run can be paused, and the footer ends with the total time, a streamed one-line summary and Start over.
trans-unit.target: 智慧代理在行動前撰寫的計畫，隨後以即時清單的形式逐項執行（Arc 智慧代理計畫，設計參考）。頁首顯示模型的標記、"Plan · 6 steps"（數字滾動變化）和目標。當 `CurrentStatus` 為 `Draft` 時，每個步驟都可以原地重新命名（Enter 儲存，Escape 復原，標題為空時按 Backspace 刪除該步驟），可透過把手拖曳或使用 Alt 加方向鍵移動，也可以刪除或新增；繼續規劃（Keep planning）會請求智慧代理再新增一個步驟，該步驟會在最後一步之前串流出現。核准計畫（Approve plan）將計畫鎖定：把手變為狀態標記，頁首以細進度線顯示 "3 of 6" 計數，目前步驟在旋轉圓弧旁閃爍，其下方顯示活動行；已完成的步驟繪製勾號並沉降為次要文字，同時顯示耗時；智慧代理可以插入一個步驟（淡強調色底色），失敗的步驟提供重試（Retry）與略過（Skip），執行可以暫停，頁尾顯示總耗時、一行串流摘要以及重新開始（Start over）。

trans-unit.source: A simulated agent for an `AgentPlan` that has no `Status`: give it to `Simulation` and it answers the plan's buttons (Approve plan, Keep planning, Pause, Resume, Retry, Skip, Start over) and plays a scripted run, one step after the other, with the beats measured on the reference. Your app writes the content: the draft (`Steps`), what Keep planning suggests (`Suggestions`), the goal, the model and the summary; nothing ships with the package. Scripts are found by step id; a step without one runs `GenericScript`. It is event-driven: exactly one timer waits per state change, nothing runs while the plan is idle, and Pause keeps the remaining time of that timer so Resume continues where the run stopped. The data is read when the plan attaches the simulation; create one per plan, since it keeps the run's state.
trans-unit.target: 用於未設定 `Status` 的 `AgentPlan` 的模擬智慧代理：把它交給 `Simulation`，它會回應計畫的按鈕（核准計畫、繼續規劃、暫停、繼續、重試、略過、重新開始），並依照參考實作測得的節拍，逐步播放預設的執行過程。內容由你的應用程式撰寫：草稿（`Steps`）、繼續規劃給出的建議（`Suggestions`）、目標、模型與摘要；套件不附帶任何內容。腳本透過步驟 id 查找；沒有腳本的步驟執行 `GenericScript`。它由事件驅動：每次狀態變化只等待一個計時器，計畫閒置時不執行任何內容；暫停（Pause）會保留該計時器剩餘的時間，因此繼續（Resume）會從停止處接著執行。計畫掛接模擬時讀取這些資料；每個計畫各建一個，因為它保存執行狀態。

trans-unit.source: One step of an `AgentPlan`: an id, an instruction-style title, and while the plan runs its state, the activity lines the agent reports, an optional note (a suggested or agent-inserted step), the reason of a failure and the time a finished step took. Every property is observed, so changing a step updates the plan on screen.
trans-unit.target: `AgentPlan` 的一個步驟：一個 id、一個指令式標題；計畫執行時還包括其狀態、智慧代理回報的活動行、可選的備註（建議或智慧代理插入的步驟）、失敗原因以及已完成步驟所用的時間。每個屬性都會被觀察，因此修改步驟會更新畫面上的計畫。

trans-unit.target: 執行寬度不超過 480 時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Whether the built-in sample run is shown (no `Steps` given).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示內建範例執行（未提供 `Steps`）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the run shows or reads out, with English defaults.
trans-unit.target: 執行顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Retry or Run again. Start a new run and reset the properties here.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按下 Retry 或 Run again 時引發。請在這裡開始新的執行並重設屬性。

trans-unit.source: Where the run stands (two-way: Stop sets Stopped, and the sample run sets every state).
trans-unit.target: 執行所處的狀態（雙向：Stop 設為 Stopped，範例執行會設定每種狀態）。

trans-unit.source: The steps in the order they happened. A collection that raises change notifications (such as an `ObservableCollection`) is followed as steps arrive; each step's own changes are followed too. Null (the default) plays the built-in sample run.
trans-unit.target: 按發生順序排列的步驟。會跟隨能發出變更通知的集合（例如 `ObservableCollection`）中新到的步驟，也會跟隨每個步驟自身的變化。Null（預設）播放內建範例執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a step's detail opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 步驟詳情展開或收起時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Stop (before the run is marked stopped). Cancel your agent here.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按下 Stop 時引發（在執行被標為已停止之前）。請在這裡取消你的智慧體。

trans-unit.source: The tokens the run has used so far; zero hides the count.
trans-unit.target: 執行到目前為止用掉的 token；為零時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: A file touched by an `FileEdit` step.
trans-unit.target: `FileEdit` 步驟改動的一個檔案。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AgentRun` shows or reads out, with English defaults. Words built from values are functions, so an app can apply its own grammar. Assign a new instance to `Labels` to change them.
trans-unit.target: `AgentRun` 顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。由值組成的文字是函式，應用程式可以套用自己的語法。給 `Labels` 指派一個新執行個體即可修改。

trans-unit.source: A scripted agent run for `AgentRunSimulation`: the agent, its steps with their timing, the outcome and the notices the simulation announces for each action. Your app writes the run; nothing ships with the package. Data only.
trans-unit.target: 用於 `AgentRunSimulation` 的腳本化智慧代理執行：代理、其帶時序的步驟、結果，以及模擬為每個操作宣告的通知。執行由你的應用程式撰寫，套件不附帶任何執行。僅為資料。

trans-unit.source: One step of an `AgentRunScenario`: its present- and past-tense labels, icon and active duration, an optional count that ticks in place, an optional approval gate before it runs and an optional failure on its first attempt.
trans-unit.target: `AgentRunScenario` 的一個步驟：其進行式與完成式標籤、圖示以及活動時長；可選的計數（原地跳動）、執行前可選的核准關卡，以及首次嘗試時可選的失敗。

trans-unit.source: Plays an `AgentRunScenario` as a live run: after `StartDelay` of Ready it works through the steps on the scenario's timing, ticks counts in place, waits for as long as it takes on an approval or a failure, and reacts to Pause, Resume, Stop, Approve, Deny, Retry and Open run. Nothing runs for real: every action only changes this object's state and says so through `Notice`. It holds no UI: give it to `Simulation` (which copies its state into the pill and routes the pill's buttons back to it), or read its state yourself after each `Changed`. Timing uses the given `TimeProvider` (the system clock by default; tests pass a manual one), and its callbacks run on the synchronization context that created the simulation (the UI thread).
trans-unit.target: 將 `AgentRunScenario` 作為即時執行播放：在 `StartDelay` 的就緒（Ready）狀態之後，依照情境的時序逐步執行各步驟，原地更新計數，遇到核准或失敗時等待所需的時長，並回應暫停（Pause）、繼續（Resume）、停止（Stop）、核准（Approve）、拒絕（Deny）、重試（Retry）與開啟執行（Open run）。沒有任何內容真正執行：每個操作只改變此物件的狀態，並透過 `Notice` 說明這一點。它不包含介面：將其交給 `Simulation`（它把狀態複製到膠囊中，並將膠囊的按鈕路由回此物件），或在每次 `Changed` 之後自行讀取其狀態。計時使用給定的 `TimeProvider`（預設為系統時鐘；測試時傳入手動時鐘），其回呼在建立此模擬的同步內容（UI 執行緒）上執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every change of the state (a beat, an action, a restart).
trans-unit.target: 在狀態每次變更之後引發（一個節拍、一個操作或一次重新開始）。

trans-unit.source: One step of an `AgentRun`. An `AvaloniaObject`: change `Status`, `Output` or `Duration` while the run is on screen and the timeline follows.
trans-unit.target: `AgentRun` 的一個步驟。它是 `AvaloniaObject`：執行顯示在螢幕上時修改 `Status`、`Output` 或 `Duration`，時間線會跟著變化。

trans-unit.source: How long the step took; null while it runs or when unknown.
trans-unit.target: 步驟用了多長時間；執行中或未知時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The files a file edit step touched.
trans-unit.target: 檔案改動步驟涉及的檔案。

trans-unit.source: What the tool was given, shown as written (often JSON or a command line).
trans-unit.target: 交給工具的輸入，按原樣顯示（通常是 JSON 或命令列）。

trans-unit.source: What the step is.
trans-unit.target: 步驟的類型。

trans-unit.source: What the tool returned, or why the step failed.
trans-unit.target: 工具傳回的內容，或步驟失敗的原因。

trans-unit.source: Where the step stands.
trans-unit.target: 步驟所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: The reasoning of a thinking step or the text of a message; null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 思考步驟的推理或訊息的文字；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The one-line title of the step ("Search the code for the upload route").
trans-unit.target: 步驟的一行標題（"Search the code for the upload route"）。

trans-unit.source: The tool a tool call runs ("search_code"), shown in mono type next to the title.
trans-unit.target: 工具呼叫執行的工具（"search_code"），以等寬字型顯示在標題旁邊。

trans-unit.source: A compact live status pill for a running agent (Arc Agent status, design reference): the agent's mark inside a thin live ring, the current activity with a matching icon, and an elapsed timer in tabular figures. A new activity rolls in from below while the pill's width follows on a spring, and the label fades at its right edge while it is wider than its room. Pressing the pill opens it in place into a small floating panel with the latest steps (icon, text, duration), a segmented step progress bar and Pause, Stop and Open run; Escape or a press outside closes it and returns focus to the pill. It covers idle (Ready), working, needs input (an accent dot and inline Approve and Deny), paused, done (the ring closes and the mark becomes a drawn check, then it settles back to Ready), failed (with Retry) and stopped. Drive it from your agent's events: set `Status`, keep `Activity` to the latest tool call in the present tense, add `Steps`, give a fixed `StartedAt` (the timer leaves out paused and failed time itself) and handle the action events; `Actions` chooses which buttons are offered, the counterpart of showing a control only when its handler exists. Without run data of its own it plays a `Simulation` when one is set (your scripted run), and otherwise rests at Ready.
trans-unit.target: 執行中智慧代理的精簡即時狀態膠囊（Arc 智慧代理狀態，設計參考）：代理標記位於細的即時環內，顯示目前活動及與之相符的圖示，並以表格數字顯示已用時間。新活動從下方滾入，膠囊寬度以彈簧方式跟隨變化，標籤寬於可用空間時在右側邊緣淡出。按下膠囊會就地展開為一個小型浮動面板，列出最新步驟（圖示、文字、耗時）、分段式步驟進度條，以及暫停（Pause）、停止（Stop）和開啟執行（Open run）按鈕；按下 Escape 或在外部按下即可關閉面板，並將焦點返回膠囊。它涵蓋閒置（就緒，Ready）、工作中、需要輸入（強調色圓點，並內嵌核准（Approve）與拒絕（Deny））、已暫停、已完成（環閉合，標記變為繪製的勾號，隨後回落到就緒）、失敗（帶重試（Retry））與已停止。請透過智慧代理的事件驅動它：設定 `Status`，將 `Activity` 保持為最新的工具呼叫（現在式），新增 `Steps`，給出固定的 `StartedAt`（計時器自行排除暫停與失敗的時間），並處理操作事件；`Actions` 選擇提供哪些按鈕，這相當於僅在存在處理常式時才顯示控制項。沒有自己的執行資料時，若設定了 `Simulation`（你撰寫的腳本化執行）便播放它，否則停在就緒狀態。

trans-unit.source: Which action buttons may show (all by default); a button also needs the right state.
trans-unit.target: 可顯示哪些操作按鈕（預設全部）；按鈕還需要對應的狀態。

trans-unit.source: What the agent does now, in the present tense. While input is needed it is the request ("Needs your approval to run a command"), when done it is the outcome that follows "Done in …", and after a failure it is the failure.
trans-unit.target: 智慧代理目前正在做什麼，使用現在式。需要輸入時為請求內容（"Needs your approval to run a command"）；完成時為結果，接在 "Done in …" 之後；失敗後為失敗原因。

trans-unit.source: The agent and its mark (drawn at 12px inside the ring); null takes the simulated run's agent, or a plain "Agent" with a default mark.
trans-unit.target: 智慧代理及其標記（在環內以 12px 繪製）；為 null 時使用模擬執行的代理，否則顯示一般的 "Agent"，並使用預設標記。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Approve is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下核准（Approve）時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Deny is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下拒絕（Deny）時引發。

trans-unit.source: When the run ended; by default the moment the status turned done or stopped.
trans-unit.target: 執行結束的時間；預設為狀態變為已完成或已停止的時刻。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the panel opens or closes.
trans-unit.target: 面板開啟或關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: Whether the panel is open. Two-way: pressing the pill, Escape and a press outside change it.
trans-unit.target: 面板是否開啟。雙向繫結：按下膠囊、Escape 以及外部按下都會改變它。

trans-unit.source: The words and number formats; replace to translate or reword.
trans-unit.target: 文字與數字格式；替換即可翻譯或改寫。

trans-unit.source: How many of the latest steps the panel lists (5); older ones slide out at the top.
trans-unit.target: 面板列出的最新步驟數量（5）；較舊的步驟會從頂部滑出。

trans-unit.source: A one-off message for screen readers, such as the result of an action; it joins the status announcement.
trans-unit.target: 供螢幕閱讀器朗讀的一次性訊息，例如某個操作的結果；它會與狀態播報合併。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Open run is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下開啟執行（Open run）時引發。

trans-unit.source: Which edge of the pill the panel grows from.
trans-unit.target: 面板從膠囊的哪一邊緣展開。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Pause is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下暫停時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Resume is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下繼續時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Retry is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下重試時觸發。

trans-unit.source: How long after done or stopped the pill settles back to Ready (4 seconds); null keeps the result on screen.
trans-unit.target: 執行完成或停止後，狀態膠囊回到就緒狀態前等待的時間（4 秒）；為 null 時結果會一直保留在畫面上。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a finished or stopped run settles back to Ready.
trans-unit.target: 執行完成或停止後回到就緒狀態時觸發。

trans-unit.source: A simulated run that drives the pill while the app sets no `Status`, `Activity`, `StartedAt` or steps: the pill starts it once attached, shows its status, activity, steps and times, and routes its buttons back to it. Null (the default) leaves a pill without data at Ready. Give each pill its own.
trans-unit.target: 模擬執行，在應用程式未設定 `Status`、`Activity`、`StartedAt` 或步驟時驅動膠囊：膠囊掛載後啟動它，顯示其狀態、活動、步驟與時間，並將按鈕轉回給它。為 null（預設）時，沒有資料的膠囊停在就緒狀態。每個膠囊各用一個。

trans-unit.source: When the run started: the timer counts from here and leaves out time spent paused or failed.
trans-unit.target: 執行開始的時間：計時器從此處開始計時，並且不計入暫停或失敗期間所花的時間。

trans-unit.source: Where the run is. Setting it (or `Activity`, `StartedAt` or a step) shows your data instead of a `Simulation`.
trans-unit.target: 執行所處的狀態。設定它（或 `Activity`、`StartedAt`、某個步驟）後，膠囊顯示你的資料，而不是 `Simulation`。

trans-unit.source: The steps list: every step of the run, pending ones included, so the progress bar knows the total.
trans-unit.target: 步驟清單：包含執行的每一個步驟（含尚未開始的步驟），讓進度條得知總數。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Stop is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下停止時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The clock for the timer and the settle delay (the system clock by default; tests pass a manual one).
trans-unit.target: 計時器與延遲回落所使用的時脈（預設為系統時脈；測試時傳入手動時脈）。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of the action events of an `AgentStatus` (Pause, Resume, Stop, Approve, Deny, Retry, Open run).
trans-unit.target: `AgentStatus` 動作事件的參數（暫停、繼續、停止、核准、拒絕、重試、開啟執行）。

trans-unit.source: What an agent is doing now: a short present-tense label ("Reading 12 files"), an optional icon and an optional count that ticks in place ("8 of 12"). While input is needed the label is the request, when done it is the outcome that follows "Done in …", and after a failure it is the failure. Immutable: set a new instance to change it; a new label or icon rolls in, a changed count only changes its digits.
trans-unit.target: 智慧代理目前正在做的事：一段簡短的現在式標籤（"Reading 12 files"）、可選的圖示以及可選的計數，計數會原地跳動（"8 of 12"）。需要輸入時，標籤為請求內容；完成時，標籤為結果，接在 "Done in …" 之後；失敗後，標籤為失敗訊息。此物件不可變：如需變更，請設定新實例；新的標籤或圖示會滾入，計數變化時只更新其數字。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ExpandedChangedEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `ExpandedChangedEvent` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AgentStatus` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance (or set its properties) to translate or reword; texts with numbers or names are functions so that the word order can change. The durations they receive are already formatted by `FormatTimer`, `FormatTotal` and the other format functions.
trans-unit.target: `AgentStatus` 顯示或播報的每一個文字，預設為英文。替換此實例（或設定其屬性）即可翻譯或改寫；含數字或名稱的文字為函式，以便調整詞序。它們接收的時長已由 `FormatTimer`、`FormatTotal` 等格式化函式處理完畢。

trans-unit.source: One step of an agent's run in an `AgentStatus`. List every step, pending ones included, so the progress bar knows the total; the panel lists the latest finished and running ones. Write a running step's label in the present tense and a finished one's in the past tense ("Running tests", then "Passed 12 of 12 tests"), so the words carry the state. Changes reach the screen at once (each property is observed).
trans-unit.target: `AgentStatus` 中智慧代理執行的一個步驟。應列出每一個步驟（含尚未開始的步驟），讓進度條得知總數；面板會列出最近完成的和正在進行的步驟。正在進行步驟的標籤使用現在式，已完成步驟的標籤使用過去式（"Running tests"，隨後為 "Passed 12 of 12 tests"），讓文字本身表達狀態。變更會立即反映到畫面上（每個屬性都會被監聽）。

trans-unit.source: How long a finished step took; shown with one decimal ("1.9s").
trans-unit.target: 已完成步驟的耗時；以一位小數顯示（"1.9s"）。

trans-unit.source: A 24 × 24 stroked glyph drawn at 16px before the label (a Lucide icon), or null.
trans-unit.target: 一個 24 × 24 的描邊圖形，以 16px 繪製於標籤之前（Lucide 圖示），或為 null。

trans-unit.source: A stable id for the step (keeps its row when the label changes).
trans-unit.target: 步驟的穩定 ID（標籤變化時仍保留其列）。

trans-unit.source: What the step does or did.
trans-unit.target: 步驟正在做或已做的事。

trans-unit.source: When an active or waiting step started; its time counts in whole seconds from here, leaving out paused time.
trans-unit.target: 活動或等待中的步驟的開始時間；其耗時以整秒從此處計算，並且不計入暫停的時間。

trans-unit.source: Where the step is; pending steps only count in the progress bar.
trans-unit.target: 步驟所處的狀態；待開始的步驟僅計入進度條。

trans-unit.source: A task delegated to an agent. An `AvaloniaObject`: change `Status`, `Progress` or `Note` while the board is on screen and the card follows (and moves column).
trans-unit.target: 交給智慧體的任務。它是 `AvaloniaObject`：看板顯示在螢幕上時修改 `Status`、`Progress` 或 `Note`，卡片會跟著變化（並換欄）。

trans-unit.source: The name of the agent that owns the task.
trans-unit.target: 負責該任務的智慧體名稱。

trans-unit.source: Your id of the task, handed back in `TaskOpened`.
trans-unit.target: 你為任務定的 id，在 `TaskOpened` 中交回。

trans-unit.source: A short line under the title: the current step, the question for the person, or the error.
trans-unit.target: 標題下的一行短文字：目前步驟、給人的提問或錯誤。

trans-unit.source: How far a running task is, from 0 to 1.
trans-unit.target: 進行中的任務完成了多少，從 0 到 1。

trans-unit.source: Where the task stands.
trans-unit.target: 任務所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: What the task is ("Draft the March release notes").
trans-unit.target: 任務是什麼（"Draft the March release notes"）。

trans-unit.source: When the task last changed; shown as a relative time.
trans-unit.target: 任務最後一次變化的時間；顯示為相對時間。

trans-unit.source: A board of tasks handed to AI agents: four columns (Queued, Running, Needs you, Done) of cards that show the task, the agent that owns it, its progress or its question, and when it last changed. Chips filter the board by agent, and pressing a card (or Enter on it) raises `TaskOpened` so the app can open that task's run. Give it your tasks through `Tasks`; a task's changes move its card. Without `Tasks` it shows sample tasks whose running ones progress on their own.
trans-unit.target: 交給 AI 智慧體的任務看板：四欄（Queued、Running、Needs you、Done）卡片，顯示任務、負責的智慧體、進度或提問，以及最後一次變化的時間。篩選按鈕按智慧體篩選看板，按下卡片（或在卡片上按 Enter）會引發 `TaskOpened`，讓應用程式開啟該任務的執行。透過 `Tasks` 提供你的任務；任務的變化會移動其卡片。未設定 `Tasks` 時顯示範例任務，其中進行中的任務會自己推進。

trans-unit.source: The agent whose tasks show; null shows every agent (two-way: the chips write it).
trans-unit.target: 只顯示其任務的智慧體；null 顯示所有智慧體（雙向：篩選按鈕會寫入它）。

trans-unit.source: True while the board is at most 720 wide.
trans-unit.target: 看板寬度不超過 720 時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Whether the sample tasks are shown (no `Tasks` given).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示範例任務（未提供 `Tasks`）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the board shows or reads out, with English defaults.
trans-unit.target: 看板顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person opens a task's run (a press on its card, or Enter).
trans-unit.target: 使用者開啟任務的執行時引發（按下卡片或按 Enter）。

trans-unit.source: The tasks. A collection that raises change notifications is followed; each task's own changes are followed too. Null (the default) shows sample tasks that progress on their own.
trans-unit.target: 任務。會跟隨能發出變更通知的集合，也會跟隨每個任務自身的變化。Null（預設）顯示會自己推進的範例任務。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AgentTasks` board shows or reads out, with English defaults. Words built from values are functions, so an app can apply its own grammar. Assign a new instance to `Labels` to change them.

trans-unit.source: A compact timeline of one orchestrated multi-agent run: the orchestrator and its subagents share a time axis, one row each (color dot, name, model). Spans show thinking (a tint of the agent's color), tool calls (solid) and waiting (hatched); thin elbow connectors show work handed down to a subagent and results coming back up, with a dot where they meet the upper row. The run replays: a playhead sweeps, the active span grows with a square leading edge and a short shine, connectors draw in as handoffs happen, and the header counts time, tokens and cost until it settles into a summary with the parallel speedup. Hover or focus a span for a card with what it did; click it (or press Enter) to pin it and dim everything off its handoff path. Play, pause, restart, a speed control and scrubbing on the axis drive the replay; live mode follows a run in progress.
trans-unit.target: 一次由編排器協調的多智慧代理執行的精簡時間軸：編排器與其子智慧代理共享同一時間軸，每個智慧代理佔一列（色點、名稱、模型）。區段表示思考（智慧代理顏色的淡色調）、工具呼叫（實心）和等待（斜線填滿）；細肘形連接線表示交給子智慧代理的工作以及結果回傳，兩者在與上一列相交處帶有一個圓點。執行會重播：播放頭掃過，活動區段以方形前緣和短暫光澤增長，連接線在交接發生時逐步繪出，標題列計算時間、權杖數和成本，直至沉澱為帶有平行加速比的摘要。將滑鼠懸停或聚焦在區段上會顯示一張說明其所做工作的提示卡；點擊（或按 Enter）可固定它，並使其交接路徑之外的內容變暗。播放、暫停、重新開始、速度控制以及在時間軸上拖曳定位都可驅動重播；即時模式會跟隨進行中的執行。

trans-unit.source: One agent of a run, shown as a row of an `AgentTimeline`: a color dot, its name and its model. The first agent of a run is the orchestrator. Data only; set it before handing the run to the timeline.

trans-unit.source: Work handed from one agent to another at a moment of the run: drawn as a thin elbow connector with a dot where it meets the upper row. Handing work down a row (orchestrator to subagent) is a dispatch: it drops at `At` and enters the target's next span. Handing it up (subagent to orchestrator) is a result: it leaves the end of the source's last span and rises to the target at `At`.
trans-unit.target: 在執行的某一時刻，從一個智慧代理交給另一個智慧代理的工作：以細肘形連接線繪製，並在與上一列相交處帶有一個圓點。沿列向下交接（編排器到子智慧代理）為分派：在 `At` 處落下，並進入目標的下一個區段。向上交接（子智慧代理到編排器）為結果：從來源智慧代理最後一個區段的末端離開，並在 `At` 處升至目標。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AgentTimeline` shows or speaks, with English defaults. Sentences with numbers are format delegates; numbers reach them already rounded (times in seconds to one decimal, speeds as given). Replace the whole object to translate the timeline.
trans-unit.target: `AgentTimeline` 顯示或朗讀的每一個文字，預設為英文。含數字的句子由格式化函式產生；數字傳入前已取整（時間以秒為單位保留一位小數，速度按給定值）。替換整個物件即可翻譯時間軸。

trans-unit.source: Plays a finished run into an `AgentTimeline` as if it were happening now, for demos of live mode: it hands the timeline a growing copy of the run (`LiveRun`), turns `IsLive` on, and on a wall-clock timer appends each span when it starts (without an end), sets its end when it finishes and appends each handoff at its moment, the way events would arrive from a backend. When the source run is over it turns live mode off, so the timeline settles on its summary.
trans-unit.target: 將一次已完成的執行以「彷彿正在發生」的方式重播到 `AgentTimeline` 中，用於即時模式展示：它向時間軸提供一份不斷增長的執行副本（`LiveRun`），開啟 `IsLive`，並依牆上時鐘計時器在每個區段開始時追加該區段（不帶結束時間），在其完成時設定結束時間，並在交接發生的時刻追加每次交接，就像事件從後端到達一樣。來源執行結束後，它會關閉即時模式，使時間軸沉澱為摘要。

trans-unit.target: 整個執行抵達且即時模式已關閉後觸發。

trans-unit.source: One orchestrated run for an `AgentTimeline`: its agents (rows, the orchestrator first), their spans and the handoffs between them. The three lists are observed: append spans and handoffs as events arrive in a live run, and set a span's `End` when it closes.
trans-unit.target: `AgentTimeline` 的一次編排執行：其智慧代理（各佔一列，編排器居首）、各自的區段以及它們之間的交接。三個清單均會被監聽：在即時執行中隨事件抵達追加區段和交接，並在區段關閉時設定其 `End`。

trans-unit.source: One stretch of an agent's work on the time axis of an `AgentTimeline`: thinking, a tool call or waiting, from `Start` to `End` in seconds from the start of the run. An open span (no `End`) grows to the current time in a live run. Changes to its properties reach the timeline at once.

trans-unit.source: A page that answers one question, written like an article: the reasoning first, then the sources as small cards, then the answer streamed in with headings, lists, a table, code and numbered citations. Pointing at a citation lights the sentence it supports and its source card; pointing at a card lights every sentence that cites it. Under the answer are actions (copy, answer again, rate, share, versions), the model line and related questions, and a box asks a follow-up. Asking again replaces the answer in place: this is one question at a time, not a conversation.
trans-unit.target: 一個回答單一問題的頁面，以文章的形式呈現：先是推理，然後是以小卡片呈現的來源，接著是串流輸出的回答，包含標題、清單、表格、程式碼和編號引用。指向某個引用時，會點亮它所支持的句子及其來源卡片；指向某張卡片時，會點亮所有引用它的句子。回答下方有動作（複製、重新回答、評分、分享、版本）、模型資訊列和相關問題，並有一個方塊可以追問。重新提問會在原處取代回答：這是一次只處理一個問題的頁面，而非對話。
