trans-unit.source: A chat with an assistant: a title menu, a model button and a new chat button on top, a thread of turns in the middle and a message box at the bottom. Replies stream in as Markdown with collapsible reasoning, tool chips, numbered citations that preview their source, and actions to copy, retry, rate and switch between versions. Editing a message or retrying a reply makes a new version of the turn; the turns after it belong to the version they followed. The chat calls `Responder` to answer, shows what it sends as it arrives and lets the person stop a reply. Without a responder, a sent message only appears in the thread and raises `MessageSent`, and your code fills the `AiChatReply` itself.
trans-unit.target: 與助理的對話：頂部為標題選單、模型按鈕與新增對話按鈕，中間為輪次列表，底部為訊息輸入框。回覆以 Markdown 串流呈現，包含可摺疊的推理過程、工具標籤、可預覽來源的編號引用，以及複製、重試、評分和在版本間切換的操作。編輯訊息或重試回覆會為該輪次建立新版本；其後的輪次屬於它們所接續的版本。對話透過 `Responder` 作答，邊到達邊顯示其送出的內容，並允許使用者停止回覆。若沒有回應器，送出的訊息只會出現在列表中並引發 `MessageSent`，由你的程式碼自行填入 `AiChatReply`。

trans-unit.source: The file types that may be attached, in the syntax of `FileDropzone.Accept`; null accepts any.
trans-unit.target: 可附加的檔案類型，語法與 `FileDropzone.Accept` 相同；為 null 時接受任何類型。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses a citation or a source row; set `Handled` to open it yourself.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按下引用或來源列時引發；設定 `Handled` 以便由你自行開啟。

trans-unit.source: The width of the column of turns (760 by default); the thread is this plus 28 on each side.
trans-unit.target: 輪次欄的寬度（預設 760）；對話區域在兩側各再加 28。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the first message of an empty chat creates a conversation.
trans-unit.target: 當空白對話的第一則訊息建立了一個對話時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person opens a conversation from the menu.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者從選單中開啟一個對話時引發。

trans-unit.source: The conversation that is shown (two-way). Null shows the empty chat; the first message then creates one.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的對話（雙向繫結）。為 null 時顯示空白對話；此時送出第一則訊息會建立一個對話。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person rates a reply or takes the rating back.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者評價某則回覆或收回評價時引發。

trans-unit.source: The heading of the empty chat; null shows `Greeting`.
trans-unit.target: 空白對話的標題；為 null 時顯示 `Greeting`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the attach button and dropping files are on.
trans-unit.target: 是否啟用附件按鈕以及拖放檔案的功能。

trans-unit.source: Whether a reply of the shown conversation is thinking or streaming (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的對話中是否有回覆正在思考或串流輸出（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the thread follows new content at the bottom (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 對話列表是否在底部跟隨新內容（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 此控制項顯示或朗讀的每一段文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person sends a message, including an edited one, and when a reply is retried (the turn's new or renewed reply is thinking: without a `Responder` your code answers it).
trans-unit.target: 當使用者送出訊息（包括編輯後的訊息）以及重試回覆時引發。該輪次新的或已更新的回覆處於思考中：若未設定 `Responder`，需由你的程式碼作答。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person picks another model.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者選擇另一個模型時引發。

trans-unit.source: Run when the person starts a new chat.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者開始新對話時執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person asks for a new chat; set `Handled` to do it yourself.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者要求新對話時引發；設定 `Handled` 以便由你自行處理。

trans-unit.source: The placeholder of the message box; null shows `Placeholder`.
trans-unit.target: 訊息輸入框的預留文字；為 null 時顯示 `Placeholder`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a reply ends: done, stopped or failed.
trans-unit.target: 當回覆結束時引發：完成、被停止或失敗。

trans-unit.source: Provides the replies; null leaves answering to your code.
trans-unit.target: 提供回覆內容；為 null 時由你的程式碼負責作答。

trans-unit.source: How often streamed text is released (34 ms): each step shows a few whole words.
trans-unit.target: 串流文字的釋出頻率（34 毫秒）：每一步顯示若干個完整單字。

trans-unit.source: The selected model (two-way); null selects the first model once.
trans-unit.target: 目前選取的模型（雙向繫結）；為 null 時僅在首次自動選取第一個模型。

trans-unit.source: Shows the detail of a `Custom` tool; the data context is the `AiChatTool`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示 `Custom` 工具的詳細資訊；資料內容為 `AiChatTool`。

trans-unit.source: How many whole words each step shows (3).
trans-unit.target: 每一步顯示的完整單字數（3）。

trans-unit.source: A conversation: a title and the turns of its first version of events.
trans-unit.target: 一個對話：一個標題，以及其第一個版本事件對應的輪次。

trans-unit.source: The heading of the menu group the conversation is listed under, such as "Today".
trans-unit.target: 該對話所在選單分組的標題，例如 "今天"。

trans-unit.source: Stable id.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 ID。

trans-unit.source: The id of the model the conversation last used.
trans-unit.target: 該對話最近使用的模型的 ID。

trans-unit.source: The title in the menu; empty takes the first six words of the first message, then "Untitled chat".
trans-unit.target: 選單中顯示的標題；為空時取第一則訊息的前六個單字，再退而顯示 "未命名對話"。

trans-unit.source: The assistant's answer to a prompt: reasoning, tool calls, sources, the text and how it ended.
trans-unit.target: 助理對一次提問的回答：推理過程、工具呼叫、來源、正文以及結束方式。

trans-unit.source: Why the reply failed.
trans-unit.target: 回覆失敗的原因。

trans-unit.source: The person's rating (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 使用者的評價（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: The id of the model that wrote it (an `Id`); decides the mark next to the reply.
trans-unit.target: 撰寫該回覆的模型的 ID（即 `Id`）；決定回覆旁邊的標記。

trans-unit.source: The reasoning text, shown under "Thought for 3s" when opened.
trans-unit.target: 推理文字，展開後顯示在「思考了 3 秒」之下。

trans-unit.source: Where the reply is in its life.
trans-unit.target: 回覆所處的生命週期階段。

trans-unit.source: The reply text in the Markdown subset: paragraphs, lists, short headings, bold, inline code, code blocks and "[n]" citations.
trans-unit.target: 回覆正文，採用 Markdown 子集：段落、清單、短標題、粗體、行內程式碼、程式碼區塊以及 "[n]" 形式的引用。

trans-unit.source: How long the model thought; null uses the measured time, rounded to seconds (at least 1).
trans-unit.target: 模型思考的時長；為 null 時使用實測時間，並四捨五入到秒（至少 1 秒）。

trans-unit.source: A prompt shown in the empty chat that sends itself when pressed.
trans-unit.target: 空白對話中顯示的提示，按下即自動送出。

trans-unit.source: A 24 × 24 icon geometry.
trans-unit.target: 24 × 24 圖示的幾何圖形。

trans-unit.source: The text of the button.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: What is sent; null sends the label.
trans-unit.target: 實際送出的內容；為 null 時送出 `Label` 的文字。

trans-unit.source: A tool call of a reply, such as a search or a query, shown as a chip that can open a detail panel.
trans-unit.target: 回覆中的一次工具呼叫，例如搜尋或查詢，顯示為一個可開啟詳細資訊面板的標籤。

trans-unit.source: The name once done, such as "Searched the web".
trans-unit.target: 完成後的名稱，例如 "已搜尋網頁"。

trans-unit.source: The icon of a finished tool; null picks Search for searches and a database for queries.
trans-unit.target: 已完成工具的圖示；為 null 時，搜尋使用 Search 圖示，查詢使用資料庫圖示。

trans-unit.source: Stable id; stream updates with the same id change the same tool.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 ID；使用相同 ID 的串流更新會修改同一個工具。

trans-unit.source: The statement of a query, shown in a monospace block.
trans-unit.target: 查詢的陳述式，以等寬字型的程式碼區塊顯示。

trans-unit.source: What the tool does.
trans-unit.target: 該工具的用途。

trans-unit.source: The result of a query.
trans-unit.target: 查詢的結果。

trans-unit.source: The label before the result; null shows `AiChatLabels.Result`.
trans-unit.target: 結果前的標籤；為 null 時顯示 `AiChatLabels.Result`。

trans-unit.source: The name while running, such as "Searching the web".
trans-unit.target: 執行中的名稱，例如 "正在搜尋網頁"。

trans-unit.source: Where the tool call is.
trans-unit.target: 該工具呼叫所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: A short result after the name: "4 sources", "212 rows" or the reason it failed.
trans-unit.target: 名稱之後的簡短結果，例如 "4 個來源"、"212 列"，或失敗的原因。

trans-unit.source: A question and its answer, with every version of them (edits and retries).
trans-unit.target: 一個提問及其回答，包含它們的所有版本（編輯與重試產生的版本）。

trans-unit.source: Which version is shown (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的版本（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: One version of a turn: a prompt, its reply and what happened after it. Editing a prompt or retrying a finished reply adds a version; the turns that came after belong to the version they followed.
trans-unit.target: 輪次的一個版本：一個提示、其回覆以及之後發生的事情。編輯提示或重試已完成的回覆會新增一個版本；其後的輪次屬於它們所接續的版本。

trans-unit.source: What the person asked in this version.
trans-unit.target: 使用者在該版本中提出的問題。

trans-unit.source: The reply to it.
trans-unit.target: 對該問題的回覆。

trans-unit.source: What the person wrote: the text and the files attached to it.
trans-unit.target: 使用者所寫的內容：文字以及附帶的檔案。

trans-unit.source: The text in the Markdown subset; the bubble shows inline code, the editor the source.
trans-unit.target: 採用 Markdown 子集的文字；氣泡中顯示行內程式碼，編輯器中顯示原始文字。

trans-unit.source: A command the person can start a prompt with, such as "/recap".
trans-unit.target: 人員可以用來開始提示的命令，例如 "/recap"。

trans-unit.source: One line that says what it does.
trans-unit.target: 一行文字，說明它的作用。

trans-unit.source: A 24 × 24 icon geometry (a Lucide path works).
trans-unit.target: 24 × 24 的圖示幾何圖形（Lucide 路徑即可）。

trans-unit.source: Stable id reported in tokens.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼，在權杖中回報。

trans-unit.source: The name without the slash; the person filters by its start, ignoring case.
trans-unit.target: 不含斜線的名稱；人員依開頭字元篩選，不區分大小寫。

trans-unit.source: A Cmd+K command palette with an AI mode (Arc AI command, design reference). Search pages and actions, or press Tab to ask a question: the answer streams inside the palette with numbered sources, and the next steps it suggests run straight from the list. The palette never changes size: the results area keeps `ResultsHeight` while typing, switching modes and streaming, and its views crossfade in place. Give it pages and actions in `Items` (or `ItemsSource`) and answer questions with `Responder`: stream text with `Append`, land the sources early with `SetSources`, and resolve with the suggested actions. With no data it is an empty palette; a `Simulation` you pass in fills it with a workspace and a simulated model, and plays a looping walkthrough while it is on screen until someone uses it. Focus stays in the input: Up and Down move the highlight, Enter opens, asks, runs or retries, Tab asks the model about the query (or opens Ask AI with suggested questions, and goes back from there), and Escape goes back to search, clears the query, then raises `CloseRequested`. Put it in an `AiCommandPaletteDialog` to open it over the page with Cmd+K or Ctrl+K.
trans-unit.target: 具備 AI 模式的 Cmd+K 命令面板（Arc AI command，設計參考）。搜尋頁面與動作，或按 Tab 提問：回答在面板內串流呈現並附有編號來源，模型建議的後續步驟可直接在清單中執行。面板的尺寸從不改變：在輸入、切換模式和串流輸出時，結果區域始終維持 `ResultsHeight`，各檢視就地交叉淡化。透過 `Items`（或 `ItemsSource`）提供頁面與動作，並用 `Responder` 回答問題：用 `Append` 串流輸出文字，用 `SetSources` 提早放出來源，最後傳回建議的動作。沒有資料時它是一個空的面板；你傳入的 `Simulation` 會為它補上工作區和模擬模型，並在畫面上可見時循環播放示範，直到有人開始使用。焦點始終留在輸入框中：Up 和 Down 移動反白，Enter 開啟、提問、執行或重試，Tab 針對查詢詢問模型（查詢為空時開啟附有建議問題的 Ask AI，並可從那裡返回），Escape 返回搜尋、清除查詢，然後引發 `CloseRequested`。把它放進 `AiCommandPaletteDialog`，即可用 Cmd+K 或 Ctrl+K 在頁面上方開啟。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a suggested action finishes, with the label it ended on ("Created ENG-2481"). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 建議的動作完成後引發，附帶它最後顯示的標籤（"Created ENG-2481"）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Plays a looping walkthrough while on screen. It stops for good on the first real pointer or key press inside, pauses off screen and starts over from a clean state, and never runs with reduced motion. Null plays it only when the palette has a `Simulation` and neither items nor a responder of its own.
trans-unit.target: 畫面上可見時循環播放示範。在面板內第一次真正的指標或按鍵操作後永久停止，不可見時暫停並從乾淨的狀態重新開始，減少動態效果時從不播放。為 null 時，只在面板有 `Simulation` 且本身既沒有項目也沒有回應器時播放。

trans-unit.source: Raised by Escape in an empty search: close the surrounding dialog here. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 在空白搜尋中按 Escape 時引發：在這裡關閉外層對話方塊。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Adds the floating shadow, for use inside a dialog or a popover.
trans-unit.target: 加上浮層陰影，用於對話方塊或彈出框中。

trans-unit.source: Listens for Cmd+K or Ctrl+K in the window and focuses the input.
trans-unit.target: 在視窗中監聽 Cmd+K 或 Ctrl+K，並聚焦輸入框。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a page or action is chosen with Enter or a click. Close your dialog or navigate here. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 用 Enter 或點按選取頁面或動作時引發。在這裡關閉對話方塊或進行導覽。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The pages and actions to search; when set it takes the place of `Items`.
trans-unit.target: 要搜尋的頁面與動作；設定後取代 `Items`。

trans-unit.source: Every word the palette shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 面板顯示或朗讀的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: Search or Ask AI (two-way). Switching back to search cancels a streaming answer.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋或 Ask AI（雙向）。切回搜尋會取消串流中的回答。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the palette switches between Search and Ask AI. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 面板在搜尋與 Ask AI 之間切換時引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The model's mark (a 24 × 24 stroked glyph) in the footer, the input and beside each answer; the sparkle by default.
trans-unit.target: 模型的標記（24 × 24 描邊圖形），顯示在頁尾、輸入框和每則回答旁；預設為閃光圖示。

trans-unit.source: The model that answers, shown in the footer and beside each answer; null (the default) shows the mark alone.
trans-unit.target: 回答問題的模型，顯示在頁尾和每則回答旁；為 null（預設）時只顯示標誌。

trans-unit.source: The text in the input (two-way): the search query, or the question being typed in Ask AI.
trans-unit.target: 輸入框中的文字（雙向）：搜尋查詢，或在 Ask AI 中正在輸入的問題。

trans-unit.source: Answers a question: stream text with `Append`, show sources early with `SetSources`, and resolve with the actions (and the text, if it was not streamed). Throw to show the failed state with a retry row. Null uses the `Simulation`'s model; with neither, a question gets no answer.
trans-unit.target: 回答問題：用 `Append` 串流輸出文字，用 `SetSources` 提早顯示來源，最後傳回動作（如果沒有串流輸出，還要傳回文字）。擲回例外狀況會顯示附有重試列的失敗狀態。為 null 時使用 `Simulation` 的模型；兩者都沒有時，提問不會得到回答。

trans-unit.source: The height of the results area in px; the palette keeps this size while typing, switching modes and streaming.
trans-unit.target: 結果區域的高度（px）；在輸入、切換模式和串流輸出時，面板都維持這個尺寸。

trans-unit.source: A simulated workspace (demos and prototypes): its items, questions and model fill in what the palette lacks, and with no items and no responder of its own the palette plays its walkthrough. Null leaves the palette to its own data.
trans-unit.target: 模擬工作區（示範與原型）：它的項目、問題和模型會補上面板缺少的部分；面板本身既沒有項目也沒有回應器時，會播放它的示範。為 null 時面板只使用自己的資料。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a source chip or a citation is chosen. Bubbles. Unless handled, a source with an address opens it with the system launcher.
trans-unit.target: 選取來源標籤或引用時引發。會向上傳遞。除非已處理，帶有網址的來源會用系統啟動器開啟。

trans-unit.source: The questions offered while Ask AI is open and empty; null offers the `Simulation`'s, if any.
trans-unit.target: Ask AI 開啟且為空時提供的問題；為 null 時提供 `Simulation` 的問題（如果有）。

trans-unit.source: A suggested next step returned with an answer and run in place: a row with a mark, a label and quiet meta text that turns into a spinner while `Run` works, then a check and the done label (or an alert, and Enter retries).
trans-unit.target: 隨回答一起傳回並就地執行的建議下一步：一列帶有標記、標籤和低調附註文字，在 `Run` 執行時變成載入圈，接著顯示勾號和完成標籤（或顯示警示圖示，按 Enter 重試）。

trans-unit.source: The label once done when `Run` returns nothing; null uses `Done`.
trans-unit.target: `Run` 沒有傳回任何內容時完成後的標籤；為 null 時使用 `Done`。

trans-unit.source: The meta text once done; a simulated action says here that nothing was sent.
trans-unit.target: 完成後的附註文字；模擬的動作會在這裡說明沒有送出任何內容。

trans-unit.source: The label after a failure; null uses `ActionFailed`.
trans-unit.target: 失敗後的標籤；為 null 時使用 `ActionFailed`。

trans-unit.source: A stable id.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 ID。

trans-unit.source: The row label ("Create issue in Linear").
trans-unit.target: 列標籤（"Create issue in Linear"）。

trans-unit.source: The 16px mark of the tool it runs in, a 24 × 24 stroked glyph; null shows an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 執行該動作之工具的 16px 標記，24 × 24 描邊圖形；為 null 時顯示箭頭。

trans-unit.source: Quiet detail after the label ("ENG · Billing").
trans-unit.target: 標籤後面的低調細節（"ENG · Billing"）。

trans-unit.source: Does the work. Resolve with a done label ("Created ENG-2481") or null; throw to show the failed state (Enter retries). The token is cancelled when the person asks again, goes back to search or the palette leaves the window.
trans-unit.target: 執行工作。傳回完成標籤（"Created ENG-2481"）或 null；擲回例外狀況會顯示失敗狀態（Enter 重試）。當使用者再次提問、返回搜尋或面板離開視窗時，權杖會被取消。

trans-unit.source: The label while it runs; null uses `Running`.
trans-unit.target: 執行期間的標籤；為 null 時使用 `Running`。

trans-unit.source: What a `Responder` resolves with: the whole text (when it did not stream it with `Append`), the sources (when it did not set them early) and the suggested actions.
trans-unit.target: `Responder` 傳回的內容：完整文字（未用 `Append` 串流輸出時）、來源（未提早設定時）以及建議的動作。

trans-unit.source: The question a `Responder` answers, with a token that is cancelled when the person asks again or goes back, and the two ways to fill the answer while it works: `Append` streams text, `SetSources` lands the source chips before the text.
trans-unit.target: `Responder` 要回答的問題，附帶一個在使用者再次提問或返回時取消的權杖，以及工作期間填入回答的兩種方式：`Append` 串流輸出文字，`SetSources` 讓來源標籤先於文字出現。

trans-unit.source: An `AiCommandPalette` as a dialog over the page: declare it once and Cmd+K (Ctrl+K elsewhere) opens it near the top of the window over a dimmed scrim, or bind `IsOpen`. It renders nothing in place. The palette gets the floating shadow and the focus when it opens. Escape in an empty search, a press on the scrim and choosing a page or action (`CloseOnSelect`) close it, and the focus returns to what had it before. Without a palette of its own it shows the sample one.
trans-unit.target: 以對話方塊形式顯示在頁面上方的 `AiCommandPalette`：宣告一次後，Cmd+K（其他平台為 Ctrl+K）會在視窗頂端附近、調暗的遮罩上方開啟它，也可以繫結 `IsOpen`。它在原位不轉譯任何內容。面板開啟時會取得浮層陰影和焦點。在空白搜尋中按 Escape、點按遮罩以及選取頁面或動作（`CloseOnSelect`）都會關閉它，焦點會回到先前擁有焦點的元素。沒有自己的面板時會顯示範例面板。

trans-unit.source: Choosing a page or action closes the dialog (default true).
trans-unit.target: 選取頁面或動作會關閉對話方塊（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while true; set false (or press Escape in an empty search) to close it. Two-way by default.
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時顯示；設為 false（或在空白搜尋中按 Escape）即可關閉。預設為雙向。

trans-unit.source: Turns the window-level open gesture on (default) or off.

trans-unit.source: A simulated workspace for an `AiCommandPalette`, for demos, prototypes and tests: the pages and actions to search (`Items`), the questions offered in Ask AI (`Questions`), and a simulated model that answers from `Answers`. It "searches" for 700ms, lands the sources, waits 250ms and streams the text in small uneven pieces every 45ms, then offers the actions, which pretend to run and say "Simulated, nothing was sent". Nothing talks to any service. Set it as the palette's `Simulation`. Each part fills in only what the palette lacks: `Items` while the palette has no items, `Questions` while it has no suggested questions, and the answers while it has no responder. While the palette has neither items nor a responder of its own it also plays the walkthrough (unless `AutoPlay` says otherwise): it searches for `SearchQuery`, opens Ask AI, asks the first question, runs its first action and starts over.
trans-unit.target: 為 `AiCommandPalette` 提供的模擬工作區，用於示範、原型和測試：要搜尋的頁面和動作（`Items`）、Ask AI 中提供的問題（`Questions`），以及依據 `Answers` 作答的模擬模型。它「搜尋」700ms，放出來源，等待 250ms，再每 45ms 以大小不一的小段串流輸出文字，然後提供動作；這些動作只是假裝執行，並顯示「Simulated, nothing was sent」。不會連接任何服務。把它設為面板的 `Simulation`。每一部分只補上面板缺少的內容：面板沒有項目時用 `Items`，沒有建議問題時用 `Questions`，沒有回應器時用其中的回答。面板本身既沒有項目也沒有回應器時，它還會播放示範（除非 `AutoPlay` 另有設定）：搜尋 `SearchQuery`，開啟 Ask AI，提出第一個問題，執行其第一個動作，然後從頭開始。

trans-unit.source: The prompt box of an AI app: a text area that grows with its text, "/" commands and "@" mentions that become tokens, attachments that upload in place (picked, pasted or dropped on the box), tool toggles, a model and effort menu, a character counter and a send button that turns into a stop button while a reply is generated. The composer reports a send through `Sent` (or `SendCommand`); your code starts the reply and sets `IsGenerating` while it runs, and the send button becomes a stop button that raises `StopRequested`. While a reply is generated the box stays editable but Enter does not send.
trans-unit.target: AI 應用程式的提示輸入框：一個會隨文字增高的文字區域，"/" 命令與 "@" 提及會變為權杖，附件可就地上傳（選取、貼上或拖放到輸入框上），並提供工具切換、模型與推理強度選單、字元計數器，以及在產生回覆時變為停止按鈕的傳送按鈕。輸入框透過 `Sent`（或 `SendCommand`）回報傳送；你的程式碼負責開始回覆，並在執行期間設定 `IsGenerating`，此時傳送按鈕會變為停止按鈕，並引發 `StopRequested`。產生回覆期間輸入框仍可編輯，但按 Enter 不會傳送。

The built-in demo runs only under full motion and while visible, can be paused, and is replaced by `Demo` when you give your own content. With no data set the card shows its invented sample.

trans-unit.source: Editing a passage of text with AI in place: select words in `Text`, press Edit with AI (or Ctrl+K), say what to change, and the rewrite shows inside the paragraph as word-level changes: removed words struck through, added words tinted, each change with its own accept and reject buttons. Once every change is decided (or Accept all / Reject all is pressed) the text updates and `EditApplied` reports it. The rewrite comes from `RewriteHandler`; without one a simple built-in stand-in rewrites the sample text.
trans-unit.target: 就地用 AI 修改一段文字：在 `Text` 中選取文字，按 Edit with AI（或 Ctrl+K），說出要改什麼，改寫會以逐詞的改動顯示在段落中：刪掉的詞被劃掉，新增的詞帶底色，每處改動都有自己的接受和拒絕按鈕。每處改動都決定後（或按下 Accept all / Reject all），文字更新並由 `EditApplied` 報告。改寫來自 `RewriteHandler`；沒有設定時，一個簡單的內建替身會改寫範例文字。

trans-unit.source: The number of changes under review (zero outside a review).
trans-unit.target: 審閱中的改動數量（審閱之外為零）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a reviewed rewrite is applied to `Text`.

trans-unit.source: The message of the last failed rewrite; null after a success or a new request.
trans-unit.target: 上一次改寫失敗的訊息；成功或送出新請求後為 null。

trans-unit.source: Every word the editor shows or reads out, with English defaults.
trans-unit.target: 編輯器顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。

trans-unit.source: Where the edit stands.
trans-unit.target: 編輯所處的階段。

trans-unit.source: The length of the selected passage; zero means no selection (two-way).

trans-unit.source: Where the selected passage starts (two-way: selecting text with the pointer or the keyboard writes it).

trans-unit.source: The quick instructions offered under the field. Default: shorter, friendlier, fix grammar, more formal.

trans-unit.target: `AiInlineEdit` 請它的 `RewriteHandler` 改寫的內容。

trans-unit.source: A dashboard card in which an assistant explains why a metric moved: the metric and its change on top, the chart it talks about with the changed stretch in a band, a short summary, the likely causes ranked by how much of the change they explain, and one suggested next step with a button. Selecting a cause moves the chart's band to that cause's stretch. While `IsAnalyzing` is true the text gives way to a shimmering line and placeholder lines. With no data set the card shows its invented sample (`AiInsightCardSamples`).
trans-unit.target: 一張儀表板卡片，由助手說明某個指標為什麼變化：上方是指標和它的變化，接著是所說明的圖表並用色帶標出變化的時段，一段簡短總結，按各自能解釋多少變化排序的可能原因，以及一條帶按鈕的建議下一步。選中某個原因時，圖表的色帶會移到這個原因的時段。`IsAnalyzing` 為 true 時，文字會換成一行閃光的提示和若干預留位置行。不設定任何資料時，卡片顯示它的虛構示例（`AiInsightCardSamples`）。

trans-unit.source: Run by the suggestion's button, with the `AiInsightActionEventArgs` as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 由建議的按鈕執行，以 `AiInsightActionEventArgs` 作為參數。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the suggestion's button is pressed (before `ActionCommand` runs).
trans-unit.target: 按下建議的按鈕時觸發（在 `ActionCommand` 執行之前）。

trans-unit.source: The likely causes, most important first; null or empty hides the section.
trans-unit.target: 可能的原因，最重要的在前；為 null 或為空時隱藏這一部分。

trans-unit.source: The change in percent (−12.4 for a 12.4% drop); null hides the change pill.
trans-unit.target: 以百分比表示的變化（下降 12.4% 時為 −12.4）；為 null 時隱藏變化標簽。

trans-unit.source: The same metric over the period before, drawn as a dashed line; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 同一指標在前一時段的值，畫成虛線；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: What the person said about the insight (two-way); pressing the same thumb again takes it back.
trans-unit.target: 對這條說明的評價（雙向）；再按一次同一個按鈕會撤回。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Feedback` changes.
trans-unit.target: `Feedback` 改變時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The stretch the insight is about, shown as a band while no cause with its own stretch is selected; null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 說明所指的時段；沒有選中帶有自己時段的原因時以色帶顯示；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Small print at the bottom (the data used, when it was written); null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 底部的小字（所用的資料、寫成的時間）；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the suggestion box shows its button.
trans-unit.target: 建議框是否顯示它的按鈕。

trans-unit.source: True while the insight is being written: the text gives way to a shimmering line and placeholders.
trans-unit.target: 正在撰寫說明時為 true：文字會換成一行閃光的提示和預留位置行。

trans-unit.source: True when the card is at most `CompactWidth` (420) wide.
trans-unit.target: 卡片寬度不超過 `CompactWidth`（420）時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Whether the thumbs up and down buttons show.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示讚和踩按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Whether a rise is good news (true: rises are green, drops red); false flips it, for costs or error rates.
trans-unit.target: 上升是否是好消息（true：上升為綠色、下降為紅色）；設為 false 時相反，用於成本或錯誤率。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or reads out, with English defaults.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。

trans-unit.source: The suggested next step; null or empty hides the suggestion box.
trans-unit.target: 建議的下一步；為 null 或為空時隱藏建議框。

trans-unit.source: What the change is measured against ("vs. the 14 days before"); null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 變化的對比基準（"vs. the 14 days before"）；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: One label per point ("Nov 4"), used by the readout and the chart's description; null numbers the points.
trans-unit.target: 每個資料點一個標簽（"Nov 4"），用於讀數和圖表的描述；為 null 時以索引代替。

trans-unit.source: The metric's values, oldest first, drawn as the line; fewer than two hides the chart.
trans-unit.target: 指標的值，從最早的開始，畫成折線；少於兩個時隱藏圖表。

trans-unit.source: The readout over the chart: the picked point, or the last point when none is picked.
trans-unit.target: 圖表上方的讀數：所選的點，沒有選中時為最後一個點。

trans-unit.source: The selected cause (two-way); null when none is. It must be one of `Causes`.
trans-unit.target: 選中的原因（雙向）；沒有選中時為 null。它必須是 `Causes` 中的一項。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SelectedCause` changes.
trans-unit.target: `SelectedCause` 改變時觸發。

trans-unit.source: What moved, in two or three sentences.
trans-unit.target: 用兩三句話說明什麼變了。

trans-unit.source: The metric's name ("Weekly active users").
trans-unit.target: 指標的名稱（"Weekly active users"）。

trans-unit.source: The metric's current value, formatted ("18,420").
trans-unit.target: 指標當前的值，已格式化（"18,420"）。

trans-unit.source: Formats a point's value in the readout; null uses the number with group separators and no decimals.
trans-unit.target: 格式化讀數中的值；為 null 時使用帶千分位符號、不帶小數的數字。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AiInsightCard` shows or reads out, with English defaults. Words built from values are functions, so an app can apply its own grammar. Assign a new instance to `Labels`.
trans-unit.target: `AiInsightCard` 顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。由數值生成的文字是函數，應用可以使用自己的語法。給 `Labels` 賦一個新執行個體即可修改。

trans-unit.source: One likely cause of the change in `Causes`.
trans-unit.target: `Causes` 中變化的一個可能原因。

trans-unit.source: A stretch of the chart, from one point index to another (both included).
trans-unit.target: 圖表上的一段，從一個點的索引到另一個點的索引（兩端都包含）。

trans-unit.source: A small assistant character that shows what an AI is doing (Arc AI mascot, design reference): a soft pebble with pill eyes, a quiet form shade and a companion dot. Idle breathes, floats, blinks and glances around. Listening leans in with wider eyes while the dot pulses like a voice level. Thinking tilts the head and looks up as the dot orbits it, passing behind and in front. Writing looks down and reads along a line the dot writes, then the pen lifts and returns. Done squints happily as the dot turns into a sparkle. Error shakes once and shows worried brows. A status change blends from the pose on screen over about 420ms, and the eyes follow the pointer on hover. Set `Status` from your assistant's phases; leave it unset to play through every state on a loop (a showcase). The mascot is a fixed square of `Size` px, from 24 (inline) to 160 (empty state); below 56 a compact drawing takes over. It pauses by itself off screen, and reduced motion keeps a still pose for each state.
trans-unit.target: 一個呈現 AI 正在做什麼的小助理角色（Arc AI mascot，設計參考）：一顆柔和的鵝卵石，有膠囊形的眼睛、一道安靜的形體陰影和一個伴隨圓點。閒置時呼吸、浮動、眨眼並四處張望。聆聽時往前靠近、眼睛睜大，圓點像音量一樣跳動。思考時歪頭往上看，圓點繞頭旋轉，從後方和前方經過。書寫時往下看，跟著圓點寫下的線讀，然後提筆返回。完成時開心地瞇眼，圓點變成閃光。出錯時搖晃一次並露出擔憂的眉毛。狀態切換在約 420ms 內從螢幕上的姿勢混合過去，懸停時眼睛跟隨指標。依據助理的階段設定 `Status`；不設定時循環播放所有狀態（用於展示）。吉祥物是邊長為 `Size` px 的固定正方形，從 24（行內）到 160（空白狀態）；小於 56 時改用精簡畫法。離開螢幕時自行暫停，減少動態效果時每個狀態保持靜止姿勢。

trans-unit.source: The accessible label in use, for example "Assistant, thinking".
trans-unit.target: 目前使用的無障礙標籤，例如「Assistant, thinking」。

trans-unit.source: Announces status changes in a polite live region. Turn it on for the one mascot that carries status, not for decorative copies.
trans-unit.target: 在禮貌型即時區域中朗讀狀態變化。只為承載狀態的那一個吉祥物開啟，不要為裝飾性的副本開啟。

trans-unit.source: The assistant's name in the accessible label ("Assistant, thinking"); `DefaultName` when null.
trans-unit.target: 無障礙標籤中的助理名稱（「Assistant, thinking」）；為 null 時使用 `DefaultName`。

trans-unit.source: Any color for the body. Overrides `Tone`; the eyes become a dark mix of it unless `EyeColor` is set.
trans-unit.target: 身體的任意顏色。覆寫 `Tone`；除非設定了 `EyeColor`，眼睛會變成它的深色混合。

trans-unit.source: The state shown now: `Status`, or the self-playing tour's state while it is null.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的狀態：`Status`，或在它為 null 時自動輪播所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Any color for the companion dot and the sparkle; the body color (the foreground for the soft tone) by default.
trans-unit.target: 伴隨圓點和閃光的任意顏色；預設為身體顏色（`Soft` 色調為前景色）。

trans-unit.source: Any color for the eyes, the squint and the brows.
trans-unit.target: 眼睛、瞇眼和眉毛的任意顏色。

trans-unit.source: When the eyes follow the pointer: over the mascot, anywhere in the window or never. Touch is ignored; thinking and writing keep their own gaze.
trans-unit.target: 眼睛何時跟隨指標：在吉祥物上方時、在視窗內任何位置或從不。忽略觸控；思考和書寫保持自己的視線。

trans-unit.source: Freezes the mascot on the current frame. It also pauses by itself off screen and while hidden, and resumes without a jump.
trans-unit.target: 讓吉祥物停在目前影格。它在離開螢幕或被隱藏時也會自行暫停，恢復時不會跳動。

trans-unit.source: Overrides the whole accessible label.
trans-unit.target: 取代整個無障礙標籤。

trans-unit.source: Every word the mascot says.
trans-unit.target: 吉祥物使用的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: Shows the companion dot that floats, pulses, orbits, writes and becomes the done sparkle.
trans-unit.target: 顯示伴隨圓點：它會漂浮、跳動、繞頭旋轉、書寫，並變成完成時的閃光。

trans-unit.source: Shows the soft contact shadow and the writing line under the mascot (drawn only at 56px and up).
trans-unit.target: 顯示吉祥物下方柔和的接觸陰影和書寫線（只在 56px 以上繪製）。

trans-unit.source: Width and height in px, from 24 (inline next to a message) to 160 (empty state). Below 56 the compact drawing takes over.
trans-unit.target: 以 px 為單位的寬和高，從 24（訊息旁的行內）到 160（空白狀態）。小於 56 時改用精簡畫法。

trans-unit.source: What the assistant is doing. Leave it null to play through every state on a loop (a showcase).
trans-unit.target: 助理正在做什麼。保持為 null 時循環播放所有狀態（用於展示）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the self-playing tour (`Status` null) moves to the next state. Bubbles. Use it to sync a caption or a control.
trans-unit.target: 自動輪播（`Status` 為 null）進入下一個狀態時引發。會向上傳遞。可用於同步說明文字或控制項。

trans-unit.source: Where the body color comes from: the accent, the foreground ink or a muted surface with a border.
trans-unit.target: 身體顏色的來源：強調色、前景墨色，或帶框線的柔和表面色。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AiMascot` says, in English by default. Replace the instance (or set its properties) to translate or reword; the accessible label is a function so that the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `AiMascot` 使用的所有文字，預設為英文。取代執行個體（或設定其屬性）即可翻譯或改寫；無障礙標籤是一個函式，以便調整語序。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `StatusChanged`: the state the self-playing tour moved to and the one it left.

trans-unit.source: A model a person can choose in the AI blocks: the model picker, the model pill and menu in a composer, a chat header or a prompt studio. Data only: an `AvaloniaObject` so the properties bind and a change (a new description, a price update) reaches what is on screen.
trans-unit.target: AI 區塊中人可以選擇的模型：模型選擇器、撰寫區、聊天標題或提示工作室中的模型膠囊與選單。僅為資料：它是一個 `AvaloniaObject`，因此屬性可以繫結，其變化（新的描述、價格更新）會反映到畫面上。

trans-unit.source: One line under the name in a featured menu row.
trans-unit.target: 精選選單列中名稱下方的一行說明。

trans-unit.source: The context window in tokens.

trans-unit.source: The level used when nothing is chosen yet; must be one of `EffortLevels`.
trans-unit.target: 尚未選擇時使用的等級；必須是 `EffortLevels` 其中之一。

trans-unit.source: A longer sentence for the summary below the picker.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在選擇器下方概覽中的較長說明。

trans-unit.source: The effort levels the model offers; null or empty means the model has no effort setting.
trans-unit.target: 模型提供的推理強度等級；為 null 或空白表示該模型沒有推理強度設定。

trans-unit.source: Stable id reported in events and bindings (the model's API id).
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼，於事件與繫結中回報（即模型的 API 識別碼）。

trans-unit.source: Price of one million input tokens (in the currency you show; the format adds the symbol).
trans-unit.target: 每百萬輸入詞元的價格（以顯示的貨幣計；格式會加上貨幣符號）。

trans-unit.source: True when the prices are placeholders; parts that print a price note it.
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時表示價格為佔位值；顯示價格的部件會加以註明。

trans-unit.source: The model's mark: a `Geometry` in a 24 × 24 box (filled with `MarkColor` or the text color) or an `IImage` such as a `DrawingImage` for a multicolor mark. Null falls back to the provider's mark.
trans-unit.target: 模型的標誌：24 × 24 方框中的 `Geometry`（以 `MarkColor` 或文字顏色填滿），或用於多色標誌的 `DrawingImage` 等 `IImage`。為 null 時使用提供者的標誌。

trans-unit.source: The fill of a `Geometry` mark; null uses the text color (it flips with the theme).
trans-unit.target: `Geometry` 標誌的填滿色；為 null 時使用文字顏色（隨佈景主題翻轉）。

trans-unit.source: The largest reply in tokens.
trans-unit.target: 最長回覆的詞元數。

trans-unit.source: The full display name, such as in a menu row.
trans-unit.target: 完整的顯示名稱，例如在選單列中顯示。

trans-unit.source: A short note after the name in a simple menu row, such as the vendor.
trans-unit.target: 簡易選單列中名稱之後的簡短備註，例如提供者。

trans-unit.source: Price of one million output tokens.

trans-unit.source: The id of the provider this model belongs to (`AiModelProvider`); groups the "More models" list and supplies a missing mark.

trans-unit.source: A shorter name for tight places (a toolbar pill); `DisplayName` falls back to `Name`.
trans-unit.target: 用於緊湊空間的較短名稱（如工具列膠囊）；`DisplayName` 會回退到 `Name`。

trans-unit.source: A small label at the end of a compact row, such as "Fast" or "Open weights".
trans-unit.target: 緊湊列末尾的小標籤，例如 "Fast" 或 "Open weights"。

trans-unit.source: A company or project that makes models: groups the "More models" list and supplies the mark of its models that have none.
trans-unit.target: 製作模型的公司或專案：將 "More models" 列表分組，並為沒有自身標誌的模型提供標誌。

trans-unit.source: Stable id that `ProviderId` refers to.
trans-unit.target: `ProviderId` 所參照的穩定 id。

trans-unit.source: The mark of models without their own; same kinds as `Mark`.
trans-unit.target: 沒有自身標誌的模型所使用的標誌；形式與 `Mark` 相同。

trans-unit.source: The fill of a `Geometry` mark; null uses the text color.
trans-unit.target: `Geometry` 標誌的填滿色；為 null 時使用文字顏色。

trans-unit.source: The group title in the "More models" list.
trans-unit.target: "More models" 列表中的分組標題。

trans-unit.source: Stable id; selections and changes refer to blocks by it.
trans-unit.target: 穩定 ID；選取範圍與修改透過它參照區塊。

trans-unit.source: The name of the block ("Introduction", "Pricing table"): shown on the selection pill, the change card, the placeholder and to screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 區塊的名稱（“Introduction”、“Pricing table”）：顯示在選取範圍膠囊、修改卡片、占位文字上，也會朗讀給螢幕閱讀器。

trans-unit.source: A change to one block that the assistant proposes: shown as a card with a word diff, applied or discarded by the person.
trans-unit.target: 助手提議對某個區塊所做的一項修改：以逐字差異卡片呈現，由使用者套用或捨棄。

trans-unit.source: The whole new block.
trans-unit.target: 整個新區塊。

trans-unit.source: The block as it is on the page when the card is made; the block to restore on undo.
trans-unit.target: 製作修改卡片時頁面上的區塊；復原時要還原的區塊。

trans-unit.source: The id of the block that changes.
trans-unit.target: 會變更的區塊 ID。

trans-unit.source: Where the change is.
trans-unit.target: 修改所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: A heading of the page.
trans-unit.target: 頁面中的一個標題。

trans-unit.source: The heading text.
trans-unit.target: 標題文字。

trans-unit.source: The page the assistant reads and edits: a title, a line of meta text and blocks.
trans-unit.target: 助手讀取與編輯的頁面：標題、一行中繼文字與多個區塊。

trans-unit.source: A line under the title ("Updated Mar 3 by Priya").

trans-unit.source: An animated spark mark that shows an AI at work (Arc AI spark): four tapered primary rays and four lighter diagonal rays around a soft core. Each status is its own motion: a slow breath at rest, a ripple while thinking, a heartbeat while writing, a gather when done and a small shake on an error, and every change blends from the pose the mark is already in, so states never hard cut. Set `Variant` to Pill for a status label or to Avatar for a round tile. Leave `Status` unset and the spark plays through idle, thinking, writing and done on its own (for demos).

trans-unit.source: An inline translator for one message or paragraph (Arc AI translate, design reference). A byline with the author and a detected-language chip sits above the text; below it a Translate picker, a Show original toggle and a status line led by the model's mark. Picking a language dims the text on screen and streams the translation in place in fast chunks, each new sentence retiring one sentence of the old text, while the paragraph's height springs to fit. Finished translations are cached per text, so Show original and switching back crossfade at once. A failure puts the previous text back and shows Couldn't translate with Retry. Wire `Translator` to your model: it gets an `AiTranslateRequest` and returns the translation as an async stream of text deltas (yield the whole text once to have the card stream it in chunks itself). Without one the card simulates the stream from `Translations`. Without `Text` it plays a `Simulation` (a message and its translations you pass, toured by itself); with neither it shows an empty card whose picker is off.
trans-unit.target: 針對一則訊息或一段文字的內嵌翻譯器（Arc AI translate，設計參考）。文字上方是含作者和偵測到的語言標籤的署名列；下方是 Translate 選擇器、Show original 開關，以及以模型標誌開頭的狀態列。選擇一種語言後，畫面上的文字變暗，譯文以快速的小塊在原處串流出現，每開始一個新句子就撤下一句舊文字，同時內文高度以彈簧動畫配合。完成的譯文依文字快取，因此「顯示原文」和切換回來時會立即交叉淡化。失敗時還原先前的文字，並顯示 Couldn't translate 和 Retry。把 `Translator` 接到你的模型：它會收到一個 `AiTranslateRequest`，並以文字增量的非同步串流傳回譯文（一次 yield 整段文字時，卡片會自行分塊串流輸出）。沒有它時，卡片從 `Translations` 模擬串流輸出。沒有 `Text` 時它播放 `Simulation`（你傳入的訊息及其譯文，自動輪播）；兩者都沒有時顯示一張空卡片，其中的選擇器處於關閉狀態。

trans-unit.source: Who wrote the text, shown with an avatar. Null hides the byline (the language chip stays), or shows the `Simulation`'s author while one plays.
trans-unit.target: 文字的作者，搭配頭像顯示。為 null 時隱藏署名列（語言標籤仍保留），播放 `Simulation` 時則顯示其作者。

trans-unit.source: Tours the languages (the `Simulation`'s `Tour`, or every other language in the picker), then the original, and loops. It pauses off screen and stops for good on the first pointer or key press inside the card; with reduced motion it translates once and stops. Null tours only while a `Simulation` plays.
trans-unit.target: 依序切換語言（`Simulation` 的 `Tour`，或選擇器中的其他每種語言），再回到原文，並循環播放。離開畫面時暫停，在卡片內第一次按下指標或按鍵後永久停止；減少動態效果時只翻譯一次就停止。為 null 時只在播放 `Simulation` 時輪播。

trans-unit.source: The language of the text: `SourceLanguage`, or the one detected from the text.
trans-unit.target: 文字的語言：`SourceLanguage`，或從文字中偵測到的語言。

trans-unit.source: Adds "Simulated, nothing was sent" to the announcements. Null: true without a `Translator` or while a `Simulation` plays.
trans-unit.target: 在朗讀中加上「Simulated, nothing was sent」。為 null 時：沒有 `Translator` 或正在播放 `Simulation` 時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每個字詞。

trans-unit.source: The languages offered in the picker, in order; null offers all six. The source language is always listed, as Original.
trans-unit.target: 選擇器中依序提供的語言；為 null 時提供全部六種。來源語言一定會列出，標為 Original。

trans-unit.source: The model's mark (a 24 × 24 stroked glyph) that leads every status; a sparkle by default. Pass your provider's mark.
trans-unit.target: 每個狀態開頭的模型標誌（24 × 24 描邊圖形）；預設是火花圖示。請傳入你的服務供應商的標誌。

trans-unit.source: The model credited in the status line: its name is the idle label. Null credits the `Simulation`'s model while one plays, or none.
trans-unit.target: 狀態列中標示的模型：其名稱是閒置時的標籤。為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間標示其模型，否則不標示。

trans-unit.source: A message to play while the card has no `Text`: its text, byline, model and ready translations, streamed as a simulation (nothing is sent). Your own `Text` wins over it; null stops it and shows the empty card.
trans-unit.target: 卡片沒有 `Text` 時要播放的訊息：它的文字、署名、模型和現成譯文，以模擬方式串流輸出（不會送出任何內容）。你自己的 `Text` 優先於它；為 null 時停止播放並顯示空卡片。

trans-unit.source: The language of `Text`. Null detects it from the text with a light check and the chip reads Detected; set, the chip reads Written in.
trans-unit.target: `Text` 的語言。為 null 時透過簡單檢查從文字中偵測，標籤顯示 Detected；設定後標籤顯示 Written in。

trans-unit.source: What the card shows: the original, a translation streaming in, a translation, or a failure.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示的內容：原文、正在串流輸出的譯文、譯文，或失敗。

trans-unit.source: Shown after the role in the byline, for example "Oct 27, 09:14".
trans-unit.target: 顯示在署名列中職稱之後，例如 "Oct 27, 09:14"。

trans-unit.source: Raised once a translation has fully arrived, before it is cached. Persist it here and pass it back in `Translations`. Bubbles.

trans-unit.target: 翻譯失敗時引發。已取消的要求從不引發它。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Your translation call: returns the translation as an async stream of text deltas. Pass the request's cancellation token on to your network call; it is cancelled when the reader picks another language, shows the original or the card leaves the window. A thrown exception's message is announced and kept as the status tooltip. Null simulates the stream.
trans-unit.target: 你的翻譯呼叫：以文字增量的非同步串流傳回譯文。請把要求的取消權杖傳給網路呼叫；讀者選擇其他語言、顯示原文或卡片離開視窗時它會被取消。擲回的例外訊息會被朗讀，並保留為狀態列的提示。為 null 時模擬串流輸出。

trans-unit.source: The language on screen (two-way); null or the source language means the original. Set it to translate, for example to a reader's preferred language: a language other than the source translates as soon as the card is shown.
trans-unit.target: 畫面上的語言（雙向）；null 或來源語言代表原文。設定它即可翻譯，例如設為讀者的偏好語言：來源語言以外的語言會在卡片一顯示時就開始翻譯。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the reader picks a language or toggles Show original (not when the app sets `Value` or autoplay moves). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 讀者選擇語言或切換 Show original 時引發（應用程式設定 `Value` 或自動播放切換時不引發）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Who wrote the text of an `AiTranslate` card, shown in its byline.
trans-unit.target: `AiTranslate` 卡片文字的作者，顯示在其署名列中。

trans-unit.source: Every word `AiTranslate` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; the phrases that name a language are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `AiTranslate` 顯示或朗讀的每個字詞，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；包含語言名稱的片語是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: One translation the card asks your `Translator` for.
trans-unit.target: 卡片向你的 `Translator` 要求的一次翻譯。

trans-unit.source: A message an `AiTranslate` plays without a translator, from data you give it: the text, its byline, the model credited and translations made ahead of time. Set it as `Simulation` while the card has no `Text`: picking a language streams the ready translation in place after a short wait (a language without one shows the failure), the status says it is simulated and nothing was sent, and unless `AutoPlay` is false the card tours `Tour` by itself until someone presses a pointer or a key inside it.
trans-unit.target: `AiTranslate` 在沒有翻譯函式時依你提供的資料播放的訊息：文字、署名、標示的模型以及預先準備好的譯文。在卡片沒有 `Text` 時把它設為 `Simulation`：選擇一種語言後，卡片會在短暫等待後原地串流輸出現成譯文（沒有譯文的語言會顯示失敗狀態），狀態會說明這是模擬、沒有送出任何內容，並且除非 `AutoPlay` 為 false，卡片會自動依序播放 `Tour`，直到有人在卡片內按下指標或按鍵。

trans-unit.source: A compact automation builder card with an AI step (Arc AI workflow, design reference). Steps are 32px rows on one 1px hairline rail: a trigger, an AI step, a branch whose paths switch with small tabs, and actions. Test run glides a small accent dot down each connector while the line behind it fills; each step crossfades to Running with a shimmering activity line, then shows its duration and an inline output preview in small muted text (the email, the label with a streamed reason, the posted message, the created issue). The path the run does not take is marked Skipped. A failing step shows its error and Retry, which resumes the run from that step. Steps are added from a compact command menu (search, rows with app marks and number shortcuts) and removed with a small button.
trans-unit.target: 一張帶有 AI 步驟的精簡自動化建構卡片（Arc AI workflow，設計參考）。步驟是排在同一條 1px 細線軌道上的 32px 列：觸發條件、AI 步驟、可用小分頁切換路徑的分支，以及動作。Test run 讓一個強調色小圓點沿著每段連接線滑下，身後的線隨之填滿；每個步驟交叉淡化為 Running 並顯示閃爍的活動列，接著以小號淡化文字顯示耗時與內嵌的輸出預覽（郵件、帶有串流理由的標籤、送出的訊息、建立的議題）。執行未走的路徑會標為 Skipped。失敗的步驟會顯示錯誤與 Retry，Retry 會從該步驟繼續執行。步驟從精簡的指令選單（搜尋、帶有應用程式標記與數字快速鍵的列）中新增，用一個小按鈕移除。

trans-unit.source: Plays a test run once the card is on screen and repeats it after a short pause, until someone presses or types inside the card. Nothing is scheduled while the card is off screen. Keep it off in real products.
trans-unit.target: 卡片出現在螢幕上後播放一次測試執行，短暫停頓後重複，直到有人在卡片內按下滑鼠或按鍵。卡片不在螢幕上時不安排任何播放。正式產品中請關閉。

trans-unit.source: The entries of the add step menu. Triggers are offered in the empty state, everything else in the menu. Null uses the simulation's catalog while its flow is shown, and no entries otherwise; an empty list hides the menu.
trans-unit.target: 新增步驟選單的項目。觸發條件在空狀態中提供，其餘都在選單中。為 null 時，顯示模擬的流程期間使用模擬的目錄，否則沒有項目；空清單會隱藏選單。

trans-unit.source: One line of context under the name. Null shows the simulation's line while its flow is shown.
trans-unit.target: 名稱下方的一行說明。為 null 時，顯示模擬的流程期間會顯示模擬的說明。

trans-unit.source: Shows the add step menu and the remove buttons. Triggers cannot be removed.
trans-unit.target: 顯示新增步驟選單與移除按鈕。觸發條件無法移除。

trans-unit.source: Shows three skeleton steps while your flow loads; Test run and the add menu are unavailable.
trans-unit.target: 在流程載入時顯示三個骨架步驟；此時 Test run 與新增選單無法使用。

trans-unit.source: True while a test run is in progress.
trans-unit.target: 測試執行進行中時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a test run passes or stops on a failed step (not after Stop). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 測試執行通過或停在失敗步驟上時觸發（Stop 之後不觸發）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Runs one step for real and returns its output; throw to fail the step with the message. Null simulates each step from its `Output` and `Duration` (the card then says "Simulated").
trans-unit.target: 實際執行一個步驟並傳回其輸出；擲回例外則以該訊息讓步驟失敗。為 null 時，每一步都依其 `Output` 與 `Duration` 模擬（卡片會顯示 "Simulated"）。

trans-unit.source: The flow the card shows and test-runs on its own while `Steps` is null: your name, line, steps and catalog, played exactly like a flow of your own (autoplay, pausing off screen, stopping for good after a press). Null shows the empty state instead.

trans-unit.source: The steps, in order (two-way). A branch carries its paths and must be the last top-level step. Null plays the `Simulation`'s flow, or shows the empty state without one; an empty list shows the empty state. Adding or removing a step puts a new list here.

trans-unit.source: Raised after a step is added or removed, with the new list (already in `Steps`). Bubbles.

trans-unit.source: The workflow's name in the header. Null shows the simulation's name while its flow is shown.
trans-unit.target: 標題列中的工作流程名稱。為 null 時，顯示模擬的流程期間會顯示模擬的名稱。

trans-unit.source: The app a step of an `AiWorkflow` belongs to: a name read to screen readers and shown in the add step menu, and a mark (a 24 × 24 stroked glyph) drawn in a small hairline square on the rail. The built-in apps are generic (Mail, AI, Chat, Tracker, ...) with Lucide glyphs; pass your own name and mark for real products (for a model step, the model's vendor with `isAccent: true`).
trans-unit.target: `AiWorkflow` 中步驟所屬的應用程式：一個供螢幕閱讀器朗讀、並顯示在新增步驟選單中的名稱，以及一個畫在軌道上細線小方框裡的標記（24 × 24 描邊圖形）。內建應用程式都是通用的（Mail、AI、Chat、Tracker 等），使用 Lucide 圖示；真實產品請傳入你自己的名稱與標記（模型步驟請使用模型廠商，並設定 `isAccent: true`）。

trans-unit.target: 模型選定的標籤：一個帶狀態圓點的細線標籤、等寬字型的信心值，以及串流出現的理由。

trans-unit.source: Every word `AiWorkflow` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; the sentences that carry a value are format functions.

trans-unit.source: A posted chat message.
trans-unit.target: 一則已送出的聊天訊息。

trans-unit.source: The output preview of a step of an `AiWorkflow`, rendered inline in small muted text under the step, aligned with its title. Use one of `AiWorkflowEmailOutput`, `AiWorkflowLabelOutput`, `AiWorkflowRouteOutput`, `AiWorkflowMessageOutput`, `AiWorkflowRecordOutput` or `AiWorkflowTextOutput`.
trans-unit.target: `AiWorkflow` 中步驟的輸出預覽，以小號淡化文字內嵌在步驟下方，與標題對齊。請使用 `AiWorkflowEmailOutput`、`AiWorkflowLabelOutput`、`AiWorkflowRouteOutput`、`AiWorkflowMessageOutput`、`AiWorkflowRecordOutput` 或 `AiWorkflowTextOutput` 其中之一。

trans-unit.source: A created or updated record: an issue key, a row, a ticket or a page.
trans-unit.target: 一筆建立或更新的紀錄：議題編號、表格列、客服單或頁面。

trans-unit.source: The path a branch took. Return it from a branch step to pick the path.
trans-unit.target: 分支走的路徑。從分支步驟傳回它即可選擇路徑。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `RunCompleted`.
trans-unit.target: `RunCompleted` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: What `RunStep` gets with each step.
trans-unit.target: `RunStep` 隨每個步驟收到的內容。

trans-unit.source: A flow an `AiWorkflow` shows and test-runs on its own while the app sets no `Steps`: a name, a line of context, the steps and the add step catalog, all supplied by the caller. Each simulated run plays the steps' `Output`, `Duration` and `Error`; with `AutoPlay` the card repeats the run while it is on screen until someone presses or types inside it. Nothing is sent. Set the data before handing the simulation to the card; to show another flow, give the card a new simulation.
trans-unit.target: 在應用程式沒有設定 `Steps` 時，`AiWorkflow` 自行顯示並測試執行的流程：名稱、一行說明、步驟與新增步驟目錄，全部由呼叫端提供。每次模擬執行都會播放步驟的 `Output`、`Duration` 與 `Error`；開啟 `AutoPlay` 時，只要卡片在螢幕上就會重複執行，直到有人在卡片內按下滑鼠或按鍵。不會送出任何內容。請在把模擬交給卡片之前設定好資料；要顯示另一個流程，就給卡片一個新的模擬。

trans-unit.source: One step of an `AiWorkflow`. The workflow treats steps as values: to change one, put a new list in `Steps`. `Output`, `Duration` and `Error` are what a simulated run shows; a run through `RunStep` shows what your code returns.
trans-unit.target: `AiWorkflow` 的一個步驟。工作流程把步驟當成值：要修改某一步，就在 `Steps` 中放入一個新清單。`Output`、`Duration` 與 `Error` 是模擬執行顯示的內容；透過 `RunStep` 執行時則顯示你的程式碼傳回的內容。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `StepsChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `StepsChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.target: 自由文字，例如草擬的回覆；以快速的分塊串流出現。

trans-unit.source: Arc alert: a persistent message that helps people recover or continue. Keep one instance and change `Tone`, `Title` and the content to morph it between states: the icon pops into the new tone, new text rises out of a soft blur and the height springs to fit. Hiding it (`IsOpen`) collapses the height while it fades, so the content below closes the gap. A string `Content` is the description line; any other content is shown as is.
trans-unit.target: Arc 警示：持續顯示的訊息，協助使用者恢復或繼續操作。保持同一執行個體，改變 `Tone`、`Title` 和內容即可在各狀態間變形：圖示以彈出方式切換為新色調，新文字從柔和模糊中升起，高度以彈簧適配內容。隱藏（`IsOpen`）時高度在淡出的同時收縮，使下方內容填補空隙。字串類型的 `Content` 為描述行；其他類型的內容按原樣顯示。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a dismissed alert finished collapsing.
trans-unit.target: 已關閉的警示完成收縮後引發。

trans-unit.source: Shows the dismiss button. Dismissing collapses the alert, then raises `Dismissed`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示關閉按鈕。關閉時先收縮警示，然後引發 `Dismissed`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the alert is shown. Hiding collapses its height and fades it out. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 警示是否顯示。隱藏時收縮高度並淡出。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: The headline. A new title rises in from below while the old one lifts away.
trans-unit.target: 標題。新標題從下方升入，舊標題同時向上移出。

trans-unit.source: Tone (default `Info`).
trans-unit.target: 色調（預設 `Info`）。

trans-unit.source: A number that rolls digit by digit like an odometer: only changed columns turn (in the direction the whole number moved), separators slide in and out, and the label crossfades with a short rise. With `AnimateOnView` every digit rolls up from zero the first time 60% of the counter is visible.

trans-unit.source: Roll every digit up from zero the first time the counter scrolls into view.
trans-unit.target: 計數器首次捲動進入視野時，所有位從零滾動到目標值。

trans-unit.source: Arc announcement bar: a slim banner for the top of a page. It rotates 2–4 short messages (the next one rises from below while the bar springs to the new height), pauses on hover, focus or a minimized window, and with `IsNavigationVisible` adds previous, next and a pause ring that fills over `Interval`. Messages can carry a call to action and a live countdown. Dismissing collapses the height so the page below eases up; with a `DismissalKey` the dismissal is remembered (`IMessageStorage`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 公告列：用於頁面頂部的細長橫幅。它輪播 2–4 則簡短訊息（下一則從下方升起，同時橫幅以彈簧變為新高度），滑鼠懸停、取得焦點或視窗最小化時暫停；設定 `IsNavigationVisible` 後會增加上一則、下一則按鈕，以及一個在 `Interval` 時間內逐漸填滿的暫停圓環。訊息可以帶有行動按鈕和即時倒數計時。關閉時高度收縮，使下方頁面平滑上移；若設定了 `DismissalKey`，關閉狀態會被記住（`IMessageStorage`）。

trans-unit.source: A key manager for an API's developer settings: a header, a toolbar with the number of active keys and a "Create key" pill, and the keys as rows. The pill unfolds in place into a form (name, test or live, scopes); submitting runs `GenerateAction` and the same panel then shows the new secret once, with a copy button, while the new row slides in at the top, highlighted until the panel closes. A row opens into its details (creator, last request, request count) and a hold-to-revoke button; a confirmed revoke strikes the row through, runs `RevokeAction` and folds the row away.

Null simulates a server (about 730ms, a random 40-character secret).

trans-unit.source: A desktop window whose client area extends into the title bar, with an Arc `TitleBar` drawn at the top. The title bar's empty part moves the window, a double click maximizes or restores it, and on Windows the system treats it as the caption (system menu, Aero Snap) and its maximize button as the system's (Snap Layouts). The window keeps resizing and, on macOS, the traffic lights. Its template hosts the bar and the content in a visual layer manager, so popups, toasts and tooltips work in both.
trans-unit.target: 工作區延伸到標題列的桌面視窗，頂端繪製 Arc `TitleBar`。拖曳標題列的空白部分移動視窗，按兩下最大化或還原；在 Windows 上，系統把它當作標題列（系統選單、Aero 貼齊），把其中的最大化按鈕當作系統按鈕（貼齊版面配置）。視窗保留縮放功能，在 macOS 上保留紅綠燈按鈕。範本把標題列和內容放在一個視覺層管理器中，因此快顯層、通知和工具提示在兩者中都能使用。

trans-unit.target: 傳送給兩個模型的完整提示。

trans-unit.source: Natural language to chart in one card (Arc Ask your data, design reference). A question field with the data source; a collapsible Generated SQL panel where the query streams in with syntax tints; a running state with a rolling count of the rows scanned over a breathing skeleton; then a result that builds as stacked bars, lines or a table, with a legend, a pointer and keyboard readout, and a one line insight streamed underneath. Failures show the database's message with Try again; a query that matches nothing offers the suggestions. Wire `GenerateSql` (a whole string, revealed four tokens a tick at a fixed final size) or `StreamSql` (chunks from your model; the panel grows with them) to your model, and `RunQuery` to a read only database role. Without them the card plays its `Simulation`, answers you supply, and asks its question once it is 35% on screen; with neither, it waits in its empty state and Ask stays unavailable.
trans-unit.target: 在一張卡片裡把自然語言變成圖表（Arc Ask your data，設計參考）。帶資料來源的問題輸入框；可收合的 Generated SQL 面板，查詢帶著語法著色串流寫入；執行狀態中，已掃描列數在呼吸的骨架上方滾動計數；接著結果以堆疊長條、折線或表格逐步呈現，附帶圖例、指標與鍵盤讀數，以及在下方串流出現的一行洞察。失敗時顯示資料庫的訊息與「重試」；沒有相符結果的查詢會提供建議問題。把 `GenerateSql`（整段字串，以固定的最終尺寸每個節拍顯示四個語彙單元）或 `StreamSql`（來自模型的分段，面板隨之增高）接上你的模型，把 `RunQuery` 接上唯讀資料庫角色。都不接上時，卡片會播放它的 `Simulation`（由你提供的答案），並在有 35% 出現在螢幕上時提出它的問題；兩者都沒有時，卡片會停在空狀態，提問按鈕無法使用。

trans-unit.source: Asks the question once the card is 35% on screen. Null: on when a `Simulation` writes the SQL, off when you wire a real model.
trans-unit.target: 卡片有 35% 出現在螢幕上時提出問題。為 null 時：由 `Simulation` 撰寫 SQL 則開啟，接上真實模型則關閉。

trans-unit.source: The view on show (two-way). Null leaves it to the card: each result opens on its own view or `DefaultChart`, and the switch changes it until the next result.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的檢視（雙向）。為 null 時交由卡片決定：每個結果依自己的檢視或 `DefaultChart` 開啟，切換器在下一個結果到來前可改變它。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person switches the view with the chart switch. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 使用者透過圖表切換器切換檢視時引發。向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The view for results that do not name one.
trans-unit.target: 未指定檢視的結果所使用的檢視。

trans-unit.source: Raised when writing or running fails; not when the person stops a run. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 撰寫或執行失敗時引發；使用者停止執行時不引發。向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Writes the SQL for a question as one string. The card reveals it four tokens every 34ms at its final size. Honour the request's cancellation token: Stop cancels it. Without this and `StreamSql` the `Simulation` writes the SQL.
trans-unit.target: 以一整段字串為問題撰寫 SQL。卡片以其最終尺寸每 34ms 顯示四個語彙單元。請遵守請求的取消權杖：「停止」會取消它。此項與 `StreamSql` 都未設定時，由 `Simulation` 撰寫 SQL。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the SQL panel open after the query starts instead of folding it away. Once the person opens or closes the panel during a run, their choice wins.
trans-unit.target: 查詢開始後讓 SQL 面板保持展開，而不是收合起來。一旦使用者在執行中展開或收合了面板，就以使用者的選擇為準。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: The placeholder of the empty field.
trans-unit.target: 輸入框為空時的預留位置文字。

trans-unit.source: The question (two-way); the field writes it as the person types. Null shows the simulation's question, or an empty field without one.
trans-unit.target: 問題（雙向）；使用者輸入時由輸入框寫入。為 null 時顯示模擬的問題，沒有模擬時輸入框為空。

trans-unit.source: The result on show, or null.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的結果，或 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised once a result is charted (for saving the question to a dashboard or logging). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 結果繪製成圖表後引發（用於把問題儲存到儀表板或記錄日誌）。向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Runs the SQL (read only) and returns a chart ready result. Call `ReportProgress` to roll the count in the running state; throw to show the database error. Without it the `Simulation` answers.
trans-unit.target: 執行 SQL（唯讀）並傳回可直接繪圖的結果。呼叫 `ReportProgress` 讓執行狀態中的計數滾動；擲回例外以顯示資料庫錯誤。未設定時由 `Simulation` 回答。

trans-unit.source: The model and database the card plays while you wire none: its question (asked on its own once the card is on screen), suggestions, source and answers, run exactly like your own delegates (the SQL revealed, the rows scanned rolling, the chart building, the insight streaming). It stands in only for what you have not wired. Null leaves the card in its empty state.
trans-unit.target: 你一個委派都沒有接上時卡片播放的模型與資料庫：它的問題（卡片出現在螢幕上後自行提出）、建議、資料來源與答案，執行方式與你自己的委派完全相同（SQL 逐步顯示、掃描列數滾動、圖表建立、洞察逐字出現）。它只替代你沒有接上的部分。為 null 時卡片停在空狀態。

trans-unit.source: The database the question runs against: its name shows in the field and the empty state, its dialect leads the SQL meta. Null uses the simulation's source, or names none.
trans-unit.target: 問題所針對的資料庫：其名稱顯示在輸入框與空狀態中，其方言位於 SQL 中繼資訊的開頭。為 null 時使用模擬的資料來源，否則不顯示名稱。

trans-unit.source: The SQL of the current run, as written so far.
trans-unit.target: 本次執行的 SQL，即目前已寫出的部分。

trans-unit.source: Where the run is: idle, writing, running, done, empty, failed or stopped.
trans-unit.target: 執行所處的階段：閒置、撰寫中、執行中、完成、無資料、失敗或已停止。

trans-unit.source: Streams the SQL for a question as chunks from your model; each chunk fades in and the panel grows with them. Takes precedence over `GenerateSql`. Honour the cancellation token.
trans-unit.target: 以來自模型的分段串流輸出問題的 SQL；每個分段淡入出現，面板隨之增高。優先於 `GenerateSql`。請遵守取消權杖。

trans-unit.source: Questions offered in the empty state and after a question that matches no data. Null offers the simulation's suggestions, or none; an empty list hides them.
trans-unit.target: 在空狀態以及問題沒有相符資料之後提供的問題。為 null 時提供模擬的建議，沒有模擬時不提供；空清單會隱藏它們。

trans-unit.source: Every word `AskYourData` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; counts and times are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `AskYourData` 顯示或朗讀的所有文字，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；計數與時間是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: What `RunQuery` returns, shaped for the chart.
trans-unit.target: `RunQuery` 傳回的內容，結構為圖表而設計。

trans-unit.source: One series of an `AskYourDataResult`: a plan, a region or a metric with one value per category.
trans-unit.target: `AskYourDataResult` 中的一個數列：一個方案、地區或指標，每個類別一個值。

trans-unit.source: A model and a database an `AskYourData` plays while the app wires neither: the question it asks on its own, the suggestions, the source, and the answers it knows. A question that contains one of an answer's `Keywords` gets that answer (the first match in order); any other gets `Fallback`. The SQL is revealed at the card's own pace after a short pause, the rows scanned roll up in ten steps, then the result builds and its insight streams in. Nothing is queried, and the live region says so. Set the data before handing the simulation to the card; to play other answers, give the card a new simulation.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式一個都沒有接上時 `AskYourData` 播放的模型與資料庫：它自行提出的問題、建議、資料來源以及它知道的答案。問題包含某個答案的 `Keywords` 之一時得到該答案（依序取第一個相符者）；其他問題得到 `Fallback`。SQL 在短暫停頓後依卡片自己的節奏逐步顯示，掃描列數分十步滾動上升，接著結果建立、洞察逐字出現。不會查詢任何內容，即時區域會說明這一點。請在把模擬交給卡片之前設定好資料；要播放其他答案，就給卡片一個新的模擬。

trans-unit.source: One answer of an `AskYourDataSimulation`: the words that pick it, the SQL, the rows scanned and the result.
trans-unit.target: `AskYourDataSimulation` 的一個答案：選中它的字詞、SQL、掃描的列數與結果。

trans-unit.source: The database an `AskYourData` question runs against.
trans-unit.target: `AskYourData` 的問題所針對的資料庫。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ConfirmRequested`: set `Cancel` to keep the selection unconfirmed.
trans-unit.target: `ConfirmRequested` 的引數：設定 `Cancel` 可讓選擇保持未確認。

trans-unit.target: `AvailabilityPicker` 的一天：日期列中的一張日卡，以及選取時顯示的時段（依開始時間排序）。

trans-unit.source: The date: the card shows its short weekday and day number, the heading and the footer its long form.
trans-unit.target: 日期：卡片顯示其簡短的星期和日數字，標題和頁尾顯示其完整形式。

trans-unit.source: How many selectable times suit every attendee (the card's "3 open").
trans-unit.target: 有多少個可選時段適合所有與會者（卡片上的 "3 open"）。

trans-unit.source: The proposed times of the day, in any order (they are shown sorted by start).
trans-unit.target: 當天提議的時段，順序不拘（顯示時依開始時間排序）。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app keeps with the day.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式與該日一同保存的任意物件。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SelectedDayChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `SelectedDayChanged` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: Find a meeting time that suits several people: a strip of days, the proposed times of the selected day with one mark per attendee (green when free, grey when busy), and a footer that sums up the choice with a button to book it. Choosing another day glides the day highlight there, slides the times in from that side and selects the first time that suits everyone; a time with busy attendees can still be booked, and the footer says who has to move a meeting. Booking turns the button into a quiet "Booked"; any new choice undoes it. The days, times and attendees are data you provide.
trans-unit.target: 為多人尋找合適的會議時間：一條日期列、所選日期的提議時段（每位與會者一個標記，空閒時為綠色，忙碌時為灰色），以及一個彙整所選內容並帶有預訂按鈕的頁尾。選擇另一天時，日期醒目提示會滑動到該日，時段從該側滑入，並自動選取第一個適合所有人的時段；有人忙碌的時段仍可預訂，頁尾會說明誰需要調整會議。預訂後按鈕會變為低調的 "Booked"；任何新的選擇都會撤銷預訂。日期、時段與與會者都是你提供的資料。

trans-unit.source: The word joining the last two names in lists ("Noor and Ingrid").
trans-unit.target: 清單中連接最後兩個名字的詞（"Noor and Ingrid"）。

trans-unit.source: The attendees, in the order of the avatars and of each time's marks.
trans-unit.target: 與會者，順序與頭像及各時段標記的順序一致。
