trans-unit.target: `AvailabilityDay` 上的一個提議會議時段：開始與結束時間，以及此時哪些與會者忙碌。有人忙碌的時段仍可選取（頁尾會說明誰需要調整會議）；對於完全無法預訂的時段，請將 `IsEnabled` 設為 false。

trans-unit.source: The attendees who are busy at this time; the picker draws a grey mark for each of them.
trans-unit.target: 此時忙碌的與會者；選擇器會為每位忙碌的與會者繪製一個灰色標記。

trans-unit.source: The end, as a time of day; null ends `Duration` after the start.
trans-unit.target: 結束時間（一天中的時刻）；為 null 時，在開始時間之後經過 `Duration` 結束。

trans-unit.source: False shows the time dimmed and keeps it from being chosen (already taken, in the past).
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時時段會變暗，且無法被選取（已被佔用、已過去）。

trans-unit.source: True while nobody in `BusyAttendees` is busy.
trans-unit.target: 當 `BusyAttendees` 中沒有人忙碌時為 true。

trans-unit.source: A line shown under the time instead of the generated one ("Everyone's free", "Noor is busy").
trans-unit.target: 顯示在時段下方、取代自動產生文字的一行（"Everyone's free"、"Noor is busy"）。

trans-unit.source: The start, as a time of day.
trans-unit.target: 開始時間（一天中的時刻）。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app keeps with the time (a booking id, the calendar's own slot).
trans-unit.target: 應用程式與該時段一同保存的任意物件（例如預訂編號、行事曆自身的時段）。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SelectedSlotChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `SelectedSlotChanged` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: A person as a photo or initials. A photo that is still downloading fades in from a soft blur (cached photos show at once); a failed photo falls back to initials; the status dot pops in on a snappy spring.
trans-unit.target: 以照片或姓名首字母表示的人員。仍在下載的照片會從柔和模糊中淡入（已快取的照片立即顯示）；照片載入失敗時退回為姓名首字母；狀態點以靈敏的彈簧彈出。

trans-unit.source: The person's name; initials are the first letters of its first two words.
trans-unit.target: 人員姓名；首字母取其前兩個詞的首字母。

trans-unit.source: Initials computed from DisplayName: the first letters of its first two words.
trans-unit.target: 由 DisplayName 計算出的首字母：取其前兩個單字的首字母。

trans-unit.source: Avatar size: Small 28, Medium 36 (default), Large 48, LargePlus 64 or XLarge 88. The status dot and the initials follow it.
trans-unit.target: 頭像尺寸：Small 為 28，Medium 為 36（預設），Large 為 48，LargePlus 為 64，XLarge 為 88。狀態圓點與首字母隨之變化。

trans-unit.source: Photo to show. A photo that fails to load falls back to initials.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的照片。照片載入失敗時改為顯示首字母。

trans-unit.source: Presence dot: None (default, no dot), Online, Offline, Busy, Away or Connecting. The status is part of the accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 上線狀態圓點：None（預設，無圓點）、Online、Offline、Busy、Away 或 Connecting。狀態是無障礙名稱的一部分。

trans-unit.source: A team or set of contributors in a small space (Arc AvatarGroup): overlapping avatars with a 2px surface ring and a 1px border ring, later people stacked over earlier ones, and a "+N" chip for everyone past `MaxVisibleCount`. People who join or leave open or close their slot on the morph spring so the stack slides (P19); the overflow count rolls the way it moved (P14). Pointing at the stack (fine pointers only) loosens it from the center (P28) and lifts the person under the pointer with a crisp ring and their name while the neighbours ease aside (P27). Only the visible people get controls, so long member lists stay cheap. Items may be `AvatarGroupMember`, `Avatar` or plain names.
trans-unit.target: 少量空間內的團隊或一組貢獻者（Arc AvatarGroup）：頭像相互疊放，帶有 2px 的表面環和 1px 的邊框環，較晚加入的人疊在較早的人之上；超過 `MaxVisibleCount` 的人員以「+N」標籤表示。加入或離開的人員會以變形彈簧展開或收起其位置，使頭像堆疊平滑滑動（P19）；溢出數字的變化方向與其實際變化一致（P14）。指標懸停在堆疊上（僅限精確指標）時，頭像會從中心鬆散開（P28），指標下的人員會以清晰的環和姓名突出顯示，相鄰頭像同時讓開（P27）。只有可見的人員才會建立控制項，因此長成員清單依然輕量。項目可以是 `AvatarGroupMember`、`Avatar` 或純文字姓名。

trans-unit.source: Bound members (`AvatarGroupMember`, `Avatar` or names); takes precedence over `Items`.
trans-unit.target: 繫結的成員（`AvatarGroupMember`、`Avatar` 或姓名）；優先於 `Items`。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the group, also used for the overflow chip ("2 more team members").
trans-unit.target: 群組的無障礙名稱，也用於溢出標籤（「另外 2 位團隊成員」）。

trans-unit.source: People shown before the rest fold into the overflow count (Arc `max`, 4).
trans-unit.target: 顯示的人數上限，其餘人員摺疊進溢出數字（Arc 的 `max`，為 4）。

trans-unit.source: How many people are folded into the "+N" chip.
trans-unit.target: 摺疊進「+N」標籤的人數。

trans-unit.source: Avatar size: Small 28, Medium 36, Large 48 (LargePlus and XLarge are treated as Large).
trans-unit.target: 頭像尺寸：Small 為 28，Medium 為 36，Large 為 48（LargePlus 與 XLarge 按 Large 處理）。

trans-unit.source: One person in an `AvatarGroup` (Arc `members[]` entry).
trans-unit.target: `AvatarGroup` 中的一位人員（Arc `members[]` 項目）。

trans-unit.source: The person's name: initials, tooltip and accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 人員姓名：用於首字母、工具提示和無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Optional photo; initials show while it loads or when it fails.
trans-unit.target: 可選的照片；載入中或載入失敗時顯示首字母。

trans-unit.source: Optional online / offline dot.
trans-unit.target: 可選的上線/離線狀態點。

trans-unit.source: An avatar field: a circle that shows the person's picture, with a button to pick one and a drop target for a file. A new picture opens a framing step where it is moved and zoomed under a circle (drag, wheel, pinch, the slider or the keyboard), then Save cuts a square of `OutputSize` pixels from it. With an `UploadHandler` the field shows the new picture at once with a progress ring until the upload ends, offers Cancel while it runs and Retry when it fails; without one, the picture is applied at once and `Cropped` hands it to the app.
trans-unit.target: 頭像欄位：一個顯示頭像的圓形，帶有選擇照片的按鈕，也可以拖入檔案。新照片會進入取景步驟，在圓形下移動和縮放（拖動、滾輪、雙指縮放、滑桿或鍵盤），然後儲存時從中剪出 `OutputSize` 像素的正方形。設定了 `UploadHandler` 時，欄位立即顯示新頭像，並顯示進度圓環直到上傳結束，進行中可以取消，失敗後可以重試；沒有處理常式時，頭像立即套用，並透過 `Cropped` 交給應用程式。

trans-unit.source: The accepted file types, as in an HTML file input: MIME types (`image/png`), `image/*` or extensions (`.png`), separated by commas. Null (the default) accepts PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF and BMP. A file is identified by its first bytes before its name, so a PDF renamed to `.png` is refused, and the picker lists only these types. While `Description` is not set, the line under the title lists the accepted types and the size limit.
trans-unit.target: 接受的檔案類型，寫法與 HTML 檔案輸入相同：MIME 類型（`image/png`）、`image/*` 或副檔名（`.png`），以逗號分隔。為 null（預設）時接受 PNG、JPEG、WebP、GIF 和 BMP。檔案先依開頭的位元組、再依名稱識別，所以改名為 `.png` 的 PDF 會被拒絕，檔案選擇器也只列出這些類型。沒有設定 `Description` 時，標題下方的一行會列出接受的類型和大小限制。

trans-unit.source: Whether the Remove button shows while there is a picture (true by default). `Remove` still works from code.
trans-unit.target: 有照片時是否顯示「移除」按鈕（預設 true）。`Remove` 仍可在程式碼中呼叫。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a framed picture is saved, before it uploads.
trans-unit.target: 儲存取景後的照片時、上傳之前觸發。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title: the accepted files and the size limit.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行：可接受的檔案和大小限制。

trans-unit.source: The person's name: the initials shown in the circle while there is no picture, with a person glyph when it is empty (the first letters of its first two words).
trans-unit.target: 此人的姓名：沒有照片時圓形裡顯示它的字首縮寫（取前兩個詞的首字母）；為空時顯示人像圖示。

trans-unit.source: The last problem: a refused file or a failed upload; null when there is none.
trans-unit.target: 最近的問題：被拒絕的檔案或失敗的上傳；沒有問題時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a file is refused (type, size or unreadable).
trans-unit.target: 檔案被拒絕時觸發（類型、大小或無法讀取）。

trans-unit.source: The initials computed from `DisplayName`.
trans-unit.target: 依 `DisplayName` 計算出的字首縮寫。

trans-unit.source: True while a file is dragged over the field.
trans-unit.target: 有檔案拖到欄位上方時為 true。

trans-unit.source: The JPEG quality of the saved picture, 1 to 100 (92 by default).
trans-unit.target: 儲存的照片的 JPEG 品質，1 到 100（預設 92）。

trans-unit.source: The field's title beside the circle.
trans-unit.target: 圓形旁邊的欄位標題。

trans-unit.source: Every word the field shows or says (English by default).
trans-unit.target: 欄位顯示或讀出的所有文字（預設為英文）。

trans-unit.source: The largest file accepted, in bytes (10 MB by default); null for no limit.
trans-unit.target: 可接受的最大檔案，以位元組計（預設 10 MB）；null 表示不限制。

trans-unit.source: How far the framing step zooms in, relative to the zoom where the picture just covers the circle (4 by default).
trans-unit.target: 取景步驟最多放大多少，相對於照片剛好蓋滿圓形時的縮放（預設 4）。

trans-unit.source: The format of the saved picture (`Bytes`): `Auto` (the default) saves a PNG, and a picture whose type is unknown (one handed to `Edit` without a file name), as PNG, and any other picture as JPEG.
trans-unit.target: 儲存的照片的格式（`Bytes`）：`Auto`（預設）把 PNG 和類型未知的照片（呼叫 `Edit` 時沒有檔名）儲存為 PNG，其他照片儲存為 JPEG。

trans-unit.source: The side of the saved square picture in pixels (512 by default).
trans-unit.target: 儲存的正方形照片的邊長，以像素計（預設 512）。

trans-unit.source: The upload's progress from 0 to 1.
trans-unit.target: 上傳進度，從 0 到 1。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the picture is removed.
trans-unit.target: 移除頭像時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The diameter of the circle (96px by default).
trans-unit.target: 圓形的直徑（預設 96px）。

trans-unit.source: The picture shown in the circle; null for none. Two-way: a saved picture is written back.
trans-unit.target: 圓形中顯示的頭像；null 表示沒有。雙向：儲存的頭像會寫回。

trans-unit.source: What the field is doing.
trans-unit.target: 欄位正在做什麼。

trans-unit.source: The status line under the title (the description, the progress, or what went wrong).
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的狀態列（說明、進度或出了什麼問題）。

trans-unit.source: Uploads a framed picture: report progress from 0 to 1 and honor the token (Cancel upload). Without a handler the picture is applied as soon as it is saved.
trans-unit.target: 上傳取景後的照片：回報從 0 到 1 的進度，並遵守取消權杖（Cancel upload）。沒有處理常式時，照片儲存後立即套用。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Cropped`.
trans-unit.target: `Cropped` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `AvatarUpload` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to translate or reword it; the texts that include a number or a name are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `AvatarUpload` 顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可翻譯或改寫；包含數字或名稱的文字是格式函式。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `FileRejected`.
trans-unit.target: `FileRejected` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: A framed picture: the square image to upload and the part of the original it was cut from.
trans-unit.target: 取景後的照片：要上傳的正方形圖片，以及它在原圖中剪出的部分。

trans-unit.source: A round button that appears once a long list, log or feed has scrolled past `Threshold` and smoothly scrolls it back to the top when pressed. Place it yourself over the scroll container (usually in the same Grid cell) and point `Target` at it, or set `BackToTop.IsAttached="True"` on the container to have the button placed in a corner of its viewport for you.
trans-unit.target: 長清單、日誌或動態消息向下捲動超過 `Threshold` 後出現的圓形按鈕，按下後平滑捲回頂部。可以自己把它放在捲動容器上方（通常在同一個 Grid 儲存格裡）並把 `Target` 指向容器，也可以在容器上設定 `BackToTop.IsAttached="True"`，由程式庫把按鈕放在檢視區的一角。

trans-unit.source: Attached to a scroll container with `BackToTop.IsAttached`: the distance from the viewport's edges (default 16).
trans-unit.target: 附加到設定了 `BackToTop.IsAttached` 的捲動容器：按鈕與檢視區邊緣的距離（預設 16）。

trans-unit.source: Attached to a scroll container: adds a back-to-top button in a corner of its viewport (in the container's adorner layer, so it does not scroll with the content).
trans-unit.target: 附加到捲動容器：在其檢視區的一角加上回到頂部按鈕（放在容器的裝飾層裡，因此不隨內容捲動）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the button is showing: the target can scroll and is scrolled further down than `Threshold`.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕是否顯示：目標可以捲動，且向下捲動超過 `Threshold`。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name and tooltip; null uses the localized "Back to top".
trans-unit.target: 協助工具名稱與提示；為 null 時使用在地化的「回到頂部」。

trans-unit.source: Attached to a scroll container with `BackToTop.IsAttached`: the viewport corner the button sits in.
trans-unit.target: 附加到設定了 `BackToTop.IsAttached` 的捲動容器：按鈕所在的檢視區角落。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a smooth scroll started by the button or `ScrollToTop` has reached the top; not raised when the user interrupts it.
trans-unit.target: 由按鈕或 `ScrollToTop` 發起的平滑捲動到達頂部時觸發；被使用者打斷時不觸發。

trans-unit.source: The button size: Small 36, Medium 44 (default) or Large 50 pixels across.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕尺寸：直徑 Small 36、Medium 44（預設）或 Large 50 像素。

trans-unit.source: The scroll container to bring back to the top: a ScrollViewer (ScrollArea is one), or a control whose template holds one (Timeline, Table, TreeView, a templated ListBox).
trans-unit.target: 要捲回頂部的捲動容器：ScrollViewer（ScrollArea 就是一種），或範本裡含有 ScrollViewer 的控制項（Timeline、Table、TreeView、具有範本的 ListBox）。

trans-unit.source: How far, in pixels, the content must be scrolled down before the button appears (default 200; negative counts as 0). Also an attached property for a container with `BackToTop.IsAttached`.
trans-unit.target: 內容需要向下捲動多少像素按鈕才出現（預設 200；負數視為 0）。也是附加屬性，用於設定了 `BackToTop.IsAttached` 的容器。

trans-unit.source: A small pill for status, category or metadata (Arc Badge): a tone, an optional leading icon and a short label. It is a standalone inline label, not a count overlay. When a string or number label changes while the badge stays mounted, the new text rises out of a soft blur, the old one lifts away, and the pill width springs to fit (P2, P5); a new icon pops in from 0.6. Other content is shown as is. Reduced motion crossfades and the width jumps.
trans-unit.target: 用於狀態、分類或中繼資料的小型膠囊標籤（Arc Badge）：包含一種色調、可選的前置圖示和簡短文字。它是獨立的行內標籤，而不是數量角標。當字串或數字標籤在徽章保持掛載時發生變化，新文字從柔和模糊中升起，舊文字向上移出，膠囊寬度以彈簧適配（P2、P5）；新圖示從 0.6 倍大小彈出。其他內容按原樣顯示。減少動態效果模式下改為交叉淡入，寬度直接跳變。

trans-unit.source: Leading icon (for example an `ArcGlyph`); it takes the tone color and is hidden from assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 前置圖示（例如 `ArcGlyph`）；採用色調顏色，並對輔助技術隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Medium (26px, default) or Small (22px).
trans-unit.target: Medium（26px，預設）或 Small（22px）。

trans-unit.source: Color treatment (Arc `tone`, neutral by default).
trans-unit.target: 顏色樣式（Arc `tone`，預設為中性）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the cell as a small pill colored by its value, such as a stage or a status. Map values to tones with `Tones` (or `ToneMap` in XAML); values without a mapping use `DefaultTone`.
trans-unit.target: 把儲存格顯示為依值著色的小膠囊，例如階段或狀態。用 `Tones`（XAML 中用 `ToneMap`）把值對應到色調；沒有對應的值使用 `DefaultTone`。

trans-unit.source: Arc's bar chart: one measure across a run of days, weeks or months, with an average reference line and a headline that reads the average at rest and the scrubbed bar while exploring. Bars grow in a left-to-right wave the first time the chart is seen; a new range zooms the slots around the latest bar while bars that keep their key morph, new ones grow beside them and leaving ones sink into the baseline. Motion is code-driven (`MotionValue` per bar) because bar heights, slots and the scale are coordinates inside the self-drawn plot, which ControlTheme transitions cannot reach.
trans-unit.target: Arc 長條圖：跨越一段天、週或月的單一指標，帶有平均值參考線；標題在靜止時顯示平均值，探索時顯示被掃過的長條。圖表首次出現時，長條按從左到右的波浪依序成長；切換範圍時，圖表圍繞最新的長條縮放各槽位，保留鍵值的長條會變形，新長條在其旁邊成長，被移除的長條則下沉至基線。動畫由程式碼驅動（每根長條一個 `MotionValue`），因為長條高度、槽位和刻度都是自繪繪圖區域中的座標，ControlTheme 的轉場無法觸及。

trans-unit.source: Headline label at rest, above the average.
trans-unit.target: 靜止時標題中平均值上方的標籤。

trans-unit.source: The range on show, such as "Sep 15–21, 2026". It rests under the headline.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的範圍，例如「Sep 15–21, 2026」。它位於標題下方。

trans-unit.source: Draws the average as a dashed reference line that springs to each new range.
trans-unit.target: 將平均值繪製為虛線參考線，並以彈簧過渡到每個新範圍。

trans-unit.source: Draws the gridlines behind the plot (default true).
trans-unit.target: 在圖表後方繪製格線（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the category (time) axis labels under the plot (default true).
trans-unit.target: 在繪圖區下方顯示類別（時間）軸標籤（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value axis labels in the right-hand gutter (default true).
trans-unit.target: 在右側邊界中顯示數值軸標籤（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Formats value-axis ticks. Defaults to the value format (Arc formats ticks like values).
trans-unit.target: 格式化數值軸的刻度。預設使用數值格式（Arc 依數值的方式格式化刻度）。

trans-unit.source: Headline label while a bar is scrubbed.
trans-unit.target: 探索某根長條時標題上顯示的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Fixes the top of the value axis; by default it is the next nice tick above the data.
trans-unit.target: 固定數值軸的上限；預設為資料上方的下一個整齊刻度。

trans-unit.source: A billing page in one view: the current plan with its status, price and next charge; the card on file and the billing email; and the invoice history with a download button per invoice. Every action raises a routed event for the host to handle (change or cancel the plan, update the card, edit the email, download an invoice). Older invoices beyond `VisibleInvoiceCount` fold behind "Show all invoices". Composed of `SettingsGroup`, `SettingsRow`, `Badge` and `Button`.
trans-unit.target: 一個畫面中的帳單頁：目前方案及其狀態、價格與下次扣款；已綁定的付款卡與帳單電子郵件；以及每張發票都附下載按鈕的發票紀錄。每項操作都會引發路由事件，交由宿主處理（變更或取消方案、更新付款卡、編輯電子郵件、下載發票）。超出 `VisibleInvoiceCount` 的較舊發票會收合在「顯示全部發票」之後。由 `SettingsGroup`、`SettingsRow`、`Badge` 與 `Button` 組成。

trans-unit.source: Where invoices are emailed, shown in the payment card.

trans-unit.target: `BillingToggle` 旁邊的價格（Arc `BillingPrice`）：金額逐位滾動到新值（`AnimatedCounter`，P14）；被劃線的原價從左側淡入，寬度以彈簧展開；計費週期文字原位替換，寬度平滑過渡，因此它們旁邊的內容不會跳動。

trans-unit.source: Arc billing toggle: a billing period switch. One thumb glides between the options on a critically damped spring, and the savings note on the cheaper period tints with `BadgeAccent` and rewrites itself in place once it is chosen. Defaults to Monthly / Yearly ("Save 20%"); supply `BillingToggleOption` items (inline or via `ItemsSource`) for other periods. `Value` is two-way. Pair it with `BillingPrice` for prices that roll to the new amount.
trans-unit.target: Arc 計費切換：計費週期開關。一個滑塊在選項之間以臨界阻尼彈簧滑動；較便宜週期上的節省提示以 `BadgeAccent` 著色，被選取後在原位改寫自身。預設提供按月／按年（「Save 20%」）；如需其他週期，可提供 `BillingToggleOption` 項目（內嵌或透過 `ItemsSource`）。`Value` 為雙向繫結。與 `BillingPrice` 搭配使用，價格可滾動到新金額。

trans-unit.source: A delete transition around a list or grid. `SwallowAsync` pulls the chosen items into a tiny black hole along a logarithmic spiral while the rest of the content bends around it (gravitational lensing), then the hole collapses with one soft shockwave; `ReleaseAsync` plays the same path backwards to put items back. Calls queue, so a release asked for during a swallow waits its turn. The effect paints a snapshot of the content while it runs; the real content is back the moment it ends. With reduced motion the items fade in 200 ms instead.
trans-unit.target: 包住清單或格線的刪除轉場。`SwallowAsync` 把選取的項目沿對數螺線吸進一個很小的黑洞，同時其餘內容繞著它彎曲（重力透鏡），接著洞塌縮並送出一圈柔和的震波；`ReleaseAsync` 沿同一條路徑倒著播放，把項目放回原處。呼叫會排隊，因此在吞噬過程中要求的釋放會等輪到它。效果執行時繪製的是內容的快照；效果一結束，真實內容就回來了。在減少動態效果下，項目改為在 200 ms 內淡化。

trans-unit.source: Length of a swallow (default 1.3 s, as measured); a release runs `ReleaseSpeed` times as long.
trans-unit.target: 吞噬的長度（預設 1.3 s，與實測一致）；釋放的長度是它的 `ReleaseSpeed` 倍。

trans-unit.source: Resting radius of the black core in DIP (default 5.5; it grows 40 % while it eats). The lens scales with it.
trans-unit.target: 黑色核心的靜止半徑，單位 DIP（預設 5.5；吞噬時變大 40 %）。透鏡隨它縮放。

trans-unit.source: True while a transition runs (or a reduced-motion fade) or another one is queued. Ignore your delete and undo triggers while it is set.
trans-unit.target: 轉場正在執行（或減少動態效果下的淡化）或另有轉場在排隊時為 true。為 true 期間請忽略你的刪除與復原觸發器。

trans-unit.source: Length of a release as a fraction of `Duration` (default 0.92: the reverse runs a little faster).
trans-unit.target: 釋放長度佔 `Duration` 的比例（預設 0.92：倒著播放稍微快一點）。

trans-unit.source: How far the shockwave ring travels after the hole collapses, in DIP (default 90).
trans-unit.target: 洞塌縮後震波環往外擴展的距離，單位 DIP（預設 90）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a transition has finished and the content is back in place.

trans-unit.source: A modal sheet that rises from the bottom edge and rests at one or more heights (detents): trip details, share options, filters, map and media views where a peek is useful before the full view. One motion value drives the sheet: a drag follows the pointer 1:1, rubber-bands past the tallest detent, and on release projects 0.2s of its velocity to pick the nearest detent or close; a flick faster than 320px/s always moves at least one detent. The dim is a function of the sheet position. The grabber answers ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End and toggles between the lowest and highest detent; reading keys on the sheet open it fully before scrolling; touch drags on the content move the sheet until it is fully open. Under reduced motion detents jump and the sheet fades. The sheet position is a `MotionValue`, not a ControlTheme transition: a drag writes it every move, a release hands the pointer velocity to the spring, and the scrim is computed from it each frame.
trans-unit.target: 從底部邊緣升起、停留在一個或多個高度（檔位）上的模態面板：適用於行程詳情、分享選項、篩選器、地圖和媒體檢視等需要先預覽、再檢視完整內容的情境。一個動作值驅動整個面板：拖曳時面板 1:1 跟隨指標，越過最高檔位時產生橡皮筋回彈；放開時，依 0.2s 內的速度投射位置，選擇最近的檔位或關閉；速度超過 320px/s 的快速輕掃至少會移動一個檔位。遮罩的暗度由面板位置決定。拖曳把手響應 ArrowUp / ArrowDown / Home / End，並在最低與最高檔位之間切換；面板上的閱讀鍵會先將其完全展開再捲動；在內容上進行觸控拖曳會移動面板，直到其完全展開。減少動態效果模式下，檔位直接跳轉，面板淡入淡出。面板位置是 `MotionValue`，而不是 ControlTheme 轉場：拖曳時每次移動都會寫入它，放開時將指標速度交給彈簧，遮罩則在每一影格由它計算。

trans-unit.source: A git-style history: one row per commit, each branch in its own colored lane, curves where a branch splits off and where it merges back, merge commits drawn as rings, and pills for branch heads and tags. Its story draws the history commit by commit (the edges draw in, the dot pops, the branch label moves up) with a caption that says what each commit did. Play, pause, step, restart and a 0.5× / 1× / 2× speed control drive it; `StartsFinished` or reduced motion opens it on the whole history. Selecting a commit (click, or the arrow keys on the focused graph) highlights everything it descends from and dims the rest.
trans-unit.target: Git 風格的提交歷史：每個提交一列，每個分支占據各自顏色的泳道，分支分出和合併回來的位置以曲線連接，合併提交畫成圓環，分支頭和標籤顯示為膠囊標籤。它的演示逐個提交地繪製歷史（連線畫出、圓點彈出、分支標籤上移），並配有說明每個提交做了什麼的字幕。播放、暫停、單步、重新開始以及 0.5× / 1× / 2× 速度控制項驅動演示；`StartsFinished` 或減少動態效果時直接顯示完整歷史。選取一個提交（點擊，或在取得焦點的圖上按方向鍵）會醒目標示它的所有祖先，其餘部分變暗。

trans-unit.source: Arc breadcrumb: where a page sits in a hierarchy, from the root to the current page. Crumbs are separated by chevrons; the last one is the current page (accent, medium weight, not a link) and every crumb reserves the width of its medium-weight label so becoming current never shifts the path. Crumbs present at first render stay still; crumbs added later slide in 8px from the path before them out of a subtle blur while their siblings make room on the smooth spring, and removed crumbs slide 4px back as they fade. Items are `BreadcrumbItem`s written inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (`ItemTemplate` renders the label). Choosing a crumb raises `ItemClick`, runs its `Command` and opens its `NavigateUri`. `MaxVisibleItems` (off by default, as in Arc) folds the middle of a long path into an overflow menu.
trans-unit.target: Arc 麵包屑：顯示頁面在層級中的位置，從根到目前頁面。各層級之間以箭頭分隔；最後一級為目前頁面（強調色、中等字重，不是連結）。每一級都會保留其中等字重標籤的寬度，因此成為目前頁面時路徑不會位移。首次渲染時已存在的層級保持靜止；之後新增的層級會從前一級的路徑位置滑入 8px，並在柔和模糊中出現，同層的其他項目則以平滑彈簧讓出空間；被移除的層級在淡出時滑回 4px。項目為內嵌寫入的 `BreadcrumbItem`，或由 `ItemsSource` 產生（`ItemTemplate` 渲染標籤）。選取某一級會引發 `ItemClick`，執行其 `Command` 並開啟其 `NavigateUri`。`MaxVisibleItems`（與 Arc 一樣預設關閉）會將較長路徑的中間部分摺疊進溢出選單。

trans-unit.source: Arc's brush chart: a long, dense time series with an overview strip. Drag the window to pan, drag a handle to resize, drag across empty track to draw a new window, tap to recenter, double-click to reset. When the view is zoomed far out a seven-point average and its low-to-high band replace the raw line, crossfading by density. Events are marked on both charts and labelled where they fit. The value axis springs to the tallest point in view; the line draws in from the left the first time the chart is seen. Dragging is followed 1:1 by a local tracker (`ChartDragTracker`); presets, resets and bound `Range` changes glide the window on a smooth spring (`MotionValue`), because the window is a coordinate pair inside the self-drawn overview.
trans-unit.target: Arc 刷選圖表：帶有概覽條的長而密集的時間序列。拖曳視窗可平移，拖曳把手可調整大小，在空白軌道上拖曳可繪製新視窗，輕點可重新置中，雙擊可重設。視圖被縮放得很遠時，七點平均值及其低到高的帶狀區域會取代原始折線，並依資料密度交叉淡入。事件會同時標記在兩個圖表上，並在有空間時標註文字。數值軸以彈簧貼合視野中最高的點；折線在圖表首次出現時從左側繪製。拖曳由本地追蹤器（`ChartDragTracker`）1:1 跟隨；預設、重設以及繫結的 `Range` 變化會以平滑彈簧（`MotionValue`）滑動視窗，因為視窗是自繪概覽內的一對座標。

trans-unit.source: Events drawn as markers on both charts.
trans-unit.target: 在兩個圖表上以標記繪製的事件。

trans-unit.source: Budget against actual spend by department as bullet charts on one shared scale, so every budget tick lines up down the table. Each row shows three qualitative bands, the actual bar (the overspend past the tick in the danger color) and the variance as a signed amount and share, colored by whether it is favorable; every figure is an expense, so spending under budget is favorable. A period switch springs every bar and counts every number to the new window, a total row sums the table, and a department opens in place to show its budget lines. Department figures and the total are summed from the lines, so they always reconcile.
trans-unit.target: 按部門把預算與實際支出畫成同一共用刻度上的子彈圖，讓每個預算刻度在整張表中上下對齊。每一列顯示三段定性區帶、實際支出條（超過刻度的超支部分以危險色繪製），以及帶正負號的差異金額與比例，並依是否有利著色；每個數字都按支出解讀，所以低於預算是有利的。期間切換讓每根條一起彈簧伸縮、每個數字計數到新的期間，合計列彙總整張表，部門可原地展開顯示其預算科目。部門數字與合計都由科目加總，因此總能對得上。

trans-unit.source: An animated "AI is building your app" visual (Arc Building blocks, design reference). Rounded blocks for a nav bar, a hero card, a chart, an avatar row, a settings row and a button fly in and snap into a tiny app layout with no bounce, land as tinted placeholders, fill with real-looking content and pick up the tint in a styling pass, while the status line steps through Laying out, Adding components, Styling and Ready. Map your request to `Status`: `Building` while it runs, `Done` when the result arrives (the rest fast forwards), `Idle` before the first prompt. Leave `Status` unset to play a simulated build. The frame grows to `Size` (or `StageWidth`) and never past its container; everything inside scales with the width.
trans-unit.target: 「AI 正在搭建你的應用程式」的動畫畫面（Arc Building blocks，設計參考）。導覽列、主卡片、圖表、頭像列、設定列和按鈕這些圓角積木飛入，無回彈地吸附進一個小小的應用程式版面，先以著色的預留位置落定，再填上逼真的內容，並於樣式階段染上主題色；狀態列依序顯示 Laying out、Adding components、Styling 和 Ready。把請求對應到 `Status`：進行中為 `Building`，結果抵達為 `Done`（其餘階段快轉），第一次提示之前為 `Idle`。不設定 `Status` 時播放模擬建置。框架長到 `Size`（或 `StageWidth`）的寬度且不超出容器；內部一切隨寬度縮放。

trans-unit.source: What the app says about its generation: idle clears the frame to dashed slots, building runs the phases (and re-assembles while `IsLooping`), done fast forwards and settles on Ready. Null plays the built-in simulated build.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式對產生過程的說明：idle 把框架清空為虛線槽位，building 播放各個階段（`IsLooping` 時重新組裝），done 快轉並停在 Ready。為 null 時播放內建的模擬建置。

trans-unit.source: Any color, taking the place of `Tone`, for a brand or per-product tint.
trans-unit.target: 任意顏色，取代 `Tone`，用於品牌色或依產品著色。

trans-unit.source: The tint of the placeholders, the button, the chart, the switch and the status mark: the accent or the foreground.
trans-unit.target: 預留位置、按鈕、圖表、開關和狀態標記的顏色：強調色或前景色。

trans-unit.source: Every word `BuildingBlocks` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or to name the thing being built (`Ready = "Your dashboard is ready"`).
trans-unit.target: `BuildingBlocks` 顯示或朗讀的所有文字，預設為英文。替換整個物件來在地化，或寫明正在建置的東西（`Ready = "Your dashboard is ready"`）。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `PhaseChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `PhaseChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Arc button: a clear, responsive action with quiet secondary states. Presses scale on a snappy spring, label changes crossfade with a short blur while the width springs to fit, and `IsLoading` shows a spinner while keeping keyboard focus (clicks are swallowed instead of disabling the button).
trans-unit.target: Arc 按鈕：清晰、靈敏的操作，次要狀態安靜低調。按下時以輕快的彈簧縮放；文字變化時以短暫模糊交叉淡化，寬度以彈簧適配內容。`IsLoading` 顯示載入指示器，同時保留鍵盤焦點（點按會被忽略，而不是停用按鈕）。

trans-unit.source: Puts the button in its loading state while true.
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時，按鈕進入載入狀態。

trans-unit.source: Anchors of popups and menus must not scale on press (the popup measures the pressed size); they answer with color only. Defaults to true.
trans-unit.target: 彈層與選單的錨點按鈕在按下時不得縮放（彈層需量測按下時的尺寸）；它們僅以顏色作出回應。預設為 true。

trans-unit.source: Spring the button's width follows when its label changes: Morph (default, a slight bounce), or Quick for a bounce-free 0.25s glide that pairs with the Label swap.
trans-unit.target: 標籤變化時按鈕寬度跟隨的彈簧：Morph（預設，帶輕微回彈），或 Quick，即 0.25 秒無回彈的滑動，與 Label 切換搭配使用。

trans-unit.source: How a new label replaces the old one: BlurSwap (default, a short blur), or Label for the quiet crossfade of Arc's AI blocks (100ms out, 160ms in rising 2px), or any other content swap mode.
trans-unit.target: 新標籤取代舊標籤的方式：BlurSwap（預設，短暫模糊），或 Label，即 Arc AI 區塊的安靜交叉淡化（淡出 100ms，淡入 160ms 並上升 2px），也可以是其他任意內容切換模式。

trans-unit.source: Button height: Small, Medium (default) or Large.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕高度：Small、Medium（預設）或 Large。

trans-unit.source: Visual style: Primary (default), Secondary, Ghost or Danger.
trans-unit.target: 視覺樣式：Primary（預設）、Secondary、Ghost 或 Danger。

trans-unit.source: Two to five related actions joined into one surface with hairline dividers (Arc button group): Share, Duplicate and Archive on a document, zoom controls, Reply / Reply all / Forward. One soft highlight glides between segments under the pointer or keyboard focus (the dividers beside it step aside), the pressed segment answers in place, and an optional chevron segment (`Menu`) opens rarer or destructive actions in a menu aligned to the group's edge. Segments are `ButtonGroupItem`s declared inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (plain data becomes the label). When a horizontal row does not fit, segments with an icon drop their label (it moves to the tooltip and the accessible name); if it still does not fit the row scrolls sideways without a scrollbar. Keyboard: every segment is a Tab stop; the arrow keys along the orientation (mirrored right to left), Home and End move between segments and wrap; Enter or Space activates. On the chevron, Enter, Space or ArrowDown opens the menu on the first row and Escape returns focus. A label that changes right after its segment was pressed (Share to Copied) is announced once.
trans-unit.target: 將兩到五個相關操作合併為一個帶細分隔線的整體（Arc 按鈕群組）：例如文件上的「分享」「複製」「封存」，縮放控制項，「回覆 / 全部回覆 / 轉寄」。指標或鍵盤焦點所在的區段下方有一個柔和高亮平滑滑動（旁邊的分隔線隨之讓開），被按下的區段原地作出回應；可選的下拉箭頭區段（`Menu`）會在與群組邊緣對齊的選單中開啟較少用或具破壞性的操作。區段可以是內嵌宣告的 `ButtonGroupItem`，也可以由 `ItemsSource` 產生（一般資料會成為標籤）。水平排列放不下時，帶圖示的區段會隱藏文字（文字移至提示與無障礙名稱）；若仍放不下，整列會橫向捲動且不顯示捲軸。鍵盤操作：每個區段都是 Tab 停駐點；沿排列方向的方向鍵（從右到左時鏡像）、Home 與 End 在區段間移動並循環；Enter 或空白鍵啟動。在下拉箭頭上，Enter、空白鍵或 ArrowDown 會在第一列開啟選單，Escape 將焦點移回。區段被按下後立即改變的標籤（如「分享」變為「已複製」）只播報一次。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a segment's own click handlers and command.
trans-unit.target: 在區段自身的點按處理常式與命令執行之後引發。

trans-unit.source: True while segments show only their icons because the row did not fit.
trans-unit.target: 因排列空間不足，區段只顯示圖示時為 true。

trans-unit.source: When a horizontal row does not fit, segments with an icon drop their label (default true).
trans-unit.target: 水平排列放不下時，帶圖示的區段隱藏其文字（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the group (Arc: required), such as "Document actions".
trans-unit.target: 按鈕群組的無障礙名稱（Arc 中必填），例如「文件操作」。

trans-unit.source: Adds a trailing chevron segment that opens this menu, aligned to the group's end (start when vertical).
trans-unit.target: 在末尾新增一個下拉箭頭區段，點按後開啟此選單，並與群組的末端對齊（垂直排列時與起始端對齊）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row of the chevron menu is activated.
trans-unit.target: 下拉選單中的某一列被啟動時引發。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name and tooltip of the chevron segment.
trans-unit.target: 下拉箭頭區段的無障礙名稱與提示。

trans-unit.source: Lays the segments out in a row (Horizontal, default) or a column (Vertical).
trans-unit.target: 按鈕區段依列（Horizontal，預設）或欄（Vertical）排列。

trans-unit.source: Small (36px) or Medium (44px, default). Large is treated as Medium.
trans-unit.target: Small（36px）或 Medium（44px，預設）。Large 按 Medium 處理。

trans-unit.source: Outline (default) for a bordered surface, or Solid for the main action of a screen (use at most once).
trans-unit.target: Outline（預設）用於有邊框的表面，Solid 用於頁面的主要操作（最多使用一次）。

trans-unit.source: A single-date month calendar. Months slide on one spring-driven strip (arrows, PageUp/PageDown, Today and a bound `DisplayMonth` all travel the same way), the title slides with them, and the selected disc glides between days while each number flips color as the disc passes it. Every month shows six weeks, so the height never changes. Full keyboard model: arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown (Shift = year), Enter/Space; disabled days are skipped in the direction of travel.
trans-unit.target: 單一日期的月曆。月份沿同一條彈簧驅動的帶狀區域滑動（箭頭、PageUp/PageDown、「今天」以及繫結的 `DisplayMonth` 都以相同方向移動），標題隨之滑動；選取的圓點在日期之間平滑移動，經過時數字的顏色隨之翻轉。每個月顯示六週，因此高度永不改變。完整的鍵盤操作：方向鍵、Home/End、PageUp/PageDown（按住 Shift 為整年）、Enter/空白鍵；被停用的日期會沿移動方向略過。

trans-unit.source: Culture for month and weekday names (null = current UI culture).
trans-unit.target: 月份與星期名稱所用的地區文化（null 表示目前 UI 文化）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the user picks a day (click, Enter / Space, or Today).
trans-unit.target: 使用者選取某一天時引發（點按、Enter / 空白鍵，或「今天」）。

trans-unit.source: Extra disabled days (weekends, booked dates...).
trans-unit.target: 額外停用的日期（週末、已被預訂的日期等）。

trans-unit.source: Any date in the displayed month (normalized to its first day). Defaults to the selection's month, else today's.
trans-unit.target: 顯示月份中的任意日期（會正規化為該月第一天）。預設為所選日期所在的月份，否則為今天所在的月份。

trans-unit.source: The first day of each week row (default Sunday).
trans-unit.target: 每一週列的第一天（預設為星期日）。

trans-unit.source: Latest selectable date; later days are disabled. Null means no upper limit.
trans-unit.target: 可選擇的最晚日期；之後的日期會被停用。null 表示沒有上限。

trans-unit.source: Earliest selectable date; earlier days are disabled. Null means no lower limit.
trans-unit.target: 可選擇的最早日期；之前的日期會被停用。null 表示沒有下限。

trans-unit.source: Label of the next-month button (default "Next month").
trans-unit.target: 下個月按鈕的標籤（預設為「下個月」）。

trans-unit.source: Label of the previous-month button (default "Previous month").
trans-unit.target: 上個月按鈕的標籤（預設為「上個月」）。

trans-unit.source: The selected date, or null when nothing is selected. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 選取的日期；未選取時為 null。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Adds a Today button that slides back to the current month and selects today when it is available.
trans-unit.target: 新增一個「今天」按鈕：點按後平滑回到目前月份，並在可用時選取今天。

trans-unit.source: Text of the Today button (default "Today").
trans-unit.target: 今天按鈕的文字（預設為「今天」）。

trans-unit.source: A recorded sales call, taken apart: a timeline with the sentiment curve, a lane per speaker, the key moments and the topics, a playhead you play, drag or step with the keys; the transcript, which follows the playhead and can be searched; the talk-time split, the topics, the key moments and the next steps agreed on the call. With no utterances and no speakers the block shows a built-in invented call, so it looks finished on a page as it is; give it `Speakers`, `Utterances`, `Moments`, `Topics` and `NextSteps` to show your own. The block has no audio of its own: bind `Position` to your player (two-way), or let the play button move the playhead in real time.
trans-unit.target: 拆開來看的一通銷售通話錄音：帶情緒曲線、每位發言人一條軌道、關鍵時刻和話題的時間軸，以及可以播放、拖曳或用按鍵移動的播放頭；跟隨播放頭、可以搜尋的文字記錄；發言時長占比、話題、關鍵時刻和通話中約定的後續步驟。 沒有發言內容也沒有發言人時，本區塊顯示內置的虛構通話，所以放在頁面上就是完整的樣子；提供 `Speakers`、`Utterances`、`Moments`、`Topics` 和 `NextSteps` 即可顯示你自己的通話。本區塊沒有自己的音訊：把 `Position` 雙向綁定到你的播放器，或讓播放按鈕即時移動播放頭。

trans-unit.source: The utterance under the playhead, or null between utterances.
trans-unit.target: 播放頭下的發言；在兩段發言之間為 null。

trans-unit.source: The recording's length: the end of the last utterance, moment or topic.
trans-unit.target: 錄音的長度：最後一段發言、時刻或話題的結束時間。

trans-unit.source: Whether the transcript scrolls to the line under the playhead as it moves.
trans-unit.target: 播放頭移動時，文字記錄是否滾動到播放頭下的那一行。

trans-unit.source: Draws a bordered card (true); false lays the block flat on the page.
trans-unit.target: 繪制帶邊框的卡片（true）；false 時區塊平鋪在頁面上。

trans-unit.source: Whether the playhead moves on its own in real time (two-way); it stops at the end.
trans-unit.target: 播放頭是否即時自動移動（雙向）；到結尾時停止。

trans-unit.source: The words the block shows and reads out.
trans-unit.target: 區塊顯示和讀出的文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a next step is ticked or cleared in the block.
trans-unit.target: 在區塊中勾選或取消一個後續步驟時引發。

trans-unit.source: The talk-time-weighted average sentiment of the call, from −1 to 1.
trans-unit.target: 整通通話按發言時長加權的平均情緒，從 −1 到 1。

trans-unit.source: How fast the playhead moves while playing (1, 1.5 or 2 from the speed button; any positive value from code).
trans-unit.target: 播放時播放頭的速度（速度按鈕在 1、1.5 和 2 之間切換；程式碼中可用任意正數）。

trans-unit.source: The playhead's place in the recording (two-way). Values past the end are clamped to `Duration`.
trans-unit.target: 播放頭在錄音中的位置（雙向）。超過結尾的值會被限制為 `Duration`。

trans-unit.source: The transcript search (two-way): lines that contain it are kept and marked on the timeline.
trans-unit.target: 文字記錄的搜尋（雙向）：保留包含它的行，並在時間軸上標出。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person moves the playhead (a click or drag on the timeline, a key, a transcript line or a moment); not while playing.
trans-unit.target: 使用者移動播放頭時引發（在時間軸上點擊或拖曳、按鍵、點擊文字記錄的一行或一個時刻）；播放時不引發。

trans-unit.source: The name of the chosen topic (two-way): its stretches are tinted on the timeline; null chooses none.
trans-unit.target: 選中話題的名稱（雙向）：它的各段在時間軸上著色；為 null 時不選。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading (who, when); null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行（誰、何時）；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The heading (the call's name); null shows the sample call's name while the samples are shown, otherwise nothing.
trans-unit.target: 標題（通話名稱）；為 null 時，顯示示例時用示例通話的名稱，否則不顯示。

trans-unit.source: A key moment of the call, pinned to a time on the timeline.
trans-unit.target: 通話中的一個關鍵時刻，固定在時間軸上的某個時間。

trans-unit.source: A follow-up agreed on the call, with an owner and a due date, that can be ticked off.
trans-unit.target: 通話中約定的後續事項，帶負責人和截止日期，可以勾選完成。

trans-unit.source: A person on a recorded call: who they are and which side of the deal they are on.
trans-unit.target: 通話中的一個人：他是誰，屬於交易的哪一方。

trans-unit.source: A stretch of the call spent on one topic. Several stretches may share a name; their time adds up.
trans-unit.target: 通話中用在一個話題上的一段時間。幾段可以同名，時間會相加。

trans-unit.source: One stretch of speech in the transcript: who spoke, when, what they said and how it sounded.
trans-unit.target: 文字記錄中的一段發言：誰說的、何時說的、說了什麼、聽起來如何。

trans-unit.source: A considerate cancellation flow in one card: it asks why, offers an alternative that fits the reason, shows what ends and when, and asks the person to hold a button to confirm; the last step thanks them or lets them reactivate. A step bar on top shows where they are. Steps slide in the direction of travel while the card's height follows on a spring; each step's controls are built once and reused. Enter runs the step's main action, Alt+Left goes back, and focus moves to the new step's title after every change.
trans-unit.target: 單一卡片內的體貼取消流程：先詢問原因，提供符合該原因的挽留方案，說明哪些內容何時終止，並要求使用者按住按鈕確認；最後一步會向使用者致謝，或允許其重新啟用。頂部的步驟列顯示目前位置。步驟會沿移動方向滑入，卡片高度則以彈簧動態效果跟隨變化；每個步驟的控制項只建立一次並重複使用。按下 Enter 執行該步驟的主要動作，Alt+Left 返回上一步，每次變更後焦點都會移至新步驟的標題。

trans-unit.source: The last day of paid access after canceling (usually the renewal date); null when access ends at once.
trans-unit.target: 取消後可繼續使用付費權限的最後一天（通常為續訂日期）；為 null 時表示立即結束存取。

trans-unit.source: Card (default) draws the flow's own frame; Plain drops it for a flow inside a dialog or another card.
trans-unit.target: Card（預設）會繪製流程自身的框線；Plain 則移除框線，適用於對話方塊或其他卡片內的流程。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the hold to cancel completes (the flow moves to Canceled), with the reason and the feedback.
trans-unit.target: 按住取消操作完成時引發（流程轉為 Canceled），附帶原因與回饋。

trans-unit.source: The offer for reasons without one of their own; null skips the offer step for them.
trans-unit.target: 供沒有專屬方案的原因使用的挽留方案；為 null 時，這些原因將跳過挽留方案步驟。

trans-unit.source: What the person wrote in the optional feedback field (two-way); null when empty.
trans-unit.target: 使用者在選填回饋欄位中填寫的內容（雙向繫結）；為空時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised by "Keep my plan" and by "Done" after an accepted offer: the person is staying, so close the flow.
trans-unit.target: 由「保留我的方案」以及接受挽留方案後的「完成」引發：使用者選擇留下，因此應關閉流程。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text and date culture; replace the whole object to localize the flow.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字與日期地區設定；取代整個物件即可在地化此流程。

trans-unit.source: What ends with the plan, listed on the confirmation step (for example "Shared projects become read-only").
trans-unit.target: 隨方案一併終止的內容，列在確認步驟中（例如「共用專案變為唯讀」）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person accepts the offer (the flow moves to Retained), with the reason and the offer.
trans-unit.target: 使用者接受挽留方案時引發（流程轉為 Retained），附帶原因與該方案。

trans-unit.source: The plan's name as people know it, such as "Studio"; used in the titles and sentences.
trans-unit.target: 方案的名稱，即使用者熟知的稱呼，例如「Studio」；用於標題與句子中。

trans-unit.source: Raised by "Reactivate plan" on the canceled step. Unless a handler marks it handled, the flow then calls `Reset`.
trans-unit.target: 在已取消步驟中按下「重新啟用方案」時引發。除非處理常式將其標示為已處理，否則流程隨後會呼叫 `Reset`。

trans-unit.source: The reasons to choose from, written inline or bound. Empty (the default) uses the five reasons in `DefaultReasons`.
trans-unit.target: 可供選擇的原因，可直接寫入或繫結。為空（預設值）時使用 `DefaultReasons` 中的五個原因。

trans-unit.source: The chosen reason (two-way); Continue is disabled while it is null.
trans-unit.target: 所選原因（雙向繫結）；為 null 時「繼續」按鈕不可用。

trans-unit.source: The step on screen: Reason, Offer, Confirm, Canceled or Retained. Changes through the flow's buttons, `GoBack` and `Reset`.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的步驟：Reason、Offer、Confirm、Canceled 或 Retained。透過流程中的按鈕、`GoBack` 與 `Reset` 變更。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the step changes, with the old and the new step.
trans-unit.target: 步驟變更後引發，附帶舊步驟與新步驟。

trans-unit.source: A memory the assistant has just noted: `Note` (such as "Noted: you run builds with the dotnet CLI") shows in the captured pill until the person files it, after which the pill shows "Saved to" the group.
trans-unit.target: 助手剛記下的一則記憶：`Note`（例如「已記下：你用 dotnet CLI 執行建置」）會在已記下的膠囊中顯示，直到使用者將其歸檔；歸檔後，膠囊會顯示「已儲存到」加上群組名稱。

trans-unit.source: The memory to file; it is added to `Memories` when the pill is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 要歸檔的記憶；按下膠囊時會將其新增到 `Memories`。

trans-unit.source: The short sentence the pill shows, such as "Noted: you run builds with the dotnet CLI".
trans-unit.target: 膠囊顯示的簡短句子，例如「已記下：你用 dotnet CLI 執行建置」。

trans-unit.source: Arc card: a contained group of related content and actions for browsable grid items (projects, listings, posts), with optional media, an owner byline and a status line that updates in place. A pointed-at card lifts 2px on a snappy spring while its border and shadow deepen and the media drifts to 1.04 (mouse only). Set `Details` and the title becomes a button and the whole card a trigger: the card grows into a larger quick look without leaving the page (P8): its surface, media, title, description, byline and action fly into a `DialogSurface` on the overlay layer on one critically damped spring (0.3s; 0.26s back) while the corners morph, the details rise in after 120ms and the page dims behind a 7px backdrop blur. Escape, the scrim or the close button send it back into the card and return focus to the title. Reduced motion fades the quick look instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 卡片：用於可瀏覽的網格項目（專案、刊登、貼文）的一組相關內容與操作，可選包含媒體、擁有者署名以及會原地更新的狀態列。指標停在卡片上時，卡片以輕快的彈簧上浮 2px，邊框與陰影加深，媒體緩慢放大至 1.04（僅限滑鼠）。設定 `Details` 後，標題變為按鈕，整張卡片變為觸發器：卡片會擴展為較大的快速預覽而不離開頁面（P8）：其表面、媒體、標題、描述、署名與操作會以臨界阻尼彈簧（0.3 秒；收回為 0.26 秒）飛入覆蓋層上的 `DialogSurface`，同時圓角變形，細節在 120 毫秒後浮現，頁面則在 7px 的背景模糊下變暗。按 Escape、點按遮罩或關閉按鈕可使其收回卡片，並將焦點返回標題。減少動態效果時，快速預覽改為淡入淡出。

trans-unit.target: 底部尾隨的控制項（按鈕）；在卡片上仍可單獨取得焦點並點按。

trans-unit.target: 快速預覽背後的遮罩（主題設定為 Arc 的 oklch(10% 0 0 / 0.46)）。

trans-unit.target: 位於 meta 下方的簡短狀態（「2 小時前更新」）；新文字會上浮出現，並以禮貌方式播報。

trans-unit.source: A deck of cards reviewed one at a time (Arc card stack): drag or flick the top card left or right, or use the buttons and arrow keys. Use it for quick, one-by-one triage where each item deserves a moment of attention: shortlisting destinations, candidates or design options. The top card tilts with the drag and shows a stamp; a flick or a long enough drag throws it out with the release velocity, the cards behind rise into place, Undo flies the last card back from where it left, and Start over deals the deck back. Only the top four cards (and cards still in flight) are realized, however long the stack. Keyboard on the focused stage: ← / → decide, Backspace or Ctrl / Cmd + Z undo. Decisions, undo and reset are announced politely. Items come from `Items` / `ItemsSource` with `ItemTemplate`; changing the items starts the stack over.
trans-unit.target: 一疊逐張審閱的卡片（Arc 卡片堆疊）：拖曳或輕掃頂部卡片向左或向右，也可使用按鈕與方向鍵。適用於需要逐一細看的快速篩選，例如候選目的地、候選人或設計方案的初選。頂部卡片會隨拖曳傾斜並顯示印章；輕掃或足夠長的拖曳會以放開時的速度將其甩出，後面的卡片上升就位；「復原」會將上一張卡片從離開的位置飛回；「重新開始」會把整疊卡片重新發牌。無論堆疊多深，只會實例化頂部四張卡片（以及仍在飛行中的卡片）。焦點位於舞台上時的鍵盤操作：← / → 作出決定，Backspace 或 Ctrl / Cmd + Z 復原。決定、復原與重設均以禮貌方式播報。項目來自 `Items` / `ItemsSource`，並配合 `ItemTemplate`；變更項目會使卡片堆重新開始。

trans-unit.source: True when there is a decision to undo.
trans-unit.target: 存在可復原的決定時為 true。

trans-unit.target: 頂部卡片的索引（所有卡片都已決定後等於項目總數）。

trans-unit.source: The last decision was undone; the card is back on top.
trans-unit.target: 上一個決定已被復原；該卡片回到頂部。

trans-unit.source: Shown once every card has been decided, instead of "All cards reviewed" and Start over.
trans-unit.target: 所有卡片都已決定後顯示，取代「所有卡片已審閱」與「重新開始」。

trans-unit.target: 用於建立空白狀態內容的資料範本；未設定 `EmptyContent` 時使用。

trans-unit.target: 卡片堆的無障礙名稱（預設為「Cards」）。

trans-unit.source: A short name for a card, used in its accessible label and in announcements ("Lisbon"). Defaults to the item's text (a string, a control's automation name, or `ToString()`).

trans-unit.target: 左側操作的名稱，顯示在其按鈕上，以及拖向左側時的印章上（預設為「Pass」）。

trans-unit.source: Past tense of the left action for announcements, such as "skipped". Without it: "Lisbon: Pass."
trans-unit.target: 用於播報的左側操作過去式，例如「skipped」。未設定時為：「Lisbon: Pass.」

trans-unit.source: Brings every card back (for custom empty content: `Command="{Binding $parent[arc:CardStack].ResetCommand}"`).
trans-unit.target: 將所有卡片全部復原（用於自訂空內容：`Command="{Binding $parent[arc:CardStack].ResetCommand}"`）。

trans-unit.target: 右側操作的名稱（預設為「Keep」）。

trans-unit.source: Past tense of the right action for announcements, such as "shortlisted".
trans-unit.target: 用於播報的右側操作過去式，例如「shortlisted」。

trans-unit.source: An editorial grid of story cards that open into articles (Arc Card to article, design reference). Each card is a picture with its tag, title and reading time drawn over it; pressing it (or Enter / Space) grows that very card into a centred article sheet: the frame and its corners stretch on one spring, the picture scales as a whole into the article's hero, the text rises in behind it and the close button pops in last. The article scrolls with a reading progress bar along its top and closes with the close button, Escape, or by pulling it down (a mouse on the picture, a finger anywhere once the article is at its top, or the wheel scrolling up past the top); it lands back on the card's slot, measured again at that moment, and focus returns to the card. `OpenItemId` is the open article (two-way; set it to open or close with the morph); `OpenItemChanged` reports every change with its cause. The grid has two columns while the control is wider than `ColumnBreakpoint` and one below; the article sizes itself to the window.
trans-unit.target: 編輯型故事卡片網格，卡片可展開為文章（Arc Card to article，設計參考）。每張卡片是一張圖片，標籤、標題和閱讀時間繪製在圖片上；按下卡片（或 Enter / Space）會讓這張卡片本身長成置中的文章面板：外框和圓角隨一根彈簧拉伸，圖片整體縮放為文章的主圖，內文隨後浮現，關閉按鈕最後彈出。文章可捲動，頂端有閱讀進度列；可用關閉按鈕、Escape 或下拉關閉（滑鼠在圖片上拖曳、手指在文章捲到頂端後任意位置拖曳，或在頂端繼續向上捲動滾輪）；關閉時落回當下重新測量的卡片位置，焦點回到卡片。`OpenItemId` 是開啟的文章（雙向；設定它即以形變開啟或關閉）；`OpenItemChanged` 回報每次變化及其原因。控制項寬於 `ColumnBreakpoint` 時網格為兩欄，否則為一欄；文章依視窗決定自身尺寸。

trans-unit.source: The width-to-height ratio of the cards and of the article's hero picture (default 4:3).
trans-unit.target: 卡片和文章主圖的寬高比（預設 4:3）。

trans-unit.target: 當項目的 `Body` 既不是字串也不是控制項時，用來顯示它的範本。

trans-unit.source: Closes the open article (it flies back onto its card).
trans-unit.target: 關閉開啟的文章（它飛回自己的卡片）。

trans-unit.source: The grid has one column while the control is at most this wide, two above (default 520).
trans-unit.target: 控制項寬度不超過此值時網格為一欄，超過則為兩欄（預設 520）。

trans-unit.source: The stories, in grid order.

Set the properties before the item is shown: the control reads them when the card is built and when the article opens.

trans-unit.source: Invented sample stories for `CardToArticle` demos and tests: six short magazine pieces (a field guide, an interview, a recipe, a science note, a craft how-to and a sky-watching tip, all written for this library) with 4:3 pictures drawn in code as simple geometric scenes (no photos). Every call returns new items, so two controls never share an item.

trans-unit.source: Four stories for the preview: a field guide, an interview, a recipe and a science note.
trans-unit.target: 預覽用的四個故事：一篇野外指南、一篇訪談、一份食譜和一則科普。

trans-unit.source: A row of slides people browse by dragging, flicking, a trackpad swipe, the arrow keys, or the controls below it (Arc carousel). Use it for a short, ordered set of peers such as products or case studies, where the neighbours stay in view as a hint that there is more. The active slide sits in the center, its neighbours shrink and dim with distance, and the page indicator stretches into a pill that travels with the slides frame by frame. Slides come from `Items` / `ItemsSource` (with `ItemTemplate`); `SelectedIndex` is the active slide (two-way). Set `Interval` to add a play control that rotates through the slides; rotation pauses on hover, keyboard focus, drag, while the carousel is scrolled out of view or the window is minimized, and is unavailable with reduced motion. Only the slides near the current position are realized.
trans-unit.target: 一排投影片，使用者可透過拖曳、輕掃、觸控板滑動、方向鍵或其下方的控制項進行瀏覽（Arc 輪播）。適用於一組簡短、有序的同類內容，例如產品或案例研究，相鄰項目保持可見，以提示還有更多內容。目前投影片位於中央，相鄰投影片會隨距離縮小並變暗，頁面指示器會拉伸成一個膠囊，並隨投影片逐格移動。投影片來自 `Items` / `ItemsSource`（配合 `ItemTemplate`）；`SelectedIndex` 為目前投影片（雙向繫結）。設定 `Interval` 可新增一個播放控制項，使投影片循環輪播；指標停留、鍵盤焦點、拖曳、輪播捲出可視範圍或視窗最小化時輪播會暫停，減少動態效果時則不可用。只有目前位置附近的投影片會被實例化。

trans-unit.source: True when rotation is available (an interval, two or more slides, full motion).
trans-unit.target: 可以輪播時為 true（需要有間隔時間、兩張或更多投影片，且為完整動態效果）。

trans-unit.source: Time per slide. A positive value adds a play control that rotates through the slides.
trans-unit.target: 每張投影片的停留時間。正值會新增一個播放控制項，使投影片循環輪播。

trans-unit.source: Whether the slides rotate (two-way; the play control toggles it). Off by default, so motion begins with the viewer; set it to start rotating on load.

trans-unit.source: Arc cascader: a select field that picks one node of a hierarchy, level by level (province, city, district). Opening the menu shows the first level; choosing a parent opens its children in a column to the right, and the menu grows with a spring. Look and motion follow `Select`: the same trigger, menu surface, gliding highlight and clear button. Nodes are any objects: `ChildrenSelector` gives the children, `TextSelector` the label and `ValueSelector` the value, which must be unique across the whole tree. Everything goes through delegates, so nothing is reflected. `SelectedItem`, `SelectedValue` and `SelectedPath` always agree; a value written before the data arrives is kept and resolved when it does. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open; Up and Down move in the column, Right opens the highlighted parent, Left goes back a column; Enter picks a leaf (or opens a parent); Escape closes without a change; typing jumps to the next matching node; Delete clears.
trans-unit.target: Arc 級聯選擇器：在層級資料中逐級選擇一個節點的選擇欄位（省、市、區）。開啟選單先顯示第一級；選取一個父節點，它的子級會在右側的一欄中展開，選單寬度隨彈簧變化。外觀和動態效果與 `Select` 一致：相同的觸發器、選單表面、滑動醒目提示和清除按鈕。節點可以是任意物件：`ChildrenSelector` 提供子級，`TextSelector` 提供標籤，`ValueSelector` 提供值，值必須在整棵樹中唯一。一切都透過委派完成，不使用反射。`SelectedItem`、`SelectedValue` 和 `SelectedPath` 始終保持一致；資料抵達之前寫入的值會被保留，資料抵達後再解析。鍵盤：Enter、Space 和方向鍵開啟；Up、Down 在目前欄移動，Right 展開醒目提示的父節點，Left 回到上一欄；Enter 選取葉節點（或展開父節點）；Escape 關閉且不變更值；輸入字母跳到下一個相符的節點；Delete 清除。

trans-unit.source: Children of a node; same shape as the one of `TreeView`. Null or empty means a leaf.
trans-unit.target: 節點的子級；簽章與 `TreeView` 的相同。為 null 或空表示葉節點。

trans-unit.source: Width of every column; NaN sizes each column to its labels (160 to 280).

trans-unit.source: A live charging session card for an EV or any device (Arc Charge session, design reference). Energy packets travel from a brushed-metal charger along the cable and through the pack to the fill front, where each one lands and brightens it. The pack fills toward a draggable charge limit, the charge curve tapers near full with the live point riding on it, and power, energy added, time to the limit and cost update every frame. Stop charging drains the flow: the power falls away, the last packets land and the point drops to the baseline; Resume ramps it back up; at the limit the session completes and Start new session returns to `StartCharge`. The card runs its own simulation (one second on screen is forty seconds of charging at `Speed` 1): set the battery and price figures, read `State`, `Charge` and the other figures, and handle `StateChanged` and `LimitChanged` to mirror the session in your backend. Drag on the pack or the curve, or use the keys on the limit marker, to move `Limit`.
trans-unit.target: 電動車或任何裝置的即時充電工作階段卡片（Arc Charge 工作階段，設計參考）。能量封包從拉絲金屬充電樁出發，沿纜線穿過電池組，抵達填充前緣，每一個落下時都會讓它變亮。電池組朝可拖曳的充電上限填充，充電曲線在接近充滿時收斂，即時點沿曲線移動，功率、已充入電量、距上限的時間與費用每影格更新。停止充電會讓能量流逐漸消退：功率隨之下降，最後的封包落下，點回落到基準線；繼續充電則讓它重新升起；達到上限時工作階段完成，按下開始新工作階段即返回 `StartCharge`。卡片執行自己的模擬（螢幕上一秒相當於 `Speed` 為 1 時的四十秒充電）：設定電池與價格數值，讀取 `State`、`Charge` 及其他數值，並處理 `StateChanged` 與 `LimitChanged`，以便在後端同步工作階段。拖曳電池組或曲線，或使用上限標記上的按鍵，即可移動 `Limit`。

trans-unit.source: Time zone of times and day separators; null uses the local zone (as Arc's browser does).

trans-unit.source: Arc checkbox: a binary choice with a precise, legible state. The fill grows in on a snappy spring, the check draws itself, and the indeterminate state morphs the same three-point path into a dash and back. Only the 18px square answers a press (it dips to 0.95); the 44px hit area and the label never move. Clicking an indeterminate box checks it (Radix behavior). `IsChecked` is the tri-state value (null = indeterminate); `CheckedState` is the same value as an enum.
trans-unit.target: Arc 核取方塊：二元選擇，狀態精確清晰。勾選框以輕快的彈簧效果填滿，勾號自行繪出，半選狀態會將同一條三點路徑變形為短橫線，再變回來。只有 18px 方塊回應按壓（會下沉至 0.95）；44px 點擊區域與標籤都不會移動。按一下半選方塊會將其勾選（Radix 行為）。`IsChecked` 為三態值（null 表示半選）；`CheckedState` 是同一個值的列舉形式。

trans-unit.source: The tri-state value as an enum; kept in sync with `IsChecked`.
trans-unit.target: 以列舉表示的三態值；與 `IsChecked` 保持同步。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the state changes, with the old and new `CheckboxState`.
trans-unit.target: 狀態變更時觸發，附帶舊的與新的 `CheckboxState`。

trans-unit.source: Secondary text under the label; also the help text read by assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方的次要文字，同時也是輔助技術朗讀的說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Marks the choice as invalid (the square takes the danger border).
trans-unit.target: 將該選項標記為無效（方塊採用危險色邊框）。

trans-unit.source: The field must be checked before a form is submitted (reported to assistive technology).
trans-unit.target: 表單提交前必須勾選此欄位（會告知輔助技術）。

trans-unit.source: Draws a yes or no value as a checkbox in the middle of the cell; a click on it flips the value (one undo step, and `CellEditEnding` can refuse it). Boolean columns use it without setting `Renderer`; set it on a column of another type to show a 0 or 1 that way. Values that are not a `Boolean` draw as text.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存格中間把是或否的值畫成核取方塊；點擊它會翻轉值（是一步復原，`CellEditEnding` 可以拒絕）。Boolean 欄無需設定 `Renderer` 就會使用它；設定在其他類型的欄上，可以用這種方式顯示 0 或 1。不是 `Boolean` 的值會畫成文字。

trans-unit.source: The last step before paying for one product: a title, the item with its price, a promo code field that turns an accepted code into a removable chip, a breakdown (subtotal, automatic lines, the code, tax) whose lines slide in and out, a rolling total and a pay button that walks through processing to paid (or to an error with "Try again"). The code check (`CouponValidator`) and the payment (`PayAsync`) are delegates so a host can call its backend; `CheckoutSummarySamples` has simulated ones.
trans-unit.target: 為單一商品付款前的最後一步：包含標題、帶價格的商品項目、優惠碼欄位（通過驗證的優惠碼會變成可移除的標籤塊）、明細（小計、自動調整列、優惠碼、稅金，各列會滑入滑出）、即時更新的總計，以及付款按鈕（依序經過處理中，直到已付款，或出錯並顯示 "Try again"）。優惠碼檢查（`CouponValidator`）和付款（`PayAsync`）都是委派，宿主可藉此呼叫自己的後端；`CheckoutSummarySamples` 提供模擬實作。

trans-unit.source: Automatic lines between the subtotal and the tax (negative amounts are discounts); lines that come or go slide in and out.
trans-unit.target: 位於小計與稅金之間的自動調整列（負數為折扣）；新增或移除的列會滑入或滑出。

trans-unit.source: The promo code in use, or null.

trans-unit.source: Checks and applies `code` as if typed; returns true when it was accepted.

trans-unit.source: Invented sample content and a simulated backend for `CheckoutSummary`: a yearly drawing app, a plan discount, sales tax, two promo codes (HELLO15 takes 15% off, FRIEND5 takes 5 off) checked in 700 ms, and a payment that takes 1400 ms. Each simulation takes an optional delay function so tests can step time.
trans-unit.target: `CheckoutSummary` 的虛構範例內容與模擬後端：一個年度繪圖應用程式、一個方案折扣、銷售稅，以及兩個優惠碼（HELLO15 享 15% 折扣，FRIEND5 折抵 5），檢查耗時 700 ms，付款耗時 1400 ms。每個模擬都接受可選的延遲函式，便於測試逐步推進時間。

trans-unit.source: The sample rule without the wait.
trans-unit.target: 不含等待的範例規則。

trans-unit.source: A new sample automatic discount: "Annual plan", three months free, −30.
trans-unit.target: 新建的範例自動折扣："Annual plan"，免費三個月，−30。

trans-unit.source: The sample code check: after `CouponCheckDelay`, HELLO15 (any case, spaces around ignored) is 15% off, FRIEND5 is 5 off, anything else is refused with a hint.
trans-unit.target: 範例的優惠碼檢查：在 `CouponCheckDelay` 之後，HELLO15（忽略大小寫，忽略前後空白）享 15% 折扣，FRIEND5 折抵 5，其他一律拒絕並附提示。

trans-unit.source: A new sample product: "Sketchbook Pro, annual", 120, billed yearly.

trans-unit.source: Arc chip group: toggle chips for facets people switch often (topics, statuses, tags). Picking a chip morphs it: a check grows in, the label slides over and the chip's edge follows on a spring while the neighbours glide to their new places, even across lines. Long sets fold behind a "+N more" chip (selected chips always stay in view); expanding staggers the revealed chips in and the group height springs. With `IsMultiple` false it is a single choice that can still be cleared. Keyboard: one tab stop; arrows move between chips and wrap, Home / End jump to the ends; Enter or Space toggles the focused chip or expands the folded ones.
trans-unit.target: Arc 標籤群組：用於人們經常切換的篩選項（主題、狀態、標籤）的可切換標籤。選取標籤時會變形：勾號生長出來，文字滑動，標籤邊緣以彈簧跟隨，相鄰標籤滑動到新位置，即使跨行也是如此。項目較多時，會摺疊到一個 "+N more" 標籤之後（已選取的標籤始終可見）；展開時，被顯示的標籤依序淡入，群組的高度以彈簧變化。`IsMultiple` 為 false 時為單選，但仍可清除選取。鍵盤操作：只有一個 Tab 停留點；方向鍵在標籤之間移動並循環，Home / End 跳到兩端；Enter 或空白鍵切換焦點標籤，或展開摺疊的標籤。

trans-unit.source: A choropleth map with a linked ranked list: every region of an area (the states of a country) is shaded by the chosen metric in quantile steps, and the same regions are ranked beside the map with a bar each. Pointing at a region outlines it, shows a card with every metric and finds its row; pointing at a legend step lights that step's regions; choosing a region flies the camera into it and shows its subregions (counties) re-binned and re-ranked, or says that there is no finer detail. Switching the metric sweeps the new colours across the map from west to east while the rows slide to their new ranks; with several areas a switch changes the country. The block contains no map data: each `ChoroplethRegion` brings its outline as SVG path data in the area's view box (975 × 610 by default). Keyboard: Tab reaches the area switch, the metric switch, the back button (while zoomed), each legend step and the list (one stop). In the list ↑ / ↓ / Home / End move, Enter or Space opens a region or pins a subregion; on a legend step they pin it. Escape releases a pinned legend step first, then zooms back out.
trans-unit.target: 帶連動排名清單的分級統計地圖:一個區域(一個國家的各州)的每個地區依所選指標以分位數分級著色,同樣的地區在地圖旁按長條排名。指向某個地區會為其描邊、顯示包含全部指標的卡片並定位到它的列;指向圖例的某一級會點亮該級的地區;選取某個地區會讓鏡頭飛入並顯示其重新分級、重新排名的下級區域(縣),或者說明沒有更細的明細。切換指標時,新的顏色會從西向東掃過地圖,同時各列滑動到新的名次;有多個區域時,切換會更換國家。該區塊不含地圖資料:每個 `ChoroplethRegion` 自帶以 SVG 路徑資料表示的輪廓,位於區域的檢視框中(預設 975 × 610)。鍵盤:Tab 依序到達區域切換、指標切換、返回按鈕(縮放時)、每個圖例級和清單(一個停靠點)。在清單中,↑ / ↓ / Home / End 移動,Enter 或 Space 開啟地區或固定下級區域;在圖例級上則固定該級。Escape 先釋放固定的圖例級,再縮放回原檢視。

trans-unit.source: Header label and highlighting language (Arc default "tsx"): a fence-style name or alias such as `cs`, `ts`, `json`, `xml`/`axaml`, `py`, `sh`. `diff` (or `patch`) colors added lines in the success color and removed lines in the danger color. Languages without a TextMate grammar, such as `text` or `plaintext`, show plain text.
trans-unit.target: 標題標籤與語法醒目提示所用的語言（Arc 預設 “tsx”）：圍欄式的名稱或別名，如 `cs`、`ts`、`json`、`xml`/`axaml`、`py`、`sh`。`diff`（或 `patch`）將新增行顯示為成功色、刪除行顯示為危險色。沒有 TextMate 語法的語言（例如 `text` 或 `plaintext`）將顯示為純文字。

trans-unit.source: Number of lines in `Code`.
trans-unit.target: `Code` 中的行數。

trans-unit.target: 摺疊狀態下可見的行數。

trans-unit.target: 摺疊時切換按鈕的文字；`{0}` 為行數。

trans-unit.source: Label of the toggle while a collapsed source is expanded (default "Show fewer lines").
trans-unit.target: 展開摺疊的原始碼時，切換按鈕的標籤（預設為「顯示較少行」）。

trans-unit.source: Shows a line-number gutter (an extension; Arc has none).
trans-unit.target: 顯示行號欄（此為擴充功能，Arc 本身沒有）。

trans-unit.source: Header text shown when `FileName` is empty (default "Source code").
trans-unit.target: `FileName` 為空時顯示的標題文字（預設為「原始碼」）。

trans-unit.source: An AI code edit suggestion in a small editor panel, like an inline edit in an AI code editor. The header shows the model's mark, the instruction and the model; the panel shows a file tab with its language mark, a running +/− count, and the code with each proposed change as an inline diff hunk: removed lines tinted red with a minus, new lines tinted green with a plus. New lines stream in, then every hunk gets Reject and Accept under it, and the footer offers Reject all and Accept all (Cmd or Ctrl + Enter). Accepting a hunk folds its removed lines away and settles the new lines into the file; rejecting folds the new lines away and restores the original. Give it the file in `Code`, the changes in `Hunks` and set `Status`; write the file in `Resolved` (or progressively in `DecisionMade`): the control never writes anything itself. With no code and no hunks it shows an empty file, or plays a `Simulation` you pass in, which reviews itself and replays until someone touches it.
trans-unit.target: 在小型編輯器面板中呈現的 AI 程式碼修改建議，類似 AI 程式碼編輯器中的行內修改。標題列顯示模型標記、使用者要求與模型；面板顯示附語言標記的檔案分頁、即時的 +/− 計數，以及程式碼，其中每處建議的變更都是一個行內差異區塊：刪除的行以紅色底並帶減號，新增的行以綠色底並帶加號。新行逐行串流進來，接著每個差異區塊下方會出現「拒絕」與「接受」，頁尾提供「全部拒絕」與「全部接受」（Cmd 或 Ctrl + Enter）。接受一個差異區塊會摺疊其刪除行並讓新行併入檔案；拒絕則摺疊新行並還原原文。把檔案放進 `Code`、變更放進 `Hunks` 並設定 `Status`；在 `Resolved` 中（或在 `DecisionMade` 中逐步）寫入檔案：控制項本身從不寫入任何內容。既沒有程式碼也沒有差異區塊時，它顯示一個空白檔案，或播放你傳入的 `Simulation`，後者會自行審閱並重播，直到有人操作它。

trans-unit.source: Shows Regenerate once the review is done (or there were no changes) and Retry on error; both raise `RegenerateRequested`. A simulation always has them and replays on its own.
trans-unit.target: 審閱完成後（或沒有變更時）顯示「重新產生」，出錯時顯示「重試」；兩者都會引發 `RegenerateRequested`。模擬一律帶有它們，並會自行重播。

trans-unit.source: Shows Stop while thinking or streaming; it raises `StopRequested`. A simulation always has it.
trans-unit.target: 思考或串流時顯示「停止」；它會引發 `StopRequested`。模擬一律帶有它。

trans-unit.source: Cmd or Ctrl + Enter accepts all and Cmd or Ctrl + Backspace rejects all while focus is inside the card; Accept all shows the hint.
trans-unit.target: 焦點在卡片內時，Cmd 或 Ctrl + Enter 接受全部，Cmd 或 Ctrl + Backspace 拒絕全部；「全部接受」顯示提示。

trans-unit.source: Simulation only: after streaming, it accepts and rejects hunks on its own (one by one and Accept all on alternate runs) and replays about 2.6s after it finishes. Any pointer, key or focus inside the card hands control to the person for that run. Off under reduced motion.
trans-unit.target: 僅用於模擬：串流結束後自行接受與拒絕差異區塊（隔輪交替為逐一決定與全部接受），結束約 2.6 秒後重播。卡片內的任何指標、按鍵或焦點都會把這一輪交給使用者控制。減少動態效果時關閉。

trans-unit.target: 檔案的原始內容，依 `\n` 分行。與 `Hunks` 都不設定時播放 `Simulation`。

trans-unit.source: Where the suggestion is: thinking shows a shimmering label over the plain file, streaming shows hunks as they grow, ready shows Accept and Reject, error shows the message and Retry. Going back to thinking clears earlier decisions.

trans-unit.source: One proposed change of a `CodeSuggestion`: it replaces `Remove` lines starting at the zero based line `Start` with the `Insert` lines (remove 0 inserts before `Start`; an empty insert deletes). To stream, replace `Insert` with a longer list (or call `AppendLine`) as tokens arrive.
trans-unit.target: `CodeSuggestion` 中的一處建議變更：從由零起算的第 `Start` 行開始，用 `Insert` 行取代 `Remove` 行（remove 為 0 時在 `Start` 之前插入；insert 為空時表示刪除）。串流時，隨著詞元抵達把 `Insert` 取代為更長的清單（或呼叫 `AppendLine`）。

trans-unit.source: A simulated suggestion for a `CodeSuggestion`, for demos, prototypes and tests: the card reads `Code` for 0.8s, then each of `Hunks` opens (its removed lines tint red in 240ms) and its new lines stream in one every 38ms. With `AutoPlay` the card then reviews it itself (one hunk at a time and Accept all on alternate runs) and replays 2.6s after it finishes. Any pointer, key or focus inside the card hands control to the person for that run; Stop keeps the hunks that finished and Regenerate replays. Reduced motion and Off open on the finished suggestion with no streaming and no autoplay. Nothing is sent to a model. Set it as the card's `Simulation`: it plays while the card has no `Code` and no `Hunks` of its own, from the top each time the card comes into a window. The file name, the instruction and the model stay on the card. Its values take effect at the next run; the hunks are copied, so one list can be shared between simulations. Use one simulation per card.
trans-unit.target: 為 `CodeSuggestion` 提供的模擬建議，用於示範、原型和測試：卡片讀取 `Code` 0.8 秒，接著 `Hunks` 中的每個差異區塊依序展開（其刪除行在 240ms 內染成紅色），新行每 38ms 串流進一行。在 `AutoPlay` 下，卡片隨後自行審閱（隔輪交替為逐一決定與全部接受），結束 2.6 秒後重播。卡片內的任何指標、按鍵或焦點都會把這一輪交給使用者控制；「停止」保留已完成的差異區塊，「重新產生」會重播。減少動態效果與關閉動態效果時直接顯示完成的建議，不串流也不自動播放。不會向任何模型傳送內容。把它設為卡片的 `Simulation`：卡片沒有自己的 `Code` 與 `Hunks` 時播放它，每次卡片進入視窗時從頭開始。檔名、指令與模型仍設定在卡片上。它的值在下一輪生效；差異區塊會被複製，所以多個模擬可以共用一份清單。每張卡片使用一個模擬。

trans-unit.target: 檔案的原始內容，依 `\n` 分行。

trans-unit.target: 模擬模型要串流輸出的完整差異區塊，依檔案中的順序排列。

trans-unit.source: Cohort retention: how many of each starting group (a month of sign-ups, new workspaces, new customers) were still active in each month after they started. One dataset, two views: a heatmap triangle (one row per cohort, darker where more stayed, with the size-weighted average row under it) and retention curves (one line per cohort and the average); the cells shrink into points and the rows unfold into lines when the view changes. Above the chart, three headline numbers: two months' average retention with the change between the newest and the oldest cohorts, and the total that started. A segment switch filters the whole block (all, one plan, one channel): every number rolls and every cell repaints in a wave from the top-left corner. Point at a cell, or use the arrow keys, for its exact numbers.
trans-unit.target: 世代留存:每個起始群組(某個月的註冊使用者、新工作區、新客戶)在開始後的每個月裡有多少仍然活躍。同一份資料,兩種檢視:熱力圖三角(每個世代一列,留存越多顏色越深,下方是依規模加權的平均列)和留存曲線(每個世代一條線加平均線);切換檢視時,儲存格收縮為點,列展開為線。圖表上方有三個總覽數字:兩個月份的平均留存及最新與最早世代之間的變化,以及開始的總數。區段切換會篩選整個區塊(全部、某個方案、某個管道):每個數字滾動,每個儲存格從左上角開始呈波浪狀重繪。指向某個儲存格,或使用方向鍵,可檢視其精確數值。

trans-unit.source: Arc color field: a swatch whose box grows into the full picker (a clipped reveal on a spring, its shadow following the shape). Pick saturation and brightness on the area, hue and opacity on the sliders, or type a value in hex, RGB, HSL or OKLCH; the format button morphs its label and the value between formats. A contrast readout counts to the WCAG ratio against `ContrastBackground` with its grade, and saved swatches pop in, reorder by drag or Alt + arrows and go with Delete. Arrow keys move every thumb (Shift and Page keys by ten); Escape drops a draft, then closes and returns focus. The eyedropper is not offered: Avalonia has no cross-platform screen color API.

trans-unit.source: Arc command palette: the keyboard entry point to product-wide actions and navigation. A search field over grouped results with icons, descriptions and shortcut caps. Typing filters the commands (label, description, group and keywords); ↓ / ↑ / Home / End move one shared highlight (a 70ms slide for keys, a snappy spring for the pointer), Enter runs the highlighted command (or, after typing, the top match), Escape clears the query and then raises `CloseRequested`. Cmd/Ctrl+K anywhere in the window focuses the field. While filtering, the remaining rows glide into place and the results frame springs to the new height. Only the rows near the visible part of the list exist, so a thousand commands cost the same as ten. The control itself is inline, like Arc's: it does not open or close. For a popup that opens on Cmd+K (or from a button) over the page and closes with a key, use `CommandPaletteDialog`, which hosts a palette. Ported from Arc's free command-palette block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli).
trans-unit.target: Arc 指令面板：面向全產品操作與導覽的鍵盤入口。搜尋欄位之下是帶圖示、描述與快速鍵鍵帽的分組結果。輸入會篩選指令（標題、描述、群組與關鍵字）；↓ / ↑ / Home / End 移動同一個共用醒目提示（按鍵使用 70ms 滑動，指標使用靈敏彈簧），Enter 執行醒目提示的指令（輸入後則執行排在最前的符合項），Escape 清除查詢，隨後引發 `CloseRequested`。視窗內任意位置按 Cmd/Ctrl+K 會聚焦搜尋欄位。篩選時，保留的列平滑滑到新位置，結果外框透過彈簧過渡到新高度。只有清單可見部分附近的列真實存在，因此一千個指令的開銷與十個相同。該控制項本身是內嵌的，與 Arc 一致：它不負責開啟或關閉。若需要按 Cmd+K（或點按按鈕）在頁面上方開啟、並可用按鍵關閉的彈出層，請使用承載面板的 `CommandPaletteDialog`。移植自 Arc 的免費 command-palette 區塊（MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli）。

trans-unit.source: The command palette as a popup: declare it once and it opens a `CommandPalette` above the page on Cmd+K (Ctrl+K elsewhere) or from a button, and closes it with a key. It renders nothing in place; while `IsOpen` is true it shows the palette near the top centre of the window over a dimmed scrim. Keys: the open gesture (`OpenGesture`) toggles it from anywhere in the window; ↓ ↑ Home End move the highlight, Enter runs the highlighted command (or the top match after typing), Escape clears the query and, in an empty field, closes. A press on the scrim, a click on the "Esc" key cap and choosing a command also close it (`CloseOnOutsidePress`, `CloseOnSelect`); focus returns to what had it before. The palette is built the first time the dialog opens and reused after that; while the dialog is closed it only listens for the open gesture. It is mounted by Core `ModalPresence` (scrim fade, focus trap, stacking with other modals) and rises 6px on the smooth spring (reduced motion: fade only, Off: instant).
trans-unit.target: 以彈出層呈現的指令面板：只需宣告一次，它就會在按下 Cmd+K（其他平台為 Ctrl+K）或點按按鈕時，在頁面上方開啟一個 `CommandPalette`，並可用按鍵關閉。它在原位不轉譯任何內容；`IsOpen` 為 true 時，它會在視窗頂部置中附近、淡淡的遮罩之上顯示面板。按鍵：開啟手勢（`OpenGesture`）可在視窗中任意位置切換它；↓ ↑ Home End 移動醒目提示，Enter 執行醒目提示的指令（輸入後則執行排在最前的符合項），Escape 清除查詢，搜尋欄位為空時則關閉。點按遮罩、點按 “Esc” 鍵帽以及選擇指令同樣會關閉它（`CloseOnOutsidePress`、`CloseOnSelect`）；焦點會回到先前擁有焦點的元素。面板在對話方塊第一次開啟時建立並重複使用；對話方塊關閉期間只處理開啟手勢。它由 Core 的 `ModalPresence` 掛載（遮罩淡入、焦點陷阱、與其他模態層堆疊），並沿平滑彈簧上移 6px（Reduced：僅淡入淡出；Off：立即顯示）。

Items still group under their `Group`, groups in the order they first appear; leave `Group` empty for one flat list in the app's order. Defaults to true.

trans-unit.source: Modal (default): a scrim over the page, a focus trap, and a press on the scrim closes. When false the page stays interactive and focus is free, and a press anywhere outside the palette closes it.

trans-unit.source: Raised when a command is chosen (Enter or a click). With `CloseOnSelect` the dialog has already started to close, so a handler that opens another dialog finds the focus back on the page; the palette then runs `SelectCommand` and the command's own `Command`.

trans-unit.source: A threaded discussion (Arc's Comment thread): replies nest under their comment and collapse, reactions toggle with a count that rolls, authors edit and delete their own comments in place, mentions autocomplete in the composer, and resolving folds the whole thread into a single chip that reopens it. Use it for review discussions on documents, designs, tickets or pull requests; use `MentionInput` when only the input is needed.

trans-unit.source: The comments, oldest first (two way). Each change replaces it with the next tree.

trans-unit.source: An us versus them table: sections of feature rows with a check, half circle, dash or text per product, a tinted band behind your column, a header that stays pinned while the table scrolls, a switch that keeps only the rows that differ and, below `StackBelow`, your column beside one competitor chosen with a picker. Zero configuration shows an invented product against generic alternatives.
trans-unit.target: 我方與對手的比較表：分組的特性列，每個產品顯示勾號、半圓、短橫或文字；你的欄背後有著色色帶，表格捲動時表頭保持固定，開關可只保留有差異的列；寬度低於 `StackBelow` 時顯示你的欄和透過選擇器選定的一個競品。無需設定即可顯示一個虛構產品與通用替代方案的比較。

trans-unit.source: A button for destructive or important actions that asks in place: pressing it morphs the same pill into an inline question with Cancel and Confirm, then into a spinner, then into a result with Undo. Only the pill's width moves (growing on the morph spring, shrinking on smooth, P5 / P9); each face sits at its natural width and its parts clear a small blur in reading order (P20) while the old face fades (P2). Unanswered questions and results time out on a pausable timer (P22, held while the pointer rests on the control), Escape and an outside press return it to rest, and focus follows the morph. Answer with a press, a hold, or a press followed by a short countdown.
trans-unit.target: 用於破壞性或重要動作的按鈕，會就地詢問：按下後，同一個膠囊會變形為帶「取消」與「確認」的內嵌問題，接著變為載入指示器，再變為帶「復原」的結果。只有膠囊的寬度會變化（展開時使用變形彈簧，收縮時使用平滑動畫，P5 / P9）；每個介面都保持自然寬度，其各部分依閱讀順序清除小幅模糊（P20），舊介面同時淡出（P2）。未作答的問題與結果會在可暫停的計時器上逾時（P22，指標停留在控制項上時暫停），Escape 鍵與外部按壓會使其回到靜止狀態，焦點隨變形移動。可以一次按壓、一次長按，或按壓後接一段短倒數來作答。

trans-unit.target: 問題或倒數計時被取消時觸發（取消、Escape、外部按壓、逾時）。

trans-unit.source: A small question anchored to the control that asks it: "Delete this comment?" with Cancel and a confirm button. It opens from its `Trigger` (or any control, through `AttachProperty` or `Open`), moves focus to Cancel, and gives focus back to the trigger when it closes. Escape and a press outside cancel. The confirm button raises `Confirmed` and runs `Command`; with a `ConfirmHandler` it shows a spinner until the work finishes and closes only when the handler reports success.
trans-unit.target: 錨定在提問控制項旁的小問題：「Delete this comment?」，帶有取消和確認按鈕。它從 `Trigger` 開啟（或透過 `AttachProperty` 或 `Open` 從任意控制項開啟），把焦點移到取消上，關閉時把焦點還給觸發按鈕。Escape 和在外面按下都會取消。確認按鈕觸發 `Confirmed` 並執行 `Command`；設定了 `ConfirmHandler` 時，它顯示載入動畫直到工作完成，只有處理常式回報成功時才關閉。

trans-unit.source: Alignment along the trigger edge.

trans-unit.source: Attaches a confirm popover to any control: a click on the control opens it.

trans-unit.source: Raised when the question closes without confirming.

trans-unit.source: Connected scatter: two measures that move together over time, drawn as one path. Each month is a point, joined in time order by a smooth curve with a small arrow on every segment long enough to hold one; a head point marks the current month and a scrubber under the chart moves it along the real curve. A dashed target line (y = k · x) splits the plot and the healthy side is tinted. A segment switch changes the series (point by point morph), the four readouts above count with the head, and Play walks the head through the months at a steady pace. The first time the block is on screen the head runs from the first month to the last and leaves its trail behind.

trans-unit.source: A "Connect your tools" card for an AI assistant (Arc Connector setup, design reference). Each app connects inline: its row opens the sign-in, waits for the person to approve and runs a first sync with a progress hairline and a rolling count, then lists the scopes it was granted behind a Connected button and offers Disconnect with an inline confirmation. A search field filters the list by name, description, account and keywords. The OAuth flow is the app's: set `ConnectHandler` to run it, report the steps through the `ConnectorConnectContext` and return the account, scopes and sync count (throw to show the reason with Retry); set `DisconnectHandler` to revoke. Without handlers the flow is simulated and nothing is sent. With no `Connectors` the card lists its `Simulation`'s apps and, once on screen, plays its scripted run; with neither it lists no apps.
trans-unit.target: AI 助理的「Connect your tools」卡片（Arc Connector setup，設計參考）。每個應用程式都在行內連結：它的列開啟登入頁面，等待使用者核准，並執行首次同步，同時顯示進度細線和滾動的計數；接著在 Connected 按鈕後列出取得的權限範圍，並提供附帶行內確認的 Disconnect。搜尋欄位依名稱、描述、帳號和關鍵字篩選清單。OAuth 流程由應用程式負責：設定 `ConnectHandler` 來執行它，透過 `ConnectorConnectContext` 回報各步驟，並傳回帳號、權限範圍和同步數量（擲回例外即可顯示原因和 Retry）；設定 `DisconnectHandler` 來撤銷存取。沒有處理常式時流程是模擬的，不會傳送任何內容。沒有 `Connectors` 時，卡片列出它的 `Simulation` 中的應用程式，並在出現在螢幕上後播放它的腳本示範；兩者都沒有時不列出任何應用程式。

The run starts once the card is on screen and stops for good at the first pointer or key press inside it; each connect is simulated (sign-in, approval, the first sync counting up) and nothing is sent. Set the data before handing the simulation to the card; to show other apps, give the card a new simulation.

trans-unit.source: Secondary actions kept close to the selected object (Arc context menu). Wraps its `Content` and opens a menu at the pointer on right-click, or under the target (12px in, 8px below) on a plain click, a tap, the ContextMenu key or Shift+F10. The menu grows from the pointer on a snappy spring, rows press with a tint, and it closes on any scroll, resize or outside press instead of repositioning. Avoid it on targets that need their own click. To give any control a right-click menu without wrapping it, attach a surface: `<Border><arc:ContextMenu.Menu><arc:MenuSurface>…</arc:MenuSurface></arc:ContextMenu.Menu></Border>`.
trans-unit.target: 靠近所選物件的次要動作（Arc 內容選單）。包裹其 `Content`，在右鍵時於指標處開啟選單，或在一般按一下、輕觸、ContextMenu 鍵或 Shift+F10 時在目標下方（向內 12px、向下 8px）開啟。選單以輕快的彈簧從指標處展開，選單列按下時會著色，捲動、調整大小或外部按壓時會關閉而不是重新定位。避免用於本身需要按一下功能的目標。若要讓任意控制項擁有右鍵選單而無需包裹，可附加一個表面：`<Border><arc:ContextMenu.Menu><arc:MenuSurface>…</arc:MenuSurface></arc:ContextMenu.Menu></Border>`。

trans-unit.source: A model's context window as a fixed budget of 200 cells (20 × 10) that fills in reading order: the system prompt, tool definitions, files and memory, the summary and the conversation, then free space, with the output reserve held as outlined cells at the end. A dashed line marks the compaction threshold. The header reads the tokens used, the window, the percentage and the free tokens, with a pill to switch models; a legend lists every part with its tokens and share; Send message, Attach file and Compact now change the window, and a status line says what happened. Crossing the threshold after a send or an attachment, or switching to a model the window overfills, folds every message but the newest two into one summary (about 6% of them, between 4K and 24K), and the space comes back. The card rewrites `Items` as it goes and raises `ItemsChanged`, `Compacted` and `ModelChanged`. Without models or items the card is empty: no model pill, every cell free, and no Send message or Attach file without `Turns` and `Files`.
trans-unit.target: 以 200 個格子（20 × 10）組成的固定預算來呈現模型的上下文視窗，依閱讀順序填入：系統提示、工具定義、檔案與記憶、摘要與對話，然後是剩餘空間，輸出保留量以輪廓格子保留在末端。虛線標示壓縮門檻。標題列顯示已用權杖、視窗大小、百分比與剩餘權杖，並附一個切換模型的膠囊；圖例列出每個部分的權杖數與佔比；傳送訊息、附加檔案與立即壓縮會改變視窗，狀態列說明發生了什麼。傳送或附加後超過門檻，或切換到視窗容納不下的模型時，除最新兩則外的所有訊息會合併為一則摘要（約佔其中的 6%，介於 4K 與 24K 之間），空間因此釋出。此卡片會在執行時改寫 `Items`，並引發 `ItemsChanged`、`Compacted` 與 `ModelChanged`。沒有模型或項目時，卡片為空：沒有模型膠囊，所有格子都空著；沒有 `Turns` 與 `Files` 時也沒有傳送訊息與附加檔案。
