trans-unit.source: A quick settings panel (Arc Control center, design reference): a 360 × 396 surface with a wide Focus tile, Notifications and Presenting tiles, and two segmented meters for the alert volume and the text size. A tile toggles in place, with its icon and state line trading places in a short blur; the chevron of the Focus and Notifications tiles grows the tile into a detail that fills the panel (a shared-element morph over a light scrim; the tiles stay put and become inert). The Focus detail picks a mode, sets the session length on a dial (one turn is two hours, 5-minute steps, resistance past 5 and 120) and starts, updates or ends the session; the Notifications detail has a master switch, one switch per channel and the people who are always let through. The meters follow a grab 1:1, jump on a tap, swell while held and stretch at their ends. Give it `FocusModes` (the first one is what a tap on the Focus tile starts), `Channels` and optionally `People`; read or bind `Volume`, `TextSize`, `AreNotificationsOn`, `IsPresenting` and `FocusSession`, or handle `StateChanged`, which reports the whole state after every change (once per step while a meter is dragged). The text size only scales the "Aa" sample: apply it to your app yourself. Edits in the Focus detail take effect only on Start or Update session; closing the detail discards them. Sessions do not end on their own when their time is up.
trans-unit.target: 快速設定面板（Arc Control center，設計參考）：一塊 360 × 396 的表面，包含一個通欄 Focus 磚塊、Notifications 與 Presenting 磚塊，以及提示音量和文字大小兩條分段條。磚塊就地切換，圖示與狀態文字以短暫的模糊交換位置；Focus 與 Notifications 磚塊的箭頭按鈕會把磚塊長成佔滿面板的詳細面板（在淺色遮罩上的共用元素形變；磚塊保持原位並變為無法互動）。Focus 詳細面板選擇模式，在轉盤上設定時長（一圈為兩小時，以 5 分鐘為一步，越過 5 和 120 時有阻力），並開始、更新或結束專注時段；Notifications 詳細面板有總開關、每個頻道一個開關，以及一律放行的人。分段條以 1:1 跟隨拖曳，輕觸即跳到該值，按住時膨脹，在兩端拉伸。提供 `FocusModes`（按 Focus 磚塊時開始第一個模式）、`Channels`，以及選用的 `People`；讀取或繫結 `Volume`、`TextSize`、`AreNotificationsOn`、`IsPresenting` 和 `FocusSession`，或處理 `StateChanged`，它在每次變化後回報完整狀態（拖曳分段條時每一步回報一次）。文字大小只縮放 "Aa" 範例：請在應用程式中自行套用。Focus 詳細面板中的編輯只在 Start 或 Update session 時生效；關閉詳細面板會捨棄它們。專注時段到時不會自行結束。

trans-unit.source: Arc cookie consent: a consent bar that morphs into a preferences panel and, once a choice is saved, folds into a small floating button that reopens it. One surface springs between the three shapes. Optional categories start off, refusing is as easy as accepting, and the choice is reported through `ConsentChanged` and can be remembered (`StorageKey`, read back with `Read`). The control is a layer: place it over the page (for example as the last child of the window's root grid, or of a preview panel); it lets clicks through everywhere except on its surface, which hangs 16px from the bottom.
trans-unit.target: Arc Cookie 同意元件：一個同意列，可變形為偏好設定面板；儲存選擇後，會收合為一個小型浮動按鈕，用於重新開啟面板。同一個表面在三種形態之間以彈簧動畫切換。選用類別預設關閉，拒絕與接受同樣簡單；選擇結果透過 `ConsentChanged` 回報，並可被記住（`StorageKey`，以 `Read` 讀回）。此元件是一個覆蓋層：將其放在頁面之上（例如作為視窗根 Grid 或預覽面板的最後一個子元素）；除表面本身外，點擊都會穿透此元件，表面距底部 16px。

trans-unit.source: Counts down to a fixed moment, or through a duration, with rolling digit wheels (Arc Countdown), and morphs into a live label at zero. The clock ticks just after each whole second, only while the countdown is on screen; a separate `PausableTimer` makes `Completed` land on time even while ticking is paused. A `Duration` countdown can be paused and resumed (`IsPaused`, `Pause`, `Resume`); a `Target` countdown counts to a fixed instant, so pausing only freezes the display. Wheels turn the short way round; the shell springs to the size of whatever it holds.
trans-unit.target: 倒數至一個固定時刻，或在一段時長內倒數，以滾動數字輪顯示（Arc Countdown），歸零時變形為即時標籤。時鐘僅在倒數計時顯示於畫面上時，於每個整秒之後稍後滴答；獨立的 `PausableTimer` 使 `Completed` 即使在暫停滴答時也能準時觸發。`Duration` 倒數計時可暫停與恢復（`IsPaused`、`Pause`、`Resume`）；`Target` 倒數計時則倒數至一個固定時刻，因此暫停只會凍結顯示。數字輪沿最短路徑轉動；外殼會彈簧式地調整為所容納內容的尺寸。

trans-unit.source: A card for buying usage credits: the balance with a two-week usage chart and how many days it lasts, preset packs with bonus badges, a custom amount slider, auto top-up with a threshold, the saved card, and a checkout whose new balance rolls in like an odometer. trans-unit.source: One action of a `CtaSection` (Arc's `CtaAction`). With `Href` it is a link-style action: pressing it raises `ActionInvoked` and, when nobody handles the event, opens an absolute http, https or mailto address. With a `Command`, or when a handler marks the event handled, it only runs. With none of these it confirms in place (a check and `ConfirmedLabel`; pressing again restores it), so a preview always answers a press.

trans-unit.source: A call to action in three shapes: a centered closing section, a split layout beside a setup card that completes itself once it is in view, and a compact banner that closes its gap when dismissed. trans-unit.source: An isometric cube character that shows what an assistant is doing (Arc cube mascot), drawn from real 3D math: a rounded silhouette, three faces shaded by how they face the light, and a face painted on the front side through its projected plane. Idle tilts, floats and blinks; thinking turns the cube a quarter turn in eased steps and the face fades in on the side that arrives at the front; writing tips the face down while lines print onto the ground in front of it; done settles with a happy squint and a sparkle; error shakes once and shows worried brows. Status changes blend from the pose on screen over 420ms, never a hard cut. Leave `Status` unset and the cube plays through every state on a loop (for showcases).
trans-unit.target: 一個表示助理正在做什麼的等軸測立方體角色（Arc 立方體吉祥物），由真實的三維數學繪製：圓潤的輪廓、依朝向光線的程度著色的三個面，以及透過投影平面畫在正面上的一張臉。閒置時傾斜、浮動和眨眼；思考時立方體以緩動的步伐轉四分之一圈，臉在轉到正面的那一面上淡入；書寫時臉向下低，線條印在它前方的地面上；完成時帶著開心的瞇眼和閃光安頓下來；出錯時搖晃一次並露出擔憂的眉毛。狀態切換從螢幕上的姿態在 420ms 內過渡，從不生硬切換。不設定 `Status` 時，立方體會循環播放每種狀態（用於展示）。

trans-unit.target: 從聚焦的叢集返回的按鈕（預設 "Show all"）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the gesture hint in the stage's corner. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 在舞台角落顯示手勢提示。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the legend of health colors and dot size. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示健康度顏色與圓點大小的圖例。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the totals panel. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示總計面板。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the zoom buttons. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示縮放按鈕。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: The legend's size entry (default "Size shows MRR").
trans-unit.target: 圖例中的大小項目（預設 "Size shows MRR"）。

trans-unit.source: Screen-reader name of the MRR / Accounts switch (default "Order the list by").
trans-unit.target: MRR / 帳戶切換開關的螢幕閱讀器名稱（預設 "Order the list by"）。

trans-unit.source: The stage's screen-reader summary: `{0}` accounts, `{1}` total MRR, `{2}` the layout (`OverviewLayoutText` or `GroupedLayoutFormat`).
trans-unit.target: 舞台的螢幕閱讀器摘要：`{0}` 為帳戶數，`{1}` 為 MRR 總額，`{2}` 為版面（`OverviewLayoutText` 或 `GroupedLayoutFormat`）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title; when null it is built from `SubtitleFormat`; an empty string hides it.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行文字；為 null 時由 `SubtitleFormat` 產生；空字串則隱藏。

trans-unit.source: The automatic subtitle; `{0}` is the number of accounts.
trans-unit.target: 自動產生的副標題；`{0}` 為帳戶數。

trans-unit.source: The totals of all accounts, of every health state and of every cluster of the shown grouping.
trans-unit.target: 所有帳戶、每個健康狀態以及所顯示分組的每個叢集的總計。

trans-unit.source: The title above the grouping tabs; hidden when null.
trans-unit.target: 分組標籤頁上方的標題；為 null 時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Where the totals panel goes (default `Auto`: beside the stage from 880 px).
trans-unit.target: 總計面板的位置（預設 `Auto`：寬度達到 880 px 時位於舞台旁邊）。

trans-unit.source: Wheel zoom per web pixel of scroll: one notch zooms by `exp(100 × value)` (default 0.0022, ×1.246).
trans-unit.target: 每個網頁像素捲動量的滾輪縮放；一格滾輪縮放 `exp(100 × value)` 倍（預設 0.0022，即 ×1.246）。

trans-unit.source: The camera's zoom relative to the fitted view (1 = everything visible).
trans-unit.target: 相機相對於適配檢視的縮放（1 = 全部可見）。

trans-unit.source: Screen-reader name of the + button (default "Zoom in").
trans-unit.target: + 按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱（預設 "Zoom in"）。

trans-unit.source: Screen-reader name of the − button (default "Zoom out").
trans-unit.target: − 按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱（預設 "Zoom out"）。

trans-unit.source: The zoom factor of the zoom buttons and the + / − keys (default 1.6).
trans-unit.target: 縮放按鈕以及 + / − 鍵的縮放倍率（預設 1.6）。

trans-unit.source: A panel whose children repeat end to end without a seam: after the last child comes the first again, in both directions. The viewport shows `VisibleItemCount` equal slots; children scroll with the wheel or touchpad, or from code (`ScrollToIndex`, `ScrollToIndexCentered`, `ScrollNext`, `ScrollPrevious`). Usable on its own or as an `ItemsPanel`; it scrolls itself, so it needs no `ScrollViewer`.
trans-unit.target: 子元素首尾無縫循環的面板：最後一個子元素之後又是第一個，兩個方向都一樣。可視區域顯示 `VisibleItemCount` 個等大的槽位；子元素可用滾輪或觸控板捲動，也可用程式碼捲動（`ScrollToIndex`、`ScrollToIndexCentered`、`ScrollNext`、`ScrollPrevious`）。可單獨使用，也可作為 `ItemsPanel`；它自己處理捲動，不需要 `ScrollViewer`。

trans-unit.source: The length of an animated scroll.
trans-unit.target: 平順捲動的時間長度。

trans-unit.source: The easing of an animated scroll (Arc's standard ease-out curve by default).
trans-unit.target: 平順捲動的緩動（預設為 Arc 標準緩出曲線）。

trans-unit.source: Whether scrolls from code and wheel notches glide; when false they jump. Reduced or no motion always jumps.
trans-unit.target: 程式碼發起的捲動與滾輪格捲動是否平順過渡；為 false 時直接跳轉。減少動態效果或關閉動態效果時一律跳轉。

trans-unit.source: Whether the mouse wheel and touchpad scroll the panel.
trans-unit.target: 滑鼠滾輪與觸控板是否捲動面板。

trans-unit.source: The scroll position in items, wrapped into `[0, count)`: 2.5 means the leading edge is halfway through the third item.
trans-unit.target: 以項目為單位的捲動位置，折回 `[0, count)` 之內：2.5 表示前緣位於第三個項目的一半。

trans-unit.source: The scroll direction: `Vertical` (the default) stacks items top to bottom, `Horizontal` left to right.
trans-unit.target: 捲動方向：`Vertical`（預設）由上到下排列各項目，`Horizontal` 由左到右。

trans-unit.source: Whether the panel settles on the nearest whole item after a touchpad or smooth-wheel scroll stops.
trans-unit.target: 觸控板或平順滾輪捲動停止後，面板是否停靠到最近的完整項目。

trans-unit.source: The gap between neighbouring items.
trans-unit.target: 相鄰項目之間的間距。

trans-unit.source: How many item slots the viewport holds; each slot gets an equal share of the panel's length.
trans-unit.target: 可視區域容納的槽位數；每個槽位平分面板的長度。

trans-unit.source: The child indexes the viewport shows, in display order (leading edge first). An item counts as visible when any part of its slot is inside the panel.
trans-unit.target: 可視區域中顯示的子元素索引，依顯示順序（前緣在前）。只要槽位有任何部分在面板內，該項目就算可見。

trans-unit.source: An animated data pipeline: events leave their sources, queue up in an event stream, are validated and enriched in batches (some are filtered out) and land in a warehouse, with part of them pushed to live dashboards. Readouts show throughput and what has been stored.
trans-unit.target: 動畫資料管線：事件從各來源送出，在事件串流中排隊，分批驗證並豐富化（部分事件會被過濾掉），最後存入資料倉儲，其中一部分會推送到即時儀表板。讀數顯示吞吐量與已儲存的數量。

trans-unit.source: How many events per second the sources emit (1–60).
trans-unit.target: 來源每秒送出的事件數（1–60）。

trans-unit.source: Share of events the transform filters out (0–0.5).
trans-unit.target: 轉換步驟過濾掉的事件比例（0–0.5）。

trans-unit.source: Node titles, details and caption text of the diagram; set it to rename or translate the scene.
trans-unit.target: 圖示的節點標題、詳細資訊與說明文字；設定此項即可重新命名或翻譯場景。

trans-unit.source: The event sources (1–4); defaults to a web app, a mobile app and webhooks.
trans-unit.target: 事件來源（1–4）；預設為網頁應用程式、行動應用程式和 Webhook。

trans-unit.source: Every visible word of a `DataFlow` (override for another language or domain).
trans-unit.target: `DataFlow` 中所有可見的文字（可覆寫，以用於其他語言或領域）。

trans-unit.source: A spreadsheet grid for editing tabular data in place: range selection, a fill handle, Excel and Google Sheets clipboard, undo, multi-column sort, a filter row and quick search, pinned and hidden columns, row checks with bulk actions, a totals row, grouping with subtotals, CSV and Excel export, and rows and columns that render only while in view. Every piece of view state (sort, filters, search, checked rows, hidden and pinned columns, density, grouping) is a two-way property, so it works bound or left to the grid. Rows come from `ItemsSource` (`DataGridRow` objects or any class read through column bindings or accessors), or block by block from a `DataSource`. Edits write back into the row items and raise `CellsChanged`; editing never re-sorts or re-filters, so rows never jump under the cursor.
trans-unit.target: 就地編輯表格資料的試算表式表格：範圍選取、填滿控點、與 Excel 和 Google 試算表互通的剪貼簿、復原、多欄排序、篩選列和快速搜尋、固定與隱藏欄、列勾選與批次操作、總計列、分組小計、CSV 與 Excel 匯出，列和欄只在可見時繪製。所有檢視狀態（排序、篩選、搜尋、勾選列、隱藏和固定的欄、列密度、分組）都是雙向屬性，既可以繫結，也可以交給表格自行管理。列來自 `ItemsSource`（`DataGridRow` 物件，或透過欄的繫結或存取函式讀取的任意類別），或者透過 `DataSource` 分塊載入。編輯會寫回列物件並引發 `CellsChanged`；編輯不會重新排序或篩選，列不會在游標下跳動。

trans-unit.source: The active cell (display row and visible column), or null when the grid has no cells.
trans-unit.target: 作用中的儲存格（顯示列號與可見欄序號）；表格沒有儲存格時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a bulk action is clicked (its command runs too).
trans-unit.target: 按下批次操作時引發（它的命令也會執行）。

trans-unit.source: Shows Delete for checked rows; deleting can be undone.
trans-unit.target: 為勾選的列顯示「刪除」；刪除可以復原。

trans-unit.source: Decides per cell whether it can be edited, on top of `IsEditable` (for example locking the rows of closed deals). Edits, pastes, fills and clears skip cells it refuses. Keep it cheap: it runs for every cell a write touches.
trans-unit.target: 在欄的 `IsEditable` 之外，逐一儲存格決定能否編輯（例如鎖定已結案交易的列）。編輯、貼上、填滿和清除會略過它拒絕的儲存格。請保持輕量：每次寫入涉及的每個儲存格都會執行它。

trans-unit.source: Shows Add row in the toolbar and allows `AddRow` and `InsertRow` (Ctrl+Shift+Plus inserts above the active row). Needs an `ItemsSource` that is a writable list, and either `DataGridRow` rows or a `RowFactory`. Added rows can be undone. Default false.
trans-unit.target: 在工具列顯示「新增列」，並允許呼叫 `AddRow` 和 `InsertRow`（Ctrl+Shift+加號在作用列上方插入）。需要可寫入清單的 `ItemsSource`，以及 `DataGridRow` 列或 `RowFactory`。新增的列可以復原。預設 false。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a step to redo.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可重做的步驟。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a step to undo.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可復原的步驟。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a body cell is pressed with the primary button, after the selection moved (or when a renderer took the press).
trans-unit.target: 用主按鈕按下主體儲存格時觸發，此時選取範圍已經移動（或轉譯器已經接管了這次按下）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a context menu is asked for on a body cell; set `Handled` to show your own menu instead of the built-in one.
trans-unit.target: 在主體儲存格上要求右鍵選單時觸發；設定 `Handled` 可以顯示你自己的選單，而不是內建選單。

trans-unit.source: Raised on a double click or double tap of a body cell, before the editor opens; set `Handled` to keep the editor from opening.
trans-unit.target: 按兩下主體儲存格時、編輯器開啟之前觸發；設定 `Handled` 可以阻止編輯器開啟。

trans-unit.source: Raised before an edit is written; cancel it to keep the editor open with an error.
trans-unit.target: 編輯寫入前引發；取消它可讓編輯器保持開啟並顯示錯誤。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a cell renderer reports a click on something actionable, such as a link.
trans-unit.target: 當儲存格轉譯器回報對可操作內容（例如連結）的點擊時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Picks a tone for a cell from its row and value, for looks the column's `FormatRules` cannot express. It runs for every cell in view on every frame, so keep it cheap; null from it falls through to the format rules.
trans-unit.target: 根據儲存格所在的列和值為它選擇色調，用於欄的 `FormatRules` 無法表達的外觀。它每一影格都會為檢視區內的每個儲存格執行，所以請保持輕量；回傳 null 時交給格式規則處理。

trans-unit.source: Raised after an edit, paste, cut, clear, fill, fill down, undo or redo wrote cells.
trans-unit.target: 編輯、貼上、剪下、清除、填滿、向下填滿、復原或重做寫入儲存格後引發。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the checked rows, in data order (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 勾選列的鍵，依資料順序（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Column keys in display order (people drag headers, or press Alt+Shift+arrows in one, to change it). Columns not listed follow in their defined order; null keeps the defined order. Pinned columns still come first. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 依顯示順序排列的欄索引鍵（使用者拖曳表頭，或在表頭上按 Alt+Shift+方向鍵來改變它）。未列出的欄依定義順序排在後面；為 null 時保持定義順序。固定欄仍然排在最前。雙向。

trans-unit.source: The widths people set by dragging, double clicking or pressing Alt+arrows on a header, by column key. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 使用者透過拖曳、按兩下或在表頭上按 Alt+方向鍵設定的寬度，依欄索引鍵保存。雙向。

trans-unit.source: Raised before the built-in menu opens, so the entries can be changed or the menu cancelled.
trans-unit.target: 在內建選單開啟之前觸發，可以修改項目或取消選單。

trans-unit.source: Culture for formatting and parsing values; null follows the Arc language.
trans-unit.target: 格式化和解析值所用的文化；為 null 時跟隨 Arc 的語言。

trans-unit.source: Loads rows from a server one block at a time as people scroll, instead of `ItemsSource`. The grid is then read only, does not group, hides Select all and exports only checked rows.
trans-unit.target: 取代 `ItemsSource`，在捲動時從伺服器分塊載入列。此時表格為唯讀、不分組、隱藏全選，並且只匯出勾選列。

trans-unit.source: Row density (two-way): Compact 32px, Standard 40px or Comfortable 48px rows.
trans-unit.target: 列密度（雙向）：Compact 32px、Standard 40px 或 Comfortable 48px。

trans-unit.source: Shown when there are no rows at all; null uses the built-in "No rows yet".
trans-unit.target: 完全沒有列時顯示的文字；為 null 時使用內建的「尚無資料」。

trans-unit.source: How many cells are flagged for failing their rules (see `Flag` and `ValidateAll`).
trans-unit.target: 因不符合規則而被標出的儲存格數量（見 `Flag` 和 `ValidateAll`）。

trans-unit.source: Export file name without the extension; null derives one from `Label`.
trans-unit.target: 匯出檔名（不含副檔名）；為 null 時由 `Label` 產生。

trans-unit.source: Formats Export offers; with more than one, Export opens a menu.
trans-unit.target: 「匯出」提供的格式；多於一種時，「匯出」會開啟選單。

trans-unit.source: Raised before the save dialog of an export opens.
trans-unit.target: 匯出的儲存對話方塊開啟前引發。

trans-unit.source: Column filters by column key (two-way). The filter row opens when any filter is set at start.
trans-unit.target: 依欄鍵的欄篩選（雙向）。開始時設定了任何篩選，篩選列就會展開。

trans-unit.source: Matches only the same letter case (default false).
trans-unit.target: 只符合大小寫相同的文字（預設 false）。

trans-unit.source: Matches only cells whose whole text equals `FindText` (default false).
trans-unit.target: 只符合整個文字等於 `FindText` 的儲存格（預設 false）。

trans-unit.source: The text the find bar looks for in the cells' display text; matching cells are tinted while the bar is open.
trans-unit.target: 尋找列在儲存格顯示文字中尋找的文字；尋找列開啟時，相符的儲存格會著色。

trans-unit.source: Group-by column keys, outermost first (two-way). Group rows show a toggle, the value, a count and subtotals.
trans-unit.target: 分組欄鍵，外層在前（雙向）。分組列顯示摺疊按鈕、分組值、列數和小計。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the hidden columns (two-way); null uses each column's `IsHidden`.
trans-unit.target: 隱藏欄的鍵（雙向）；為 null 時使用各欄的 `IsHidden`。

trans-unit.source: Whether a cell editor is open.
trans-unit.target: 儲存格編輯器是否開啟。

trans-unit.source: Whether the filter row is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 篩選列是否展開（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the find bar (Ctrl+F; Ctrl+H adds the replace row). Not available with a `DataSource`, where Ctrl+F focuses the toolbar search.
trans-unit.target: 顯示尋找列（Ctrl+F；Ctrl+H 會加上取代列）。使用 `DataSource` 時不可用，此時 Ctrl+F 聚焦工具列搜尋。

trans-unit.source: Shows six placeholder rows while data loads.
trans-unit.target: 資料載入時顯示六列預留列。

trans-unit.source: Shows the row gutter with row numbers and checkboxes for checking rows.
trans-unit.target: 顯示帶列號和核取方塊的列號欄，用於勾選列。

trans-unit.source: Row items: `DataGridRow` objects or any objects the columns can read. `INotifyCollectionChanged` sources are followed.
trans-unit.target: 列物件：`DataGridRow` 或欄能讀取的任意物件。會追蹤 `INotifyCollectionChanged` 資料來源的變化。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the grid; also names exported files and the xlsx worksheet.
trans-unit.target: 表格的無障礙名稱；也用於命名匯出檔案和 xlsx 工作表。

trans-unit.source: Most cells a paste may hold (default 1,000,000). A bigger clipboard is refused with a message instead of being read, so a huge or hostile table cannot exhaust memory.
trans-unit.target: 一次貼上最多允許的儲存格數（預設 1,000,000）。超過時會拒絕並給出提示，而不是讀取內容，因此過大或惡意構造的表格不會耗盡記憶體。

trans-unit.source: Tallest the scrolling area grows before it scrolls, in px (default 400); infinity fills the available height.
trans-unit.target: 捲動區域開始捲動前的最大高度，單位 px（預設 400）；無限大表示佔滿可用高度。

trans-unit.source: Prefixes exported CSV text that a spreadsheet would run as a formula (it starts with =, +, -, @, a tab or a carriage return) with a single quote, which blocks CSV injection (default true). Numbers and days are not touched.
trans-unit.target: 為匯出的 CSV 中試算表會當作公式執行的文字（以 =、+、-、@、定位字元或歸位字元開頭）加上一個單引號前綴，以防止 CSV 注入（預設 true）。數字和日期不受影響。

trans-unit.source: What a paste does with clipboard rows that run past the last row: drop them (default) or add rows for them.
trans-unit.target: 貼上時超出最後一列的剪貼簿列如何處理：捨棄（預設）或為它們新增列。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the pinned columns (two-way); null uses `IsPinned`, or the first column when no column sets it.
trans-unit.target: 固定欄的鍵（雙向）；為 null 時使用 `IsPinned`，沒有任何欄設定時固定第一欄。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Enter is pressed on a cell that cannot be edited, and on a double click of the row number: "open this row".
trans-unit.target: 對不可編輯的儲存格按 Enter 時觸發，也在按兩下列號時觸發：「開啟這一列」。

trans-unit.source: Creates the object for a new row, for typed rows: `() => new Account()`. Rows of `DataGridRow` need no factory. Give typed rows a key that `RowKeySelector` reads and that no other row has.
trans-unit.target: 為自有類別的列建立新列的物件：`() => new Account()`。`DataGridRow` 類型的列不需要工廠。請給自有類別的列一個 `RowKeySelector` 能讀到、且沒有其他列使用的索引鍵。

trans-unit.source: Stable row identity; defaults to `Key`, else the item itself. Required with `DataSource`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的列識別；預設用 `Key`，否則用列物件本身。使用 `DataSource` 時必須設定。

trans-unit.source: Tints a whole row with a tone chosen from the row object (null for no tint). Runs for every row in view on every frame.
trans-unit.target: 根據列物件選擇的色調為整列著色（回傳 null 表示不著色）。每一影格都會為檢視區內的每一列執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised after checked rows were deleted (removed from the source when it is a writable list).
trans-unit.target: 勾選的列被刪除後引發（資料來源是可寫入清單時會從中移除）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after rows are added, and after a redo puts them back (undoing an addition raises `RowsDeleted`).
trans-unit.target: 在新增列之後，以及取消復原把它們放回去之後觸發（復原新增會觸發 `RowsDeleted`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a delete was undone (rows put back into a writable source at their old indices).
trans-unit.target: 刪除被復原後引發（列依原來的位置放回可寫入的資料來源）。

trans-unit.source: Quick search text (two-way): every word must appear in some visible column.
trans-unit.target: 快速搜尋文字（雙向）：每個字詞都必須出現在某個可見欄中。

trans-unit.source: The selected range, or null when the grid has no cells.
trans-unit.target: 選取的範圍；表格沒有儲存格時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Shows the built-in right-click menu (also Shift+F10 and the menu key, and a long press on touch). Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示內建的右鍵選單（也包括 Shift+F10、功能表鍵，以及觸控螢幕上的長按）。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the row number in the gutter. When false the gutter narrows to 40px and its checkboxes always show.
trans-unit.target: 在列號欄顯示列號。為 false 時列號欄縮窄到 40px，核取方塊一律顯示。

trans-unit.source: Shows the selection address and the Sum, Average and Count of the selected cells in the status bar.
trans-unit.target: 在狀態列顯示選取範圍位址以及所選儲存格的加總、平均值和計數。

trans-unit.source: Shows the toolbar with search, undo and redo, filters, columns, density and export.
trans-unit.target: 顯示工具列：搜尋、復原與重做、篩選、欄、列密度和匯出。

trans-unit.source: Shows the sticky totals row; it covers every row the filters keep, collapsed groups included.
trans-unit.target: 顯示固定在底部的總計列；它統計篩選後保留的全部列，包括摺疊分組中的列。

trans-unit.source: Sort keys in priority order (two-way). Header clicks, Shift-clicks and the column menu change it.
trans-unit.target: 依優先順序排列的排序鍵（雙向）。按一下欄標題、按住 Shift 按一下和欄選單都會改變它。

trans-unit.source: Steps kept for undo (default 100; 0 turns undo off).
trans-unit.target: 復原保留的步數（預設 100；0 表示關閉復原）。

trans-unit.source: What happens to a value that fails its column's rules: refused (default) or accepted and flagged.
trans-unit.target: 不符合欄規則的值如何處理：拒絕（預設），或接受並標出。

trans-unit.source: Number of rows the filters keep (the data source's row count with a `DataSource`).
trans-unit.target: 篩選後保留的列數（使用 `DataSource` 時為資料來源回報的列數）。

trans-unit.source: An extra toolbar action for checked rows, shown between Export and Delete.
trans-unit.target: 勾選列時工具列上的額外操作，顯示在「匯出」和「刪除」之間。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the checked rows (an `IReadOnlyList<object>` in data order) as its parameter.
trans-unit.target: 執行時以勾選的列（依資料順序的 `IReadOnlyList<object>`）作為參數。

trans-unit.source: A 24x24 Lucide geometry shown before the label (such as `ArcIcons.Archive`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示在標籤前的 24x24 Lucide 幾何圖形（例如 `ArcIcons.Archive`）。

trans-unit.source: Draws the button in the danger color.
trans-unit.target: 以危險色繪製按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Button text; also the accessible name. The label hides below 640px of grid width.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕文字，也是無障礙名稱。表格寬度小於 640px 時隱藏標籤。

trans-unit.source: One icon button of an `ActionsRenderer`.
trans-unit.target: `ActionsRenderer` 的一個圖示按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the row object as its parameter; the button is disabled while `CanExecute` is false.
trans-unit.target: 以該列物件為參數執行；`CanExecute` 為 false 時按鈕被停用。

trans-unit.source: A 24 x 24 stroked geometry drawn at 16 px (such as `ArcIcons.Trash2`).
trans-unit.target: 24 x 24 的描邊幾何圖形，以 16 px 繪製（例如 `ArcIcons.Trash2`）。

trans-unit.source: Draws the icon in the danger color.
trans-unit.target: 用危險色繪製圖示。

trans-unit.source: Names the action in `Part` and for screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Part` 中以及對螢幕閱讀器命名這個動作。

trans-unit.source: One cell as the grid hands it to a validation rule, an editability predicate or a style selector.
trans-unit.target: 表格交給驗證規則、可編輯判斷或樣式選擇器的一個儲存格。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of the cell events of a `DataGrid`: `CellClick`, `CellDoubleClick`, `CellContextRequested` and `RowActivated`.
trans-unit.target: `DataGrid` 儲存格事件的引數：`CellClick`、`CellDoubleClick`、`CellContextRequested` 和 `RowActivated`。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `CellInvoked`.
trans-unit.target: `CellInvoked` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: A pointer press over a cell, for `OnPointerPressed`.
trans-unit.target: 儲存格上的一次指標按下，用於 `OnPointerPressed`。

trans-unit.source: Everything a `DataGridCellRenderer` needs to draw one cell.
trans-unit.target: `DataGridCellRenderer` 繪製一個儲存格所需的全部資訊。

trans-unit.source: Draws the cells of a `DataGridColumn` in place of the plain text: a status badge, a progress bar, a link, an icon. The grid keeps drawing rows itself, so a renderer is a few draw calls over the cell, never a control. Sorting, filtering, totals, copy and export keep working on the column's value; `GetText` decides the text that copy and screen readers see.
trans-unit.target: 取代純文字來繪製 `DataGridColumn` 的儲存格：狀態徽章、進度列、連結、圖示。表格仍然自己繪製列，所以轉譯器只是在儲存格上的幾次繪製呼叫，絕不是控制項。排序、篩選、合計、複製和匯出仍然作用於欄的值；`GetText` 決定複製和螢幕閱讀器看到的文字。

trans-unit.source: One column of a `DataGrid`. The cell value comes from `ValueGetter`, else from `Binding` (a compiled binding against the row item, written back two-way), else from the `DataGridRow` field (or dictionary entry) named by `Key`. Values are normalized to a string, a `Decimal`, a `DateOnly` or null by `Type`.
trans-unit.target: `DataGrid` 的一欄。儲存格的值來自 `ValueGetter`，其次是 `Binding`（針對列物件的編譯繫結，雙向寫回），再次是 `Key` 指定的 `DataGridRow` 欄位（或字典項目）。值依 `Type` 正規化為字串、`Decimal`、`DateOnly` 或 null。

trans-unit.source: What the totals row and group subtotals show; null sums numbers and currency, averages percent and shows nothing otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 總計列和分組小計顯示的內容；為 null 時數字和貨幣加總、百分比取平均，其他類型不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Symbol of a Currency column (default "$"); it does not change with the interface language.
trans-unit.target: 貨幣欄的符號（預設 "$"）；不隨介面語言變化。

trans-unit.source: .NET format of a Date column (such as "yyyy-MM-dd"); null uses the language's short date with the month name.
trans-unit.target: 日期欄的 .NET 格式（例如 "yyyy-MM-dd"）；為 null 時使用該語言帶月份名稱的日期格式。

trans-unit.source: Decimal places of Number, Currency and Percent values.
trans-unit.target: Number、Currency 和 Percent 值的小數位數。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the text box that edits the column's cells with your own content (a slider, a rating, a picker). The template gets a `DataGridEditContext` as its data context; only the cell being edited is a real control.
trans-unit.target: 用你自己的內容（滑桿、評分、選擇器）取代編輯該欄儲存格的文字方塊。範本以 `DataGridEditContext` 作為資料內容；只有正在編輯的儲存格是真正的控制項。

trans-unit.source: Header text; also used for copied header rows, exports and accessible names.
trans-unit.target: 欄標題文字；也用於複製的標題列、匯出和無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: False makes the column read only: edits, pastes, fills and clears skip it.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時欄為唯讀：編輯、貼上、填滿和清除都會略過它。

trans-unit.source: False leaves the filter cell empty and drops Filter from the column menu.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時篩選格留空，欄選單中也沒有「篩選」。

trans-unit.source: Offers Group by in the column menu; null allows it for Text, Select and Date columns.
trans-unit.target: 欄選單是否提供「依此欄分組」；為 null 時 Text、Select 和 Date 欄可以分組。

trans-unit.source: Starts hidden; people can show it again from the Columns menu.
trans-unit.target: 初始隱藏；使用者可以在「欄」選單中重新顯示它。

trans-unit.source: Starts pinned to the left edge. When no column sets it, the first column is pinned.
trans-unit.target: 初始固定在左側。沒有任何欄設定它時，固定第一欄。

trans-unit.source: False disables the header sort button and the sort items of the column menu.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時停用欄標題的排序按鈕和欄選單中的排序項目。

trans-unit.source: Row field the column reads and writes; also the id used by sorting, filters, pinning and hiding.
trans-unit.target: 該欄讀寫的列欄位；也是排序、篩選、固定和隱藏使用的識別。

trans-unit.source: Narrowest a resize can reach (default 72). Resizing stops at 560px.
trans-unit.target: 調整欄寬能達到的最小寬度（預設 72）。最大到 560px 為止。

trans-unit.source: Choices of a Select column, in sort order; null uses up to 200 distinct values already in the column.
trans-unit.target: Select 欄的選項，依排序順序；為 null 時取該欄已有的最多 200 個不同值。

trans-unit.source: Draws the column's cells in place of the plain text: a status badge, a progress bar, a link, an icon, or your own `DataGridCellRenderer`. Null draws the formatted value. Sorting, filtering, totals and export still use the value.
trans-unit.target: 取代純文字來繪製該欄的儲存格：狀態徽章、進度列、連結、圖示，或你自己的 `DataGridCellRenderer`。為 null 時繪製格式化後的值。排序、篩選、合計和匯出仍然使用值。

trans-unit.source: Kind of data: Text, Number, Currency, Percent, Select or Date.
trans-unit.target: 資料類型：Text、Number、Currency、Percent、Select 或 Date。

trans-unit.source: Starting width in px (default 140). The last column absorbs spare width on a wide grid.
trans-unit.target: 初始寬度，單位 px（預設 140）。表格較寬時，最後一欄吸收多餘的寬度。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ContextMenuOpening`: change `Items` or set `Cancel` to stop the menu.
trans-unit.target: `ContextMenuOpening` 的引數：修改 `Items` 或設定 `Cancel` 來阻止選單。

trans-unit.source: What a `EditTemplate` edits: the value of one cell. The template's content gets this object as its `DataContext`; bind your controls to `Value` and call `Commit` or `Cancel` (Enter, Tab and Escape do the same when the focused control leaves them alone).
trans-unit.target: `EditTemplate` 所編輯的內容：一個儲存格的值。範本的內容以該物件作為 `DataContext`；把你的控制項繫結到 `Value`，並呼叫 `Commit` 或 `Cancel`（當取得焦點的控制項不處理時，Enter、Tab 和 Escape 同樣有效）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Value` or `ErrorMessage` changes.
trans-unit.target: 當 `Value` 或 `ErrorMessage` 變更時觸發。

trans-unit.source: A column filter as stored in a `DataGridLayoutState`: an expression or the values a select column keeps.
trans-unit.target: 儲存在 `DataGridLayoutState` 中的欄篩選：一個運算式，或選擇欄保留的值。

trans-unit.source: Tints the cells of a column whose value passes a test, such as an ARR below 10,000 or a stage that reads "Lost". Add rules to `FormatRules`; the first rule that matches decides. Compared values are read the way the column reads typed text, so `Value` for a date column is a day such as 2026-03-01.
trans-unit.target: 為值通過某項測試的欄儲存格著色，例如低於 10,000 的 ARR，或寫著「Lost」的階段。把規則新增到 `FormatRules`；第一條符合的規則生效。被比較的值依該欄讀取輸入文字的方式讀取，所以日期欄的 `Value` 是形如 2026-03-01 的日期。

trans-unit.source: The view of a `DataGrid` that people shape: column order, widths, pinned and hidden columns, sort, filters, grouping and density. `GetLayoutState` reads it and `SetLayoutState` applies it, so a view can be saved when a window closes and restored when it opens. `ToJson` and `FromJson` use a source-generated serializer (trim and AOT safe); unknown fields are ignored and missing fields fall back to the defaults.
trans-unit.target: 使用者塑造的 `DataGrid` 檢視：欄順序、寬度、固定與隱藏的欄、排序、篩選、分組和列密度。`GetLayoutState` 讀取它，`SetLayoutState` 套用它，所以檢視可以在視窗關閉時儲存、在開啟時還原。`ToJson` 和 `FromJson` 使用來源產生的序列化器（對裁剪和 AOT 安全）；未知欄位會被忽略，缺少的欄位回到預設值。

trans-unit.source: An entry you add to the grid's context menu through `ContextMenuItems`.
trans-unit.target: 透過 `ContextMenuItems` 新增到表格右鍵選單的一個項目。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the row object of the clicked cell as its parameter.
trans-unit.target: 以被點擊儲存格的列物件為參數執行。

trans-unit.source: A 24 x 24 stroked geometry shown before the label.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在標籤前的 24 x 24 描邊幾何圖形。

trans-unit.source: The entry's text.
trans-unit.target: 項目的文字。

trans-unit.source: The colors and pens a `DataGridCellRenderer` draws with. They are resolved from the ArcDesign tokens and follow the theme and the accent, so a renderer never holds a color of its own.
trans-unit.target: `DataGridCellRenderer` 繪製時使用的色彩和筆刷。它們由 ArcDesign 權杖解析而來，並跟隨主題和強調色，所以轉譯器從不持有自己的色彩。

trans-unit.source: A check on the values of a column. Add rules to `Rules`; they run when a value is typed, pasted, filled or set by a renderer, and `ValidateAll` runs them over every row. The first rule that returns a message decides.
trans-unit.target: 對欄的值的一項檢查。把規則新增到 `Rules`；在輸入、貼上、填滿或由轉譯器設定值時執行，`ValidateAll` 會對每一列執行它們。第一條回傳訊息的規則生效。

trans-unit.source: One column of a `Table`. The cell value comes from `ValueSelector` or `Binding` (compiled against the table's item type in XAML); sorting uses `SortValueSelector` / `SortBinding` when given, else the cell value, and `Comparer` when given, else Arc's comparison (numbers numerically, text with natural ordering, empty values last in both directions). Cells are drawn as text; `CellTemplate` hosts custom content.
trans-unit.target: `Table` 的一欄。儲存格值來自 `ValueSelector` 或 `Binding`（在 XAML 中針對表格的項目類型編譯）；排序時，若提供了 `SortValueSelector` / `SortBinding` 則使用它們，否則使用儲存格值；若提供了 `Comparer` 則使用它，否則使用 Arc 的比較方式（數字依數值比較，文字依自然排序，空值在兩個方向上都排在最後）。儲存格以文字繪製；`CellTemplate` 用於承載自訂內容。

trans-unit.source: Custom cell content (Arc `render`); the data context is the row item.
trans-unit.target: 自訂儲存格內容（Arc `render`）；資料內容為該列的項目。

trans-unit.source: Column label; also the default `EffectiveKey`.
trans-unit.target: 欄標籤；同時也是預設的 `EffectiveKey`。

trans-unit.source: Right-aligns the column. Null detects it: every non-empty value is a number.
trans-unit.target: 使該欄靠右對齊。為 null 時自動偵測：所有非空值均為數字。

trans-unit.source: When false the header is a plain label (Arc `sortable: false`).
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時，表頭僅為一般標籤（Arc `sortable: false`）。

trans-unit.source: Stable id reported by `SortKey` and sort events (defaults to `SortMemberPath`, then `Header`).
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼，由 `SortKey` 與排序事件回報（預設為 `SortMemberPath`，其次為 `Header`）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the member the column sorts by, reported as the sort key. The sorted value itself comes from `SortBinding`, `SortValueSelector` or the cell value.
trans-unit.target: 此欄排序所依據的成員名稱，作為排序鍵回報。實際用於排序的值來自 `SortBinding`、`SortValueSelector` 或儲存格值。

trans-unit.source: Format for cell text: a composite format (`{0:N0} items`) or a format string (`C0`).
trans-unit.target: 儲存格文字的格式：複合格式（`{0:N0} items`）或格式字串（`C0`）。

trans-unit.source: Pixel widths are fixed; Auto columns are measured once and held so sorting never reflows them; star columns share the rest.
trans-unit.target: 像素寬度固定；Auto 欄在首次測量後保持不變，因此排序時不會重新排版；星號欄平分其餘空間。

trans-unit.source: Arc date field: type a date (parsed with `Culture`) or open the calendar popup (click, Alt+Down or ArrowDown) and pick a day. The shown date rolls part by part in time's direction (a later date rises from below, an earlier one drops from above; parts after a wider or narrower part slide along), the picked day's disc glides in the calendar and the footer confirms it before the popup returns to the field. Escape closes and keeps focus in the field; `MinDate`, `MaxDate` and `DisabledDates` reach the calendar and also reject typed dates. Label, description, error and size come from the field foundation.
trans-unit.target: Arc 日期欄位：輸入日期（依 `Culture` 解析），或開啟日曆彈出層（點擊、Alt+Down 或 ArrowDown）並選取某一天。顯示的日期依時間方向逐段滾動（較晚的日期由下方升起，較早的日期由上方落下；位於較寬或較窄部分之後的部分沿其滑動）；所選日期的圓點在日曆中滑動，頁尾確認選取後彈出層返回欄位。按 Escape 關閉並使焦點留在欄位中；`MinDate`、`MaxDate` 與 `DisabledDates` 同時作用於日曆，並拒絕輸入的日期。標籤、說明、錯誤與尺寸由欄位基礎元件提供。

trans-unit.source: Footer button that clears the value (Arc: "Clear").
trans-unit.target: 用於清除值的頁尾按鈕（Arc：「Clear」）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for formatting, parsing and the calendar (null = current UI culture).
trans-unit.target: 用於格式化、解析與日曆的地區設定（null = 目前 UI 的地區設定）。

trans-unit.source: Extra disabled days (weekends, booked dates...), passed to the calendar.
trans-unit.target: 額外停用的日期（週末、已預訂日期等），傳遞給日曆。

trans-unit.source: .NET date pattern of the shown value. Null uses the culture's long date without the weekday and with the abbreviated month (en-US "Oct 20, 2026", Arc's default `{ month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示值的 .NET 日期格式。為 null 時，使用該地區設定的長日期格式，去掉星期並使用縮寫月份（en-US 為 "Oct 20, 2026"，即 Arc 的預設值 `{ month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }`）。

trans-unit.source: Footer status without a value (Arc: "Choose a day").
trans-unit.target: 未選取值時的頁尾狀態文字（Arc：「Choose a day」）。

trans-unit.source: First column of the calendar.
trans-unit.target: 日曆的第一欄。

trans-unit.source: Whether the calendar popup is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 日曆彈出層是否開啟（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Latest selectable date.
trans-unit.target: 可選取的最晚日期。

trans-unit.source: Earliest selectable date.
trans-unit.target: 可選取的最早日期。

trans-unit.source: The picked date (two-way). Null shows the placeholder.
trans-unit.target: 所選日期（雙向繫結）。為 null 時顯示預留位置文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SelectedDate` changes.
trans-unit.target: 當 `SelectedDate` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: Footer status with a value; {0} is the formatted date (Arc: "Selected {0}").
trans-unit.target: 有值時的頁尾狀態文字；{0} 為格式化後的日期（Arc：「Selected {0}」）。

trans-unit.source: Adds a Today button to the calendar header.
trans-unit.target: 在日曆標題中新增「今天」按鈕。

trans-unit.source: An inclusive range of whole days.
trans-unit.target: 以整日計的閉區間日期範圍。

trans-unit.source: Arc date range picker: a compact trigger whose surface grows into the panel it opens (P9) — two months beside a preset rail, or one month under a scrolling preset row when the boundary is narrower than 712px. The range highlight stretches across each week as you hover or move with the keyboard, its solid ends glide between days, months slide in the direction you travel, the preset highlight glides between presets, and on Apply the formatted label flies back into the trigger as the surface shrinks around it (P8). Picking is a draft: only Apply commits (`SelectedRangeChanged`); Cancel, Escape or a press outside discard it.
trans-unit.target: Arc 日期範圍選擇器：緊湊的觸發器，其表面會展開為所開啟的面板（P9）——並排顯示兩個月份與預設清單，或在邊界寬度小於 712px 時，於可捲動的預設列下方顯示一個月份。懸停或使用鍵盤移動時，範圍高亮會橫跨每一週延伸，其實心端點在日期之間滑動，月份沿移動方向滑入，預設高亮在預設之間滑動；點選「套用」時，格式化後的標籤會在表面收合時飛回觸發器（P8）。選取是草稿：只有「套用」會提交（`SelectedRangeChanged`）；「取消」、Escape 或在外部按下都會捨棄草稿。

trans-unit.source: Label of the button that applies the picked range (default Apply).
trans-unit.target: 套用所選日期範圍的按鈕的標籤（預設為「套用」）。

trans-unit.source: The element the panel stays inside (null = the window).
trans-unit.target: 面板保持在其內部的元素（null = 視窗）。

trans-unit.source: Label of the cancel button in the panel (default Cancel).
trans-unit.target: 面板中取消按鈕的標籤（預設為「取消」）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for month titles, weekday heads and the range label.
trans-unit.target: 用於月份標題、星期標題與範圍標籤的地區設定。

trans-unit.source: Day count; {0} is the number (Arc: "1 day" / "12 days").
trans-unit.target: 天數；{0} 為數字（Arc：「1 day」 / 「12 days」）。

trans-unit.source: Day count for two or more days; {0} is the number (default "{0} days").
trans-unit.target: 兩天或以上時的天數格式；{0} 為天數（預設為「{0} 天」）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的輔助文字。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的錯誤提示。

trans-unit.source: First column of the months (Arc's weekStartsOn: Sunday or Monday).
trans-unit.target: 月份的第一欄（Arc 的 weekStartsOn：週日或週一）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the panel is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 面板是否開啟（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Arc names the trigger with its label but does not show it; set true for a visible field label.
trans-unit.target: Arc 以標籤為觸發器命名，但不顯示標籤；設為 true 可顯示可見的欄位標籤。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the trigger and the panel (Arc: "Date range"); shown above when `IsLabelVisible`.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器與面板的無障礙名稱（Arc：「Date range」）；當 `IsLabelVisible` 為 true 時顯示於上方。

trans-unit.source: Latest selectable day.
trans-unit.target: 可選取的最晚日期。

trans-unit.source: Earliest selectable day.
trans-unit.target: 可選取的最早日期。

trans-unit.source: One or two months; Auto picks two when the boundary is at least 712px wide.
trans-unit.target: 一個或兩個月份；Auto 在邊界寬度至少為 712px 時選擇兩個月份。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the next-month button (default Next month).
trans-unit.target: 下個月按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設為「下個月」）。

trans-unit.source: Trigger text when no range is selected (default No dates).
trans-unit.target: 未選取範圍時的觸發文字（預設為「未選取日期」）。

trans-unit.source: Readout while the hovered date is the start date and the end is still to be picked (default Pick an end date).
trans-unit.target: 懸停日期為起始日期、尚待選取結束日期時的讀數（預設為「選取結束日期」）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while no range is applied (Arc: "Select dates").
trans-unit.target: 未套用範圍時顯示（Arc：「Select dates」）。

trans-unit.source: The preset rail (null = Arc's eight defaults, `Default`).
trans-unit.target: 預設清單（null = Arc 的八個預設值，`Default`）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the previous-month button (default Previous month).
trans-unit.target: 上個月按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設為「上個月」）。

trans-unit.source: The applied range (two-way). Null shows the placeholder.
trans-unit.target: 已套用的範圍（雙向繫結）。為 null 時顯示預留位置文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a range is applied.
trans-unit.target: 套用範圍時引發。

trans-unit.source: A date picker made of turning wheels, one each for the day, the month and the year, as on a phone. Drag or flick a wheel and it coasts and comes to rest on a row; the mouse wheel, a tap on a row above or below, and the arrow keys turn it too. The day and month wheels loop; the year wheel stops at its ends.
trans-unit.target: 由滾輪組成的日期選擇器，日、月、年各一個，就像手機上那樣。拖動或快速撥動滾輪，它會繼續滑行並停在某一列；滑鼠滾輪、點按上方或下方的列以及方向鍵也能轉動它。日和月的滾輪首尾相接；年的滾輪到兩端會停下。

trans-unit.source: Culture of the month names. Default en-US.
trans-unit.target: 月份名稱使用的地區。預設 en-US。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the day wheel.
trans-unit.target: 日滾輪的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The latest date that can be picked. Its year is the last row of the year wheel. Default 31 December 2100.
trans-unit.target: 能選擇的最晚日期。它的年份是年滾輪的最後一列。預設 2100 年 12 月 31 日。

trans-unit.source: The earliest date that can be picked. Its year is the first row of the year wheel. Default 1 January 1900.
trans-unit.target: 能選擇的最早日期。它的年份是年滾輪的第一列。預設 1900 年 1 月 1 日。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the month wheel.
trans-unit.target: 月滾輪的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The order of the wheels from left to right.
trans-unit.target: 滾輪從左到右的順序。

trans-unit.source: The picked date, today by default (the time of day is dropped). It is kept between `MinDate` and `MaxDate`.
trans-unit.target: 選中的日期，預設是今天（不保留一天中的時間）。它保持在 `MinDate` 和 `MaxDate` 之間。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the picked date changes, by the wheels or by code.
trans-unit.target: 選中的日期改變時觸發，無論是滾輪還是程式碼改變的。

trans-unit.source: Whether the month wheel shows full names (March) instead of short ones (Mar).
trans-unit.target: 月滾輪是否顯示完整名稱（March）而不是簡稱（Mar）。

trans-unit.source: How many rows each wheel shows, the picked one in the middle. Odd numbers from 3 to 9; default 5.
trans-unit.target: 每個滾輪顯示幾列，選中的一列在中間。3 到 9 之間的奇數；預設 5。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the year wheel.
trans-unit.target: 年滾輪的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: One scan or update in a `DeliveryTracker`'s history.
trans-unit.target: `DeliveryTracker` 歷史記錄中的一次掃描或更新。

trans-unit.source: Where an order is: the order and carrier, the estimated arrival (or the delivery time), five status steps from ordered to delivered, a drawing of the route with the van on it, and the history of scans, newest first. Moving `Stage` springs the steps forward and announces the new stage; `RouteProgress` moves the van.
trans-unit.target: 訂單到了哪裡：訂單和承運商、預計送達時間（或送達時間）、從下單到送達的五個狀態步驟、畫出車輛位置的路線圖，以及從新到舊的掃描記錄。修改 `Stage` 會讓步驟以彈簧前進並讀出新階段；`RouteProgress` 移動車輛。

trans-unit.source: The time window beside the arrival ("2 – 6 pm").
trans-unit.target: 送達時間旁邊的時間段（"2 – 6 pm"）。

trans-unit.source: Who carries the parcel (an invented carrier in the samples).
trans-unit.target: 運送包裹的承運商（示例中是虛構的承運商）。

trans-unit.source: Where it goes, for the route's name ("Home").
trans-unit.target: 包裹送往的地方，用於路線的名稱（"Home"）。

trans-unit.source: The arrival day as shown ("Thursday, Nov 12"), or the delivery time once delivered.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的送達日期（"Thursday, Nov 12"），送達後為送達時間。

trans-unit.source: Whether the delivery is late: shows the Delayed pill.
trans-unit.target: 是否延誤：顯示 Delayed 標籤。

trans-unit.source: The block's built-in text.
trans-unit.target: 區塊內置的文字。

trans-unit.source: The order number, without the "#".
trans-unit.target: 訂單號，不含 "#"。

trans-unit.source: Where the parcel leaves from, for the route's name ("Riverside hub").
trans-unit.target: 包裹出發的地方，用於路線的名稱（"Riverside hub"）。

trans-unit.source: How far along the route the van is, 0 to 1. Delivered draws it at the end whatever the value.
trans-unit.target: 車輛沿路線走了多遠，0 到 1。已送達時無论此值為何，都畫在終點。

trans-unit.source: The current stage (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 當前階段（双向）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Stage` changes.
trans-unit.target: `Stage` 變化時引發。

trans-unit.source: The day relative times are counted from; null uses the local date.
trans-unit.target: 計算相對時間的基準日期；為 null 時使用本地日期。

trans-unit.source: A screenshot-to-code card (Arc Design to code, design reference). The person drops a UI screenshot or imports a frame from a design file; a scan line crosses it and the layout regions it finds appear as boxes with tags; then code streams in beside it, linked region by region (pointing at a box or a tag highlights its lines and the other way round), with a working live preview one tab away. Generation comes from `Generator`, an async delegate that adds regions and writes code chunks through a `DesignToCodeContext`. Without one the card plays a built-in simulation on a sample pricing card and, while it is on screen, loops it (generate, hold on the code, show the preview, start again) until the first pointer or key press inside the card. Dropping a file uses Avalonia drag and drop; Choose file raises `ChooseFileRequested` for your picker (hand the file to `LoadFileAsync`).
trans-unit.target: 截圖轉程式碼卡片（Arc Design to code，設計參考）。使用者拖入介面截圖或從設計檔匯入一個畫框；掃描線掃過它，找到的版面區域以帶標籤的方框出現；接著程式碼在旁邊串流寫出，並與區域一一對應（指向方框或標籤會反白它的程式碼行，反之亦然），切換一個分頁即可看到可實際操作的即時預覽。產生來自 `Generator`，這是一個透過 `DesignToCodeContext` 新增區域並寫入程式碼片段的非同步委派。沒有產生器時，卡片在範例價格卡片上播放內建模擬，並在可見期間循環播放（產生、停留在程式碼上、顯示預覽、重新開始），直到卡片內第一次出現指標按下或按鍵。拖入檔案使用 Avalonia 拖放；Choose file 會引發 `ChooseFileRequested`，供你開啟檔案選擇器（把檔案交給 `LoadFileAsync`）。

trans-unit.source: The file types accepted, as in an input's accept attribute (MIME types, `image/*` or extensions). Other files show an error.
trans-unit.target: 接受的檔案類型，寫法同輸入框的 accept 屬性（MIME 類型、`image/*` 或副檔名）。其他檔案會顯示錯誤。

trans-unit.source: Plays the `Simulation` on a loop while the card is on screen (generate, hold on the code, show the preview, start again), and stops at the first pointer or key press inside the card. Null plays it when there is no `Generator`. Under reduced motion it plays once.
trans-unit.target: 卡片在畫面上時循環播放 `Simulation`（產生、停留在程式碼上、顯示預覽、重新開始），並在卡片內第一次出現指標按下或按鍵時停止。為 null 時，在沒有 `Generator` 的情況下播放。在減少動態效果下只播放一次。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Choose file. Bubbles. Open your file picker, pass the file to `LoadFileAsync` and set Handled; when nobody handles it the card uses the sample and says nothing was opened.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按下 Choose file 時引發。會冒泡。開啟你的檔案選擇器，把檔案交給 `LoadFileAsync` 並設定 Handled；沒有人處理時，卡片改用範例，並說明沒有開啟任何檔案。

trans-unit.source: The code written so far (the finished code once `Phase` is Done).
trans-unit.target: 目前已寫出的程式碼（`Phase` 為 Done 時即完成的程式碼）。

trans-unit.source: Raised with the finished code when a run completes. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 一次執行完成時引發，附帶完成的程式碼。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Runs your design file picker or link flow for Import design file: return the frame (with its rendered image) or null when cancelled. Null simulates an import of the simulation's design, if any.
trans-unit.target: 為「匯入設計檔」執行你的設計檔選擇器或連結流程：回傳畫框（帶算繪後的影像），取消時回傳 null。為 null 時模擬匯入模擬的設計（如果有）。

trans-unit.source: The problem the status names (a rejected file, a failed import or run), or null.
trans-unit.target: 狀態中指出的問題（被拒絕的檔案、失敗的匯入或執行），沒有時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The file name shown in the code header, in the status while writing and in the copy button's name. Empty uses the simulation's while it plays.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在程式碼標題列、撰寫時的狀態以及複製按鈕名稱中的檔名。為空時，播放模擬期間使用模擬的檔名。

trans-unit.source: Turns a source into code: call `AddRegion` as parts are detected, then `Write` as code streams, with a region id to link a chunk to its box. Complete the task when done, throw to show the error, and stop when the context's token is cancelled. Null plays the `Simulation`, if any.
trans-unit.target: 把來源轉換為程式碼：辨識出部分時呼叫 `AddRegion`，程式碼串流抵達時呼叫 `Write`，並用區域 id 把程式碼片段與它的方框連結。完成時結束工作，擲出例外以顯示錯誤，並在內容的權杖取消時停止。為 null 時播放 `Simulation`（如果有）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個詞。

trans-unit.source: The language the code is highlighted as (a TextMate grammar name or alias such as tsx, jsx, html or vue).
trans-unit.target: 程式碼醒目標示所用的語言（TextMate 語法名稱或別名，例如 tsx、jsx、html 或 vue）。

trans-unit.source: The largest file accepted, in bytes (10 MB by default).
trans-unit.target: 接受的最大檔案，單位為位元組（預設 10 MB）。

trans-unit.source: The model credited in the code header: its mark and name. Null credits the simulation's model while it plays, and none otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 在程式碼標題列中註明的模型：它的標誌與名稱。為 null 時，播放模擬期間註明模擬的模型，否則不註明。

trans-unit.source: Where the card is in its run.
trans-unit.target: 卡片在本次執行中所處的階段。

trans-unit.source: Renders the finished code in the Preview tab (for example in a sandboxed web view; never run generated code in your app). Return null for no preview. Null uses the simulation's preview after a simulated run, and a short note otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 在「預覽」分頁中算繪完成的程式碼（例如放在沙箱化的網頁檢視中；切勿在你的應用程式內執行產生的程式碼）。回傳 null 表示沒有預覽。為 null 時，模擬執行之後使用模擬的預覽，其他情況顯示一則簡短說明。

trans-unit.source: The design and code the card plays while there is no `Generator`: its design shows while `Source` is unset, Use sample brings it back, and Generate (or the autoplay loop) scans it and streams its code exactly like a generator would. Null leaves the card on its drop zone.
trans-unit.target: 沒有 `Generator` 時卡片播放的設計與程式碼：`Source` 未設定期間顯示它的設計，「Use sample」會把它帶回來，「產生」（或自動播放循環）會掃描它並串流輸出它的程式碼，方式與產生器完全相同。為 null 時卡片停在拖放區。

trans-unit.source: The design shown (two-way). Leave it unset to show the `Simulation`'s design (or the drop zone without one, or when `Generator` is set); set it to null to open on the drop zone. A source without an image draws its `Sketch`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的設計（雙向）。不設定時顯示 `Simulation` 的設計（沒有模擬或設定了 `Generator` 時顯示拖放區）；設為 null 則以拖放區開啟。沒有影像的來源繪製它的 `Sketch`。

trans-unit.source: The layer open on the output side (two-way). Each new run returns to Code so the stream is visible.
trans-unit.target: 輸出那一側開啟的圖層（雙向）。每次新的執行都會回到「程式碼」，讓串流輸出可見。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Completed`: the finished code and what it was made from.
trans-unit.target: `Completed` 的引數：完成的程式碼以及它的來源。

trans-unit.source: What a `Generator` gets besides the source: a token that is cancelled when the person stops the run (Escape or Stop) or replaces the design, `AddRegion` for each layout region as it is detected, and `Write` for each chunk of code as it streams. Both may be called from any thread; calls after the run ended are ignored.
trans-unit.target: `Generator` 除來源之外取得的內容：一個權杖，在使用者停止執行（Escape 或 Stop）或取代設計時取消；每辨識出一個版面區域時呼叫的 `AddRegion`；以及程式碼串流抵達時為每個程式碼片段呼叫的 `Write`。兩者都可以在任何執行緒呼叫；執行結束後的呼叫會被忽略。

trans-unit.source: Every word `DesignToCode` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; sentences with values are format functions so the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `DesignToCode` 顯示或朗讀的每一個詞，預設為英文。取代整個物件即可在地化或改寫；帶數值的句子是格式化函式，因此可以調整語序。

trans-unit.source: A layout region found on the design: an id that code chunks refer to, a short label for its tag, and its box in percent of the design's width and height (0 to 100, from the top left).
trans-unit.target: 在設計上找到的一個版面區域：程式碼片段參照的 id、標籤上的簡短文字，以及以設計寬度與高度百分比表示的方框（0 到 100，從左上角起算）。

trans-unit.source: A design and the code a model could write for it, which a `DesignToCode` plays while the app wires no `Generator`: the design (an image or a `Sketch`), the layout regions the scan finds, the code part by part with the region each part implements, and optionally the model credited, the file name and a preview. With `AutoPlay` the card loops it while it is on screen (generate, hold on the code, show the preview, start again) until someone presses or types inside it. Nothing is uploaded or sent. Set the data before handing the simulation to the card; to play another design, give the card a new simulation.
trans-unit.target: 一個設計以及模型可能為它寫出的程式碼，在應用程式沒有接上 `Generator` 時由 `DesignToCode` 播放：設計（影像或 `Sketch`）、掃描找到的版面區域、逐段的程式碼及每段實作的區域，以及可選的署名模型、檔名與預覽。開啟 `AutoPlay` 時，卡片在畫面上會循環播放它（產生、停留在程式碼上、顯示預覽、重新開始），直到有人在卡片內按下或輸入。不會上傳或傳送任何內容。請在把模擬交給卡片之前設定好資料；要播放另一個設計，就給卡片一個新的模擬。

trans-unit.source: One part of the code of a `DesignToCodeSimulation`: its text and the region it implements.
trans-unit.target: `DesignToCodeSimulation` 程式碼中的一段：它的文字以及它實作的區域。

trans-unit.source: The theme colors, font and corner radius a `DesignToCodeSketch` draws with.
trans-unit.target: `DesignToCodeSketch` 繪製時使用的主題色彩、字型與圓角。

trans-unit.source: The design a `DesignToCode` card turns into code: a name, where it came from and its image, or a `Sketch` that draws it in code in the card's colors.
trans-unit.target: `DesignToCode` 卡片轉換為程式碼的設計：名稱、來源以及影像，或者一個以卡片的色彩用程式碼繪製它的 `Sketch`。

trans-unit.source: A focused surface for decisions that need attention: confirmations, short forms, step flows whose title crossfades. Declare it anywhere in XAML; it renders nothing in place and shows its panel above a blurred scrim while `IsOpen` is true: The overlay fades in while the panel rises 8px from 0.96 on the smooth spring; closing is shorter and starts from wherever the entrance is. Escape and a press on the scrim close it (cancellable through `Closing`); Tab cycles inside; focus returns to the opener. Code can await a result with `ShowAsync` or `ConfirmAsync`.
trans-unit.target: 用於需要注意之決策的聚焦表面：確認、簡短表單、標題淡入切換的分步流程。可在 XAML 中任意位置宣告；它不會在原位置渲染任何內容，當 `IsOpen` 為 true 時，會在模糊遮罩之上顯示其面板。覆蓋層淡入，面板以平滑彈簧從 0.96 縮放並上升 8px；關閉比進入更短，並從進入動畫當前所在的位置開始。Escape 與在遮罩上按下都會關閉（可透過 `Closing` 取消）；Tab 在內部循環；焦點返回至開啟它的元素。程式碼可透過 `ShowAsync` 或 `ConfirmAsync` 等待結果。

trans-unit.source: Set on a button inside a dialog, drawer or bottom sheet: clicking it closes that overlay with this value as its `CloseResult` (and the result of `ShowAsync`).
trans-unit.target: 設定於對話方塊、抽屜或底部面板內的按鈕上：點選後會以此值作為其 `CloseResult` 關閉該覆蓋層（同時也是 `ShowAsync` 的結果）。

trans-unit.source: False hides the header row: the title, the description, the close button and the line under them, for a panel that brings its own heading (a branded sign-in, for example). Keep `Title` set: it stays the accessible name of the panel. Without the close button the dialog closes with Escape, a click outside or its own buttons. Defaults to true.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時隱藏標題列：標題、說明、關閉按鈕與下方的分隔線，適合自帶標題的面板（例如品牌化的登入對話方塊）。仍要設定 `Title`：它仍是面板的無障礙名稱。沒有關閉按鈕時，對話方塊透過 Esc、點擊外部或自己的按鈕關閉。預設為 true。

trans-unit.source: Panel width: Small 360, Medium 440 (Arc), Large 560 — always within the viewport minus 32px.
trans-unit.target: 面板寬度：Small 360、Medium 440（Arc）、Large 560——始終不超過視埠寬度減去 32px。

trans-unit.source: A chat composer with voice input (Arc Dictation button, design reference): the field, a model label, the dictation mic and send. Pressing the mic springs it into a recording pill with a live waveform, a timer, cancel and Insert; words stream into the field as the person speaks, the recognizer's guesses muted until they settle. Insert appends the text and puts the caret at its end; Enter sends. Speech comes from `Recognizer` (an `IDictationRecognizer` you write for your platform or service). For demos, a `Simulation` speaks the scripts you give it without touching the microphone and, unless `AutoPlay` says otherwise, loops a scripted dictation until the person first touches the card. With neither, the composer is a plain field whose mic says dictation is not available. Handle `SendRequested` to send; without a handler sending is simulated.
trans-unit.target: 具備語音輸入的聊天輸入框（Arc Dictation button，設計參考）：輸入框、模型標籤、聽寫麥克風與傳送按鈕。按下麥克風，它以彈簧動態展開成附即時波形、計時器、取消與插入的錄音膠囊；使用者說話時文字流入輸入框，辨識器的猜測以淡色顯示，確定後轉為內文顏色。插入會附加文字並把游標放在末端；按 Enter 傳送。語音來自 `Recognizer`（你為所在平台或服務撰寫的 `IDictationRecognizer`）。用於展示時，`Simulation` 會在不存取麥克風的情況下朗讀你提供的腳本，並且除非 `AutoPlay` 另有設定，會循環播放一段腳本化聽寫，直到使用者第一次操作卡片。兩者都沒有時，輸入框只是一個一般欄位，按下麥克風會提示聽寫無法使用。處理 `SendRequested` 以傳送；沒有處理常式時傳送是模擬的。

trans-unit.source: Loops a scripted dictation (listen, insert, send) until the first pointer, key or focus inside the card; it pauses off screen. Null plays it only with a `Simulation` and no `Recognizer`. For docs and demos, not production.
trans-unit.target: 循環播放一段腳本化聽寫（聆聽、插入、傳送），直到卡片內第一次出現指標、按鍵或焦點；不在畫面上時暫停。為 null 時只在有 `Simulation` 且沒有 `Recognizer` 時播放。供文件與展示使用，不適用於正式環境。

trans-unit.source: Raised with the final text of a dictation, after it has been appended to the field. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 攜帶聽寫的最終文字，在它附加到輸入框之後引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: True while a send is pending (the send button shows a spinner).
trans-unit.target: 傳送進行中時為 true（傳送按鈕顯示轉圈）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the composer shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 輸入框顯示或朗讀的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: Seconds before listening stops and inserts on its own; 0 turns the limit off.
trans-unit.target: 聆聽自動停止並插入之前的秒數；0 表示不限制。

trans-unit.source: The model label at the start of the toolbar (the model the composer sends to); null (the default) hides it.
trans-unit.target: 工具列開頭的模型標籤（輸入框傳送到的模型）；為 null（預設）時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: The field's placeholder, such as "Message" and the assistant's name; null (the default) shows none.
trans-unit.target: 輸入框的預留位置文字，例如 "Message" 加上助理的名稱；為 null（預設）時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The speech source. Null uses `Simulation`; with neither, the mic says dictation is not available.
trans-unit.target: 語音來源。為 null 時使用 `Simulation`；兩者都沒有時，麥克風會提示聽寫無法使用。

trans-unit.source: Raised to send the message (Enter in the field or the send button). Set `Completion` to your sending task: the button spins until it completes and the field clears when it succeeds. Without a handler the send is simulated. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 傳送訊息時引發（在輸入框中按 Enter 或按下傳送按鈕）。把 `Completion` 設為你的傳送工作：按鈕會轉圈直到工作完成，成功後輸入框清空。沒有處理常式時傳送是模擬的。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: A simulated voice to dictate with while `Recognizer` is null: it never touches the microphone and speaks its scripts, and with `AutoPlay` left null the composer loops it on its own. Its clock stands still while the card is off screen. Null (the default) plays nothing. Give each composer its own simulation.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Recognizer` 為 null 時用於聽寫的模擬聲音：它從不存取麥克風，只朗讀自己的腳本；`AutoPlay` 維持 null 時輸入框會自行循環播放它。卡片不在畫面上時它的時鐘會停止。為 null（預設）時不播放任何內容。請給每個輸入框各自的模擬執行個體。

trans-unit.source: Where the dictation is.
trans-unit.target: 聽寫所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised on every status change, with the error code for denied and error. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 每次狀態變化時引發；遭拒與發生錯誤時附帶錯誤代碼。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The field's text (two-way): typing, an inserted dictation and the clear after sending change it.
trans-unit.target: 輸入框的文字（雙向）：輸入、插入的聽寫內容與傳送後的清空都會改變它。

trans-unit.source: Raised whenever the live transcript of the current dictation changes. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 目前聽寫的即時轉寫內容每次變化時引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Every word `DictationButton` and `DictationControl` show or say, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; counts, times and errors are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `DictationButton` 與 `DictationControl` 顯示或朗讀的所有文字，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；計數、時間與錯誤是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: Just the mic and its recording pill, for a composer you already have (Arc Dictation button, design reference). Pressing the mic springs it leftward into a 216px pill: cancel, a live waveform, the elapsed time and Insert, which sits where the mic was. Words arrive through `TranscriptChanged` (render them in your field, the interim part muted) and the final text through `Committed`. A blocked microphone or a failure turns the slot into Try again. Speech comes from `Recognizer`; for demos, a `Simulation` speaks the scripts you give it and records nothing. With neither, pressing the mic says dictation is not available. Same state machine as `DictationButton`, no field.
trans-unit.target: 只有麥克風與它的錄音膠囊，用於你已有的輸入框（Arc Dictation button，設計參考）。按下麥克風，它向左以彈簧動態展開成 216px 的膠囊：取消、即時波形、已錄時間與插入，插入位於麥克風原本的位置。文字透過 `TranscriptChanged` 送達（在你的輸入框中呈現，暫定部分用淡色），最終文字透過 `Committed` 送達。麥克風遭封鎖或發生錯誤時，該位置會變成 Try again。語音來自 `Recognizer`；用於展示時，`Simulation` 會朗讀你提供的腳本，不錄下任何內容。兩者都沒有時，按下麥克風會提示聽寫無法使用。與 `DictationButton` 使用同一個狀態機，但沒有輸入框。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person cancels; drop any live text you rendered. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 使用者取消時引發；請捨棄你呈現的即時文字。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Raised with the final text of a dictation, to append to your field. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 攜帶聽寫的最終文字引發，供附加到你的輸入框。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Every word the control shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 控制項顯示或朗讀的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: Seconds before listening stops and inserts on its own; 0 turns the limit off.
trans-unit.target: 聆聽自動停止並插入之前的秒數；0 表示不限制。

trans-unit.source: The speech source. Null uses `Simulation`; with neither, starting fails as unavailable.
trans-unit.target: 語音來源。為 null 時使用 `Simulation`；兩者都沒有時，啟動會以無法使用失敗。

trans-unit.source: A simulated voice to dictate with while `Recognizer` is null: it never touches the microphone and speaks its scripts, and the control says nothing is recorded. Null (the default) leaves the mic unavailable. Give each control its own simulation.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Recognizer` 為 null 時用於聽寫的模擬聲音：它從不存取麥克風，只朗讀自己的腳本，控制項會說明沒有錄下任何內容。為 null（預設）時麥克風無法使用。請給每個控制項各自的模擬執行個體。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the recognizer detects the end of an utterance. Do nothing, or confirm hands-free. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 辨識器偵測到一句話結束時引發。可以不做任何事，或免手動確認。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Where the dictation is.
trans-unit.target: 聽寫所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised on every status change, with the error code for denied and error. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 每次狀態變化時引發；遭拒與發生錯誤時附帶錯誤代碼。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The live transcript of the current dictation.
trans-unit.target: 目前聽寫的即時轉寫內容。

trans-unit.source: Raised whenever the live transcript changes (render it in your field, the interim part muted). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 即時轉寫內容每次變化時引發（在你的輸入框中呈現，暫定部分用淡色）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of how a domain name is resolved: the browser asks its recursive resolver, the resolver finds nothing in its cache and walks the name servers from the top (a root server refers it to the top-level domain's servers, those refer it to the domain's own name servers, which answer with the address), stores the answer for its time to live and hands it back; asked again, it answers from the cache. Packets travel between the parts, a message log names each exchange, and two readouts count the round trips and the lookup time. Play, pause, step, restart and a 0.5× / 1× / 2× speed control drive it; under reduced motion it opens on its end and steps apply in place. Timings and addresses are illustrative.
trans-unit.target: 網域名稱解析過程的動畫講解：瀏覽器詢問它的遞迴解析器，解析器在快取中找不到結果，於是從頂層開始逐級詢問名稱伺服器（根伺服器把它指向頂級網域的伺服器，頂級網域伺服器再把它指向該網域自己的名稱伺服器，後者回傳位址），在存活時間內保存該答案並回傳給瀏覽器；再次詢問時，直接從快取回答。封包在各部分之間傳遞，訊息記錄列出每一次交換，兩個讀數分別統計往返次數和查詢耗時。播放、暫停、單步、重新開始以及 0.5× / 1× / 2× 速度控制項驅動演示；在減少動態效果下直接開啟結束狀態，單步就地生效。時間和位址僅供示意。

trans-unit.source: The address the authoritative server answers with (default 203.0.113.42, a documentation address).
trans-unit.target: 權威伺服器回傳的位址（預設 203.0.113.42，一個文件專用位址）。

trans-unit.source: The name being looked up (default an invented "docs.lumen-garden.dev"). Use a name with at least two labels.
trans-unit.target: 要查詢的名稱（預設是虛構的 "docs.lumen-garden.dev"）。請使用至少包含兩級標籤的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Ends the story with a second lookup answered from the cache (default true).
trans-unit.target: 在演示結尾進行第二次查詢，並從快取回答（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個文字。

trans-unit.source: The chapter the story is in.
trans-unit.target: 演示目前所處的章節。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the story enters a chapter (also at the end, with `Done`).
trans-unit.target: 演示進入某個章節時觸發（結束時也會觸發，值為 `Done`）。

trans-unit.source: How long, in seconds, the resolver may keep the answer (default 300).
trans-unit.target: 解析器可以保留答案的時長，以秒為單位（預設 300）。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `DnsResolution` shows or announces, in English by default (the playback buttons are named by `PlaybackLabels`). Replace the instance to translate or reword; texts with names or numbers are functions so the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `DnsResolution` 顯示或朗讀的每一個文字，預設為英文（播放按鈕的名稱由 `PlaybackLabels` 指定）。替換整個實例即可翻譯或改寫；包含名稱或數字的文字為函數，以便調整詞序。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `StepChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `StepChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: The central area that holds the documents: one `DockGroup`, or a split of document groups (side-by-side editors). Documents stay inside it; tools enter it only with `CanDockAsDocument`. A workspace has at most one, and it is never removed, even when it is empty (it then shows `EmptyDocumentContent`).
trans-unit.target: 存放文件的中央區域：一個 `DockGroup`，或由文件群組組成的分割（並排編輯）。文件只能留在其中；工具只有在 `CanDockAsDocument` 時才能進入。一個工作區至多有一個，即使為空也不會移除（此時顯示 `EmptyDocumentContent`）。

trans-unit.source: The document group or split of document groups; null when no document is open.
trans-unit.target: 文件群組或由文件群組組成的分割；沒有開啟的文件時為 null。

trans-unit.source: A tab group: its `Panes` share one card, one tab each, and `ActivePane` is the one shown. A group whose last pane leaves is removed from the layout.
trans-unit.target: 分頁群組：其 `Panes` 共用一張卡片，每個一個分頁，`ActivePane` 是正在顯示的那個。最後一個面板離開的群組會從版面中移除。

trans-unit.source: The pane whose tab is selected and whose content is shown. Two-way; always one of `Panes` (or null when empty).
trans-unit.target: 分頁被選取、內容正在顯示的面板。雙向；總是 `Panes` 之一（為空時為 null）。

trans-unit.source: True when the group is inside the `DockDocumentArea` (its tabs then look like document tabs).
trans-unit.target: 群組位於 `DockDocumentArea` 內時為 true（其分頁此時顯示為文件分頁）。

trans-unit.source: An IDE-style dock layout: panes (`DockPane`) sit in tab groups, groups are nested in horizontal and vertical splits with draggable dividers, and documents live in a central `DockDocumentArea`. Each group is a rounded card with 6px gaps between cards. Panes move with `Move` or the tab menu (Move to, Dock to), close from their tab, menu or keyboard, and the whole layout saves to JSON (`SaveLayout`) and loads back (`LoadLayout`). Write the tree as the content in XAML, or build a `DockWorkspace` in code.
trans-unit.target: IDE 式停靠版面：面板（`DockPane`）位於分頁群組中，群組巢狀在帶可拖曳分隔線的水平與垂直分割裡，文件位於中央的 `DockDocumentArea`。每個群組是一張圓角卡片，卡片之間留 6px 縫。面板可透過 `Move` 或分頁選單（移動到、停靠到）移動，可從分頁、選單或鍵盤關閉，整個版面可儲存為 JSON（`SaveLayout`）並讀回（`LoadLayout`）。在 XAML 中把樹寫成內容，或在程式碼中建構 `DockWorkspace`。

trans-unit.source: The active pane: the one whose content last had focus or whose tab was last chosen. Two-way; setting it selects the pane's tab (use `Activate` to also move focus into it).
trans-unit.target: 作用中面板：最後取得內容焦點或最後被選取分頁的面板。雙向；設定它會選取該面板的分頁（要同時把焦點移入面板，用 `Activate`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `ActivePane` changes.
trans-unit.target: `ActivePane` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: Builds a document item's pane. A template that produces a `DockPane` is used as it is; anything else is wrapped in a pane. The pane's `DataContext` is the item; without an `Id` or `Title` it takes them from `IDockItem` or the item's `ToString()`.
trans-unit.target: 產生文件項目的面板。範本產出 `DockPane` 時直接使用；產出其他內容時包進一個面板。面板的 `DataContext` 是該項；沒有 `Id` 或 `Title` 時從 `IDockItem` 或該項的 `ToString()` 取值。

trans-unit.source: Data items that each become a document pane in the document area. Adding an item opens its pane, removing it closes the pane; when the user closes a tab and the collection is a writable list, the item is removed from it.
trans-unit.target: 每一項產生一個文件面板、放入文件區的資料集合。新增一項會開啟它的面板，移除一項會關閉面板；使用者關閉分頁且集合是可寫入的清單時，該項會從集合中移除。

trans-unit.source: What the document area shows while no document is open; by default an empty state that reads "No open documents".
trans-unit.target: 沒有開啟的文件時文件區顯示的內容；預設是顯示「No open documents」的空狀態。

trans-unit.source: How panes float: `Auto` (the default) uses real windows in a desktop window of a classic desktop application and floating cards inside the layout anywhere else; `Window` and `Overlay` force one of them; `Disabled` keeps every pane docked (dragging out of the layout puts the pane back, and `CanFloat` counts as false).
trans-unit.target: 面板如何浮動：`Auto`（預設）在傳統桌面應用程式的桌面視窗中使用真正的視窗，在其他地方使用版面內的浮動卡片；`Window` 和 `Overlay` 強制使用其中一種；`Disabled` 讓所有面板保持停靠（拖出版面會放回原處，`CanFloat` 視為 false）。

trans-unit.source: Locks the layout: panes cannot be moved, closed, floated or auto-hidden; the dividers still resize.
trans-unit.target: 鎖定版面：面板不能移動、關閉、浮動或自動隱藏；分隔線仍可調整。

trans-unit.source: Raised after any change of the layout (move, close, open, resize, activate, load); handy for saving it automatically.
trans-unit.target: 版面發生任何變化（移動、關閉、開啟、調整大小、啟用、讀入）之後引發；便於自動儲存。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a pane closed.
trans-unit.target: 面板關閉後引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised before a pane closes; set `Cancel` to keep it open.
trans-unit.target: 面板關閉前引發；設定 `Cancel` 可保持其開啟。

trans-unit.source: Supplies panes while a saved layout loads, for ids that no pane of this layout has had (declared in XAML or opened since). Return null to skip the id.
trans-unit.target: 讀入儲存的版面時，為本版面從未有過的面板 Id（XAML 中宣告或之後開啟的除外）提供面板。傳回 null 則略過該 Id。

trans-unit.source: Whether a drag shows the compass and the edge buttons. Off, panes still dock by where the pointer is in a group (a quarter from an edge splits that side, the middle joins as a tab) and close to the layout's edge; only the preview shows.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳時是否顯示羅盤和邊緣按鈕。關閉後，面板仍依指標在群組內的位置停靠（離邊四分之一以內分割那一側，中間作為分頁加入），靠近版面邊緣時停靠到該邊；只顯示預覽框。

trans-unit.source: Builds a tool item's pane; same rules as `DocumentTemplate`.
trans-unit.target: 產生工具項目的面板；規則與 `DocumentTemplate` 相同。

trans-unit.source: Data items that each become a tool pane, placed by its `PreferredSide` (left when the template sets none). Same rules as `DocumentsSource`.
trans-unit.target: 每一項產生一個工具面板的資料集合，依 `PreferredSide` 放置（範本未設定時放在左側）。規則與 `DocumentsSource` 相同。

trans-unit.source: The layout model. Replace it to show another layout; never null.
trans-unit.target: 版面模型。取代它即可顯示另一套版面；不能為 null。

trans-unit.source: Smallest size in px along the parent split's direction (default 120).
trans-unit.target: 沿父分割方向的最小尺寸（px，預設 120）。

trans-unit.source: The node's share of its parent split, relative to its siblings (shares need not add up to 100). Updated when a divider is dragged; setting it moves the divider.
trans-unit.target: 節點在父分割中的份額，相對於同層節點（份額之和不必為 100）。拖曳分隔線時更新；設定它會移動分隔線。

trans-unit.source: One dockable pane of a `DockLayout`: a tool (with a `PreferredSide`) or a document (without one). The pane is its own content host: when it moves between groups it is the same instance under a new parent, so its content keeps its state (scroll position, input, selection). Only the active pane of a group is in the visual tree.

trans-unit.source: A custom domain setup card. The customer adds a domain and gets the DNS records to create, each with a copy button; a live checker then polls the resolvers, marks every record valid, not found or misconfigured (with what was found and a one-line fix) and finishes with the domain verified and its SSL certificate issued. The three server steps are async delegates: `GetRecordsAction` lists the records, `VerifyAction` is one check and `IssueCertificateAction` runs once every record is valid. The card does the polling, stops on "all valid" or any conflicting record and cancels everything when it is removed or leaves the window. With none of them set it plays a simulated flow (add, check, a conflicting record, fix, verified) until someone clicks or types in it.
trans-unit.target: 自訂網域設定卡片。客戶新增網域並取得需要建立的 DNS 記錄（每筆都附有複製按鈕）；即時檢查器隨後輪詢解析器，把每筆記錄標為有效、找不到或設定錯誤（附帶找到的內容和一行修正建議），最後完成網域驗證並簽發 SSL 憑證。三個伺服器步驟是非同步委派：`GetRecordsAction` 列出記錄，`VerifyAction` 做一次檢查，`IssueCertificateAction` 在所有記錄有效後執行。卡片負責輪詢，在「全部有效」或出現衝突記錄時停止，並在被移除或離開視窗時取消一切。三個委派都沒設定時，它會播放一段模擬流程（新增、檢查、衝突記錄、修正、驗證通過），直到有人在其中點擊或輸入。

An exception stops the run, shows the message and raises `Failed`. Null plays a scripted check.
trans-unit.target: 對記錄做一次檢查：每次輪詢都會等待它，參數是網域、記錄，以及這是哪一輪的第幾次。為每筆記錄回傳結論。記錄仍在生效時回傳 `Missing`，只有值衝突時才回傳 `Invalid`。只要有記錄缺失，卡片就繼續輪詢，全部有效或任一無效時停止。例外會中止這一輪、顯示訊息並觸發 `Failed`。為 null 時播放腳本化的檢查。

trans-unit.target: 一次檢查的結果：每筆記錄的結論和生效統計。

trans-unit.source: Arc's donut chart: a few parts of one whole. The legend and the ring show and hide segments together, the center reads the active segment (or the total at rest) and rolls like a drum between readouts, small parts fold into "Other", and new data moves every arc from where it is on screen, keeping its velocity. The first time the chart is seen all segments sweep out of the top together, each trailing edge a beat behind. Arc interpolates start and end angles rather than paths; every angle is a `MotionValue` written into one self-drawn ring, which ControlTheme transitions cannot express.
trans-unit.target: Arc 環形圖：表示一個整體的若干部分。圖例與圓環同步顯示和隱藏分段；中心顯示目前啟用的分段（靜止時顯示總計），並在讀數之間像滾筒一樣滾動；過小的部分合併為「Other」；新資料會讓每段弧線從其在畫面上的目前位置出發，並保留其速度。首次看到此圖表時，所有分段會一同從頂部掃出，每段的後緣比前緣晚一拍。Arc 對起始角與結束角進行插值，而非路徑；每個角度都是寫入一個自繪圓環的 `MotionValue`，這是 ControlTheme 過渡無法表達的。

trans-unit.source: The selected (pinned) segment key. Hover and focus preview other segments without changing it. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 所選（固定）分段的鍵。懸停與聚焦只預覽其他分段，不會改變它。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the selected segment changes.
trans-unit.target: 當所選分段變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: Ring diameter in pixels; the ring scales down to fit narrower containers.
trans-unit.target: 圓環直徑（像素）；當容器較窄時，圓環會等比縮小以適應。

trans-unit.source: Segments below this share of the total join "Other" (only when at least two would).
trans-unit.target: 占總量比例低於此值的分段合併為「Other」（僅當至少有兩個分段符合條件時）。

trans-unit.source: Keys of hidden segments. A hidden segment closes and the rest of the ring redistributes. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 隱藏分段的鍵。隱藏的分段會收合，其餘圓環重新分配空間。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a segment.
trans-unit.target: 當圖例顯示或隱藏某個分段時引發。

trans-unit.source: What clicking a legend row does.
trans-unit.target: 點選圖例列時執行的動作。

trans-unit.source: The most segments drawn, counting "Other".
trans-unit.target: 最多繪製的分段數，包含「Other」。

trans-unit.source: Label of the segment that holds the grouped small parts.
trans-unit.target: 容納合併小部分之分段的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Ring thickness in pixels.
trans-unit.target: 圓環粗細（像素）。

trans-unit.source: The synced legend beside (at least 460px wide) or below the ring.
trans-unit.target: 與圓環同步的圖例，位於圓環旁（寬度至少 460px）或其下方。

trans-unit.source: Center label at rest, above the total.
trans-unit.target: 靜止時位於中心的標籤，顯示於總計上方。

trans-unit.source: A field of dots that bulge away from the pointer like a lens, wobble back on their own springs and ripple outward from every click or tap (Arc Dot grid, design reference). Content placed inside sits on top and stays interactive; the field listens to the pointer across the whole control, over the content too.
trans-unit.target: 一片點陣，點會像透鏡一樣從指標處向外鼓起，沿各自的彈簧晃回原位，並隨每次點擊或輕觸向外擴散漣漪（Arc 點陣，設計參考）。放在裡面的內容位於點陣之上並保持可互動；點陣在整個控制項範圍內監聽指標，內容上方也一樣。

trans-unit.source: Color the dots take under the lens and in ripples. The theme uses the accent color.
trans-unit.target: 點在透鏡下與漣漪中呈現的顏色。主題使用強調色。

trans-unit.target: 靜止時點的顏色。主題使用強邊框色。

trans-unit.source: Dot radius in px at rest.
trans-unit.target: 靜止時點的半徑，單位 px。

trans-unit.source: Distance between dots in px; lower is denser. At least 6.
trans-unit.target: 點與點之間的距離，單位 px；越小越密。最小為 6。

trans-unit.source: Whether the field fades out toward its edges.
trans-unit.target: 點陣是否在靠近邊緣處淡出。
