trans-unit.target: 透鏡在最強處（向外三分之一處）把點推開的距離，單位 px。

trans-unit.source: A temporary side surface for focused work that keeps the page in context: filters, settings, record details, forms too long for a dialog. Declare it anywhere; while `IsOpen` its panel springs in from `Side` above a lightly blurred scrim. The header is a drag handle: it follows the pointer toward the edge and rubber-bands the other way; past a third of the panel, or on a flick toward the edge faster than 500px/s, the drawer closes and keeps the flick's velocity; otherwise it springs back. A click, Escape or the scrim closes it with a quicker tween. The close button is always there; under reduced motion dragging is off and the panel only fades.
trans-unit.target: 用於聚焦工作的暫時側邊表面，可讓頁面保持上下文：篩選器、設定、紀錄詳情、過長而不適合對話方塊的表單等。可在任意位置宣告；當 `IsOpen` 為 true 時，其面板會從 `Side` 方向以彈簧彈入，並位於輕微模糊的遮罩之上。標題列是拖曳把手：它跟隨指標朝邊緣移動，朝另一方向則產生橡皮筋回彈；超過面板的三分之一，或以快於 500px/s 的速度朝邊緣輕彈時，抽屜會關閉並保留輕彈的速度；否則會彈回。點選、Escape 或遮罩會以較快的補間動畫關閉它。關閉按鈕始終存在；在減少動態效果模式下，拖曳功能關閉，面板只淡入淡出。

trans-unit.source: Edge the panel is anchored to (default Right).
trans-unit.target: 面板所固定的邊緣（預設為 Right）。

trans-unit.source: A focused list of actions anchored to a labelled trigger (Arc dropdown menu). The trigger shows an optional icon, the `Label` (a new label rises in from a soft blur while the trigger width springs) and a chevron that turns on the CSS spring while open. The menu grows from the trigger edge on Arc's 580ms CSS spring with a 160ms fade, one highlight glides between rows for the pointer and jumps for the keyboard, and rows fade in with a short stagger. Rows are declared inline (`<arc:MenuEntry Header="Rename" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}"/>`) or supplied with `ItemsSource`. Replace the built-in trigger with `Trigger` (any control; buttons toggle the menu on click and never press-scale). Enter, Space or ArrowDown on the trigger open the menu on the first row; Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger. Rows with child rows open submenus (nest `MenuEntry` elements, or set `ChildrenSelector` for `ItemsSource` data); `ItemClicked` reports rows of every level.
trans-unit.target: 錨定在帶標籤觸發器上的聚焦動作清單（Arc 下拉式選單）。觸發器顯示可選圖示、`Label`（新標籤從柔和模糊中升起，同時觸發器寬度以彈簧變化）以及在開啟時透過 CSS 彈簧轉動的箭頭。選單以 Arc 的 580ms CSS 彈簧從觸發器邊緣展開，伴隨 160ms 淡入；一個高亮會在列之間為指標滑動，為鍵盤則直接跳轉；各列以短促的錯落時序淡入。列可以內嵌宣告（`<arc:MenuEntry Header="Rename" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}"/>`），也可透過 `ItemsSource` 提供。可用 `Trigger` 取代內建觸發器（任意控制項；按鈕在點選時切換選單，且從不產生按壓縮放）。在觸發器上按 Enter、Space 或 ArrowDown 會在第一列開啟選單；Escape 關閉選單並將焦點返回觸發器。帶子列的列會開啟子選單（巢狀放入 `MenuEntry` 元素，或為 `ItemsSource` 資料設定 `ChildrenSelector`）；`ItemClicked` 會回報各層的列。

trans-unit.source: Menu alignment against the trigger (Arc: end).
trans-unit.target: 選單相對觸發器的對齊方式（Arc：end）。

trans-unit.source: Children of an `ItemsSource` item: a non-empty result makes its row open a submenu of those children (same signature as `TreeView.ChildrenSelector`; applied at every level).
trans-unit.target: `ItemsSource` 中某一項的子項：傳回非空結果時，該項所在的列會開啟由這些子項組成的子選單（簽章與 `TreeView.ChildrenSelector` 相同；在各層都會套用）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu closes.
trans-unit.target: 選單關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: Leading icon of the built-in trigger (a 24x24 Lucide geometry such as `ArcIcons.Settings`).
trans-unit.target: 內建觸發器的前置圖示（24x24 Lucide 幾何圖形，例如 `ArcIcons.Settings`）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the menu is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 選單是否開啟（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row is activated.
trans-unit.target: 當某一列被啟用時引發。

trans-unit.source: Template that renders each ItemsSource item as a row.
trans-unit.target: 將每個 ItemsSource 項目渲染為一列的範本。

trans-unit.source: Data items shown as one row each; ItemTemplate renders them when set.
trans-unit.target: 以每個項目一列顯示的資料項目；設定後由 ItemTemplate 渲染。

trans-unit.source: Trigger text (Arc: required). Changing it morphs the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器文字（Arc：必填）。變更時觸發器會變形。

trans-unit.source: Maximum height of the menu; longer menus scroll. NaN (default) uses the theme's 384px. The menu never grows past the room the window leaves beside the trigger, whatever this is set to.
trans-unit.target: 選單的最大高度；更長的選單會捲動。NaN（預設）使用主題的 384px。無論設為多少，選單都不會超出視窗在觸發器旁留出的空間。

trans-unit.source: Turns any control into a dropdown trigger for a `MenuSurface`: clicks (buttons) or taps toggle the menu, Enter / Space / ArrowDown open it on the first row, ArrowUp on the last, Escape returns focus to the control, and Arc buttons stop press-scaling while they anchor the menu. Used by split buttons, button groups and row "more" buttons: `<arc:Button arc:DropdownMenu.Menu="{StaticResource RowMenu}"/>`.
trans-unit.target: 將任意控制項轉換為 `MenuSurface` 的下拉式觸發器：點選（按鈕）或輕觸會切換選單，Enter / Space / ArrowDown 在第一列開啟選單，ArrowUp 在最後一列開啟，Escape 將焦點返回該控制項；當 Arc 按鈕錨定選單時會停止按壓縮放。用於分割按鈕、按鈕群組與列內「更多」按鈕：`<arc:Button arc:DropdownMenu.Menu="{StaticResource RowMenu}"/>`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the menu opens.
trans-unit.target: 選單開啟時引發。

trans-unit.source: Edge of the trigger the menu opens from: Bottom (default), Top, Left or Right.
trans-unit.target: 選單從觸發器的哪一側展開：Bottom（預設）、Top、Left 或 Right。

trans-unit.source: Custom trigger content that replaces the built-in button (the menu anchors to it).
trans-unit.target: 取代內建按鈕的自訂觸發器內容（選單錨定於此）。

trans-unit.source: Arc elastic slider: a single value slider made of something that gives. The thumb swells to 1.28× under the finger (P24), the track stretches like rubber up to 26px past either end and springs back with the release velocity (0.5s, bounce 0.42), the end icons are pushed outward with the stretch, a value tag hangs off the thumb and sways with its speed (up to 11°), and marks act as detents the thumb clicks into within 7px. Arrows, Shift+arrows, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End work as in a native range input; a key at a limit hits the wall and bounces. `SmallChange` is the step the value snaps to.
trans-unit.target: Arc 彈性滑桿：一個帶有回彈感的單一數值滑桿。拇指在手指按下時放大至 1.28×（P24），軌道在任一端之外最多如橡皮筋般拉伸 26px，並以釋放速度回彈（0.5s，bounce 0.42）；兩端圖示隨拉伸向外推移；數值標籤懸掛於拇指上，並隨其速度擺動（最多 11°）；刻度充當檔位，拇指在 7px 之內會「喀嗒」一聲卡入。方向鍵、Shift+方向鍵、PageUp / PageDown 以及 Home / End 的用法與原生 range 輸入相同；按鍵在極限處會碰壁並回彈。`SmallChange` 是數值吸附的步長。

trans-unit.source: Icon after the track; pushed outward when the track is pulled past its end.
trans-unit.target: 軌道之後的圖示；當軌道被拉過末端時向外推移。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value beside the label. The tag still appears while dragging or using keys.
trans-unit.target: 在標籤旁顯示數值。拖曳或使用鍵盤時數值標籤仍會出現。

trans-unit.source: Visible label; it also names the thumb.
trans-unit.target: 可見標籤；同時也作為拇指的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Detents: a dragged thumb clicks into each one and holds for a few pixels. Labels print under the track.
trans-unit.target: 檔位：拖曳的拇指會在每個檔位處「喀嗒」一聲卡入，並在幾個像素範圍內停留。標籤印在軌道下方。

trans-unit.source: Icon before the track; pushed outward when the track is pulled past its start.
trans-unit.target: 軌道之前的圖示；當軌道被拉過起點時向外推移。

trans-unit.source: Runs once a drag is released, a key changes the value or a mark label is clicked.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳釋放、按鍵變更數值或點選刻度標籤後執行一次。

trans-unit.source: Formats the value in the value tag and readout; when not set, the value is shown with the slider's Decimals.
trans-unit.target: 設定數值標籤與讀數的格式；未設定時，數值依滑桿的 Decimals 顯示。

trans-unit.source: A searchable emoji picker: a search field with a skin tone choice, a strip of categories, a scrolling grid of every Unicode emoji (recently used first) and a preview line with the name of the emoji under the pointer or the keyboard. Typing filters by name and keyword; the arrow keys, Home, End and Page keys move through the grid, Enter picks. The grid draws only the rows in view. Picking raises `EmojiSelected` with the emoji in the chosen skin tone, runs `Command` and moves the emoji to the front of `Recent`.
trans-unit.target: 可搜尋的表情符號選擇器：帶膚色選擇的搜尋框、一排分類、一個可捲動的格線（包含所有 Unicode 表情符號，最近使用的排在最前），以及顯示指標或鍵盤所在表情符號名稱的預覽列。輸入文字依名稱和關鍵字篩選；方向鍵、Home、End 和翻頁鍵在格線中移動，Enter 選擇。格線只繪製可見的列。選擇時觸發 `EmojiSelected`（帶有所選膚色的表情符號），執行 `Command`，並把表情符號移到 `Recent` 的最前面。

trans-unit.source: Runs when an emoji is picked; its parameter is the emoji text (with the skin tone).
trans-unit.target: 選擇表情符號時執行；參數是表情符號文字（帶膚色）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an emoji is picked.
trans-unit.target: 選擇表情符號時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Whether the preview line under the grid is shown (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示格線下方的預覽列（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the search field and the skin tone choice are shown (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示搜尋框和膚色選擇（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the picker shows or says (English by default).
trans-unit.target: 選擇器顯示或讀出的所有文字（預設為英文）。

trans-unit.source: Emoji newer than this Unicode emoji version are left out (15.0 by default), so fonts that lack them show no empty boxes.
trans-unit.target: 排除比這個 Unicode 表情符號版本更新的表情符號（預設 15.0），所以缺少它們的字型不會顯示空白方框。

trans-unit.source: How many emoji `Recent` keeps (24 by default; 0 hides the section).
trans-unit.target: `Recent` 最多保留多少個表情符號（預設 24；0 隱藏這一節）。

trans-unit.source: The search text. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋文字。雙向。

trans-unit.source: The skin tone applied to people and hands that have tones. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 套用於帶膚色的人物和手勢的膚色。雙向。

trans-unit.source: Every word an `EmojiPicker` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to translate or reword it. Emoji names come from the Unicode data and stay in English.
trans-unit.target: `EmojiPicker` 顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可翻譯或改寫。表情符號名稱來自 Unicode 資料，保持英文。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `EmojiSelected`.
trans-unit.target: `EmojiSelected` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: Arc empty state: a useful next step when there is nothing to show yet (an empty list, zero search results, first use). A centered icon block, a title, one or two sentences and an optional action. Keep it mounted and change its properties to morph between states: the icon pops into the new one, the copy rises in while the old copy leaves, and the text block's height springs to fit. The icon block settles in once when it first appears.
trans-unit.target: Arc 空狀態：在尚無內容可顯示時（空清單、搜尋結果為零、首次使用）提供有用的下一步。包括置中的圖示區塊、標題、一到兩句說明以及可選的動作。保持其掛載，透過變更屬性在各狀態之間變形：圖示彈入新的圖示，文案升起，舊文案離開，文字區塊的高度以彈簧適應內容。圖示區塊在首次出現時僅穩定地進入一次。

trans-unit.source: The call to action, usually a button (or a panel of two).
trans-unit.target: 引導操作，通常為一個按鈕（也可為兩個按鈕的面板）。

trans-unit.source: One or two sentences on why it is empty and what to do next.
trans-unit.target: 說明為何為空以及下一步該做什麼，一到兩句。

trans-unit.source: The icon: a control, or a 24×24 Lucide `Geometry`. Default: Lucide Folder at stroke 1.5.
trans-unit.target: 圖示：一個控制項，或 24×24 的 Lucide `Geometry`。預設為 Lucide Folder，描邊寬度 1.5。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the region.
trans-unit.target: 該區域的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: `Small` is a compact empty state for list panes, side panels and cards: a 32px icon block, 16px above and below, and tighter gaps, whatever the window width. Medium (default) and Large are Arc's layout, whose vertical padding follows the window.
trans-unit.target: `Small` 是用於清單欄、側邊面板與卡片的精簡空狀態：32px 的圖示區塊，上下各 16px，間距較緊湊，與視窗寬度無關。Medium（預設）與 Large 是 Arc 的版面，其上下內距會隨視窗變化。

trans-unit.source: The headline (a heading, level 3).
trans-unit.target: 標題（三級標題）。

trans-unit.source: Four empty states in one illustration whose shapes morph between scenes as you switch tabs. Each `EmptyStatesItem` is a tab with a scene (no results, offline, caught up, not found) and its copy; every shape of the drawing travels to its new position, size, radius, rotation and color on a spring, outlines morph point by point and line accents draw in a beat later. The primary action raises `ActionInvoked` (and runs `ActionCommand`); the app does the work and moves `Phase` to Loading and then Done, and the drawing and copy follow. With no items the block shows Arc's four scenes and copy.
trans-unit.target: 同一幅插圖中的四種空狀態，切換標籤時圖形會在各場景之間變形。每個 `EmptyStatesItem` 是一個標籤，包含場景（無結果、離線、已全部處理、未找到）及其文案；圖形中的每個形狀都會以彈簧動畫移動到新的位置、大小、圓角、旋轉角度與顏色，輪廓逐點變形，線條強調則稍後再繪製。主要操作會觸發 `ActionInvoked`（並執行 `ActionCommand`）；應用程式負責處理工作，並將 `Phase` 設為 Loading，接著設為 Done，插圖與文案隨之變化。若沒有任何項目，該區塊會顯示 Arc 的四個場景與文案。

trans-unit.source: Runs when the action is pressed, after `ActionInvoked`; its parameter is the event arguments.
trans-unit.target: 按下操作按鈕時，於 `ActionInvoked` 之後執行；其參數為事件引數。

trans-unit.source: The action of the selected item was pressed (Idle or Done). Do the work and set `Phase`.
trans-unit.target: 所選項目的操作（處於 Idle 或 Done 時）被按下。請執行工作並設定 `Phase`。

trans-unit.source: The tabs, in order. Empty (the default) shows Arc's four scenes with Arc's copy.
trans-unit.target: 標籤，依序排列。為空（預設）時顯示 Arc 的四個場景與文案。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the region.
trans-unit.target: 該區域的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Where the selected item's action stands: Idle, Loading or Done (two way). Switching tabs resets it to Idle.

trans-unit.source: A table card with an AI column (Arc Enrich column, design reference). One prompt runs down every row; each cell shimmers while it works, then settles into a value with its source, or a failure with a retry. The top bar holds the table's name, the row count and the column button (Run column, Stop, Re-run); the AI column's header shows its name over its prompt with an edit control that opens an editor; the footer names the model and counts the results. Give it `Rows` and an `Enrich` delegate that fills one cell: it gets the row and an `EnrichColumnContext` (the prompt, a cancellation token, the attempt and `SetActivity` for the shimmering label) and returns the value and its source, or throws to fail the cell with the exception's message. At most `Concurrency` cells run at once and the workers start 140ms apart so the column fills top to bottom. Persist values from `CellChanged` and feed them back through `InitialCells`. With no rows of its own the column plays its `Simulation`, a table you supply, and nothing is sent; with neither it shows the empty frame (no rows, Run column unavailable). The rows are a virtualizing list: give the control a height (or a `MaxHeight`) for long tables and only the rows on screen are built; without one every row shows. Below 560px wide the domain, the source text and the model detail fold away; below 440px the gutters tighten, values wrap to two lines and failure reasons hide behind "Failed".
trans-unit.target: 帶一欄 AI 欄的表格卡片（Arc Enrich column，設計參考）。同一個提示詞逐列執行；每個儲存格在處理時顯示微光，隨後落定為附來源的值，或顯示可重試的失敗。頂列包含表格名稱、列數和欄位按鈕（Run column、Stop、Re-run）；AI 欄的表頭在欄名下方顯示提示詞，並附有開啟編輯器的編輯控制項；頁尾顯示模型並統計結果。提供 `Rows` 和一個填入儲存格的 `Enrich` 委派：它收到資料列和一個 `EnrichColumnContext`（提示詞、取消權杖、嘗試次數，以及設定微光標籤的 `SetActivity`），傳回值及其來源，或擲出例外，以例外訊息把儲存格標為失敗。同時最多執行 `Concurrency` 個儲存格，各工作者相隔 140ms 啟動，讓這一欄由上到下依序填入。在 `CellChanged` 中儲存值，並透過 `InitialCells` 傳回。這一欄自己沒有資料列時，會播放它的 `Simulation`（由你提供的表格），不傳送任何內容；兩者都沒有時顯示空框架（沒有資料列，Run column 無法使用）。資料列是虛擬化清單：長表格請為控制項設定高度（或 `MaxHeight`），只會建立畫面上的資料列；未設定時顯示全部資料列。寬度小於 560px 時，網域、來源文字和模型說明收起；小於 440px 時，左右留白收緊，值換成兩行，失敗原因隱藏在「Failed」後面。

trans-unit.source: Runs the column once when it first scrolls into view, if no cell has a value yet. Null (the default) means on while the `Simulation` plays and off with your own `Enrich`.
trans-unit.target: 在這一欄第一次捲入檢視區時執行一次，前提是尚未有任何儲存格有值。為 null（預設）時，播放 `Simulation` 期間開啟，使用你自己的 `Enrich` 則關閉。

trans-unit.source: Raised whenever a cell changes state (queued, running, done, failed). Use it to persist values. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 每當儲存格狀態變化（排隊、執行、完成、失敗）時觸發。用它儲存值。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The AI column's name and prompt (two-way). The person can edit both from the column header; saving re-runs every row. Null shows the simulation's column while it plays, and an unnamed column otherwise.
trans-unit.target: AI 欄的名稱和提示詞（雙向）。使用者可以在欄標題中編輯兩者；儲存後會重新執行每一列。為 null 時，播放模擬期間顯示模擬的欄，否則顯示一個未命名的欄。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person saves an edited column (the column then re-runs). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 使用者儲存編輯後的欄位時觸發（隨後這一欄會重新執行）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: How many cells run at once. Workers start 140ms apart so the column fills top to bottom.
trans-unit.target: 同時執行的儲存格數。各工作者相隔 140ms 啟動，讓這一欄由上到下依序填入。

trans-unit.source: Fills one cell: it gets the row and its context (prompt, column, cancellation token, attempt, `SetActivity`) and returns the value with its source. Throw to mark the cell failed with the exception's message. Null plays the `Simulation`'s answers while its rows are shown; with rows of your own and no delegate nothing runs.
trans-unit.target: 填入一個儲存格：它收到資料列及其內容物件（提示詞、欄位定義、取消權杖、嘗試次數、`SetActivity`），傳回值及其來源。擲出例外即以例外訊息把儲存格標為失敗。為 null 時，顯示 `Simulation` 的資料列期間播放它的答案；使用你自己的資料列而沒有委派時不執行任何內容。

trans-unit.source: Values you already have, keyed by row id, such as cells saved from an earlier run.
trans-unit.target: 已有的值，依資料列 id 索引，例如上一次執行儲存下來的儲存格。

trans-unit.source: Shows the edit control on the AI column's header.
trans-unit.target: 在 AI 欄的表頭上顯示編輯控制項。

trans-unit.source: Whether any cell is queued or running.
trans-unit.target: 是否有儲存格正在排隊或執行。

trans-unit.source: Every word the column shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 這一欄顯示或朗讀的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: The model shown in the footer. Null shows the simulation's model while it plays, and hides it otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 頁尾中顯示的模型。為 null 時，播放模擬期間顯示模擬的模型，否則隱藏。

trans-unit.source: A short note after the row count. Null shows "sample data" while the simulation plays and nothing otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 列數後面的簡短備註。為 null 時，播放模擬期間顯示「sample data」，否則不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The rows to enrich. Null shows the `Simulation`'s rows, or no rows without one.
trans-unit.target: 要補全的資料列。為 null 時顯示 `Simulation` 的資料列，沒有模擬時不顯示任何資料列。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a run settles (finished or stopped), with every cell. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 一次執行落定（完成或停止）時觸發，並附上所有儲存格。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The table the column plays on its own while `Rows` is null: your name, column, model, rows and the answer each row settles into, run exactly like your own delegate would (queued, shimmering, settled, a failure to retry). Null shows the empty frame instead.
trans-unit.target: `Rows` 為 null 時這一欄自行播放的表格：你的名稱、欄、模型、資料列以及每一列最後得到的答案，執行方式與你自己的委派完全相同（排隊、微光、落定、可重試的失敗）。為 null 時改為顯示空框架。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person opens a value's source. Set Handled to open it yourself; otherwise the system opens the address. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 使用者開啟某個值的來源時觸發。設定 Handled 即可自行開啟；否則由系統開啟該網址。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The table's name in the top bar. Null shows the simulation's name while it plays.
trans-unit.target: 頂列中的表格名稱。為 null 時，播放模擬期間顯示模擬的名稱。

trans-unit.source: One cell of the AI column: its status and, once settled, its value and source or the reason it failed. Immutable; the column hands out a new cell on every change.
trans-unit.target: AI 欄的一個儲存格：它的狀態，以及落定後的值和來源或失敗原因。不可變；每次變化時這一欄都會給出一個新的儲存格。

trans-unit.source: What the enrich delegate gets with each row: the column and its prompt, a cancellation token that fires when the person stops the run or the column is re-run, the attempt number and `SetActivity` for the shimmering label.
trans-unit.target: 補全委派隨每一列收到的內容：欄位定義及其提示詞、在使用者停止執行或重新執行整欄時觸發的取消權杖、嘗試次數，以及設定微光標籤的 `SetActivity`。

trans-unit.source: The AI column: its name in the header and the prompt that runs down every row.
trans-unit.target: AI 欄：表頭中的名稱，以及逐列執行的提示詞。

trans-unit.source: Every word `EnrichColumn` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; counts and names are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `EnrichColumn` 顯示或朗讀的每個詞語，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；數量和名稱是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: The model shown in the footer of an `EnrichColumn`.
trans-unit.target: `EnrichColumn` 頁尾中顯示的模型。

trans-unit.source: What the enrich delegate returns for one row: the value and, optionally, its source.
trans-unit.target: 補全委派為一列傳回的結果：值，以及選用的來源。

trans-unit.source: One row of an `EnrichColumn`: the record the prompt runs on (a company, a lead, a ticket).
trans-unit.target: `EnrichColumn` 的一列：提示詞所作用的紀錄（一家公司、一筆潛在客戶、一張工單）。

trans-unit.source: A table an `EnrichColumn` plays on its own while the app sets no `Rows`: a name, the AI column, the model in the footer, the rows and, for each row, the answer a simulated run settles into. When the column runs (on its own the first time it comes into view, or from Run column), each cell waits through its answer's `Steps`, showing their activities, then shows the value and its source. An answer with an `Error` fails on its first attempt, so the failed state and Retry show. Nothing is sent, and the top bar says the data is a sample. Set the data before handing the simulation to the column; to show another table, give the column a new simulation.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式沒有設定 `Rows` 時 `EnrichColumn` 自行播放的表格：名稱、AI 欄、頁尾中的模型、資料列，以及每一列模擬執行後得到的答案。這一欄執行時（第一次進入檢視區時自動執行，或透過 Run column），每個儲存格依序經過其答案的 `Steps` 並顯示它們的活動，然後顯示值及其來源。帶有 `Error` 的答案在第一次嘗試時失敗，因而顯示失敗狀態和重試。不會傳送任何內容，頂列會說明這是範例資料。請在把模擬交給這一欄之前設定好資料；要顯示另一張表格，就給這一欄一個新的模擬。

trans-unit.source: What one row of an `EnrichColumnSimulation` settles into, and how it gets there.
trans-unit.target: `EnrichColumnSimulation` 中一列最後得到的結果，以及得到它的過程。

trans-unit.source: One stage of a simulated cell of an `EnrichColumn`: the shimmering activity and how long it lasts.
trans-unit.target: `EnrichColumn` 模擬儲存格的一個階段：顯示微光的活動以及它持續的時間。

trans-unit.source: Where a value came from: a short label and the address it opens.
trans-unit.target: 值的出處：一個簡短的標籤和它開啟的網址。

trans-unit.source: Asks the Foundation generator (shipped with TKCode.Arc.Foundation) to describe an enum at compile time: its members in declaration order, their values, the `[Description]` or `[Display(Name)]` text and whether it is `[Flags]`. The description is registered with `EnumTypes` when the assembly loads, so an `EnumSelector` lists the enum without reflection (AOT and trimming safe).
trans-unit.target: 請 Foundation 產生器（隨 TKCode.Arc.Foundation 發佈）在編譯期描述一個列舉：依宣告順序的成員、它們的值、`[Description]` 或 `[Display(Name)]` 文字，以及是否帶 `[Flags]`。描述在組件載入時註冊到 `EnumTypes`，因此 `EnumSelector` 不需反射即可列出該列舉（相容 AOT 與修剪）。

trans-unit.source: Lists the members of an enum as choices: a `RadioGroup` for a plain enum, and `Checkbox`es for a `[Flags]` enum, whose checked members are combined bit by bit (checking a composite member checks its parts, a member whose bits are only partly set shows the dash, and a zero member such as `None` clears the rest). The members, their `[Description]` texts and the `[Flags]` marker come from code the generator writes for enums marked `EnumMetadataAttribute`, so nothing is reflected (AOT and trimming safe). `SelectedEnum` (two-way) is the value; the options are laid out in `Rows` and `Columns`, or in a panel of your own (`ItemsPanel`).
trans-unit.target: 把列舉的成員列為選項：一般列舉顯示為 `RadioGroup`，`[Flags]` 列舉顯示為 `Checkbox`，勾選的成員按位元組合（勾選組合成員會勾選其組成部分，位元只設定了一部分的成員顯示短橫，`None` 這樣的零值成員會清除其餘選項）。成員、它們的 `[Description]` 文字和 `[Flags]` 標記來自產生器為標記了 `EnumMetadataAttribute` 的列舉產生的程式碼，因此不使用反射（相容 AOT 與修剪）。`SelectedEnum`（雙向）是值；選項依 `Rows` 和 `Columns` 排列，或放在自訂的面板（`ItemsPanel`）中。

trans-unit.source: Gap between columns of the default grid (16 by default).
trans-unit.target: 預設格線的欄間距（預設 16）。

trans-unit.source: Columns of the default grid; 0 computes them from `Rows`. With both 0 the options are one column.
trans-unit.target: 預設格線的欄數；0 表示依 `Rows` 計算。兩者都為 0 時選項排成一欄。

trans-unit.source: Radio options or checkboxes; `Auto` picks by `HasFlags`.
trans-unit.target: 單選項或核取方塊；`Auto` 依 `HasFlags` 選擇。

trans-unit.source: The mode in use: `DisplayMode` with `Auto` resolved.
trans-unit.target: 實際使用的模式：解析了 `Auto` 之後的 `DisplayMode`。

trans-unit.source: The enum to list. When null, the type of `SelectedEnum` is used. The enum must be marked `EnumMetadataAttribute` (or registered with `EnumTypes`); otherwise no option is shown.
trans-unit.target: 要列出的列舉。為 null 時使用 `SelectedEnum` 的型別。列舉必須標記 `EnumMetadataAttribute`（或註冊到 `EnumTypes`），否則不顯示任何選項。

trans-unit.source: Whether the listed enum is marked `[Flags]`.
trans-unit.target: 列出的列舉是否標記了 `[Flags]`。

trans-unit.source: The legend above the options; a string is also the group's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 選項上方的圖例；字串同時作為群組的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The label of each option; it receives an `EnumSelectorItem`. Null shows its `Text`.
trans-unit.target: 每個選項的標籤；它接收一個 `EnumSelectorItem`。為 null 時顯示其 `Text`。

trans-unit.source: The options shown, one per listed member, in declaration order.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的選項，每個列出的成員一個，依宣告順序。

trans-unit.source: A panel of your own for the options (for example a `WrapPanel`); null uses a uniform grid of `Rows` by `Columns`.
trans-unit.target: 自訂的選項面板（例如 `WrapPanel`）；為 null 時使用 `Rows` × `Columns` 的均勻格線。

trans-unit.source: Gap between rows of the default grid; 8 for radio options and 0 for checkboxes by default.
trans-unit.target: 預設格線的列間距；預設單選項為 8，核取方塊為 0。

trans-unit.source: Rows of the default grid; 0 computes them from `Columns`.
trans-unit.target: 預設格線的列數；0 表示依 `Columns` 計算。

trans-unit.source: The selected value (two-way): a member, a combination of members of a `[Flags]` enum, or null for none.
trans-unit.target: 選取的值（雙向）：一個成員、`[Flags]` 列舉的成員組合，或表示未選取的 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SelectedEnum` changes, by the person or by code.
trans-unit.target: `SelectedEnum` 變化時觸發，無論由使用者還是程式碼引起。

trans-unit.source: Show each member's localized text or `[Description]` (true, the default), or its name in code.
trans-unit.target: 顯示每個成員的在地化文字或 `[Description]`（true，預設），或顯示其程式碼中的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SelectedEnumChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `SelectedEnumChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: How an `EnumSelector` presents its options.
trans-unit.target: `EnumSelector` 如何呈現它的選項。

trans-unit.source: One option of an `EnumSelector`: an enum member and the text it shows. It is the data an `ItemTemplate` receives (bind to `Text`, or to `Member` for the rest).
trans-unit.target: `EnumSelector` 的一個選項：一個列舉成員及其顯示的文字。它是 `ItemTemplate` 接收的資料（繫結 `Text`，其他資訊繫結 `Member`）。

trans-unit.source: The text shown for the member: its localized text, `[Description]` or name, as `UseDisplayNames` says.
trans-unit.target: 成員顯示的文字：依 `UseDisplayNames` 的設定，為在地化文字、`[Description]` 或名稱。

trans-unit.source: The enums controls can describe without reflection. Enums marked `EnumMetadataAttribute` register themselves when their assembly loads (generated code); others can be registered in code with `Register`. A registration made later replaces an earlier one for the same type.
trans-unit.target: 控制項不需反射即可描述的列舉。標記了 `EnumMetadataAttribute` 的列舉在組件載入時自動註冊（產生的程式碼）；其他列舉可以在程式碼中用 `Register` 註冊。同一型別後註冊的會取代先註冊的。

trans-unit.source: An environment of `EnvVariables`: a column of the matrix and a choice in the pills and selects.
trans-unit.target: `EnvVariables` 的一個環境：矩陣中的一欄，也是膠囊與下拉選單中的一個選項。

trans-unit.source: The stable identifier that `Environments` refers to ("production").
trans-unit.target: `Environments` 所參照的穩定識別碼（"production"）。

trans-unit.source: The name people read ("Production").
trans-unit.target: 供人閱讀的名稱（"Production"）。

trans-unit.source: What a redeploy covers, handed to `RedeployAction` and the redeploy events.
trans-unit.target: 一次重新部署所涵蓋的內容，會傳給 `RedeployAction` 與重新部署相關事件。

trans-unit.source: One row of `EnvVariables`: a value and the environments it applies to. A key can have several rows (one value for development and staging, another for production), but each environment is covered by at most one row of a key. The value stays out of the visual tree until someone reveals it; a sensitive value is never shown.

Every number derives from `Cases`, `Results` and the two version ids. Without `RunCaseAsync` a run is simulated from `EvalSuiteSamples`; with it, your code runs each case on each version and returns an `EvalResult` (build it with `Grade` to apply the case's check). trans-unit.source: Arc expandable card: a summary card whose header opens a details panel below it. Opening is one morph: width and height grow on the same smooth spring (real size, never a scale, so text and corners never stretch) and the chevron turns with it; the details fade in once the box has made room, and on close they fade first and the box follows 60ms later. A second click mid-flight reverses from the current size and velocity. The summary line rolls only the words that changed. Escape closes the card from anywhere inside it and returns focus to the header.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可展開卡片：摘要卡片，其標題可在下方開啟詳細資料面板。展開為一次連續的形變：寬度與高度沿同一平滑彈簧同時增長（使用真實尺寸而非縮放，因此文字與圓角不會變形），箭頭隨之轉動；詳細資料在方塊騰出空間後淡入，收合時則先淡出，方塊再延遲 60ms 收攏。飛行途中再次按一下會從當前尺寸與速度反向運動。摘要列只滾動變化的詞語。Escape 可在卡片內任何位置將其關閉，並把焦點交回標題。

trans-unit.source: Arc expandable text: long text clamped to `Lines` lines with a soft fade over the last one. Read more opens it to its full height with a calm ease out (500–600ms, growing with the distance) and Show less closes it (400–450ms); the height, the fade and the chevron follow one progress value, so they always move in step, and a click mid-flight reverses from the current height. The toggle only appears when the text really overflows, and stays correct as the width or font changes. While collapsed the text is laid out only past the clamp, so a very long text costs as much as a short one. The whole text is always available to assistive technology. For selectable or rich content, use `ExpandableContent`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可展開文字：過長的文字被截斷為 `Lines` 行，末行帶柔和的漸隱效果。「閱讀更多」會以平緩的 ease out 緩動（500–600ms，隨距離增加）展開至完整高度，「收合」則以 400–450ms 收攏；高度、漸隱與箭頭共用同一進度值，因此始終同步移動，動畫途中點選會從目前高度反向。僅當文字確實溢出時才顯示切換按鈕，並在寬度或字型變化時保持正確。摺疊時文字只排版到截斷線之後，因此很長的文字與短文字的開銷相同。完整文字始終可供輔助技術使用。需要可選取或豐富內容時，請使用 `ExpandableContent`。

trans-unit.source: Rich text with runs and inline links (`InlineUIContainer`); used instead of `Text` when set.
trans-unit.target: 富文字，包含多段文字與行內連結（`InlineUIContainer`）；設定後取代 `Text` 使用。

trans-unit.source: The text (paragraphs separated by line breaks).
trans-unit.target: 文字內容（段落以換行分隔）。

trans-unit.source: A compact pill of icon buttons for 3 to 6 related actions (message, file and card actions). One action always shows its label; the one you point at or focus takes it over while its neighbours slide aside (width springs inside one row, P5), and an action can confirm in place: the icon draws a check and the label becomes a past tense word (P2, P15). On touch the first tap reveals the label and a second tap runs the action. One Tab stop; arrow keys move and wrap, Home and End jump, Enter and Space run.
trans-unit.target: 緊湊的膠囊形圖示按鈕組，用於 3 至 6 個相關操作（訊息、檔案與卡片操作）。始終有一個操作顯示其標籤；滑鼠指向或取得焦點的操作會接管標籤，相鄰項目同時滑開（寬度在同一列內以彈簧變化，P5）。操作可原地確認：圖示變為勾選，標籤變為過去式詞語（P2、P15）。觸控螢幕上，第一次點按顯示標籤，第二次點按執行操作。整組只佔用一個 Tab 焦點；方向鍵移動並循環，Home 與 End 跳轉，Enter 與空白鍵執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised whenever an action runs, before its own `AsyncAction`.
trans-unit.target: 每次操作執行時觸發，早於其自身的 `AsyncAction`。

trans-unit.source: How long a confirmation stays (default 1.4s).
trans-unit.target: 確認狀態保持的時長（預設 1.4s）。

trans-unit.source: The action (item or its container) whose label shows at rest; null uses the first enabled action.
trans-unit.target: 靜止時顯示標籤的操作（項目或其容器）；為 null 時使用第一個啟用的操作。

trans-unit.source: The action currently showing its label.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示標籤的操作。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the toolbar, such as "Message actions".
trans-unit.target: 工具列的無障礙名稱，例如「訊息操作」。

trans-unit.source: Small (28px, 14px icons) or Medium (36px, 16px icons; default). Large is treated as Medium.
trans-unit.target: Small（28px，圖示 14px）或 Medium（36px，圖示 16px；預設）。Large 按 Medium 處理。

trans-unit.source: One action of an `ExpandingButtonGroup`: an icon that grows to reveal its label. The width rides the morph spring between the icon and the icon plus the longer of `Label` and `DoneLabel`; the label slides out from behind the icon and tucks back faster. Code-driven because the reveal is asymmetric (240ms with a delay in, 120ms out) and blurs, which a ControlTheme transition cannot express.
trans-unit.target: `ExpandingButtonGroup` 的一個操作：圖示會展開以顯示標籤。寬度沿形變彈簧在圖示與「圖示加上 `Label` 與 `DoneLabel` 中較長者」之間變化；標籤從圖示後滑出，收回時更快。由程式碼驅動，因為展開與收合不對稱（展開 240ms 並帶延遲，收合 120ms）且帶模糊效果，ControlTheme 過渡無法表達。

trans-unit.source: Runs the action. The button is busy until the task completes; returning false, or throwing, skips the confirmation. Without it, `Click` and `Command` count as success.
trans-unit.target: 執行該操作。任務完成前按鈕處於忙碌狀態；回傳 false 或擲出例外則略過確認。未設定時，`Click` 與 `Command` 視為成功。

trans-unit.target: 操作執行後原位顯示的過去式詞語（如「已封存」）；開啟內容的操作請省略。

trans-unit.source: Arc expanding search: a search that waits as an icon button until it is needed (headers, toolbars). The button morphs into the field on the morph spring (its corners follow the width, from a circle to the control radius), results unfold beneath it in groups with the match in medium weight, and a highlight glides between them on the snappy spring. ArrowUp / ArrowDown move (wrapping), Enter chooses, Escape folds it back into the icon; leaving an empty field folds it too. Before anything is typed it shows `Suggestions`. Place it in the lane the field may grow into: it fills that lane's width and keeps the button on the `Anchor` edge; the field never grows past `ExpandedWidth` or the lane.
trans-unit.target: Arc 展開式搜尋：平時以圖示按鈕形式出現，需要時才展開（用於標題列、工具列）。按鈕沿形變彈簧變形為欄位（圓角隨寬度變化，從圓形過渡到控制項圓角），結果在其下方依群組展開，符合的部分以中等字重顯示，醒目提示沿靈敏彈簧在各結果之間滑動。ArrowUp / ArrowDown 移動（循環），Enter 選取，Escape 將其收回為圖示；欄位為空時離開也會收回。尚未輸入任何內容時顯示 `Suggestions`。請將其放在欄位可以擴展的區域內：它會填滿該區域的寬度，並把按鈕保持在 `Anchor` 所在的邊緣；欄位的寬度永遠不會超過 `ExpandedWidth` 或該區域。

trans-unit.source: The edge the button sits on. Default End.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕所在的邊緣。預設為 End。

trans-unit.source: A scroll-driven teardown of a screen: a stack of equally sized layers, one picture per layer, that tips back and turns as you scroll, separates in depth while a label draws in beside each layer, focuses the layers one at a time (the others dim, the focused one takes the accent and the caption below changes), then closes and stands up again as one screen. A row of stop buttons jumps to the whole screen, each layer and the screen put back together. Use it on a launch or marketing page to show how an interface, a design system or a device is built.
trans-unit.target: 對畫面進行的捲動驅動拆解動畫：一疊等大小的圖層，每層一張圖片，隨捲動向後傾斜並旋轉，依深度分開，同時在旁繪製每層的標籤，逐一聚焦圖層（其他圖層變暗，聚焦的圖層採用強調色，下方說明隨之變化），然後收合並整體重新站立為一個畫面。一排停止按鈕可跳轉到完整畫面、每個圖層，以及重新組合後的畫面。適用於啟動頁或行銷頁面，展示介面、設計系統或裝置的構成。

trans-unit.source: The feedback control of an AI reply (Arc Response feedback, design reference), for your own message rows: thumbs up and down after any `Leading` actions and `Trailing` content pinned to the end of the row. Thumbs down opens an inline panel with reason chips and an optional note; thumbs up fills and asks what was good; a submit shows a short thank-you before the panel folds back into the row. Pressing the active thumb clears the rating. Every thumb press sends a `Rating` submission and the panel sends a `Details` one, through `FeedbackHandler` (a task that throws shows the inline error and Try again; its cancellation token fires when the panel closes or the rating changes) and `FeedbackSubmitted`. Without a handler the sends are simulated and the control says so.
trans-unit.target: AI 回覆的意見回饋控制項（Arc Response feedback，設計參考），用於你自己的訊息列：在任何 `Leading` 操作之後是讚與倒讚，`Trailing` 內容固定在列尾。按倒讚會在行內展開一個附原因標籤與可選備註的面板；按讚會填滿圖示並詢問哪裡做得好；送出後顯示簡短的感謝，隨後面板收回到操作列中。再次按下目前啟用的按鈕會清除評分。每次按下讚或倒讚都會傳送一筆 `Rating` 送出，面板會傳送一筆 `Details` 送出，經由 `FeedbackHandler`（擲回例外的工作會顯示行內錯誤與 Try again；面板關閉或評分改變時其取消權杖觸發）與 `FeedbackSubmitted`。沒有處理常式時傳送是模擬的，控制項會如實說明。

trans-unit.source: Shows the optional note field after a thumbs down.

trans-unit.source: Persists feedback: called with a `Rating` submission on every thumb press and a `Details` one when reasons or a note are submitted. Throw (or fault the task) to show the inline error and Try again; the token is cancelled when the panel closes or the rating changes. Null simulates sends.

trans-unit.source: A public board of feature requests: filter by status (under review, planned, in progress, done), sort by top, newest or trending, vote with a count that rolls, open a request to read it and join its comment thread, and suggest a new one from the form under the header. Rows glide to their new places when the order changes. Votes, comments and new requests change the `FeedbackRequest` objects in place and are reported through `VoteChanged`, `RequestSubmitted` and `CommentsChanged`. A board with no requests when it first loads shows a sample.
trans-unit.target: 一個公開的功能請求看板：按狀態（審核中、已計劃、進行中、已完成）篩選，按熱門、最新或趨勢排序，投票時票數滾動，打開請求閱讀並參與評論，並可在標題下方的表單中提出新請求。順序改變時各行會滑到新位置。投票、評論和新請求會直接修改 `FeedbackRequest` 對象，並通過 `VoteChanged`、`RequestSubmitted` 和 `CommentsChanged` 報告。首次加載時沒有請求，會顯示一組示例。

trans-unit.source: Arc's generous target for dropping one or more files: drag files from the system onto it, click (or Enter / Space) to choose from the device, or paste a file while the pointer is over it. Files are checked against `Accept`, `MaxFileSize` and `MaxFiles`; refusals shake the target. The list shows each file with an upload state driven by `UploadHandler` or by the app, with Retry and Remove.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的檔案拖放區，目標區域較大，便於放入一個或多個檔案：可從系統拖入檔案，點選（或按 Enter / 空白鍵）從裝置選擇，或在指標懸停時貼上檔案。檔案會依 `Accept`、`MaxFileSize` 與 `MaxFiles` 檢查；被拒絕時目標區域會抖動。清單顯示每個檔案的上傳狀態（由 `UploadHandler` 或應用程式驅動），並提供重試與移除。

trans-unit.source: Accepted types like an HTML file input: extensions (".pdf") and MIME types ("image/*", "application/pdf"), comma separated.
trans-unit.target: 接受的類型，與 HTML 檔案輸入相同：副檔名（「.pdf」）與 MIME 類型（「image/*」、「application/pdf」），以逗號分隔。

trans-unit.source: Allow several files (default true); a single-file dropzone replaces its file.
trans-unit.target: 是否允許多個檔案（預設 true）；單檔拖放區會取代其檔案。

trans-unit.source: Once the list holds this many files, the prompt folds to a slim bar; a file dragged over brings the icon back.
trans-unit.target: 清單中檔案數達到此數量後，提示會收為細條；拖入檔案時圖示會重新出現。

trans-unit.source: The line under the label (default "Drop files here or choose from your device").
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方的文字（預設「將檔案拖曳到此處，或從裝置中選取」）。

trans-unit.source: The label while files hover over the target (default "Drop to upload" / "Drop to add files").
trans-unit.target: 檔案懸停在目標上時顯示的標籤（預設「放開以上傳」／「放開以新增檔案」）。

trans-unit.source: The refusal shown under the target, or null.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在目標下方的拒絕提示；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the visitor's files change (added or removed; Arc's `onFilesChange`).
trans-unit.target: 訪客的檔案變化（新增或移除）時觸發（Arc 的 `onFilesChange`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when files are refused (type not accepted, or more than `MaxFiles`).
trans-unit.target: 檔案被拒絕時觸發（類型不被接受，或超過 `MaxFiles`）。

trans-unit.source: True while files are dragged over the target.
trans-unit.target: 檔案被拖曳到目標上方時為 true。

trans-unit.source: The target's label (default "Add files").
trans-unit.target: 目標的標籤（預設「新增檔案」）。

trans-unit.source: List the files under the target (default) or inside its edge.
trans-unit.target: 檔案清單顯示在目標下方（預設）或目標邊緣之內。

trans-unit.source: Files above this many bytes fail with a size reason and never upload.
trans-unit.target: 超過此位元組數的檔案會因大小原因失敗，且永遠不會上傳。

trans-unit.source: The most files the list holds (default 5).
trans-unit.target: 清單最多可容納的檔案數（預設 5）。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the small line under the description (default: the accepted types, or the file limit).
trans-unit.target: 取代描述下方的小字列（預設：接受的類型，或檔案數量上限）。

trans-unit.source: Uploads each added file: report 0–100 through the progress, complete the task when it lands, throw to fail it (the message becomes the reason). Removing the row cancels the token.
trans-unit.target: 上傳每個新增的檔案：透過進度回報 0–100，檔案上傳完成時完成任務，擲出例外則任務失敗（例外訊息將作為原因顯示）。移除該列會取消權杖。

trans-unit.source: One row of a `FileDropzone`. Every property notifies, so an app can drive an upload itself by setting `Status` and `Progress` (or through `ReportProgress` and friends).
trans-unit.target: `FileDropzone` 的一列。每個屬性都會發出通知，因此應用程式可透過設定 `Status` 與 `Progress`（或透過 `ReportProgress` 等方法）自行驅動上傳。

trans-unit.source: Raised when any property of this row changes.
trans-unit.target: 此列的任一屬性變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: A complete file selection flow: a dropzone that takes dropped files or opens the file picker, validation of type (`Accept`) and size (`MaxSize`), one upload per accepted file through `Uploader` with a progress bar and a counted percentage, and Retry and Remove on every row. Rejected files stay listed with their error; removing a file cancels its upload. A polite status line says what was added, rejected, uploaded, failed or removed.
trans-unit.target: 完整的檔案選取流程：拖放區接受拖入的檔案或開啟檔案選取器，依類型（`Accept`）與大小（`MaxSize`）驗證，每個被接受的檔案透過 `Uploader` 上傳一次並顯示進度條與計數百分比，每一列都有重試與移除。被拒絕的檔案連同錯誤留在清單中；移除檔案會取消其上傳。禮貌模式的狀態列會說明新增、拒絕、上傳完成、上傳失敗或移除了什麼。

trans-unit.source: Accepted types, comma separated: extensions (".pdf"), MIME types ("application/zip") and wildcards ("image/*"). Rejected files stay listed with an error. Empty accepts everything.
trans-unit.target: 接受的類型，以逗號分隔：副檔名（".pdf"）、MIME 類型（"application/zip"）與萬用字元（"image/*"）。被拒絕的檔案連同錯誤留在清單中。為空時接受所有檔案。

trans-unit.source: The text at the dropzone's end.
trans-unit.target: 拖放區末端的文字。

trans-unit.source: The dropzone's help text; it also describes the dropzone to screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 拖放區的說明文字；它也會向螢幕閱讀器描述拖放區。

trans-unit.source: The file list, newest last. Two-way: the control replaces it when files are added or removed.
trans-unit.target: 檔案清單，最新的在最後。雙向：新增或移除檔案時控制項會取代它。

trans-unit.source: Raised after files were added or removed, with the new list.
trans-unit.target: 新增或移除檔案後引發，帶有新清單。

trans-unit.source: True while files are dragged over the dropzone.
trans-unit.target: 檔案拖到拖放區上方時為 true。

trans-unit.source: The dropzone's heading.
trans-unit.target: 拖放區的標題。

trans-unit.source: The largest accepted file in bytes; larger files are listed with an error. Null or 0 sets no limit.
trans-unit.target: 允許的最大檔案位元組數；更大的檔案會帶錯誤列出。為 null 或 0 時不限制。

trans-unit.source: Whether several files can be added; when false a new file replaces the list (and cancels running uploads).
trans-unit.target: 是否可以新增多個檔案；為 false 時新檔案取代清單（並取消進行中的上傳）。

trans-unit.source: The last status message ("2 files added.", "report.pdf uploaded."); empty until the first one.
trans-unit.target: 最後一則狀態訊息（"2 files added."、"report.pdf uploaded."）；第一則之前為空。

trans-unit.source: Uploads one accepted file: report 0 to 100 through the progress, return when done, throw to mark the file failed. The token is cancelled when the file is removed or replaced, or the control leaves the tree. Null only lists files.
trans-unit.target: 上傳一個被接受的檔案：透過 progress 回報 0 到 100，完成後返回，擲出例外則把檔案標為失敗。檔案被移除或取代、或控制項離開視覺樹時取消權杖。為 null 時只列出檔案。

trans-unit.source: Carries the file list after files were added or removed.
trans-unit.target: 攜帶新增或移除檔案後的檔案清單。

trans-unit.source: A file in a `FileUpload` list: the picked or dropped file, its name and size, the validation error when it was rejected, and the state of its upload.
trans-unit.target: `FileUpload` 清單中的一個檔案：選取或拖入的檔案、其名稱與大小、被拒絕時的驗證錯誤，以及上傳狀態。

trans-unit.source: Why the file was rejected (wrong type or too large); null for an accepted file.
trans-unit.target: 檔案被拒絕的原因（類型不符或過大）；被接受的檔案為 null。

trans-unit.source: How far the upload got, 0 to 100; it never goes back while the upload runs.
trans-unit.target: 上傳進行到的程度，0 到 100；上傳進行中不會倒退。

trans-unit.source: Where the upload stands.
trans-unit.target: 上傳所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Where a `FileUploadItem`'s upload stands.
trans-unit.target: `FileUploadItem` 的上傳所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Base of the filter boxes (`NumberFilterBox`, `TextFilterBox`): one filter condition laid out as an enable checkbox with the label, an operator `Select` that shows symbols, the value editor and an optional `ExtraContent`. The box only holds the condition; it never filters data. Your view model reads `IsActive`, the operator and the value (or calls the derived `Matches`) and filters on its own terms. Unchecking the box disables the operator, the value and the extra content but keeps them, so checking it again restores the condition.
trans-unit.target: 篩選框的基底類別（`NumberFilterBox`、`TextFilterBox`）：一個篩選條件排成一列，依序是帶標籤的啟用核取方塊、以符號顯示運算子的 `Select`、值編輯器和選用的 `ExtraContent`。篩選框只保存條件，從不過濾資料。檢視模型讀取 `IsActive`、運算子和值（或呼叫衍生類別的 `Matches`），依自己的方式過濾。取消勾選會停用運算子、值和附加內容但保留它們，再次勾選即恢復原條件。

trans-unit.source: Muted hint under the label; collapses when empty.
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方的淡化提示；為空時收合。

trans-unit.source: Content placed after the value editor (a checkbox, a button); disabled with the filter, collapsed when null.
trans-unit.target: 放在值編輯器之後的內容（核取方塊、按鈕）；隨篩選一起停用，為 null 時收合。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the condition changes: `IsActive`, the operator, the value or an option that changes matching.
trans-unit.target: 條件變化後引發：`IsActive`、運算子、值或影響比對的選項。

trans-unit.source: Whether the condition takes part in filtering (two-way, default true). Off keeps the operator and the value.
trans-unit.target: 條件是否參與篩選（雙向，預設 true）。關閉時保留運算子和值。

trans-unit.source: The field name shown beside the checkbox (text or any content); clicking it toggles `IsActive`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在核取方塊旁的欄位名稱（文字或任意內容）；點選它會切換 `IsActive`。

trans-unit.source: Shares the width of the label column with every box (or `Grid` column) of the same group name inside an element with `Grid.IsSharedSizeScope="True"`, so stacked filters line up. A name is letters, digits and underscores and does not start with a digit.
trans-unit.target: 在設定了 `Grid.IsSharedSizeScope="True"` 的元素內，與同群組名稱的每個篩選框（或 `Grid` 欄）共用標籤欄寬度，使疊放的篩選框對齊。群組名稱由字母、數字和底線組成，且不以數字開頭。

trans-unit.source: A fixed width for the label column (default NaN: as wide as the label, or the shared width of `LabelSizeGroup`).
trans-unit.target: 標籤欄的固定寬度（預設 NaN：與標籤同寬，或取 `LabelSizeGroup` 的共用寬度）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the operator field (default "Operator"; read as "Price operator").
trans-unit.target: 運算子欄位的協助工具名稱（預設 "Operator"；讀作 "Price operator"）。

trans-unit.source: Height of the operator and value fields: Small 36, Medium 44 (default), Large 50.
trans-unit.target: 運算子與值輸入框的高度：Small 36、Medium 44（預設）、Large 50。

trans-unit.source: An applied filter shown as a chip: "Label · Value". The id is the field id, so one chip per field.
trans-unit.target: 已套用的篩選條件，以標籤形式顯示：「標籤 · 值」。ID 為欄位 ID，因此每個欄位對應一個標籤。

trans-unit.source: A filterable field of the Add filter menu: pick the field, then one of its options. Its properties can be bound in XAML; an open menu follows later changes. Chips already applied keep the label they were created with.
trans-unit.target: 「新增篩選」選單中的一個可篩選欄位：先選欄位，再選它的一個選項。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結；開啟的選單會跟隨之後的變化。已套用的篩選標籤保留建立時的標籤文字。

trans-unit.source: Optional 24x24 stroked glyph shown before the label.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在標籤前的可選 24x24 描邊圖示。

trans-unit.source: Stable id; also the id of the chip the field produces, so there is one chip per field.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id；也是該欄位產生的篩選標籤的 id，因此每個欄位只有一個標籤。

trans-unit.source: The field's name in the menu and on its chip ("Status").
trans-unit.target: 欄位在選單和篩選標籤上的名稱（「狀態」）。

trans-unit.source: The symbols and spoken names of the filter operators, as a plain lookup (no attributes are reflected, so it is safe for AOT and trimming). The filter boxes show the symbols; use the names for tooltips, summaries or screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 篩選運算子的符號與朗讀名稱，是一張一般的對照表（不反射任何屬性標記，因此相容 AOT 與裁剪）。篩選框顯示符號；名稱可用於工具提示、摘要或螢幕閱讀器。

trans-unit.source: Arc's filter toolbar: keep collection filters close and easy to reset. Applied filters are removable chips ("Status · Open") whose slots open and close on a spring so neighbors slide along, a changed value morphs in place, Clear all appears while any filter is applied, and the Add filter menu picks a field, then a value (one chip per field). An optional search field sits with the actions. `ActiveFilters` is two-way and a mutable list is updated in place; `FiltersChanged` reports every change, and changes are announced.
trans-unit.target: Arc 篩選工具列：讓集合的篩選條件保持在手邊，並易於重設。已套用的篩選為可移除的標籤（「狀態 · 未解決」），其位置以彈簧展開或收合，使相鄰標籤滑動讓位；變化的值會原位形變；只要套用了任一篩選，就會出現「全部清除」；「新增篩選」選單先選取欄位，再選取值（每個欄位一個標籤）。操作按鈕旁可放置選用的搜尋欄位。`ActiveFilters` 為雙向繫結，可變清單會原地更新；`FiltersChanged` 回報每一次變化，並會向輔助技術播報。

trans-unit.source: Extra actions shown beside Add filter (Arc `children`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示在「新增篩選」旁邊的額外操作（Arc 的 `children`）。

trans-unit.source: The applied filters (two-way). A mutable list is updated in place by remove, Clear all and Add filter.
trans-unit.target: 已套用的篩選（雙向繫結）。可變清單會因移除、「全部清除」與「新增篩選」而原地更新。

trans-unit.source: Label of the Add filter button (default Add filter).
trans-unit.target: 「新增篩選」按鈕的標籤（預設 「Add filter」）。

trans-unit.source: Label of the button that removes every applied filter (default Clear all).
trans-unit.target: 移除所有已套用篩選條件之按鈕的標籤（預設 「Clear all」）。

trans-unit.source: Text shown in the toolbar when no filter is applied (default No filters applied).
trans-unit.target: 未套用篩選時工具列中顯示的文字（預設 「No filters applied」）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a filter is added, changed, removed or all are cleared from the toolbar.
trans-unit.target: 在工具列中新增、修改、移除篩選或全部清除之後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Shows a search field with the actions; its text is `SearchText`.
trans-unit.target: 與操作按鈕一同顯示搜尋欄位；其文字為 `SearchText`。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the toolbar group.
trans-unit.target: 工具列群組的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The trigger edge the Add filter panel lines up with.
trans-unit.target: 「新增篩選」面板對齊的觸發邊緣。

trans-unit.source: Placeholder text of the search field (default Search).
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄位的預留位置文字（預設 「Search」）。

trans-unit.source: Text of the search field (two-way). Escape in the field clears it.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄位的文字（雙向繫結）。在搜尋欄位中按 Escape 會將其清空。

trans-unit.source: Separate soft buttons in a quiet tray for floating editors and canvas toolbars (Undo, Redo, Share, Present). One shared highlight (P7 `GlidingIndicator`) morphs in position and size to whichever button the pointer or keyboard focus is on, holds still across gaps and separators, fades when the pointer leaves the tray, and settles darker in place while a button is pressed; the buttons themselves never scale. Icon-only buttons and shortcut hints show the Arc `Tooltip`. One Tab stop; arrow keys move and wrap, Home and End jump, Enter and Space act.
trans-unit.target: 浮動編輯器與畫布工具列使用的獨立柔和按鈕，排列在安靜的托盤中（復原、重做、分享、簡報）。一個共用的醒目提示（P7 `GlidingIndicator`）會在位置與尺寸上形變，移向滑鼠或鍵盤焦點所在的按鈕；經過間隙與分隔符時保持靜止，滑鼠離開托盤時淡出，按下按鈕時原位變暗；按鈕本身從不縮放。僅圖示的按鈕與快速鍵提示會顯示 Arc `Tooltip`。整組只佔用一個 Tab 焦點；方向鍵移動並循環，Home 與 End 跳轉，Enter 與空白鍵執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised after an item's own click handlers and command.
trans-unit.target: 在某項目自身的點按處理常式與命令之後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Shows every item as an icon with its label in a tooltip; items with their own setting win.
trans-unit.target: 將每個項目顯示為圖示，其標籤放在工具提示中；項目自行設定的值優先。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the toolbar, such as "Board actions".
trans-unit.target: 工具列的無障礙名稱，例如「看板操作」。

trans-unit.source: Lays the buttons out in a row (Horizontal, default) or a column (Vertical).
trans-unit.target: 按鈕排列方式：橫向一列（Horizontal，預設）或直向一欄（Vertical）。

trans-unit.source: Small (30px buttons) or Medium (36px, default). Large is treated as Medium.
trans-unit.target: Small（30px 按鈕）或 Medium（36px，預設）。Large 按 Medium 處理。

trans-unit.source: Side of the item tooltips; null uses Top for a row and Right for a column.
trans-unit.target: 各項目工具提示所在的一側；為 null 時，橫列使用 Top，直欄使用 Right。

trans-unit.source: Surface of the tray: Muted (default), or Floating for a raised shadow and hairline edge.
trans-unit.target: 托盤的表面樣式：Muted（預設），或帶有凸起陰影與細邊框的 Floating。

trans-unit.source: A tab list beside one scroll area that holds the content of every tab, stacked in order (scroll-linked tabs, or a scroll spy). Selecting a tab scrolls its section into place; scrolling the content selects the tab of the section that reaches the anchor line (`SnapAlignment`). Use it for settings pages, long forms and documents where the person reads straight through but also jumps between sections. Items are `FluidTabItem` containers written inline, or are generated from `ItemsSource`: `ItemTemplate` renders the tab, `IconTemplate` its icon and `ContentTemplate` its section.
trans-unit.target: 標籤列旁是一個捲動區域，依序堆疊每個標籤的內容（捲動連動標籤頁，即 scroll spy）。選取標籤會把它的區段捲動到位；捲動內容會選取到達錨線（`SnapAlignment`）的區段所對應的標籤。適用於設定頁、長表單與文件：使用者可以一路讀下去，也可以在區段之間跳轉。項目是直接寫入的 `FluidTabItem` 容器，或由 `ItemsSource` 產生：`ItemTemplate` 呈現標籤，`IconTemplate` 呈現圖示，`ContentTemplate` 呈現區段。

trans-unit.source: Length of the smooth scroll to a selected section. Zero jumps.
trans-unit.target: 平滑捲動到選取區段的時長。為零時直接跳轉。

trans-unit.source: Padding around the stacked sections inside the scroll area.
trans-unit.target: 捲動區域內堆疊區段周圍的內距。

trans-unit.source: Template for the section of a data item (the tab uses `ItemTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 資料項目區段的範本（標籤使用 `ItemTemplate`）。

trans-unit.source: Easing of the smooth scroll to a selected section.
trans-unit.target: 平滑捲動到選取區段的緩動函式。

trans-unit.source: Template for the icon of a data item's tab; the item itself is the icon's data. Without it, data items have no icon.
trans-unit.target: 資料項目標籤圖示的範本；資料項目本身就是圖示的資料。未設定時資料項目沒有圖示。

trans-unit.source: Whether selecting a tab scrolls smoothly. When false, or when the motion level is below full, the scroll jumps.
trans-unit.target: 選取標籤時是否平滑捲動。為 false 或動態效果等級低於完整時，直接跳轉。

trans-unit.source: Space between two sections in the scroll area.
trans-unit.target: 捲動區域中兩個區段之間的間距。

trans-unit.source: The line of the scroll area that a selected section scrolls to, and that decides the current section while scrolling.
trans-unit.target: 選取區段要捲動到的那條線，也是捲動時判斷目前區段的那條線。

trans-unit.source: Width of the tab list.
trans-unit.target: 標籤列的寬度。

trans-unit.source: Which side the tab list is on.
trans-unit.target: 標籤列位於哪一側。

trans-unit.source: One tab of a `FluidTabControl`: `Header` (with an optional `Icon`) is shown in the tab list, and `Content` is shown as the tab's section in the control's scroll area, stacked with the sections of the other tabs. Disabled tabs are skipped by the arrow keys and cannot be selected; a hidden tab hides its section too.
trans-unit.target: `FluidTabControl` 的一個標籤：`Header`（以及選用的 `Icon`）顯示在標籤列中，`Content` 作為該標籤的區段顯示在控制項的捲動區域中，與其他標籤的區段依序堆疊。停用的標籤會被方向鍵略過且無法選取；隱藏的標籤也會隱藏它的區段。

trans-unit.source: Optional icon shown before the header in the tab list: a glyph, a control or a value for `IconTemplate`.
trans-unit.target: 在標籤列中顯示於標題之前的選用圖示：字形、控制項，或交給 `IconTemplate` 的值。

trans-unit.source: Template that renders `Icon`.
trans-unit.target: 呈現 `Icon` 的範本。

trans-unit.source: Whether this tab is the selected one.
trans-unit.target: 該標籤是否為選取的標籤。

trans-unit.source: A tapered conversion funnel with the drop-off at each step. Every step is a column with its name, count, retention and drop-off; the band's thickness follows the count. `View` shows the total, a gapped split by segment, or one segment rescaled to the full band, and the band morphs between them on a spring. Dots stream through the band and leave at each step with that step's real drop-off. Below 420 pixels of width the funnel runs top to bottom.
trans-unit.target: 逐級收窄的轉換漏斗，標出每一步的流失。每一步是一欄，顯示名稱、人數、留存率和流失；色帶的粗細跟隨人數。`View` 顯示總計、依區隔拆開並留有間隙的色帶，或重新縮放到整條色帶的單一區隔，色帶在它們之間沿彈簧變形。圓點流過色帶，並在每一步依該步的真實流失離開。寬度低於 420 像素時漏斗由上到下排列。

trans-unit.source: The step being read, or null (two-way). A number outside the stages clears it.
trans-unit.target: 正在讀取的步驟，或 null（雙向）。超出階段範圍的數字會清除它。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the step being read changes.
trans-unit.target: 正在讀取的步驟變更時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Thickness of the band at the first step when it runs left to right (default 200).
trans-unit.target: 由左到右排列時色帶在第一步的粗細（預設 200）。

trans-unit.source: Message shown when the first step of the current view is zero or there are no stages (default "No data").
trans-unit.target: 目前檢視的第一步為零或沒有階段時顯示的訊息（預設 "No data"）。

trans-unit.source: Streams dots through the band; they leave at each step with its real drop-off. Off under reduced motion (default true).
trans-unit.target: 讓圓點流過色帶；它們在每一步依真實流失離開。減少動態效果時關閉（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: What the funnel measures, such as "Signups in March"; names the chart for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 漏斗衡量的內容，例如 "Signups in March"；也是輔助科技讀到的圖表名稱。

trans-unit.source: Which way the funnel runs; `Auto` (default) goes top to bottom below 420 pixels of width.
trans-unit.target: 漏斗的排列方向；`Auto`（預設）在寬度低於 420 像素時由上到下。

trans-unit.source: Optional parts of the audience; each stage then lists one count per segment in `Values`.
trans-unit.target: 選用的受眾區隔；此時每個階段在 `Values` 中為每個區隔列出一個數字。

trans-unit.source: The steps from first to last. Inline in XAML, or assign any list; replace or change the list to update the chart.
trans-unit.target: 從第一步到最後一步的步驟。可在 XAML 中內嵌撰寫，或指派任意清單；取代或變更清單即可更新圖表。

trans-unit.source: Unit after each count, such as "users" (default: none).
trans-unit.target: 每個人數後的單位，例如 "users"（預設無）。

trans-unit.source: Formats counts (default: grouped, one decimal at most, then `Unit`).
trans-unit.target: 格式化人數（預設：千分位分組，最多一位小數，後接 `Unit`）。

trans-unit.source: `total` (default), `split` for a gapped band per segment, or a segment key that isolates and rescales that segment. Unknown names show the total.
trans-unit.target: `total`（預設）、`split`（每個區隔一條帶間隙的色帶），或單獨顯示並重新縮放某區隔的區隔鍵。未知名稱顯示總計。

trans-unit.source: One part of the audience that a `FunnelChart` can split or isolate.
trans-unit.target: `FunnelChart` 可以拆分或單獨顯示的一部分受眾。

trans-unit.source: One step of a `FunnelChart`.
trans-unit.target: `FunnelChart` 的一個步驟。

trans-unit.source: One customer account of a `CustomerGalaxy`: a dot whose area follows `Mrr` and whose color follows `Health`. The values the groupings read (plan, region, industry …) go into `Groups` under the grouping's `Key`.
trans-unit.target: `CustomerGalaxy` 的一個客戶帳戶：一個圓點，其面積隨 `Mrr` 變化，顏色隨 `Health` 變化。分組所讀取的值（方案、地區、產業等）放入 `Groups` 中，以分組的 `Key` 為鍵。

trans-unit.source: The `Key` of the account's health; it picks the dot color.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶健康度的 `Key`；它決定圓點的顏色。

trans-unit.source: Stable id (selection and incremental updates match accounts by it); the name is used when it is empty.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 ID（選取與增量更新依此比對帳戶）；ID 為空時使用名稱。

trans-unit.source: Monthly recurring revenue; the dot's area grows with it and every total adds it up.
trans-unit.target: 月度經常性收入；圓點面積隨之增長，且每個總計都會加總它。

trans-unit.source: The account's name, shown at the top of its card and announced when it is selected.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶名稱，顯示在其卡片頂部，並在被選取時播報。

trans-unit.source: One short line about the account, shown at the bottom of its card ("Renewal call booked").
trans-unit.target: 關於帳戶的一行簡短說明，顯示在其卡片底部（"Renewal call booked"）。

trans-unit.source: Who owns the account ("Self-serve" for accounts without one); shown on the card.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶的負責人（無負責人的帳戶為 "Self-serve"）；顯示在卡片上。

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back from `AccountSelected`.
trans-unit.target: 任何你希望從 `AccountSelected` 取回的值。

trans-unit.source: One cluster of a `GalaxyGrouping`: the account value it collects and the label it shows.
trans-unit.target: `GalaxyGrouping` 的一個叢集：它收集的帳戶值以及它顯示的標籤。

trans-unit.source: The `Groups` value of the accounts in this cluster ("business").
trans-unit.target: 此叢集中帳戶的 `Groups` 值（"business"）。

trans-unit.source: The label above the cluster and in the totals list ("Business"); `Key` when null.
trans-unit.target: 叢集上方以及合計列表中的標籤（"Business"）；為 null 時使用 `Key`。

trans-unit.source: One way to group the accounts of a `CustomerGalaxy` into clusters (a tab of its grouping switch): the accounts' `Groups` value under `Key` picks their cluster. The key `HealthKey` groups by `Health` and takes its clusters from `HealthStates`.
trans-unit.target: 將 `CustomerGalaxy` 的帳戶分組為叢集的一種方式（即其分組切換的一個頁籤）：帳戶在 `Key` 下的 `Groups` 值決定其所屬叢集。鍵 `HealthKey` 依 `Health` 分組，並從 `HealthStates` 取得叢集。

trans-unit.source: The tab text ("Plan"); `Key` when null.
trans-unit.target: 頁籤文字（"Plan"）；為 null 時使用 `Key`。

trans-unit.source: The `Groups` key this grouping reads ("plan", "region"), or `HealthKey`.
trans-unit.target: 此分組讀取的 `Groups` 鍵（"plan"、"region"），或 `HealthKey`。

trans-unit.source: The title of the totals list while this grouping is shown ("By plan"); built from `ListTitleFormat` when null.
trans-unit.target: 顯示此分組時合計列表的標題（"By plan"）；為 null 時由 `ListTitleFormat` 產生。

trans-unit.source: A health state of a `CustomerGalaxy`: its key, legend label and color, how strongly its dots are drawn, and whether it counts as growth or risk in the totals.
trans-unit.target: `CustomerGalaxy` 的一種健康度狀態：其鍵、圖例標籤與顏色、圓點的繪製強度，以及它在合計中是否計為成長或風險。

trans-unit.source: Opacity of its bar segments in the totals list (default 1; the neutral state 0.5).
trans-unit.target: 合計列表中其柱段的不透明度（預設 1；中性狀態為 0.5）。

trans-unit.source: A fixed color instead of `Tone` (it does not follow the theme).
trans-unit.target: 固定顏色，用於取代 `Tone`（不隨主題變化）。

trans-unit.source: Opacity of its dots and legend dot (default 0.95; the neutral state 0.72).
trans-unit.target: 其圓點與圖例圓點的不透明度（預設 0.95；中性狀態為 0.72）。

trans-unit.source: Its MRR is the "growing" subtotal of the totals panel.
trans-unit.target: 其 MRR 計入合計面板的 "growing" 小計。

trans-unit.source: Its MRR is the "at risk" subtotal and the risk share of every cluster.
trans-unit.target: 其 MRR 為 "at risk" 小計，並計入每個叢集的風險占比。

trans-unit.source: The value of `Health` that selects this state ("at-risk").
trans-unit.target: 用於選取此狀態的 `Health` 值（"at-risk"）。

trans-unit.source: The legend, card and list label ("At risk"); `Key` when null.
trans-unit.target: 圖例、卡片與列表中的標籤（"At risk"）；為 null 時使用 `Key`。

trans-unit.source: Paint order: lower layers are drawn first, so higher ones sit on top (neutral 0, risk last).
trans-unit.target: 繪製順序：較低的圖層先繪製，因此較高的圖層位於上方（中性為 0，風險最後）。

trans-unit.source: The ArcDesign color of its dots, legend dot and bar segments (default `Neutral`).
trans-unit.target: 其圓點、圖例圓點與柱段的 ArcDesign 顏色（預設 `Neutral`）。

trans-unit.source: A project timeline: tasks grouped by phase on a calendar, with a today line, dependency arrows and a summary bar per phase. Drag a bar to move it or its ends to change the dates (snapped to whole days, with a dashed snap target, a date label and a spring on release); arrows re-route as bars move and turn red when a task starts before one it depends on ends. Zoom glides between day, week and month around the middle of the view; folding a phase slides its rows into it. Everything works from the keyboard (arrows to move between bars, Alt and Alt + Shift with arrows to change dates). Sized for tens of tasks; each arrow is redrawn every frame while something moves.
trans-unit.target: 專案時間軸：任務依階段分組排在日曆上，附今天線、相依箭頭與每個階段一條的彙總條。拖曳長條可移動，拖曳兩端可調整日期（吸附到整天，拖曳時顯示虛線吸附目標與日期標籤，放開後彈簧歸位）；箭頭隨長條移動重新走線，任務早於其相依任務結束就開始時變紅。縮放在日、週、月之間圍繞視圖中心滑動；摺疊階段時其列滑入階段列。所有功能都可用鍵盤操作（方向鍵在長條間移動，Alt 與 Alt + Shift 搭配方向鍵改日期）。適合幾十個任務；有物件移動時每個箭頭每個影格都會重畫。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a phase is folded or unfolded.
trans-unit.target: 階段被摺疊或展開時引發。

trans-unit.source: The ids of the folded phases.
trans-unit.target: 已摺疊階段的 id。

trans-unit.source: The phases in display order.
trans-unit.target: 依顯示順序排列的階段。

trans-unit.source: The tasks. Set once; the timeline keeps its own working copy and reports changes through `TasksChanged`.
trans-unit.target: 任務。設定一次即可；時間軸保留自己的工作副本，並透過 `TasksChanged` 回報變更。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a move, resize, undo or reset with every task and what changed.
trans-unit.target: 移動、調整長度、復原或重設之後引發，附帶所有任務與發生的變更。

trans-unit.source: The heading in the toolbar.
trans-unit.target: 工具列中的標題。

trans-unit.source: The day that places the today line and the initial scroll (default: the current date).
trans-unit.target: 決定今天線與初始捲動位置的日期（預設為目前日期）。

trans-unit.source: The scale: day, week or month.
trans-unit.target: 縮放層級：日、週或月。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the zoom changes.
trans-unit.target: 縮放變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: A 270° ring gauge (Arc "Gauge"): one value against a known range, read as a percentage with an optional named state from `Thresholds`. The ring fills once when half of it scrolls into view, then springs to every new value while the percentage rolls (Core `RollingDigits`); the state color and label switch exactly when the moving count crosses a band. Reduced and Off motion land on the value at once.
trans-unit.target: 270° 環形儀表（Arc「Gauge」）：將一個值與已知範圍比較，以百分比顯示，並可選擇來自 `Thresholds` 的命名狀態。環形在其一半捲動進入視野時一次性填滿，之後每個新值都會以彈簧過渡，百分比同時滾動（Core `RollingDigits`）；當滾動中的計數跨越某個區間時，狀態顏色與標籤會立即切換。Reduced 與 Off 動態效果直接跳到目標值。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Detail` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Detail` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Label` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Maximum` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Maximum` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Minimum` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Minimum` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Tone` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Tone` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Value` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Value` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: A band that starts at `From` (in value units). The highest band the value reaches sets the ring's tone and names the state under the number, so the state never rests on color alone. Its properties can be bound in XAML (for example a localized label); the gauge follows later changes.
trans-unit.target: 從 `From`（以數值單位計）開始的區間。數值達到的最高區間決定圓環的色調，並在數字下方給出狀態名稱，因此狀態從不只靠顏色表達。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結（例如在地化的標籤）；儀表會跟隨之後的變化。

trans-unit.source: Lowest value of the band, in the gauge's value units.
trans-unit.target: 區間的最小值，使用儀表的數值單位。

trans-unit.source: State name shown under the number, such as "Healthy".
trans-unit.target: 顯示在數字下方的狀態名稱，例如「健康」。

trans-unit.source: Ring and label color while the value is in this band.
trans-unit.target: 數值處於此區間時圓環和標籤的顏色。

trans-unit.source: The model that answered: its name as people know it, your key for its provider, its API id and, optionally, its mark.
trans-unit.target: 回答問題的模型：大家熟知的名稱、你為其服務商設定的鍵、API id，以及選用的標記。

trans-unit.source: Prices in US dollars per million tokens. Reasoning tokens bill at the output rate.
trans-unit.target: 每百萬 token 的美元價格。推理 token 按輸出單價計費。

trans-unit.source: A live stats strip for a streaming LLM response (Arc Generation stats, design reference). The head shows the model's mark, its name and a status with an icon and a word (Waiting, Streaming, Done in 4.18s, Stopped at 1.90s, Failed). Below it four cells split by hairlines: time to first token, speed in tokens per second with a small sparkline, output tokens and cost. While the response streams every number counts up in tabular digits and the sparkline draws; when it ends the numbers settle on exact values. Details opens a breakdown with a latency bar (first token, generation, total) and a token table (input, cached input, output, reasoning, total) with rates and cost. A failed response gets a row with the reason and Retry. Feed it from your streaming handler: set `StartedAt` when the request leaves, `Status` Waiting until the first chunk, then Streaming while you set a new `Usage` with the growing output tokens, then Done with the duration. Speed, latency and cost follow. Leave `Status` unset and set `Simulation` to play simulated runs of your own; with neither the strip is idle and every value reads a dash.
trans-unit.target: 串流 LLM 回覆的即時統計列（Arc Generation stats，設計參考）。頂部顯示模型的標記、名稱，以及由圖示和文字組成的狀態（Waiting、Streaming、Done in 4.18s、Stopped at 1.90s、Failed）。下方是以細線分隔的四個儲存格：首個 token 時間、附迷你折線的每秒 token 速度、輸出 token 與費用。回覆串流輸出時，每個數字以等寬數字逐步累加，迷你折線逐步繪出；結束後數字定格在精確值上。Details 會展開明細，其中有延遲條（首個 token、生成、總計）與 token 表格（輸入、快取輸入、輸出、推理、總計）及其單價與費用。失敗的回覆會多出一列，顯示原因與 Retry。用你的串流處理程式提供資料：請求送出時設定 `StartedAt`，在第一個資料區塊之前 `Status` 為 Waiting，之後為 Streaming，同時每次傳入帶有持續增加之輸出 token 的新 `Usage`，最後以 Done 並附上時長結束。速度、延遲與費用隨之得出。不設定 `Status` 並設定 `Simulation`，即可播放你自己的模擬執行；兩者都未設定時，統計列處於閒置狀態，每個值都顯示短橫線。

trans-unit.target: 在錯誤列中顯示 Retry；按下時引發 `RetryRequested`。

trans-unit.source: The token usage and timing. Set a new one as chunks arrive (output tokens), on the first token (`Ttft`) and on the last (`Duration`). Speed and cost are derived unless it carries them.

trans-unit.source: A bordered card with four cells, or one quiet wrapping line for under a chat message.

trans-unit.source: One response a `GenerationStatsSimulation` plays: the model and its prices, the token counts it ends on, how long the first token takes and the peak speed. Give `FailAtTokens` to make it fail once at that output count and succeed when retried.

trans-unit.source: A simulated stream for a `GenerationStats` that has no `Status`: it plays `Runs` in order on its own virtual clock, which the strip advances in 40ms steps while it is on screen (full motion only), so leaving the screen pauses the run. A run waits for its first token, then streams with a ramp up and a few percent of waver, in chunks of four or more tokens, and settles; a run with `FailAtTokens` fails there once and succeeds when retried (by Retry, or on its own after a short wait). A settled run stays on screen while the breakdown is open. Nothing is sent anywhere. Create one per strip: it keeps the playback state.
trans-unit.target: 供沒有 `Status` 的 `GenerationStats` 使用的模擬串流：它依序在自己的虛擬時鐘上播放 `Runs`，統計列位於畫面上時以 40ms 為步長推進該時鐘（僅完整動態效果），因此離開畫面會暫停執行。一次執行先等待首個 token，然後以爬升與幾個百分點的波動、每塊四個或更多 token 的方式串流輸出，最後定格；帶有 `FailAtTokens` 的執行會在該處失敗一次，重試後成功（透過 Retry，或在短暫等待後自動重試）。明細展開時，已定格的執行會停留在畫面上。不會傳送任何內容。每個統計列建立一個：它保存播放狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised whenever the frame (status, usage, error) changes.
trans-unit.target: 每當畫面（狀態、用量、錯誤）變化時引發。

trans-unit.source: The token usage and timing of one response, all optional. Make a new one (or a copy with `with`) whenever a value changes: update `OutputTokens` as chunks arrive, set `Ttft` on the first token and `Duration` on the last. Speed and cost are derived unless you pass `TokensPerSecond` or `CostUsd`.

trans-unit.source: A floating ghost mascot that shows what an assistant is doing (Arc ghost mascot): a soft sheet whose hem ripples while it hovers, a quiet form shade and two simple eyes, drawn in one control. Idle floats, blinks and glances around; listening comes forward with wide eyes and a small head tilt; thinking drifts up, turns translucent and looks up at a swirl that curls in and out; writing leans toward a line it writes with a tiny pen, eyes on the tip; done lifts with happy eyes, a smile and a sparkle; error wobbles once, sinks and droops its eyes. Every status change blends from the pose on screen over 400ms, never a hard cut. Leave `Status` unset and the ghost plays through every state on a loop (for showcases); `StatusChanged` reports each step.
trans-unit.target: 一隻表示助理正在做什麼的漂浮幽靈吉祥物（Arc 幽靈吉祥物）：懸停時下襬起伏的柔軟布單、低調的形體陰影和兩隻簡單的眼睛，繪製在一個控制項中。閒置時漂浮、眨眼、四處張望；傾聽時向前靠近，睜大眼睛，頭微微歪向一側；思考時向上飄起，變得半透明，抬頭看著一個畫入又擦去的漩渦；書寫時傾向它用小筆寫出的一行，眼睛盯著筆尖；完成時升起，眼睛變成開心的弧線，帶著微笑和閃光；出錯時搖晃一次，下沉，眼睛垂下。每次狀態切換都從畫面上的姿態在 400ms 內過渡，從不生硬切換。不設定 `Status` 時，幽靈會循環示範每一種狀態（用於展示）；`StatusChanged` 回報每一步。

trans-unit.source: Inline AI autocomplete for a text field (Arc Ghost text, design reference). When the person pauses, muted ghost text continues their sentence right at the caret, streamed from your `Suggest` function. Tab accepts the whole suggestion and it settles from ghost ink to text ink in place; Cmd+Right (Ctrl+Right, Option or Alt+Right too) accepts one word at a time; Escape fades it away; typing the same characters as the ghost keeps it in place instead of asking again. A small chip at the end shows the model's mark and name, a shimmering Thinking while it waits, a Tab key cap and "to accept" when a suggestion is ready (a tap target on touch screens), Accepted with a check after Tab, and No suggestion with Retry when your function throws. The field is a real Avalonia `TextBox` (caret, selection, IME, undo, clipboard and spellcheck stay native); the ghost is the muted tail of the same text layout, so text and ghost wrap identically at any width. A multi-line field grows with its text from `Rows` to `MaxRows` lines on a 180ms tween and has a label row and a footer row; a single-line field scrolls sideways and keeps the chip inline at its end. With no `Suggest` and no text it is a plain field, or plays a `Simulation` you pass in that types, pauses, accepts and loops; clicking it takes over.
trans-unit.target: 文字欄位的行內 AI 自動完成（Arc Ghost text，設計參考）。使用者停頓時，淡色的幽靈文字會剛好在游標處接著句子寫下去，內容由你的 `Suggest` 函式串流提供。Tab 接受整段建議，並讓它原地從幽靈墨色過渡到正文墨色；Cmd+Right（Ctrl+Right，Option 或 Alt+Right 也可以）一次接受一個字詞；Escape 讓它淡出；輸入與幽靈文字相同的字元會保留它，而不會重新請求。末端的小標籤顯示模型的標誌與名稱，等待時顯示閃爍的 Thinking，建議就緒時顯示 Tab 鍵帽與 "to accept"（在觸控螢幕上可點按），按 Tab 後顯示帶勾號的 Accepted，函式擲回例外時顯示 No suggestion 與 Retry。欄位是真正的 Avalonia `TextBox`（游標、選取、輸入法、復原、剪貼簿與拼字檢查都維持原生）；幽靈文字是同一文字版面中淡色的尾端，因此文字與幽靈文字在任何寬度下都以相同方式換行。多行欄位以 180ms 補間從 `Rows` 行長高到 `MaxRows` 行，並有標籤列與頁尾列；單行欄位水平捲動，標籤保持在行尾。沒有 `Suggest` 也沒有文字時，它是一般的欄位，或播放你傳入的 `Simulation`，自動打字、停頓、接受並循環；點一下即可接手。

trans-unit.target: 以被接受的文字引發：整段建議或下一個字詞。會向上傳遞。
