trans-unit.target: `Status` 變化時引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Returns a continuation for the text before the caret: a string, a task of one, or a stream of chunks (`GhostTextResponse`); null skips without showing Thinking. Cancel your work when the token fires.
trans-unit.target: 為游標前的文字回傳接續內容：字串、回傳字串的工作，或分塊串流（`GhostTextResponse`）；回傳 null 表示略過，且不顯示 Thinking。權杖觸發時請取消你的工作。

trans-unit.source: The suggestion at the caret (what Tab would accept), or empty.
trans-unit.target: 游標處的建議（Tab 會接受的內容），或為空。

trans-unit.source: The text (two-way). Programmatic changes run through the same logic as typing, so a parent can drive the field.
trans-unit.target: 文字（雙向）。以程式碼修改與打字走相同的邏輯，因此父層可以驅動這個欄位。

trans-unit.source: A bordered field, or plain text that sits flush inside a card you already have.
trans-unit.target: 帶邊框的欄位，或平貼在你既有卡片中的純文字。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `GhostText` shows or says, in English by default: the chip in each state, the key hints, the keys description read with the field and the polite announcements. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; sentences that carry text are functions so word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `GhostText` 顯示或朗讀的每一個字，預設為英文：各狀態下的標籤、按鍵提示、隨欄位朗讀的按鍵說明以及禮貌播報。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；包含文字的句子是函式，以便調整詞序。

trans-unit.source: The answer of a `GhostTextSuggest` function: a whole suggestion now, a task that completes with one, or a stream of chunks that appear one after another (each fades in on its own). A string or a `Task<string?>` converts implicitly; wrap an async iterator with `FromStream`. A null or empty result shows nothing.
trans-unit.target: `GhostTextSuggest` 函式的回答：立即給出的整段建議、完成時給出建議的工作，或依序出現的分塊串流（每塊各自淡入）。字串或 `Task<string?>` 可隱含轉換；非同步迭代器請用 `FromStream` 包裝。結果為 null 或空時不顯示任何內容。

trans-unit.source: A simulated session for a `GhostText`, for demos, prototypes and tests: it types each line of the `Script`, pauses, lets the scripted suggestion stream in 3 to 6 word chunks after a short think, and accepts it; lines alternate between Tab and a word at a time with Cmd+Right, then it rests and starts over. Every step goes through the field's own handling (typing, asking, Tab, the word key), so it shows exactly what a person would see. Set it as the field's `Simulation`: it plays while the field has no `Suggest` and no text, at every motion level, pausing off screen; with reduced motion (or none) it plays once and stops. Clicking or focusing the field hands it to the person, who then gets the scripted suggestions and, for anything else, `Suggest`. Label, placeholder, footer and model stay on the field. Use one simulation per field.
trans-unit.target: 為 `GhostText` 提供的模擬工作階段，用於示範、原型和測試：它逐行輸入 `Script`，停頓，讓劇本中的建議在短暫思考後以 3 到 6 個字詞的分塊串流出現並接受；各行在 Tab 與 Cmd+Right 逐字詞接受之間交替，然後休息並從頭開始。每一步都經過欄位自己的處理（輸入、請求、Tab、逐字詞鍵），所以顯示的正是使用者會看到的樣子。把它設為欄位的 `Simulation`：欄位沒有 `Suggest` 也沒有文字時播放它，在所有動態效果等級下執行，離開畫面時暫停；減少動態效果（或關閉動態效果）時只播放一次就停止。點一下或聚焦欄位會把它交給使用者，使用者隨後得到劇本中的建議，其他內容則由 `Suggest` 回答。標籤、預留位置文字、頁尾與模型仍設定在欄位上。每個欄位使用一個模擬。

trans-unit.source: The lines to type and the suggestions that continue them, in order.
trans-unit.target: 要輸入的各行以及接續它們的建議，依順序排列。

trans-unit.source: Suggestions for text the script does not cover, such as what the person types after taking the field over; null suggests nothing there.
trans-unit.target: 為劇本未涵蓋的文字提供建議，例如使用者接手欄位後輸入的內容；為 null 時這些內容不會得到建議。

trans-unit.source: One line of a `GhostTextSimulation`: the words it types, and the suggestion that continues them.
trans-unit.target: `GhostTextSimulation` 中的一行：它輸入的字詞，以及接續這些字詞的建議。

trans-unit.source: Tells glass surfaces (`GlassCard`, `GlassMenu`, `GlassSegmented`, `GlassTabBar`) what lies behind them. Set `arc:GlassBackdrop.Source` once on a container and every glass surface inside it shows a blurred, tinted copy of that visual, lined up with the part it covers.
trans-unit.target: 告訴玻璃表面（`GlassCard`、`GlassMenu`、`GlassSegmented`、`GlassTabBar`）身後是什麼。在容器上設定一次 `arc:GlassBackdrop.Source`，容器內的每個玻璃表面都會顯示該元素經過模糊和著色、並與其覆蓋部分對齊的副本。

trans-unit.source: Whether the glass redraws its copy of `SourceProperty` every frame while it is on screen (inherited; false by default). Turn it on for a source that changes on its own; a still source only needs the copy drawn when the glass moves.
trans-unit.target: 玻璃在畫面上時是否每一格都重畫 `SourceProperty` 的副本（可繼承；預設 false）。來源自己會變化時開啟；靜止的來源只需在玻璃移動時重畫副本。

trans-unit.source: The visual seen blurred through the glass surfaces inside this element (inherited). Null: the glass is a tinted translucent surface without blur.
trans-unit.target: 透過此元素內的玻璃表面看到的、經過模糊的元素（可繼承）。為 null 時，玻璃是沒有模糊的半透明著色表面。

trans-unit.source: A card of frosted glass: the content sits on a blurred, tinted copy of what lies behind the card (see `GlassBackdrop`), framed by a 1px edge light that is bright along the top left and fades to a faint shade at the bottom right. A soft sheen follows the pointer across the card and brightens the edge near it; with `MaxTilt` the card also leans toward the pointer in perspective. `Tilt` drives the same light (and lean) from another source, such as a device's orientation, while the pointer is elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: 一張磨砂玻璃卡片：內容放在卡片身後內容經過模糊和著色的副本上（見 `GlassBackdrop`），四周是一條 1px 的邊緣光，左上角最亮，到右下角淡成一道淺影。一片柔和的光澤隨指標在卡片上移動，並照亮附近的邊緣；設定 `MaxTilt` 後，卡片還會以透視朝指標傾斜。指標不在卡片上時，`Tilt` 可以從其他來源（例如裝置方向）驅動同樣的光（和傾斜）。

trans-unit.source: The largest lean toward the pointer in degrees (0..20); 0 (the default) keeps the card flat and only moves the light.
trans-unit.target: 朝指標傾斜的最大角度（度，0..20）；0（預設）讓卡片保持平整，只移動光。

trans-unit.source: Strength of the pointer sheen and the edge glow, 0..1; 0 leaves the glass still.
trans-unit.target: 指標光澤和邊緣光的強度，0..1；為 0 時玻璃保持靜止。

trans-unit.source: Where the light comes from while the pointer is not over the card, -1..1 on each axis ((0, 0) is at rest: no sheen and no lean). Feed it a device's orientation or any other signal; the pointer takes over while it is on the card.
trans-unit.target: 指標不在卡片上時光來自哪裡，每個軸 -1..1（(0, 0) 表示靜止：沒有光澤也不傾斜）。可以接入裝置方向或任何其他訊號；指標在卡片上時由指標接管。

trans-unit.source: A menu on frosted glass: commands on a translucent surface that blurs and tints what lies behind it (see `GlassBackdrop`). One highlight of brighter glass glides from row to row under the pointer or the keyboard focus, and a soft glow inside it follows the pointer along the row. Place it inline, or attach it to a button with `arc:GlassMenu.Menu` (or call `Open`) to show it as a popup that closes when a command runs, on Escape or on a click outside.
trans-unit.target: 一個磨砂玻璃選單：命令放在一塊會模糊並著色身後內容的半透明表面上（見 `GlassBackdrop`）。一塊更亮的玻璃醒目提示在指標或鍵盤焦點下逐列滑動，內部一團柔光沿著該列跟隨指標。可以直接放在頁面中，也可以用 `arc:GlassMenu.Menu` 附加到按鈕上（或呼叫 `Open`），作為彈出選單顯示，執行命令、按 Escape 或點按外部時關閉。

trans-unit.source: Whether the menu is open as a popup (read-only; use `Open` and `Close`).
trans-unit.target: 選單是否作為彈出選單開啟（唯讀；使用 `Open` 和 `Close`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a command row runs (click, tap, Enter or Space), after its own `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 執行一個命令列時觸發（點按、Enter 或 Space），在該列自己的 `Command` 之後。

trans-unit.source: A menu that opens from this control: a click or tap toggles it, and Down, Enter or Space open it with the first command focused. On a `Button` it opens on `Click`.
trans-unit.target: 從此控制項開啟的選單：點按切換它，按 Down、Enter 或 Space 開啟並讓第一個命令取得焦點。在 `Button` 上，它在 `Click` 時開啟。

trans-unit.source: Where a popup menu opens relative to its anchor (below it, aligned to its left edge, by default).
trans-unit.target: 彈出選單相對錨點開啟的位置（預設在錨點下方，與其左邊緣對齊）。

trans-unit.source: One command of a `GlassMenu`: an optional icon, the label and an optional shortcut hint. It is a `Button`, so it takes a `Command` and raises `Click`; the menu also reports it through `ItemInvoked` and closes when it was opened from an anchor.
trans-unit.target: `GlassMenu` 中的一個命令：可選的圖示、文字和可選的快速鍵提示。它是一個 `Button`，所以接受 `Command` 並觸發 `Click`；選單還會透過 `ItemInvoked` 回報它，並在選單是從錨點開啟時關閉。

trans-unit.source: An optional 24×24 stroke icon before the label (for example `ArcIcons.Copy`).
trans-unit.target: 文字前可選的 24×24 描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons.Copy`）。

trans-unit.source: Marks a destructive command (Delete, Leave): the label and icon take the danger color.
trans-unit.target: 標記危險的命令（刪除、離開）：文字和圖示使用危險色。

trans-unit.source: A shortcut hint shown at the end of the row, such as "⌘C" or "Ctrl+C". It is only a label.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在列尾的快速鍵提示，例如「⌘C」或「Ctrl+C」。它只是文字。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ItemInvoked`.
trans-unit.target: `ItemInvoked` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: A thin line between groups of items in a `GlassMenu`.
trans-unit.target: `GlassMenu` 中分隔各組項目的一條細線。

trans-unit.source: Color of the line (set by the theme).
trans-unit.target: 線的顏色（由主題設定）。

trans-unit.source: Thickness of the line (set by the theme).
trans-unit.target: 線的粗細（由主題設定）。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `GlassSegmented`: a label with an optional icon. Write it inline (`<arc:GlassSegment Content="Day" />`) or let the control create it for each item of `ItemsSource`. Its label brightens while it is selected or while the dragged lens is over it.
trans-unit.target: `GlassSegmented` 中的一個選項：文字加可選的圖示。可以直接寫出（`<arc:GlassSegment Content="Day" />`），也可以由控制項為 `ItemsSource` 中的每一項建立。選取時或被拖曳的透鏡經過時，它的文字會變亮。

trans-unit.source: An optional 24×24 stroke icon before the label (for example `ArcIcons.Sun`).
trans-unit.target: 文字前可選的 24×24 描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons.Sun`）。

trans-unit.source: Whether this segment is the selected one (set by the owning `GlassSegmented`).
trans-unit.target: 此分段是否被選取（由所屬的 `GlassSegmented` 設定）。

trans-unit.source: A segmented control on frosted glass: a row of two to five options on a translucent track that blurs what lies behind it (see `GlassBackdrop`). The selection is a lens of brighter glass that glides to the chosen segment, its leading edge running ahead so it stretches on the way and draws together as it lands. Press the selected segment and the lens swells; drag it and it follows the finger or pointer, choosing the segment it is released over. Arrows, Home and End move the selection (wrapping, skipping disabled segments); only the selected segment is in the Tab order.
trans-unit.target: 一個磨砂玻璃上的分段控制項：兩到五個選項排成一列，放在會模糊身後內容的半透明軌道上（見 `GlassBackdrop`）。選取是一塊更亮的玻璃透鏡，它滑向選取的分段，前緣先行，所以途中被拉長，落下時再收攏。按住選取的分段，透鏡會鼓起；拖曳它，它跟隨手指或指標，放開時選取它所在的分段。方向鍵、Home 和 End 移動選取（循環，略過停用的分段）；只有選取的分段在 Tab 順序中。

trans-unit.source: One destination of a `GlassTabBar`: an icon over a short label, with an optional badge on the icon. Write it inline (`<arc:GlassTab Content="Home" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.House}" />`) or let the bar create it for each item of `ItemsSource`.
trans-unit.target: `GlassTabBar` 中的一個目的地：圖示加下方的短文字，圖示上可帶一個徽章。可以直接寫出（`<arc:GlassTab Content="Home" Icon="{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.House}" />`），也可以由標籤列為 `ItemsSource` 中的每一項建立。

trans-unit.source: A badge on the icon: null shows none, an empty string a dot (something new), any other text a small count pill ("3", "9+"). It is read out after the tab's name.
trans-unit.target: 圖示上的徽章：null 不顯示，空字串顯示一個圓點（有新內容），其他文字顯示一個小數字（「3」「9+」）。它在標籤名稱之後朗讀。

trans-unit.source: The tab's 24×24 stroke icon (for example `ArcIcons.House`).
trans-unit.target: 標籤的 24×24 描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons.House`）。

trans-unit.source: Whether this tab is the selected one (set by the owning `GlassTabBar`).
trans-unit.target: 此標籤是否被選取（由所屬的 `GlassTabBar` 設定）。

trans-unit.source: A floating bottom tab bar of frosted glass for an app shell: a pill that hovers over the content near the bottom edge, blurring what scrolls under it (see `GlassBackdrop`), with three to five destinations. The selected tab sits in a lens of brighter glass that glides and stretches to the next tab; press and drag the lens to scrub across the tabs. Arrows, Home and End move between tabs (wrapping); only the selected tab is in the Tab order.
trans-unit.target: 一個用於應用程式外殼的浮動底部磨砂玻璃標籤列：一條浮在內容之上、靠近底邊的膠囊，模糊從它下面捲過的內容（見 `GlassBackdrop`），放三到五個目的地。選取的標籤位於一塊更亮的玻璃透鏡中，透鏡滑向下一個標籤並在途中拉伸；按住並拖曳透鏡可以在標籤之間滑動。方向鍵、Home 和 End 在標籤之間移動（循環）；只有選取的標籤在 Tab 順序中。

trans-unit.source: Whether each tab shows its label under the icon (true, the default). False shows icons only, in a lower bar; the labels remain the tabs' accessible names.
trans-unit.target: 每個標籤是否在圖示下顯示文字（true，預設）。為 false 時只顯示圖示，標籤列更矮；文字仍是各標籤的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: A team's goals and key results for a period: each key result shows its value against the target, a progress bar with a mark where it should be by today, the owner's confidence and the last check-in, and opens an inline check-in (a new value, a confidence and a note). A timeline view draws every key result's check-ins over the period against the straight line to its target. A team filter and confidence counts sit on top. With no goals the block shows built-in invented goals for a quarter. Give it `Goals`, `PeriodStart` and `PeriodEnd` to show your own; `CheckedIn` reports each check-in.
trans-unit.target: 一個週期內團隊的目標和關鍵結果：每個關鍵結果顯示目前值對比目標值、一條帶有今天應達到位置標記的進度條、負責人的信心和最近一次進度更新，並可以在原地更新進度（新數值、信心和備註）。時間軸檢視把每個關鍵結果在週期內的進度更新畫在通向目標的直線旁邊。頂部有團隊篩選和按信心的統計。 沒有目標時，區塊顯示內置的季度虛構目標。提供 `Goals`、`PeriodStart` 和 `PeriodEnd` 即可顯示你自己的資料；`CheckedIn` 報告每次進度更新。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a check-in was saved in the block (or with `CheckIn`).
trans-unit.target: 在區塊中（或通過 `CheckIn`）保存一次進度更新後引發。

trans-unit.source: The name check-ins made in the block are signed with; null leaves the author out.
trans-unit.target: 在區塊中進行的進度更新所署的名字；為 null 時不署名。

trans-unit.source: Draws a bordered card (true); false lays the block flat on the page.
trans-unit.target: 繪制帶邊框的卡片（true）；false 時區塊平鋪在頁面上。

trans-unit.source: The words the block shows and reads out.
trans-unit.target: 區塊顯示和讀出的文字。

trans-unit.source: The last day of the period; null uses the end of the current quarter.
trans-unit.target: 週期的最後一天；為 null 時用本季度的結束。

trans-unit.source: The first day of the period; null uses the start of the current quarter.
trans-unit.target: 週期的第一天；為 null 時用本季度的開始。

trans-unit.source: The team the goals are narrowed to (two-way); null shows every team.
trans-unit.target: 目標縮小到的團隊（雙向）；為 null 時顯示所有團隊。

trans-unit.source: The heading; null shows the sample heading while the samples are shown.
trans-unit.target: 標題；為 null 時，顯示示例時用示例標題。

trans-unit.source: The day progress is expected at and check-ins are dated; null uses today.
trans-unit.target: 計算應達進度、記錄進度更新日期所用的日子；為 null 時用今天。

trans-unit.source: Which view is shown (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 顯示哪種檢視（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: A check-in on a key result: the value reached on a day, the owner's confidence and a note.
trans-unit.target: 關鍵結果的一次進度更新：某天達到的數值、負責人的信心和一條備註。

trans-unit.source: How sure the owner is that a key result will be met.
trans-unit.target: 負責人對達成關鍵結果有多大把握。

trans-unit.source: A goal: what a team wants to achieve in the period, measured by its key results.
trans-unit.target: 一個目標：團隊在週期內想達成的事，由它的關鍵結果衡量。

trans-unit.source: A measurable result that tells whether a goal was met: from a start value to a target, with check-ins.
trans-unit.target: 一個可衡量的結果，用來判斷目標是否達成：從起始值到目標值，帶有進度更新。

trans-unit.source: Which view of the goals `GoalTracker` shows.
trans-unit.target: `GoalTracker` 顯示目標的哪種檢視。

trans-unit.source: A grid of square tiles that bends toward the pointer like spacetime around a mass (Arc Gravity well, design reference). Tiles near the well lean in, shrink and dim on their own springs; a click, a tap, Space or Enter sends a shockwave rolling outward through the grid. Each item becomes one tile: photos, avatars, icons or any small content.
trans-unit.target: 一格格正方形圖塊組成的網格，像時空圍繞質量一樣朝指標彎曲（Arc 重力井，設計參考）。重力井附近的圖塊沿各自的彈簧向內傾斜、縮小並變暗；點擊、輕觸、Space 或 Enter 會發出一道向外滾過網格的衝擊波。每個項目成為一個圖塊：照片、頭像、圖示或任何小型內容。

trans-unit.source: A fixed column count; 0 (the default) fits as many columns as `MinTileSize` allows.
trans-unit.target: 固定的欄數；為 0（預設）時在 `MinTileSize` 允許的範圍內放入盡可能多的欄。

trans-unit.source: The gap between tiles in px.
trans-unit.target: 圖塊之間的間距，單位 px。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the grid.
trans-unit.target: 網格的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The smallest tile width in px when `Columns` is 0.
trans-unit.target: `Columns` 為 0 時圖塊的最小寬度，單位 px。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a click, a tap or a key sends a shockwave, with its origin in the grid.
trans-unit.target: 點擊、輕觸或按鍵發出衝擊波時觸發，並提供它在網格中的起點。

trans-unit.source: The reach of the well in px.
trans-unit.target: 重力井的作用範圍，單位 px。

trans-unit.source: The pull strength, from 0 to about 1.5.
trans-unit.target: 吸力強度，從 0 到約 1.5。

trans-unit.source: The corner radius of every tile; the content is clipped to it and the shockwave ring follows it.
trans-unit.target: 每個圖塊的圓角半徑；內容會被裁切到這個圓角，衝擊波的外框環也隨之變化。

trans-unit.source: The origin of a `GravityWell` shockwave.
trans-unit.target: 一道 `GravityWell` 衝擊波的起點。

trans-unit.source: A help center: a home with a search field, categories and popular articles; search results that follow every keystroke; a page per category; and an article view with a breadcrumb, a table of contents that scrolls to each section, related articles and a "Was this helpful?" question that asks what was missing after a No. Articles are Markdown (`Body`). trans-unit.source: A landing page hero in three designs, each one full screen tall. Centered sets a headline over a drifting mesh with a live dashboard rising from the bottom edge, Split puts the copy beside a live workflow graph that routes sample events node by node, and Minimal is large type over a mesh gradient with customer marks along the bottom edge. Set `Title` to show your own content in the chosen layout, at its natural height.
trans-unit.target: 三種設計的登陸頁首屏，每種都佔滿一屏高度。Centered 把標題放在飄動的網格漸層上，並有一個從底邊升起的即時儀表板；Split 把文案放在逐節點傳遞範例事件的即時工作流程圖旁邊；Minimal 是網格漸層上的大字，底邊排列客戶標誌。設定 `Title` 可在所選版面中按自然高度顯示你自己的內容。

A row of faces and a line of proof close the section.

trans-unit.source: Sends the address: awaited with the trimmed address and a token that `Reset` (or the block leaving the window) cancels. Return to confirm; throw to show `FailedMessage` and keep the address. Null simulates a send of 900 ms.
trans-unit.target: 提交地址：傳入去掉首尾空白的地址和一個令牌，`Reset` 或區塊離開窗口時會取消它。正常返回表示確認；抛出异常則顯示 `FailedMessage` 並保留地址。為 null 時模擬 900 毫秒的提交。

trans-unit.source: A button that commits only after it is held, for destructive or hard to undo actions where a stray tap must not count. The fill tracks the hold on a linear, pausable timeline (P22) and is revealed from the leading edge with the label inverted exactly at the edge (P29); letting go early rewinds it on a smooth spring, and finishing morphs the label and icon into the done state (P2, P5, P15). Space and Enter can be held too; the hint is in the help text.
trans-unit.target: 僅在按住之後才會確認的按鈕，適用於破壞性或難以復原的操作，避免誤觸即生效。填滿進度沿線性、可暫停的時間軸（P22）推進，從前緣顯露，文字在前緣處精確反色（P29）；提前放開時以平滑彈簧回退，完成時標籤與圖示變形為完成狀態（P2、P5、P15）。Space 與 Enter 鍵同樣可以按住，提示見說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised once when a hold completes (after which `Command` runs).
trans-unit.target: 按住完成時觸發（之後執行 `Command`）。

trans-unit.source: Shown once the hold completes (default "Done").
trans-unit.target: 按住完成後顯示（預設「Done」）。

trans-unit.source: How long the button must be held (default 1.2s).
trans-unit.target: 按鈕需要被按住的時長（預設 1.2s）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a hold starts and when it ends.
trans-unit.target: 按住開始與結束時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Leading 24×24 glyph (default Lucide trash-2); it becomes a drawn check when done.
trans-unit.target: 前置的 24×24 圖形（預設為 Lucide trash-2）；完成時變為繪製的勾號。

trans-unit.source: The done state. Set it back to false to reset the button (the fill rewinds as the label morphs back).
trans-unit.target: 完成狀態。設回 false 即可重設按鈕（標籤變形回去時，填滿同步回退）。

trans-unit.source: True while a hold is in progress (for surrounding hints such as "Keep holding").
trans-unit.target: 按住進行中為 true（可用於周圍的提示，例如「繼續按住」）。

trans-unit.source: The instruction and the action, such as "Hold to delete project".
trans-unit.target: 操作提示與動作，例如「按住以刪除專案」。

trans-unit.source: Fill color: Accent (default), Danger for irreversible actions, or Neutral.
trans-unit.target: 填滿顏色：Accent（預設）、用於不可逆操作的 Danger，或 Neutral。

trans-unit.source: A holographic card, such as a member card, an event badge or a reward reveal (Arc Holo card, design reference). It leans toward the pointer in perspective while a rainbow foil, a sprinkle of glitter and a glare follow the light across its face, and a floating shadow leans the other way. With a `Back` it is a button: a click or tap spins it half a turn (to the right on the right half, back to the left on the left half), and Enter or Space spins it to the right. The card is always 5:7, at most 300 wide unless a width is set.
trans-unit.target: 一張全像卡片，例如會員卡、活動識別證或獎勵揭曉卡（Arc Holo card，設計參考）。它以透視朝指標傾斜，彩虹箔、細碎的亮粉與高光隨光點在卡面上流動，一塊浮起的陰影則往反方向偏移。設定了 `Back` 時它是一個按鈕：按一下或輕觸讓它轉半圈（按在右半邊往右，按在左半邊往左轉回），Enter 或 Space 讓它往右轉。卡片永遠是 5:7，未設定寬度時最寬 300。

trans-unit.source: The back of the card. Without one the card only tilts: it does not flip, is not focusable and is not a button.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的背面。沒有背面時卡片只會傾斜：不翻面、無法取得焦點，也不是按鈕。

trans-unit.source: The template for `Back` when it is data rather than a control.
trans-unit.target: 當 `Back` 是資料而不是控制項時使用的範本。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a click, a tap, the keyboard or `Flip` turns the card over.
trans-unit.target: 當按一下、輕觸、鍵盤或 `Flip` 讓卡片翻面時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The front of the card: any content, stretched over the whole card and clipped to its corners.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的正面：任意內容，鋪滿整張卡片並依圓角裁切。

trans-unit.source: The template for `Front` when it is data rather than a control.
trans-unit.target: 當 `Front` 是資料而不是控制項時使用的範本。

trans-unit.source: Strength of the foil, glitter and glare, 0..1; 0 leaves the content plain.
trans-unit.target: 箔層、亮粉與高光的強度，0..1；為 0 時內容維持原樣。

trans-unit.source: Whether the back faces the viewer. Two-way: a click, a tap or Enter / Space turns it, and setting it turns the card (to the right). Setting it does not raise `FlippedChanged`.
trans-unit.target: 背面是否朝向觀看者。雙向：按一下、輕觸或 Enter / Space 會翻轉它，設定它也會讓卡片翻面（往右）。設定它不會觸發 `FlippedChanged`。

trans-unit.source: The card's accessible name, such as "Mira Okafor, Lumen Society patron pass". When empty, the text of the visible face is used.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的無障礙名稱，例如 "Mira Okafor, Lumen Society patron pass"。為空時使用目前可見那一面的文字。

trans-unit.source: The largest tilt in degrees, reached with the pointer at the card's edge; 0 turns tilting off.
trans-unit.target: 最大傾斜角度（度），在指標位於卡片邊緣時達到；為 0 時關閉傾斜。

trans-unit.source: What assistive technology calls the card when it can flip ("flip card").
trans-unit.target: 卡片可以翻面時，輔助科技對它的稱呼（"flip card"）。

trans-unit.source: What turned a `HoloCard` over, and so which way it spun.
trans-unit.target: 是什麼讓 `HoloCard` 翻面，因此它往哪個方向轉。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `FlippedChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `FlippedChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `BandsChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `BandsChanged` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: Horizon chart: many daily series compared by how far each one strays from its own baseline, every series folded into one 28px band strip so a screenful of rows (markets, services, stores) reads at a glance. The distance above the baseline fills in one colour and the distance below in another; the strip is cut into bands that are stacked into one row height, and a darker colour means further away. One synchronized crosshair crosses every row and writes that day's value for each of them; the rows sort by name, by their largest swing or by their latest value, and the band count (1 to 4) folds or unfolds every row on one spring.
trans-unit.target: 地平線圖:依每條序列偏離自身基線的程度來比較許多每日序列,每條序列都摺疊成一條 28px 的色帶條,這樣一螢幕的列(市場、服務、門市)一眼就能讀完。基線之上的距離填滿為一種顏色,基線之下的距離填滿為另一種顏色;色帶條被切成多個色帶並疊放進同一列高,顏色越深表示偏離越遠。一條同步的十字線貫穿每一列,並寫出當天每一列的值;各列可依名稱、最大波動或最新值排序,色帶數量(1 到 4)以同一條彈簧摺疊或展開每一列。

trans-unit.source: The colour of the distance above the baseline; null takes the Series1 token.
trans-unit.target: 基線之上距離的顏色;為 null 時使用 Series1 權杖。

trans-unit.source: How many bands each row folds into, 1 to 4 (two-way; other values are coerced). One band is an ordinary area chart. Default 3.
trans-unit.target: 每一列摺疊成多少個色帶,1 到 4(雙向;其他值會被強制修正)。一個色帶就是一般的面積圖。預設 3。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the band count changed.
trans-unit.target: 在色帶數量改變後引發。

trans-unit.source: Run when the band count changes, with the new count as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 色帶數量改變時執行,新的數量作為參數。

trans-unit.source: What the values are measured against ("winter forecast"), in the caption and the spoken texts; null takes `BaselineText`.
trans-unit.target: 數值所比較的對象("winter forecast"),用於說明文字和語音文字;為 null 時使用 `BaselineText`。

trans-unit.source: The colour of the distance below the baseline; null takes the Series3 token.
trans-unit.target: 基線之下距離的顏色;為 null 時使用 Series3 權杖。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the crosshair moves to another day or is cleared.
trans-unit.target: 當十字線移到另一天或被清除時引發。

trans-unit.source: Run when the crosshair moves to a day or is cleared, with the day's index (or null) as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 當十字線移到某一天或被清除時執行,該天的索引(或 null)作為參數。

trans-unit.source: The days of the axis, oldest first; each row's values line up with them. Empty takes the longest row and numbers the days.
trans-unit.target: 座標軸的日期,最早的在前;每一列的值與之對齊。為空時取最長的一列並為各天編號。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading (what the rows are and what they are compared with); null or empty leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行(這些列是什麼、與什麼比較);為 null 或空時省略。

trans-unit.source: The distance from the baseline that fills every band; NaN (default) takes the largest absolute value rounded up to a multiple of 12.
trans-unit.target: 與基線的距離達到多少時填滿每個色帶;NaN(預設)取最大絕對值並向上取整到 12 的倍數。

trans-unit.source: Whether the band switch is shown.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示色帶切換器。

trans-unit.source: Whether the colour scale and its caption are shown.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示顏色刻度及其說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Whether the sort switch is shown.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示排序切換器。

trans-unit.source: The words of the block, for translation or rewording.
trans-unit.target: 此區塊的文字,用於翻譯或改寫。

trans-unit.source: The day the crosshair is on (two-way); null hides it and shows the latest day.
trans-unit.target: 十字線所在的那一天(雙向);為 null 時隱藏十字線並顯示最新的一天。

trans-unit.source: The rows as a list you own (followed when it raises collection changes); it wins over `Series`.
trans-unit.target: 由你持有的列清單(當它引發集合變更時會被追蹤);優先於 `Series`。

trans-unit.source: The order of the rows (two-way). Default `Peak`.
trans-unit.target: 各列的順序(雙向)。預設 `Peak`。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the order changed.
trans-unit.target: 在順序改變後引發。

trans-unit.source: Run when the order changes, with the new `HorizonSort` as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 順序改變時執行,新的 `HorizonSort` 作為參數。

trans-unit.source: The labelled ticks of the axis; null puts one on the first day and on every first of a month (days that carry a date).

trans-unit.source: A read-only preview of a person or link that opens after a short hover or keyboard focus: mentions, avatars, author names, link previews — where a click must stay free for navigation. It waits 500ms; moving to another trigger while a card is open (or within 300ms of one closing) opens the next after 80ms with a fade only. The pointer can travel into the card during a 140ms grace and it stays open while the pointer is over it. Tab focus opens at once, Enter skips the wait, Escape closes (and it stays closed while the pointer rests on the trigger); on touch a tap toggles it. One card is open at a time. The card grows from the trigger edge: scale 0.96 and 4px toward the trigger on the smooth spring, with its own fade; leaving mid-exit and coming back turns it around. Focus never enters the card, so keep its content read-only.
trans-unit.target: 在短暫懸停或鍵盤焦點之後開啟的人員或連結唯讀預覽：提及、頭像、作者名稱、連結預覽，也就是必須保留點擊以供導覽的情境。它等待 500ms；卡片開啟時（或關閉後 300ms 內）移到另一個觸發器，會在 80ms 後僅以淡入淡出開啟下一張。指標可在 140ms 的寬限期內移入卡片，只要指標停留在卡片上，卡片就保持開啟。Tab 焦點立即開啟，Enter 跳過等待，Escape 關閉（指標停留在觸發器上時保持關閉）；觸控時點按會切換。同一時間只開啟一張卡片。卡片從觸發器邊緣延展：以平滑彈簧縮放至 0.96，並朝觸發器方向移動 4px，同時帶有自身的淡入淡出；在退場途中離開再返回時會反向。焦點不會進入卡片，因此其內容應保持唯讀。

trans-unit.source: Alignment along the trigger edge (default Start).
trans-unit.target: 沿觸發器邊緣的對齊方式（預設 Start）。

trans-unit.source: Attaches a hover card to any control.
trans-unit.target: 為任意控制項附加懸停卡片。

trans-unit.source: Space inside the card border (Arc: 16; a chat's citation preview uses 14 16).
trans-unit.target: 卡片邊框內側的間距（Arc 為 16；對話的引用預覽使用 14 16）。

trans-unit.source: Card width (Arc: 18.5rem).
trans-unit.target: 卡片寬度（Arc：18.5rem）。

trans-unit.source: Grace after the pointer leaves, so it can travel into the card (default 140ms).
trans-unit.target: 指標離開後的寬限時間，以便移入卡片（預設 140ms）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the card closes (the exit may still be playing).
trans-unit.target: 卡片關閉時觸發（退場動畫可能仍在播放）。

trans-unit.source: Open state (two-way): it follows the card when hover, focus, a click or Escape opens or closes it, and setting it opens or closes the card at once without the delay; any write cancels a pending open or close.
trans-unit.target: 開啟狀態（雙向繫結）：它會隨懸停、焦點、點擊或 Escape 鍵的開啟或關閉操作而變化；設定它會立即開啟或關閉卡片，不受延遲影響；任何寫入都會取消待定的開啟或關閉。

trans-unit.source: Gap to the trigger (Arc: 8).
trans-unit.target: 與觸發器之間的間距（Arc：8）。

trans-unit.source: Hover time before the first card opens (default 500ms); with `OpensOnFocus` also the wait after keyboard focus.
trans-unit.target: 指標懸停多久後開啟第一個卡片（預設 500ms）；與 `OpensOnFocus` 一起使用時，也是鍵盤焦點落定後的等待時間。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the card opens.
trans-unit.target: 卡片開啟時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Opens the card when keyboard focus (Tab or the arrow keys) lands on the trigger or inside it, after `OpenDelay` (zero opens at once), and closes it as soon as focus leaves unless the pointer rests on the trigger or the card; focus from a click or from code does not open it. Off by default, where Tab focus opens the card at once and losing focus starts the `CloseDelay` grace.
trans-unit.target: 當鍵盤焦點（Tab 鍵或方向鍵）落在觸發器或其內部時，經過 `OpenDelay` 後開啟卡片（為零時立即開啟），焦點離開時立即關閉，除非指標停留在觸發器或卡片上；由點擊或程式碼引起的焦點不會開啟卡片。預設關閉，此時 Tab 焦點會立即開啟卡片，失去焦點則開始 `CloseDelay` 的寬限期。

trans-unit.source: Preferred side (default Bottom).
trans-unit.target: 首選的一側（預設 Bottom）。

trans-unit.source: The focusable trigger shown in place of the card (a mention, an avatar, a link).
trans-unit.target: 可取得焦點的觸發器，顯示在卡片的位置（提及、頭像或連結）。

trans-unit.source: A person preview for `HoverCard`: portrait (or initials), name, role, a short bio, a few numbers and a quiet footer line. Each time the card opens its rows settle in from 4px below with a tiny stagger (40ms + 35ms per row, standard duration, ease enter); reduced motion shows them at rest. The stagger replays on every open, which a ControlTheme transition (first frame never animates) cannot express, so one linear `MotionValue` drives a shared timeline for all rows.
trans-unit.target: 用於 `HoverCard` 的人員預覽：頭像（或首字母）、名稱、角色、簡短簡介、數個數字，以及一行低調的頁尾。每次卡片開啟時，各列會從下方 4px 處以細微的錯開時序（40ms + 每列 35ms，標準時長，進入緩動）滑入；減少動態效果時直接顯示在定位。錯開動畫每次開啟都會重新播放，這是 ControlTheme 過渡（首幀從不播放動畫）無法表達的，因此由一個線性的 `MotionValue` 為所有列驅動共用時間軸。

trans-unit.source: Portrait; a downloading portrait fades in from a soft blur.
trans-unit.target: 頭像；下載中的頭像會從柔和的模糊中淡入。

trans-unit.source: Short biography shown under the name; empty when not set.
trans-unit.target: 顯示於名稱下方的簡短簡介；未設定時為空。

trans-unit.source: A surface that leaves a trail of pictures behind the pointer: every few dozen px of movement a picture pops in where the pointer is, tilted a little, rests for a moment and sinks away, cycling through `Sources`.

trans-unit.source: The navigation of a mail app, built on `Sidebar`: a rail toggle and Compose on top, the folders with their unread counts, the labels with colored dots under a heading that folds (with a "New label" row), and the storage meter and the signed-in account at the bottom. It collapses to a 64px icon rail where the folder icons, the label dots, Compose's pencil and the avatar stay and counts become dots; the width springs. Counts above 999 read "999+". Without `Folders` and `MailLabels` it shows an invented mailbox.
trans-unit.target: 郵件應用程式的導覽，以 `Sidebar` 為基礎建構：頂部是圖示列切換按鈕和寫信按鈕，下面是帶未讀數的資料夾、在可摺疊標題下帶彩色圓點的標籤（最後有一列「New label」），底部是儲存空間條和登入的帳號。它可收起為 64px 的圖示列，資料夾圖示、標籤圓點、寫信按鈕的筆和頭像都會保留，計數變成圓點；寬度以彈簧變化。超過 999 的計數顯示為「999+」。沒有 `Folders` 和 `MailLabels` 時顯示一個虛構的信箱。

trans-unit.source: An inbox built for getting through it fast: swipe a row right to archive or left to snooze or assign, or keep your hands on the keys (J / K to move, E archive, S snooze, A assign, L label, Z undo). A counter rolls down as the inbox empties, a bar fills with what is done, every action can be undone from the bar at the bottom, and an empty inbox says so. Triaged items leave `Items` (and come back on undo); `Triaged` and `Undone` report each step so your server can follow. An inbox that is empty when it first loads shows a sample.
trans-unit.target: 一個為快速處理而做的收件箱：向右滑動一行即可歸檔，向左滑動可稍後提醒或分配，也可以不離開鍵盤（J / K 移動，E 歸檔，S 稍後提醒，A 分配，L 標籤，Z 撤銷）。收件箱變空時計數向下滾動，進度條顯示已完成的部分，每個操作都能在底部的條上撤銷，清空時會明確告訴你。處理過的項目離開 `Items`（撤銷時回來）；`Triaged` 和 `Undone` 報告每一步，便於服務器同步。首次加載時收件箱為空，會顯示一組示例。

trans-unit.source: The item the keyboard acts on (two-way through `MoveTo`); null when the inbox is empty.
trans-unit.target: 鍵盤操作的項目（通過 `MoveTo` 雙向）；收件箱為空時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Triaged` and `Undone`.

trans-unit.source: An invoice editor with a live printed preview: choose the client and the payment terms, edit line items with quantity, unit price and tax rate, give a discount as a percentage or an amount, and write a note. The subtotal, discount, tax and total follow every keystroke, the sheet on the right shows the invoice as it will print, and Send checks the invoice and hands it to `SendAsync`. In a narrow block a switch shows the form or the preview.
trans-unit.target: 帶實時打印預覽的發票編輯器：選擇客戶和付款期限，編輯包含數量、單價和稅率的明細行，按百分比或金額給出折扣，並寫一段備注。小計、折扣、稅和合計隨每次輸入更新，右側的紙張顯示打印出來的樣子，發送會先檢查發票再交給 `SendAsync`。在窄區塊中，切換開關顯示表單或預覽。

trans-unit.source: The clients offered by the "Bill to" select.

trans-unit.source: The playback of fetched speech, supplied by the app (an audio element, a platform player, or an adapter over `IAudioPlayer`). The `SpeechPlayer` drives it and reads `Position` on every frame while it plays, so its position is the player's clock. All calls come from the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: 由應用程式提供的已取得語音的播放（音訊元素、平台播放器，或以 `IAudioPlayer` 為基礎的轉接器）。`SpeechPlayer` 會驅動它，並在播放時每個影格讀取 `Position`，所以它的位置就是播放器的時鐘。所有呼叫都來自 UI 執行緒。

trans-unit.source: One video stream that can be loaded, played, paused and sought, and that hands out its current frame on request. Implementations raise every event on the `SynchronizationContext` current when the player was created (the UI thread for controls), and report the position a few times a second while playing, like an HTML media element's `timeupdate`. The backend keeps the clock and outputs the audio; the caller never schedules frames.
trans-unit.target: 一路可以載入、播放、暫停和定位的影片串流，並可在要求時交出目前的影格。實作會在建立播放器時的 `SynchronizationContext` 上引發所有事件（控制項使用 UI 執行緒），播放時每秒約回報幾次位置，類似 HTML 媒體元素的 `timeupdate`。時脈與音訊輸出由後端負責；呼叫端從不安排影格。

trans-unit.source: Icons that morph between two states instead of swapping: lines rotate and slide into place, outlines interpolate (P16 `PathMorph`), and a few carry a moment of their own (the bell rings, the heart bursts). Every morph rides an interruptible spring, so toggling quickly reverses from wherever the icon is. Drawn in one `Render` on the 24-unit grid. The icon is decorative: put it in a button that carries the name and the pressed or expanded state.
trans-unit.target: 在兩種狀態之間變形而非直接切換的圖示：線條旋轉並滑入定位，輪廓進行插值（P16 `PathMorph`），部分圖示還帶有自身的動態效果（鈴鐺會響，愛心會迸發）。每次變形都沿可被打斷的彈簧運行，因此快速切換時會從圖示當前位置反向。圖示在 24 單位網格上透過一次 `Render` 繪製。此圖示僅作裝飾：請將其放入帶有名稱以及按下或展開狀態的按鈕中。

trans-unit.source: Before and after, split by a divider (Arc image compare). Drag anywhere to move it: the handle follows 1:1, rubber-bands past the edges and stays where it is released. A press on the image springs the divider there; on touch the press waits for a drag along the divider's axis so the page still scrolls, and a tap moves the divider. Arrow keys step 1% (Shift 10%), PageUp / PageDown 10%, Home and End reveal one side fully, and a double-click on the handle springs it back to the middle. Changing `Orientation` swings the divider a quarter turn. `Before` / `After` take any content (an `Image` with `Stretch="UniformToFill"`, a drawing, a control). `BeforeSource` / `AfterSource` load a picture with an `ArcImage` on top of that content: it fades in from a soft blur while downloading, and when it fails the content underneath shows instead.
trans-unit.target: 前後對比，由分隔線分開（Arc 影像對比）。拖曳任意位置即可移動：把手 1:1 跟隨，越過邊緣時有橡皮筋式回彈，放開後停留在原處。在影像上按下會將分隔線以彈簧方式移動到該處；觸控時需等待沿分隔線方向的拖曳，以便頁面仍可捲動，輕點則移動分隔線。方向鍵每次步進 1%（按住 Shift 為 10%），PageUp / PageDown 為 10%，Home 和 End 將一側完整顯示，雙擊把手會將其彈回中間。變更 `Orientation` 會使分隔線旋轉四分之一圈。`Before` / `After` 可接受任意內容（`Stretch="UniformToFill"` 的 `Image`、繪圖或控制項）。`BeforeSource` / `AfterSource` 透過 `ArcImage` 在該內容之上載入圖片：下載時從柔和的模糊中淡入，載入失敗時則顯示底層內容。

trans-unit.source: The result, shown on the right (or bottom).

trans-unit.target: 原始內容，顯示在左側（或頂部）。會縮放以覆蓋整個框架。

trans-unit.source: Caption over the before side (default "Before").
trans-unit.target: Before 一側上方的標註（預設「Before」）。

trans-unit.source: Vertical stacks the images top and bottom; changing it swings the divider a quarter turn.
trans-unit.target: Vertical 會將影像上下堆疊；變更它會使分隔線旋轉四分之一圈。

trans-unit.source: Where the divider sits, in percent from the left (or top). Two-way; defaults to 50.
trans-unit.target: 分隔線所在的位置，以距左側（或頂部）的百分比表示。雙向繫結；預設為 50。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the divider position is committed: live once per whole percent while dragging, and on release.
trans-unit.target: 分隔線位置確定時觸發：拖曳期間每個整數百分比觸發一次，放開時也會觸發。

trans-unit.source: Shows the captions; they fade as the divider reaches them (Arc `labels={false}` hides them).
trans-unit.target: 顯示標註；隨分隔線靠近而淡出（Arc `labels={false}` 可將其隱藏）。

trans-unit.source: An image generation card: a prompt, model and aspect chips with Generate, a 2 × 2 grid where each image resolves as a pixel mosaic (coarse colour blocks to full detail under a soft light band) with its own progress ring, and a footer with the status and Upscale, Vary and Download. Pick an image to continue with it: Upscale grows it to fill the grid and sweeps a band of crisp pixels across it, Vary makes four new images from it and Download hands it to the app. Give it a `Generator` that makes one image (it is called once per tile, in parallel, for Generate, Vary and Retry, and reports progress through its `ImageGenerationContext`) and optionally an `Upscaler`. With no generator it plays its `Simulation`, pictures painted by your `Painter`, nothing downloaded, and generates once when it first scrolls into view; with neither, Generate stays unavailable.
trans-unit.target: 一張圖像生成卡片：提示詞、模型與畫面比例標籤和 Generate，一個 2 × 2 網格，每張圖像以像素馬賽克的方式成形（在柔和的光帶下從粗略色塊到完整細節），並帶有自己的進度環，以及一個顯示狀態和 Upscale、Vary、Download 的頁尾。選取一張圖像繼續操作：Upscale 把它放大到鋪滿網格並讓一道清晰像素帶掃過，Vary 以它為基礎產生四張新圖，Download 把它交給應用程式。為它提供一個產生單張圖像的 `Generator`（每個格子呼叫一次，平行執行，用於 Generate、Vary 和 Retry，並透過其 `ImageGenerationContext` 回報進度），以及選用的 `Upscaler`。沒有產生器時，它會播放它的 `Simulation`：由你的 `Painter` 繪製圖片，不下載任何內容，並在第一次捲動進入可視範圍時自動生成一次；兩者都沒有時，Generate 無法使用。

trans-unit.source: The shapes offered as chips. Null or empty offers 1:1, 4:5 and 16:9.
trans-unit.target: 作為標籤提供的畫面比例。為 null 或空時提供 1:1、4:5 和 16:9。

trans-unit.source: Generates once when the card first scrolls into view, then picks image 1 if nobody has touched the card. Null (the default) does so with the simulation only, not with your `Generator`.
trans-unit.target: 在卡片第一次捲動進入可視範圍時自動生成一次，如果沒有人操作過卡片，再選取第 1 張圖像。為 null（預設）時只在使用模擬時這樣做，使用你的 `Generator` 時不會。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Download, with the image and a file name built from the prompt, its number and its size. Save it from here (for example through the window's storage provider). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按下 Download 時觸發，附帶圖像和一個由提示詞、編號與尺寸組成的檔名。請在這裡儲存它（例如透過視窗的儲存提供者）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Makes one image. Called once per tile, in parallel, for Generate, Vary (the request's VariationOf is set) and Retry. Report progress from 0 to 1 through the context, optionally with a preview the mosaic resolves from; throw to mark the tile failed. The context's token is cancelled on Stop. Null uses the `Simulation`'s, if any.
trans-unit.target: 產生一張圖像。每個格子呼叫一次，平行執行，用於 Generate、Vary（請求的 VariationOf 已設定）和 Retry。透過內容物件以 0 到 1 回報進度，可附帶供馬賽克成形的預覽；擲出例外即把該格子標記為失敗。按下 Stop 時內容物件的權杖會被取消。為 null 時使用 `Simulation` 的產生器（如果有）。

trans-unit.source: True while the picked image is expanded over the grid.
trans-unit.target: 選取的圖像展開覆蓋網格時為 true。

trans-unit.source: True while a batch runs (Generate reads Stop).
trans-unit.target: 批次執行時為 true（Generate 顯示為 Stop）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或播報的每一個詞。

trans-unit.source: The models offered as chips. Null or empty offers the simulation's models, or one unnamed model.
trans-unit.target: 作為標籤提供的模型。為 null 或空時提供模擬中的模型，沒有模擬時提供一個未命名的模型。

trans-unit.source: The prompt field's placeholder; null uses `Placeholder`.

trans-unit.source: The prompt (two-way); the field and the suggestions write it. Null starts with the simulation's prompt, if any.

trans-unit.source: The chosen shape's id (two-way); null or unknown chooses the first. It applies to the next generation; the grid keeps the shape of its batch.
trans-unit.target: 所選畫面比例的 id（雙向）；為 null 或未知時選擇第一個。它對下一次生成生效；網格維持本批次的比例。

trans-unit.source: The picked image (the upscaled one after an upscale), or null.
trans-unit.target: 選取的圖像（放大後為放大後的圖像），或 null。

trans-unit.source: The chosen model's id (two-way); null or unknown chooses the first model.
trans-unit.target: 所選模型的 id（雙向）；為 null 或未知時選擇第一個模型。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person picks or clears an image, and with the upscaled image once an upscale finishes. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 使用者選取或取消選取圖像時觸發，放大完成後也會以放大後的圖像觸發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The generator the card plays while `Generator` is null: its prompt, models, suggestions and painter, run exactly like your own generator (four tiles resolving from coarse blocks, Upscale, Vary). Null leaves Generate unavailable instead.
trans-unit.target: `Generator` 為 null 時卡片播放的產生器：它的提示詞、模型、建議與繪製器，執行方式與你自己的產生器完全相同（四個格子從粗略色塊成形、Upscale、Vary）。為 null 時 Generate 無法使用。

trans-unit.source: Prompts offered in the empty grid before the first generation; picking one fills the prompt and generates. Null offers the simulation's, or none.

trans-unit.source: Upscales the picked image while it is expanded; return the new image with its width and height. The token is cancelled when the expanded image closes. Null uses the `Simulation`'s, or keeps the image as it is.
trans-unit.target: 在選取的圖像展開時將其放大；傳回帶有寬度和高度的新圖像。展開的圖像關閉時權杖會被取消。為 null 時使用 `Simulation` 的放大器，沒有模擬時保持圖像原樣。

trans-unit.source: An output shape offered as a chip on an `ImageGeneration` card.

trans-unit.source: Handed to a generator or upscaler: the cancellation of the run and a way to report progress.

trans-unit.source: One generated image.

trans-unit.source: Every word `ImageGeneration` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; text with numbers in it comes from format functions. Image numbers start at 1.
trans-unit.target: `ImageGeneration` 顯示或播報的每一個詞，預設為英文。取代整個物件即可在地化或改寫；帶數字的文字來自格式化函式。圖像編號從 1 開始。

trans-unit.source: A model offered as a chip on an `ImageGeneration` card.
trans-unit.target: 在 `ImageGeneration` 卡片上作為標籤提供的模型。

trans-unit.source: Paints a picture for an `ImageGenerationSimulation`: `width` × `height` opaque BGRA bytes, row by row (width × height × 4). The same prompt and seed should paint the same picture. Called off the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: 為 `ImageGenerationSimulation` 繪製一張圖片：`width` × `height` 的不透明 BGRA 位元組，逐列排列（width × height × 4）。相同的提示詞與種子應繪製相同的圖片。在 UI 執行緒之外呼叫。

trans-unit.source: What `Generator` is asked to make: one image of a batch.
trans-unit.target: 要求 `Generator` 產生的內容：一個批次中的一張圖像。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SelectionChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `SelectionChanged` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: A generator and an upscaler an `ImageGeneration` plays while the app wires no `Generator`, fed by the caller: the prompt it starts with, the models and suggestions on offer, and a `Painter` that paints a picture for a prompt (the same prompt and seed always paint the same picture). Each tile reports progress frame by frame over two to three seconds and resolves from the painted preview; Upscale paints it again at twice the detail over about two seconds. Nothing is downloaded or sent anywhere. Set the data before handing the simulation to the card; to offer other pictures, give the card a new simulation.
trans-unit.target: 在應用程式沒有接上 `Generator` 時由 `ImageGeneration` 播放的產生器與放大器，資料由呼叫端提供：起始的提示詞、可選的模型與建議，以及一個為提示詞繪製圖片的 `Painter`（相同的提示詞與種子總是繪製相同的圖片）。每個格子在兩到三秒內逐影格回報進度，並從繪製的預覽中逐步成形；Upscale 在約兩秒內以兩倍細節重新繪製。不會下載或傳送任何內容。請在把模擬交給卡片之前設定好資料；要提供其他圖片，就給卡片一個新的模擬。

trans-unit.source: An image generation canvas (Arc Image reveal, design reference): the way current image models show a picture forming. A soft, heavily blurred preview made from the image's own colors, with fine film grain, sharpens top to bottom behind a soft-edged band while the rest gently comes into focus; a translucent pill shows a progress ring and the step count; queued and failed jobs get a calm surface with one soft shimmer, or an alert, the message and Retry. Drive it with `Status`, `Progress` and `Source` (coarse progress updates are smoothed into one continuous reveal; without progress it estimates from `Duration`), or hand it a `Generator` that reports progress and returns the image. A `Source` alone is shown finished. For demos, a `Simulation` plays a looping, simulated generation over the pictures it is given; with nothing at all the canvas rests on its plain surface. The canvas fills its container up to 560px wide and keeps `AspectRatio`.
trans-unit.target: 影像生成畫布（Arc Image reveal，設計參考）：以當今影像模型的方式呈現圖片逐漸成形。一張由影像本身顏色產生、帶細緻底片顆粒的高度模糊柔和預覽，在一條邊緣柔和的光帶後方由上而下變清晰，其餘部分慢慢對焦；半透明的膠囊顯示進度環與步數；排隊中與失敗的工作顯示一塊安靜的表面與一道柔和的微光，或警示圖示、錯誤訊息與 Retry。以 `Status`、`Progress` 與 `Source` 驅動它（粗略的進度更新會被平滑成一段連續的顯現；沒有進度時依 `Duration` 估算），或交給它一個回報進度並傳回圖片的 `Generator`。只設定 `Source` 時，圖片直接以完成狀態顯示。用於展示時，`Simulation` 會在傳入的圖片上播放循環的模擬生成；什麼都沒有設定時，畫布停在它的素色表面上。畫布填滿容器，最寬 560px，並維持 `AspectRatio`。

trans-unit.source: The status on screen, in every mode (the simulation's and the generator's too).
trans-unit.target: 畫面上顯示的狀態，適用於所有模式（包括模擬模式與產生器模式）。

trans-unit.target: 在 `Status`、`Generator` 與 `Source` 都為 null 時播放的模擬工作：依 `Duration`、`QueueDuration` 與 `HoldDuration` 的節奏輪流揭示它的圖片。為 null（預設）時畫布停在素色表面上。請給每個控制項各自的模擬執行個體。

trans-unit.source: A simulated image job for an `ImageReveal` that has no `Status`, `Generator` or `Source`, for demos and prototypes. Each run waits in the queue for `QueueDuration` (plus `StartDelay`), generates over `Duration` and reveals one of `Pictures`; with `IsLooping` it holds for `HoldDuration`, blurs back out and runs again with the next picture. The first run shows the picture `Seed` picks (seed 1 the first, seed 2 the second, wrapping), so tiles in a grid differ. Announcements say "simulated". Nothing is generated or downloaded. Create one per control: it keeps its place in the pictures.
trans-unit.target: 用於展示和原型的 `ImageReveal` 模擬影像工作，適用於沒有 `Status`、`Generator` 或 `Source` 的控制項。每次執行先在佇列中等待 `QueueDuration`（加上 `StartDelay`），再於 `Duration` 內生成並揭示 `Pictures` 中的一張；開啟 `IsLooping` 時停留 `HoldDuration`，然後重新模糊淡出，並以下一張圖片再次執行。第一次執行顯示 `Seed` 選中的圖片（種子 1 為第一張，種子 2 為第二張，循環取用），讓格線中的圖塊各不相同。播報會註明 "simulated"。不會生成或下載任何內容。請為每個控制項建立一個執行個體：它會記住自己播放到哪張圖片。

trans-unit.source: A section title that reveals itself when 45% of it scrolls into view (Arc InViewTitle, P18 + P20): opacity leads, the blur clears next and the movement settles last, so the title is readable before it fully arrives. Titles already scrolled past show at once. With `IsReplayEnabled` it hides again (a quick fade with no stagger) when it leaves and replays on every entry. Reduced motion shows the title without movement, blur or masks. Drawn as one control: no per-word controls.
trans-unit.target: 當其 45% 捲動進入視野時自行顯現的章節標題（Arc InViewTitle，P18 + P20）：不透明度先行，模糊隨後消退，位移最後收尾，因此標題在完全到位之前即可閱讀。已捲過的標題會立即顯示。設定 `IsReplayEnabled` 後，標題離開時會再次隱藏（快速淡出，無錯開），並在每次進入時重新播放。減少動態效果時標題直接顯示，不帶位移、模糊或遮罩。它以單一控制項繪製：沒有逐字控制項。

The pointer stirs soft ink tinted with the accent color, which turns neutral as it spreads and fades over a couple of seconds; left alone, a slow, calm stir keeps it alive. Content placed inside sits on top and stays interactive.

trans-unit.source: Arc inline edit: click-to-edit text for names and short fields read far more often than they change. The text turns into a field in place with the same metrics, so nothing around it moves, and the frame grows with what is typed. Enter commits (`TextCommitted`) and saves optimistically through `SaveHandler`: the new text shows at once, quieter until the save lands, then a check draws. Escape cancels and the text rolls back; a failed save restores the last saved `Value`, says why, and offers to try again. Tab or a click elsewhere saves like Enter. Multiline: Shift+Enter adds a line break.
trans-unit.target: Arc 行內編輯：點擊即可編輯，適用於名稱與短欄位這類經常閱讀、卻很少變動的文字。文字會就地轉為欄位，度量保持一致，因此周圍內容不會移動，框架會隨輸入內容增長。Enter 提交（`TextCommitted`），並透過 `SaveHandler` 樂觀儲存：新文字立即顯示，儲存完成前稍顯淡化，隨後繪製一個勾號。Escape 取消並回復文字；儲存失敗時會還原上一次儲存的 `Value`，說明原因，並提供重試。Tab 或點擊其他位置與 Enter 一樣儲存。多行模式下，Shift+Enter 新增換行。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an edit is cancelled with Escape or the cancel button.

trans-unit.source: True while the field is open.

trans-unit.source: Wraps onto several lines and grows in height; Enter still saves, Shift+Enter adds a line break.
trans-unit.target: 換行並可增加高度；Enter 仍會儲存，Shift+Enter 新增換行。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name, for example "Project name".
trans-unit.target: 無障礙名稱，例如「Project name」。

trans-unit.source: Where the control is in its save cycle.
trans-unit.target: 控制項所處的儲存週期階段。

trans-unit.source: Shown while the value is empty.

trans-unit.source: Keeps room after a single line for the save and cancel buttons (66 px; default true), so the box is the same width at rest and while editing. False lets the box hug its text, so a tag or badge can follow the name: the rest state then draws nothing past the frame (no pencil, saving spinner or result mark; the half-opacity text, the failed-save message and the announcements remain), and while editing the buttons overlay what follows, with the control drawn above its later siblings in the same panel. The reserve does not come back while editing, so neither the text nor the content after it moves when the buttons appear. A multiline field fills its line and keeps its 38 px reserve.
trans-unit.target: 在單行文字後面為儲存與取消按鈕保留空間（66 px；預設 true），使框在靜止時與編輯時寬度相同。設為 False 時框緊貼文字，名稱後面可以緊接標籤或徽章：此時靜止狀態在框外不繪製任何東西（沒有鉛筆、儲存中的載入指示或結果標記；半透明的文字、儲存失敗的訊息與播報仍然保留），編輯時按鈕覆蓋在後面的內容上，控制項繪製在同一面板中排在它後面的元素之上。保留空間不會在編輯時恢復，因此按鈕出現時，文字與它後面的內容都不會移動。多行欄位佔滿整列，保留 38 px。

trans-unit.source: The retry link after a failed save.
trans-unit.target: 儲存失敗後的重試連結。

trans-unit.source: Arc input: a single-line field with a visible label, helper and error rows that open on a spring and rewrite only the words that change, and the Arc frame states (hover and focus darken the border, an error turns it danger, disabled fades). Everything from Avalonia's TextBox is kept: caret, selection, IME, undo, clipboard and a two-way `Text`.

trans-unit.source: A "get started in 30 seconds" card for SDK onboarding (Arc Install snippet, design reference): framework tabs, three numbered steps (Install, Add your key, Ship) and highlighted snippets that take a developer from install to the first event. Step 1 offers npm, pnpm, yarn and bun when the framework installs packages; every snippet has a copy button; Generate key wipes a fresh key into the placeholder in place. Snippets, file names and step lines crossfade in space that is reserved for the longest of them, so switching frameworks never moves anything. Give it your `Frameworks` (write `{{key}}` where the key goes) and a `KeyGenerator` that creates a real key, or pass `ApiKey` for a reader who already has one. With no frameworks it shows the SDK of its `Simulation`, if any, and otherwise the three steps with empty snippets; with no generator it invents keys (nothing is sent, and step 2 says so).
trans-unit.target: 用於 SDK 引導的「30 秒上手」卡片（Arc Install snippet，設計參考）：框架分頁、三個編號步驟（安裝、新增金鑰、上線）和語法標示的程式碼片段，帶開發者從安裝走到第一個事件。當框架透過套件安裝時，步驟 1 提供 npm、pnpm、yarn 和 bun；每段片段都有複製按鈕；「產生金鑰」會把新金鑰就地擦入預留位置。片段、檔名和步驟說明在為其中最長者預留的空間裡交叉淡化，因此切換框架不會移動任何東西。傳入你的 `Frameworks`（在金鑰所在位置寫 `{{key}}`）和能建立真實金鑰的 `KeyGenerator`，或為已有金鑰的讀者傳入 `ApiKey`。沒有框架時顯示其 `Simulation` 的 SDK（如果有），否則顯示三個步驟與空白的程式碼片段；沒有產生器時會編造金鑰（不傳送任何內容，步驟 2 會據實說明）。

trans-unit.target: 讀者自己的金鑰。設定後，各片段顯示該金鑰，「產生金鑰」按鈕隱藏，適用於已登入且已有金鑰的讀者。

trans-unit.source: A directory of the apps a workspace can connect (Arc Integrations, design reference): a heading and a search field, a row of filters (All, Connected and one per category, each with its count), and one row per app with its mark, name, category, description and a status pill. Connect runs `ConnectAction` (the pill spins, then turns into a green "Connected" and a settings button slides in; a failure shows Retry). The name or the settings button opens a drawer with the permissions, the sync frequency and a hold-to-disconnect button. Search and filters reflow the list: leaving rows fade where they were, the others glide to their place and the list's height follows.
trans-unit.target: 工作區可連線的應用程式目錄（Arc Integrations，設計參考）：包含標題和搜尋欄位、一排篩選項（All、Connected 以及每個類別一項，各附數量），以及每個應用程式一列，顯示其標誌、名稱、類別、描述和狀態膠囊。連線會執行 `ConnectAction`（膠囊旋轉，然後變為綠色的 "Connected"，同時滑入一個設定按鈕；失敗時顯示 Retry）。點擊名稱或設定按鈕會開啟抽屜，其中有權限、同步頻率和一個長按中斷連線的按鈕。搜尋和篩選會讓清單重新排版：離開的列在原處淡出，其餘列滑向各自的位置，清單高度隨之變化。

trans-unit.source: Connects an app: awaited while its pill spins, with the request and a token that `CancelConnect` (or the block leaving the window) cancels. Return `Connected` or `Failed`; throwing fails too, a cancellation returns the app to idle. Null waits `SimulatedConnectDuration` and succeeds (a demo).

trans-unit.source: Run when a connect starts, with the `IntegrationItem` as the parameter; when it cannot execute the connect does not start.

trans-unit.source: Raised before a connect starts; setting `Cancel` keeps it from starting.

trans-unit.source: Disconnects an app after the hold completed (or `DisconnectAsync`); throwing keeps it connected. Null disconnects at once.

trans-unit.source: Raised when the checked filter changes.

trans-unit.source: A form for inviting people to a workspace. Type a name or an address and pick from the directory, or paste a whole list: every person becomes a chip with a role, and entries that cannot be invited become red chips that say why (select one to fix it). A seat meter counts members, pending invites and the new chips against the plan, and offers the next plan when they run over. Send moves the chips into the pending list below, where each invite can be sent again or revoked; when an invite is accepted its row leaves and the person joins the team avatars in the header. Server work goes through `SendAction`, `ResendAction`, `RevokeAction` and `UpgradeAction`; `MarkDelivered` and `MarkJoined` report what happened later.
trans-unit.target: 用於邀請人員加入工作區的表單。輸入姓名或地址並從通訊錄中選擇，或貼上整份清單：每個人都會成為帶有角色的標籤，無法邀請的項目會變成紅色標籤並說明原因（選取它即可修正）。席位計量條會依方案統計成員、待接受的邀請和新增的標籤，超出時會提供下一個方案。傳送會把標籤移到下方的待接受清單，其中每個邀請都可以重新傳送或撤銷；邀請被接受後，對應的列會消失，此人會加入標頭中的團隊頭像。伺服器端的工作透過 `SendAction`、`ResendAction`、`RevokeAction` 和 `UpgradeAction` 完成；`MarkDelivered` 和 `MarkJoined` 用於回報之後發生的情況。

trans-unit.source: The plan in use; its seat limit is the meter's maximum. Null uses the first of `Plans`.
trans-unit.target: 正在使用的方案；其席位上限即計量條的最大值。為 null 時使用 `Plans` 中的第一個。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行文字；為 null 時省略。

trans-unit.source: The people who can be found by name or email, when you give them as a list to follow; it wins over `Directory`.
trans-unit.target: 可依姓名或電子郵件尋找的人員，以可追蹤變化的清單提供；優先於 `Directory`。

trans-unit.source: The chips in the field, in order.
trans-unit.target: 輸入欄中的標籤，依順序排列。

trans-unit.source: The chips changed (added, removed, a role changed).
trans-unit.target: 標籤發生了變化（新增、移除、角色變更）。

trans-unit.source: The example domain of the "incomplete domain" message; null takes the domain of the first directory address.
trans-unit.target: 「incomplete domain」訊息中的範例網域；為 null 時取通訊錄中第一個地址的網域。

trans-unit.source: An accepted invite left the list and its person joined the team (`Members`).
trans-unit.target: 已接受的邀請離開了清單，此人加入了團隊（`Members`）。

trans-unit.source: An invite was sent again.
trans-unit.target: 邀請已重新傳送。

trans-unit.source: An invite was revoked.
trans-unit.target: 邀請已被撤銷。

trans-unit.source: Invites went out (`SendAction` completed).
trans-unit.target: 邀請已送出（`SendAction` 已完成）。

trans-unit.source: True (default) draws a card at most 600 wide with a border; false lays the block flat at the container's width.
trans-unit.target: 為 True（預設）時繪製最寬 600 的帶邊框卡片；為 false 時以容器的寬度平鋪該區塊。

trans-unit.source: True when `SeatsUsed` is more than the plan's limit (Send is held back).
trans-unit.target: 當 `SeatsUsed` 超過方案上限時為 True（傳送會被攔下）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the reset button beside Send (it calls `Reset`).
trans-unit.target: 在傳送按鈕旁顯示重設按鈕（它會呼叫 `Reset`）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 該區塊顯示或播報的每一個字詞。

trans-unit.source: How many people a query lists at most (5).
trans-unit.target: 一次查詢最多列出多少人（5）。

trans-unit.source: The plan changed after an upgrade.
trans-unit.target: 方案在升級後發生了變化。

trans-unit.source: The plans, smallest first: the next one after `CurrentPlan` is offered when the seats run over.
trans-unit.target: 各方案，由小到大排列：席位超出時會提供 `CurrentPlan` 之後的下一個。

trans-unit.target: 重新傳送一個邀請；發生例外時按鈕維持原樣並播報失敗。

trans-unit.source: `Reset` ran (the reset button or code); simulations that drive the block should stop.

trans-unit.source: Revokes one invite (the row leaves first); an exception puts the row back.
trans-unit.target: 撤銷一個邀請（該列先離開）；發生例外時該列會放回原處。

trans-unit.source: A chip's role was picked from its menu.

trans-unit.target: 「Paste a sample list」按鈕貼上的清單；為 null 時隱藏該按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Seats in use: members, pending invites and the chips that can be invited.
trans-unit.target: 已佔用的席位：成員、待接受的邀請以及可以邀請的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Sends the invites (called after the rows were added as "Sending"). Report deliveries with `MarkDelivered`; rows still sending when the task completes are marked sent. An exception takes the rows back and returns the chips to the field. Null sends nothing and marks the rows sent at once.
trans-unit.target: 傳送邀請（在各列以「Sending」新增後呼叫）。用 `MarkDelivered` 回報送達情況；工作完成時仍在傳送的列會被標記為已傳送。發生例外時會收回這些列，並把標籤放回輸入欄。為 null 時不傳送任何內容，並立即把各列標記為已傳送。

trans-unit.target: 在傳送邀請時、`SendAction` 之前執行，以 `InvitePeopleSendRequest` 作為其參數。

trans-unit.source: `SendAction` threw; the rows were taken back and the chips are in the field again.

trans-unit.target: 空輸入欄的「Suggested」清單顯示多少人（4）。

trans-unit.source: The heading; null leaves it out.

trans-unit.source: Moves the workspace to the given plan; the block switches when the task completes. An exception keeps the plan.
trans-unit.target: 把工作區切換到指定的方案；工作完成時該區塊隨之切換。發生例外時維持原方案。

trans-unit.target: 人們加入的工作區（用於有人接受邀請時的播報）。

trans-unit.source: A chip in the field: a person to invite with a role, or an entry that cannot be invited (with the text as typed and the reason). Selecting an invalid chip puts its text back into the field for editing.
trans-unit.target: 輸入欄中的一個標籤：一位帶有角色的受邀者，或一個無法邀請的項目（帶有輸入的原文和原因）。選取無效標籤會把它的文字放回輸入欄以便編輯。

trans-unit.source: The invited person (a directory person, or one made from a typed address).
trans-unit.target: 受邀的人（通訊錄中的人員，或由輸入的地址產生的人員）。

trans-unit.source: The role the person will join with.
trans-unit.target: 此人將以此角色加入。

trans-unit.source: When it was sent, in words ("2 days ago"); null says "just now". The row shows "Sent {SentText}".
trans-unit.target: 傳送時間，以文字表示（「2 days ago」）；為 null 時顯示「just now」。該列顯示「Sent {SentText}」。

trans-unit.source: Sending, sent or joined.
trans-unit.target: Sending、sent 或 joined。

trans-unit.source: A person `InvitePeople` knows: someone in the workspace directory, a member of the team, or the person an invite went to. People are matched by `Email` (case-insensitive), so the same address in `Directory` and `Members` is the same person.
trans-unit.target: `InvitePeople` 認識的一個人：工作區通訊錄中的某人、團隊成員，或收到邀請的人。人員依 `Email`（不分大小寫）比對，因此 `Directory` 和 `Members` 中相同的地址即同一個人。

trans-unit.source: The portrait; null shows the initials on the muted surface.
trans-unit.target: 頭像照片；為 null 時在柔和色表面上顯示姓名首字母。

trans-unit.source: The email address; the person's identity and what an invite is sent to.

trans-unit.source: The full name ("Clara Weiss"); suggestions match it as a substring, a pasted full name finds the person.

trans-unit.source: True for the role new chips start with (the first role marked default wins; none marked = the first role).
trans-unit.target: 新標籤起始使用的角色為 True（第一個標記為預設的角色優先；都沒有標記則取第一個角色）。

trans-unit.source: The role's name, shown on the chip's role button and in the pending row ("Member").
trans-unit.target: 角色名稱，顯示在標籤的角色按鈕和待接受列中（「Member」）。

trans-unit.source: What `SendAction` receives: the invites that were just added to the pending list.
trans-unit.target: `SendAction` 收到的內容：剛剛新增到待接受清單中的邀請。

trans-unit.source: A journey as a Sankey chart: stages left to right, the people at each step as bars and the flows between steps as ribbons, with the people who leave below the main path and the goal in green. Point at a step or a flow to trace that cohort through the whole journey (where they came from, where they went) with a tooltip; click a step to keep it traced and read its details in the side panel (where people came from and went next); switch segments (channels, cohorts) and every bar, ribbon and count morphs to the new numbers. Under the chart, a "Flow table" lists every flow.
trans-unit.target: 以桑基圖呈現的旅程:階段從左到右排列,每一步的人數為長條,步驟之間的流向為帶狀連線,離開的人位於主路徑下方,目標以綠色表示。指向某一步或某條流向,即可在工具提示中追蹤該世代走完整個旅程的情況(從哪裡來、到哪裡去);點擊某一步可保持追蹤,並在側面板中檢視其詳情(人們從哪裡來、接著去了哪裡);切換分段(管道、世代)時,每個長條、帶狀連線和計數都會轉場變形為新的數字。圖表下方有一個 "Flow table" 列出每條流向。

trans-unit.source: What is announced when the segment changes; `{0}` segment, `{1}` visitors, `{2}` goal count. Default "{0}: {1} visits and {2} reached the goal."
trans-unit.target: 分段改變時播報的內容;`{0}` 為分段,`{1}` 為訪客數,`{2}` 為達成目標的人數。預設 "{0}: {1} visits and {2} reached the goal."

trans-unit.source: Spoken name of the chart (its node buttons form one group). Default "Journey steps".
trans-unit.target: 圖表的朗讀名稱(其節點按鈕構成一個群組)。預設 "Journey steps"。

trans-unit.source: The label of the button that clears the selection. Default "Clear".
trans-unit.target: 清除選取的按鈕的標籤。預設 "Clear"。

trans-unit.source: A count of people in the tooltip and spoken names; `{0}` is the formatted count. Default "{0} users".
trans-unit.target: 工具提示和朗讀名稱中的人數;`{0}` 為格式化後的數量。預設 "{0} users"。

trans-unit.source: The overview's first group: the biggest exits before the last stage. Default "Biggest drop-offs".

trans-unit.target: 總覽中目標占訪客比例之後的文字。預設 "of visitors reached the goal"。

trans-unit.source: People who reached a goal node in the shown segment.
trans-unit.target: 所顯示分段中到達目標節點的人數。

trans-unit.source: The link previewed now (pointer over its ribbon); null when none.

trans-unit.source: The node previewed now (pointer over it, or keyboard focus on it); null when none.

trans-unit.source: A selected node's first group: where its people came from. Default "Arrived from".

trans-unit.source: Shows the side panel. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示側面板。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: The flow table is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 流向表格已展開(雙向)。

trans-unit.source: Shows the "Flow table" button and table. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示 "Flow table" 按鈕和表格。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: The line when a selected node has nothing flowing out. Default "The journey stops here".
trans-unit.target: 所選節點沒有任何流出時的文字。預設 "The journey stops here"。

trans-unit.source: The line when a selected node has nothing flowing in. Default "The journey begins here".
trans-unit.target: 所選節點沒有任何流入時的文字。預設 "The journey begins here"。

trans-unit.source: Formats the shares on the chart's node labels (fractions 0–1); null rounds to whole percents ("32%").

trans-unit.source: A selected node's second group: where its people went. Default "Moved on to".

trans-unit.source: The overview's second group: the last stage's nodes. Null uses the last stage's header.
trans-unit.target: 總覽的第二組:最後階段的節點。為 null 時使用最後階段的標題。

trans-unit.source: The overview's note under its title.
trans-unit.target: 總覽標題下方的說明。

trans-unit.source: Spoken name of the side panel. Default "Step details".
trans-unit.target: 側面板的朗讀名稱。預設 "Step details"。

trans-unit.source: Runs when the user switches segments; the parameter is the new segment.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者切換分段時執行;參數為新的分段。

trans-unit.source: Spoken name of the segment switch. Default "Segment".
trans-unit.target: 分段切換器的朗讀名稱。預設 "Segment"。

trans-unit.source: Segments used instead of `Segments` when set (an observable collection is followed).
trans-unit.target: 設定後將使用它取代 `Segments` 的分段(可觀察集合會被追蹤)。

trans-unit.source: The selected node (two-way): kept traced, detailed in the side panel, kept across segments. Null for none.

trans-unit.source: A collapsible tree for JSON. Values are colored by type, branches unfold row by row on a smooth spring, search highlights every match and opens the branches that hold them, long arrays and objects load in pages, and each row can copy its value or path. Follows the WAI-ARIA tree pattern: arrows move and open, Home/End jump, Enter/Space toggle, Ctrl/Cmd+C copies the current value (Shift: its path) and / focuses the search. Rows are a flat, virtualized list (see `TablesTreeRowsPanel`), so very large documents stay smooth. Input: `Json` (text), `Value` (`JsonNode`) or `Element`.
trans-unit.target: 用於 JSON 的可摺疊樹狀結構。值依類型著色，分支以平滑彈簧逐列展開，搜尋會醒目標示每個符合項並展開包含符合項的分支，長陣列與物件分頁載入，每一列都可複製其值或路徑。遵循 WAI-ARIA 樹狀模式：方向鍵移動與展開，Home/End 跳轉，Enter/Space 切換展開，Ctrl/Cmd+C 複製目前的值（Shift：複製其路徑），/ 聚焦搜尋。列是一個扁平的虛擬化清單（參見 `TablesTreeRowsPanel`），因此非常大的文件依然流暢。輸入：`Json`（文字）、`Value`（`JsonNode`）或 `Element`。

trans-unit.source: Routed event behind Copied; the argument carries the copy kind, the node path and the copied text.
trans-unit.target: Copied 對應的路由事件；引數包含複製類型、節點路徑與複製的文字。

trans-unit.source: Path of the current row.
trans-unit.target: 目前列的路徑。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row becomes the current one (Arc `onSelect`).
trans-unit.target: 某一列成為目前列時觸發（Arc `onSelect`）。

trans-unit.source: A `JsonElement` to show (cloned, so its document may be disposed afterwards).
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的 `JsonElement`（會被複製，因此之後其文件可以被釋放）。

trans-unit.target: 資料到達時展開的層級（1 表示展開根節點）。

trans-unit.source: Why `Json` could not be parsed, or null.
trans-unit.target: `Json` 無法解析的原因；否則為 null。

trans-unit.source: Search text (two-way). Matching is case-insensitive over keys and primitive values.

trans-unit.source: Padding around the rows of the tree.
trans-unit.target: 樹列區域的內距。

trans-unit.source: A `JsonNode` to show.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的 `JsonNode`。

trans-unit.source: A team board of status columns where cards lift, tilt with the pointer's speed and spring into the slot that opens for them. Group it by person for swimlanes; columns can carry work-in-progress limits that update live while a card is dragged; every column has quick add, and a card opens into a details drawer for its title, status, owner, notes and checklist. Cards move with the mouse, pen, touch (after a short hold) or the keyboard (Space, arrows, Space), and every pick up, move and drop is announced. The card list's order is the order inside every column: persist `CardsChanged`'s snapshot to keep the board as the user left it.
trans-unit.target: 團隊看板：由狀態欄組成，卡片被拿起後會隨指標速度傾斜，並落入為其開啟的時段。依人員分組即可顯示泳道；欄可設定在製品上限，拖曳卡片時即時更新；每欄都有快速新增，點選卡片會開啟詳情抽屜，可編輯其標題、狀態、負責人、備註和步驟。卡片可用滑鼠、觸控筆、觸控（短按後）或鍵盤（空格、方向鍵、空格）移動，每次拿起、移動和放下都會播報。卡片清單的順序即每欄內的順序：請持久化 `CardsChanged` 的快照，以保留使用者離開時的看板狀態。

trans-unit.source: Adds an "Unassigned" entry to the owner menu (cards without an owner always get their own swimlane).
trans-unit.target: 在負責人選單中新增一個 "Unassigned" 項目（沒有負責人的卡片一律擁有自己的泳道）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after quick add created a card.
trans-unit.target: 快速新增建立卡片後引發。

trans-unit.source: Runs after quick add created a card (parameter: the new `KanbanCard`).
trans-unit.target: 快速新增建立卡片後執行（參數：新的 `KanbanCard`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised before quick add creates a card; change its key or title, or cancel it.
trans-unit.target: 快速新增建立卡片之前引發；可變更其鍵或標題，也可取消。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a drag ended without a drop and the card is going back.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳在未放下的情況下結束、卡片正在退回時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a card lifted.
trans-unit.target: 卡片被拿起後引發。

trans-unit.target: 在抽屜中編輯卡片的標題或備註時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a card is clicked or Enter is pressed on it; set Handled to keep the drawer closed.
trans-unit.target: 點選卡片或在卡片上按下 Enter 時引發；設定 Handled 可使抽屜保持關閉。

trans-unit.source: Runs when a card is clicked or Enter is pressed on it (parameter: the `KanbanCard`).
trans-unit.target: 點選卡片或在卡片上按下 Enter 時執行（參數：`KanbanCard`）。

trans-unit.source: Makes the id of a card created with quick add; null continues the highest number ("FLD-244" → "FLD-245").
trans-unit.target: 為透過快速新增建立的卡片產生編號；null 則延續最大的數字（"FLD-244" → "FLD-245"）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a card moved (dropped, or its status or owner changed in the drawer).

trans-unit.source: Runs after a card was moved (parameter: the `KanbanCardMovedEventArgs`).

trans-unit.source: Raised before a lifted card is dropped; set Cancel to send it back.
trans-unit.target: 被拿起的卡片放下之前引發；設定 Cancel 可使其退回。

trans-unit.source: The cards in board order (the order inside every column). Use it in XAML; `CardsSource` wins when set.
trans-unit.target: 依看板順序排列的卡片（即每欄內的順序）。在 XAML 中使用；設定後 `CardsSource` 優先。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every move, edit, checklist change or new card, with the full card list in board order.

trans-unit.source: A collection of `KanbanCard`s that replaces `Cards` (observed when it raises collection changes). A writable list is reordered in place on every drop and quick add; a read-only one is left alone and the board keeps its own order (persist `CardsChanged`).
trans-unit.target: 取代 `Cards` 的 `KanbanCard` 集合（在其引發集合變更時被監聽）。可寫入的清單會在每次放下和快速新增時就地重新排序；唯讀清單則維持不變，看板保留自己的順序（請持久化 `CardsChanged`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a checklist step was ticked or unticked in the drawer.
trans-unit.target: 在抽屜中勾選或取消勾選步驟時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a column went over its limit or came back under it (committed changes, not drag previews).
trans-unit.target: 欄超出其上限或回落到上限之內時引發（僅針對已提交的變更，不包括拖曳預覽）。

trans-unit.source: The status columns, left to right.
trans-unit.target: 狀態欄，由左至右排列。

trans-unit.source: The column width of a compact board (Arc: 235).
trans-unit.target: 精簡看板的欄寬（Arc：235）。

trans-unit.source: At this width and below the board is compact: narrow columns, tighter paddings, sideways snapping (Arc: 560).
trans-unit.target: 在此寬度及以下時看板為精簡模式：欄變窄、內距收緊、橫向貼齊（Arc：560）。

trans-unit.source: The person new cards belong to (and whose swimlane quick add opens in); null uses the first person.
trans-unit.target: 新卡片所屬的人（快速新增將在其泳道中開啟）；null 則使用第一位人員。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the details drawer closed.
trans-unit.target: 詳情抽屜關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the details drawer opened for a card.
trans-unit.target: 為卡片開啟詳情抽屜時引發。

trans-unit.source: How far a mouse or pen must move before a pressed card lifts (Arc: 5).
trans-unit.target: 滑鼠或觸控筆需移動多遠，按下的卡片才會被拿起（Arc：5）。

trans-unit.source: The lifted card, or null.
trans-unit.target: 被拿起的卡片，或 null。

trans-unit.source: The widest the details drawer gets; it is never wider than the board minus 16 (Arc: 400).
trans-unit.target: 詳情抽屜的最大寬度；它永遠不會超過看板寬度減 16（Arc：400）。

trans-unit.source: Status columns only, or one swimlane per person; switching flies every card to its new place.
trans-unit.target: 僅依狀態欄，或每人一條泳道；切換時每張卡片都會飛到其新位置。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the grouping changed.
trans-unit.target: 分組方式變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: True while the board is at or below `CompactWidth`.
trans-unit.target: 看板寬度位於 `CompactWidth` 或以下時為 True。

trans-unit.source: Opens the details drawer when a card is clicked or Enter is pressed on it (false only raises `CardInvoked`).
trans-unit.target: 點選卡片或在卡片上按下 Enter 時開啟詳情抽屜（為 false 時僅引發 `CardInvoked`）。

trans-unit.source: Lets cards be dragged (pointer, touch and keyboard).
trans-unit.target: 允許拖曳卡片（指標、觸控和鍵盤）。

trans-unit.source: True while a card is lifted (pointer, touch or keyboard).
trans-unit.target: 卡片被拿起期間（指標、觸控或鍵盤）為 True。

trans-unit.source: Shows the "+" buttons and the Add card rows.
trans-unit.target: 顯示 "+" 按鈕和 "Add card" 行。

trans-unit.source: No dragging, no quick add and no edits; the drawer still opens and shows the card.
trans-unit.target: 不可拖曳、不可快速新增、不可編輯；抽屜仍會開啟並顯示卡片。

trans-unit.source: The labels cards can carry (the dot color and the name).
trans-unit.target: 卡片可攜帶的標籤（圓點顏色與名稱）。

trans-unit.source: The narrowest a column gets on a wide board; narrower boards scroll sideways (Arc: 251).

trans-unit.source: The documents an assistant can search and quote, on one card: totals and an Add files button over a drop zone, the document list with each file's stage (queued, uploading, parsing, embedding, ready or failed), a progress ring, its chunk count and date, Re-index and Delete (with an inline confirmation), Retry on a failed row, and a search preview that ranks the indexed passages for a question and marks the words that matched. Without an `IndexHandler` the card runs a simulated pipeline that splits each document's `Text` into chunks; without a `SearchHandler` it searches those chunks with BM25. Set both to connect your own storage, parser, embeddings and vector search. With no documents of your own and `IsSampleData` left on, the card shows the invented Kestrel Lane library (`KnowledgeBaseSamples`).
trans-unit.target: 一張卡片列出助理可以搜尋和引用的文件：頁首有總計和「Add files」按鈕，下方是拖放區；文件清單顯示每個檔案的階段（排隊、上傳、解析、向量化、就緒或失敗）、進度環、分塊數和日期，以及「Re-index」和「Delete」（帶列內確認），失敗的列有「Retry」；搜尋預覽會為一個問題替已索引的段落排序，並標出相符的字詞。沒有 `IndexHandler` 時，卡片執行一個模擬流程，把每個文件的 `Text` 分成分塊；沒有 `SearchHandler` 時，它用 BM25 搜尋這些分塊。兩者都設定後即可接入你自己的儲存、解析、向量和向量搜尋。沒有你自己的文件且 `IsSampleData` 保持開啟時，卡片顯示虛構的 Kestrel Lane 資料庫（`KnowledgeBaseSamples`）。

trans-unit.source: An overview of KPI cards that open in place: each card shows a metric's value on the last day, its change against the prior period and a sparkline; choosing a card grows it into a detail view (a trend chart with the prior period dashed behind it, a readout under the pointer or keyboard cursor, a sentence about the metric and a breakdown table by dimension) and Escape folds it back. A range switch (7 / 30 / 90 days) morphs every line and rolls every number; the Compare toggle shows or hides the prior period. The block contains no data: give it `Metrics` (each a daily series ending on `EndDate`, at least twice the longest range long) and, for the breakdown, `Dimensions` with matching `Breakdowns`. Keyboard: Tab reaches Compare, the range switch and each card; Enter or Space opens a card and moves focus to the close button; in the detail view Tab reaches the close button, the chart (← / → move the cursor by a day, Home and End jump to the ends) and the dimension switch. Escape closes the detail view from anywhere on the page and returns focus to the card.
trans-unit.target: 原地展開的 KPI 卡片概覽：每張卡片顯示指標在最後一天的值、與上一週期相比的變化以及迷你趨勢線；選擇一張卡片會將其放大為詳細檢視（趨勢圖，上一週期以虛線置於其後；指標或鍵盤游標下的讀數卡；一句關於該指標的說明；依維度劃分的明細表），按 Escape 則摺疊回去。範圍切換器（7 / 30 / 90 天）使每條線形變、每個數字滾動；Compare 開關顯示或隱藏上一週期。此元件不含資料：請提供 `Metrics`（每個都是截止於 `EndDate` 的每日序列，長度至少為最長範圍的兩倍），如需明細，再提供 `Dimensions` 及對應的 `Breakdowns`。鍵盤：Tab 依序到達 Compare、範圍切換器和各張卡片；Enter 或 Space 開啟卡片並將焦點移到關閉按鈕；在詳細檢視中，Tab 依序到達關閉按鈕、圖表（← / → 依天移動游標，Home 和 End 跳到兩端）和維度切換器。Escape 可在頁面任何位置關閉詳細檢視並將焦點還給該卡片。

trans-unit.source: One collection of cards and six ways to look at it: a grid, a masonry wall, a list, a fanned stack, a 3D carousel and a helix. Switching the view flies every card to its new place on its own spring, starting from the option you chose and spreading outward; pointing at a card lifts it and shows it in the bottom panel, and selecting a card turns it into a detail with a picture, a description, facts and an action. The carousel and helix turn by dragging, flicking, the wheel or the keys and always settle on a card.
trans-unit.target: 一組卡片，以及檢視它的六種方式：格狀、瀑布牆、清單、扇形堆疊、3D 輪播與螺旋。切換檢視時，每張卡片都會以各自的彈簧飛向新位置，從你選擇的選項開始並向外擴散；指向卡片會將其抬起並在底部面板中顯示，選取卡片則會將其變為詳情，包含圖片、描述、事實與操作。輪播與螺旋可透過拖曳、輕彈、滾輪或按鍵旋轉，並且總會停在一張卡片上。

trans-unit.source: A list of leads ranked by score, with the reasons behind each score and the stage each lead is in. Stage tabs, a search and a score band narrow the table; choosing a row opens the lead's score breakdown (fit, engagement and intent factors, each with its points) beside it; a stage switch there, or the bulk bar for several selected rows, moves leads between stages. With no leads the block shows a built-in invented pipeline. Give it `Leads` and `Stages` to show your own; `LeadsMoved` reports every move so you can save it.

trans-unit.source: The lowest score that counts as warm (50); below it a lead is cold.
trans-unit.target: 算作溫和的最低分數（50）；低於它為冷門。

trans-unit.source: One reason behind a lead's score: a short label and the points it adds (or, when negative, takes away).
trans-unit.target: 分數背後的一個原因：一句簡短說明和它加上（為負時減去）的分數。

trans-unit.source: A lead: a person at a company, the stage they are in and the factors that make up their score.
trans-unit.target: 一位潛在客戶：某家公司的一個人、所在階段，以及組成分數的各個因素。

trans-unit.source: A stage of the lead pipeline ("New", "Working", "Qualified").
trans-unit.target: 銷售管道中的一個階段（"New"、"Working"、"Qualified"）。

trans-unit.source: A grid of pictures that opens any of them full screen. The chosen tile grows into the lightbox, the picture opening out of the tile's crop to its whole frame, and shrinks back into its tile on close, even after moving to another picture. In the lightbox, arrows, the arrow keys or a sideways swipe move between pictures; the wheel, a trackpad or touch pinch, a double click or the zoom buttons zoom in about the pointer, and a zoomed picture is dragged to look around. Escape, the close button, a click beside the picture or pulling it up or down closes it.
trans-unit.target: 一個可以全螢幕打開任意照片的網格。被選取的方塊放大成燈箱，照片從方塊的裁切畫面展開成完整畫面；關閉時縮回它的方塊，即使中途切換到了別的照片。在燈箱中，用箭頭、方向鍵或左右滑動切換照片；滾輪、觸控板或觸控螢幕的雙指縮放、雙擊或放大按鈕會圍繞指標放大，放大後可以拖曳查看。Escape、關閉按鈕、點擊照片旁邊，或把照片向上或向下拉開都會關閉燈箱。

trans-unit.source: The backdrop behind the lightbox, set by the theme (near black, whatever the theme).
trans-unit.target: 燈箱後面的背景，由主題設定（無論哪種主題都接近黑色）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the close button (default "Close").
trans-unit.target: 關閉按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設 "Close"）。

trans-unit.source: A fixed number of columns; 0 (default) fits as many as `MinTileWidth` allows.
trans-unit.target: 固定的列數；0（預設）按 `MinTileWidth` 放下盡可能多的列。

trans-unit.target: 讀出照片的方式；{0} 是它的位置，{1} 是照片總數（預設 "Photo {0} of {1}"）。

trans-unit.source: True while the lightbox is open (or opening).

trans-unit.source: True while the open picture is zoomed in.
trans-unit.target: 打開的照片被放大時為 true。

trans-unit.source: The gallery's and the lightbox's accessible name (default "Photos").
trans-unit.target: 網格和燈箱的無障礙名稱（預設 "Photos"）。

trans-unit.target: 下一張按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設 "Next photo"）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the previous button (default "Previous photo").
trans-unit.target: 上一張按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設 "Previous photo"）。

trans-unit.source: Space between tiles, set by the theme.
trans-unit.target: 方塊之間的間距，由主題設定。
