trans-unit.target: 方塊的寬除以高（預設 1，正方形）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the zoom in button (default "Zoom in").
trans-unit.target: 放大按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設 "Zoom in"）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the zoom out button (default "Zoom out").
trans-unit.target: 縮小按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設 "Zoom out"）。

trans-unit.source: Arc's line chart: one or more measures over time with series toggles, a crosshair that glides between points and a tooltip that follows on its own spring. Lines draw in from the left the first time the chart is seen, and a new range morphs every line from the shape on screen (resampled on shared x positions) while the value axis springs to its new range and the gridlines ride it. A hidden series flattens into the baseline as it fades. Motion is code-driven (`MotionValue` and a per-point spring array) because every animated value is a coordinate inside one self-drawn geometry, which ControlTheme transitions cannot express.
trans-unit.target: Arc 折線圖：一個或多個隨時間變化的度量，帶有系列切換、在資料點之間滑動的十字游標，以及依自身彈簧跟隨的提示框。圖表首次出現時，線條從左側繪製出現；切換到新範圍時，每條線會從畫面上的形狀變形（在共用的 x 位置上重新取樣），同時數值軸以彈簧移動到新範圍，網格線隨之移動。隱藏的系列會在淡出時壓平到基線。動態效果由程式碼驅動（`MotionValue` 加上每個點的彈簧陣列），因為每個動畫值都是同一幅自繪幾何圖形中的一個座標，而 ControlTheme 過渡無法表達這一點。

trans-unit.source: Smooth monotone curves that never swing past the data, or straight segments.
trans-unit.target: 平滑的單調曲線（不會超出資料範圍），或直線段。

trans-unit.source: Keys of hidden series. Two-way; the legend toggles it.
trans-unit.target: 隱藏系列的鍵。雙向繫結；圖例可切換其顯示狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a series; the argument carries the hidden series keys.
trans-unit.target: 圖例顯示或隱藏系列時引發；引數包含隱藏系列的鍵。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the current shapes on screen, dimmed and breathing, while the next range loads.
trans-unit.target: 載入下一個範圍期間，保留目前圖形並使其變暗、呈呼吸效果。

trans-unit.source: Horizontal gridlines at the value ticks.
trans-unit.target: 在數值刻度處顯示水平網格線。

trans-unit.source: Series toggles. Null shows the legend when there is more than one series.
trans-unit.target: 系列切換項。為 null 時，若系列多於一個則顯示圖例。

trans-unit.source: The category (time) axis labels under the plot.
trans-unit.target: 繪圖區下方的分類（時間）軸標籤。

trans-unit.source: The value axis labels in the right-hand gutter.
trans-unit.target: 右側邊界中的數值軸標籤。

trans-unit.source: Formats value-axis ticks. Defaults to a compact number, such as 1.2K.
trans-unit.target: 設定數值軸刻度的格式。預設為精簡數字，例如 1.2K。

trans-unit.source: Fixes the top of the value axis (default: the next nice tick above the data).
trans-unit.target: 固定數值軸的頂端（預設：資料上方的下一個整齊刻度）。

trans-unit.source: Fixes the bottom of the value axis (default: zero, or the data minimum when it dips below).
trans-unit.target: 固定數值軸的底端（預設：零；若資料最小值低於零，則為資料最小值）。

trans-unit.source: A line chart you play like a recording. The line is drawn from left to right as the clock runs, with the current value next to its leading end and the time on the axis below. Events you mark on the clock show up as the line reaches them: a dot lands on the line, a small card names the event above the chart, and its row in the list beside the chart is highlighted, later adding what happened next. Around the chart sit a play button, a position slider, a speed switch, and figures for the current time, value, comparison and best value so far.
trans-unit.target: 像播放錄影一樣播放的折線圖。時鐘走動時，折線由左向右畫出，目前的值顯示在線的前端，時間顯示在下方的座標軸上。你在時鐘上標記的事件會在折線抵達時出現：一個圓點落到線上，一張小卡片在圖表上方寫出事件名稱，圖表旁清單中對應的一列會被醒目標示，之後還會補上隨後發生了什麼。圖表四周是播放按鈕、位置滑桿、速度切換，以及目前時間、數值、對照比值與目前最佳值的讀數。

trans-unit.source: Starts a replay from the beginning once, as soon as 40% of the block has scrolled into view; nothing happens when motion is reduced.
trans-unit.target: 區塊有 40% 捲入檢視區時，從頭開始播放一次；減少動態效果時不會播放。

trans-unit.source: What the legend calls the dashed comparison; the ratio's label reuses it ("Versus typical day").
trans-unit.target: 圖例對虛線對照的稱呼；比值的標籤也會用到它（"Versus typical day"）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the chart first appears fully drawn (`End`, the default) or empty (`Start`).
trans-unit.target: 圖表第一次出現時是完整畫出（`End`，預設）還是空白（`Start`）。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the heading saying what the line measures and over which day; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題下的一句話，說明折線量測的是什麼、是哪一天；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: An incident's effect, the dip over 20 minutes; {0} is the signed percentage.
trans-unit.target: 故障的效果，也就是之後 20 分鐘內的下滑；{0} 為帶正負號的百分比。

trans-unit.source: The time from the first point to the last at normal speed (16 seconds by default).
trans-unit.target: 以正常速度從第一個點播到最後一個點所需的時間（預設 16 秒）。

trans-unit.source: Announced when the replay reaches the end; {0} peak value, {1} its time.
trans-unit.target: 重播抵達結尾時播報；{0} 為峰值，{1} 為其時間。

trans-unit.source: Whether the replay is playing.
trans-unit.target: 重播是否正在播放。

trans-unit.source: Announced when playback passes a moment; {0} time, {1} title.
trans-unit.target: 播放經過某個時刻時播報；{0} 為時間，{1} 為標題。

trans-unit.source: The key moments as a list to follow (observed when it raises collection changes); it wins over `Moments`.
trans-unit.target: 以要追蹤的清單形式提供的關鍵時刻（引發集合變更時會被觀察）；優先於 `Moments`。

trans-unit.source: The heading of the moments column.
trans-unit.target: 時刻欄的標題。

trans-unit.source: The play button's screen reader name while playing.
trans-unit.target: 播放時播放按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: The play button's text while playing.
trans-unit.target: 播放時播放按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: Announced when playback is paused; {0} is the time.
trans-unit.target: 播放暫停時播報；{0} 為時間。

trans-unit.source: The peak value and when; {0} value, {1} time.
trans-unit.target: 峰值及其出現時間；{0} 為數值，{1} 為時間。

trans-unit.source: The readout's peak label.
trans-unit.target: 讀數中峰值的標籤。

trans-unit.source: The play button's screen reader name while paused partway.
trans-unit.target: 中途暫停時播放按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: The play button's text while paused partway.
trans-unit.target: 中途暫停時播放按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: The data to play: one entry per sample with its clock time in minutes, its value and, if you have one, a typical value to compare with.
trans-unit.target: 要播放的資料：每個取樣一項，包含以分鐘計的時鐘時間、數值，以及選填的、用於對照的典型值。

trans-unit.source: Where the playhead is, in minutes on the replay clock.
trans-unit.target: 播放頭所在位置，以重播時鐘上的分鐘數計。

trans-unit.source: The play button's screen reader name at the end.
trans-unit.target: 抵達結尾時播放按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: The play button's text at the end.
trans-unit.target: 抵達結尾時播放按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: A moment's effect, the rise over the next hour; {0} is the formatted rise.
trans-unit.target: 時刻的效果，也就是之後一小時內的上升；{0} 為格式化後的上升量。

trans-unit.source: The scrubber's screen reader name.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳列的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: What the legend calls the line being played.
trans-unit.target: 圖例對正在播放的折線的稱呼。

trans-unit.source: The playback speed (two-way): 0.5, 1, 2 or 4.
The speed control's screen reader name.
trans-unit.target: 速度控制項的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: Writes the hour labels under the chart; without one, they read like "6 am".
trans-unit.target: 輸出圖表下方的小時標籤；未提供時，標籤形如 "6 am"。

trans-unit.source: Writes a clock time (minutes) wherever one is shown or spoken; without one, times read like "9:40 am".
trans-unit.target: 在顯示或朗讀時鐘時間（分鐘）的地方輸出文字；未提供時，時間形如 "9:40 am"。

trans-unit.source: The readout's time label.
trans-unit.target: 讀數中時間的標籤。

trans-unit.source: The heading of the block; null hides it.

trans-unit.target: 讀數中比值的標籤；{0} 為首字母小寫的 `BaselineLabel`。

trans-unit.source: An event to point out in a `LineReplay`, timed on the same clock as the data. It gets a row in the list of moments, a tick on the slider, and a dot and a card on the chart once the replay gets there.
trans-unit.target: 在 `LineReplay` 中要指出的事件，與資料使用同一個時鐘。它在時刻清單中佔一列，在滑桿上有一個刻度，重播抵達時在圖表上顯示一個圓點與一張卡片。

trans-unit.target: 標題下方選填的一行說明。

trans-unit.source: A stable id, reported back by `MomentReached`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼，會由 `MomentReached` 回報。

trans-unit.source: The sort of event, which decides the icon (problems also use the warning color).
trans-unit.target: 事件的類型，決定圖示（問題類事件還會使用警告色）。

trans-unit.source: The clock time of the event in minutes; it may fall between two samples.
trans-unit.target: 事件的時鐘時間，以分鐘計；可以落在兩個取樣之間。

trans-unit.source: A short name for the event ("Release notes published").
trans-unit.target: 事件的簡短名稱（"Release notes published"）。

trans-unit.source: The sort of event a `LineReplayMoment` marks, which decides its icon.
trans-unit.target: `LineReplayMoment` 所標記的事件類型，決定其圖示。

trans-unit.source: A sample for a `LineReplay`: when it was taken (`Time`, minutes on the block's clock), what it measured (`Value`), and optionally what a normal day measured then (`Baseline`), which the chart shows as a dashed line.
trans-unit.target: `LineReplay` 的一個取樣：取樣時間（`Time`，區塊時鐘上的分鐘數）、量得的值（`Value`），以及選填的、平常日子在該時刻的值（`Baseline`），圖表會把它畫成虛線。

trans-unit.source: How a `LineReplay` looks before anyone has played it.
trans-unit.target: `LineReplay` 在還沒有人播放之前的樣子。

trans-unit.source: Shows the cell as an accent-colored link with an underline that strengthens on hover. A click on the text raises `CellInvoked` with `Part`; the cell is not selected by that click.
trans-unit.target: 把儲存格顯示為強調色連結，底線在滑鼠移上時加深。點擊文字會以 `Part` 觸發 `CellInvoked`；該次點擊不會選取儲存格。

trans-unit.source: A message composer that unfurls links (Arc Link unfurl, design reference). Paste an address, or type one and a space, and it becomes an inline link that shows its address under a soft loading sweep; once the preview resolves the favicon and title roll in and the link unrolls into a card under the message (site, title, description and image) in one continuous morph: the card's corner grows out of the link, width first and height after, lifting on a shadow while it travels, and the toolbar glides down with it. Click the link, press the card's collapse button, press Alt+Enter after the link or drag the card up to fold it back into the text; the remove button takes the link out of the message. Give it a `Resolver` that asks your own unfurl endpoint (Open Graph, oEmbed) for a `LinkUnfurlPreview`; without one, `Samples` resolve by address and any other address gets a plain preview built from it after a simulated 1.15s fetch. Enter or the send button raises `SendRequested` (and calls `SendHandler`) with the text, links written out as addresses, and the resolved previews.
trans-unit.target: 會展開連結的訊息輸入框（Arc Link unfurl，設計參考）。貼上一個網址，或輸入網址後再輸入一個空格，它就成為一個行內連結，在柔和的載入掃光下顯示網址；預覽解析完成後，網站圖示與標題捲入，連結在訊息下方展開為一張卡片（網站、標題、描述與圖片），整個過程是一次連續的形變：卡片的一角從連結中長出，先變寬、後變高，移動途中藉陰影抬起，工具列隨之下滑。點按連結、按下卡片的收合按鈕、在連結後按 Alt+Enter，或把卡片向上拖曳，即可把它收回文字中；移除按鈕會把連結從訊息中刪去。為它提供一個 `Resolver`，向你自己的展開端點（Open Graph、oEmbed）請求 `LinkUnfurlPreview`；沒有解析器時，`Samples` 依網址解析，其他網址在模擬的 1.15s 請求之後得到由網址產生的純文字預覽。Enter 或傳送按鈕會引發 `SendRequested`（並呼叫 `SendHandler`），帶上文字（連結寫為網址）與已解析的預覽。

trans-unit.source: Unfurls a card as soon as its preview resolves (default). When false the link only gains its favicon and title, and opens on click.
trans-unit.target: 預覽解析完成後立即展開卡片（預設）。為 false 時連結只取得網站圖示與標題，點按後才展開。

trans-unit.source: Pastes the first sample 1.1s after the composer first scrolls into view, unless someone has already interacted with it.
trans-unit.target: 輸入框首次捲入檢視 1.1s 後貼上第一個範例，除非已有人與它互動。

trans-unit.source: Opens and folds cards instantly without the morph, shows a still tint instead of the sweep and turns autoplay off.
trans-unit.target: 不經形變立即展開與收合卡片，以靜止色塊取代掃光，並關閉自動播放。

trans-unit.source: True while a send is pending: the message is read-only and the send button holds.
trans-unit.target: 傳送進行中時為 true：訊息為唯讀，傳送按鈕保持等待。

trans-unit.source: The message field's accessible name (Arc's `label`), such as "Message #trail-club".
trans-unit.target: 訊息輸入區的無障礙名稱（Arc 的 `label`），例如 "Message #trail-club"。

trans-unit.source: Every word the composer shows or announces; replace to translate or reword.
trans-unit.target: 輸入框顯示或播報的全部文字；替換它即可翻譯或改寫。

trans-unit.source: The color of an unfurled link and its tie to its card; null uses the accent.
trans-unit.target: 已展開連結及其與卡片之間聯繫的顏色；null 使用強調色。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an address became a link (pasted, typed with a space after it, or from a sample).
trans-unit.target: 網址變成連結時引發（貼上、輸入後加空格，或來自範例）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a link left the message (the remove button, Backspace or Delete, a send or a clear).
trans-unit.target: 連結離開訊息時引發（移除按鈕、Backspace 或 Delete、傳送或清除）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a link's fetch finished: its status is then ready (with a preview) or failed.
trans-unit.target: 連結的請求完成時引發：其狀態隨後為 ready（帶預覽）或 failed。

trans-unit.source: The text shown while the message is empty.
trans-unit.target: 訊息為空時顯示的文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a link's card opened or folded (`IsExpanded` says which).
trans-unit.target: 連結的卡片展開或收合時引發（由 `IsExpanded` 說明是哪一種）。

trans-unit.source: Fetches the preview of a pasted address (usually from your own unfurl endpoint); return null when there is none: the link then stays in the text without a card and is fetched again when clicked. The token is cancelled when the link is removed or the message is sent. Null uses the samples and plain previews after a simulated 1.15s fetch.
trans-unit.target: 取得所貼上網址的預覽（通常來自你自己的展開端點）；沒有預覽時傳回 null：連結隨後留在文字中、沒有卡片，點按時會重新取得。連結被移除或訊息被傳送時，取消權杖會被觸發。為 null 時使用範例與純文字預覽，並模擬 1.15s 的請求。

trans-unit.source: Sample links offered as buttons under the message; the built-in resolver answers their addresses with them. Once a sample is in the message its button shows or folds its card. Null or empty hides the buttons.
trans-unit.target: 以按鈕形式顯示在訊息下方的範例連結；內建解析器以它們回應對應的網址。範例進入訊息後，其按鈕用於展開或收合它的卡片。為 null 或空時隱藏這些按鈕。

trans-unit.source: The message of the last failed send, shown under the composer as an alert; null when there is none.
trans-unit.target: 上一次傳送失敗的訊息，以警示形式顯示在輸入框下方；沒有時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Sends a message after `SendRequested`: the composer holds while the task runs, then clears and confirms; a failed task shows its message under the composer and keeps the message.
trans-unit.target: 在 `SendRequested` 之後傳送訊息：工作執行期間輸入框保持等待，完成後清除並確認；工作失敗時在輸入框下方顯示其訊息並保留原訊息。

trans-unit.source: Raised on Enter or the send button with the message; set `Pending` to hold the composer.
trans-unit.target: 按下 Enter 或傳送按鈕時引發，帶有訊息；設定 `Pending` 可讓輸入框保持等待。

trans-unit.source: Multiplier for the morph and the simulated fetch (1 = as measured; 0.1 to 10).
trans-unit.target: 形變與模擬請求的速度倍率（1 = 實測速度；0.1 到 10）。

trans-unit.source: The message text; links stand in it as their addresses. Two-way: typing writes it; setting it replaces the message.
trans-unit.target: 訊息文字；連結在其中以網址形式出現。雙向：輸入會寫入它；設定它會取代訊息。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `LinkUnfurl` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance (or set its properties) to translate or reword; texts with names in them are functions so the word order can change. The message field's own name and placeholder are `Label` and `Placeholder`.
trans-unit.target: `LinkUnfurl` 顯示或播報的全部文字，預設為英文。替換執行個體（或設定其屬性）即可翻譯或改寫；含名稱的文字是函式，以便調整詞序。訊息輸入區本身的名稱與預留位置文字是 `Label` 與 `Placeholder`。

trans-unit.source: A link in the message of a `LinkUnfurl`: its address, its status and its preview.
trans-unit.target: `LinkUnfurl` 訊息中的一個連結：它的網址、狀態與預覽。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of the link events of `LinkUnfurl`.
trans-unit.target: `LinkUnfurl` 連結事件的引數。

trans-unit.source: What a `LinkUnfurl` sends: the text, with every link written out as its address, and the previews.
trans-unit.target: `LinkUnfurl` 傳送的內容：文字（每個連結寫為其網址）與預覽。

trans-unit.source: What a link in a `LinkUnfurl` points to, as an unfurl endpoint reports it (Open Graph, oEmbed): the site, a title, an optional description, image and favicon. A preview without an `Image` shows a card without a media area; one without a `Favicon` shows the site's initial on a small square.
trans-unit.target: `LinkUnfurl` 中連結所指向的內容，由展開端點回報（Open Graph、oEmbed）：網站、標題，以及選用的描述、圖片與網站圖示。沒有 `Image` 的預覽顯示不含媒體區的卡片；沒有 `Favicon` 的預覽在小方塊上顯示網站的首字母。

trans-unit.source: Invented sample links for `LinkUnfurl` demos: three fictional sites (a trail guide, a recipe box, a history podcast) with code-drawn favicons and share images, plus the starting message. None of them is a real site.
trans-unit.target: 供 `LinkUnfurl` 範例使用的虛構範例連結：三個虛構網站（步道指南、食譜合集、歷史 Podcast），網站圖示與分享圖片皆由程式碼繪製，另有起始訊息。它們都不是真實網站。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SendRequested`. Set `Pending` to the task that sends the message: the composer holds until it completes, then clears and confirms; a failed task shows its message under the composer.
trans-unit.target: `SendRequested` 的引數。把 `Pending` 設為傳送訊息的工作：輸入框保持等待直到它完成，然後清除並確認；工作失敗時在輸入框下方顯示其訊息。

trans-unit.source: Glyph tabs for a few sections of equal rank, each with a short label. A lens in the foreground color marks the selected tab: it travels to the next tab as one pill, taking that tab's width on the way, and the tab under it is painted again in reverse colors, which fills outline glyphs. Only one label shows at a time, the old one gone before the new one fades in. The lens can be dragged or flicked to another tab, and it tips a little toward whichever tab the mouse rests on.
trans-unit.target: 用於幾個同級分區的圖示標籤，每個附帶一段簡短文字。一枚前景色的透鏡標出選取的標籤：它作為一塊膠囊移向下一個標籤，途中變成那個標籤的寬度；它下方的標籤以反色再畫一遍，描邊圖示因此變成實心。同一時間只顯示一段文字，舊文字消失後新文字才淡入。透鏡可以拖曳或甩到另一個標籤，滑鼠停在某個標籤上時，它會朝那邊略微偏過去。

trans-unit.source: Where labels appear: on the selected tab only (default), on every tab, or nowhere.
trans-unit.target: 文字顯示在哪裡：只在選取的標籤上（預設）、每個標籤上，或都不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Fill of the lens (and of the badges outside it). Defaults to the foreground color.
trans-unit.target: 透鏡的填色（也是透鏡之外徽章的底色）。預設為前景色。

trans-unit.source: Color of the glyphs, labels and badges redrawn inside the lens. Defaults to the background color.
trans-unit.target: 在透鏡裡重畫的圖示、文字和徽章的顏色。預設為背景色。

trans-unit.source: One tab of a `LiquidTabBar`: a glyph, a label shown next to it when the tab is open, and an optional badge count. A tab is 44px wide with its glyph alone and opens to fit its label; a tab without a glyph is a text tab that always shows its label. A disabled tab is skipped by the arrow keys and cannot be selected.
trans-unit.target: `LiquidTabBar` 的一個標籤：一個圖示、標籤展開時顯示在旁邊的文字，以及可選的徽章計數。只顯示圖示時標籤寬 44px，展開後容納文字；沒有圖示的標籤是純文字標籤，始終顯示文字。停用的標籤會被方向鍵略過，也無法被選取。

trans-unit.source: The glyph drawn inside the lens, filled in; null fills in `Glyph`.
trans-unit.target: 在透鏡裡填實繪製的圖示；為 null 時填實 `Glyph`。

trans-unit.source: A count shown on the glyph's corner; its digits roll when it changes. 0 hides the badge.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在圖示角落的計數；數值變化時數字會捲動。為 0 時隱藏徽章。

trans-unit.source: What screen readers hear for the badge, after the label (for example "3 unread"); null reads the number.
trans-unit.target: 螢幕閱讀器在文字之後為徽章讀出的內容（例如 "3 unread"）；為 null 時讀出數字。

trans-unit.source: A 24 × 24 stroked glyph (for example `ArcIcons.House`). Null makes a text tab that always shows its label.
trans-unit.target: 24 × 24 的描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons.House`）。為 null 時是始終顯示文字的純文字標籤。

trans-unit.source: Whether this tab is the selected one.
trans-unit.target: 此標籤是否為選取項目。

trans-unit.source: The tab's name: shown next to the glyph while the tab is open and read by screen readers. When null, the text of `Content` or of `Value` is used.
trans-unit.target: 標籤的名稱：標籤展開時顯示在圖示旁邊，並由螢幕閱讀器讀出。為 null 時使用 `Content` 或 `Value` 的文字。

trans-unit.source: The value the bar reports as its `SelectedValue` while this tab is selected.
trans-unit.target: 此標籤被選取時，標籤列回報為 `SelectedValue` 的值。

trans-unit.source: A product on a `ProductListing`.
trans-unit.target: `ProductListing` 上的一件商品。

trans-unit.source: A subscription checkout on one page: express wallets, a plan radio group with a billing switch, a seat stepper, add-ons, billing details and a card form on the left, and an order summary on the right that recalculates every line, the coupon, the tax by country and the total with each change, with every amount rolling digit by digit. A successful payment fades the form aside while the summary glides to the centre and unfolds into a receipt. Below 760 px of its own width the summary sits on top as a total you can expand; below 520 px plans and fields stack.
trans-unit.target: 單頁完成的訂閱結帳：左側是快捷錢包、附計費週期切換的方案選項群組、席位步進器、附加項目、帳單資訊和卡片表單，右側是訂單摘要，每次變更都會重新計算每一列、優惠碼、依國家計算的稅和總計，所有金額逐位捲動。付款成功後表單淡出到一側，摘要滑到中央並展開成收據。自身寬度小於 760 px 時摘要位於頂端，顯示為可展開的總計；小於 520 px 時方案和欄位堆疊成一欄。

trans-unit.target: 選用附加項目，依顯示順序排列（摘要列遵循此順序）。

trans-unit.source: The most seats (500 by default).
trans-unit.target: 最多席位數（預設 500）。

trans-unit.source: A realtime visitors card (Arc Live visitors, design reference): a pulsing live status, the number of people on the site rolling digit by digit, a dotted world map where new arrivals ping in and fade, the top pages right now with bars that reorder as counts change, and a ticker of signups and upgrades with the country and how long ago. A pause button holds the last snapshot. Feed it from your realtime source: set `Count`, `Pages`, `Visitors` and `Events` to new snapshots as they arrive (the card works out what moved from the ids), or push single arrivals and conversions with `PushVisitor` and `PushEvent`. Reflect the socket's state in `Connection`. Without `Count` the card plays its `Simulation`, a `LiveVisitorsSimulation` of a site you describe; with neither, it holds placeholders and says there is no data.
trans-unit.target: 即時訪客卡片（Arc Live visitors，設計參考）：脈動的即時狀態、逐位滾動的站內人數、新訪客閃現後淡去的點陣世界地圖、帶長條且隨人數重新排序的目前熱門頁面，以及顯示國家和多久之前的註冊與升級動態。暫停按鈕保留最後一份快照。從你的即時資料來源取得資料：在新快照抵達時設定 `Count`、`Pages`、`Visitors` 和 `Events`（卡片根據 id 判斷哪些發生了變化），或用 `PushVisitor` 和 `PushEvent` 逐筆推送訪客與轉換。用 `Connection` 反映連線狀態。沒有 `Count` 時，卡片播放它的 `Simulation`，也就是一個描述你所指定網站的 `LiveVisitorsSimulation`；兩者都沒有時，卡片維持預留位置狀態並說明沒有資料。

trans-unit.source: The stream's state: Connecting shows placeholders in the same space, Reconnecting keeps the last data with a warning dot.
trans-unit.target: 資料串流的狀態：Connecting 在同樣的位置顯示預留位置，Reconnecting 保留最後的資料並顯示警告色圓點。

trans-unit.target: 此刻站內的人數。保持為 null 時播放 `Simulation`；一旦設定，卡片只顯示你傳入的資料。

trans-unit.source: A simulated visitors stream for a `LiveVisitors` card that has no `Count`, for demos, prototypes and tests. It plays the site you describe: about `TypicalCount` people spread over `SitePages`, a new arrival from one of `Cities` every 600ms, page counts that drift, and one of `Conversions` every 2.4s; it starts with a few conversions from the last minutes. Nothing is fetched or tracked. It has no timer of its own: call `Advance` with the time that passed (the card does this from its clock while it is on screen and not paused). Setting any data property starts the stream over. Create one per card.
trans-unit.target: 用於展示、原型和測試，供沒有 `Count` 的 `LiveVisitors` 卡片使用的模擬訪客資料串流。它播放你描述的網站：約 `TypicalCount` 人分布在 `SitePages` 上，每 600ms 有一位來自 `Cities` 之一的新訪客，頁面人數會漂移，每 2.4s 發生一次 `Conversions` 之一；開始時已有幾筆最近幾分鐘的轉換。不會擷取或追蹤任何內容。它沒有自己的計時器：用經過的時間呼叫 `Advance`（卡片在螢幕上且未暫停時由自己的時鐘呼叫）。設定任何資料屬性都會讓資料串流從頭開始。請為每張卡片建立一個執行個體。

trans-unit.source: A pricing calculator for LLM workloads in one panel (Arc LLM cost calculator, design reference). The header shows the selected model's monthly total in a large rolling figure. Below it come your workload presets, three sliders for input tokens per request, output tokens per request and requests per day, and a Cached input switch that bills part of the input at the cache read rate. Every model sits in a ranked list, lowest cost first, with its mark, a bar relative to the most expensive model and a rolling monthly cost; rows glide to their new rank as values change. Picking a row selects that model for the total, the footer breakdown (input, cached, output, per request) and its price line. Prices are inputs: pass your own `Models` with list prices in US dollars per 1M tokens and say where they came from in `Description`. With no models the panel shows its empty state. `ComputeCost` is the arithmetic the panel uses, for server code and invoices.
trans-unit.target: 一個面板中的 LLM 工作負載價格試算器（Arc LLM cost calculator，設計參考）。頁首以大型滾動數字顯示所選模型的每月總額。其下是你的工作負載預設、三個滑桿（每次請求的輸入 token 數、每次請求的輸出 token 數和每天的請求數），以及一個 Cached input 開關，開啟後部分輸入依快取讀取價格計費。所有模型依費用由低到高排在一份清單中，每列有其標誌、一根相對於最貴模型的長條和滾動的每月費用；數值改變時各列滑動到新的名次。選取一列，總額、底部明細（輸入、快取、輸出、每次請求）和價格列就切換為該模型。價格是輸入：傳入你自己的 `Models` 及其牌價（每 1M token 的美元價格），並在 `Description` 中說明來源。沒有模型時，面板顯示空狀態。`ComputeCost` 是面板使用的演算法，可用於伺服器程式碼和發票。

trans-unit.source: Adds a Try again button to the error state; it raises `RetryRequested`.
trans-unit.target: 在錯誤狀態中加入 Try again 按鈕；它會觸發 `RetryRequested`。

trans-unit.source: Days in a billing month (default 30).

trans-unit.source: A passkey-first sign in and sign up screen (Arc's Login › Centered block): a card on a quiet ring backdrop that morphs from the passkey view through an email address and a six digit code to the signed-in account, with single sign-on buttons, a sign in / sign up switch in the top bar and a status line in the footer. Steps rise into place out of a small blur while the card's height follows on a spring; the resend countdown rolls; the backdrop drifts with a fine pointer.

trans-unit.target: 郵件應用程式的位址（例如 `mailto:`）。設定後（且沒有 `OpenMailAppAsync`），開啟郵件應用程式會開啟它，頁面停留在已寄出步驟，等待 `CompleteSignIn`；否則執行示範。

trans-unit.source: How the person signed in (meaningful on the Done step).
trans-unit.target: 使用者的登入方式（在完成步驟中生效）。

trans-unit.source: Sign in (default) or create an account (two way); the header switch flips it.
trans-unit.target: 登入（預設）或建立帳號（兩種模式，雙向切換）；標頭的開關會切換它。

trans-unit.source: Terms, Privacy or the mail app was chosen. Handle it to open the destination yourself.
trans-unit.target: 選擇了服務條款、隱私權或郵件應用程式時觸發。若要自行開啟目標頁面，請處理此事件。

trans-unit.source: Runs after an unhandled `Navigate`; its parameter is the event arguments.
trans-unit.target: 未處理的 `Navigate` 之後執行；參數為事件引數。

trans-unit.source: The picture behind everything, cropped to fill like CSS `object-fit: cover`. Null draws a dusk landscape.
trans-unit.target: 位於所有內容後方的圖片，裁切方式與 CSS `object-fit: cover` 相同，以填滿區域。為 null 時繪製黃昏風景。

trans-unit.source: Which point of the picture stays in view when it is cropped, as fractions (default 0.5, 0.58: centred, a little below the middle).
trans-unit.target: 裁切圖片時保持在可見範圍內的焦點，以分數表示（預設 0.5, 0.58：置中，略低於中線）。

trans-unit.source: The privacy policy's address. Without one, Privacy shows a note in the footer instead.
trans-unit.target: 隱私權政策的位址。未設定時，隱私權會改在頁尾顯示一則說明。

trans-unit.source: The provider the person signed in with, or null.
trans-unit.target: 使用者登入所用的第三方登入方式，或 null。

trans-unit.source: The single sign-on providers, one equal button each. Empty (the default) shows Google, Apple and GitHub.
trans-unit.target: 單一登入的第三方登入方式，每項各對應一個等寬按鈕。為空（預設值）時顯示 Google、Apple 和 GitHub。

trans-unit.source: Single sign-on providers from a view model; when set it wins over `Providers`.
trans-unit.target: 來自檢視模型的單一登入提供者；設定後優先於 `Providers`。

trans-unit.source: Seconds before another link can be sent from the Sent step (30).
trans-unit.target: 已寄出步驟中再次寄送連結前需等待的秒數（30）。

trans-unit.source: The person signed in (the emailed link, a provider, or `CompleteSignIn`).
trans-unit.target: 使用者已登入（透過郵件連結、第三方登入或 `CompleteSignIn`）。

trans-unit.source: Runs after `SignedIn`; its parameter is the event arguments.
trans-unit.target: 在 `SignedIn` 之後執行；其參數為事件參數。

trans-unit.source: The person signed out from the Done step (or `SignOut` was called).
trans-unit.target: 使用者在完成步驟中登出（或呼叫了 `SignOut`）時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The card's step.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的步驟。

trans-unit.source: The terms' address. Without one, Terms shows a note in the footer instead.
trans-unit.target: 服務條款的位址。未設定時，"Terms" 會改為在頁尾顯示一則說明。

trans-unit.source: The demo's delays.
trans-unit.target: 示範的延遲時間。

trans-unit.source: Every text a `LoginImmersive` page shows or announces, with English defaults. Sentences that carry a value (the product, an address, a provider, a count of seconds) are functions.
trans-unit.target: `LoginImmersive` 頁面顯示或朗讀的所有文字，附英文預設值。帶有數值（產品、位址、第三方登入、秒數）的句子為函式。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `LinkSent`.
trans-unit.target: `LinkSent` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Navigate`. Set `Handled` to open the destination yourself; otherwise the page opens `Href` with the platform launcher when it is an absolute web or mail address.
trans-unit.target: `Navigate` 的引數。設定 `Handled` 可自行開啟目的地；否則當 `Href` 為絕對網頁或郵件位址時，頁面會透過平台啟動器開啟它。

trans-unit.source: A single sign-on provider of a `LoginImmersive` page: one equal-width button in the row under "or", with the provider's mark before its name. The name also fills the busy and success sentences ("Opening {name}").
trans-unit.target: `LoginImmersive` 頁面的單一登入提供者：位於 "or" 下方一列中的等寬按鈕，名稱前顯示提供者的標誌。名稱也用於忙碌與成功提示（"Opening {name}"）。

trans-unit.source: The provider's mark on a 24-unit box, filled with `MarkBrush` (null: the button's text colour).
trans-unit.target: 提供者的標誌，位於 24 單位的方框中，以 `MarkBrush` 填滿（為 null 時使用按鈕的文字顏色）。

trans-unit.source: The fill of `Mark`; null follows the button's text colour in both themes.
trans-unit.target: `Mark` 的填滿色；為 null 時在兩種主題下都跟隨按鈕的文字顏色。

trans-unit.source: The provider's name, shown on its button.
trans-unit.target: 第三方登入的名稱，顯示在其按鈕上。

trans-unit.source: An app-defined value that identifies the provider in handlers (for example an OAuth scheme name).
trans-unit.target: 由應用程式定義的值，用於在處理常式中識別該第三方登入（例如 OAuth 方案名稱）。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SignedIn`.
trans-unit.target: `SignedIn` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: How long the built-in simulation waits at each beat (the measured beats of the reference preview). Only used for actions whose handler (`SendLinkAsync`, `OpenMailAppAsync`, `SignInWithProviderAsync`) is not set, except `LinkSentHold`, which always applies.
trans-unit.target: 內建模擬在每個節拍處等待的時長（即參考預覽中量測的節拍）。僅用於未設定處理常式（`SendLinkAsync`、`OpenMailAppAsync`、`SignInWithProviderAsync`）的操作，`LinkSentHold` 除外，它一律生效。

trans-unit.source: Split login page: an email-first sign-in in the left column (brand and "Sign up" above, the steps in the middle, a status line and the legal links below) beside a full-height picture. Continue looks the account up, the password step shows it as a chip, Sign in checks the password, narrows to a check and opens the account with a progress line before greeting the person by name; single sign-on skips the password. "Forgot password?" sends a reset link with a resend countdown. The flow is simulated with the reference preview's timings until you set the asynchronous handlers (`LookupAccountAsync`, `VerifyPasswordAsync`, `SignInWithProviderAsync`, `SendResetLinkAsync`); `SignedIn` hands the account to your app. Breakpoints follow the block's own width: 5:6 columns from 1100, 1:1 from 760, the form alone below 760 (the picture hides), tighter padding below 480.
trans-unit.target: 分割式登入頁：左欄是以電子郵件為先的登入（上方為品牌和 "Sign up"，中間為步驟，下方為狀態列和法律連結），右側是全高圖片。"Continue" 會查詢帳戶，密碼步驟將其顯示為標籤；"Sign in" 檢查密碼，收合為勾號並開啟帳戶，同時顯示進度列，然後以名字問候使用者；單一登入則略過密碼。"Forgot password?" 會寄出附重新寄送倒數的重設連結。此流程依參考預覽的時間設定模擬，直到你設定非同步處理常式（`LookupAccountAsync`、`VerifyPasswordAsync`、`SignInWithProviderAsync`、`SendResetLinkAsync`）為止；`SignedIn` 將帳戶交給你的應用程式。斷點依區塊本身的寬度：1100 起為 5:6 欄，760 起為 1:1，760 以下只顯示表單（圖片隱藏），480 以下內距更緊湊。

trans-unit.source: The account being signed in or signed in; null on the email step.
trans-unit.target: 正在登入或已登入的帳戶；在電子郵件步驟時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Accounts to recognize when `LookupAccountAsync` is not set (an email matching one, case-insensitive, shows its name and picture); when set this wins over `Accounts`.
trans-unit.target: 未設定 `LookupAccountAsync` 時用於辨識的帳號（電子郵件與其中之一相符時，不區分大小寫，會顯示其名稱與圖片）；設定後，此項優先於 `Accounts`。

trans-unit.source: The brand mark (24 × 24 view box, stroked in the accent color); null draws the built-in notebook.
trans-unit.target: 品牌標誌（24 × 24 檢視框，以強調色描邊）；為 null 時繪製內建的筆記本圖示。

trans-unit.source: The product name beside the brand mark; also used in the headings and the block's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 緊接品牌標誌旁的產品名稱；也用於標題與區塊的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The account single sign-on uses when the email field holds no valid address (null: the first account, else a built-in sample).
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件欄位沒有有效位址時，單一登入所使用的帳號（為 null 時：第一個帳號，若無則使用內建範例）。

trans-unit.source: The password the simulated check accepts while `VerifyPasswordAsync` is not set.
trans-unit.target: 未設定 `VerifyPasswordAsync` 時，模擬驗證接受的密碼。

trans-unit.source: The text of the email field (two-way). Signing out puts the account's email back here.
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件欄位的文字（雙向繫結）。登出時會將帳號的電子郵件放回此處。

trans-unit.source: True while an action runs.
trans-unit.target: 操作執行期間為 True。

trans-unit.source: True fills the parent with square corners and no border (a whole screen); false (default) is a framed block with a 1px border, 26px corners and at least 640 high.
trans-unit.target: True 時填滿父容器，採用直角且無邊框（整個螢幕）；false（預設）為有框區塊，具有 1px 邊框、26px 圓角，且高度至少為 640。

trans-unit.source: Every built-in text (English defaults).
trans-unit.target: 所有內建文字（英文預設值）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "Sign up", "Terms" or "Privacy" is used; handle it to navigate yourself.
trans-unit.target: 使用 "Sign up"、"Terms" 或 "Privacy" 時引發；請自行處理以導覽。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the `LoginSplitLink` when a link is used.
trans-unit.target: 使用連結時，與 `LoginSplitLink` 一起執行。

trans-unit.source: The picture of the right column, cropped to cover it; null draws a metal facade in code.
trans-unit.target: 右側欄的圖片，裁切以填滿該區域；為 null 時由程式碼繪製金屬外牆。

trans-unit.source: The picture's focal point as fractions of its size (default 0.5, 0.58: centered, a little below the middle).
trans-unit.target: 圖片的焦點，以其尺寸的比例表示（預設 0.5, 0.58：置中，略低於中間）。

trans-unit.source: Address of "Privacy" (see `SignUpHref`).
trans-unit.target: "Privacy" 的位址（參見 `SignUpHref`）。

trans-unit.source: Single sign-on buttons; when set this wins over `Providers`. An empty list hides the divider and the buttons.
trans-unit.target: 單一登入按鈕；設定後優先於 `Providers`。空清單會隱藏分隔線與按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Seconds before another reset link can be asked for (default 30).
trans-unit.target: 再次申請重設連結前需等待的秒數（預設 30）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a password reset link went out (first send and every resend).
trans-unit.target: 密碼重設連結寄出時引發（首次寄送和每次重新寄送時）。

trans-unit.source: Address of "Sign up". With an address, an unhandled `Navigate` opens it; without, the status line says where it would go.
trans-unit.target: "Sign up" 的位址。設定位址後，未處理的 `Navigate` 會開啟該位址；未設定時，狀態列會說明將前往的位置。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the greeting appears after a sign-in (Arc's `onSignIn`).
trans-unit.target: 登入後出現問候語時觸發（Arc 的 `onSignIn`）。

trans-unit.source: Runs with the `LoginSplitSignedInEventArgs` after a sign-in.
trans-unit.target: 登入後以 `LoginSplitSignedInEventArgs` 作為參數執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised after Sign out.
trans-unit.target: 在登出後引發。

trans-unit.source: The visible status line (also announced politely); null when empty.
trans-unit.target: 可見的狀態列（同時以禮貌方式朗讀）；為空時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The step on show.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的步驟。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the step changes.
trans-unit.target: 步驟變更時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Address of "Terms" (see `SignUpHref`).
trans-unit.target: "Terms" 的位址（參見 `SignUpHref`）。

trans-unit.source: Pauses of the simulated flow and the beats of the sign-in sequence.
trans-unit.target: 模擬流程的暫停時間，以及登入序列的節拍。

trans-unit.source: A person who can sign in to a `LoginSplit`: a name, an email and an optional picture. The chip, the account row and the greeting show it; without a picture the avatar shows the initials of the name.
trans-unit.target: 可登入 `LoginSplit` 的帳號：包含名稱、電子郵件和可選的圖片。晶片、帳號列和問候語都會顯示它；沒有圖片時，頭像顯示名稱的首字母。

trans-unit.target: `LoginSplit` 的所有內建文字（英文預設值）：標題、欄位標籤、按鈕、錯誤訊息、狀態列，以及螢幕閱讀器朗讀的內容。透過 `Labels` 整體取代即可在地化或更名；帶值的文字為函式。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `NavigateEvent`. Set `Handled` to keep the block from opening `Href`.
trans-unit.target: `NavigateEvent` 的參數。設定 `Handled` 可阻止區塊開啟 `Href`。

trans-unit.source: A single sign-on button of a `LoginSplit`: a name and a mark.
trans-unit.target: `LoginSplit` 中的單一登入按鈕，包含名稱和標記。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ResetLinkSentEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `ResetLinkSentEvent` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SignedInEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `SignedInEvent` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SignedOutEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `SignedOutEvent` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `StepChangedEvent`.
trans-unit.target: `StepChangedEvent` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: The pauses of the simulated flow a `LoginSplit` plays when no handler is set, and the beats of the sign-in sequence. Defaults are the reference preview's measured timings.
trans-unit.target: 未設定處理常式時，`LoginSplit` 播放之模擬流程中的停頓，以及登入序列中的節拍。預設值為參考預覽中實測的時長。

trans-unit.source: A quiet, continuously moving row of marks under a heading and a line of text, with a control to pause it. The row holds still while a mouse rests on it. Below full motion it stops, shows each mark once and hides the control. The default marks are invented; pass `Brands` with marks you have permission to show.
trans-unit.target: 標題和一行文字下方一排安靜、持續移動的標誌，附帶暫停控制項。滑鼠停留時保持靜止。動效低於完整層級時停止移動，每個標誌只顯示一次並隱藏控制項。預設標誌是虛構的；請透過 `Brands` 傳入你有權展示的標誌。

trans-unit.source: The marks to show. Null shows seven invented sample marks.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的標誌。為 null 時顯示七個虛構的範例標誌。

trans-unit.source: The line beside the heading.
trans-unit.target: 標題旁邊的文字。

trans-unit.source: Whether the row is paused (two way). The pause control sets it.
trans-unit.target: 標誌列是否暫停（雙向）。暫停控制項會設定它。

trans-unit.source: The control's screen reader name while the row moves ("Pause logo motion").
trans-unit.target: 移動時控制項的螢幕閱讀器名稱（"Pause logo motion"）。

trans-unit.source: What a screen reader hears when the row pauses ("Motion paused").
trans-unit.target: 暫停時螢幕閱讀器聽到的內容（"Motion paused"）。

trans-unit.source: The control's text while the row moves ("Pause").
trans-unit.target: 移動時控制項的文字（"Pause"）。

trans-unit.source: The control's screen reader name while the row is paused ("Play logo motion").
trans-unit.target: 暫停時控制項的螢幕閱讀器名稱（"Play logo motion"）。

trans-unit.source: The control's text while the row is paused ("Play").
trans-unit.target: 暫停時控制項的文字（"Play"）。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the row ("Illustrative tool logos").
trans-unit.target: 標誌列的螢幕閱讀器名稱（"Illustrative tool logos"）。

trans-unit.source: The heading ("Good work moves between tools").
trans-unit.target: 標題（"Good work moves between tools"）。

trans-unit.source: `Color` (the default) shows each mark in its colors; `Mono` draws every mark in the text color.
trans-unit.target: `Color`（預設）以各自顏色顯示標誌；`Mono` 以文字顏色繪製所有標誌。

trans-unit.source: Passwordless sign-in by email link in one card: the person types an address and asks for a link; the card turns into "Check your inbox" with the address, a resend button that waits out `ResendDelay` on a countdown ring, and a way back to change the address; and, when your app opens a stale link, the expired state sends a fresh one in one press. The states swap with a short lift while the card's height follows on a spring. Your app sends the mail from `LinkRequested` or an async `LinkSender` (the button shows a spinner and a failure message).
trans-unit.target: 在一張卡片中透過郵件連結免密碼登入：使用者輸入地址並請求連結；卡片變成「Check your inbox」，顯示地址、一個在倒數圓環上等待 `ResendDelay` 的重寄按鈕，以及返回修改地址的入口；當你的應用程式開啟過期的連結時，過期狀態一鍵寄送新連結。狀態之間以短暫上移切換，卡片高度以彈簧跟隨。你的應用程式在 `LinkRequested` 中或透過非同步的 `LinkSender` 寄送郵件（按鈕顯示載入圈和失敗訊息）。

trans-unit.source: The address in the field (two-way); the link goes here.
trans-unit.target: 輸入框中的地址（雙向）；連結寄送到這裡。

trans-unit.source: True while `LinkSender` runs.
trans-unit.target: `LinkSender` 執行期間為 True。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text; replace the whole object to localize the card.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字；替換整個物件即可在地化卡片。

trans-unit.source: How long a link works, as told in the text (default 15 minutes).
trans-unit.target: 連結的有效時間，用於文字說明（預設 15 分鐘）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a link should be emailed (the first time, on Resend and after an expired link), before `LinkSender` runs.
trans-unit.target: 需要寄送連結郵件時引發（第一次、重寄時以及連結過期後），在 `LinkSender` 執行之前。

trans-unit.source: Sends the link and reports success; while it runs the button shows a spinner. Null sends nothing itself (handle `LinkRequested`).
trans-unit.target: 寄送連結並回報是否成功；執行期間按鈕顯示載入圈。為 null 時自身不寄送任何內容（請處理 `LinkRequested`）。

trans-unit.source: The product name in the title ("Sign in to Lumenfield").
trans-unit.target: 標題中的產品名稱（「Sign in to Lumenfield」）。

trans-unit.source: How long the resend button waits after each link (default 30 seconds).
trans-unit.target: 每次寄送連結後重寄按鈕等待的時間（預設 30 秒）。

trans-unit.source: The time left before the link can be sent again (zero when it can).
trans-unit.target: 距離可以再次寄送連結的剩餘時間（可以寄送時為零）。

trans-unit.source: The state on screen (two-way). Set it to Expired when your app opens a link that is too old.
trans-unit.target: 畫面上的狀態（雙向）。當你的應用程式開啟過期的連結時，把它設為 Expired。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the state changes, with the old and the new state.
trans-unit.target: 狀態改變後引發，帶有舊狀態和新狀態。

trans-unit.source: An app dock: a row of icons on a shelf that swell like a lens under the pointer, pushing their neighbours aside, with the name of the icon under the pointer above it and a bounce when an icon is launched.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式 Dock：架子上的一排圖示，在指標下像放大鏡一樣變大並把相鄰圖示推開，指標下的圖示上方顯示它的名稱，啟動圖示時會彈跳。

trans-unit.source: The space between icons at rest, in px.
trans-unit.target: 圖示靜止時的間距，單位為 px。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an icon is launched by a click, a tap, Enter or Space.
trans-unit.target: 透過點擊、輕點、Enter 或 Space 啟動圖示時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The side of an icon at rest, in px.
trans-unit.target: 圖示靜止時的邊長，單位為 px。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the dock.
trans-unit.target: Dock的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The scale of the icon right under the pointer (1.8 by default; 1 turns magnification off).
trans-unit.target: 指標正下方圖示的縮放比例（預設 1.8；設為 1 關閉放大）。

trans-unit.source: Whether launching an icon marks it running (a dot under it).
trans-unit.target: 啟動圖示時是否將其標為執行中（圖示下方顯示一個圓點）。

trans-unit.source: How far from the pointer icons still grow, in px.
trans-unit.target: 離指標多遠的圖示仍會變大，單位為 px。

trans-unit.source: The space between the shelf's edge and the icons, in px.
trans-unit.target: 架子邊緣與圖示之間的距離，單位為 px。

trans-unit.source: One icon of a `MagnifyDock`: a button whose content is the icon, with a `Label` that shows above it under the pointer or keyboard focus, and a dot beneath it while `IsRunning`.
trans-unit.target: `MagnifyDock` 中的一個圖示：內容為圖示的按鈕，指標或鍵盤焦點在其上時上方顯示 `Label`，`IsRunning` 時下方顯示一個圓點。

trans-unit.source: Whether the app is open: a dot shows under the icon. A launch sets it when the dock marks launches.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式是否已開啟：圖示下方顯示一個圓點。Dock標記啟動時，啟動會設定它。

trans-unit.source: The name shown above the icon and read by assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在圖示上方、並由輔助技術讀出的名稱。

trans-unit.source: The icon a `MagnifyDock` launched.
trans-unit.target: `MagnifyDock` 啟動的圖示。

trans-unit.source: An Arc-styled Markdown document rendered by StreamMark: headings, lists, tables, quotes, links, inline code and fenced code highlighted in Arc's syntax palette. Show static text with `Text`, or stream a reply with `Append` / `Complete` (or your own `Stream`). The document grows with its content (no internal scrolling); put long documents in a `ScrollViewer`.
trans-unit.target: 由 StreamMark 渲染的 Arc 風格 Markdown 文件：標題、清單、表格、引言、連結、行內程式碼，以及依 Arc 語法配色高亮的圍欄程式碼區塊。使用 `Text` 顯示靜態文字，或使用 `Append` / `Complete`（或你自己的 `Stream`）串流輸出回覆。文件隨內容增長（無內部捲動）；長文件請放入 `ScrollViewer`。

trans-unit.source: Vertical space between blocks (paragraphs, lists, code, tables).
trans-unit.target: 區塊之間的垂直間距（段落、清單、程式碼、表格）。

trans-unit.source: The 0-based index of the current match, or -1 when the search has no match.
trans-unit.target: 目前相符項目的序號（從 0 開始），沒有相符項目時為 -1。

trans-unit.source: The current document is parsed and applied, so `GetOutline` and the scroll methods have their final targets. Raised again when a new `Text` or `Stream` becomes ready, and after a new template is applied. Runs on the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: 目前文件已解析並套用，因此 `GetOutline` 與跳轉方法的目標已最終確定。新的 `Text` 或 `Stream` 就緒、以及重新套用範本後再次引發。在 UI 執行緒上執行。

trans-unit.source: True when the document has a selection, so a copy action can be enabled.
trans-unit.target: 文件有選取範圍時為 true，可用於啟用複製操作。

trans-unit.source: True when the current document has been parsed and the result is applied to the view, so the outline, the search matches and the scroll targets are final. A static `Text` becomes ready once; a stream becomes ready when it completes. False before the template is applied and while a new source is being parsed.
trans-unit.target: 目前文件已解析且結果已套用到檢視時為 true，此時大綱、尋找相符項目與跳轉目標均已最終確定。靜態 `Text` 就緒一次；串流在結束時就緒。範本尚未套用時、以及新來源正在解析期間為 false。

trans-unit.source: Whether `Append` paces the text (true, the default: it is released in small steps that follow the arrival rate). False shows every appended piece as one batch at once: the host has already paced it, for example in whole words on a fixed clock.
trans-unit.target: `Append` 是否依節奏釋出文字（true，預設值：文字以小步釋出，並跟隨到達速率）。為 false 時，每次附加的內容都會一次整體顯示：宿主已自行依節奏處理，例如以固定時鐘逐個顯示完整單字。

trans-unit.source: Whether a stream is attached and has not completed yet.
trans-unit.target: 是否已附加串流且尚未完成。

trans-unit.source: Body line height in pixels; NaN (default) uses the font size times Arc's prose leading (1.65).
trans-unit.target: 內文行高，單位為像素；NaN（預設）時使用字型大小乘以 Arc 的正文行距（1.65）。

trans-unit.source: A link was clicked (anchors inside the document scroll by themselves and do not arrive here).
trans-unit.target: 連結被點擊時觸發（文件內的錨點會自行捲動，不會傳到這裡）。

trans-unit.source: The number of matches of the last `Find`, 0 when nothing is searched.
trans-unit.target: 最近一次 `Find` 的相符數量，未尋找時為 0。

trans-unit.source: Opens allowed absolute links (http, https, mailto) with the system launcher when no `LinkClicked` handler marks the event handled and the link policy does not ask for confirmation.
trans-unit.target: 在沒有 `LinkClicked` 處理常式將事件標記為已處理，且連結原則不要求確認時，使用系統啟動器開啟允許的絕對連結（http、https、mailto）。

trans-unit.source: How long each batch of text appended with `Append` fades in at full motion; null uses Arc's standard duration. A host that paces the text itself usually sets 150 ms.
trans-unit.target: 透過 `Append` 附加的每批文字以完整動效淡入所需的時長；為 null 時使用 Arc 的標準時長。宿主自行控制節奏時通常設為 150 ms。

trans-unit.source: Whether appended text still fades in at reduced motion (a short opacity fade). False shows it at once, which suits a reply that grows continuously: there is no whole to fade.
trans-unit.target: 透過 `Append` 附加的文字在減少動效時是否仍淡入（短暫的不透明度漸變）。為 false 時立即顯示，適合持續增長的回覆：此時沒有完整的整體可供淡入。

trans-unit.source: The matches or the current match of `Find` changed (including when the document changes under a search and the query is run again). Runs on the UI thread.
trans-unit.target: `Find` 的相符項目或目前相符項目發生變化（包括尋找期間文件變更、查詢重新執行）。在 UI 執行緒上執行。

trans-unit.source: The selection of the document view changed; `HasSelection` and the copy results follow.
trans-unit.target: 文件檢視的選取範圍發生變化；`HasSelection` 與複製結果隨之更新。

trans-unit.source: StreamMark services (plugins, code block options, link policy). Null uses services set on an ancestor with `MarkdownServices.SetServices`, else `DefaultServices`.
trans-unit.target: StreamMark 服務（外掛程式、程式碼區塊選項、連結原則）。為 null 時使用祖先元素上透過 `MarkdownServices.SetServices` 設定的服務，否則使用 `DefaultServices`。

trans-unit.source: A streamed reply to show instead of `Text`. `Append` creates one when none is set; you can also supply your own (for example one fed from a worker thread with `Push`).
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的串流回覆，代替 `Text`。未設定時，`Append` 會建立一個；你也可以提供自己的串流（例如透過 `Push` 從工作執行緒供給的串流）。

trans-unit.source: The Markdown source to show. Setting it ends a stream started with `Append`.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的 Markdown 原始文字。設定此屬性會結束由 `Append` 開始的串流。

trans-unit.source: Shares held of one ticker; the ticket blocks selling more than this.
trans-unit.target: 某個代碼的持股數；下單票會阻止賣出超過這一數量的股票。

trans-unit.source: An order in the `MarketTerminal` order list.
trans-unit.target: `MarketTerminal` 訂單列表中的一筆訂單。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the order when its status or price changes (a working order filled, an order canceled).
trans-unit.target: 訂單的狀態或價格變化時在訂單上觸發（掛單成交、訂單被取消）。

trans-unit.source: What the ticket submits: passed to `PlaceOrderAction` and `OrderPlaced`.
trans-unit.target: 下單票提交的內容：傳給 `PlaceOrderAction` 和 `OrderPlaced`。

trans-unit.source: Which side of the market an order takes.
trans-unit.target: 訂單的買賣方向。

trans-unit.source: Where an order stands.
trans-unit.target: 訂單所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: How an order is priced.
trans-unit.target: 訂單的定價方式。

trans-unit.source: The time range of the `MarketTerminal` chart.
trans-unit.target: `MarketTerminal` 圖表的時間範圍。

trans-unit.source: A symbol of the `MarketTerminal` watchlist. Its candles are generated from these numbers, the same way every time for the same ticker and range, and then move with the simulated live price.
trans-unit.target: `MarketTerminal` 自選清單中的一個代碼。它的 K 線由這些數字產生，同一代碼和範圍每次產生的結果都相同，之後隨模擬的即時價格變動。

trans-unit.source: A trading terminal screen. A candlestick chart with volume, two moving averages, a crosshair with an open, high, low and close readout, and wheel, drag and pinch zoom sits beside a watchlist with intraday sparklines and flashing live prices, and an order ticket for market and limit orders with an order list. Everything is simulated by default: candles are generated from each symbol's price, previous close and volatility, ticks are a random walk, and orders fill against the live price locally. Set `PlaceOrderAction` and `CancelOrderAction` (and feed prices with `SetPrice`) to connect it to a real service.
trans-unit.target: 一個交易終端畫面。帶成交量、兩條移動平均線、顯示開高低收讀數的十字線，以及滾輪、拖曳與雙指縮放的 K 線圖，旁邊是帶日內迷你走勢線和閃爍即時價格的自選清單，以及用於市價單和限價單、附帶訂單列表的下單票。預設一切都是模擬的：K 線由每個代碼的價格、昨收和波動率產生，跳動是隨機漫步，訂單在本機按即時價格成交。設定 `PlaceOrderAction` 和 `CancelOrderAction`（並用 `SetPrice` 輸入價格）即可串接真實服務。

trans-unit.source: Cash available for buys (two-way). The ticket blocks a buy that costs more, and fills update it.
trans-unit.target: 可用於買入的現金（雙向）。下單票會阻止成本超出它的買單，成交會更新它。

trans-unit.source: Cancels a working order with a real service; awaited before the order shows as canceled. Null cancels at once.
trans-unit.target: 透過真實服務取消掛單；在訂單顯示為已取消之前等待它完成。為 null 時立即取消。

trans-unit.source: Whether simulated ticks stream (two-way; the Live button pauses and resumes them).
trans-unit.target: 是否持續產生模擬跳動（雙向；Live 按鈕可暫停和恢復）。

trans-unit.source: The block's built-in text.
trans-unit.target: 區塊的內建文字。

trans-unit.source: The ticket's limit price (two-way); 0 fills in the live price when the limit field opens.
trans-unit.target: 下單票的限價（雙向）；為 0 時，限價輸入框展開時填入即時價格。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a working order is canceled from the list.
trans-unit.target: 從列表中取消掛單時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an order fills: a market order right away, a limit order when the price reaches it.
trans-unit.target: 訂單成交時觸發：市價單立即觸發，限價單在價格到達時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an order is placed (it may already be filled, or working).
trans-unit.target: 下單時觸發（訂單可能已經成交，也可能在掛單等待）。

trans-unit.source: The ticket's share count (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 下單票的股數（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: The ticket's side (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 下單票的買賣方向（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: The ticket's order type (two-way); a limit order shows the limit price field.
trans-unit.target: 下單票的訂單類型（雙向）；限價單會顯示限價輸入框。

trans-unit.source: Places an order with a real service: awaited when the ticket is submitted, while the button shows a spinner. An exception leaves the order unplaced and writes its message under the button. Null places it locally at once.
trans-unit.target: 透過真實服務下單：提交下單票時等待它完成，期間按鈕顯示載入指示。拋出例外時訂單不會下達，並把例外訊息寫在按鈕下方。為 null 時立即在本機下單。

trans-unit.source: The chart's time range (two-way). One and five days use 5 and 30 minute candles; the rest are daily.
trans-unit.target: 圖表的時間範圍（雙向）。一天和五天使用 5 分鐘和 30 分鐘 K 線；其餘使用日線。

trans-unit.source: The trading day the simulation treats as today; null uses today's date.
trans-unit.target: 模擬視為今天的交易日；為 null 時使用今天的日期。

trans-unit.source: Whether the 20 candle moving average is drawn (two-way; the toolbar toggles it).
trans-unit.target: 是否繪製 20 根 K 線的移動平均線（雙向；工具列可切換）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the 50 candle moving average is drawn (two-way; the toolbar toggles it).
trans-unit.target: 是否繪製 50 根 K 線的移動平均線（雙向；工具列可切換）。

trans-unit.source: Time between simulated ticks.
trans-unit.target: 兩次模擬跳動之間的時間。

trans-unit.source: The symbol charted and traded (two-way); null or unknown charts the first symbol.
trans-unit.target: 正在繪製和交易的代碼（雙向）；為 null 或未知時繪製第一個代碼。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the charted symbol changes.
trans-unit.target: 圖表所顯示的代碼變化時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text of `MarketTerminal`. Replace the whole object to localize the block; parameterized entries are functions that receive already formatted values. Times and numbers use en-US formats.
trans-unit.target: `MarketTerminal` 的內建文字。替換整個物件即可在地化區塊；帶參數的項目是接收已格式化值的函式。時間與數字使用 en-US 格式。

trans-unit.source: Fails text longer than `Length` characters.
trans-unit.target: 文字長度超過 `Length` 個字元時不通過。

trans-unit.source: A tool server `McpServers` lists: its name, how it is reached, whether it is on, where it stands and the tools it offers. Data only: an `AvaloniaObject` so changes from your code or from the block reach both the screen and your bindings.
trans-unit.target: `McpServers` 列出的一個工具伺服器：它的名稱、存取方式、是否打開、目前狀態以及它提供的工具。僅為資料：它是一個 `AvaloniaObject`，因此你的程式碼或區塊做出的修改都會同時反映到介面和你的繫結上。

trans-unit.source: The arguments after `Command`, as one line.
trans-unit.target: `Command` 之後的參數，寫成一行。

trans-unit.source: The program of a command server, such as `npx` or `/usr/local/bin/ledger-tools`.
trans-unit.target: 命令伺服器要啟動的程式，例如 `npx` 或 `/usr/local/bin/ledger-tools`。

trans-unit.source: The server's last lines of output or the transport's trace, shown under "Show log" with the error.
trans-unit.target: 伺服器最後幾行輸出或傳輸層的追蹤記錄，與錯誤一起顯示在 "Show log" 下。

trans-unit.source: One sentence on why the last connection failed; shown while `Status` is `Error`.
trans-unit.target: 用一句話說明上次連線為什麼失敗；在 `Status` 為 `Error` 時顯示。

trans-unit.source: A stable id reported in events; the block makes one from the name for servers it adds.
trans-unit.target: 在事件中報告的穩定 id；區塊為自己新增的伺服器根據名稱產生 id。

trans-unit.source: Whether the server is turned on (two-way; the row's switch edits it). Default true.
trans-unit.target: 伺服器是否打開（雙向；列上的開關會修改它）。預設為 true。

trans-unit.source: The display name, such as "Field notes".
trans-unit.target: 顯示名稱，例如 "Field notes"。

trans-unit.source: Where the server stands (two-way; the block sets it while connecting).
trans-unit.target: 伺服器的目前狀態（雙向；區塊在連線時會設定它）。

trans-unit.source: How the server is reached: `Http` (default) or `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 伺服器的存取方式：`Http`（預設）或 `Command`。

trans-unit.source: The address of an HTTP server, such as `https://notes.example.dev/mcp`.
trans-unit.target: HTTP 伺服器的位址，例如 `https://notes.example.dev/mcp`。

trans-unit.source: Headers (HTTP) or environment variables (command) sent to the server; only their keys are shown.
trans-unit.target: 傳送給伺服器的請求標頭（HTTP）或環境變數（命令）；只顯示它們的鍵名。

trans-unit.source: The version the server reported, such as "2.3.1"; null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 伺服器報告的版本，例如 "2.3.1"；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: A card to manage the tool servers (MCP) an assistant can call. Each server is a row with its mark, name, transport tag (HTTP or Local), a live status line (connected with its tool count, connecting, couldn't connect, off) and a switch that turns it on or off. Opening a row shows why it failed, with the log and Retry; its tools, each with a switch (Enable all and Disable all for the lot, a "Changes data" tag on tools that write); its address or command, header or variable keys and version; and Reconnect and Remove with a confirmation. Add server opens a form for a URL or a command with its arguments and optional headers or environment variables; the new server joins the list and connects. The servers are `McpServer` objects in `Servers` (four invented samples by default; give your own list, an `ObservableCollection` works, and the block adds and removes on it). Connections go through `ConnectAsync`; without it the block simulates one (`SimulateConnect`). Every change is reported by an event, and read out by a polite live region.
trans-unit.target: 一張卡片，用來管理助理可以呼叫的工具伺服器（MCP）。每個伺服器是一列，包含標記、名稱、傳輸標籤（HTTP 或 Local）、即時狀態列（已連線及工具數量、正在連線、無法連線、已關閉）以及一個打開或關閉它的開關。展開一列會顯示：失敗原因、記錄和 Retry；它的工具，每個工具都有開關（Enable all 和 Disable all 一次改變全部，會寫入資料的工具帶有 "Changes data" 標籤）；它的位址或命令、請求標頭或變數的鍵名以及版本；以及 Reconnect 和需要確認的 Remove。Add server 打開一個表單，可以填寫 URL，或填寫命令及其參數，並可加上請求標頭或環境變數；新伺服器加入清單後立即連線。伺服器是 `Servers` 中的 `McpServer` 物件（預設是四個虛構的範例；也可以交給它你自己的清單，可以使用 `ObservableCollection`，區塊會在其上新增和移除）。連線透過 `ConnectAsync` 進行；未設定時區塊會模擬連線（`SimulateConnect`）。每次變化都會透過事件報告，並由一個禮貌的即時區域讀出。

trans-unit.source: Whether the Add server button is offered (default true; a read-only list never offers it).
trans-unit.target: 是否提供 Add server 按鈕（預設為 true；唯讀清單從不提供）。

trans-unit.source: Whether open servers offer Remove (default true; a read-only list never offers it).
trans-unit.target: 展開的伺服器是否提供 Remove（預設為 true；唯讀清單從不提供）。

trans-unit.source: Connects a server and lists its tools: awaited while the server shows Connecting, with a token cancelled when the server is turned off, removed, connected again or the block leaves the window. Return `Success` or `Failure`; throwing fails with the exception's message. Null waits `SimulatedConnectDuration` and uses `SimulateConnect`.
trans-unit.target: 連線一個伺服器並列出它的工具：在伺服器顯示 Connecting 期間等待它完成，並傳入一個權杖；當伺服器被關閉、被移除、再次連線或區塊離開視窗時，權杖會被取消。傳回 `Success` 或 `Failure`；擲回例外時以例外訊息作為失敗原因。為 null 時等待 `SimulatedConnectDuration`，然後使用 `SimulateConnect`。

trans-unit.source: How many servers are on and connected.
trans-unit.target: 已打開並已連線的伺服器數量。

trans-unit.source: How many tools are enabled on the connected servers: what the assistant can call now.
trans-unit.target: 已連線伺服器上已啟用的工具數量：助理現在可以呼叫的工具。

trans-unit.source: The open server (two-way); one at a time, null when all are closed.
trans-unit.target: 展開的伺服器（雙向）；一次只展開一個，全部收合時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Whether the Add server form is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: Add server 表單是否打開（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: True while the block is at most 520 wide (the compact paddings).
trans-unit.target: 區塊寬度不超過 520 時為 true（使用緊湊的內距）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or reads out (English by default).
trans-unit.target: 區塊顯示或讀出的所有文字（預設為英文）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a server joined the list from the form or `AddServer` (before it connects).
trans-unit.target: 有伺服器透過表單或 `AddServer` 加入清單時引發（在它連線之前）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a server left the list after its removal was confirmed, or by `RemoveServer`.

trans-unit.source: The servers, in display order. Default: a fresh copy of `Servers` per block. The block adds and removes servers on this list (when it is not read-only) and follows its changes when it raises them.
trans-unit.target: 伺服器，依顯示順序排列。預設：每個區塊各有一份 `Servers` 的新副本。區塊會在這個清單上新增和移除伺服器（清單不是唯讀時），並在清單報告變化時跟隨它。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a server's switch turned it on or off.

trans-unit.source: How long a simulated connection takes when `ConnectAsync` is null (1.2 s).
trans-unit.target: `ConnectAsync` 為 null 時，模擬連線所用的時間（1.2 秒）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a server's `Status` changed, by the block or by your code.
trans-unit.target: 伺服器的 `Status` 改變時引發，無論是區塊還是你的程式碼改變的。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading; null shows `Subtitle`, an empty string hides it.

trans-unit.source: Raised when tools were turned on or off: one by its switch, or several by Enable all or Disable all.

trans-unit.target: 伺服器提供的一個工具：助理呼叫它所用的名稱、一句說明它做什麼的話，以及是否提供它。僅為資料：它是一個 `AvaloniaObject`，因此在程式碼中（或由區塊）做出的修改會反映到介面和你的繫結上。

trans-unit.source: Whether the tool writes, sends or deletes something; its row shows a "Changes data" tag.

trans-unit.source: One sentence on what the tool does.

trans-unit.source: Whether the tool is offered to the assistant (two-way; default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否把這個工具提供給助理（雙向；預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: The name the assistant calls the tool by, such as `search_notes`.
trans-unit.target: 助理呼叫這個工具時使用的名稱，例如 `search_notes`。

trans-unit.source: An audio player with a playlist: the current track's cover, title and artist, previous / play / next buttons, a seek bar with the elapsed and total time, a mute button with a volume slider, and the tracks as rows that play when pressed. Playback goes through `Backend` (or `AudioBackend`): add `TKCode.Arc.Audio.Native` on desktop or `TKCode.Arc.Audio.Browser` in WebAssembly for sound; the default backend keeps time silently. Skipping wraps around and keeps playing or paused as it was; a track that reaches its end stops and returns to 0:00.
trans-unit.target: 附播放清單的音訊播放器：目前曲目的封面、標題和藝人，上一首 / 播放 / 下一首按鈕，附已播放與總長度的進度列，附音量滑桿的靜音按鈕，以及按下即播放的曲目列。播放透過 `Backend`（或 `AudioBackend`）：桌面加入 `TKCode.Arc.Audio.Native`、WebAssembly 加入 `TKCode.Arc.Audio.Browser` 即可發聲；預設後端只靜默計時。切換曲目會循環並維持原本的播放或暫停；曲目播放到結尾會停下並回到 0:00。

trans-unit.source: The backend that plays the audio; null uses `Backend`. Set it before the player is shown.
trans-unit.target: 播放音訊的後端；為 null 時使用 `Backend`。請在播放器顯示之前設定。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the player tightens (smaller paddings, buttons and title; a taller cover). 420.
trans-unit.target: 低於此寬度時播放器收緊（更小的內距、按鈕和標題；更高的封面）。420。

trans-unit.source: The volume the mute button restores when nothing louder was muted before (0.7).
trans-unit.target: 先前沒有可還原的音量時，靜音按鈕還原的音量（0.7）。

trans-unit.source: The current track's length: what the backend reports once it is loaded, the track's own `Duration` before.
trans-unit.target: 目前曲目的長度：載入後為後端回報的值，載入前為曲目本身的 `Duration`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the backend makes sound (false for the silent default backend).
trans-unit.target: 後端是否發出聲音（預設的靜默後端為 false）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the compact layout applies (the player is narrower than `CompactWidth`).
trans-unit.target: 是否使用緊湊版面（播放器窄於 `CompactWidth`）。

trans-unit.source: Draws a bordered card with rounded corners (true); false lays the player flat on the page.
trans-unit.target: 繪製附圓角的邊框卡片（true）；false 時播放器平鋪在頁面上。

trans-unit.source: Whether the volume is zero (the mute button then offers to unmute).
trans-unit.target: 音量是否為零（此時靜音按鈕提供取消靜音）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the current track is playing (two-way): set it to play or pause.
trans-unit.target: 目前曲目是否正在播放（雙向）：設定它即可播放或暫停。

trans-unit.source: Every word the player shows or reads to screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 播放器顯示或讀給螢幕閱讀器的全部文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the backend could not load or play the current track.
trans-unit.target: 後端無法載入或播放目前曲目時觸發。

trans-unit.source: How far into the current track playback is, as last reported by the backend.
trans-unit.target: 目前曲目已播放到的位置，以後端最近一次回報為準。

trans-unit.source: The index of the current track in `Tracks` (two-way); −1 when the playlist is empty.
trans-unit.target: 目前曲目在 `Tracks` 中的索引（雙向）；播放清單為空時為 −1。

trans-unit.source: The current track; null when the playlist is empty.
trans-unit.target: 目前曲目；播放清單為空時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the current track changes.
trans-unit.target: 目前曲目改變時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the current track played to its end (the player has stopped and returned to the start).
trans-unit.target: 目前曲目播放到結尾時觸發（播放器已停止並回到開頭）。

trans-unit.source: The output volume from 0 to 1 (two-way, 0.7); 0 is muted.
trans-unit.target: 輸出音量，從 0 到 1（雙向，0.7）；0 即靜音。

trans-unit.source: Every word `MediaPlayer` shows or reads to screen readers, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; texts that take values are functions so that word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `MediaPlayer` 顯示或讀給螢幕閱讀器的每個字，預設為英文。替換整個執行個體即可翻譯或改寫；帶數值的文字是函式，以便調整語序。

trans-unit.source: One entry of a `MediaPlayer`'s playlist: what it is called, who made it, its cover and the audio to play.
trans-unit.target: `MediaPlayer` 播放清單中的一項：名稱、作者、封面和要播放的音訊。

trans-unit.source: The album or collection; shown under the heading after the artist.
trans-unit.target: 專輯或合輯；顯示在標題下方、藝人之後。

trans-unit.source: Who made it; shown under the heading before the album.
trans-unit.target: 作者；顯示在標題下方、專輯之前。

trans-unit.source: The cover art, drawn to fill the cover frame (cropped, not stretched).
trans-unit.target: 封面圖，填滿封面框（裁切，不拉伸）。

trans-unit.source: What the cover shows, for screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 封面內容的描述，供螢幕閱讀器使用。

trans-unit.source: The track's length, shown in the playlist before it has been loaded; the player replaces it with the length the audio reports once the track is loaded.
trans-unit.target: 曲目的長度，在載入前顯示在播放清單中；曲目載入後，播放器會用音訊回報的長度取代它。

trans-unit.source: The audio to play; a track without one can be selected but stays silent.
trans-unit.target: 要播放的音訊；沒有音訊的曲目可以選取，但不會發聲。

trans-unit.source: Anything you want to keep with the track.
trans-unit.target: 任何想隨曲目保存的內容。

trans-unit.source: The track's name: the player's heading while it is current, and its row in the playlist.
trans-unit.target: 曲目名稱：作為目前曲目時是播放器的標題，也是它在播放清單中的那一列。

trans-unit.source: One task from the call: an owner, a due date and whether it is done.
trans-unit.target: 通話中產生的一項任務：一位負責人、一個到期日，以及是否已完成。

trans-unit.source: AI notes for one call (Arc Meeting summary, design reference): a header with the platform's mark, the title, the platform, date and length and the attendee stack, then Summary, Decisions and Action items that stream in after a short summarizing pass. Hovering a line, or focusing its timestamp, shows the transcript quote it came from. Action items can be checked off and sent to an issue tracker or a docs app (`SendRequested`); the footer credits the model and offers copy and regenerate. Give it the notes in `Meeting` and drive `Status` yourself, or leave `Status` unset and the card plays its own summarizing pass when it scrolls into view. With `Summarizer` the card calls your async streaming delegate instead and streams each snapshot it yields. With neither it plays a `Simulation` (a call's notes you pass); with no data at all it shows the no transcript state. A send with no handler is simulated.
trans-unit.target: 一次通話的 AI 會議紀錄（Arc Meeting summary，設計參考）：頁首包含平台標誌、標題、平台、日期與時長以及與會者頭像組，接著是經過一段簡短的彙整過程後串流出現的摘要、決議和待辦事項。滑鼠停在一行上或聚焦它的時間戳記，會顯示它出自的逐字稿原話。待辦事項可以勾選完成，也可以傳送到議題追蹤工具或文件應用程式（`SendRequested`）；頁尾署名模型，並提供複製和重新產生。把紀錄放進 `Meeting` 並自己驅動 `Status`，或者不設定 `Status`，讓卡片在捲動進入畫面時自己播放彙整過程。設定 `Summarizer` 後，卡片改為呼叫你的非同步串流委派，並串流顯示它產出的每一個快照。兩者都沒有時，它播放 `Simulation`（你傳入的一次通話的紀錄）；完全沒有資料時，顯示「無逐字稿」狀態。沒有處理常式的傳送是模擬的。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person checks or unchecks an action item. The card keeps the checked state itself. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 使用者勾選或取消勾選一個待辦事項時觸發。勾選狀態由卡片自己保存。向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a send succeeded (or a simulated send finished). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 傳送成功（或模擬傳送完成）時觸發。向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: When the card drives its own status: start summarizing and play the pass. False starts on the finished notes.
trans-unit.target: 卡片自己驅動狀態時：開始彙整並播放彙整過程。為 false 時一開始就顯示完成的紀錄。

trans-unit.source: The message under the error title when the status is Error.
trans-unit.target: 狀態為 Error 時顯示在錯誤標題下方的訊息。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個文字。

trans-unit.source: The notes of the call. Null plays `Simulation`, or shows the no transcript state without one.
trans-unit.target: 這次通話的紀錄。為 null 時播放 `Simulation`，沒有模擬時顯示「無逐字稿」狀態。

trans-unit.source: The model credited in the footer. Null credits the `Simulation`'s model while one plays, or hides the credit.
trans-unit.target: 頁尾中署名的模型。為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間署名其模型，否則隱藏署名。

trans-unit.source: Raised by Regenerate in the footer and Try again in the error state. Bubbles. A card that drives its own status also replays its pass (or runs `Summarizer` again).
trans-unit.target: 由頁尾的重新產生和錯誤狀態中的 Try again 觸發。向上傳遞。自己驅動狀態的卡片還會重新播放它的彙整過程（或再次執行 `Summarizer`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person sends an action item. Bubbles. Set `Completion` to your request before the handler returns; leave it null and the card simulates the send.
trans-unit.target: 使用者傳送一個待辦事項時觸發。向上傳遞。在處理常式返回之前把 `Completion` 設為你的請求；保持為 null 時，卡片會模擬這次傳送。

trans-unit.source: Where action items can be sent (Issues and Docs by default). An empty list hides the send buttons.
trans-unit.target: 待辦事項可以傳送到的位置（預設是 Issues 和 Docs）。空清單會隱藏傳送按鈕。

trans-unit.source: A call to play while the card has no `Meeting` and no `Summarizer`: its notes and model, with the summarizing pass, the notes streaming in and a tick and a send played once (sends are simulated). Your own data wins over it; null stops it and shows the no transcript state.
trans-unit.target: 卡片既沒有 `Meeting` 也沒有 `Summarizer` 時要播放的通話：它的紀錄和模型，包括彙整過程、串流顯示紀錄，以及只播放一次的勾選和傳送（傳送是模擬的）。你自己的資料優先於它；為 null 時停止播放並顯示「無逐字稿」狀態。

trans-unit.source: The status, when you drive it. Null (the default) lets the card play its own summarizing pass when it scrolls into view, or run `Summarizer`. Ready with empty lists shows the no transcript state.
trans-unit.target: 由你驅動時的狀態。為 null（預設）時，卡片在捲動進入畫面後播放自己的彙整過程，或執行 `Summarizer`。Ready 且清單為空時顯示沒有逐字稿的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Stream the notes in, a few words at a time, when the status moves from Summarizing to Ready.
trans-unit.target: 狀態從 Summarizing 變為 Ready 時，以每次幾個字詞的方式串流顯示紀錄。

trans-unit.source: An async streaming delegate that produces the notes: the card calls it when it drives its own status (on first view and on regenerate), shows the summarizing pass until the first snapshot arrives, then streams every snapshot it yields (each one the notes so far). A fault shows the error state with its message. Takes the place of `Meeting` while it runs.
trans-unit.target: 產生紀錄的非同步串流委派：卡片自己驅動狀態時（第一次進入畫面和重新產生時）呼叫它，在第一個快照抵達之前顯示彙整過程，之後串流顯示它產出的每一個快照（每一個都是截至目前的紀錄）。出錯時顯示帶有錯誤訊息的錯誤狀態。執行期間取代 `Meeting`。

trans-unit.source: The notes of one call: what it was, who was on it, and the Summary, Decisions and Action items lists. Map your model's output to it; keep `At` as the time from the start of the recording.
trans-unit.target: 一次通話的紀錄：通話內容、與會者，以及摘要、決議和待辦事項三個清單。把模型的輸出對應到它；`At` 保持為從錄音開始算起的時間。

trans-unit.source: Every word `MeetingSummary` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; counts, dates and names are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `MeetingSummary` 顯示或朗讀的每一個文字，預設為英文。若要在地化或改寫，請替換整個物件；數量、日期和姓名是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: Somewhere an action item can be sent: an issue tracker, a notes app. A name and a 24 × 24 stroked mark; the defaults are `Issues` and `Docs`. Pass your own mark for a real product.
trans-unit.target: 待辦事項可以傳送到的地方：議題追蹤工具、筆記應用程式。一個名稱和一個 24 × 24 的描邊標誌；預設值是 `Issues` 和 `Docs`。對於真實的產品，請傳入你自己的標誌。

trans-unit.source: A call a `MeetingSummary` plays without a summarizer, from data you give it: the notes, the model credited and how simulated sends are numbered. Set it as `Simulation` while the card has no `Meeting` and no `Summarizer`: when the card scrolls into view it plays its summarizing pass, streams the notes in and, unless someone uses the card first, ticks off the second action item and sends the first one. Sends are simulated and announce that nothing was sent.
trans-unit.target: `MeetingSummary` 在沒有彙整器時依你提供的資料播放的通話：會議紀錄、署名的模型，以及模擬傳送的編號方式。在卡片既沒有 `Meeting` 也沒有 `Summarizer` 時把它設為 `Simulation`：卡片捲動進入畫面後會播放彙整過程、串流顯示紀錄，並且只要沒有人先操作卡片，就會勾選第二個待辦事項並傳送第一個。傳送是模擬的，並會播報什麼都沒有傳送。

trans-unit.source: A site navigation bar whose dropdown is one panel that morphs. Hovering a top-level item opens its panel under the bar; moving to a neighbour does not close and reopen it: the panel springs to the new item's size and place while the old content slides out toward where the pointer came from and the new content slides in from where it went. Items without a panel are plain links.
trans-unit.target: 一個網站導覽列，它的下拉部分是一個會變形的面板。懸停在頂層項目上會在導覽列下方開啟它的面板；移到相鄰項目時不會關閉再重新開啟：面板以彈簧變到新項目的大小和位置，舊內容朝指標來的方向滑出，新內容從指標去的方向滑入。沒有面板的項目是一般連結。

trans-unit.source: How long the pointer may be away from the bar and the panel before the panel closes.
trans-unit.target: 指標離開導覽列和面板多久之後面板才關閉。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the navigation landmark.
trans-unit.target: 導覽區域的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a link inside a panel, or a top-level item without a panel, is activated. The panel closes after it.
trans-unit.target: 選取面板中的連結，或選取沒有面板的頂層項目時觸發。之後面板關閉。

trans-unit.source: The panel is never wider than this; content that wants more is measured at this width (and wraps).
trans-unit.target: 面板最寬不超過這個值；想要更寬的內容會按這個寬度測量（並換行）。

trans-unit.source: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before a closed menu opens (moves between items while open are instant).
trans-unit.target: 指標在觸發項上停留多久後才開啟關閉中的選單（開啟時在項目之間移動是立即的）。

trans-unit.source: The index of the item whose panel is open, or -1 when the panel is closed (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 面板已開啟的項目的索引，面板關閉時為 -1（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: When false, hovering does nothing and panels open only on click, tap or the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時懸停沒有作用，面板只在點擊、輕觸或使用鍵盤時開啟。

trans-unit.source: One top-level entry of a `MegaMenuMorph`: a label in the bar and, when `Content` is set, the panel it opens. An item without content is a plain link: activating it raises `LinkInvoked`.
trans-unit.target: `MegaMenuMorph` 的一個頂層項目：導覽列中的一個標籤，設定了 `Content` 時還有它開啟的面板。沒有內容的項目是一般連結：啟用它會觸發 `LinkInvoked`。

trans-unit.source: What the panel shows: a control (usually a grid of `MegaMenuMorphLink`s) or data shown through `ContentTemplate`. Null makes the item a plain link without a panel.
trans-unit.target: 面板顯示的內容：一個控制項（通常是放著 `MegaMenuMorphLink` 的網格），或透過 `ContentTemplate` 顯示的資料。為 null 時項目是沒有面板的一般連結。

trans-unit.source: The template that turns `Content` into controls when it is data.
trans-unit.target: 當 `Content` 是資料時，把它變成控制項的範本。

trans-unit.source: The label shown in the bar and used as the name of the trigger and of its panel.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在導覽列中的標籤，也用作觸發項和面板的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Set to mark the item that belongs to the current page: its label keeps the full text color and is announced as current.
trans-unit.target: 標記屬於目前頁面的項目：它的標籤保持完整的文字顏色，並被播報為目前項目。

trans-unit.source: Anything the app wants to keep with the item (a route, a page key). The menu never reads it.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式想和項目一起保存的任何東西（路由、頁面鍵）。選單從不讀取它。

trans-unit.source: A destination inside a `MegaMenuMorph` panel: an icon on a quiet tile, a title and an optional one-line description. It is a button, so it has the usual click, command and keyboard behavior; the menu raises `LinkInvoked` and closes when one is clicked. Up and Down move between the links of a panel.
trans-unit.target: `MegaMenuMorph` 面板中的一個目標：柔和圖塊上的圖示、標題和選用的一行說明。它是一個按鈕，所以有一般的點擊、命令和鍵盤行為；點擊時選單觸發 `LinkInvoked` 並關閉。Up 和 Down 在面板的連結之間移動。

trans-unit.source: One short line under the title, or null for none.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行簡短說明，為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example one of `ArcIcons`) shown on a tile before the text, or null for none.
trans-unit.target: 一個 24×24 的描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons` 中的一個），顯示在文字前的圖塊上，為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The link's title.
trans-unit.target: 連結的標題。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `LinkInvoked`: the top-level item and, inside its panel, the link.
trans-unit.target: `LinkInvoked` 的參數：頂層項目，以及它面板中的連結。

trans-unit.target: 記憶的一個歸檔群組（預設為「關於你」「偏好」「專案」「人物」）。

trans-unit.source: The key a memory's `GroupKey` refers to.
trans-unit.target: 記憶的 `GroupKey` 所指向的鍵。

trans-unit.source: The label of the filter pill and the group heading.
trans-unit.target: 篩選膠囊與群組標題的標籤。

trans-unit.source: One thing the assistant remembers about the person. Data only: an `AvaloniaObject` so that the properties bind and a change (an edit from elsewhere) reaches the row on screen.
trans-unit.target: 助手對使用者記住的一件事。僅為資料：它是一個 `AvaloniaObject`，因此屬性可以繫結，其他地方的變更（例如編輯）也能同步到畫面上的列。

trans-unit.target: 該記憶所歸入的 `MemoryGroup` 的鍵。

trans-unit.source: Stable id, unique within `Memories`.

trans-unit.target: 設定後（記憶與某人有關），該列會顯示一個小頭像，且此名稱作為其無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The date of the source, shown as a short date such as "Sep 8".

trans-unit.source: The memory as one sentence without a final period, such as "Prefers tables to long bullet lists".
trans-unit.target: 記憶內容，為一個不含句末句號的句子，例如「偏好表格勝過長條列表」。
