trans-unit.source: One row of a `MenuSurface`: a leading icon (a Lucide `Geometry` such as `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}`, or any control), a header, an optional shortcut hint and the check or radio indicator of toggle rows. Rows never draw their own hover or focus fill: the surface's shared highlight glides to the row under the pointer and jumps to the keyboard position. Activation runs `Command`, raises `Click` and the surface's `ItemClicked`, then closes the menu unless `StaysOpenOnClick` is set. A row with child rows (`Items` declared inline, or `ItemsSource`) opens a submenu instead: it shows a chevron, and a click, Enter, Space or ArrowRight opens the submenu beside the menu (hovering opens it after a short delay). Rows inside a submenu can open their own submenus.
trans-unit.target: `MenuSurface` 中的一列：前置圖示（Lucide `Geometry`，例如 `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Pencil}`，或任意控制項）、標題、可選的快速鍵提示，以及切換列的勾選或單選指示器。各列不繪製自己的懸停或焦點填色：由選單面板共用的反白會滑動到指標所在的列，並跳到鍵盤所在的位置。啟動時會執行 `Command`、引發 `Click` 與選單面板的 `ItemClicked`，然後關閉選單，除非設定了 `StaysOpenOnClick`。帶子列的列（內嵌宣告的 `Items`，或 `ItemsSource`）則改為開啟子選單：它會顯示箭頭，點選、Enter、Space 或 ArrowRight 會在選單旁開啟子選單（懸停片刻後也會開啟）。子選單中的列也可以開啟自己的子選單。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the row is activated (pointer release, Enter or Space), before the menu closes.
trans-unit.target: 列被啟動（指標放開、Enter 或空白鍵）時引發，發生在選單關閉之前。

trans-unit.source: Command run when the row is activated; the row is disabled while the command cannot execute.
trans-unit.target: 列被啟動時執行的命令；命令無法執行時此列會被停用。

trans-unit.source: Parameter passed to Command when the row is activated.
trans-unit.target: 列被啟動時傳遞給 Command 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Radio rows with the same group name (within one surface) are mutually exclusive.
trans-unit.target: 同一群組名稱（在同一選單面板內）的單選列互斥。

trans-unit.source: Draws a separator line above the row (Arc's `separatorBefore`).
trans-unit.target: 在列的上方繪製分隔線（Arc 的 `separatorBefore`）。

trans-unit.source: True when the row opens a submenu (it has child rows): it shows a chevron instead of a shortcut hint and opens the submenu instead of running `Command` or raising `Click`.
trans-unit.target: 列會開啟子選單（它有子列）時為 true：它顯示箭頭而不是快速鍵提示，並且會開啟子選單，而不是執行 `Command` 或引發 `Click`。

trans-unit.source: The row label (strings ellipsize; any content is accepted). Also the typeahead text unless `TextSearch.Text` is set.
trans-unit.target: 列的標籤（字串會被省略截斷，也可接受任意內容）。除非設定了 `TextSearch.Text`，否則它也是輸入搜尋的文字。

trans-unit.source: Data template that renders the header; without one, a string header is drawn as ellipsizing text.
trans-unit.target: 渲染標題的資料範本；未設定時，字串標題會以省略號截斷的文字繪製。

trans-unit.source: Leading icon: a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` (drawn as a 16px stroke glyph) or any control.
trans-unit.target: 前置圖示：24x24 的 Lucide `Geometry`（繪製為 16px 描邊圖示）或任意控制項。

trans-unit.source: Shortcut shown as a quiet hint at the row end (display only; bind the key with a hot key yourself).
trans-unit.target: 顯示在列末端的快速鍵提示（僅用於顯示；快速鍵需自行以熱鍵繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Free-form shortcut hint (for example "⌘ ,"); wins over `InputGesture`.
trans-unit.target: 自由格式的快速鍵提示（例如 “⌘ ,”）；優先於 `InputGesture`。

trans-unit.source: Checked state (two-way). Rows without an icon show a check (or a dot for radio rows) when checked.
trans-unit.target: 勾選狀態（雙向繫結）。沒有圖示的列在選取時顯示勾選標記（單選列顯示圓點）。

trans-unit.source: Danger text and icon, and a danger-tinted highlight. Put destructive rows last and name what they destroy.
trans-unit.target: 危險文字與圖示，並使用危險色調的反白。破壞性列應放在最後，並寫明將被破壞的對象。

trans-unit.source: Rows of the submenu this row opens, from data (use it or inline `Items`, not both). Items are turned into rows the way the menu's own items are: `MenuEntry` instances are used as is.
trans-unit.target: 此列所開啟子選單的列，來自資料（與內嵌的 `Items` 二擇一，不要同時使用）。各項轉換為列的方式與選單自身的項目相同：`MenuEntry` 執行個體按原樣使用。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the menu open after activation (toggles that people flip several times).
trans-unit.target: 啟動後保持選單開啟（適用於需要多次切換的開關）。

trans-unit.source: How the row toggles when activated: None for a command row, CheckBox, or Radio.
trans-unit.target: 列被啟動時的切換方式：None（命令列）、CheckBox 或 Radio。

trans-unit.source: Inherited from the owning `MenuSurface`; selects the row geometry.
trans-unit.target: 繼承自所屬的 `MenuSurface`；決定列的幾何外觀。

trans-unit.source: Arc metric card: a compact summary for a number that needs context (uptime, orders). The value rolls like an odometer (`AnimatedCounter`, from zero on first view); the label, context and change chip roll in from the side the number moved toward (a larger number rises from below, a smaller one drops from above), and the chip's width springs to fit. A signed change reads its direction in color as well as sign; set `IsChangeGlyphVisible` to add a direction glyph and `Sparkline` for a small trend line.
trans-unit.target: Arc 指標卡片：用於呈現需要上下文的數字的精簡摘要（如運作時間、訂單數）。數值以里程表式滾動（`AnimatedCounter`，首次顯示時從零開始）；標籤、上下文與變化標籤會從數字移動的方向滾入（較大的數字從下方升起，較小的數字從上方落下），標籤寬度以彈簧方式適配內容。帶正負號的變化同時以顏色與正負號指示方向；設定 `IsChangeGlyphVisible` 可加入方向圖示，設定 `Sparkline` 可顯示小型趨勢線。

trans-unit.source: The change chip, such as "+12%"; empty hides the chip. Write the sign: color is not the only cue.
trans-unit.target: 變化標籤，例如 “+12%”；為空時隱藏標籤。請寫明正負號：顏色並非唯一的提示。

trans-unit.source: Direction read from the sign of `Change`.
trans-unit.target: 由 `Change` 的正負號讀取的方向。

trans-unit.source: The comparison line, such as "vs last week".
trans-unit.target: 比較說明列，例如 “較上週”。

trans-unit.source: Fraction digits of the number (default 0).
trans-unit.target: 數字的小數位數（預設 0）。

trans-unit.source: Adds a trending up / down glyph to a signed change chip (default false, like Arc).
trans-unit.target: 在帶正負號的變化標籤上加入上升或下降的趨勢圖示（預設 false，與 Arc 一致）。

trans-unit.source: What is measured.
trans-unit.target: 所衡量的對象。

trans-unit.source: Text before the number, such as "$".
trans-unit.target: 數字前的文字，例如 “$”。

trans-unit.source: Optional values for a small trend line beside the number.
trans-unit.target: 可選的數值，用於在數字旁繪製小型趨勢線。

trans-unit.source: Unit after the number, such as "%" or " ms".
trans-unit.target: 數字後的單位，例如 “%” 或 “ ms”。

trans-unit.source: The number; it rolls from zero on first view, then between values.
trans-unit.target: 數值；首次顯示時從零滾動到該值，之後在不同值之間滾動。

trans-unit.source: Metric explorer: a row of KPI cards (label, big number, change, sparkline) where any card opens into a chart you can inspect. The card's surface grows into the chart's panel: metric tabs with their values, the readout (name, big number, change with rolling digits), the range switch, a legend with the date span, and the chart itself: this period as a line with the period before it dashed beside it. Pointing at the chart, dragging, or using the arrow keys shows the nearest day with a crosshair and a date capsule, and swaps the readout to that day against the same day one period earlier. Switching metric morphs the line point by point; switching range zooms the time window like a camera. Escape clears the inspection, then closes the chart.
trans-unit.target: 指標瀏覽器：一排 KPI 卡片（標籤、大數字、變化、迷你趨勢線），任意一張卡片都可展開為可檢視的圖表。卡片的表面會生長為圖表的面板：帶數值的指標頁籤、讀數（名稱、大數字、帶滾動數字的變化）、範圍切換器、帶日期跨度的圖例，以及圖表本身：本週期為實線，其旁以虛線顯示上一週期。指向圖表、拖曳或使用方向鍵會以十字線和日期膠囊顯示最近的一天，並把讀數換成該天與上一週期同一天的對比。切換指標會讓折線逐點形變；切換範圍會像鏡頭一樣縮放時間視窗。Escape 先清除檢視，再關閉圖表。

trans-unit.source: Said when the metric or the range changes in the open chart: {0} metric, {1} range, {2} value, {3} up / down, {4} change, {5} comparison.
trans-unit.target: 開啟的圖表中指標或範圍變更時播報：{0} 指標，{1} 範圍，{2} 值，{3} 上升 / 下降，{4} 變化，{5} 對比。

trans-unit.source: A compact product analytics overview: a header with a range switch (7D / 30D / 90D) and an Export button, a row of metric tabs (total and change for the range; the selected one drives the chart), an inspectable area chart that can overlay the previous period, and two ranked lists. Totals and list values count to their new numbers when the range changes, the chart cross-fades, the range thumb and the tab underline glide. Long ranges are drawn as weekly points. Fill `Metrics`, `PrimaryItems` and `SecondaryItems` from code or bind the `*Source` properties.
trans-unit.target: 精簡的產品分析總覽：頂部是帶範圍切換（7D / 30D / 90D）和 Export 按鈕的標題，下面是一排指標標籤（顯示該範圍的總數和變化，選取的標籤決定圖表內容），一個可檢視細節的面積圖（可疊加上一週期），以及兩個排名清單。範圍改變時，總數和清單的值會計數到新的數字，圖表交叉淡入淡出，範圍滑塊和標籤底線平滑滑動。較長的範圍按每週一個點繪製。可在程式碼中填入 `Metrics`、`PrimaryItems` 和 `SecondaryItems`，也可以繫結 `*Source` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: A strip of live metrics. In `Scroll` the metrics run past in one line like a stock ticker, with faded edges; pointing at the strip or focusing in it holds the line, and a pause button stops it for good (moving content needs a way to stop it). In `Roll`, or under reduced motion, the metrics sit in even columns. Either way each value rolls digit by digit when it updates, the change since the previous value shows with an arrow in the success or danger color, and the cell flashes that tint once.
trans-unit.target: 一條即時指標帶。在 `Scroll` 模式下，指標像股票行情一樣排成一行捲動經過，兩端漸隱；指標指向或焦點位於其中時這一行會停住，暫停按鈕可以讓它一直停下（移動的內容需要有辦法停止）。在 `Roll` 模式下，或在減少動態效果時，指標排成等寬的欄。無論哪種方式，每個值在更新時都會逐位滾動，與上一個值相比的變化以箭頭和成功色或危險色顯示，儲存格也會以該色調閃爍一次。

trans-unit.source: Shows the pause button while the line scrolls (default true). Hide it only when the app offers its own way to stop the line.
trans-unit.target: 在這一行捲動時顯示暫停按鈕（預設 true）。只有當應用程式提供了自己的停止方式時才隱藏它。

trans-unit.source: Stops the scrolling line where it is; the pause button and the Space key on it toggle it. Values still update.

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of a sparse mixture-of-experts layer. Tokens enter one at a time; a router scores every expert (a small bar each), the token travels to its top-k experts, which light up in a first and second choice color and count it, and their outputs merge into the token's output chip. Experts have a capacity: a full expert skips the token, and a token whose every choice is full passes through unchanged. The header switches between top 1 and top 2 and shows the parameters that run per token; a load balance bar sits under the stage. Pointing at, focusing or pinning a token or an expert freezes the story on it and shows its route or its load. The routing is computed from the tokens' scores (or stable scores derived from their text); the numbers are illustrative.
trans-unit.target: 稀疏混合專家層的動畫講解。Token 逐一進入；路由器為每位專家評分（每位專家一根小柱），token 被送往其前 top-k 位專家，這些專家以第一和第二選擇顏色亮起並計數，它們的輸出匯入 token 的輸出標籤塊。專家有容量：已滿的專家會略過該 token，所有選擇都已滿的 token 則原樣通過。標題可在 top 1 與 top 2 之間切換，並顯示每個 token 運行的參數；負載平衡條位於舞台下方。指向、聚焦或釘選某個 token 或專家會凍結演示並顯示其路由或負載。路由根據 token 的分數計算（或由其文字推導出的穩定分數）；數字僅為示意。

trans-unit.source: The parameters that run for one token at the current top k, in billions.
trans-unit.target: 在目前 top-k 下，每個 token 運行的參數量（單位：十億）。

trans-unit.source: The tokens each expert takes before it is full, or null when nothing is ever dropped.
trans-unit.target: 每位專家在額滿前可接收的 token 數；若從不捨棄任何 token 則為 null。

trans-unit.source: Scales each expert's capacity, ⌈factor × tokens × k / experts⌉ tokens (default 1). A full expert skips further tokens. `PositiveInfinity` never drops a token; zero, negative and NaN values count as 1.
trans-unit.target: 縮放每位專家的容量，即 ⌈factor × tokens × k / experts⌉ 個 token（預設為 1）。已滿的專家會略過後續的 token。`PositiveInfinity` 從不捨棄 token；零、負數與 NaN 均按 1 計算。

trans-unit.source: The token being routed, or −1 while the summary shows.
trans-unit.target: 正在路由的 token 索引；顯示摘要時為 −1。

trans-unit.source: The experts, 2 to 12 (more are cut to the first 12). Leave it empty, or give fewer than two, for the eight default experts. Changing the experts starts the story over.
trans-unit.target: 專家，數量為 2 到 12（超過 12 個的只取前 12 個）。留空，或給出少於兩個，則使用預設的八位專家。更改專家會重新開始演示。

trans-unit.source: The first choice's color (null: chart series 1, which follows the accent).
trans-unit.target: 第一選擇的顏色（null：圖表系列 1，跟隨強調色）。

trans-unit.source: The expert being inspected (hovered, keyboard-focused or pinned), or −1.
trans-unit.target: 正在檢查（懸停、鍵盤聚焦或釘選）的專家；否則為 −1。

trans-unit.source: The token being inspected (hovered, keyboard-focused or pinned), or −1.
trans-unit.target: 正在檢查（懸停、鍵盤聚焦或釘選）的 token；否則為 −1。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or speaks; replace it to translate or reword.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個文字；替換它即可翻譯或改寫。

trans-unit.source: The load balance the card shows, 0 to 1; null before anything is routed.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示的負載平衡，範圍 0 到 1；尚未路由任何內容時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The parameter counts in billions behind the active-parameters readout (default 480 in all, 6 shared, 12 per expert): shared + k × per expert run for each token.
trans-unit.target: 啟用參數讀數背後的參數量，單位為十億（預設總計 480，其中共享 6，每位專家 12）：每個 token 運行的為 共享 + k × 每位專家。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a token leaves the router for its experts, with its route.
trans-unit.target: token 離開路由器前往其專家時引發，附帶其路由。

trans-unit.target: 目前 top-k 與容量下，每個 token 的計畫路由。

trans-unit.source: The second choice's color (null: chart series 2).
trans-unit.target: 第二選擇的顏色（null：圖表系列 2）。

trans-unit.source: The tokens to route, in order. Leave it empty for the default sentence (see `MixtureOfExpertsSamples`). Changing the tokens starts the story over.

trans-unit.source: One expert of a `MixtureOfExperts`: a short name, what it tends to handle and an icon.
trans-unit.target: `MixtureOfExperts` 的一位專家：一個簡短名稱、它通常處理的內容，以及一個圖示。

trans-unit.source: A short sentence on what the expert tends to handle, shown while it is inspected.
trans-unit.target: 一句簡短說明該專家通常處理什麼，在被檢查時顯示。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroked glyph drawn at 14 px (Lucide style); null shows the first letter of the name.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 描邊圖形，以 14 px 繪製（Lucide 風格）；為 null 時顯示名稱的第一個字母。

trans-unit.source: The expert's name, best one short word (the narrow layout shows only the icon and speaks the name).

trans-unit.source: Every word a `MixtureOfExperts` shows or speaks, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; sentences with numbers or names are functions so the word order can change. Footer notes may contain `{token}`, which is replaced by a small chip with the token's text. Numbers of parameters arrive formatted ("30", "2.5").
trans-unit.target: `MixtureOfExperts` 顯示或朗讀的每一個文字，預設為英文。替換整個實例即可翻譯或改寫；包含數字或名稱的句子為函數，以便調整詞序。頁尾註解可以包含 `{token}`，它會被替換為一個顯示該 token 文字的小標籤塊。參數數量已格式化後傳入（如 "30"、"2.5"）。

trans-unit.source: How one token was routed: its normalized gate scores, the experts it chose (best first) with their weights within the choice, the chosen experts that were full and skipped it, and the expert loads once it has been routed. The whole sequence is planned at once, so a route can be read before its token plays.
trans-unit.target: 一個 token 的路由方式：其標準化的閘控分數、所選專家（依最佳排序）及其在該選擇內的權重、被略過的已滿所選專家，以及該 token 路由後各專家的負載。整個序列一次規劃完成，因此可在 token 播放前閱讀其路由。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Routed`: a token leaves the router for its experts.
trans-unit.target: `Routed` 的參數：一個 token 離開路由器前往其專家。

trans-unit.source: One token that a `MixtureOfExperts` routes: its text and, optionally, the router's raw score for every expert. (The name ends in Item because `MixtureOfExpertsToken` is the control's design token.)
trans-unit.target: `MixtureOfExperts` 路由的一個 token：其文字，以及可選的路由器對每位專家的原始分數。（名稱以 Item 結尾，是因為 `MixtureOfExpertsToken` 是該控制項的設計 token。）

trans-unit.source: The router's raw score for each expert, in the order of `Experts` ("24, 6, 3, 58" in XAML). Scores are non-negative and are normalized to sum to 1; missing entries count as 0 and extra ones are ignored. Null derives stable example scores from `Text`.
trans-unit.target: 路由器對 `Experts` 中每位專家的原始分數，依其順序排列（XAML 中寫作 "24, 6, 3, 58"）。分數為非負數，並被標準化為總和為 1；缺失的項目以 0 計，多餘的項目則忽略。為 null 時由 `Text` 推導出穩定的範例分數。

trans-unit.source: The token as the model sees it (spaces are kept, so " the" and "the" are different tokens). It is shown in the input, output and sequence chips and named in the footer.
trans-unit.target: 模型所見的 token（保留空格，因此 " the" 與 "the" 是不同的 token）。它顯示在輸入、輸出和序列標籤塊中，並在頁尾中被點名。

trans-unit.source: A bottom list of actions: an optional `Title` and `Message`, a card of `ActionSheetItem` rows and, set apart under it, a Cancel row. Choosing a row raises `ActionInvoked` (and runs the row's own `Command`) and closes the sheet; so does Cancel. It is a `Sheet`, so it opens with `IsOpen` in `Overlay`, closes on a scrim tap, a pull down or Escape, and moves by the same physics: its position is a motion value written on every drag move, not a ControlTheme transition, and it jumps instead of gliding under reduced motion. Rows shade while pressed.
trans-unit.target: 底部操作清單：可選的 `Title` 和 `Message`，一張由 `ActionSheetItem` 列組成的卡片，以及與它分開的取消列。選擇一列會觸發 `ActionInvoked`（並執行該列自己的 `Command`）並關閉面板，取消也一樣。它是一個 `Sheet`，所以在 `Overlay` 裡用 `IsOpen` 開啟，點遮罩、下拉或按 Esc 即可關閉，並遵循同樣的物理效果：它的位置是拖曳時每次移動都會寫入的運動值，不是 ControlTheme 過渡，減弱動效時直接跳到位置而不滑動。列在按下時變深。

trans-unit.source: The person chose an action; the sheet is closing.
trans-unit.target: 使用者選擇了一個操作；面板正在關閉。

trans-unit.source: The label of the Cancel row: "Cancel". Null or empty hides the row.
trans-unit.target: 取消列的文字：「Cancel」。為 null 或空時隱藏該列。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a title or a message, so the header shows.
trans-unit.target: 是否有標題或說明，從而顯示頭部。

trans-unit.source: A second, smaller line under the title.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的第二行較小文字。

trans-unit.source: Mobile button: a touch-first button with a press state (it scales down and dims while a finger is on it) and no hover state. It is at least 44 by 44 so it is easy to hit. `Variant` picks how prominent it is.
trans-unit.target: 移動端按鈕：觸控優先的按鈕，有按壓狀態（手指按在上面時縮小並變暗），沒有懸停狀態。它至少 44 乘 44，便於點中。`Variant` 決定它的顯著程度。

trans-unit.source: How prominent the button is: filled, tinted or plain text.
trans-unit.target: 移動端按鈕的顯著程度：實心、淺色填充或純文字。

trans-unit.source: Mobile checkbox: a 22px rounded box with a check, and the label (the content) beside it, in a row at least 44 high so the whole row is the touch target. A finger on the box shrinks it on a spring (the row itself does not move); there is no hover state. The check draws itself in when it appears, and with `IsThreeState` it also has an indeterminate state, shown as a dash that morphs into the check and back. With reduced motion the marks appear at once.
trans-unit.target: 移動端核取方塊：22px 的圓角框，帶勾選，標籤（內容）在旁邊，整列至少 44 高，所以整列都是觸控目標。手指按在框上時，框沿彈簧縮小（整列不動）；沒有懸停狀態。勾選出現時自己畫出來；設定 `IsThreeState` 時還有不確定狀態，顯示為短橫，並與勾選互相形變。減少動效時標記立即出現。

trans-unit.source: A centered alert or confirmation dialog: a `Title`, a `Message` and up to three actions (the items, usually mobile `Button`s) over a scrim. Put it in `Overlay` and open it with `IsOpen`. Two actions share a row when each fits its half; three, or narrow widths, stack them at the full width. Pressing an action button closes the dialog (see `CloseOnAction`) after the button's own click handler or command has run. Tapping the scrim and Escape close it only when `IsDismissible` is on. Set Dialog.IsDestructive on an action button for a danger-colored action. Closed, it does not catch touches. Several overlays (a dialog, a sheet, a toast host) share the one `Overlay` slot: put them together in a `Grid`. The dialog's presence is one `MotionValue` (0 gone, 1 shown) that drives the scrim's opacity and the panel's opacity and scale, so a dialog closed while it is still appearing reverses from where it is. It is not a ControlTheme transition because the exit must finish before the dialog stops catching touches.
trans-unit.target: 置中的提示或確認對話框：`Title`、`Message` 和最多三個操作（子項，通常是移動端 `Button`），位於遮罩之上。把它放進 `Overlay`，用 `IsOpen` 開啟。兩個操作在各自放得進半寬時同排顯示；三個操作或寬度較窄時，按全寬縱向堆疊。按下操作按鈕會在按鈕自己的點擊處理或命令執行之後關閉對話框（見 `CloseOnAction`）。僅當 `IsDismissible` 開啟時，點遮罩和按 Esc 才會關閉它。在操作按鈕上設定 Dialog.IsDestructive 可得到危險色的操作。關閉時它不攔截觸控。多個浮層（對話框、底部面板、Toast 宿主）共用同一個 `Overlay` 槽：把它們一起放進一個 `Grid`。對話框的出現程度是一個 `MotionValue`（0 為消失，1 為完全顯示），它同時驅動遮罩的不透明度以及面板的不透明度和縮放，所以在對話框還在出現時關閉它，會從目前狀態反向運動。它不是 ControlTheme 過渡，因為必須等退出結束後，對話框才能停止攔截觸控。

trans-unit.source: Whether pressing an action button closes the dialog: true.
trans-unit.target: 按下操作按鈕是否關閉對話框：true。

trans-unit.source: Attached to an action `Button`: whether it is a destructive action, drawn with the Danger color (filled: a Danger pill, tinted: Danger text on a soft pill, plain: Danger text).
trans-unit.target: 附加到操作 `Button` 上：它是否是破壞性操作，用危險色繪製（實心：危險色膠囊；淡色：淺底上的危險色文字；純文字：危險色文字）。

trans-unit.source: Whether tapping the scrim or pressing Escape closes the dialog: false, so the person has to choose an action.
trans-unit.target: 點遮罩或按 Esc 是否關閉對話框：false，這樣使用者必須選擇一個操作。

trans-unit.source: Whether the dialog is open.
trans-unit.target: 對話框是否開啟。

trans-unit.source: The message under the title.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的訊息。

trans-unit.source: The title, shown in bold above the message.
trans-unit.target: 標題，以粗體顯示在訊息上方。

trans-unit.source: Mobile icon button: a 44 by 44 icon-only button with a press state (it scales down while a finger is on it) and no hover state. `Variant` picks plain, tinted, filled or floating (`Fab`). An icon-only button has no visible text, so always set `AutomationProperties.Name`.
trans-unit.target: 移動端圖示按鈕：44 乘 44 的純圖示按鈕，有按壓狀態（手指按在上面時縮小），沒有懸停狀態。`Variant` 選擇樸素、淺色、實心或懸浮（`Fab`）。純圖示按鈕沒有可見文字，所以一定要設定 `AutomationProperties.Name`。

trans-unit.source: The glyph geometry shown in the button, for example a Lucide icon.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕中顯示的圖示幾何，例如 Lucide 圖示。

trans-unit.source: How prominent the button is: plain, tinted, filled or a floating action button.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕的顯著程度：樸素、淺色、實心或懸浮操作按鈕。

trans-unit.source: A card of `ListItem` rows with an optional `Header` above it and `Footer` under it, the way settings screens group their rows. Put it in a scrolling `Page`. Each data item becomes a `ListItem` row. When the item template's root is itself a `ListItem`, that row is the container (it is not wrapped in a second row), so its `Title`, `Subtitle`, `Command` and so on can be bound in the template. A template that returns plain content is shown inside a row; style that row with a `ListItem` selector in `ListGroup.Styles`.
trans-unit.target: 一張由 `ListItem` 列組成的卡片，上方可有 `Header`，下方可有 `Footer`，就像設定頁替列分組的方式。把它放進可捲動的 `Page`。每個資料項目都會成為一列 `ListItem`。如果項目範本的根本身就是 `ListItem`，這一列就直接作為容器（不會再套一層），因此可以在範本中繫結它的 `Title`、`Subtitle`、`Command` 等屬性。範本傳回一般內容時，內容會顯示在一列之中；請在 `ListGroup.Styles` 中用 `ListItem` 選取器設定這一列的樣式。

trans-unit.source: A note under the card, for example what the settings in it do.
trans-unit.target: 卡片下方的說明，例如其中的設定有什麼作用。

trans-unit.source: A short label above the card.
trans-unit.target: 卡片上方的簡短標籤。

trans-unit.source: One row of a `ListGroup`: an optional `Icon`, the title (the content), an optional `Subtitle`, optional `Trailing` content and an optional chevron. It is a button: give it a `Command` or handle `Click` and a finger on it shades the row. It has no hover state.
trans-unit.target: `ListGroup` 的一列：可有 `Icon`、標題（內容）、`Subtitle`、`Trailing` 內容和箭頭。它是一個按鈕：給它 `Command` 或處理 `Click`，手指按在上面時列會變暗。它沒有懸停狀態。

trans-unit.source: The glyph geometry shown before the title, for example a Lucide icon.
trans-unit.target: 標題前顯示的圖示幾何，例如 Lucide 圖示。

trans-unit.source: Whether a chevron at the end of the row shows that it opens another screen.
trans-unit.target: 列尾是否顯示箭頭，表示它會開啟另一個頁面。

trans-unit.source: A second, smaller line under the title.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方第二行較小的文字。

trans-unit.source: The content at the end of the row: a value, a badge or a control such as a `Switch`.
trans-unit.target: 列尾的內容：值、徽章或 `Switch` 這樣的控制項。

trans-unit.source: The top bar of a `Page`: a `Leading` slot (usually a back button), a centered `Title` and a `Trailing` slot for actions. It is 44 high, and the slots are at least 44 wide.
trans-unit.target: `Page` 的頂部列：起始的 `Leading` 槽（通常是返回按鈕）、置中的 `Title` 和放操作的 `Trailing` 槽。列高 44，槽的寬度至少 44。

trans-unit.source: The command the back button runs.
trans-unit.target: 返回按鈕執行的命令。

trans-unit.source: The back button's label, usually the previous screen's title. Empty shows the chevron alone.
trans-unit.target: 返回按鈕的文字，通常是上一頁的標題。為空時只顯示箭頭。

trans-unit.source: The opacity of the title in the bar: 1 normally, and with a large title it fades in as the large one collapses.
trans-unit.target: 列裡標題的不透明度：平時為 1，有大標題時隨大標題收起而淡入。

trans-unit.source: How far the large title has collapsed into the bar, from 0 (fully shown) to 1 (gone, the bar's own title is shown). Bind it to the page's scroll offset divided by `LargeTitleExtent`. It does nothing without `LargeTitle`.
trans-unit.target: 大標題收進列裡的程度，從 0（完全顯示）到 1（已收起，顯示列自己的標題）。把它綁定到頁面捲動位移除以 `LargeTitleExtent`。沒有 `LargeTitle` 時不起作用。

trans-unit.source: Whether the title also shows as a large heading under the bar, like a root screen in iOS.
trans-unit.target: 標題是否同時在列下方顯示為大標題，類似 iOS 的根頁面。

trans-unit.source: The current height of the large title row, between 0 and `LargeTitleExtent`.
trans-unit.target: 大標題列目前的高度，在 0 到 `LargeTitleExtent` 之間。

trans-unit.source: The content at the start of the bar, usually a back button.
trans-unit.target: 列起始處的內容，通常是返回按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Whether the bar shows a back button (a chevron and `BackText`) before `Leading`.
trans-unit.target: 列是否在 `Leading` 之前顯示返回按鈕（箭頭加 `BackText`）。

trans-unit.source: The bar's title.
trans-unit.target: 列的標題。

trans-unit.source: The content at the end of the bar, usually action buttons.
trans-unit.target: 列末端的內容，通常是操作按鈕。

trans-unit.source: A stack of pages, one on top. `Push` slides a page in from the right over the one below, which shifts left and dims; `Pop` and the back swipe from the left edge slide it away again. The swipe follows the finger, and on release the finger's speed decides whether the page leaves or springs back. Pages are usually `Page`s; only the top one is in the visual tree while the stack is at rest, and a page that is not on top keeps its state. Bind a `Navbar`'s `BackCommand` to `BackCommand`. The slide is a `MotionValue`, not a ControlTheme transition: the swipe writes it on every move and a release hands the finger's velocity to the spring. Under reduced motion pages change at once.
trans-unit.target: 頁面堆疊，頂部一個頁面。`Push` 讓頁面從右側滑入，蓋住下面的頁面，下面的頁面向左移動並變暗；`Pop` 和從左邊緣的返回滑動把它滑走。滑動跟隨手指，放開時由手指的速度決定頁面離開還是彈回。頁面通常是 `Page`；堆疊靜止時只有頂部的頁面在視覺樹裡，不在頂部的頁面保持狀態。把 `Navbar` 的 `BackCommand` 繫結到 `BackCommand`。滑動是 `MotionValue`，不是 ControlTheme 過渡：滑動時每次移動都會寫入它，放開時手指的速度交給彈簧。減弱動效時，頁面直接切換。

trans-unit.source: Whether there is a page to go back to.
trans-unit.target: 是否有可以返回的頁面。

trans-unit.source: Whether a swipe from the left edge pops the top page: true.
trans-unit.target: 從左邊緣滑動是否會彈出頂部頁面：true。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a page is pushed or popped, as soon as the stack changes (the slide may still be running).
trans-unit.target: 推入或彈出頁面時觸發，堆疊一變化就觸發（此時滑動可能還在進行）。

trans-unit.source: The first page of the stack. Setting it resets the stack to that one page.
trans-unit.target: 堆疊的第一個頁面。設定它會把堆疊重設為只有這一頁。

trans-unit.source: A mobile page: an optional `Header` (usually a `Navbar`), the content, and an optional `Footer` (usually a `Tabbar`), laid out inside the device's safe area. The safe area is the space the notch, rounded corners and gesture bar take; on desktop and in tests it is zero unless set by hand.
trans-unit.target: 移動端頁面：可選的 `Header`（通常是 `Navbar`）、內容，以及可選的 `Footer`（通常是 `Tabbar`），排佈在裝置的安全區之內。安全區是瀏海、圓角和手勢列佔用的空間；在桌面和測試中，除非手動設定，否則為零。

trans-unit.source: Whether the page lays out above the soft keyboard: the content shrinks by the keyboard's height, so the focused input stays visible, and the footer (a `Tabbar`) goes behind the keyboard the way iOS does. Off, the keyboard covers the page and only `KeyboardInset` reports it.
trans-unit.target: 頁面是否排布在軟體鍵盤之上：內容依鍵盤高度縮小，使取得焦點的輸入框保持可見，頁尾（`Tabbar`）像 iOS 那樣退到鍵盤後面。關閉時，鍵盤會遮住頁面，只有 `KeyboardInset` 會回報它。

trans-unit.source: The slot below the content, usually a `Tabbar`.
trans-unit.target: 內容下方的槽，通常是 `Tabbar`。

trans-unit.source: The slot above the content, usually a `Navbar`.
trans-unit.target: 內容上方的槽，通常是 `Navbar`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the content scrolls vertically inside the page. Off, the content gets the page's height as it is. On, a `Navbar` in `Header` that has a large title collapses it as the content scrolls.
trans-unit.target: 內容是否在頁面內縱向捲動。關閉時，內容直接得到頁面的高度。開啟時，`Header` 裡帶大標題的 `Navbar` 會隨內容捲動而摺疊。

trans-unit.source: The height the soft keyboard covers at the bottom edge, read from the page or from any control inside it with `GetKeyboardInset` (it is inherited), so an overlay such as a `Sheet` can lift itself. It is the target height, not the animated one: it is 0 when the keyboard is hidden.
trans-unit.target: 軟體鍵盤在底邊遮住的高度，可從頁面或頁面內任意控制項用 `GetKeyboardInset` 讀取（它會被繼承），讓 `Sheet` 這樣的浮層能自己抬起。它是目標高度，而不是動畫中的高度：鍵盤隱藏時為 0。

trans-unit.source: Where the pages below a control get the keyboard's height when the platform has no input pane: set it on a host (inherited). Null uses `TopLevel.InputPane`.
trans-unit.target: 平台沒有輸入面板時，控制項之下的頁面從哪裡取得鍵盤高度：設定在宿主上（會被繼承）。為 null 時使用 `TopLevel.InputPane`。

trans-unit.source: The slot over the whole page, header and footer included, for a `Sheet`.
trans-unit.target: 整頁之上的槽，包括頁首和頁尾，用來放 `Sheet`。

trans-unit.source: The insets the page keeps free on each edge. With `UsePlatformSafeArea` the platform sets it (zero where there is no insets manager); otherwise set it yourself.
trans-unit.target: 頁面在每條邊上保留的空白。啟用 `UsePlatformSafeArea` 時由平台設定（沒有 insets 管理員時為零）；否則請自行設定。

trans-unit.source: Whether `SafeArea` follows the platform's safe area padding.
trans-unit.target: `SafeArea` 是否跟隨平台的安全區邊距。

trans-unit.source: Pull to refresh: wraps scrollable content. Pulling down while the content is at its top drags the content along with rubber-band resistance and shows an arrow that turns over as the pull nears `PullThreshold`. Releasing past it raises `RefreshRequested` and runs `Command`; the content rests below the indicator, which spins, until `IsRefreshing` is false again (set it, or take a deferral from the event data). Releasing early springs the content back. A pull that starts while the inner scroll viewer is scrolled, or that goes sideways or up, is left to the content. The content's position is a `MotionValue`, not a ControlTheme transition: a pull writes it on every move, and a release hands the finger's velocity to the spring, which a new pull can catch mid-flight. Under reduced motion the content does not stretch with the finger; the refresh still runs and the content jumps.
trans-unit.target: 下拉重新整理：包住可捲動的內容。內容在頂部時向下拉，內容會帶著橡皮筋阻尼跟手，並顯示一個箭頭，下拉接近 `PullThreshold` 時箭頭翻轉。越過閾值放開會觸發 `RefreshRequested` 並執行 `Command`；內容停在指示器下方，指示器轉動，直到 `IsRefreshing` 再次為 false（可以自己設定，也可以從事件資料裡取一個延遲）。提前放開，內容彈回。手勢開始時內部的捲動檢視已經捲動過，或手勢向側面或向上，就交給內容處理。內容的位置是 `MotionValue`，不是 ControlTheme 過渡：下拉時每次移動都會寫入它，放開時手指的速度交給彈簧，新的下拉可以在途中接住它。減弱動態效果時，內容不隨手指拉伸；重新整理照常進行，內容直接跳轉。

trans-unit.source: The command a refresh runs, with `CommandParameter`.
trans-unit.target: 重新整理時執行的命令，參數為 `CommandParameter`。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 傳給 `Command` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Whether a refresh is in progress. Two-way: a release past the threshold sets it, and setting it false ends the refresh.
trans-unit.target: 重新整理是否正在進行。雙向：越過閾值放開會把它設為 true，把它設為 false 則結束重新整理。

trans-unit.source: How far the content has to be pulled down, in px, for a release to start a refresh: 64.
trans-unit.target: 內容要被下拉多遠（單位 px），放開才會開始重新整理：64。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a release past the threshold starts a refresh. Take a deferral if the work is asynchronous.
trans-unit.target: 越過閾值放開而開始重新整理時觸發。如果工作是非同步的，就取一個延遲（deferral）。

trans-unit.source: Mobile radio: a 22px circle with an accent dot that springs in when the item is chosen, and the label (the content) beside it, in a row at least 44 high so the whole row is the touch target. Items that share a `GroupName` are mutually exclusive: choosing one clears the others. The arrow keys move the choice to the previous or next enabled item of the same group among the siblings. A finger on it dims it; there is no hover state.
trans-unit.target: 移動端單選：22px 的圓，選取時強調色圓點以彈簧彈入，標籤（內容）在旁邊，整列至少 44 高，所以整列都是觸控目標。`GroupName` 相同的項互斥：選取一項會清除其他項。方向鍵把選擇移到同組、同層的上一個或下一個可用項。手指按在上面時會變暗；沒有懸停狀態。

trans-unit.source: Mobile search bar: a `TextField` with a search glyph before the text and a pill shape. Enter raises `Submitted`, and the soft keyboard offers a Search key.
trans-unit.target: 移動端搜尋列：文字前帶搜尋圖示、膠囊形狀的 `TextField`。按 Enter 會觸發 `Submitted`，軟鍵盤提供搜尋鍵。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Enter or the keyboard's Search key.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按 Enter 或鍵盤的搜尋鍵時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Mobile segmented control: a short row of `SegmentedItem`s that share the width, one selected, for switching between a few views of the same content. It derives from Avalonia's `ListBox`, so `SelectedIndex`, `SelectionChanged` and binding work as they do there. It has no hover state. The selected block slides between segments on a spring (and jumps with reduced motion) while the label colors cross-fade.
trans-unit.target: 移動端分段控制項：一排共享寬度的 `SegmentedItem`，選中其中一個，用於在同一內容的幾個檢視之間切換。它衍生自 Avalonia 的 `ListBox`，所以 `SelectedIndex`、`SelectionChanged` 和繫結都和那裡一樣。沒有懸停狀態。選中的區塊沿彈簧在各段之間滑動（減少動效時直接跳轉），文字顏色交叉淡化。

trans-unit.source: One segment of a `Segmented`: its label is the content. The selected one is raised on a Surface fill.
trans-unit.target: `Segmented` 的一個分段：標籤就是內容。選中的一個浮在 Surface 填充上。

trans-unit.source: A bottom sheet: a panel that rises over a `Page` with a scrim behind it. The person closes it by tapping the scrim, pulling the handle down or flicking it, or with Escape. Put it in `Overlay` and open it with `IsOpen`; it sizes to its content, up to `MaxHeightFraction` of the page, and the content scrolls beyond that. Closed, it does not catch touches. With `Detents` the sheet rests at several heights instead (a peek and a full view): a pull follows the finger, stretches like a rubber band past the tallest detent, and on release looks 0.2 s ahead to pick the nearest detent or close; a flick always moves at least one detent. The content scrolls only at the tallest detent, and a pull down from its top moves the sheet. The scrim follows the position. The panel's position is a `MotionValue`, not a ControlTheme transition: a drag writes it on every move, a release hands the finger's velocity to the spring, and the scrim is computed from the position each frame. Under reduced motion the panel jumps instead of gliding.
trans-unit.target: 底部面板：從 `Page` 上方升起、背後帶遮罩的面板。點遮罩、下拉把手、快速下滑或按 Esc 都能關閉它。把它放進 `Overlay`，用 `IsOpen` 開啟；它的高度隨內容而定，最高到頁面的 `MaxHeightFraction`，超出後內容捲動。關閉時它不攔截觸控。設定 `Detents` 後，面板改為停在多個高度（先露出一部分，再展開）：拖曳時一比一跟隨手指，越過最高的停靠高度後像橡皮筋一樣有阻力，放開時向前看 0.2 秒，停在最近的停靠高度或關閉；快速滑動至少會移動一個停靠高度。內容只在最高的停靠高度捲動，從內容頂部下拉會移動面板。遮罩跟隨位置。面板的位置是 `MotionValue`，不是 ControlTheme 過渡：拖曳時每次移動都會寫入它，放開時手指的速度交給彈簧，遮罩由每幀的位置計算。減弱動效時，面板直接跳到位置而不滑動。

trans-unit.source: The sheet came to rest on another detent.
trans-unit.target: 面板停到了另一個停靠高度。

trans-unit.source: The detent the sheet rests on (index into the sorted detents).
trans-unit.target: 面板所停的停靠高度（已排序停靠高度中的索引）。

trans-unit.source: The resting heights as fractions of the sheet's height, for example "0.4, 0.9". Null or empty: the panel sizes to its content. One value is a fixed height.
trans-unit.target: 停靠高度，按面板所在區域高度的比例計，例如「0.4, 0.9」。為 null 或空時，面板高度隨內容而定。只有一個值時是固定高度。

trans-unit.source: Index into the sorted detents the sheet opens at (default 0, the lowest).
trans-unit.target: 面板開啟時所在的停靠高度，是已排序停靠高度中的索引（預設 0，最低的一個）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the person can close the sheet by tapping the scrim, pulling the panel down or pressing Escape.
trans-unit.target: 使用者能否透過點遮罩、下拉面板或按 Esc 關閉面板。

trans-unit.source: Whether the sheet is open.
trans-unit.target: 面板是否開啟。

trans-unit.source: The tallest the panel gets, as a fraction of the sheet's height: 0.9.
trans-unit.target: 面板最高的高度，按面板所在區域高度的比例計：0.9。

trans-unit.source: The height of the bottom safe area (the home indicator) in px, kept free under the content. The sheet does not read the platform: bind it to the page, for example `SafeAreaBottom="{Binding SafeArea.Bottom, ElementName=Page}"`.
trans-unit.target: 底部安全區（Home 指示條）的高度，單位 px，保留在內容下方。面板不會讀取平台資訊：請把它繫結到頁面，例如 `SafeAreaBottom="{Binding SafeArea.Bottom, ElementName=Page}"`。

trans-unit.source: The title shown in the handle area, under the grabber.
trans-unit.target: 把手區域裡、拖曳條下方顯示的標題。

trans-unit.source: Mobile switch: a 51 by 31 toggle for settings that take effect immediately. The thumb glides on a spring, the hit area is at least 44 by 44, and there is no hover state. The track fills with the on color when checked.
trans-unit.target: 移動端開關：51 乘 31 的切換控制項，用於立即生效的設定。滑塊沿彈簧滑動，點按區域至少 44 乘 44，沒有懸停狀態。選取時滑軌填滿為開啟色。

trans-unit.source: The bottom tab bar of a `Page`. Put `TabbarItem`s in it; the selected one is highlighted and the items share the width equally. One accent pill glides behind the icon of the selected item on a spring, and jumps with reduced motion.
trans-unit.target: `Page` 的底部標籤列。把 `TabbarItem` 放進去；選中的一項醒目顯示，各項平分寬度。一個強調色膠囊沿彈簧在選中項的圖示後面滑動，減少動效時直接跳轉。

trans-unit.source: One tab of a `Tabbar`: an `Icon` above its label (the content). It is at least 44 high and has no hover state.
trans-unit.target: `Tabbar` 的一個標籤：標籤文字（內容）上方有一個 `Icon`。它至少 44 高，沒有懸停狀態。

trans-unit.source: The glyph geometry shown above the label, for example a Lucide icon.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在標籤文字上方的圖示幾何，例如 Lucide 圖示。

trans-unit.source: Mobile text field: a 44px filled field with an optional `Icon` before the text and a clear button that shows while the field has focus and text. The border takes the accent color while focused; there is no hover state. It derives from Avalonia's `TextBox`, so text, selection and binding work as they do there. Show a placeholder with `PlaceholderText`.
trans-unit.target: 移動端文字方塊：44px 高的填充文字方塊，文字前可有 `Icon`，有焦點且有文字時顯示清除按鈕。取得焦點時邊框變為強調色；沒有懸停狀態。它衍生自 Avalonia 的 `TextBox`，所以文字、選取和繫結都和那裡一樣。用 `PlaceholderText` 顯示預留位置提示。

trans-unit.source: The glyph geometry shown before the text, for example a Lucide icon.
trans-unit.target: 文字前顯示的圖示幾何，例如 Lucide 圖示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the clear button is showing now.
trans-unit.target: 清除按鈕此刻是否顯示。

trans-unit.source: Whether a clear button shows while the field has focus and text: true.
trans-unit.target: 文字方塊有焦點且有文字時是否顯示清除按鈕：true。

trans-unit.source: Transient messages near the bottom of the page. Put one `Toast` in `Overlay` and call `Show`: the message slides up and fades in above the page's footer and bottom safe area, stays for `DefaultDuration` and leaves by itself. A finger on a toast holds its countdown; a swipe to either side sends it away. `ToastPolicy` chooses between a short stack and one at a time. The host does not catch touches except on the toasts themselves, so the page under it stays usable. Several overlays (a toast, a dialog, a sheet) share the one `Overlay` slot: put them together in a `Grid` with the toast last, so it shows above the others. Each toast's presence and swipe offset are `MotionValue`s rather than ControlTheme transitions: a swipe writes the offset on every move and a release hands the finger's velocity to the spring. The countdown is a `MotionTimeline`, so it can be paused and still ends on time. Under reduced motion a toast only fades, and with motion off it appears and disappears at once.
trans-unit.target: 頁面底部附近的短暫訊息。在 `Overlay` 裡放一個 `Toast` 並呼叫 `Show`：訊息在頁面頁尾和底部安全區之上滑入並淡入，停留 `DefaultDuration` 後自行離開。手指按住 Toast 會暫停它的倒數計時；向任一側滑動會把它送走。`ToastPolicy` 在簡短的堆疊和一次一則之間選擇。宿主除了 Toast 本身之外不攔截觸控，所以它下面的頁面仍可使用。多個浮層（Toast、對話框、底部面板）共用同一個 `Overlay` 槽：把它們一起放進一個 `Grid`，Toast 放在最後，這樣它顯示在其他浮層之上。每個 Toast 的出現程度和滑動位移是 `MotionValue`，而不是 ControlTheme 過渡：滑動時每次移動都會寫入位移，放手時手指的速度交給彈簧。倒數計時是 `MotionTimeline`，所以可以暫停，並且仍然準時結束。減弱動效時 Toast 只淡入淡出，關閉動效時它立即出現和消失。

trans-unit.source: Space between the toasts and whatever is below them: the page's footer and bottom safe area plus this value: 16.
trans-unit.target: Toast 與其下方內容之間的間距：頁面頁尾和底部安全區再加上這個值：16。

trans-unit.source: How long a toast stays when `Show` is not given a duration: 3 seconds. `Zero` keeps it until dismissed.
trans-unit.target: `Show` 沒有指定時長時，Toast 停留多久：3 秒。`Zero` 表示一直保留到被關閉。

trans-unit.source: The most toasts shown at once under `Stack`: 3.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Stack` 策略下同時顯示的 Toast 最多幾則：3。

trans-unit.source: How toasts that are showing are treated when a new one arrives: `Stack`.
trans-unit.target: 新 Toast 到來時，如何處理正在顯示的 Toast：`Stack`。

trans-unit.source: The bottom action bar of a `Page`: 44 high with a hairline above it. Put plain `Button`s in it as items and they share the width equally, or fill the `Leading`, `Center` and `Trailing` slots. It is meant for `Footer`, alone or in a stack above a `Tabbar`. `IsOpen` shows and hides the bar: it slides down and fades out (faster than it came), and slides up and fades in. The position is a `MotionValue`, not a ControlTheme transition, because a toggle that flips mid-flight must continue from where the bar is rather than restart. Under reduced motion the bar jumps. A closed bar keeps its place in the layout, so the content does not jump; set IsVisible to false to remove it.
trans-unit.target: 底部操作列：屬於 `Page`，高 44，上方有一條髮絲線。把樸素的 `Button` 作為項目放進去，它們等分寬度；也可以填充 `Leading`、`Center` 和 `Trailing` 槽。它用於 `Footer`，可以單獨使用，也可以疊在 `Tabbar` 上方。`IsOpen` 顯示和隱藏這個列：隱藏時向下滑出並淡出（比出現時更快），顯示時向上滑入並淡入。位置是 `MotionValue`，不是 ControlTheme 過渡，因為在途中被再次切換時，必須從列目前的位置繼續，而不是重新開始。減弱動態效果時，列直接跳轉。關閉的列仍佔著版面中的位置，內容不會跳動；要移除它，把 IsVisible 設為 false。

trans-unit.source: The content in the middle of the bar, next to the items.
trans-unit.target: 列中間的內容，和項目放在一起。

trans-unit.source: Whether the bar is shown. False slides it away and stops it catching touches.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示這個列。為 false 時把它滑走，並且不再攔截觸控。

trans-unit.source: The content at the start of the bar, usually one action.
trans-unit.target: 列起始處的內容，通常是一個操作。

trans-unit.source: The content at the end of the bar, usually one action.
trans-unit.target: 列末端的內容，通常是一個操作。

trans-unit.source: Footer content, usually buttons; give them `arc:Dialog.Result` to close with a result.
trans-unit.target: 頁尾內容，通常是按鈕；為按鈕設定 `arc:Dialog.Result` 即可以某個結果關閉。

trans-unit.source: Backdrop blur radius in px (the theme sets Arc's value; off under ReduceTransparency).
trans-unit.target: 背景模糊半徑，單位 px（佈景主題設定 Arc 的值；在 ReduceTransparency 下關閉）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the close button.
trans-unit.target: 關閉按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Escape closes (default true; cancellable through `Closing`).
trans-unit.target: 按 Escape 關閉（預設 true；可透過 `Closing` 取消）。

trans-unit.source: A press on the scrim closes (default true; cancellable through `Closing`).
trans-unit.target: 在遮罩層上按下時關閉（預設 true；可透過 `Closing` 取消）。

trans-unit.source: The result of the last close (from `arc:Dialog.Result` buttons, `Close` or `CloseCommand`).
trans-unit.target: 上一次關閉的結果（來自 `arc:Dialog.Result` 按鈕、`Close` 或 `CloseCommand`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the overlay closes (the exit may still be playing).
trans-unit.target: 浮層關閉時引發（退場動畫可能仍在播放）。

trans-unit.source: Raised before a close requested by the user or by `Close`; cancel to keep it open.
trans-unit.target: 使用者要求或由 `Close` 觸發關閉之前引發；取消即可保持開啟。

trans-unit.source: Secondary line under the title (also the panel's accessible help text).
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的次要文字（同時也是面板的無障礙說明文字）。

trans-unit.source: Modal (default): scrim, backdrop blur and a focus trap. When false the page stays interactive and focus is free (Radix `modal={false}`).
trans-unit.target: 模態（預設）：遮罩、背景模糊與焦點陷阱。為 false 時頁面保持可互動，焦點可自由移動（Radix `modal={false}`）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while true; set false (or call `Close`) to play the exit. Two-way by default.
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時顯示；設為 false（或呼叫 `Close`）以播放退場動畫。預設為雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the overlay opens.

trans-unit.source: Scrim brush (the theme sets the component's own scrim color).
trans-unit.target: 遮罩畫刷（佈景主題設定該元件自身的遮罩顏色）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the close button on the dialog (default true).
trans-unit.target: 在對話方塊上顯示關閉按鈕（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Heading. Changing it while open crossfades (the new copy rises in with a soft blur).
trans-unit.target: 標題。開啟時變更它會交叉淡化（新文字帶著輕微模糊升起）。

trans-unit.source: A blind test of two models: one prompt goes to two anonymous models, both answers stream in at the same pace, and only after the person votes are the models revealed. Each answer shows how fast it started, how fast it came and what it cost, and a small standings list ranks the models by win rate.
trans-unit.target: 模型競技場是一項盲測：一條提示傳送給兩個匿名模型，兩個回答以相同的速度串流呈現，只有在使用者投票後才會揭示模型身分。每個回答都會顯示開始速度、生成速度和成本，並附有一個小型戰績榜，依勝率對模型排名。

trans-unit.source: Whether the first round starts by itself when the arena is shown.
trans-unit.target: 競技場顯示時，第一輪是否自動開始。

trans-unit.source: Whether a vote was cast that the person has not yet seen in the standings (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 是否有使用者尚未在戰績榜中看到的投票（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the models are hidden until the vote (two-way). Turning it off shows them at once and turning it on hides them again.
trans-unit.target: 模型是否在投票前隱藏（雙向繫結）。關閉時立即顯示模型，開啟時再次隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Whether the standings popover is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 戰績榜彈出層是否開啟（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 區塊顯示或播報的每一段文字。

trans-unit.source: The last vote of this round, or null (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 本輪的最後一次投票，若無則為 null（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the standings are reset.
trans-unit.target: 戰績榜重設時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The most rows the standings show.
trans-unit.target: 戰績榜最多顯示的列數。

trans-unit.source: How the two answers are paced when shown.
trans-unit.target: 兩個回答顯示時的節奏控制方式。

trans-unit.source: Chooses the pair of each round; null picks two random models and avoids repeating the last pair.

trans-unit.source: A model details card for a model picker, docs or a marketplace that keeps one size in every state (Arc Model card, design reference). The header shows the model's mark, name and provider with a Compare switch. The details view has a two line summary, all seven modality chips (unsupported ones dashed and muted), the context window with a gauge that reads as pages, max output and knowledge cutoff, input, output and cached prices per million tokens, a monthly volume slider that rolls the estimated cost live, and benchmark bars against two rivals where hovering or focusing a row shows the exact score, its rank and the gap to the leader. The footer shows the API model id with Copy model id. Compare crossfades to a side by side table against any rival, with a check and the margin on the better value and a tally of who leads. Details, compare, loading and error are stacked in one grid cell, so switching models, views or benchmarks never moves the card: every price, limit and score rolls in place in tabular digits and every text value crossfades. Without a `Model` the card keeps its frame, says no model is selected and reads every value as not listed.

trans-unit.source: Chooses a model and its reasoning effort from one compact pill. The pill shows the current choice; its menu lists a few featured models with a one-line note each, an effort setting, and every other model grouped by provider. Under the pill a summary shows what the model can hold and costs, and confirms each change for a moment. A composition of `ModelPill`, `ModelMenu` and `ModelSummary`: the catalog, the selection and the effort are properties, so bind them or read them back from the events. The pill opens on a pointer press or on Enter, Space and ArrowDown; the menu has a featured list, an Effort row and a More models row that open submenus (or pages in a narrow window); choosing closes the menu and returns focus to the pill; the effort moves to the nearest level a new model offers. Set `IsSummaryVisible` to false for the pill alone (a toolbar, a header). Screen readers hear a polite announcement after each change ("Now using Aurora Prime 3, medium effort"); the visible confirmation under the summary stays for `NoticeDuration`.
trans-unit.target: 從一個緊湊的膠囊中選擇模型及其推理強度。膠囊顯示目前的選擇；其選單列出數個精選模型（各附一行說明）、一項推理強度設定，以及依提供者分組的所有其他模型。膠囊下方的概覽顯示該模型能容納的內容與費用，並在每次變更後短暫給出確認。它由 `ModelPill`、`ModelMenu` 和 `ModelSummary` 組合而成：目錄、選取與推理強度皆為屬性，因此可以繫結，或從事件中讀回。膠囊在指標按下，或按 Enter、Space 與 ArrowDown 時開啟選單；選單包含精選清單、Effort 列和 More models 列，它們會開啟子選單（視窗較窄時改為頁面）；選擇後選單關閉，焦點回到膠囊；推理強度會移到新模型所提供的最接近的一檔。把 `IsSummaryVisible` 設為 false，就只剩膠囊（用於工具列或頁首）。每次變更後，螢幕閱讀器會聽到一則禮貌式朗讀（"Now using Aurora Prime 3, medium effort"）；概覽下方的確認提示會保留 `NoticeDuration` 的時間。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of a model's training loop. Each step draws a batch from the data, runs it forward through a small network (a wave of activations, left to right), compares the prediction with the right answer to get the loss (bars show the probability the model gave each class, and the loss is −ln of the right one), runs the loss backward (a wave of gradients, right to left) and nudges every weight (the connections change thickness and color). The loss lands on a curve that falls step by step. The first step stops at every phase with a caption; later steps repeat the loop faster. Play, pause, step, restart and a 0.5× / 1× / 2× speed control drive it; under reduced motion it opens on its end and steps apply in place. The network and the numbers are illustrative.
trans-unit.target: 模型訓練迴圈的動畫講解。每一步從資料中取出一個批次，讓它前向通過一個小型網路（一波激活值，從左到右），把預測與正確答案比較得到損失（長條顯示模型給每個類別的機率，損失是正確類別機率的 −ln），再把損失反向傳播（一波梯度，從右到左），並微調每個權重（連線的粗細和顏色隨之變化）。損失落在一條逐步下降的曲線上。第一步會在每個階段停下並顯示說明；之後的步驟更快地重複這個迴圈。播放、暫停、單步、重新開始以及 0.5× / 1× / 2× 速度控制項驅動演示；在減少動態效果下直接開啟結束狀態，單步就地生效。網路和數字僅供示意。

trans-unit.source: The examples per batch, named in the batch caption (default 32).
trans-unit.target: 每個批次的樣本數，顯示在批次說明中（預設 32）。

trans-unit.source: The last loss measured; NaN before the first.
trans-unit.target: 最近一次測得的損失；第一次之前為 NaN。

trans-unit.source: The current step, from 1; 0 before the first.
trans-unit.target: 目前的步驟，從 1 開始；第一步之前為 0。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a step finishes its update, with the step and its loss.
trans-unit.target: 某一步完成更新時觸發，附帶該步驟及其損失。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個文字。

trans-unit.source: The learning rate, named in the readout and the update caption; a larger rate moves the weights further each step (default 0.05).
trans-unit.target: 學習率，顯示在讀數和更新說明中；學習率越大，每一步權重移動得越遠（預設 0.05）。

trans-unit.source: The loss of each step, in order; null (the default) uses a sample curve that falls from 2.30 and levels off. Extra values are ignored, missing ones continue the sample curve. Values are clamped to 0.01 – 5.
trans-unit.target: 每一步的損失，按順序排列；null（預設）使用一條從 2.30 開始下降並趨於平穩的範例曲線。多餘的值會被忽略，缺少的部分沿範例曲線繼續。值會被限制在 0.01 – 5 之間。

trans-unit.source: The phase of the current step.
trans-unit.target: 目前步驟所處的階段。

trans-unit.source: Arc money input: a currency amount field. Digits group as they are typed without moving the caret, the missing cents wait as faint ghosts so the amount never changes width when it settles, long amounts scale down to fit instead of scrolling, and quick add chips and arrow keys roll the digits. A currency menu switches the currency and keeps the major amount. `Value` is the amount in major units (12.5 for $12.50); `MinorUnits` gives the integer minor units Arc reports.
trans-unit.target: Arc 金額輸入框：貨幣金額欄位。數字在輸入時即分組且插入點不移動，未輸入的分值以淡色虛影等待，因此金額穩定後寬度不會改變；過長的金額會縮小以適應而非捲動；快速加入標籤與方向鍵會滾動數字。貨幣選單可切換貨幣並保留主單位金額。`Value` 以主單位表示金額（$12.50 為 12.5）；`MinorUnits` 提供 Arc 回報的整數最小單位。

trans-unit.target: 格式化文化（Arc `locale`）：預設為 en-US，絕不使用目前的系統文化。

trans-unit.source: One piece of a `SkeletonMorph` layout (Arc Skeleton morph, design reference). While its region loads it is a skeleton of the given size and its content is not shown; when the region resolves, the content mounts in place, the skeleton stretches from its own box to the content's measured box on a critically damped spring while it fades, and the content sharpens in out of a 4 px blur. Give text skeletons the text's line height and line count (`Lines`, `LineHeight`) and set `SkeletonWidth` near the typical text width. A block outside a `SkeletonMorph` simply shows its content.
trans-unit.target: `SkeletonMorph` 版面中的一個部分（Arc Skeleton morph，設計參考）。所在區域載入時它是指定尺寸的骨架，不顯示內容；區域解析時內容就地掛載，骨架在淡出的同時沿臨界阻尼彈簧從自身的方框伸展到內容量得的方框，內容則從 4 px 模糊中變清晰。為文字骨架提供文字的行高與行數（`Lines`、`LineHeight`），並把 `SkeletonWidth` 設為接近文字的典型寬度。不在 `SkeletonMorph` 中的區塊直接顯示其內容。

trans-unit.source: Makes the skeleton round (an avatar placeholder): its radius is half the short side.
trans-unit.target: 讓骨架變為圓形（頭像佔位）：圓角為短邊的一半。

trans-unit.source: True once the content is shown (mounted); false while the block is a skeleton or waiting for its turn.
trans-unit.target: 內容顯示（已掛載）後為 true；區塊是骨架或在等待輪到它時為 false。

trans-unit.source: Corner radius of a shape skeleton in pixels (6 by default; clamped to half the short side).

trans-unit.source: A tiny loader drawn from four strokes that morph between dots, bars, a ring and a square while loading, then fold into a check (success) or a cross (error) with a small pop (Arc morph loader, design reference). Drive it with `Status` from your request state and return it to Loading for the next request: the strokes gather back into the `Variant`. It inherits its color from `Foreground` like text, takes the success or danger tone for a result (`Tone`), never changes its footprint, and is announced as a polite status unless `IsDecorative` is set.
trans-unit.target: 一個由四筆繪成的小型載入指示器：載入中在點、條、環與方塊之間變形，結束時折成勾號（成功）或叉號（失敗）並輕輕彈一下（Arc morph loader，設計參考）。用請求狀態驅動 `Status`，下一次請求時把它設回 Loading：筆畫會收攏回 `Variant`。它像文字一樣從 `Foreground` 繼承顏色，出現結果時採用成功或危險色調（`Tone`），從不改變佔位尺寸，除非設定了 `IsDecorative`，否則會以禮貌的狀態播報。

trans-unit.source: The color of the strokes while loading (inherited like text color).
trans-unit.target: 載入中筆畫的顏色（像文字顏色一樣繼承）。

trans-unit.source: Arc morph select: a select whose trigger is the list. Opening grows the trigger itself into the options surface (width, height and corners spring together, P9), a single highlight glides between options (P7), and the chosen label lifts out of the list and settles into the trigger (P8) while the trigger springs to its new width (P5). Supports groups (`Group`), icons and trailing meta, type-ahead, search for long lists and the full listbox keyboard model. Use it for property pickers and form fields with up to a few hundred options. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open on the selected option (Home / End open on the first or last); arrows, PageUp / PageDown (8 at a time) and Home / End move; Enter or Space picks; Alt+Up picks and closes; typing jumps (or searches when search is on); Escape closes and returns focus; Tab closes without picking.
trans-unit.target: Arc 變形選擇框：觸發器本身即是清單。開啟時，觸發器會直接變形為選項面板（寬度、高度與圓角一同以彈簧變化，P9），單一反白在選項之間滑動（P7），所選標籤從清單中浮起並落入觸發器（P8），同時觸發器以彈簧變為新寬度（P5）。支援群組（`Group`）、圖示與尾隨中繼資料、輸入搜尋、長清單搜尋以及完整的清單方塊鍵盤操作模型。適用於屬性選擇器以及最多數百個選項的表單欄位。鍵盤：Enter、空白鍵與方向鍵會在所選選項上開啟（Home / End 在第一個或最後一個選項上開啟）；方向鍵、PageUp / PageDown（每次 8 項）與 Home / End 用於移動；Enter 或空白鍵用於選取；Alt+Up 選取並關閉；輸入字元會跳轉（開啟搜尋時則進行搜尋）；Escape 關閉並返回焦點；Tab 關閉且不選取。

trans-unit.source: MRR waterfall: how recurring revenue moved over a period, as a bridge. One bar stands for the revenue at the start, five floating bars add or take away (new business, expansion, reactivation, contraction, churn) and the last bar is the revenue at the end. Above the chart the ending revenue rolls to its new value with the change since the start, beside net revenue retention, the quick ratio and logo churn. Select a bar, with the pointer or the arrow keys, to list the accounts behind it in the side panel; point at a bar to preview its list. Switching the period or the unit (currency or percent of the start) moves bars, axis, labels, rows and numbers together on one spring.
trans-unit.target: MRR 瀑布圖:以橋形圖呈現經常性收入在一個週期內的變化。一根柱代表期初收入,五根浮動柱表示增加或減少(新增業務、擴展、重新啟用、收縮、流失),最後一根柱是期末收入。圖表上方,期末收入滾動到新值,並顯示相對期初的變化,旁邊是淨收入留存、速動比率和客戶流失率。用指標或方向鍵選取一根柱,即可在側邊面板列出其背後的帳戶;將指標停在柱上可預覽其清單。切換週期或單位(貨幣或佔期初的百分比)時,柱、座標軸、標籤、列和數字會在同一個彈簧上一起移動。

trans-unit.source: An animated multi-region deployment: a global load balancer sends users to the primary region while its database replicates to standby regions. When a region fails its health checks traffic shifts to the next healthy region and, if it held the primary database, a replica is promoted; a recovered region catches up as a replica.
trans-unit.target: 動畫示範的多區域部署：全域負載平衡器將使用者導向主要區域，其資料庫同時複寫至備援區域。某區域的健康檢查失敗時，流量會切換至下一個健康區域；若該區域持有主要資料庫，則會將一個副本升格為主要；恢復的區域則以副本身分重新同步。

trans-unit.source: Arc multi-select: pick several values from a fixed list while the field stays one line. Picked values show as chips in the trigger (their slots spring open, the chips grow in out of a blur); past `MaxVisibleChips` they fold into a "+N" chip whose count rolls. Each option's check draws itself. A clear button pops in while anything is selected. Keyboard: Enter or Space opens and closes; arrows open and move the highlight (wrapping, skipping disabled options); Enter toggles the highlighted option; Escape closes. `IsSearchable` adds a search field to the menu (an addition: Arc's menu has none).
trans-unit.target: Arc 多選框：從固定清單中選取多個值，同時欄位保持單行。已選值以標籤形式顯示在觸發器中（其位置以彈簧展開，標籤從模糊中淡入放大）；超過 `MaxVisibleChips` 時，它們會摺疊為一個 “+N” 標籤，其計數會滾動變化。每個選項的勾選標記自行繪製。只要有選取項目，清除按鈕就會彈出。鍵盤：Enter 或空白鍵開啟與關閉；方向鍵開啟並移動反白（循環移動，略過停用的選項）；Enter 切換目前反白的選項；Escape 關閉。`IsSearchable` 會在選單中加入搜尋欄位（這是對 Arc 的補充：Arc 的選單沒有搜尋）。

trans-unit.source: A guided form that asks for one thing at a time: a card with a progress list and a step count, one step of fields, and Back and Continue buttons (Continue reads `CompleteLabel` on the last step). Submitting the last step shows a success block in place of the fields and folds the buttons away. Steps slide 20 px in the direction of travel while the card springs to the new step's height (both ways); done steps draw a check and the count rolls. Every step keeps its fields alive while other steps are shown, so values survive Back and Continue. Enter in a single-line text field submits the step. A step can block its submission with `ValidateAsync`, with `StepValidating`, or by a field with a data validation error; `CompleteAsync` runs the final submission with a spinner on the button.
trans-unit.target: 引導式表單，一次只詢問一件事：一張卡片，包含進度清單和步驟計數、一個步驟的欄位，以及「返回」與「繼續」按鈕（最後一步時「繼續」顯示 `CompleteLabel`）。送出最後一步後，卡片會以成功提示區塊取代欄位，並收合按鈕。各步驟會以 20 px 的距離沿前進方向滑動，同時卡片以彈簧動畫過渡到新步驟的高度（前進與後退皆然）；已完成的步驟會繪製勾選標記，計數會滾動變化。每個步驟在顯示其他步驟時都會保留其欄位，因此返回與繼續時數值不會遺失。在單行文字欄位中按 Enter 會送出該步驟。步驟可透過 `ValidateAsync`、`StepValidating` 或帶有資料驗證錯誤的欄位阻止送出；`CompleteAsync` 執行最終送出，按鈕上顯示載入指示器。

trans-unit.source: A home for updates: a bell with an unread badge that opens a panel of notifications with read state, an All / Unread switch, expandable details and bulk actions ("Mark all read", "Clear read"). Use it when updates need a persistent place instead of a brief toast, and connect the read state to your data store through `IsRead` and the `ReadChanged` and `Dismissed` events. The panel grows out of the bell (6px toward it at scale 0.97, standard 240ms) and leaves in 120ms; counts roll, the summary rises into its new wording, the view highlight glides on the morph spring, rows collapse their height on the smooth spring as they leave (cascading 35ms apart after a bulk action) and settle in with a 4px rise when the panel opens. Escape closes the panel and returns focus to the bell. Ported from Arc's free notification-center block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli).
trans-unit.target: 更新的常駐入口：一個帶未讀徽章的鈴鐺，點選後開啟通知面板，面板包含已讀狀態、All / Unread 切換、可展開的詳細資料與批次操作（「Mark all read」、「Clear read」）。當更新需要持久的位置，而非短暫的訊息提示時使用，並透過 `IsRead` 與 `ReadChanged` 及 `Dismissed` 事件，將已讀狀態連接到你的資料儲存。面板從鈴鐺處展開（朝鈴鐺方向偏移 6px、縮放至 0.97，標準時長 240ms），並在 120ms 內收合；計數滾動更新，摘要以向上推入的方式切換為新文字，檢視的醒目提示沿變形彈簧滑動，列離開時以平滑彈簧收合高度（批次操作後以 35ms 間隔依序串接），面板開啟時各列以 4px 上升的方式就位。按下 Escape 關閉面板，並將焦點返回鈴鐺。移植自 Arc 免費的通知中心區塊（MIT 授權，版權所有 (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli）。

trans-unit.source: A persistent "now playing" player (Arc Now playing, design reference): a 336 × 64 mini bar — cover thumbnail, title and artist, level bars, play and next — that grows in place, in one continuous morph, into the full player with a large cover, a 54-bar waveform scrubber, the elapsed and remaining time and previous / play / next. The cover, play and next buttons fly between the two layouts while the shell's height and radius follow the same spring; the other parts fade out and stagger in. Pull the full cover down (more than 70px, or flick it) or press Escape to fold it back. Give it `Tracks`. Playback runs on its own clock (one second per second, on to the next track at the end, wrapping at both ends), so it works without audio. To drive real audio, follow `IsPlaying` and `Index` (both two-way) or handle `PlayingChanged` and `IndexChanged`, report the audio position through `CurrentTime` (each value corrects the clock, which keeps the waveform moving between updates; ignored during a scrub), and set the audio position in `SeekRequested`.
trans-unit.target: 一個常駐的 "now playing" 播放器（Arc Now playing，設計參考）：336 × 64 的迷你列——封面縮圖、標題與演出者、音量列、播放與下一首——以一次連續形變原地展開為完整播放器，帶大封面、54 根柱的波形拖曳定位列、已播放與剩餘時間，以及上一首 / 播放 / 下一首。封面、播放與下一首按鈕在兩種版面之間飛行，外殼的高度與圓角跟隨同一彈簧變化；其餘部分淡出，並依序淡入。向下拉完整封面（超過 70px 或快速甩動）或按 Escape 即可收合回去。請設定 `Tracks`。播放運行在自己的時鐘上（每秒走一秒，播完自動切到下一首，兩端都會回繞），因此沒有音訊也能運作。要驅動真實音訊，請跟隨 `IsPlaying` 與 `Index`（皆為雙向），或處理 `PlayingChanged` 與 `IndexChanged`，並透過 `CurrentTime` 回報音訊位置（每個值都會校正時鐘，使波形在兩次更新之間保持移動；波形拖曳期間忽略），在 `SeekRequested` 中設定音訊位置。

trans-unit.source: The position reported by real audio (for example on each time update). Every new value corrects the built-in clock, which keeps moving between updates; ignored while the waveform is being dragged.
trans-unit.target: 真實音訊回報的位置（例如每次時間更新時）。每個新值都會校正內建時鐘，時鐘在兩次更新之間持續前進；波形被拖曳時忽略。

trans-unit.source: Three small level bars that dance while a track plays and rest while paused (Arc Now playing's levels, design reference): 3 × 14 bars 2 apart, growing from the bottom. Playing, each bar swings between 25% and 100% of its height (ease-in-out, back and forth) with its own period — 900, 640 and 1100ms, started 0, 300 and 500ms in — at full opacity. Paused, they settle in 240ms to 30%, 60% and 42% at 55% opacity. Reduced motion holds them still while playing (70%, 100%, 70%). Decorative: hidden from assistive tech.
trans-unit.target: 三根小音量列，播放時跳動，暫停時靜止（Arc Now playing 的音量列，設計參考）：3 × 14 根柱，間距 2，從底部向上生長。播放時，每根柱在其高度的 25% 與 100% 之間往復擺動（ease-in-out），各自有獨立的週期——900、640 和 1100ms，分別延遲 0、300 和 500ms 開始——且完全不透明。暫停時，它們在 240ms 內沉降到 30%、60% 和 42%，不透明度為 55%。減少動態效果時，播放中保持靜止（70%、100%、70%）。僅作裝飾：對輔助技術隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Arc number field: a bounded number with clear increment controls. The value rolls like an odometer, the steppers and ArrowUp / ArrowDown repeat and speed up while held, Shift, PageUp and PageDown take large steps, Home and End jump to the limits, and `IsScrubEnabled` lets the label be dragged sideways. Typing edits a plain draft that applies live while valid and commits on Enter, blur or the next step (snapped to the step grid and clamped). A press past a limit strains the value toward it, shakes the refused stepper and names the limit beside the label (`"Max 10 seats"`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 數字輸入框：帶有明確增減控制項的有界數值。數值以里程表式滾動；步進按鈕及 ArrowUp / ArrowDown 按住時會重複並逐步加速；Shift、PageUp 與 PageDown 以較大步幅調整；Home 與 End 跳到上下限；`IsScrubEnabled` 允許左右拖曳標籤來調整數值。輸入時編輯一份一般草稿：有效時即時套用，並在按下 Enter、失去焦點或執行下一步時確認（會對齊步進網格並限制在範圍內）。按壓超出上下限時，數值會向該限制拉伸，被拒絕的步進按鈕會晃動，並在標籤旁標示該限制（`"Max 10 seats"`）。

trans-unit.source: Formatting and parsing culture (Arc `locale`, default en-US, never the current culture).
trans-unit.target: 格式化與解析所用的區域性（Arc 的 `locale`，預設 en-US，從不使用目前的系統區域性）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name prefix of the minus stepper (default "Decrease").
trans-unit.target: 減號步進按鈕的無障礙名稱前綴（預設 "Decrease"）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name prefix of the plus stepper (default "Increase", read as "Increase Seats").
trans-unit.target: 加號步進按鈕的無障礙名稱前綴（預設 "Increase"，讀作 "Increase Seats"）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the limit note beside the label when a press meets a limit or a typed value passes one.
trans-unit.target: 當按壓觸及上下限或輸入的值超出範圍時，在標籤旁顯示限制提示。

trans-unit.source: Drag the label sideways to scrub the value, one step every 6px (Arc `scrub`).
trans-unit.target: 左右拖曳標籤以調整數值，每 6px 前進一個步長（Arc 的 `scrub`）。

trans-unit.source: Fewest fraction digits shown (default: the precision of `Step` and `Minimum`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示的最少小數位數（預設：由 `Step` 與 `Minimum` 的精度決定）。

trans-unit.source: Computes the prefix from the value (Arc's function prefix); wins over `Prefix`.
trans-unit.target: 根據數值計算前綴（Arc 的函式式前綴）；優先於 `Prefix`。

trans-unit.source: One step (default 1; zero or less counts as 1). Its precision sets the default fraction digits.
trans-unit.target: 單一步長（預設 1；為零或負數時以 1 計算）。其精度決定預設的小數位數。

trans-unit.source: Computes the suffix from the value: `n => n == 1 ? " seat" : " seats"`.
trans-unit.target: 根據數值計算後綴：`n => n == 1 ? " seat" : " seats"`。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every real change of `Value` (never during template application).
trans-unit.target: 每次 `Value` 實際變更後觸發（套用範本期間不會觸發）。

trans-unit.source: A number filter condition: an enable checkbox with the label, an operator (= ≠ < ≤ > ≥) and a `NumberField` for the target. It holds the condition (`IsActive`, `Operator`, `Value`, `Tolerance`) and never filters data itself; read the properties in your view model, or test values with `Matches` or `Condition`. Typed values snap to multiples of `SmallChange` counted from `Minimum`; by default that is 1 in `Integer` mode and one unit of the last decimal place in `Decimal` mode.
trans-unit.target: 數字篩選條件：帶標籤的啟用核取方塊、運算子（= ≠ < ≤ > ≥）和輸入目標值的 `NumberField`。它保存條件（`IsActive`、`Operator`、`Value`、`Tolerance`），本身從不過濾資料；請在檢視模型中讀取這些屬性，或用 `Matches` 或 `Condition` 判斷值。輸入的值會對齊到從 `Minimum` 起算的 `SmallChange` 的倍數；預設在 `Integer` 模式下為 1，在 `Decimal` 模式下為最後一位小數的一個單位。

trans-unit.source: The current condition (operator, value and tolerance) as plain data.
trans-unit.target: 目前的條件（運算子、值和容差），以純資料表示。

trans-unit.source: Fraction digits shown and typed in `Decimal` mode (default 2, at most 10).
trans-unit.target: `Decimal` 模式下顯示和輸入的小數位數（預設 2，最多 10）。

trans-unit.source: The step of PageUp, PageDown and Shift with an arrow (default null: 10 in Integer mode, 1 in Decimal mode).
trans-unit.target: PageUp、PageDown 和 Shift+方向鍵的步長（預設 null：Integer 模式為 10，Decimal 模式為 1）。

trans-unit.source: Highest value that can be entered (default 9007199254740991).
Lowest value that can be entered, and origin of the step grid (default 0).
trans-unit.target: 可輸入的最小值，也是步進格線的原點（預設 0）。

trans-unit.source: Whole numbers or decimals (default `Decimal`).
trans-unit.target: 整數或小數（預設 `Decimal`）。

trans-unit.source: The comparison (two-way, default `Equal`).
trans-unit.target: 比較方式（雙向，預設 `Equal`）。

trans-unit.source: The operators the menu offers (default null: all six).
trans-unit.target: 選單提供的運算子（預設 null：全部六個）。

trans-unit.source: One step of the arrows and the steppers, and the grid typed values snap to (default null: 1, or one unit of the last decimal place).
trans-unit.target: 方向鍵和步進按鈕的一步，也是輸入值對齊的格線（預設 null：1，或最後一位小數的一個單位）。

trans-unit.source: How far apart two values may be and still count as equal (default 0); see `NumberFilterCondition`.
trans-unit.target: 兩個值相差多少以內仍視為相等（預設 0）；請參閱 `NumberFilterCondition`。

trans-unit.source: Group separators in the value (default true).
trans-unit.target: 值中顯示分組分隔符號（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: The target value (two-way, default 0).
trans-unit.target: 目標值（雙向，預設 0）。

trans-unit.source: A number condition as plain data: operator, target and tolerance. It has no UI, so a view model can build one from its own state and test values with `Matches`. The tolerance widens equality: `Equal` accepts values within it, `NotEqual` those outside it, the strict comparisons need to clear it and the inclusive ones may fall short by it. A negative tolerance counts as zero.
trans-unit.target: 以純資料表示的數字條件：運算子、目標值和容差。它不含介面，檢視模型可以用自己的狀態建構一個，再用 `Matches` 判斷值。容差放寬了相等：`Equal` 接受容差以內的值，`NotEqual` 接受容差以外的值，嚴格比較必須超出容差，包含等號的比較允許差一個容差。負的容差視為零。

trans-unit.source: Whether `NumberFilterBox` takes whole numbers or decimals.
trans-unit.target: `NumberFilterBox` 接受整數還是小數。

trans-unit.source: How `NumberFilterBox` compares a value with its target.
trans-unit.target: `NumberFilterBox` 如何把值與目標值比較。

trans-unit.source: Arc onboarding checklist: a getting started list for a new account or workspace. The ring and count follow every check, finished steps strike through and fold into a completed row that opens again, and the next step opens and takes focus. Use it for a short, one time setup of three to eight steps; use a stepper or a step form when the order is strict.
trans-unit.target: Arc 新手引導清單：面向新帳戶或新工作區的入門清單。圓環和計數跟隨每次勾選，完成的步驟劃掉後收進可再次展開的「已完成」列，下一步自動展開並取得焦點。適用於三到八個步驟的一次性簡短設定；順序嚴格時請使用步驟條或分步表單。

trans-unit.source: The keys of the finished steps. Setting it folds those steps away at once, without motion or events.
trans-unit.target: 已完成步驟的鍵。設定它會立即收起這些步驟，沒有動效，也不引發事件。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the finished steps change through a person or an action; setting Completed does not raise it.
trans-unit.target: 已完成的步驟因使用者或操作而改變時引發；設定 Completed 不會引發。

trans-unit.source: The title once every step is done.
trans-unit.target: 所有步驟完成後的標題。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a person hides or shows the body; setting IsHidden does not raise it.
trans-unit.target: 使用者隱藏或顯示主體時引發；設定 IsHidden 不會引發。

trans-unit.source: Whether every step is done.
trans-unit.target: 是否所有步驟都已完成。

trans-unit.source: Hides the body, leaving the header as a bar.
trans-unit.target: 隱藏主體，只保留標題列。

trans-unit.source: Bound steps; takes precedence over the inline steps.
trans-unit.target: 繫結的步驟；優先於內嵌步驟。

trans-unit.source: Inline steps (`<arc:OnboardingChecklistStep Title="…"/>`); ignored while ItemsSource is set.
trans-unit.target: 內嵌步驟（`<arc:OnboardingChecklistStep Title="…"/>`）；設定 ItemsSource 時會被忽略。

trans-unit.source: One step of an `OnboardingChecklist` (Arc `steps[]` entry).
trans-unit.target: `OnboardingChecklist` 的一個步驟（Arc `steps[]` 項目）。

trans-unit.source: Runs the step. Completing checks it off; throwing keeps it open and shows the exception's message.
trans-unit.target: 執行該步驟。完成時勾選它；擲回例外時保持展開並顯示例外訊息。

trans-unit.source: The label of the button that does the step. Without it, the step is checked off by hand.
trans-unit.target: 執行該步驟的按鈕標籤。不設定時，步驟由手動勾選。

trans-unit.source: A command that runs the step when no Action is set; it checks the step off unless it throws.
trans-unit.target: 未設定 Action 時執行該步驟的命令；除非擲回例外，否則會勾選該步驟。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to the command.
trans-unit.target: 傳給命令的參數。

trans-unit.source: A sentence shown while the step is open.
trans-unit.target: 步驟展開時顯示的一句話。

trans-unit.source: The stable key of the step, used by `Completed`; the title when unset.
trans-unit.target: 步驟的穩定鍵，供 `Completed` 使用；未設定時取標題。

trans-unit.source: A compact first-run card: a line drawing on top whose shapes morph from scene to scene (an empty box, files dropping in, a team around a board, a badge), and below it the step's title and sentence, a row of step dots, Back and a main button. The main button says Next, then Get started on the last step, then Replay intro once the onboarding is complete; Skip in the drawing's corner jumps to the last step. The Left and Right arrow keys step back and forth anywhere in the card. With no `Steps` the card shows four sample steps, one per scene.
trans-unit.target: 精簡的首次執行卡片：上方是線條圖，其形狀會在各場景之間變形（空盒子、檔案落入、團隊圍繞看板、徽章）；下方是步驟的標題與說明、一排步驟點、「返回」按鈕與主按鈕。主按鈕先顯示「下一步」，最後一步顯示「開始使用」，導覽完成後顯示「重播導覽」；繪圖角落的「跳過」會直接跳到最後一步。左右方向鍵可在卡片任意位置前後切換步驟。未設定 `Steps` 時，卡片顯示四個範例步驟，每個場景一個。

trans-unit.source: The sentence of the completed state.
trans-unit.target: 已完成狀態下的說明文字。

trans-unit.source: The title of the completed state.
trans-unit.target: 完成狀態的標題。

trans-unit.source: The step shown, 0-based (two way). Values outside the steps are clamped.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的步驟，從 0 開始計數（雙向）。超出步驟範圍的值會被限制在有效範圍內。

trans-unit.source: Get started was pressed on the last step: start the app's own flow here.

trans-unit.source: Draws the card's border, rounded corners and shadow (default true). False for a card that fills a sheet or a phone screen edge to edge.

trans-unit.target: 卡片區域的無障礙名稱，例如 "Northdesk onboarding"。

trans-unit.source: The button labels, the dots' names and the announced status texts.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕文字、圓點的名稱以及朗讀的狀態文字。

trans-unit.source: Replay intro was pressed (or `Replay` called); the card is back on the first step.

trans-unit.source: Runs when Skip is pressed, after `Skipped`; its parameter is the event arguments.

trans-unit.target: 按下 Skip（或呼叫 `Skip`）後為 true；卡片此時位於最後一步。

trans-unit.source: The step changed (Next, Back, a dot, an arrow key, Skip, Replay or code), with the old and new index and the reason.

trans-unit.source: The steps, in order (each with its scene and text). Empty (the default) shows four sample steps.

trans-unit.source: A short first-run survey asked one question at a time in a card: a counter with "Skip survey", a progress bar, the question with cards for one choice, checkboxes for several (with an optional limit) or a box for a few sentences, and Back, "Skip question" for optional questions and Continue (Finish on the last). Questions slide in the direction of travel while the card's height follows; the answers are kept when the person goes back, and the thank-you reports every answer in `Completed`. Enter continues, Alt+Left goes back and the number keys pick an option. Without `Questions` it asks four invented example questions.

trans-unit.source: The category the logo belongs to. The category chips are built from these.

trans-unit.source: The line of text in the card.
trans-unit.target: 卡片中的一行文字。

trans-unit.source: The mark: SVG path data (24 by 24), an image address, an image source or a control.
trans-unit.target: 標誌：SVG 路徑資料（24 × 24）、圖片位址、圖片來源或控制項。

trans-unit.source: Stable identifier. When empty, `Name` identifies the logo.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼。為空時由 `Name` 識別該標誌。

trans-unit.source: Whether the integration is connected. It starts the status and is set when a connection succeeds.
trans-unit.target: 整合是否已連線。它決定初始狀態，連線成功後會被設定。

trans-unit.source: The brand or product name, used in the chip's name tag, the card and the accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 品牌或產品名稱，用於標誌的名稱標籤、卡片和無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: An integrations orbit (Arc Orbit logos, design reference): your product mark at the centre with brand logos on two flat rings that turn slowly and hold still whenever the pointer or keyboard focus is inside. Category chips turn the matching logos toward the detail side and dim the rest. Choosing a logo springs its ring so the logo glides to a fixed spot, draws an accent connector from the centre and morphs a detail card out of the chip, with a description, the status, a Connect action, a Docs link and previous and next.
trans-unit.target: 整合軌道（Arc Orbit logos，設計參考）：你的產品標誌位於中央，品牌標誌排在兩條平面環上，環緩慢轉動，指標或鍵盤焦點在內時保持靜止。類別膠囊會把相符的標誌轉向詳情一側並讓其餘標誌變暗。選中一個標誌時，它所在的環以彈簧轉動，使標誌滑到固定位置，從中央畫出強調色連線，並從標誌中長出詳情卡片，包含說明、狀態、Connect 操作、Docs 連結以及上一個和下一個。

trans-unit.source: Label of the first category chip, the one that shows every logo.

trans-unit.source: Content of the centre disc, such as your product mark. Defaults to a simple mark in the accent color.

trans-unit.source: Raised when the Connect button is pressed. A handler can set `Completion`.

trans-unit.source: Holds the orbit still, for a page-level motion control.

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the logo list, and the title of the idle panel.

trans-unit.source: Color of the two ring lines. The theme uses the subtle border.
