trans-unit.source: Id (or name) of the logo whose card is open. Null closes the card. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 卡片已開啟的標誌的 id（或名稱）。為 null 時關閉卡片。雙向。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a logo is opened, when previous or next steps to another, and with no logo and index -1 when the card closes.
trans-unit.target: 開啟標誌、用上一個或下一個切換到另一個標誌時引發；卡片關閉時沒有標誌且索引為 -1。

trans-unit.source: Multiplies the rotation speed. At 1 the inner ring turns once every 64 seconds and the outer ring, the other way, every 88 seconds. 0 holds the orbit still.
trans-unit.target: 轉速倍數。為 1 時內環每 64 秒轉一圈，外環反向每 88 秒轉一圈。0 讓軌道保持靜止。

trans-unit.source: Quick actions for one object, laid out on an arc around a round trigger. A press, a drag in an action's direction and a release runs that action; a short tap keeps the arc out so an action can be clicked. The target is picked by the pointer's angle around the trigger, so the pointer need not reach the action itself. A lens slides under the target, actions near the pointer are drawn toward it, and a label pill names the target, gives the cancel hint and confirms the action that ran. The trigger shows an ellipsis at rest, a close mark while the arc is out and a check after an action runs.
trans-unit.target: 一個物件的快捷動作，排列在圓形觸發按鈕周圍的圓弧上。按住、朝某個動作的方向拖曳再放開，就執行該動作；輕點一下則讓圓弧保持展開，以便點選動作。目標由指標繞觸發按鈕的角度決定，所以指標不必碰到動作本身。透鏡滑到目標下方，靠近指標的動作被吸向指標，標籤膠囊說出目標、給出取消提示，並確認執行了哪個動作。觸發按鈕靜止時顯示刪節號，圓弧展開時顯示關閉標記，動作執行後顯示勾號。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an action fires, from a release, a click, the keyboard or assistive technology. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 某個動作被觸發時引發，來源可以是放開、點選、鍵盤或輔助技術。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Whether confirmations are announced to assistive technology through a polite live region (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否透過禮貌型即時區域把確認文字告知輔助技術（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: What the pill says while a drag is away from every action (releasing there fires nothing).
trans-unit.target: 拖曳離開所有動作時膠囊顯示的文字（在那裡放開不會觸發任何動作）。

trans-unit.source: The angle the arc faces, in degrees clockwise from the right (default -90: up).
trans-unit.target: 圓弧朝向的角度，單位為度，從右側順時針計算（預設 -90：朝上）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the arc is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 圓弧是否展開（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the trigger and the menu, also the pill's text whenever the arc is out but no action is aimed at.
trans-unit.target: 觸發按鈕與選單的無障礙名稱；圓弧展開但沒有對準任何動作時，它也是膠囊上的文字。

trans-unit.source: How far each action's center sits from the trigger's center, in px (default 104).
trans-unit.target: 每個動作中心離觸發按鈕中心的距離，單位 px（預設 104）。

trans-unit.source: How many degrees the arc spans (default 150); 360 spreads the actions evenly round a full ring.
trans-unit.target: 圓弧張開的角度（預設 150）；360 時動作平均分布成一整圈。

trans-unit.source: One action of an `OrbitMenu`: a round button with a glyph, named by `Label` (the pill text and the accessible name). It draws itself, circle, shadow and glyph, so an arc of actions costs one element each.
trans-unit.target: `OrbitMenu` 的一個動作：帶圖示的圓形按鈕，由 `Label`（膠囊顯示的文字與無障礙名稱）命名。它自行繪製圓形、陰影與圖示，因此一段圓弧上的動作每個只需一個元素。

trans-unit.source: Fill of the circle (set by the theme; it fades out while the lens is under the action).
trans-unit.target: 圓形的填色（由主題設定；透鏡位於動作下方時它會淡出）。

trans-unit.source: Color of the circle's edge.
trans-unit.target: 圓形邊緣的顏色。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the action fires: a release over it, a click, Enter, Space or assistive technology. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 動作觸發時引發：在它上方放開、點選、Enter、Space 或輔助技術。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Command run when the action fires.
trans-unit.target: 動作觸發時執行的命令。

trans-unit.source: Parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 傳給 `Command` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Corner radius of the button; the theme's pill radius draws a circle.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕的圓角半徑；使用主題的膠囊圓角半徑會畫出圓形。

trans-unit.source: What the pill says once the action has run, such as "Saved"; null falls back to `Label`.
trans-unit.target: 動作執行後膠囊上的文字，例如 "Saved"；為 null 時改用 `Label`。

trans-unit.source: Color of the glyph.
trans-unit.target: 圖示的顏色。

trans-unit.source: The 24 × 24 stroked glyph in the middle of the button.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕中間的 24 × 24 描邊圖示。

trans-unit.source: Size of the glyph.
trans-unit.target: 圖示的大小。

trans-unit.source: What the action does, in a few words: the pill shows it while the action is targeted, and it is the accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 用幾個字說明動作做什麼：動作被對準時膠囊顯示它，它也是無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Shadow under the button.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕下方的陰影。

trans-unit.source: Diameter of the button.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕的直徑。

trans-unit.source: The action's color: `Danger` for destructive actions.
trans-unit.target: 動作的顏色：破壞性動作使用 `Danger`。

trans-unit.source: One agent of an `AgentOrchestrator` run: the lead or a sub-agent. Data only: an `AvaloniaObject`, so a change made by your code or by a message reaches the graph, the log and the detail panel.
trans-unit.target: `AgentOrchestrator` 執行中的一個智慧體：主智慧體或子智慧體。只是資料：它是一個 `AvaloniaObject`，因此你的程式碼或訊息所做的改變都會反映到圖、訊息記錄和詳情面板中。

trans-unit.source: What it is doing right now (the last progress note); the node shows it in place of the task while set.
trans-unit.target: 它現在正在做的事（最近一則進度說明）；設定後節點會顯示它而不是任務。

trans-unit.source: Stable id used by messages and steps (`From`, `To`).
trans-unit.target: 訊息和步驟使用的固定 id（`From`、`To`）。

trans-unit.source: The model the agent runs on, shown in the detail panel; null shows nothing.
trans-unit.target: 智慧體使用的模型，顯示在詳情面板中；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The name on the node, such as "Scout".
trans-unit.target: 節點上的名稱，例如 "Scout"。

trans-unit.source: What it handed back (the text of its result or error).
trans-unit.target: 它交回的內容（結果或錯誤的文字）。

trans-unit.source: What the agent is for, one short phrase under the name ("Market research").
trans-unit.target: 智慧體的用途，名稱下方的一個短語（"Market research"）。

trans-unit.source: Where the agent stands; messages change it, and so can `SetStatus`.
trans-unit.target: 智慧體所處的狀態；訊息會改變它，`SetStatus` 也可以。

trans-unit.source: The task it was given (the text of the last `Delegate` it received).
trans-unit.target: 交給它的任務（它最近收到的 `Delegate` 的文字）。

trans-unit.source: A row of single-character slots for one-time codes (Arc's OTP input block): a visible label, one slot per character, helper and error copy under the row. Typing fills a slot and moves on; a paste fills the slots from the focused one; arrow keys move between slots and Backspace on an empty slot clears the one before it. Characters rise into their slot, a paste lands as a short left to right wave, one focus ring glides between the slots, and a new error nudges the row side to side once. `Value` is two-way; `Completed` fires when an edit fills the last slot, which is where a host checks the code.
trans-unit.target: 用於一次性驗證碼的單字元格子列（Arc 的 OTP 輸入區塊）：可見的標籤、每個字元一個格子，以及列下方的輔助文字與錯誤文字。輸入時填入格子並移至下一格；貼上時從目前聚焦的格子開始依序填入；方向鍵可在格子之間移動，在空白格子上按 Backspace 會清除前一格。字元會向上升入格子，貼上時出現一道由左至右的短暫波浪動畫，一個焦點環在格子之間滑動，新的錯誤會讓整列左右晃動一次。`Value` 為雙向繫結；編輯填滿最後一格時觸發 `Completed`，宿主應在此檢查驗證碼。

trans-unit.source: Focuses the first slot when the field is loaded (Arc's `autoFocus`).
trans-unit.target: 載入時聚焦第一個格子（Arc 的 `autoFocus`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every edit by the person that leaves all slots filled (Arc: `if (next.length === length) verify(next)`).
trans-unit.target: 使用者每次編輯後引發，且所有格子均已填滿時引發。（Arc：`if (next.length === length) verify(next)`）

trans-unit.source: Executed with the code when an edit fills every slot (after `Completed`).
trans-unit.target: 編輯填滿所有格子時執行，參數為驗證碼（在 `Completed` 之後）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the slots (Arc's `description`).
trans-unit.target: 格子下方的輔助文字（Arc 的 `description`）。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the slots (Arc's `error`); non-empty makes the field invalid, and a new error shakes the row once.
trans-unit.target: 格子下方的錯誤文字（Arc 的 `error`）；非空時欄位變為無效狀態，新的錯誤會讓輸入列抖動一次。

trans-unit.source: Which characters the slots accept (Arc's `inputMode`): digits only (default) or any text.
trans-unit.target: 格子接受的字元類型（Arc 的 `inputMode`）：僅數字（預設）或任意文字。

trans-unit.source: True while every slot holds a character.
trans-unit.target: 所有格子都有字元時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Invalid state: danger slots and ring. Always true while `ErrorMessage` is not empty.
trans-unit.target: 無效狀態：格子與焦點環顯示為危險色。只要 `ErrorMessage` 不為空，此值一律為 true。

trans-unit.source: When true the slots keep focus and arrow keys but ignore typing, paste and deletion (while a host checks a code).
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時，格子保留焦點與方向鍵，但忽略輸入、貼上與刪除（用於主機檢查驗證碼期間）。

trans-unit.source: Success state: success slots and ring (an addition to Arc, which has no success look).
trans-unit.target: 成功狀態：格子與圓環顯示成功樣式（這是對 Arc 的補充，Arc 沒有成功樣式）。

trans-unit.source: The visible label and the name of the group of slots (Arc's required `label`).
trans-unit.target: 可見的標籤，同時也是這組格子的名稱（Arc 必填的 `label`）。

trans-unit.source: Number of slots (Arc's `length`), 1 to 32.
trans-unit.target: 格子數量（Arc 的 `length`），取值 1 到 32。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of each slot: `{0}` is `Label`, `{1}` the slot's position from 1 and `{2}``Length` ("Verification code, digit 1 of 6").
trans-unit.target: 每個格子的無障礙名稱：`{0}` 為 `Label`，`{1}` 為從 1 開始的格子位置，`{2}``Length`（"Verification code, digit 1 of 6"）。

trans-unit.source: The code, one character per slot (Arc's `value` and `onChange`); two-way.
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼，每個格子一個字元（Arc 的 `value` 與 `onChange`）；雙向。

trans-unit.source: Raised whenever `Value` changes; `ChangeSource` tells edits from code.
trans-unit.target: `Value` 每次變更時觸發；`ChangeSource` 用於區分編輯產生的變更與程式碼產生的變更。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Completed`.
trans-unit.target: `Completed` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ValueChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `ValueChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: A small book or magazine that opens on its cover (Arc Page curl, design reference). Tap the right page to go forward and the left page to go back, or drag a page: it folds along a line that follows the pointer, showing its back, a lit curl and a shadow on the page below. A page count with previous and next buttons sits underneath.

trans-unit.source: The frame of a project or record page (Arc page header block): a fixed header with breadcrumbs, a large title with a status badge, a description, a meta row, actions and tabs, over the scrolling body of the selected tab. Scrolling the body past 16px folds the header into a compact bar (the breadcrumbs give way to the title and its status, which scrolls back to the top when chosen); it opens again only near the top (4px), so it never flickers. Secondary actions fold into the "More actions" menu when the breadcrumbs would get less than 240px, and return at 272px. Tab counts roll digit by digit, a 2px indicator glides between tabs, and panels slide in from the side of travel. Breakpoints follow the control's own width: below 560px the padding tightens, the root crumb and the compact badge hide and the title steps down a size; below 460px the primary action shows only its icon. Ported from Arc's free page-header block (MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli) and made data driven: tabs are `PageHeaderTab` items (or data items with `ItemTemplate` and `ContentTemplate`), actions are `PageHeaderAction`s.
trans-unit.target: 專案或紀錄頁面（Arc 頁首區塊）的框架：固定在頂部的頁首，包含麵包屑、附帶狀態徽章的大型標題、描述、中繼資訊列、操作與標籤，下方為所選標籤的可捲動內文。內文捲動超過 16px 時，頁首收合為精簡列（麵包屑讓位給標題及其狀態；選取標題時會捲回頂部）；只有回到頂部附近（4px 以內）才會再次展開，因此不會閃爍。當麵包屑可用寬度將小於 240px 時，次要操作會收合進「More actions」選單，寬度回到 272px 時再展開。標籤計數逐位滾動，2px 指示條在標籤之間滑動，面板從移動方向的一側滑入。斷點依控制項自身的寬度而定：低於 560px 時內距收緊，根麵包屑與精簡徽章隱藏，標題降一級字級；低於 460px 時主要操作只顯示圖示。移植自 Arc 的免費頁首區塊（MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Elia Kuratli），並改為資料驅動：標籤為 `PageHeaderTab` 項目（或帶有 `ItemTemplate` 與 `ContentTemplate` 的資料項目），操作為 `PageHeaderAction`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an action is chosen from its button or the "More actions" menu.

On Windows the header is the system caption (system menu, Aero Snap). The body is never part of it. Defaults to false.

trans-unit.source: Zooms, pans and pages through a set of pages: pictures from `ItemsSource` or pages rendered on demand from an `IPageSource`. One self-drawn surface draws only the visible pages, so a document of ten thousand pages costs no more than a short one; a toolbar moves between pages and picks the zoom and the layout, and `Layers` draw over the pages and take pointer input. Pages are always white paper, in dark themes too. Ctrl / Cmd + wheel, a trackpad magnify and a touch pinch zoom about the pointer; the toolbar and the keyboard zoom about the viewport center on a spring; the middle button or holding Space pans in any mode. Designed to be derived from: `ToolbarStart` and `ToolbarEnd` extend the toolbar; `LeadingPane` and `ContentOverlay` add a side panel and floating parts without a new template (give the derived control a theme that is `BasedOn` this one); `OnViewerKeyDown` takes keys first; `GetPageBitmap` shares the render cache with other views of the same pages.
trans-unit.target: 縮放、平移並翻閱一組頁面：來自 `ItemsSource` 的圖片，或由 `IPageSource` 按需繪製的頁面。一個自繪表面只繪製可見頁面，所以一萬頁的文件開銷不比短文件大；工具列用於翻頁、選擇縮放和版面，`Layers` 在頁面之上繪製並接收指標輸入。頁面始終是白紙，深色主題下也一樣。Ctrl / Cmd + 滾輪、觸控板放大和觸控捏合以指標為錨點縮放；工具列和鍵盤以檢視區中心為錨點，用彈簧縮放；任何模式下中鍵或按住空白鍵都能平移。專為衍生設計：`ToolbarStart` 和 `ToolbarEnd` 擴充工具列；`LeadingPane` 和 `ContentOverlay` 無需新範本即可加入側邊欄和浮動部件（讓衍生控制項的主題 `BasedOn` 此主題）；`OnViewerKeyDown` 最先處理按鍵；`GetPageBitmap` 讓同一頁面的其他檢視共用繪製快取。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `CurrentPageIndex` changes.
trans-unit.target: `CurrentPageIndex` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: The page at the middle of the viewport (two-way, from 0); setting it jumps there.
trans-unit.target: 檢視區中線所在的頁面（雙向，從 0 開始）；設定它會跳到該頁。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the zoom fitted to the viewport (default Width); the zoom is worked out again when the viewport changes.

trans-unit.source: Content at the right end of the toolbar.

trans-unit.source: The zoom (two-way): 1 shows pages at their own size. Clamped to the limits; a change from outside sets `FitMode` to None.

trans-unit.source: Arc pagination: previous and next buttons around a sliding window of five page buttons and one current-page mark that travels between them on a morph spring. When the window moves, the numbers travel like a belt by the number of slots it moved (smooth spring), entering numbers fade in and leaving ones fade out quickly. `CurrentPage` is 1-based, two-way and clamped to `1..PageCount`; with `ShowBoundaryPages` the first and last pages stay reachable behind an ellipsis.
trans-unit.target: Arc 分頁：上一頁、下一頁按鈕之間是由五個頁碼按鈕組成的滑動視窗，以及一個目前頁標記，它會藉由變形彈簧在各按鈕之間移動。視窗移動時，頁碼會依移動的格數如輸送帶般平移（平滑彈簧）；新出現的頁碼淡入，離開的頁碼快速淡出。`CurrentPage` 從 1 開始計算，為雙向繫結，並限制在 `1..PageCount` 範圍內；啟用 `ShowBoundaryPages` 後，首頁與末頁仍可透過省略號存取。

trans-unit.source: The current page, 1-based. Two-way; values outside `1..PageCount` are clamped for display.
trans-unit.target: 目前頁碼，從 1 開始。雙向繫結；超出 `1..PageCount` 範圍的值在顯示時會被限制。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the first and last pages visible behind an ellipsis when the window does not reach them (not in Arc).
trans-unit.target: 當視窗未涵蓋首頁與末頁時，以省略號形式保留其可見（Arc 中沒有此功能）。

trans-unit.source: Arc password field: a labeled password input with a reveal toggle inside the frame. The toggle's eye is crossed out by a slash that draws itself (it is never swapped for a second icon), and after the first toggle every switch between dots and characters resolves in place from a light blur. Enter or Space on the toggle shows or hides the password; the toggle reports its pressed state and switches its name between `ShowPasswordText` and `HidePasswordText`. The explicit reveal selection persists across focus changes until the user or caller changes `IsRevealed`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 密碼輸入框：帶標籤的密碼輸入框，外框內有顯示切換按鈕。切換按鈕的眼睛圖示上有一條自行繪製的斜線（從不替換為第二個圖示）；首次切換之後，圓點與字元之間的每次切換都會透過輕微模糊原地過渡。在切換按鈕上按 Enter 或 Space 可顯示或隱藏密碼；該按鈕會回報其按下狀態，並在 `ShowPasswordText` 與 `HidePasswordText` 之間切換其名稱。使用者明確選擇的顯示狀態在焦點變化時維持不變，直到使用者或呼叫端變更 `IsRevealed`。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is shown.
trans-unit.target: 密碼顯示時切換按鈕的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Shows the password as text (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 以文字形式顯示密碼（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Name of the toggle while the password is hidden.
trans-unit.target: 密碼隱藏時切換按鈕的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Arc password strength: a new-password field that shows how strong the password is while it is typed. Four segments fill in a staggered wave and change tone, the strength word rises when strength improves and drops when it falls, each requirement checks off with a drawn tick (unmet length rules show a rolling "4 more"), and a new `ErrorMessage` shakes the field once. Scoring runs on the device through a pluggable `Scorer` (default: `PasswordStrengthEstimator`, synchronous and cheap).
trans-unit.target: Arc 密碼強度：新密碼輸入框，在輸入時即顯示密碼的強度。四段分段條以交錯波浪的方式填滿並變換色調，強度文字在強度提升時上升、下降時下降；每項要求都會以繪製的勾號逐一打勾（未達成的長度規則會顯示滾動的 "4 more"）；新的 `ErrorMessage` 會讓輸入框晃動一次。評分在本機透過可替換的 `Scorer` 完成（預設：`PasswordStrengthEstimator`，同步且成本低）。

trans-unit.source: How characters are counted for `ShortLength`; null counts code points.
trans-unit.target: `ShortLength` 的字元計數方式；為 null 時以碼點計數。

trans-unit.source: The current level, 0 (empty) to 4 (strong).
trans-unit.target: 目前等級，從 0（空）到 4（強）。

trans-unit.source: Every user-facing string (English defaults).
trans-unit.target: 所有面向使用者的字串（英文預設值）。

trans-unit.source: Requirements to check. Strength is the share of rules met, spread over four steps.
trans-unit.target: 要檢查的要求。強度為達成規則的比例，分布在四個等級上。

trans-unit.source: Scores the password; null uses `PasswordStrengthEstimator` with `ShortLength`.
trans-unit.target: 為密碼評分；為 null 時使用帶有 `ShortLength` 的 `PasswordStrengthEstimator`。

trans-unit.source: Below this many characters the meter holds at its first step and reads "Too short". Default 8.
trans-unit.target: 低於此字元數時，強度條停留在第一段並顯示 "Too short"。預設 8。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every scored change of the password.
trans-unit.target: 每次密碼經過評分並發生變更後觸發。

trans-unit.source: The current strength word.
trans-unit.target: 目前的強度文字。

trans-unit.source: Fails text that does not match a regular expression; empty values pass (add `RequiredRule` to refuse them).
trans-unit.target: 文字不符合規則運算式時不通過；空值通過（新增 `RequiredRule` 可拒絕空值）。

trans-unit.source: An animated card payment: the customer pays at checkout, the gateway tokenizes the card, the authorization request travels through the card network to the issuing bank, the issuer approves or declines, the response comes back and approved payments settle to the merchant account, whose balance grows.
trans-unit.target: 動畫示範的信用卡付款：顧客於結帳時付款，支付閘道將卡片權杖化，授權要求經由卡組織傳送至發卡銀行，發卡行核准或拒絕，回應回傳；核准的付款會結算至商家帳戶，其餘額隨之增加。

trans-unit.source: The amount paid (default 42).
trans-unit.target: 已支付的金額（預設 42）。

trans-unit.source: Last four digits of the card.
trans-unit.target: 卡號的末四碼。

trans-unit.source: ISO currency code (default USD).
trans-unit.target: ISO 貨幣代碼（預設 USD）。

trans-unit.source: Every N-th payment is declined (0 never declines).
trans-unit.target: 每第 N 筆付款會被拒絕（0 表示從不拒絕）。

trans-unit.source: Node titles, badges and caption text of the diagram; set it to rename or translate the scene.
trans-unit.target: 圖表中的節點標題、徽章與說明文字；設定此項可重新命名或翻譯場景。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the issuer decides a payment.
trans-unit.target: 發卡行做出付款決定時引發。

trans-unit.target: `PaymentFlow` 中所有可見文字（可覆寫以用於其他語言或領域）。

trans-unit.source: Shows a PDF in a plain `PageViewer`, without the tools of `PdfViewer`: `arc:Pdf.Source="report.pdf"`. The document opens while the viewer is in a tree and is closed when the source changes or the viewer leaves. There is no password form and no failure cover; failures, a needed password included, are in `Pdf.Error`.
trans-unit.target: 在一般 `PageViewer` 中顯示 PDF，不帶 `PdfViewer` 的工具：`arc:Pdf.Source="report.pdf"`。檢視器在視覺樹中時開啟文件，來源變更或檢視器離開時關閉。沒有密碼表單和失敗覆蓋層；失敗（包括需要密碼）記錄在 `Pdf.Error` 中。

trans-unit.source: Why the document of `Pdf.Source` could not be opened, a needed password included; null otherwise.
trans-unit.target: `Pdf.Source` 的文件未能開啟的原因（包括需要密碼）；否則為 null。

trans-unit.source: The PDF to show. Sets the viewer's `PageSource`.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的 PDF。會設定檢視器的 `PageSource`。

trans-unit.source: A PDF viewer: `PageViewer` plus a document (`Source` or `Document`), a sidebar with thumbnails and the table of contents, search, text selection, links, and the states of opening one (loading, failed, password). Rendering comes from `Backend`: call `ArcPdfNative.Use()` on desktop or `await ArcPdfBrowser.UseAsync()` in a browser. Without a backend a real document fails with a hint; pages are never faked. `SimulatedPdfDocument` gives generated pages for tests and design time.
trans-unit.target: PDF 檢視器：`PageViewer` 加上文件（`Source` 或 `Document`）、帶縮圖和目錄的側邊欄、搜尋、文字選取、連結，以及開啟文件的各種狀態（載入、失敗、密碼）。繪製來自 `Backend`：桌面上呼叫 `ArcPdfNative.Use()`，瀏覽器中呼叫 `await ArcPdfBrowser.UseAsync()`。沒有後端時，真實文件會失敗並給出提示，絕不偽造頁面。`SimulatedPdfDocument` 提供產生的頁面，用於測試和設計階段。

trans-unit.source: The current result (two-way), from 0 in document order, or -1 for none. Setting it scrolls to that result. While a scan wraps around to earlier pages, the same result's number can grow.
trans-unit.target: 目前結果（雙向），按文件順序從 0 開始，沒有時為 -1。設定它會捲動到該結果。掃描環繞到前面的頁面時，同一結果的序號可能變大。

trans-unit.source: An already open document to show. It stays yours: the viewer never disposes it.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的已開啟文件。它仍歸你所有：檢視器從不釋放它。

trans-unit.source: A document could not be opened.
trans-unit.target: 文件未能開啟。

trans-unit.target: `Status` 為 Failed 時，文件未能開啟的原因。

trans-unit.source: What to do with a link that leads out of the document. Only http, https and mailto ever open; a document is untrusted, so every other scheme is refused whatever this says.
trans-unit.target: 如何處理指向文件外部的連結。只有 http、https 和 mailto 才會開啟；文件不可信，所以無論這裡如何設定，其他協定都會被拒絕。

trans-unit.source: Matches only text of the same case.
trans-unit.target: 只比對大小寫相同的文字。

trans-unit.source: Arc phone input: a phone field with a country picker. The number formats as it is typed in the selected country's shape (separators only print while digits follow, a typed trunk prefix is kept) with a faint guide showing the rest of the expected number; the value comes out in E.164. The flag button grows into a searchable country list (one morphing surface), pasted or autofilled international numbers pick their own country (+1 picks Canada by area code), and typing "+" in the number jumps into the picker with a calling-code search. After blur an incomplete or too long number shows "Numbers in United Kingdom have 10 digits" unless `IsValidationEnabled` is off or an `ErrorMessage` replaces it; a valid number shows a check. Keyboard: on the country button ArrowDown / ArrowUp open the list and a printable key opens it seeded with that key; in the search ArrowDown / ArrowUp, PageDown / PageUp (8 rows), Home / End (with an empty search) move, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns to the button, Tab closes. In the number, Backspace / Delete on a separator delete the digit beside it.
trans-unit.target: Arc 電話輸入框：帶國家選擇器的電話欄位。號碼會依所選國家的格式邊輸入邊排版（分隔符僅在後面有數字時才顯示，輸入的國內長途前綴會保留），並以淡色提示顯示預期號碼的其餘部分；值以 E.164 格式輸出。國旗按鈕會展開為可搜尋的國家清單（同一個變形面板）；貼上或自動填入的國際號碼會自動選取對應國家（+1 依區碼選取加拿大）；在號碼中輸入 "+" 會跳至選擇器並以國際區號搜尋。失去焦點後，不完整或過長的號碼會顯示 "英國號碼應為 10 位數字"，除非關閉了 `IsValidationEnabled` 或被 `ErrorMessage` 取代；有效號碼會顯示勾號。鍵盤操作：在國家按鈕上，ArrowDown / ArrowUp 開啟清單，可列印字元鍵會開啟清單並以該字元作為搜尋初始值；在搜尋框中，ArrowDown / ArrowUp、PageDown / PageUp（8 列）、Home / End（搜尋框為空時）可移動，Enter 選取，Escape 關閉並回到按鈕，Tab 關閉。在號碼中，在分隔符上按 Backspace / Delete 會刪除其旁邊的數字。

trans-unit.source: Photos laid out edge to edge, either in justified rows that all share one height and fill the width exactly, or in masonry columns. Every photo keeps its own proportions. Selecting a photo (a click, Enter or Space) opens it wide on a row of its own and the rest flow around it; when the grid is resized, photos are added or removed, or the layout changes, every photo glides from where it was to its new place instead of jumping.
trans-unit.target: 一張挨一張排列的照片：可以排成高度相同、正好佔滿寬度的行，也可以排成多列。每張照片都保持自己的比例。選取一張照片（點擊、Enter 或 Space）會讓它在單獨的一行裡展開變大，其餘照片隨之讓開；網格大小改變、照片增加或刪除、版面配置改變時，每張照片都會從原來的位置平滑移到新位置，而不是直接跳過去。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Redacted`: the safe prompt and every entity it replaced.
trans-unit.target: `Redacted` 的參數：安全提示詞以及它取代的每個實體。

trans-unit.source: A guardrail card that shows personal data being redacted before a prompt reaches the model (Arc PII redaction, design reference). Scan marks each name, email, phone number and card number in the message with its type, then swaps each one for a numbered placeholder such as `[EMAIL_1]` in a single crossfade. Send carries the safe prompt along a small flow (you, the PII guard, the model), the reply streams back in quick chunks with its placeholders, and the guard puts the original values back for the person. Show original flips the message between the safe prompt and what was typed, and the message can be edited before a scan. Detection comes from `Detector` (your DLP or NER service) or the built-in `PiiRedactor`; the reply from `Sender` or a simulation, which the card says. Without a `Message` it plays a `Simulation` (a conversation you pass) on a loop while at least a quarter of it is on screen, until someone interacts; with neither it shows an empty message field.
trans-unit.target: 一張防護卡片，展示個人資料在提示詞送到模型之前被遮蔽的過程（Arc PII redaction，設計參考）。掃描會在訊息中標出每個姓名、電子郵件、電話號碼與卡號及其類型，接著在一次交叉淡化中把它們各自換成帶編號的預留位置，例如 `[EMAIL_1]`。傳送會讓安全提示詞沿著一條小流程（你、PII 防護、模型）傳遞，回覆帶著預留位置分小塊快速串流傳回，防護再為使用者放回原始值。顯示原文會在安全提示詞與輸入的內容之間切換，掃描前訊息可以編輯。偵測來自 `Detector`（你的 DLP 或 NER 服務）或內建的 `PiiRedactor`；回覆來自 `Sender` 或模擬，卡片會註明模擬。沒有 `Message` 時，只要卡片至少四分之一在畫面內，它就循環播放 `Simulation`（你傳入的一段對話），直到有人操作；兩者都沒有時顯示空的訊息框。

trans-unit.source: Plays scan, send and restore on a loop while at least a quarter of the card is on screen. Stops for good as soon as someone edits, toggles or presses a button. Off with reduced motion.
trans-unit.target: 只要卡片至少四分之一在畫面內，就循環播放掃描、傳送與還原。一旦有人編輯、切換或按下按鈕就永久停止。減少動態效果時關閉。

trans-unit.source: The color of card numbers (theme: Series4).
trans-unit.target: 卡號的顏色（主題：Series4）。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the built-in detector, for example with your DLP or NER service. Return spans with an exclusive end; the token is cancelled when the person presses Stop or Reset. A thrown exception shows its message with Retry.
trans-unit.target: 取代內建偵測器，例如換成你的 DLP 或 NER 服務。傳回終點不含在內的區間；使用者按下 Stop 或 Reset 時權杖會被取消。擲出的例外會顯示其訊息並提供 Retry。

trans-unit.source: The color of emails (theme: Series2).
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件的顏色（主題：Series2）。

trans-unit.source: Whether people can edit the message before a scan. Cmd or Ctrl plus Enter scans from the field.
trans-unit.target: 掃描前使用者能否編輯訊息。在輸入框中按 Cmd 或 Ctrl 加 Enter 即開始掃描。

trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每個詞語。

trans-unit.source: The message to check (two-way). Null shows the `Simulation`'s message, or a blank field without one.
trans-unit.target: 要檢查的訊息（雙向）。為 null 時顯示 `Simulation` 的訊息，沒有模擬時顯示空白輸入框。

trans-unit.source: The model's mark, a 24 × 24 stroked glyph drawn at 16px; the sparkle by default.
trans-unit.target: 模型的標記，一個 24 × 24 的描邊圖形，以 16px 繪製；預設為火花。

trans-unit.source: The mark's color; the accent by default.
trans-unit.target: 標記的顏色；預設為強調色。

trans-unit.source: The model the safe prompt goes to, on the flow and above the reply; null names the `Simulation`'s model, or none.
trans-unit.target: 安全提示詞送往的模型，顯示在流程列上與回覆上方；為 null 時顯示 `Simulation` 的模型，沒有則不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The color of names: their marks, placeholders and cell (theme: Series1).
trans-unit.target: 姓名的顏色：用於其標記、預留位置與類型格（主題：Series1）。

trans-unit.source: Names the built-in detector always flags, on top of introductions like "I'm", "this is" and "my name is". Pass the signed-in person's name and their contacts. Null uses the `Simulation`'s names, or none.
trans-unit.target: 內建偵測器一律標出的姓名，此外還會辨識「I'm」、「this is」與「my name is」之類的自我介紹。傳入已登入使用者的姓名及其聯絡人。為 null 時使用 `Simulation` 的姓名，沒有則不標。

trans-unit.source: Where the card is in its flow (read only).
trans-unit.target: 卡片位於流程中的哪個階段（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Raised on every phase change. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 每次階段變化時觸發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The color of phone numbers (theme: Series3).
trans-unit.target: 電話號碼的顏色（主題：Series3）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once the message is redacted, with the safe prompt and every entity. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 訊息遮蔽完成時觸發，附帶安全提示詞與每個實體。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The restored reply once it is back, otherwise null (read only).
trans-unit.target: 回覆傳回後為還原後的回覆，否則為 null（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the reply is restored, with the model's raw reply and the text the person sees. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 回覆還原後觸發，附帶模型的原始回覆與使用者看到的文字。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The safe prompt once the message is redacted, otherwise null (read only).
trans-unit.target: 訊息遮蔽後為安全提示詞，否則為 null（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Sends the safe prompt to your model and returns its reply, placeholders included; the card restores them. Without it the reply is simulated (the `Simulation`'s reply, or a short stand-in) and the card says so. A thrown exception shows its message with Retry.
trans-unit.target: 把安全提示詞傳給你的模型並傳回其回覆（含預留位置）；卡片會將它們還原。沒有它時回覆是模擬的（`Simulation` 的回覆，或一則簡短的替身回覆），卡片會註明。擲出的例外會顯示其訊息並提供 Retry。

trans-unit.source: Shows the original message instead of the safe prompt once it is redacted (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 訊息遮蔽後顯示原始訊息而非安全提示詞（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: A conversation to play: its message (while the card has no `Message`), the names to flag, the model and its written reply. Your own values win over the simulation's; null stops it and shows the empty field.
trans-unit.target: 要播放的對話：它的訊息（卡片沒有 `Message` 時）、要標記的姓名、模型以及寫好的回覆。你自己的值優先於模擬的值；為 null 時停止播放並顯示空的訊息框。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `PiiRedaction` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the whole object to translate or reword; sentences with a number or a name are functions so the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `PiiRedaction` 顯示或朗讀的每個詞語，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可翻譯或改寫；含數字或名稱的句子是函式，以便調整語序。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `PhaseChanged`: the phase the card left and the one it entered.
trans-unit.target: `PhaseChanged` 的參數：卡片離開的階段與進入的階段。

trans-unit.source: A conversation a `PiiRedaction` plays without a model, from data you give it: the message, the names the built-in detector should always flag, the model the safe prompt goes to and the model's reply with its placeholders. Set it as `Simulation`: while the card has no `Message` it shows this message and, unless `AutoPlay` is false, plays scan, send and restore on a loop. Without a `Sender` the reply is simulated and the card says so; nothing is sent.
trans-unit.target: `PiiRedaction` 在沒有模型時依你提供的資料播放的對話：訊息、內建偵測器應一律標出的姓名、安全提示詞送往的模型，以及附預留位置的模型回覆。把它設為 `Simulation`：卡片沒有 `Message` 時會顯示這則訊息，並且除非 `AutoPlay` 為 false，會循環播放掃描、傳送和還原。沒有 `Sender` 時回覆是模擬的，卡片會註明；不會傳送任何內容。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ReplyRestored`: the model's reply and the text the person sees.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyRestored` 的參數：模型的回覆以及使用者看到的文字。

trans-unit.source: Build a pivot table by hand: drag fields from the field list into Rows, Columns and Values (or move them with the keyboard from each chip's menu), reorder chips within a zone, pick each value's aggregation, and the table below regroups at once, with a total for every row, every column and the whole. With no records the block pivots built-in invented sales. Give it `ItemsSource` and `Fields` (each field reads one value from a record) to pivot your own; `RowFields`, `ColumnFields` and `ValueFields` hold the layout and change as the person drags.
trans-unit.target: 手動搭建透視表：把欄位從欄位清單拖到 Rows、Columns 和 Values 中（或用每個欄位按鈕選單中的鍵盤操作移動），在一個區域內調整順序，為每個值選擇彙總方式，下方的表格立即重新分組，並帶有每一行、每一列和全部資料的合計。 沒有記錄時，區塊對內置的虛構銷售資料做透視。提供 `ItemsSource` 和 `Fields`（每個欄位從一條記錄中讀出一個值）即可透視你自己的資料；`RowFields`、`ColumnFields` 和 `ValueFields` 保存布局，並隨使用者拖曳而改變。

trans-unit.source: Draws a bordered card (true); false lays the block flat on the page.
trans-unit.target: 繪制帶邊框的卡片（true）；false 時區塊平鋪在頁面上。

trans-unit.source: The records to pivot; null (with no `Fields`) pivots the sample sales.
trans-unit.target: 要透視的記錄；為 null（且沒有 `Fields`）時透視示例銷售資料。

trans-unit.source: The words the block shows and reads out.
trans-unit.target: 區塊顯示和讀出的文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a field moved to another zone or place, or a value's aggregation changed, by the person or by code.
trans-unit.target: 欄位移到另一個區域或位置、或某個值的彙總方式改變時引發，無論是使用者還是程式碼所為。

trans-unit.source: The pivot as computed for the current layout.
trans-unit.target: 按目前布局算出的透視結果。

trans-unit.source: Whether the table shows a total column and a total row.
trans-unit.target: 表格是否顯示合計列和合計行。

trans-unit.source: How the values of a field are combined in a pivot cell.
trans-unit.target: 一個欄位的值在透視單元格中如何彙總。

trans-unit.source: A field of the records: a key, a title and how to read it from a record.
trans-unit.target: 記錄的一個欄位：鍵、標題，以及如何從一條記錄中讀出它。

trans-unit.source: A field placed in the values zone with its aggregation.
trans-unit.target: 放在值區域中的一個欄位及其彙總方式。

trans-unit.source: Where a field sits in the pivot layout.
trans-unit.target: 欄位在透視布局中所處的位置。

trans-unit.source: A pixel-art robot on a 24 × 24 grid that shows what an assistant is doing (Arc Pixel mascot, design reference). It idles, thinks, types, celebrates and errors in frame-stepped sprite animations on a fixed 40ms clock, and status changes morph from the current pose one pixel at a time. Every sprite pixel is `Scale` device-independent pixels, snapped to whole device pixels, so it stays crisp at every size from 24px to 192px. Set `Status` from your request lifecycle, or leave it null to play the built-in loop through every state. The palette follows the theme neutrals and `AccentBrush` (the theme's accent by default).
trans-unit.target: 一個畫在 24 × 24 網格上的像素機器人，呈現助理正在做什麼（Arc Pixel mascot，設計參考）。它以固定 40ms 時脈上的逐格精靈動畫待機、思考、打字、慶祝和出錯，狀態切換時從目前姿勢一次一個像素地變形過去。每個精靈像素佔 `Scale` 個裝置無關像素，並對齊到整數裝置像素，因此在 24px 到 192px 的每個尺寸下都保持清晰。依請求生命週期設定 `Status`，或留空以循環播放內建的全部狀態。調色盤跟隨主題中性色和 `AccentBrush`（預設為主題強調色）。

trans-unit.source: The accent of the antenna, chest light, typed bar, sparkles and the eyes' glow; the theme's accent by default.
trans-unit.target: 天線、胸燈、打字進度列、閃光和眼睛光暈使用的強調色；預設為主題強調色。

trans-unit.source: Announces status changes politely to assistive technology. Null (the default) announces when `Status` is set and stays quiet for the built-in loop. Turn it off when nearby text already announces progress.
trans-unit.target: 以禮貌方式向輔助科技播報狀態變化。為 null（預設）時，設定了 `Status` 就播報，內建循環則保持安靜。附近文字已播報進度時請關閉。

trans-unit.source: Who the mascot stands for, used in the accessible label ("Assistant is thinking").
trans-unit.target: 吉祥物代表的助理名稱，用於無障礙標籤（"Assistant is thinking"）。

trans-unit.source: Freezes the animation on the current frame. The mascot also pauses by itself while off screen.
trans-unit.target: 把動畫凍結在目前這一格。離開螢幕時吉祥物也會自動暫停。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the generated accessible label.
trans-unit.target: 取代自動產生的無障礙標籤。

trans-unit.source: Every word the mascot says.
trans-unit.target: 吉祥物說出的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: Pixel scale from 1 to 8: each sprite pixel is this many device-independent pixels, so 1 renders 24px, 2 renders 48px, 4 renders 96px and 8 renders 192px. Other values clamp.
trans-unit.target: 像素縮放，1 到 8：每個精靈像素佔這麼多個裝置無關像素，所以 1 算繪為 24px，2 為 48px，4 為 96px，8 為 192px。其他值會被限制在範圍內。

trans-unit.source: The status the mascot shows: `Status`, or the built-in loop's current step when it is null.
trans-unit.target: 吉祥物正在顯示的狀態：`Status`，為 null 時則是內建循環的目前這一步。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `ShownStatus` changes, with the old and new status. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: `ShownStatus` 變化時觸發，帶有舊狀態和新狀態。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: What the assistant is doing. Leave it null to play the built-in loop through every state.
trans-unit.target: 助理正在做什麼。留空則循環播放內建的全部狀態。

trans-unit.source: Every word `PixelMascot` says, in English by default: the accessible label for each status, where `{0}` is the assistant's name. Replace the whole object to localize or reword.
trans-unit.target: `PixelMascot` 說出的所有文字，預設為英文：每種狀態的無障礙標籤，其中 `{0}` 是助理名稱。取代整個物件即可在地化或改寫措辭。

trans-unit.source: The built-in status loop of `PixelMascot` (idle, thinking, writing, done, idle, thinking, error) as a shared clock. A mascot without a `Status` plays this loop on its own; put one `PixelMascotLoop` in resources and bind several mascots' `Status` to its `Status` to keep them in step. It switches only at step boundaries (one timer tick every few seconds), never per frame.
trans-unit.target: `PixelMascot` 的內建狀態循環（待機、思考、撰寫、完成、待機、思考、出錯），作為共用時脈。沒有 `Status` 的吉祥物會自己播放這個循環；在資源中放一個 `PixelMascotLoop`，把多個吉祥物的 `Status` 繫結到它的 `Status`，即可讓它們步調一致。它只在步與步的邊界切換（每隔幾秒一次計時器觸發），從不逐格執行。

trans-unit.source: Whether the loop moves on. False holds the current status.
trans-unit.target: 循環是否繼續推進。為 false 時停在目前狀態。

trans-unit.source: The status the loop is on.
trans-unit.target: 循環目前所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ShownStatusChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `ShownStatusChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: A side-by-side plan comparison: a heading with a monthly / yearly switch, a feature count with a "Show differences only" filter, one column per plan with its price and a select button, and a feature matrix. Switching the billing period counts every price to the new amount; selecting a plan tints its column and slides a rail under it; the filter collapses the rows every plan shares. Without plans and features it shows Arc's sample offering (`PlanComparisonSamples`).
trans-unit.target: 並排的方案比較：附月付 / 年付切換的標題、附「Show differences only」篩選的功能計數、每個方案一欄（含價格與選取按鈕），以及功能矩陣。切換計費週期時每個價格都會計數到新金額；選取方案會為該欄著色並在下方滑入一條導軌；篩選會收合所有方案共有的列。沒有方案和功能時顯示 Arc 的範例方案（`PlanComparisonSamples`）。

trans-unit.source: The billing period the prices are shown for. Two-way: the billing switch edits it.
trans-unit.target: 價格所對應的計費週期。雙向：計費切換會修改它。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Billing` changes, by the billing switch or by the app.
trans-unit.target: `Billing` 變更時引發，無論來自計費切換還是應用程式。

trans-unit.source: Clears the selection.
trans-unit.target: 清除選取。

trans-unit.source: ISO 4217 code of the prices ("USD" by default).
trans-unit.target: 價格的 ISO 4217 代碼（預設 "USD"）。

trans-unit.source: The feature rows, in display order, each with one value per plan. Empty (and no `FeaturesSource`) shows the sample features.
trans-unit.target: 功能列，依顯示順序排列，每列為每個方案提供一個值。為空（且沒有 `FeaturesSource`）時顯示範例功能。

trans-unit.source: A list of features that replaces `Features` when set; a list that raises collection changes is followed.
trans-unit.target: 設定後取代 `Features` 的功能清單；會跟隨引發集合變更的清單。

trans-unit.source: Whether the monthly / yearly switch and its note show (true by default).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示月付 / 年付切換及其說明（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether only the features the plans do not share are listed. Two-way: the filter switch edits it.
trans-unit.target: 是否只列出各方案不共有的功能。雙向：篩選開關會修改它。

trans-unit.source: Whether the footnote under the matrix shows (true by default).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示矩陣下方的註腳（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the block draws its own card (border, corner radius, surface and the lines between its sections, at most 1060 wide). Turn it off to set the block flush into a page section, as Arc's preview does.
trans-unit.target: 區塊是否繪製自己的卡片（框線、圓角、表面以及各部分之間的分隔線，最寬 1060）。關閉後區塊平鋪在頁面區段中，與 Arc 的預覽相同。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text and its culture; replace the object to localize the block.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字及其文化特性設定；替換整個物件即可在地化此區塊。

trans-unit.source: The plans, one column each, in display order. Empty (and no `PlansSource`) shows the sample plans.
trans-unit.target: 方案清單，每個一欄，依顯示順序排列。為空（且沒有 `PlansSource`）時顯示範例方案。

trans-unit.source: A list of plans that replaces `Plans` when set; a list that raises collection changes is followed.
trans-unit.target: 設定後取代 `Plans` 的方案清單；會跟隨引發集合變更的清單。

trans-unit.source: Back to the first look: monthly prices, every feature listed, nothing selected.
trans-unit.target: 回到初始狀態：月付價格、列出全部功能、未選取任何方案。

trans-unit.source: Selects `plan` (null clears the selection), as if its button were pressed, without the command.
trans-unit.target: 選取 `plan`（null 清除選取），如同按下其按鈕，但不執行命令。

trans-unit.source: Invoked when someone presses a select button, with the plan selected now (null when it was cleared).
trans-unit.target: 有人按下選取按鈕時呼叫，參數為目前選取的方案（清除選取時為 null）。

trans-unit.source: The chosen plan, or null. Two-way: the select buttons edit it (pressing the chosen plan's button clears it).
trans-unit.target: 選取的方案，或 null。雙向：選取按鈕會修改它（再次按下已選方案的按鈕會清除選取）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SelectedPlan` changes, by a select button or by the app.
trans-unit.target: `SelectedPlan` 變更時引發，無論來自選取按鈕還是應用程式。

trans-unit.source: How many features are listed now.
trans-unit.target: 目前列出的功能數量。

trans-unit.source: The billing period a `PlanComparison` prices its plans for.
trans-unit.target: `PlanComparison` 為其方案定價所用的計費週期。

trans-unit.source: Billed month to month (`PlanComparisonPlan.MonthlyPrice`).
trans-unit.target: 按月計費（`PlanComparisonPlan.MonthlyPrice`）。

trans-unit.source: Billed once a year (`PlanComparisonPlan.YearlyPrice`, shown per month).
trans-unit.target: 按年計費一次（`PlanComparisonPlan.YearlyPrice`，按月顯示）。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `BillingChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `BillingChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: The billing period now shown.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的計費週期。

trans-unit.source: The billing period before the change.
trans-unit.target: 變更前的計費週期。

trans-unit.source: One row of a `PlanComparison`'s feature matrix: the feature's name and what each plan offers, in the order of the block's plans. A value equal to `Included` shows a check, one equal to `NotIncluded` is muted. Rows that every plan shares (`IsShared`) are hidden by "Show differences only".
trans-unit.target: `PlanComparison` 功能矩陣的一列：功能名稱以及各方案提供的內容，依區塊方案的順序排列。等於 `Included` 的值顯示勾選標記，等於 `NotIncluded` 的值以淡化顏色顯示。所有方案共有的列（`IsShared`）會被「Show differences only」隱藏。

trans-unit.source: True when every plan offers the same, so the row hides while only differences are shown.
trans-unit.target: 所有方案提供相同內容時為 true，此時只顯示差異時該列會隱藏。

trans-unit.source: The feature's name, such as "Version history"; the row header.
trans-unit.target: 功能名稱，例如 "Version history"；用作列表頭。

trans-unit.source: The value for the plan at `index`, or an empty string when there is none.
trans-unit.target: 索引為 `index` 的方案對應的值；沒有時為空字串。

trans-unit.source: What each plan offers, in the order of the block's plans; a missing value shows as empty.
trans-unit.target: 各方案提供的內容，依區塊方案的順序排列；缺少的值顯示為空。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text of `PlanComparison`. Replace the whole object to localize the block; sentences with a number or a plan name are functions. Prices and counts use `Culture`.
trans-unit.target: `PlanComparison` 的內建文字。替換整個物件即可在地化此區塊；含數字或方案名稱的句子是函式。價格與計數使用 `Culture`。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the billing switch: "Billing period".
trans-unit.target: 計費切換的無障礙名稱："Billing period"。

trans-unit.source: The heading of the filter bar: "Compare plans".
trans-unit.target: 篩選列的標題："Compare plans"。

trans-unit.source: Culture for prices and counts (default en-US).
trans-unit.target: 價格與計數使用的文化特性（預設 en-US）。

trans-unit.source: The sentence under the heading.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的說明句。

trans-unit.source: The label of the filter switch: "Show differences only".
trans-unit.target: 篩選開關的標籤："Show differences only"。

trans-unit.source: The count beside it: (shown, total) ⇒ "6 of 8 features".
trans-unit.target: 旁邊的計數：(shown, total) ⇒ "6 of 8 features"。

trans-unit.source: The header over the feature names: "What changes".
trans-unit.target: 功能名稱上方的表頭："What changes"。

trans-unit.source: The footnote: "Prices in USD per seat. Yearly plans are billed annually.".

trans-unit.source: A small surface anchored to a trigger and opened by a click, for interactive content that should not block the page: share settings, a small filter form, a picker built from your own controls. Two ways to use it: Code can open any content anchored to any control with `ShowAt`. The panel starts 5px toward its trigger at scale 0.97, fades in fast and settles on a spring from the side it actually landed on; it leaves in about 160ms at half the travel, and an open and a close reverse each other mid-flight. Escape and a press outside close it and return focus to the trigger; focus moves into the panel on open. The trigger answers presses with color only (no press scale), since the panel is measured against it.
trans-unit.target: 一個錨定在觸發器上、由點擊開啟的小型浮層，適用於不應阻擋頁面的互動內容：分享設定、小型篩選表單、由您自己的控制項組成的選取器。有兩種用法：程式碼可透過 `ShowAt` 將任意內容錨定到任意控制項上開啟。面板從觸發器方向偏移 5px 開始，縮放比例為 0.97，快速淡入並以彈簧從實際落位的一側穩定下來；關閉時約 160ms 內完成，移動距離為一半，且開啟與關閉在過程中可相互反轉。按下 Escape 或在外部按下會關閉面板，並將焦點返回觸發器；開啟時焦點會移入面板。觸發器僅以顏色回應按下（無按壓縮放），因為面板是相對於它量測的。

trans-unit.source: Alignment along the trigger edge (default Start).
trans-unit.target: 沿觸發器邊緣的對齊方式（預設 Start）。

trans-unit.source: Attaches a popover to any control: a click on the control toggles it.

trans-unit.target: 開啟狀態（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Who is looking at this page right now: the avatars of the current viewers, overlapping, each in a ring of their own color, the most recent first, with a "+N" chip for the rest and a rolling "N viewing" count. It follows a live list: a newcomer grows in at the front and sends out one ring while the others slide over, someone pushed past `MaxVisibleCount` slides into the chip, someone who leaves shrinks away and the gap closes. Idle viewers fade. The chip opens the full list. Joins and leaves are announced politely to screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 顯示此刻誰正在檢視這個頁面：目前檢視者的頭像相互重疊，各自帶有自己顏色的圓環，最近加入的在前，其餘的人收進一個 "+N" 小標籤，並有一個滾動的 "N viewing" 計數。它跟隨一個即時清單：新來的人在最前面放大出現並發出一道圓環，其他人隨之滑開；被擠出 `MaxVisibleCount` 的人滑入小標籤；離開的人縮小消失，空位隨之合攏。閒置的檢視者會變淡。小標籤可開啟完整清單。加入和離開會以禮貌方式通知螢幕閱讀器。

trans-unit.source: Says "Name joined" and "Name left" through a polite live region (default true).

trans-unit.source: A seat-priced plan picker: a seat slider with step buttons and a billing switch above the plan cards, and a totals row with the selected plan's price, the yearly savings and a trial button. Every number rolls digit by digit as the seats or the billing change; the recommended badge glides to the plan that fits the team, and the selection frame follows the plan in use. A plan the user picks stays selected while it covers the seats; above its cap the selection falls back to the recommendation and the capped card offers to go back to its seat limit. All plans, stops, prices and rules are data: `Plans`, `SeatStops`, the plans' volume tiers, caps and thresholds.
trans-unit.target: 依席位計價的方案選擇器：方案卡片上方是帶步進按鈕的席位滑桿和計費切換，下方是合計列，顯示所選方案的價格、年繳節省金額和試用按鈕。席位或計費變更時，每個數字都會逐位滾動；推薦徽章會滑動到最適合團隊的方案，選取框跟隨目前使用的方案。使用者選擇的方案只要能涵蓋席位就保持選取；席位超過其上限時，選取會退回推薦方案，且超限的卡片會提供返回其席位上限的選項。所有方案、檔位、價格和規則都是資料：`Plans`、`SeatStops`、方案的大量折扣層級、上限和門檻。

trans-unit.source: The plans, in display order (three is the design target; two to four fit). Plans written inline in XAML land here.
trans-unit.target: 依顯示順序排列的方案（設計目標為三個，兩到四個皆可）。直接在 XAML 中內嵌撰寫的方案會歸入此屬性。

trans-unit.source: Optional: chooses the recommended plan for a seat count from the plans; null uses each plan's `RecommendFromSeats` (the largest threshold reached wins).
trans-unit.target: 可選：依席位數從方案中選出推薦方案；為 null 時使用各方案的 `RecommendFromSeats`（達到的最大門檻生效）。

trans-unit.source: The plan recommended for the current seats.
trans-unit.target: 目前席位數下推薦的方案。

trans-unit.source: What yearly billing saves on the selected plan in a year.

trans-unit.source: The built-in text of `PricingCalculator`. Replace the whole object to localize the block; entries with numbers are functions that receive the already formatted amounts and counts. Formats with a `{0}` keep the amount rolling in place, so they are format strings instead of functions. Amounts and counts use `Culture`.
trans-unit.target: `PricingCalculator` 的內建文字。取代整個物件即可在地化此區塊；帶數字的項目是接收已格式化金額與數量的函式。帶 `{0}` 的格式會讓金額原位滾動，因此它們是格式字串而非函式。金額與數量使用 `Culture`。

trans-unit.source: One plan of a `PricingCalculator`: its name and line, monthly and yearly seat prices, an optional seat cap, volume tiers, the seat count from which it is recommended, and its feature lines. Changes show at once.
trans-unit.target: `PricingCalculator` 的一個方案：包括名稱與說明列、按月與按年的席位單價、可選的席位上限、大量折扣層級、開始推薦的席位數，以及功能列。變更會立即生效。

trans-unit.source: Price of one seat for one month with yearly billing; null: the monthly price less `YearlyDiscount`.
