trans-unit.source: Arguments of `PlanPicked`.
trans-unit.target: `PlanPicked` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SeatsChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `SeatsChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: What a trial request carries: the plan, the seats, the billing period and the total shown.
trans-unit.target: 試用請求所包含的內容：方案、席位數、計費週期以及所顯示的合計。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `TrialStarted`.
trans-unit.target: `TrialStarted` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: A price cut per seat that applies from a number of seats on (the largest tier reached wins).
trans-unit.target: 每個席位的降價，從某個席位數起生效（以達到的最大層級為準）。

trans-unit.source: A prize wheel: slices with their own odds, a spin that draws a winner by those odds and slows to a stop on it, pegs that flick the pointer as they pass, and the winning slice lit once the wheel rests.
trans-unit.target: 抽獎轉盤：每塊扇區有自己的機率，轉動時依機率抽出中獎項並減速停在它上面，經過的釘子會撥動指標，轉盤停下後中獎扇區亮起。

trans-unit.source: How long a spin takes from the first push to the stop.
trans-unit.target: 一次轉動從開始到停下所用的時間。

trans-unit.source: Whether a person can spin the wheel by clicking, tapping or pressing Enter or Space (true).
trans-unit.target: 是否允許使用者透過點擊、輕點或按 Enter、Space 轉動轉盤（true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the wheel is turning.
trans-unit.target: 轉盤是否正在轉動。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the wheel.
trans-unit.target: 轉盤的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The slice the wheel last stopped on; null before the first spin ends.
trans-unit.target: 轉盤上次停下時所在的扇區；第一次轉動結束前為 null。

trans-unit.source: The index of the slice the wheel last stopped on; -1 before the first spin ends.
trans-unit.target: 轉盤上次停下時所在扇區的索引；第一次轉動結束前為 -1。

trans-unit.source: Whether slices are as wide as their odds (true) or all the same width.
trans-unit.target: 扇區寬度是否與其機率成比例（true），否則所有扇區一樣寬。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the wheel comes to rest, with the winning slice.
trans-unit.target: 轉盤停下時觸發，並帶有中獎扇區。

trans-unit.source: The word in the hub, which spins the wheel.
trans-unit.target: 中心圓上的文字，點擊它會轉動轉盤。

trans-unit.source: Raised each time a peg flicks the pointer, for a click sound or a haptic tick.
trans-unit.target: 每次釘子撥動指標時觸發，可用於播放點擊聲或觸覺回饋。

trans-unit.source: The least number of full turns a spin makes before it settles on the winner.
trans-unit.target: 轉動在停到中獎項之前至少轉過的整圈數。

trans-unit.source: The slice a `PrizeWheel` stopped on.
trans-unit.target: `PrizeWheel` 停下時所在的扇區。

trans-unit.source: One slice of a `PrizeWheel`: its prize and its odds.
trans-unit.target: `PrizeWheel` 的一塊扇區：它的獎品和機率。

trans-unit.source: A fill of the slice's own; by default slices alternate between the wheel's two surfaces.
trans-unit.target: 扇區自己的填充；預設情況下扇區在轉盤的兩種表面色之間交替。

trans-unit.source: The label color on a slice with its own `Fill`; the wheel's text color by default.
trans-unit.target: 設定了 `Fill` 的扇區上的文字顏色；預設為轉盤的文字顏色。

trans-unit.source: The prize, written on the slice. Keep it short: a word or two.
trans-unit.target: 寫在扇區上的獎品。要簡短：一兩個詞。

trans-unit.source: The slice's odds relative to the others (1 by default; 0 never wins).
trans-unit.target: 扇區相對於其他扇區的機率（預設 1；0 永遠不會中）。

trans-unit.source: A color a `ProductDetail` product comes in, with its own pictures.
trans-unit.target: `ProductDetail` 商品的一種顏色，帶有自己的圖片。

trans-unit.source: A product page: the pictures of the chosen color with thumbnails, the brand, name, rating and price, color swatches, size buttons (sold-out sizes are struck through and low stock is called out), a quantity, Add to cart and Save, and the details and the reviews behind a switch. Add to cart waits for a size when the product has sizes.
trans-unit.target: 商品頁：所選顏色的圖片和縮略圖，品牌、名稱、評分和價格，顏色樣本，尺碼按鈕（售完的尺碼加刪除線，庫存不多時會提示），數量，加入購物車和收藏，以及通過切換顯示的詳情和評價。商品有尺碼時，加入購物車需要先選擇尺碼。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Add to cart adds the product.
trans-unit.target: 加入購物車成功時引發。

trans-unit.source: The maker, shown small over the name.
trans-unit.target: 品牌，以小字顯示在名稱上方。

trans-unit.source: The price before a reduction, struck through; null when not reduced.
trans-unit.target: 降價前的價格，加刪除線顯示；未降價時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The symbol written before prices ("$").
trans-unit.target: 價格前面的貨幣符號（"$"）。

trans-unit.source: The paragraph of the Details tab.
trans-unit.target: 詳情頁的一段說明。

trans-unit.source: The bullet points of the Details tab.
trans-unit.target: 詳情頁的要點列表。

trans-unit.source: Whether the product is saved to a wish list (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 商品是否已收藏（双向）。

trans-unit.source: The block's built-in text.
trans-unit.target: 區塊內置的文字。

trans-unit.source: The index of the picture shown, among the chosen color's pictures.
trans-unit.target: 所選顏色的圖片中正在顯示的那一張的索引。

trans-unit.source: The price.
trans-unit.target: 價格。

trans-unit.source: The product name.
trans-unit.target: 商品名稱。

trans-unit.source: How many to add (two-way); kept between 1 and the chosen size's stock (at most 10).
trans-unit.target: 要加入的數量（双向）；保持在 1 到所選尺碼的庫存之間（最多 10）。

trans-unit.source: The average rating out of 5; 0 hides it.
trans-unit.target: 平均評分，滿分 5；為 0 時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: How many reviews the rating is based on (may be more than `Reviews` lists).
trans-unit.target: 評分所依據的評價數量（可以多於 `Reviews` 列出的數量）。

trans-unit.source: The index of the chosen color in `Colors` (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 所選顏色在 `Colors` 中的索引（双向）。

trans-unit.source: The index of the chosen size in `Sizes`, or −1 before one is chosen (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 所選尺碼在 `Sizes` 中的索引，未選擇時為 −1（双向）。

trans-unit.source: The pictures of a product page: one large picture with a strip of thumbnails. Clicking a thumbnail, the arrow buttons or the arrow keys slide to another picture. With a mouse or pen over the picture it zooms in toward the pointer, so the texture of a fabric or the print on a label can be read without opening anything; on a touch screen the picture is swiped instead, following the finger and keeping its speed when let go.
trans-unit.target: 商品頁的圖片區：一張大圖加一排縮圖。點擊縮圖、箭頭按鈕或按方向鍵會滑到另一張圖片。滑鼠或筆移到圖片上時，會朝指標放大，不用打開任何東西就能看清布料的紋理或標籤上的小字；在觸控螢幕上則改為滑動圖片，圖片跟隨手指，放手時保留速度。

trans-unit.source: The stage's width divided by its height (default 1, a square).
trans-unit.target: 展示區的寬除以高（預設 1，正方形）。

trans-unit.source: How a picture is announced; {0} is its position and {1} the number of pictures (default "Image {0} of {1}").
trans-unit.target: 讀出圖片的方式；{0} 是它的位置，{1} 是圖片總數（預設 "Image {0} of {1}"）。

trans-unit.source: Whether a mouse or pen over the picture zooms into it (default true).
trans-unit.target: 滑鼠或筆移到圖片上時是否放大（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: True while the picture is zoomed in under the pointer.
trans-unit.target: 圖片在指標下放大時為 true。

trans-unit.source: The pictures written inline, used while `ItemsSource` is null.
trans-unit.target: 直接寫在 XAML 中的圖片，在 `ItemsSource` 為空時使用。

trans-unit.source: The pictures to show: `ProductGalleryImage`s, `ImageSource`s or addresses. Wins over `Items`; a collection that reports changes is followed.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的圖片：`ProductGalleryImage`、`ImageSource` 或地址。優先於 `Items`；會跟隨能報告變化的集合。

trans-unit.source: The gallery's accessible name, such as the product's name (default "Product images").
trans-unit.target: 圖片區的無障礙名稱，比如商品名稱（預設 "Product images"）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the next button (default "Next image").
trans-unit.target: 下一張按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設 "Next image"）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the previous button (default "Previous image").
trans-unit.target: 上一張按鈕的無障礙名稱（預設 "Previous image"）。

trans-unit.source: The picture on the stage, or null.
trans-unit.target: 展示區目前的圖片，沒有時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The index of the picture on the stage; -1 when there are none. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 展示區目前圖片的序號；沒有圖片時為 -1。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: How a picture fills the stage (default Uniform: the whole product, on the stage's muted ground).
trans-unit.target: 圖片如何填充展示區（預設 Uniform：在淺色底上顯示完整商品）。

trans-unit.source: Where the thumbnails go: under the picture (default) or down its left side.
trans-unit.target: 縮圖的位置：圖片下方（預設）或左側。

trans-unit.source: How much a mouse or pen over the picture enlarges it (default 2); 1 turns the hover zoom off.
trans-unit.target: 滑鼠或筆移到圖片上時放大的倍數（預設 2）；設為 1 會關閉懸停放大。

trans-unit.source: A product listing page: category chips, a price range, an in-stock switch and a sort, over a grid of product cards that fits as many columns as the block's width allows. Each card shows the picture, a tag, the name, the rating, the price (with the price before a reduction) and the colors, and has a quick add button; the header keeps the count of what was added. In a narrow block the filters fold behind a button.
trans-unit.target: 商品列表頁：分類標籤、價格區間、只看有貨開關和排序，下方是按區塊寬度放入盡可能多列的商品卡片網格。每張卡片顯示圖片、標籤、名稱、評分、價格（以及降價前的價格）和顏色，並有快速加入按鈕；頁頭記錄已加入的數量。在窄區塊中，篩選收進一個按鈕後面。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a quick add button is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下快速加入按鈕時引發。

trans-unit.source: How many items were added with the quick add buttons (two-way, so the app can reset it).
trans-unit.target: 用快速加入按鈕加入的數量（双向，應用可以重置它）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the cart button is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下購物車按鈕時引發。

trans-unit.source: The symbol written before prices ("$").
trans-unit.target: 價格前面的貨幣符號（"$"）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sold-out products are hidden (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 是否隱藏已售完的商品（双向）。

trans-unit.source: The block's built-in text.
trans-unit.target: 區塊內置的文字。

trans-unit.source: Most columns the grid uses (4).
trans-unit.target: 網格最多使用的列數（4）。

trans-unit.source: The highest price shown (two-way); null ends at the most expensive product.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的最高價格（双向）；為 null 時到最貴的商品為止。

trans-unit.source: The lowest price shown (two-way); null starts at the cheapest product.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的最低價格（双向）；為 null 時從最便宜的商品開始。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a card is pressed (to open the product).
trans-unit.target: 按下卡片時引發（用於打開商品）。

trans-unit.source: The products, when bound; otherwise `Products` is used.
trans-unit.target: 綁定時使用的商品；未設定時使用 `Products`。

trans-unit.source: The categories shown; empty shows every category.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的分類；為空時顯示所有分類。

trans-unit.source: How the grid is ordered (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 網格的排序方式（双向）。

trans-unit.source: The heading over the grid.
trans-unit.target: 網格上方的標題。

trans-unit.source: The products that pass the filters, in the sort order.
trans-unit.target: 通過篩選的商品，按排序方式排列。

trans-unit.source: A customer review of a `ProductDetail` product.
trans-unit.target: 對 `ProductDetail` 商品的一條顾客評價。

trans-unit.source: A size a `ProductDetail` product comes in.
trans-unit.target: `ProductDetail` 商品的一種尺碼。

trans-unit.source: One row of the Activity tab: "{first name} {Action} {Target}", an optional `Detail` line and a time. Rows are grouped under `Group` headings in the order the groups first appear.
trans-unit.target: 「動態」分頁中的一列：「{first name} {Action} {Target}」，外加選用的 `Detail` 行和一個時間。各列依 `Group` 標題分組，分組順序為各組首次出現的順序。

trans-unit.source: The verb after the name, for example "shipped" or "commented on".
trans-unit.target: 姓名之後的動詞，例如「shipped」或「commented on」。

trans-unit.source: An optional second line, for example a quote from the comment.
trans-unit.target: 選用的第二行，例如留言的引文。

trans-unit.source: The heading this row is listed under, for example "This week".
trans-unit.target: 該列所列入的標題，例如「This week」。

trans-unit.source: What happened; picks the icon.
trans-unit.target: 發生了什麼；決定圖示。

trans-unit.source: What it happened to, shown in the strong color, for example "Color tokens v3".
trans-unit.target: 事情發生的對象，以強調色顯示，例如「Color tokens v3」。

trans-unit.source: When, as shown at the end of the row, for example "3h" or "Aug 30".
trans-unit.target: 時間，顯示在列末，例如「3h」或「Aug 30」。

trans-unit.source: A person working on a `ProfileProject`, drawn as a small overlapping face.
trans-unit.target: 參與某個 `ProfileProject` 的人，繪製成一張重疊的小頭像。

trans-unit.source: The portrait (optional).
trans-unit.target: 頭像照片（選用）。

trans-unit.source: The person's name (initials without a portrait, and the accessible name).
trans-unit.target: 此人的姓名（無照片時顯示首字母，也是無障礙名稱）。

trans-unit.source: The person a `ProfilePage` shows: name, handle, headline, location, website, bio, pictures and when they joined. The page replaces the whole object after a successful save (see `Profile`).
trans-unit.target: `ProfilePage` 顯示的人：姓名、使用者名稱、簡介標語、所在地、網站、個人簡介、圖片和加入時間。儲存成功後，頁面會替換整個物件（見 `Profile`）。

trans-unit.source: The portrait; without one the avatar shows the initials of `Name`.
trans-unit.target: 頭像照片；沒有時頭像顯示 `Name` 的首字母。

trans-unit.source: A few sentences about the person (the edit sheet caps it at `BioMaxLength`).
trans-unit.target: 關於此人的幾句話（編輯面板將其限制在 `BioMaxLength` 以內）。

trans-unit.source: The wide picture at the top; drawn over `CoverBrush`.
trans-unit.target: 頂部的寬幅圖片；繪製在 `CoverBrush` 之上。

trans-unit.source: A fill for the cover area, under `Cover` (default: the muted surface).
trans-unit.target: 封面區域的填滿，位於 `Cover` 之下（預設：柔和色表面）。

trans-unit.source: The handle without the "@", for example "rowan".
trans-unit.target: 不含「@」的使用者名稱，例如「rowan」。

trans-unit.source: A short line about the person's role, shown after the handle.
trans-unit.target: 關於此人職責的一句簡短說明，顯示在使用者名稱之後。

trans-unit.source: When the person joined, as shown after "Joined", for example "June 2020"; hidden while empty.
trans-unit.target: 此人的加入時間，顯示在「Joined」之後，例如「June 2020」；為空時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Where the person is; the line is hidden while it is empty.
trans-unit.target: 此人所在的地方；為空時隱藏該行。

trans-unit.source: The display name, for example "Rowan Ellery". The activity rows use its first word.
trans-unit.target: 顯示名稱，例如「Rowan Ellery」。動態列使用它的第一個詞。

trans-unit.source: A website without or with its scheme, for example "rowanellery.studio"; hidden while empty.
trans-unit.target: 網站，可含或不含通訊協定，例如「rowanellery.studio」；為空時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: A person's profile page as one block: a wide cover with the avatar riding its bottom edge, the name, handle and headline, Share and Edit profile; an about column (bio, location, website, joined date and up to three stats) beside two tabs, Activity (grouped rows) and Projects (cards with stars). Edit profile slides a sheet in from the right inside the block; saving writes the new values back and makes each changed field glow once. The block is `PageHeight` tall (760, or less when less space is available) and scrolls inside; the sheet always covers the visible part. Its layout follows its own width: the cover shrinks below 1000, the columns stack below 760, the header tightens below 640, the cards go to one column below 560 and the sheet's paired fields stack below 420.
trans-unit.target: 作為一個整體的個人檔案頁：寬幅封面，頭像騎在封面底邊上，其下是姓名、使用者名稱和簡介標語，以及 Share 和 Edit profile；一個簡介欄（個人簡介、所在地、網站、加入日期和最多三項統計）位於兩個分頁旁，即 Activity（分組的列）和 Projects（帶星號的卡片）。Edit profile 會在該區塊內從右側滑入一個編輯面板；儲存會寫回新值，並讓每個變更過的欄位閃亮一次。該區塊高 `PageHeight`（760，可用空間更少時則更小），並在內部捲動；編輯面板始終覆蓋可見部分。其版面配置跟隨自身寬度：低於 1000 時封面縮小，低於 760 時各欄堆疊，低於 640 時標頭收緊，低於 560 時卡片變為單欄，低於 420 時編輯面板中成對的欄位堆疊。

trans-unit.source: The Activity rows, when no `ActivitySource` is set.
trans-unit.target: Activity 列，在未設定 `ActivitySource` 時使用。

trans-unit.source: A collection of `ProfileActivity` you own; wins over `Activity`.
trans-unit.target: 由你持有的 `ProfileActivity` 集合；優先於 `Activity`。

trans-unit.source: The most characters the bio field takes (default 200); the counter shows what is left.
trans-unit.target: 個人簡介欄位最多接受的字元數（預設 200）；計數器顯示剩餘數量。

trans-unit.source: Copies the link (returns whether it worked; throwing counts as a failure). Null uses the system clipboard.
trans-unit.target: 複製連結（傳回是否成功；擲回例外視為失敗）。為 null 時使用系統剪貼簿。

trans-unit.source: Whether Edit profile is offered (default true). False makes the page read-only, as for someone else's profile.
trans-unit.target: 是否提供 Edit profile（預設 true）。為 False 時頁面為唯讀，例如檢視他人的個人檔案。

trans-unit.source: Whether the edit sheet is open (two-way). Setting it opens or closes the sheet.
trans-unit.target: 編輯面板是否已開啟（雙向）。設定它會開啟或關閉該面板。

trans-unit.source: Whether the block has a 1px border and rounded corners (default true); false for a full-window page.
trans-unit.target: 該區塊是否帶有 1px 邊框和圓角（預設 true）；全視窗頁面時為 false。

trans-unit.source: Whether a save is running.
trans-unit.target: 是否正在儲存。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or announces. Replace the whole object to translate it.
trans-unit.target: 該區塊顯示或播報的每一個字詞。替換整個物件即可翻譯它。

trans-unit.source: The block's height when there is room (default 760); with less space it takes what it gets and scrolls inside.
trans-unit.target: 有空間時該區塊的高度（預設 760）；空間更少時它取得多少就用多少，並在內部捲動。

trans-unit.source: The person shown. A successful save replaces it with a new object holding the trimmed values.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的人。儲存成功後，會用一個包含已去除前後空白的值的新物件替換它。

trans-unit.source: The link Share copies; null copies "https://example.com/@{handle}".
trans-unit.target: Share 複製的連結；為 null 時複製「https://example.com/@{handle}」。

trans-unit.source: The project cards, when no `ProjectsSource` is set.
trans-unit.target: 專案卡片，在未設定 `ProjectsSource` 時使用。

trans-unit.source: A collection of `ProfileProject` you own; wins over `Projects`.
trans-unit.target: 你自行持有的 `ProfileProject` 集合；優先於 `Projects`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SaveHandler` threw.
trans-unit.target: 在 `SaveHandler` 擲回例外時引發。

trans-unit.source: Saves the edited profile (it receives the trimmed draft). Throw to keep the sheet open: the exception's message is shown above the sheet's buttons. Null simulates a save that succeeds after `SimulatedSaveDelay`.
trans-unit.target: 儲存編輯後的個人檔案（接收去除前後空白的草稿）。擲回例外可讓編輯面板保持開啟：例外的訊息會顯示在編輯面板按鈕的上方。為 null 時，會模擬一次在 `SimulatedSaveDelay` 之後成功的儲存。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a successful save, once `Profile` holds the new values.
trans-unit.target: 儲存成功後引發，此時 `Profile` 已包含新值。

trans-unit.source: How long Share shows Copied or Failed before it reads Share again (default 1800ms).
trans-unit.target: Share 顯示 Copied 或 Failed 多久之後才恢復為 Share（預設 1800ms）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after Share tried to copy the link.
trans-unit.target: 在 Share 嘗試複製連結後引發。

trans-unit.source: How long the simulated save takes when no `SaveHandler` is set (default 700ms).
trans-unit.target: 未設定 `SaveHandler` 時，模擬儲存所需的時間（預設 700ms）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a project's star is pressed, after its count and state were updated.
trans-unit.target: 在按下某個專案的星號、其數量與狀態更新之後引發。

trans-unit.source: The numbers under the bio, when no `StatsSource` is set (up to three are shown).
trans-unit.target: 未設定 `StatsSource` 時，顯示在簡介下方的數字（最多顯示三個）。

trans-unit.source: A collection of `ProfileStat` you own; wins over `Stats` and is followed when it notifies.
trans-unit.target: 你自行持有的 `ProfileStat` 集合；優先於 `Stats`，並會在其發出通知時跟著更新。

trans-unit.source: The tab shown (two-way; default Activity). Bind it to control the tabs from outside.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的索引標籤（雙向；預設 Activity）。繫結它即可從外部控制索引標籤。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Tab` changes (by a tab, the arrow keys or a binding).
trans-unit.target: 在 `Tab` 變更時引發（透過索引標籤、方向鍵或繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Every word `ProfilePage` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; formatted texts are functions so that word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `ProfilePage` 顯示或朗讀的每一個詞，預設為英文。替換該執行個體即可翻譯或改寫；帶格式的文字是函式，因此詞序可以調整。

trans-unit.source: A card of the Projects tab: a cover, the title and visibility, a description, collaborators, when it was updated and a star button. Starring writes `IsStarred` and `StarCount` back.
trans-unit.target: 專案索引標籤中的一張卡片：封面、標題與可見度、描述、協作者、更新時間與一個星號按鈕。按下星號會寫回 `IsStarred` 和 `StarCount`。

trans-unit.source: The people on it, drawn as overlapping faces.
trans-unit.target: 參與該專案的人，以相互重疊的頭像繪製。

trans-unit.source: The picture at the top of the card; drawn over `CoverBrush`.
trans-unit.target: 卡片頂部的圖片；繪製在 `CoverBrush` 之上。

trans-unit.source: A fill for the cover area, under `Cover` (default: the muted surface).
trans-unit.target: 封面區域的填滿，位於 `Cover` 之下（預設：柔和的表面色）。

trans-unit.source: One or two lines about it.
trans-unit.target: 關於該專案的一兩行說明。

trans-unit.source: A key you choose; reported by `StarChanged`.
trans-unit.target: 由你選定的索引鍵；由 `StarChanged` 回報。

trans-unit.source: Whether the viewer has starred it (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 檢視者是否已為其加上星號（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: How many stars it has (two-way: the star button adds or removes one).
trans-unit.target: 它獲得的星號數（雙向：星號按鈕會加一或減一）。

trans-unit.source: The project's name (one line, cut with an ellipsis).
trans-unit.target: 專案的名稱（單行，超出部分以省略號截斷）。

trans-unit.source: When it last changed, as shown, for example "Updated 3h ago".
trans-unit.target: 其最近一次變更的時間，依所顯示的文字，例如 "Updated 3h ago"。

trans-unit.source: Public or private; shown at the end of the title line.
trans-unit.target: 公開或私人；顯示在標題行的末尾。

trans-unit.source: One number under the bio, for example 3,107 followers. The page shows up to three.
trans-unit.target: 簡介下方的一個數字，例如 3,107 位追蹤者。頁面最多顯示三個。

trans-unit.source: A key you choose (optional).
trans-unit.target: 由你選定的索引鍵（選用）。

trans-unit.source: The word under the number, for example "Followers".
trans-unit.target: 數字下方的文字，例如 "Followers"。

trans-unit.source: The number, shown with group separators (3,107).
trans-unit.target: 數字，以千分位符號顯示（3,107）。

trans-unit.source: Shows how much of a known task is complete (Arc Progress). One smooth spring drives both the fill and the counted percentage, so the number always matches the bar; the fill slides in from the left (keeping its round end) and turns to the success color at 100%, where a check settles in beside the count. `Minimum` is treated as 0 like Arc; a non-positive `Maximum` counts as 100.
trans-unit.target: 顯示已知任務的完成進度（Arc 進度條）。同一個平滑彈簧同時驅動填滿與計數百分比，因此數字始終與進度條一致；填滿從左側滑入（保留圓形末端），達到 100% 時變為成功色，同時一個勾號在計數旁彈入定位。`Minimum` 與 Arc 相同，視為 0；非正數的 `Maximum` 按 100 計算。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsComplete` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsComplete` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Shows the counted percentage and, at 100%, a check (Arc `showValue`).
trans-unit.target: 顯示計數的百分比；達到 100% 時還會顯示勾號（Arc 的 `showValue`）。

trans-unit.source: Visible label above the bar; it is also the accessible name (defaults to "Progress").
trans-unit.target: 進度條上方的可見標籤；同時也是無障礙名稱（預設為 "Progress"）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Percentage` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Percentage` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Shows a number as a horizontal bar with its text at the right edge. The value is read against `Minimum` and `Maximum` (0 to 100 by default, which suits a percent column).
trans-unit.target: 把數字顯示為水平條，文字顯示在右端。值依 `Minimum` 和 `Maximum` 讀取（預設 0 到 100，適合百分比欄）。

trans-unit.source: A compact sprint board: a few stages as columns, each task a card that the arrow buttons send one stage left or right, a sprint line that fills as tasks reach the finished stage, a team row, an All work / My work switch and an Add button. A moved card flies in a straight line to the end of its new column while the old column closes up; filtered cards fade out in place as the others close the gap. Everything works with Tab, Enter and Space, and screen readers hear each move. Sized for tens of tasks; for hundreds, drag and drop and virtualization, use a full kanban board.
trans-unit.target: 精簡的衝刺看板：若干階段作為欄，每個任務是一張卡片，箭頭按鈕可將其向左或向右移動一個階段；衝刺進度列隨任務抵達已完成階段而填滿；團隊列、All work / My work 切換開關以及新增按鈕。被移動的卡片會沿直線飛到新欄末尾，原欄隨之收攏；被篩選的卡片在原位淡出，其他卡片則填補空缺。全部操作均可透過 Tab、Enter 與空白鍵完成，螢幕閱讀器會播報每次移動。適用於數十個任務；數百個任務時，需要拖放與虛擬化，請改用完整的看板。

trans-unit.source: Runs after the board added a task (parameter: the new `ProjectBoardTask`).
trans-unit.target: 看板新增任務後執行（參數：新的 `ProjectBoardTask`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the Add button is pressed: supply the task, add nothing, or let the board add a draft.
trans-unit.target: 按下新增按鈕時引發：提供任務、不新增任何內容，或讓看板新增一個草稿。

trans-unit.source: The stage new tasks go to; null or unknown uses the first stage.
trans-unit.target: 新任務所進入的階段；為 null 或未知值時使用第一個階段。

trans-unit.source: The Add button's label (its name and tooltip when only the icon shows).
trans-unit.target: 新增按鈕的標籤（僅顯示圖示時，其名稱與工具提示也使用此文字）。

trans-unit.source: Announced after an add: {0} the task, {1} its stage.
trans-unit.target: 新增後播報；{0} 為任務，{1} 為其階段。

trans-unit.source: The label of the button that shows every task.
trans-unit.target: 顯示所有任務的按鈕的標籤。

trans-unit.source: False makes moves, adds and filters change in place at once, as with reduced motion.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時，移動、新增與篩選的變化會立即於原位生效，與減少動態效果時一致。

trans-unit.source: A column's screen reader name: {0} the stage, {1} the number of cards shown.
trans-unit.target: 欄的螢幕閱讀器名稱：{0} 為階段，{1} 為顯示的卡片數量。

trans-unit.source: A column's screen reader name when it shows one card: {0} the stage.
trans-unit.target: 欄只顯示一張卡片時的螢幕閱讀器名稱：{0} 為階段。

trans-unit.source: The comments part of a card's screen reader name: {0} the count.
trans-unit.target: 卡片螢幕閱讀器名稱中評論部分：{0} 為數量。

trans-unit.source: The comments part of a card's screen reader name for one comment.
trans-unit.target: 卡片螢幕閱讀器名稱中，只有一則評論時的評論部分。

trans-unit.source: At this width and below the actions take a row of their own and Add shows only its icon.
trans-unit.target: 在此寬度及以下，操作按鈕各佔一行，新增按鈕僅顯示圖示。

trans-unit.source: The person using the board: "My work" shows the tasks they own, drafts are theirs. Null hides the switch.
trans-unit.target: 使用看板的人："My work" 顯示其負責的任務，草稿歸其所有。為 null 時隱藏切換開關。

trans-unit.source: The number of tasks in the finished stage (every task, whatever the filter).
trans-unit.target: 已完成階段中的任務數量（無論篩選條件為何，統計所有任務）。

trans-unit.source: The area label of drafts; null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 草稿的區域標籤；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Titles the Add button cycles through for drafts when no `AddRequested` handler supplies a task.
trans-unit.target: 當沒有 `AddRequested` 處理常式提供任務時，新增按鈕為草稿輪替使用的標題。

trans-unit.source: The due part of a card's screen reader name: {0} the due label.
trans-unit.target: 卡片螢幕閱讀器名稱中的截止部分：{0} 為截止標籤。

trans-unit.source: Shown in an empty column while only the current user's tasks are shown.
trans-unit.target: 僅顯示目前使用者的任務時，顯示在空欄中的文字。

trans-unit.source: Shown in an empty column while every task is shown (a stage's own `EmptyText` wins).
trans-unit.target: 顯示所有任務時，顯示在空欄中的文字（階段自身的 `EmptyText` 優先）。

trans-unit.source: Which cards are shown: every task or the current user's.
trans-unit.target: 顯示哪些卡片：所有任務或目前使用者的任務。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Filter` changes.
trans-unit.target: `Filter` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the filter switch.
trans-unit.target: 篩選切換開關的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: Shows the Add button.
trans-unit.target: 顯示新增按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Draws the board as a bordered, rounded card (true); false fills its space flat (a page of its own).
trans-unit.target: 將看板繪製為帶邊框、圓角的卡片（true）；false 則使其平鋪填滿所在空間（作為獨立頁面）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the progress sentence and the sprint line (the line also divides the header from the columns).
trans-unit.target: 顯示進度語句與衝刺進度列（該進度列同時將標題與各欄分隔開）。

trans-unit.source: The narrowest column of the wide layout (200); narrower boards scroll sideways.
trans-unit.target: 寬版配置中最窄的欄（200）；更窄的看板會左右捲動。

trans-unit.source: Runs after a card's arrow button moved its task (parameter: a `ProjectBoardMoveRequest`).
trans-unit.target: 卡片的箭頭按鈕移動任務後執行（參數：`ProjectBoardMoveRequest`）。

trans-unit.source: Put in `MoveToFormat` for the right arrow of a task in the last stage (the button is disabled).
trans-unit.target: 用於 `MoveToFormat`，作為最後階段任務的右箭頭文字（該按鈕會被停用）。

trans-unit.source: Put in `MoveToFormat` for the left arrow of a task in the first stage (the button is disabled).
trans-unit.target: 用於 `MoveToFormat`，作為第一階段任務的左箭頭文字（該按鈕會被停用）。

trans-unit.source: An arrow button's name: {0} the task, {1} the stage it sends the task to.
trans-unit.target: 箭頭按鈕的名稱：{0} 為任務，{1} 為該按鈕將任務移至的階段。

trans-unit.source: Announced after a move: {0} the task, {1} its new stage.
trans-unit.target: 移動後播報：{0} 為任務，{1} 為其新階段。

trans-unit.source: The label of the button that shows the current user's tasks.
trans-unit.target: 顯示目前使用者任務的按鈕標籤。

trans-unit.source: At this width and below the board turns narrow: touch-sized buttons, no team row, one column and a peek.
trans-unit.target: 在此寬度及以下，面板會切換為窄版配置：按鈕為觸控尺寸，不顯示團隊列，只顯示一欄並露出一角。

trans-unit.source: The title of a draft when `DraftTitles` is empty.
trans-unit.target: 當 `DraftTitles` 為空時，草稿的標題。

trans-unit.source: The due label of drafts; null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 草稿的截止日期標籤；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The owner part of a card's screen reader name: {0} the owner's name.
trans-unit.target: 卡片螢幕閱讀器名稱中負責人的部分：{0} 為負責人的姓名。

trans-unit.source: The progress sentence under the heading: {0} finished tasks, {1} all tasks (the filter never changes them).
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的進度文字：{0} 為已完成任務數，{1} 為全部任務數（篩選不會改變它們）。

trans-unit.source: The stages, left to right (2 to 6 read well).
trans-unit.target: 階段，從左到右排列（2 到 6 個較為合適）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the board added a task (the Add button or `AddTask`).
trans-unit.target: 面板新增任務後引發（新增按鈕或 `AddTask`）。

trans-unit.source: The number of tasks on the board (every task, whatever the filter).
trans-unit.target: 面板上的任務數（所有任務，不受篩選影響）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a task changed stage, as its card starts to fly (save the move here).
trans-unit.target: 任務變更階段時引發，此時其卡片開始飛行（在此儲存移動）。

trans-unit.source: Raised before a task changes stage; set `Cancel` to keep it.
trans-unit.target: 任務變更階段之前引發；設定 `Cancel` 可保留原狀。

trans-unit.source: The tasks; each column shows its stage's tasks in this order. `TasksSource` takes precedence when set.
trans-unit.target: 任務；每欄依此順序顯示其階段的任務。設定後 `TasksSource` 優先。

trans-unit.source: A collection of `ProjectBoardTask`s (observed when it raises collection changes) that replaces `Tasks`. A writable list is reordered by moves (a moved task goes to the end of its new column) and receives added tasks; a read-only one only has its tasks' stages changed.
trans-unit.target: 由 `ProjectBoardTask` 組成的集合（引發集合變更時會被監看），用於取代 `Tasks`。可寫入的清單會隨移動重新排序（被移動的任務排到其新欄的末尾），並接收新增的任務；唯讀清單則只變更其任務的階段。

trans-unit.source: The people shown as overlapping avatars in the header (hidden when empty and on narrow boards).
trans-unit.target: 標題中以重疊頭像顯示的人員（為空時以及在窄版面板上隱藏）。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the team avatars.
trans-unit.target: 團隊頭像的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: The heading in the header; null leaves the heading out (the progress sentence stays).
trans-unit.target: 標題列中的標題；為 null 時不顯示標題（進度文字保留）。

trans-unit.source: A move made with a card's arrow buttons (the parameter of `MoveCommand`).
trans-unit.target: 透過卡片的箭頭按鈕進行的移動（即 `MoveCommand` 的參數）。

trans-unit.source: One column of a `ProjectBoard`: a stage of the work, such as Planned, In progress, Review or Done. Tasks name their stage by `Key`.
trans-unit.target: `ProjectBoard` 的一欄：工作的一個階段，例如規劃、進行中、審閱或完成。任務透過 `Key` 指定所屬階段。

trans-unit.source: The text shown in the column while it has no cards; null uses the board's empty texts.
trans-unit.target: 欄中沒有卡片時顯示的文字；為 null 時使用面板的空狀態文字。

trans-unit.source: The column heading; empty uses `Key`.
trans-unit.target: 欄標題；為空時使用 `Key`。

trans-unit.source: Marks the stage that counts as finished: its tasks fill the sprint line, their titles turn quiet and their due labels stop warning. When no stage is marked, the last stage counts as finished.
trans-unit.target: 標記計為已完成的階段：其任務計入衝刺進度線，任務標題轉為淡化顯示，截止日期標籤不再發出警告。若未標記任何階段，則最後一個階段計為已完成。

trans-unit.source: A stable id that tasks refer to with `StageKey`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼，任務透過 `StageKey` 參照它。

trans-unit.source: One card of a `ProjectBoard`: a task with an area, a due label, a title, an owner and a comment count, in the stage named by `StageKey`. Changing `StageKey` moves the card to that column.
trans-unit.target: `ProjectBoard` 的一張卡片：一個任務，包含區域、截止日期標籤、標題、負責人和留言數，位於 `StageKey` 指定的階段中。變更 `StageKey` 會將卡片移到對應的欄。

trans-unit.source: The small label at the top left (a product area or team); null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 左上角的小標籤（產品區域或團隊）；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The number of comments; zero hides the comment count.
trans-unit.target: 留言數；為零時隱藏留言數。

trans-unit.source: The due label at the top right ("Today", "Fri", "Oct 3"); null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 右上角的截止日期標籤（如 "Today"、"Fri"、"Oct 3"）；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Shows the due label in the warning color; ignored once the task is in the finished stage.
trans-unit.target: 以警告色顯示截止日期標籤；任務進入已完成階段後忽略此設定。

trans-unit.source: A stable id for events and persistence (a new GUID by default).
trans-unit.target: 用於事件與持久化的穩定識別碼（預設為新的 GUID）。

trans-unit.source: The person responsible (a 22px avatar; the "My work" filter compares it with the current user).
trans-unit.target: 負責人（22px 頭像；"My work" 篩選會將其與目前使用者比較）。

trans-unit.source: The `Key` of the task's stage; an unknown key shows it in the first stage.
trans-unit.target: 任務所在階段的 `Key`；未知的鍵會將任務顯示在第一個階段中。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app wants to keep with the task.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式希望與任務一同保存的任意物件。

trans-unit.source: The card title; long titles wrap.
trans-unit.target: 卡片標題；過長的標題會換行。

trans-unit.source: A person on a project block: a board card's owner, a calendar attendee, a meeting guest or a release owner. Without a picture the blocks draw a generated avatar: the initials on a soft color picked from the person's key or name, so the same person keeps the same color everywhere.
trans-unit.target: 專案區塊中的一位人員：面板卡片的負責人、行事曆與會者、會議來賓或發布負責人。沒有圖片時，區塊會繪製產生的頭像：在根據該人員的鍵或名稱選取的柔和顏色上顯示其首字母，因此同一人員在各處都保持相同顏色。

trans-unit.source: A picture drawn in the avatar circle; null draws the generated avatar.

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of prompt caching. Up to four requests share a prompt prefix (tool schemas, instructions, documents, the chat so far) and add a new message each. The first processes every segment in one steady sweep and carries the prefix into the cache panel, where a time-to-live ring fills; later requests read the prefix back under one passing band and only process their message, and their processed tokens, input cost and first-token time roll down from the row above. A toggle edits one segment: the next request matches the cache only up to it, shows a break there and writes the rest again. When no request arrives the ring drains on an accelerated clock and the cache expires; then the round starts over. The totals roll into the input cost saved and the first-token speedup. Costs and times are computed from `Pricing` and `FirstTokenEstimator`; the numbers are illustrative.
trans-unit.target: 提示快取的動畫講解。最多四個請求共享一段提示前綴（工具架構、指令、文件、至今的對話），並各自加入一則新訊息。第一個請求以穩定的一次掃過處理每個段落，並將前綴帶入快取面板，其中的存活時間環逐漸填滿；後續請求在一條掠過的光帶下讀回前綴，只處理它們的訊息，而它們處理的 token、輸入成本與第一個 token 時間會從上一列向下滾入。切換開關可編輯一個段落：下一個請求只會比對到該段落為止的快取，在那裡顯示斷點，並重新寫入其餘部分。若沒有請求到達，存活時間環會以加速的時鐘排空，快取隨之過期；然後整輪重新開始。合計數值彙總為節省的輸入成本與第一個 token 加速比。成本與時間由 `Pricing` 與 `FirstTokenEstimator` 計算；數字僅為示意。

trans-unit.source: A settings card for bring-your-own-key AI products (Arc Provider keys, design reference). One row per provider with its mark, the masked key (`sk-••••4f2a`), a status as icon plus label (Connected, Invalid, Not set), when the key was last used, and four actions: reveal for five seconds with a countdown ring, copy, rotate, and remove with undo. Pressing a status tests the stored key again. Add key and Rotate open an inline form under the row that checks the key's format as you type, then shows Testing connection and Connected before the row takes the new key. Bind `Keys` (two-way) and handle `KeySaved` and `KeyRemoved` to persist; set `TestKey` to test keys on your server. Providers without a key read Not set. For a demo, set `Simulation` instead of `TestKey` to simulate every test; with neither, a test fails with `NoKeyTest`, so no key reads Connected without a check.
trans-unit.target: 為自備金鑰 AI 產品設計的設定卡片（Arc Provider keys，設計參考）。每個供應商一列，顯示其標誌、遮罩金鑰（`sk-••••4f2a`）、由圖示加文字組成的狀態（Connected、Invalid、Not set）、金鑰最近一次使用的時間，以及四個操作：帶倒數圓環的五秒顯示、複製、輪替與可復原的移除。按下狀態會重新測試已儲存的金鑰。Add key 與 Rotate 會在該列下方開啟內嵌表單，在輸入時檢查金鑰格式，然後顯示 Testing connection 與 Connected，再讓該列採用新金鑰。繫結 `Keys`（雙向）並處理 `KeySaved` 與 `KeyRemoved` 以保存；設定 `TestKey` 以在你的伺服器上測試金鑰。沒有金鑰的供應商顯示為 Not set。用於展示時，設定 `Simulation` 而非 `TestKey` 來模擬每次測試；兩者都沒有時，測試會以 `NoKeyTest` 失敗，因此任何金鑰都不會未經檢查就顯示為 Connected。

trans-unit.source: A line under the title; null or empty hides it.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行文字；為 null 或空白時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: A quiet line under the list, an encryption note by default; null or empty hides it.
trans-unit.target: 清單下方一行低調的文字，預設是加密說明；為 null 或空白時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Shows placeholder rows with the real row geometry while keys load.
trans-unit.target: 在金鑰載入期間顯示預留列，幾何尺寸與真實的列一致。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a key was copied to the clipboard, for an audit log. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 金鑰被複製到剪貼簿時引發，可用於稽核記錄。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the undo window of a removal closes, so a removal only reaches your server once it sticks. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 移除的復原視窗關閉時引發，所以移除只有在確定後才會傳到你的伺服器。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a new key passed its test; persist it here (the row already shows it as connected). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 新金鑰通過測試時引發；在這裡保存（該列已顯示為已連線）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The keys, one per provider (two-way): the card writes the new list on every add, rotation, removal, undo and retest. Providers without an entry read Not set; null or an empty list is the empty state, every row Not set.
trans-unit.target: 金鑰，每個供應商一把（雙向）：每次新增、輪替、移除、復原與重新測試時，卡片都會寫回新的清單。沒有項目的供應商顯示為 Not set；為 null 或空清單時即為空白狀態，每一列都是 Not set。

trans-unit.source: Raised on every change to the keys: added, rotated, removed, restored with undo, or retested. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 金鑰每次變更時引發：新增、輪替、移除、復原或重新測試。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個詞。

trans-unit.source: The card width under which each row stacks (status beside the name, the key on its own line) and the form stacks.
trans-unit.target: 卡片寬度低於此值時，每一列改為堆疊排列（狀態在名稱旁邊，金鑰獨佔一行），表單也會堆疊。

trans-unit.source: Which providers get a row, in order. Null or an empty list shows no rows.
trans-unit.target: 哪些供應商有一列，以及它們的順序。為 null 或空清單時不顯示任何列。

trans-unit.source: How long a revealed key stays visible before it masks itself again.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的金鑰在重新遮罩之前保持可見的時間長度。

trans-unit.source: Simulated key tests while `TestKey` is null, for demos: stored invalid keys fail again, everything else connects, and announcements say nothing was sent. Null (the default) runs no simulated test.
trans-unit.target: `TestKey` 為 null 時使用的模擬金鑰測試，用於展示：已儲存的無效金鑰會再次失敗，其餘金鑰都連線成功，朗讀會說明沒有傳送任何內容。為 null（預設）時不執行模擬測試。

trans-unit.source: Tests a key and returns whether the provider accepted it. The request carries the pasted key when adding or rotating, and no key when retesting a stored one (test it on your server by provider); its token is cancelled when the form closes. Null uses `Simulation`; with neither, every test fails with `NoKeyTest`.
trans-unit.target: 測試金鑰並傳回供應商是否接受它。新增或輪替時，請求帶有貼上的金鑰；重新測試已儲存的金鑰時不帶金鑰（請在伺服器上依供應商測試）；其權杖會在表單關閉時取消。為 null 時使用 `Simulation`；兩者都沒有時，每次測試都以 `NoKeyTest` 失敗。

trans-unit.source: The card's title, also the name of the section.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的標題，也是該區塊的名稱。

trans-unit.source: How long Undo stays after a removal; `KeyRemoved` is raised when it closes.
trans-unit.target: 移除後 Undo 保留的時間長度；它關閉時會引發 `KeyRemoved`。

trans-unit.source: Every word `ProviderKeys` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; words that name a provider, a prefix, a time or an error are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `ProviderKeys` 顯示或朗讀的每一個詞，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；涉及供應商、前綴、時間或錯誤的詞是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: Simulated key tests for a `ProviderKeys` without `TestKey`, for demos and prototypes: after `Delay`, retesting a stored key whose status is Invalid fails again with its own error (or `RejectedError`), and every other test connects. Nothing is sent anywhere, and the card adds "Simulated, nothing was sent." to what it announces.
trans-unit.target: 供沒有 `TestKey` 的 `ProviderKeys` 使用的模擬金鑰測試，用於展示與原型：等待 `Delay` 之後，重新測試狀態為 Invalid 的已儲存金鑰會以其自身的錯誤（或 `RejectedError`）再次失敗，其餘測試都連線成功。不會傳送任何內容，卡片會在朗讀中附加 "Simulated, nothing was sent."。

trans-unit.source: A status card for the AI providers a product depends on (Arc Provider status, design reference). Each row shows the provider's mark, its health as an icon and label (Operational, Degraded, Outage), the median latency in tabular numerals and a 30 day uptime bar of small ticks with a tooltip per day. A row with an incident is a button that opens its updates (Investigating, Identified, Monitoring, Resolved), newest first; new updates grow the panel smoothly. The header sums up health across providers and checks again on a visible countdown ring, with a refresh button, a Checking state and an error state that keeps the last results. Cards narrower than 560px take two lines per row. Give it `Providers` and a `RefreshHandler` that fetches fresh status (from your own aggregation endpoint). With neither, a `Simulation` plays its story on simulated checks; without one the card says there are no providers.
trans-unit.target: 一張呈現產品所依賴的 AI 服務供應商狀態的卡片（Arc Provider status，設計參考）。每一列顯示供應商的標誌、以圖示和標籤表示的健康狀態（Operational、Degraded、Outage）、以等寬數字顯示的中位延遲，以及由小刻度組成、每天都附提示的 30 天可用率條。帶有事件的列是一個按鈕，依從新到舊展開其更新（Investigating、Identified、Monitoring、Resolved）；新的更新會讓面板平順變高。標題列彙總所有供應商的健康狀態，並依可見的倒數計時環再次檢查，附有重新整理按鈕、Checking 狀態，以及保留上次結果的錯誤狀態。寬度小於 560px 的卡片每列佔兩行。傳入 `Providers` 和一個取得最新狀態的 `RefreshHandler`（來自你自己的彙整端點）。兩者都沒有時，由 `Simulation` 在模擬檢查中播放其故事；沒有模擬時，卡片說明沒有供應商。

trans-unit.source: An error to show in the header, such as a failed first load. Errors thrown by the refresh handler show on their own.
trans-unit.target: 在標題列中顯示的錯誤，例如第一次載入失敗。重新整理處理常式擲回的錯誤會自行顯示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an incident row is opened or closed by the person. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 使用者展開或收合事件列時觸發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The provider whose incident is open (two-way), or null.
trans-unit.target: 目前展開事件的供應商（雙向），或 null。

trans-unit.source: A quiet line under the list, such as how latency and uptime are measured. A playing simulation shows a sample data note.
trans-unit.target: 清單下方一行低調的說明，例如延遲與可用率是如何量測的。正在播放的模擬會顯示一則範例資料說明。

trans-unit.source: Raised by the Status page link of an open incident. Bubbles. When nothing handles it, the link opens the incident's `Url`; with neither a handler nor a URL the link is hidden.
trans-unit.target: 由展開事件中的 Status page 連結觸發。會向上傳遞。沒有任何處理常式處理它時，連結會開啟事件的 `Url`；既沒有處理常式也沒有 URL 時，連結會隱藏。

trans-unit.source: True while a check runs.
trans-unit.target: 檢查進行期間為 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows skeleton rows with the same row height, for the first load.
trans-unit.target: 第一次載入時顯示列高相同的骨架列。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個字詞。

trans-unit.source: A one-off message for screen readers, such as the result of an action; it is read each time it changes.
trans-unit.target: 給螢幕閱讀器的一次性訊息，例如某個操作的結果；每次變化時都會朗讀。

trans-unit.source: The providers to show. Leave it null (with no `RefreshHandler`) to play `Simulation`. A check that returns providers writes them here.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的供應商。保持為 null（且沒有 `RefreshHandler`）即播放 `Simulation`。回傳供應商的檢查會把結果寫回這裡。

trans-unit.source: Fetches fresh status on the countdown and on the refresh button. Return the new providers, or update `Providers` yourself and return null. Throw to show the error state: the last results stay and the countdown turns into a retry. A newer check cancels the older one through the token. Without it the refresh controls are hidden.
trans-unit.target: 在倒數結束和按下重新整理按鈕時取得最新狀態。回傳新的供應商，或自行更新 `Providers` 並回傳 null。擲回例外即顯示錯誤狀態：上次的結果保留，倒數變為重試。新的檢查會透過取消權杖取消較早的檢查。沒有它時，重新整理控制項會隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Time between automatic checks (30 seconds by default). The countdown pauses while the card is off screen or hidden; retries after an error wait at most 10 seconds. Null turns automatic checks off and keeps the refresh button.
trans-unit.target: 兩次自動檢查之間的時間（預設 30 秒）。卡片不在畫面上或被隱藏時倒數暫停；出錯後的重試最多等待 10 秒。為 null 時關閉自動檢查，但保留重新整理按鈕。

trans-unit.source: A simulated status feed to play while `Providers` and `RefreshHandler` are null: its first step shows at once, and each simulated check on the countdown moves its story on. Null (the default) shows no providers. Give each card its own simulation.
trans-unit.target: `Providers` 和 `RefreshHandler` 為 null 時播放的模擬狀態來源：其第一步立即顯示，倒數計時上的每次模擬檢查都會推進故事。為 null（預設）時不顯示供應商。每張卡片使用自己的模擬。

trans-unit.source: The card's title.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的標題。

trans-unit.source: One day in a provider's history.
trans-unit.target: 供應商歷史記錄中的一天。

trans-unit.source: An incident of a provider: a title and its updates.
trans-unit.target: 供應商的一個事件：標題及其更新。

trans-unit.source: One AI provider in a `ProviderStatus` card: its mark, health, latency, daily history and incident.
trans-unit.target: `ProviderStatus` 卡片中的一個 AI 服務供應商：它的標誌、健康狀態、延遲、逐日歷史記錄和事件。

trans-unit.source: Every word `ProviderStatus` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; numbers, dates and sentences that carry values are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `ProviderStatus` 顯示或朗讀的每一個字詞，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫措辭；數字、日期以及帶有數值的句子是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: A simulated status feed for a `ProviderStatus` that has no `Providers` and no `RefreshHandler`, for demos and prototypes. The card shows the first step's providers, then runs a simulated check every `Interval` on its countdown (or when the refresh button is pressed): each check takes `CheckDelay` and moves to the next step, looping, so incidents can open, post updates and resolve. Nothing is fetched. Create one per card: it keeps its place in the story.
trans-unit.target: 供沒有 `Providers` 和 `RefreshHandler` 的 `ProviderStatus` 使用的模擬狀態來源，用於展示與原型。卡片先顯示第一步的供應商，然後依倒數計時每隔 `Interval`（或按下重新整理按鈕時）進行一次模擬檢查：每次檢查耗時 `CheckDelay`，並進入下一步、循環播放，因此事件可以開啟、發布更新並解決。不會取得任何資料。每張卡片建立一個：它會記住故事進行到哪裡。

trans-unit.source: One simulated check of a `ProviderStatusSimulation`: what it returns, or that it fails.
trans-unit.target: `ProviderStatusSimulation` 的一次模擬檢查：它回傳的內容，或者它失敗。

trans-unit.source: One update of an incident.
trans-unit.target: 事件的一則更新。

trans-unit.source: A ranking that changes over time: bars slide past each other as their values climb, and a timeline plays, pauses or scrubs the periods. Every bar shows its name and value, so hue is never the only cue. Space or Enter plays or pauses, ← / → step a period, ↑ / ↓ read the bars by rank, Home / End go to the first and last period, Escape clears the reading. Under reduced motion nothing plays by itself and periods change without interpolation.
trans-unit.target: 隨時間變化的排名：數值上升時長條彼此超越，時間軸可以播放、暫停或拖曳瀏覽各個時期。每個長條都顯示名稱和數值，因此色相不是唯一的線索。Space 或 Enter 播放或暫停，← / → 逐步切換時期，↑ / ↓ 依名次讀取長條，Home / End 前往第一個和最後一個時期，Escape 清除讀數。減少動態時不會自動播放，時期切換也沒有內插。

trans-unit.source: How many bars are shown (default 8, at least 1); items ranked below slide out.
trans-unit.target: 顯示多少個長條（預設 8，至少 1）；排名更低的項目滑出。

trans-unit.source: Message shown without items or frames.
trans-unit.target: 沒有項目或幀時顯示的訊息。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the period shown changes, whether by playback, a step, a scrub or `FrameIndex`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的時期變化時觸發，無論來自播放、逐步、拖曳還是 `FrameIndex`。

trans-unit.source: How long one period takes while playing (default 1400 ms).
trans-unit.target: 播放時一個時期的時長（預設 1400 ms）。

trans-unit.source: The period shown (two-way). Changing it glides through the values between periods.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的時期（雙向）。變更時會平滑經過時期之間的數值。

trans-unit.source: One frame per period, in order: the period's name and the values by item id. A missing id counts as zero.
trans-unit.target: 每個時期一幀，依順序：時期名稱和依項目 id 的數值。缺少的 id 計為零。

trans-unit.source: Optional categories: the first four take series hues and a legend appears. Without groups every bar uses the first hue.
trans-unit.target: 選用的分類：前四個使用系列色相並顯示圖例。沒有群組時所有長條都使用第一個色相。

trans-unit.source: Id of the item whose name and value are emphasised.
trans-unit.target: 名稱和數值被強調的項目 id。

trans-unit.source: Starts playing the first time the chart scrolls into view (default true). Ignored under reduced motion.
trans-unit.target: 圖表第一次捲動進入可視範圍時開始播放（預設 true）。減少動態時忽略。

trans-unit.source: Starts over from the first period after the last one (default false).
trans-unit.target: 最後一個時期之後從第一個時期重新開始（預設 false）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the timeline is playing (two-way). Starting it on the last period replays from the first.
trans-unit.target: 時間軸是否正在播放（雙向）。在最後一個時期開始播放時從第一個時期重播。

trans-unit.source: The competitors, one per bar. Assign a list or add items inline in XAML; changes to an observable list are followed.
trans-unit.target: 參賽者，每個長條一項。可指派清單，或在 XAML 中內嵌加入；可觀察清單的變化會被追蹤。

trans-unit.source: What is being ranked, such as "Monthly riders by city"; names the chart for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 排名的內容，例如 "Monthly riders by city"；為輔助技術命名圖表。

trans-unit.source: Raised when playback starts or stops.
trans-unit.target: 播放開始或停止時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Formats the axis ticks (default: `ValueFormatter`, or compact numbers).
trans-unit.target: 格式化座標軸刻度（預設：`ValueFormatter`，或精簡數字）。

trans-unit.source: Formats bar values and tooltips (default: compact numbers through `ArcFormatting.Compact`, such as 1.2K).
trans-unit.target: 格式化長條數值和提示框（預設：透過 `ArcFormatting.Compact` 得到的精簡數字，例如 1.2K）。

trans-unit.source: One measure of a `RadarChart`; axes run clockwise from the top in the order given.
trans-unit.target: `RadarChart` 的一個度量；各軸依給定順序從頂端開始順時針排列。

trans-unit.source: A radar chart: several profiles drawn on one web of measures. Replacing a profile morphs its shape on a gently bouncing spring; sweeping the axes with the pointer or the keyboard compares each profile's value at that axis.
trans-unit.target: 雷達圖：在同一張度量網上繪製多個對象。替換對象時，其形狀在輕微回彈的彈簧上變形；用指標或鍵盤掃過各軸，可比較每個對象在該軸上的數值。

trans-unit.source: Key of the axis being read (two-way), or null. A key that matches no axis shows no reading.
trans-unit.target: 正在讀取的軸的索引鍵（雙向），或 null。與任何軸都不相符的索引鍵不顯示讀數。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the axis being read changes.
trans-unit.target: 正在讀取的軸變化時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The measures, at least three, clockwise from the top. Add `RadarAxis` items in XAML or bind any list; an observable list is followed.
trans-unit.target: 度量，至少三條，從頂端開始順時針排列。可在 XAML 中加入 `RadarAxis` 項目，或繫結任意清單；可觀察的清單會被追蹤。

trans-unit.source: Message shown with fewer than three axes or no series.
trans-unit.target: 少於三條軸或沒有系列時顯示的訊息。

trans-unit.source: Opacity of each profile's fill, from 0 to 1 (default 0.18).
trans-unit.target: 每個對象填滿的不透明度，範圍 0 到 1（預設 0.18）。

trans-unit.source: Draws the rings as circles (default) or as polygons with a corner on each axis.
trans-unit.target: 把環繪製為圓形（預設）或每條軸上有一個角的多邊形。

trans-unit.source: Shows the legend: each profile's name and line key (default true).
trans-unit.target: 顯示圖例：每個對象的名稱與線條樣式（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: What the chart compares, such as "Team skills"; names it for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 圖表比較的內容，例如 "Team skills"；為輔助技術命名圖表。

trans-unit.source: The value at the outer ring (default 100). `RadarAxis.Maximum` wins on its axis.
trans-unit.target: 外環處的值（預設 100）。`RadarAxis.Maximum` 在其軸上優先。

trans-unit.source: Number of rings in the web (default 4).
trans-unit.target: 網的環數（預設 4）。

trans-unit.source: The profiles, in drawing and colour order. Add `RadarSeries` items in XAML or bind any list; an observable list is followed.
trans-unit.target: 各個對象，依繪製與顏色順序排列。可在 XAML 中加入 `RadarSeries` 項目，或繫結任意清單；可觀察的清單會被追蹤。

trans-unit.source: Largest diameter of the web in pixels (default 320); it shrinks to fit the space.
trans-unit.target: 網的最大直徑，單位為像素（預設 320）；會縮小以符合空間。

trans-unit.source: Formats a value on its axis for the tooltip and assistive technology (default: grouped, one decimal at most, true minus sign).
trans-unit.target: 為提示與輔助技術格式化某條軸上的數值（預設：千位分組，最多一位小數，使用真正的減號）。

trans-unit.source: One profile of a `RadarChart`: a closed shape with a value per axis.
trans-unit.target: `RadarChart` 的一個對象：封閉形狀，每條軸一個數值。

trans-unit.source: A value of a `RadarSeries` on one axis.
trans-unit.target: `RadarSeries` 在一條軸上的數值。

trans-unit.source: One card of `RadioCards`: indicator, label (the card's content) with an optional icon, description and meta. The group creates a card for each option. For a `RadioCardOption` the card takes its label, icon, description, meta, disabled state and reason from the option; for any other item the label is the group's `ItemTemplate`, and a style on `arc|RadioCard` (or the group's `ItemContainerTheme`) can bind these properties, `IsEnabled` and `AutomationProperties.Name` to the item.
trans-unit.target: `RadioCards` 的一張卡片：指示器、標籤（卡片的內容）及選用圖示、說明和附註。群組為每個選項建立一張卡片。對於 `RadioCardOption`，卡片從選項讀取標籤、圖示、說明、附註、停用狀態和原因；對於其他項目，標籤由群組的 `ItemTemplate` 產生，並且可以用針對 `arc|RadioCard` 的樣式（或群組的 `ItemContainerTheme`）把這些屬性、`IsEnabled` 和 `AutomationProperties.Name` 繫結到項目。

trans-unit.source: A line under the label that explains the option; also the card's accessible help text.
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方解釋該選項的一行文字；同時也是卡片的無障礙說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Why the card is disabled; shown in place of the description while the card is disabled.
trans-unit.target: 卡片被停用的原因；卡片停用時顯示在說明的位置。

trans-unit.source: Content before the label, such as an `ArcGlyph` (shown in an 18 px box).
trans-unit.target: 標籤前的內容，例如 `ArcGlyph`（顯示在 18 px 的方框中）。

trans-unit.source: Content at the bottom of the card (at the end of a list row), such as a price.
trans-unit.target: 卡片底部（清單列中位於末端）的內容，例如價格。

trans-unit.source: One option of `RadioCards` (Arc `RadioCardOption`): a label with optional description, a meta value (price, estimate), a decorative icon, and a reason shown in place of the description when the option is disabled. Its properties can be bound in XAML; the cards follow later changes.
trans-unit.target: `RadioCards` 的一個選項（Arc `RadioCardOption`）：一個標籤，可選的描述、中繼資訊（價格、估算）、裝飾圖示，以及選項停用時取代描述顯示的原因。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結；卡片組會跟隨之後的變化。

trans-unit.source: One or two short lines under the label.
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方的一兩行簡短說明。

trans-unit.source: Short reason shown in place of the description when the option is disabled.
trans-unit.target: 選項停用時取代描述顯示的簡短原因。

trans-unit.source: Decorative 18px icon beside the label: a Lucide `Geometry` (for example `ArcIcons.Zap`) or any content.
trans-unit.target: 標籤旁的 18px 裝飾圖示：Lucide `Geometry`（例如 `ArcIcons.Zap`）或任意內容。

trans-unit.source: A disabled card cannot be selected and is skipped by the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 停用的卡片不能被選取，方向鍵會略過它。

trans-unit.source: Card title (text or any content); falls back to `Value`.
trans-unit.target: 卡片標題（文字或任意內容）；未設定時使用 `Value`。

trans-unit.source: A price, estimate or other value: under the text in a grid card, at the end of a list row.
trans-unit.target: 價格、估算或其他數值：在格狀卡片中位於文字下方，在清單列中位於列尾。

trans-unit.source: The value reported as the group's `SelectedValue`.
trans-unit.target: 作為卡片組 `SelectedValue` 回報的值。

trans-unit.source: Arc radio cards: selectable option cards for choices that need more than a label (plans, shipping speeds, regions). One selection ring springs from card to card, so the eye follows the change, and a 6px dot pops into the chosen card's indicator. Behaves as a radio group: one tab stop, arrows (mirrored in right-to-left) move and select, Home / End jump to the ends and Enter / Space select. Disabled cards are skipped and show their reason. Cards come from `ItemsSource` or inline `RadioCardOption` items; `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected option's value.
trans-unit.target: Arc 單選卡片：用於需要超過文字標籤的選擇（方案、配送速度、地區）的可選選項卡片。單一選取環會從一張卡片彈向另一張，讓視線跟隨變化；選中卡片的指示器中會彈出一個 6px 的圓點。其行為與單選群組一致：只有一個 Tab 停駐點，方向鍵（在由右至左的版面中鏡像）移動並選取，Home / End 跳到兩端，Enter / Space 選取。停用的卡片會被略過，並顯示其原因。卡片來自 `ItemsSource` 或內嵌的 `RadioCardOption` 項目；`SelectedValue`（雙向繫結）為所選選項的值。

trans-unit.source: A choice is required (reported to assistive technology).
trans-unit.target: 必須進行選擇（會告知輔助技術）。

trans-unit.source: Card placement: Grid (responsive columns, the default) or List (full-width rows with the meta at the end).
trans-unit.target: 卡片排列方式：Grid（響應式欄，預設）或 List（全寬列，中繼資料位於末端）。

trans-unit.source: Narrowest a grid column may get before the grid drops a column (Arc default 180).
trans-unit.target: 網格欄可收窄到的最小寬度，低於此寬度時網格會減少一欄（Arc 預設 180）。

trans-unit.source: Arc radio group: choose one option from a visible set. One highlight (a `ControlOn` border with a faint fill) glides to the chosen row on the morph spring while the new dot springs in and the old one shrinks away, so a change reads as a single physical move. Arrow keys take the same path; the group is one tab stop (the selected row). Options come from `ItemsSource` or inline `RadioOption` items; `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected option's `Value`. The `Header` is the legend and the group's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: Arc 單選群組：從一組可見選項中選取其一。一個高亮框（`ControlOn` 邊框加淡色填滿）會以變形彈簧滑動到所選列，新的圓點彈入，舊的圓點縮小消失，因此變化看起來像一次連貫的物理移動。方向鍵走同樣的路徑；整個群組只有一個 Tab 停駐點（所選列）。選項來自 `ItemsSource` 或內嵌的 `RadioOption` 項目；`SelectedValue`（雙向繫結）為所選選項的 `Value`。`Header` 為圖例，也是該群組的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: One row of a `RadioGroup`: a ring with a springing dot, the label (the row's content) and an optional description. The group creates a row for each option. For a `RadioOption` the row takes its label, description and disabled state from the option; for any other item the label is the group's `ItemTemplate`, and a style on `arc|RadioGroupItem` (or the group's `ItemContainerTheme`) can bind `Description`, `IsEnabled` and `AutomationProperties.Name` to the item.
trans-unit.target: `RadioGroup` 的一列：帶有彈出圓點的圓環、標籤（列的內容）和選用的說明。群組為每個選項建立一列。對於 `RadioOption`，列從選項讀取標籤、說明和停用狀態；對於其他項目，標籤由群組的 `ItemTemplate` 產生，並且可以用針對 `arc|RadioGroupItem` 的樣式（或群組的 `ItemContainerTheme`）把 `Description`、`IsEnabled` 和 `AutomationProperties.Name` 繫結到項目。

trans-unit.source: A line under the label that explains the option; also the row's accessible help text.
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方解釋該選項的一行文字；同時也是列的無障礙說明文字。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `RadioGroup` (Arc `{ value, label, description? }`). Use it in `ItemsSource` or inline in XAML; the group reports `Value` as its `SelectedValue`. Its properties can be bound in XAML; the group follows later changes.
trans-unit.target: `RadioGroup` 的一個選項（Arc `{ value, label, description? }`）。可放在 `ItemsSource` 中，或在 XAML 中內嵌撰寫；選項組把 `Value` 作為它的 `SelectedValue` 回報。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結；選項組會跟隨之後的變化。

trans-unit.source: Secondary line under the label; wraps on narrow widths.
trans-unit.target: 標籤下方的第二行文字；窄寬度時會換行。

trans-unit.source: A disabled option cannot be selected and is skipped by the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 停用的選項不能被選取，方向鍵會略過它。

trans-unit.source: Row title; falls back to `Value`.
trans-unit.target: 列標題；未設定時使用 `Value`。

trans-unit.source: The value reported as the group's `SelectedValue`.
trans-unit.target: 作為選項組 `SelectedValue` 回報的值。

trans-unit.source: Arc range histogram slider: two thumbs over a histogram of the values they filter. Bars inside the range light up, cut exactly at each thumb. The thumbs follow the pointer 1:1, never cross, rubber-band up to 10px at the ends and settle on a nearby bar edge with the velocity of the release. A press anywhere on the chart or the track springs the nearest thumb there. Arrows step, Shift+arrows and PageUp / PageDown move to the next bar edge, and Home / End go to a thumb's limit.
trans-unit.target: Arc 範圍直方圖滑桿：兩個滑桿疊在它們所篩選數值的直方圖上。範圍內的長條會亮起，並恰好切在每個滑桿處。滑桿 1:1 跟隨指標，不會交叉，在兩端最多以橡皮筋方式多走 10px，並帶著放開時的速度停靠到附近的長條邊緣。在圖表或軌道上任意位置按下，最近的滑桿會以彈簧移動過去。方向鍵按步長移動，Shift+方向鍵和 PageUp / PageDown 移到下一個長條邊緣，Home / End 轉到滑桿的極限。

trans-unit.source: How many bars the histogram draws.
trans-unit.target: 直方圖繪製的長條數量。

trans-unit.source: The raw values the histogram counts, such as every listing's price. Assign a new list to redraw the bars.
trans-unit.target: 直方圖統計的原始數值，例如每個房源的價格。指派一個新清單可重繪長條。

trans-unit.source: The visible label; the thumbs are named from it unless `LowerThumbName` or `UpperThumbName` say otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 可見的標籤；滑桿的名稱由它產生，除非 `LowerThumbName` 或 `UpperThumbName` 另有指定。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the lower thumb; when null it is the label with ", minimum" appended.
trans-unit.target: 下限滑桿的無障礙名稱；為 null 時是標籤後加「, minimum」。

trans-unit.source: The lower end of the range; null means the smallest value on the scale.
trans-unit.target: 範圍的下限；null 表示刻度上的最小值。

trans-unit.source: The end of the scale; null takes it from the data, rounded up.
trans-unit.target: 刻度的終點；null 時取自資料並向上取整。

trans-unit.source: The start of the scale; null takes it from the data, rounded down and never above 0.
trans-unit.target: 刻度的起點；null 時取自資料並向下取整，且不大於 0。

trans-unit.source: The closest the two thumbs may sit, in steps.
trans-unit.target: 兩個滑桿之間的最小距離，以步長計。

trans-unit.source: Raised on every change of the range, from a drag, a key or code.
trans-unit.target: 範圍每次變化時觸發，無論來自拖曳、按鍵還是程式碼。

trans-unit.source: Lets a released thumb that lands within 9px of a bar edge settle on that edge, so a range does not cut a bar in half.
trans-unit.target: 讓放開後落在長條邊緣 9px 以內的滑桿停靠到該邊緣，使範圍不會把長條切成兩半。

trans-unit.source: The grid the values rest on and the distance of one arrow key press.
trans-unit.target: 數值停靠的網格，也是按一次方向鍵移動的距離。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the upper thumb; when null it is the label with ", maximum" appended.
trans-unit.target: 上限滑桿的無障礙名稱；為 null 時是標籤後加「, maximum」。

trans-unit.source: The upper end of the range; null means the largest value on the scale.
trans-unit.target: 範圍的上限；null 表示刻度上的最大值。

trans-unit.source: Raised once a drag is released or a key changes the range.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳放開或按鍵改變範圍時觸發一次。

trans-unit.source: Formats the readout and the spoken values (default: en-US with the decimals of the step or the minimum).
trans-unit.target: 格式化讀數和朗讀的值（預設：en-US，小數位取自步長或最小值）。

trans-unit.source: Fails a number outside `Minimum` and `Maximum`; empty values and other types pass.
trans-unit.target: 數字超出 `Minimum` 和 `Maximum` 時不通過；空值和其他型別通過。

trans-unit.source: Arc rating: a row of stars for a score from 1 to N. Pointing previews a value, a press or drag commits it, and a rolling word beside the stars says what the value means. Half stars, clearing, a read-only display and other shapes (`Icon`, `EmptyIcon`) are options. The arrow keys move by one step, Home and End jump, the number keys choose a star, and Backspace or Delete clear.
trans-unit.target: Arc 評分：一排星星，用於 1 到 N 的打分。指向時預覽分值，按下或拖曳時提交，星星旁捲動的文字說明分值的含義。半星、清除、唯讀顯示和其他形狀（`Icon`、`EmptyIcon`）都是可選項。方向鍵按一檔移動，Home 和 End 跳到兩端，數字鍵選擇星星，Backspace 或 Delete 清除。

trans-unit.source: Lets choosing the current value again clear it; Backspace and Delete clear from the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 允許再次選擇目前的值來清除評分；Backspace 和 Delete 可用鍵盤清除。

trans-unit.source: Lets the pointer, touch and arrow keys move in half stars.
trans-unit.target: 讓指標、觸控和方向鍵以半星為單位移動。

trans-unit.source: A hint under the stars.
trans-unit.target: 星星下方的提示。

trans-unit.source: The shape of the part of a star that is not filled, in the same 24 × 24 box. Null uses `Icon`. A half value shows the left half of `Icon` over the right half of this shape.
trans-unit.target: 星星未填充部分的形狀，同樣在 24 × 24 的框內。為 null 時使用 `Icon`。半值時左半邊顯示 `Icon`，右半邊顯示這個形狀。

trans-unit.source: The text shown beside empty stars.
trans-unit.target: 星星為空時旁邊顯示的文字。

trans-unit.source: The shape of each star, drawn in a 24 × 24 box like the Lucide icons of `ArcIcons`, for example `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Heart}` or path data. Null draws a star.
trans-unit.target: 每顆星的形狀，在 24 × 24 的框內繪製，與 `ArcIcons` 中的 Lucide 圖示一致，例如 `{x:Static arc:ArcIcons.Heart}` 或路徑資料。為 null 時繪製星星。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value without taking input.
trans-unit.target: 只顯示分值，不接受輸入。

trans-unit.source: The visible label and the accessible name of the group.
trans-unit.target: 可見的標籤，也是這組星星的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The number of stars.
trans-unit.target: 星星的數量。

trans-unit.source: Shows the word or number for the previewed value beside the stars.
trans-unit.target: 在星星旁顯示預覽分值對應的文字或數字。

trans-unit.source: The size of the stars.
trans-unit.target: 星星的尺寸。

trans-unit.source: The committed value; 0 means not rated. It is shown rounded to the nearest step.
trans-unit.target: 已提交的值；0 表示未評分。顯示時四捨五入到最近的一檔。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a person commits a new value; 0 means the rating was cleared.
trans-unit.target: 使用者提交新值時觸發；0 表示評分已清除。

trans-unit.source: One word per whole star. Five whole stars default to Poor through Excellent; anything else reads "4 out of 5".
trans-unit.target: 每顆整星一個詞。五顆整星預設為 Poor 到 Excellent；其他情況顯示為「4 out of 5」。

trans-unit.source: The state of one reaction (Arc's `Reaction`): how many people chose it and whether the viewer did. A reaction whose count reaches zero leaves the bar.
trans-unit.target: 單一回應的狀態（Arc 的 `Reaction`）：選擇它的人數，以及檢視者是否已選擇。計數降為零的回應會離開回應列。

trans-unit.source: One reaction the picker offers (Arc's `ReactionOption`): an id, a label and a 24×24 Lucide glyph. Its properties can be bound in XAML (for example a localized label); the bar follows later changes.
trans-unit.target: 選擇器提供的一種表情回應（Arc 的 `ReactionOption`）：一個 id、一個標籤和一個 24×24 Lucide 圖示。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結（例如在地化的標籤）；回應列會跟隨之後的變化。

trans-unit.source: 24×24 Lucide geometry (`ArcIcons` or `Parse`), drawn with a 1.75 stroke.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 Lucide 幾何圖形（`ArcIcons` 或 `Parse`），以 1.75 的描邊繪製。

trans-unit.source: Stable id, matched by `Id`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id，與 `Id` 對應。

trans-unit.source: Name shown in the picker caption and tooltips, and read by assistive technology ("Love").
trans-unit.target: 顯示在選擇器說明和提示中、並由輔助技術讀出的名稱（「喜愛」）。

trans-unit.source: Arc reactions: a bar of reaction pills with counts plus an add button that opens a compact picker, like Slack's reactions on a comment, post or release note. One tap adds or removes the viewer's reaction: the count rolls (only the digits that change, in the direction it moved), the icon gets a velocity kick that stacks on quick taps (P27), the viewer's own reactions take the accent and a filled glyph. Pills scale in out of a blur and leave the bar when their count reaches zero while the rest glide into place (P26, P19); a new row grows the bar on a spring (P6). Hovering or focusing a pill shows its label and who reacted (`Tooltip`). Keyboard: Enter / Space toggles a pill or opens the picker; in the picker every arrow moves and wraps, Home / End jump, Enter picks, Escape closes and returns focus to the add button. Each change is announced politely.
trans-unit.target: Arc 回應：一排帶計數的回應膠囊，以及一個開啟精簡選取器的新增按鈕，類似 Slack 在留言、貼文或發布說明上的回應。單擊即可新增或移除檢視者的回應：計數滾動（只滾動變化的數字，方向與變化方向一致），圖示會獲得速度衝擊，快速連點時疊加（P27）；檢視者自己的回應採用強調色與實心圖形。膠囊從模糊中縮放出現，計數降為零時離開回應列，其餘膠囊滑動就位（P26、P19）；新增一行時，回應列會以彈簧擴展（P6）。懸停或聚焦到膠囊上會顯示其標籤以及誰做出了回應（`Tooltip`）。鍵盤操作：Enter / Space 切換膠囊或開啟選取器；在選取器中，所有方向鍵都會移動並循環，Home / End 跳轉，Enter 選取，Escape 關閉並將焦點返回新增按鈕。每次變化都會以禮貌方式通報。

trans-unit.source: Name and tooltip of the add button (default "Add reaction").
trans-unit.target: 新增按鈕的名稱與提示（預設 "Add reaction"）。

trans-unit.source: True while the picker is open.
trans-unit.target: 選取器開啟時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the bar (default "Reactions").
trans-unit.target: 回應列的無障礙名稱（預設 "Reactions"）。

trans-unit.source: Every reaction the picker offers, in picker order (inline children or a bound list).
trans-unit.target: 選取器提供的所有回應，依選取器中的順序排列（內嵌子項或繫結清單）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the picker tray (default "Add a reaction").
trans-unit.target: 選取器托盤的無障礙名稱（預設 "Add a reaction"）。

trans-unit.source: Gap between the picker and the add button (the theme sets Arc's sideOffset 8).
trans-unit.target: 選取器與新增按鈕之間的間距（主題設定 Arc 的 sideOffset 為 8）。

trans-unit.source: How long a pointer rests on a pill before its tooltip shows (the theme sets Arc's 0.45s).
trans-unit.target: 指標停留在回應膠囊上多久後顯示其提示（主題設定 Arc 的 0.45s）。

trans-unit.source: Builds a pill's tooltip from its option and reaction; null uses the label followed by who reacted ("Love · You, Ada and 2 others").
trans-unit.target: 根據選項與回應建立膠囊的提示；為 null 時使用標籤加上誰做出了回應（"Love · You, Ada and 2 others"）。

trans-unit.source: The reactions shown, in bar order (two-way). A reaction whose count reaches zero leaves the bar.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的回應，依回應列中的順序排列（雙向繫結）。計數降為零的回應會離開回應列。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the viewer adds or removes a reaction (Arc's onValueChange), after `Value` changed.
trans-unit.target: 檢視者新增或移除回應時觸發（Arc 的 onValueChange），於 `Value` 變更之後。

trans-unit.source: A live line chart that scrolls continuously as readings arrive, holds still under the pointer so a point can be read, and marks readings flagged as anomalies. Feed it through `Points` or `Append`.
trans-unit.target: 隨讀數到達而持續捲動的即時折線圖，指標懸停時靜止以便讀取某個點，並標記被判定為異常的讀數。透過 `Points` 或 `Append` 饋入。

trans-unit.source: Message shown before the first reading.
trans-unit.target: 第一個讀數到達前顯示的訊息。

trans-unit.source: The usual time between readings (default 1 second). The view trails the newest reading by this, so the line has somewhere to go until the next one arrives.
trans-unit.target: 讀數之間的通常間隔（預設 1 秒）。檢視比最新讀數落後這麼多，這樣折線在下一個讀數到達前一直有前進的餘地。

trans-unit.source: True while the view holds still for any reason: `IsPaused`, the pointer or the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 檢視因任何原因保持靜止時為 true：`IsPaused`、指標或鍵盤。

trans-unit.source: Holds the view still while the pointer is over the plot (default true).
trans-unit.target: 指標停留在繪圖區上時讓檢視保持靜止（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Holds the view still; readings that arrive meanwhile are kept (two-way). Set by the status button, Space and Enter.
trans-unit.target: 讓檢視保持靜止；期間到達的讀數會被保留（雙向）。由狀態按鈕、Space 和 Enter 設定。

trans-unit.source: What is measured, such as "Checkout latency"; shown above the value and names the chart for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 量測的內容，例如「Checkout latency」；顯示在數值上方，並作為圖表對輔助技術的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Text of the status button while the view follows the feed.
trans-unit.target: 檢視跟隨資料時狀態按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: Fixed upper end of the value axis (null: follow the data in view).
trans-unit.target: 數值軸固定的上端（null：跟隨檢視內的資料）。

trans-unit.source: Fixed lower end of the value axis (null: follow the data in view).
trans-unit.target: 數值軸固定的下端（null：跟隨檢視內的資料）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the view starts or stops holding still, for any reason.
trans-unit.target: 檢視因任何原因開始或停止保持靜止時引發。

trans-unit.source: Text of the status button while the view holds still.
trans-unit.target: 檢視保持靜止時狀態按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: Height of the plot in pixels, without the time labels (default 200).
trans-unit.target: 繪圖區的高度（像素），不含時間標籤（預設 200）。

trans-unit.source: Readings in ascending time. An `INotifyCollectionChanged` source is watched, and its new items are appended; removing the oldest items from it does not change the view.
trans-unit.target: 依時間遞增排列的讀數。`INotifyCollectionChanged` 資料來源會被監看，其新增項目會被附加；從中移除最舊的項目不會改變檢視。

trans-unit.source: Formats times (default: HH:mm:ss, in the offset the readings carry).
trans-unit.target: 格式化時間（預設：HH:mm:ss，採用讀數所帶的時區位移）。

trans-unit.source: Unit after each value, such as "ms".
trans-unit.target: 每個數值後面的單位，例如「ms」。

trans-unit.source: Formats values (default: grouped, one decimal at most, true minus sign, then `Unit`). With a formatter the header shows its text instead of rolling digits.
trans-unit.target: 格式化數值（預設：分組，最多一位小數，真正的減號，後接 `Unit`）。設定後頁首顯示其文字，而不是滾動數字。

trans-unit.source: How much time the plot shows (default 30 seconds).
trans-unit.target: 繪圖區顯示的時長（預設 30 秒）。

trans-unit.source: One reading of a `RealtimeStream`.
trans-unit.target: `RealtimeStream` 的一個讀數。

trans-unit.source: The collapsible thinking block of an AI reply (Arc Reasoning block, design reference). While the model thinks, a shimmering label counts the seconds and the latest reasoning streams under it in muted text, two lines tall. When it finishes it folds to "Thought for 7s" with a chevron; opening it shows the full reasoning as steps with headings on a quiet rail, then a footer with the outcome and a copy button. Give it the reasoning as one growing string in `Reasoning` (blank lines split paragraphs and a line written as `**Heading**` or `## Heading` starts a step) or as `ReasoningStep`s in `Steps`, and set `Status`. The seconds are counted here unless you set `Elapsed`. With no data it reads "Thought process" and has nothing to open; a `Simulation` plays a reasoning you pass in instead.
trans-unit.target: AI 回覆中可摺疊的思考區塊（Arc Reasoning block，設計參考）。模型思考時，一個閃爍的標籤逐秒計時，最新的推理以淡色文字在其下方串流出現，最多兩行。完成後它摺疊為帶箭頭的 "Thought for 7s"；展開後以軌道上的步驟呈現完整推理，底部是結果和複製按鈕。把推理作為一個不斷增長的字串傳給 `Reasoning`（空行分隔段落，寫成 `**Heading**` 或 `## Heading` 的行開始一個新步驟），或放入 `Steps`，並設定 `Status`。除非你自行設定 `Elapsed`，秒數由該區塊自己計時。沒有資料時，它顯示 "Thought process"，也沒有可展開的內容；`Simulation` 則會播放你傳入的推理。

trans-unit.source: Shows a Stop button while the model thinks; it raises `StopRequested`.
trans-unit.target: 在模型思考時顯示停止按鈕；它會引發 `StopRequested`。

trans-unit.source: The time the model has thought. Null counts it here while thinking and keeps the count after.
trans-unit.target: 模型已思考的時間。為 null 時，在思考期間由該區塊自行計時，結束後保留計數。

trans-unit.source: The reason shown at the end of the reasoning when `Status` is `Error`.
trans-unit.target: `Status` 為 `Error` 時，顯示在推理末尾的原因。

trans-unit.source: Whether the steps are open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 步驟是否展開（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 該區塊顯示或朗讀的每一個文字。

trans-unit.source: The 18px mark at the left of the head (a 24 × 24 stroked glyph); the sparkle by default.
trans-unit.target: 頭部左側 18px 的標記（24 × 24 的描邊圖示）；預設為星芒。

trans-unit.source: The mark's color; the accent by default.
trans-unit.target: 標記的顏色；預設為強調色。

trans-unit.source: The reasoning so far as one string. Set it as it grows; it takes the place of `Steps`.
trans-unit.target: 到目前為止的推理，作為一個字串。隨其增長不斷設定它；它取代 `Steps`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Retry on a failed block. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 當人在失敗的區塊上按下重試時引發。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: A simulated model to play while the block has no reasoning, steps, status or time of its own (demos and prototypes). The block starts it over each time it takes it up; null shows the block's own state.
trans-unit.target: 要播放的模擬模型，在該區塊沒有自己的推理、步驟、狀態或時間時使用（展示與原型）。該區塊每次接手它時都會從頭開始；為 null 時顯示該區塊自己的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Where the block is: thinking, done, stopped or failed.
trans-unit.target: 該區塊所處的狀態：思考中、已完成、已停止或失敗。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Stop. Bubbles. Abort your request, then set `Status` to Stopped.
trans-unit.target: 當人按下停止時引發。會冒泡。終止你的請求，然後把 `Status` 設為 Stopped。

trans-unit.source: A card or a plain block.
trans-unit.target: 卡片或精簡樣式的區塊。

trans-unit.source: Every word `ReasoningBlock` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; the times are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `ReasoningBlock` 顯示或朗讀的每一個文字，預設為英文。若要在地化或改寫，請替換整個物件；時間是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: Plays a reasoning into a `ReasoningBlock` the way a model streams it, for demos, prototypes and tests: the block thinks, the seconds count, and `Reasoning` arrives three words every 45ms; then the block finishes with the time it took. Nothing is sent to a model. Set it as the block's `Simulation`. The block plays it while it has no reasoning, steps, status or time of its own, starts it over each time it takes it up, and advances it only while it is on screen; Stop on the block stops it. Use one simulation per block. It has no timer of its own: without a block, call `Advance` with the time that passed.
trans-unit.target: 像模型串流輸出那樣把一段推理播放到 `ReasoningBlock` 中，用於展示、原型和測試：該區塊進入思考、逐秒計時，`Reasoning` 以每 45ms 三個詞的速度到達；然後該區塊以所用的時間完成。不會向任何模型傳送內容。把它設為該區塊的 `Simulation`。該區塊在沒有自己的推理、步驟、狀態或時間時播放它，每次接手時從頭開始，只在顯示於螢幕上時推進；該區塊上的停止按鈕會停止它。每個區塊使用一個模擬。它沒有自己的計時器：沒有區塊時，呼叫 `Advance` 並傳入經過的時間。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the text, the status or the shown second changes.
trans-unit.target: 文字、狀態或顯示的秒數變化時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised once the last word is in and the simulated model has stopped thinking.
trans-unit.target: 最後一個詞到達、模擬模型停止思考時引發一次。

trans-unit.source: The whole reasoning to stream, written the way `Reasoning` reads it (blank lines split paragraphs, `**Heading**` starts a step). A change takes effect the next time the simulation starts.
trans-unit.target: 要串流輸出的完整推理，寫法與 `Reasoning` 的讀取方式相同（空行分隔段落，`**Heading**` 開始一個步驟）。修改會在模擬下次開始時生效。

trans-unit.source: One step of a model's reasoning: an optional heading and the text under it. Change `Text` in place as the model streams; the `ReasoningBlock` follows every change.
trans-unit.target: 模型推理的一個步驟：一個選用的標題和其下的文字。模型串流輸出時就地修改 `Text`；`ReasoningBlock` 會跟隨每次修改。

trans-unit.source: The step's heading (a few words); empty for a step that is only text.
trans-unit.target: 步驟的標題（幾個詞）；僅有文字的步驟為空。

trans-unit.source: The step's text.
trans-unit.target: 步驟的文字。

trans-unit.source: One thought of a `ReasoningTree`: a short label for the node, the full sentence for the tag and screen readers, an illustrative score and the thoughts it leads to. The tree reads three levels: the thoughts given to `Thoughts` are depth 1, their children depth 2 and their grandchildren depth 3; deeper thoughts are ignored. Add a thought to one parent only.
trans-unit.target: `ReasoningTree` 中的一個思路：節點的簡短標籤、用於標籤與螢幕閱讀器的完整句子、一個示意分數，以及它所通向的思路。樹會呈現三個層級：給予 `Thoughts` 的思路為深度 1，它們的子節點為深度 2，孫節點為深度 3；更深的思路將被忽略。請只把一個思路加入一個父節點下。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Key` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Key` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Label` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Score` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Score` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Text` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Text` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of tree search over thoughts (tree of thoughts with beam search). Each depth proposes candidate thoughts as edges draw out of their parents, scores them with bars that fill while the digits count, keeps the best `BeamWidth` and prunes the rest (they fade and their edges retract), and the survivors expand one depth further, up to three. The last depth picks its best thought as the answer, and the winning path draws from the question to the answer with a sheen at its head while each node on it lights up. Play, pause, step and restart drive the story; the beam width control starts it over. Wide cards read left to right in four columns; narrow ones become an indented outline. The scores are illustrative values, not the output of a model.
trans-unit.target: 對思路進行樹搜尋（思路樹加束搜尋）的動畫講解。每個深度會提出候選思路，邊線從其父節點抽出；隨著數字計數，長條逐漸填滿以為其評分；保留最佳的 `BeamWidth` 個並剪枝其餘（它們淡出，邊線收回），倖存者再向下展開一層，最多三層。最後一層選出其最佳思路作為答案，獲勝路徑從問題繪製至答案，光澤位於其頭部，路徑上的每個節點依序亮起。寬卡片從左到右分為四欄閱讀；窄卡片則變為縮排的大綱。播放、暫停、單步與重新開始控制演示過程；束寬控制項會使其重新開始。分數為示意值，並非模型的輸出。

trans-unit.target: 定義 `Answered` 路由事件。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `BeamWidth` property.

trans-unit.target: 定義 `ThoughtsSource` 屬性。
