trans-unit.target: `Answered` 的參數：搜尋所到達的答案，以及它是如何得出的。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `ReasoningTree` shows or announces, in English by default: column headers, the header status, the beam width label, the tag and accessible names of the thoughts and the polite announcements. Replace the instance to translate or reword; sentences with numbers are functions so that word order can change. The playback buttons are named by `PlaybackLabels`.
trans-unit.target: `ReasoningTree` 顯示或宣讀的每一個文字，預設為英文：欄標題、標題狀態、束寬標籤、思路的標籤與無障礙名稱，以及即時區域的播報。替換整個實例即可翻譯或改寫；包含數字的句子為函數，以便調整詞序。播放按鈕的名稱由 `PlaybackLabels` 指定。

trans-unit.source: One person invited through a `ReferralCard`.
trans-unit.target: 透過 `ReferralCard` 邀請的一個人。

trans-unit.source: A give-and-get referral card (Arc Referral card, design reference). The ask on top ("Give $20, get $20"), the invite link in a quiet field with a Copy button and three share buttons (a post, a network and email, drawn with generic glyphs), and an invite-by-email field that turns each address into a chip. Below, the funnel as three rolling numbers (invited, signed up, earned), a segmented milestone bar with the reward it unlocks, and the people invited with their avatar and stage as a glyph plus a word. Everything is derived from `Referrals`: pass the list from your backend and replace it when sign-ups and payments come in. Stage changes crossfade in place, the earned total counts up, and reaching the goal turns the bar and its line into the unlocked state. Sending invites calls `InviteHandler`; without one the send is simulated. With no referrals the card plays its `Simulation` (your program) once when it is 40% on screen; with neither it is empty: zero counts and "No invites yet".
trans-unit.target: 雙向獎勵的推薦卡片（Arc Referral card，設計參考）。頂部是邀約（"Give $20, get $20"），邀請連結放在一個安靜的欄位裡，附複製按鈕和三個分享按鈕（貼文、人脈和電子郵件，使用通用圖示），另有一個依電子郵件邀請的欄位，把每個地址變成一個標籤。下方是三個滾動數字組成的漏斗（已邀請、已註冊、已賺取）、顯示所解鎖獎勵的分段里程碑進度列，以及被邀請的人：頭像加上以圖示和文字表示的階段。一切都由 `Referrals` 推導：傳入後端的清單，並在有人註冊或付款時替換它。階段變化在原位交叉淡化，已賺取總額累加，達到目標時進度列及其文字變為已解鎖狀態。傳送邀請會呼叫 `InviteHandler`；沒有它時傳送是模擬的。沒有推薦資料時，卡片在有 40% 進入畫面時播放一次它的 `Simulation`（你的計畫）；兩者都沒有時卡片為空：計數為零，並顯示 "No invites yet"。

trans-unit.source: The ISO 4217 code used to format the reward and the total ("USD" writes "$20").
trans-unit.target: 用於格式化獎勵和總額的 ISO 4217 貨幣代碼（"USD" 寫作 "$20"）。

trans-unit.source: One or two lines under the heading. Null says what both sides get.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一兩行文字。為 null 時說明雙方各得什麼。

trans-unit.source: The subject of the share email, or null for none.
trans-unit.target: 分享郵件的主旨，為 null 時沒有主旨。

trans-unit.source: Sends the invites. Send stays busy until the task ends; a failed task keeps the chips and shows the exception's message; on success the addresses join the top of the list as Invited. The token is cancelled when the card leaves the screen. Null simulates the send.
trans-unit.target: 傳送邀請。工作結束前傳送按鈕保持忙碌狀態；工作失敗時保留標籤並顯示例外訊息；成功後這些地址以 Invited 狀態加入清單頂部。卡片離開畫面時取消權杖。為 null 時模擬傳送。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a send succeeded (or was simulated), with the addresses. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 傳送成功（或模擬傳送）後引發，附上這些地址。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的每一個詞。

trans-unit.source: The person's invite link. The domain shows muted and the code in full color; Copy copies the whole URL.
trans-unit.target: 此人的邀請連結。網域以弱化色顯示，邀請碼以內文色顯示；複製按鈕複製完整 URL。

trans-unit.source: Raised after Copy has written the link to the clipboard. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 複製按鈕把連結寫入剪貼簿後引發。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: The most addresses one send can hold. Extra addresses are refused with a note.
trans-unit.target: 一次傳送最多可包含的地址數。多出的地址會被拒絕並附上說明。

trans-unit.source: The bonus after a number of paid referrals: the goal (up to 12 segments are drawn), the reward in a few words and an optional line shown once unlocked. Null (the default) hides the milestone.
trans-unit.target: 達到一定數量的付費推薦後獲得的額外獎勵：目標（最多繪製 12 段）、用幾個詞說明的獎勵，以及解鎖後顯示的選用說明。為 null（預設）時隱藏里程碑。

trans-unit.source: Raised once when paid referrals reach the milestone's goal. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 付費推薦達到里程碑目標時引發一次。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: The share URL of the network button, with `{url}` and `{text}` placeholders. Null passes the link itself.
trans-unit.target: 人脈按鈕的分享 URL，帶 `{url}` 和 `{text}` 預留位置。為 null 時直接傳遞連結本身。

trans-unit.source: The share URL of the post button, with `{url}` and `{text}` placeholders (filled escaped), for example your social network's share intent. Null passes the link itself.
trans-unit.target: 貼文按鈕的分享 URL，帶 `{url}` 和 `{text}` 預留位置（以跳脫後的值填入），例如你的社群網路的分享網址。為 null 時直接傳遞連結本身。

trans-unit.source: Everyone invited, newest first. The counts, the milestone and the list are derived from it, and the card follows it when you replace it. Null shows the `Simulation`'s program, or the empty card.
trans-unit.target: 所有被邀請的人，依由新到舊排列。計數、里程碑和清單都由它推導，替換它時卡片隨之更新。為 null 時顯示 `Simulation` 的計畫，否則顯示空卡片。

trans-unit.source: The credit each side gets, in whole currency units. Drives the heading, the Earned total and the rows' Earned label; 0 (the default) leaves the amount out of the words.
trans-unit.target: 雙方各得的獎勵，以整數貨幣單位計。決定標題、已賺取總額以及各列的 Earned 標籤；為 0（預設）時文字中不寫金額。

trans-unit.source: Text that goes with the link in a post, a network share and the email body.
trans-unit.target: 在貼文、人脈分享和郵件內文中與連結一起出現的文字。

trans-unit.target: 標題。為 null 時由獎勵產生："Give $20, get $20"（沒有獎勵時為 "Invite friends"）。

trans-unit.target: `ReferralCard` 顯示或朗讀的每一個詞，預設是英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫措辭；數量、金額和日期是格式化函式。金額傳入時已經格式化（"$20"）。

Give it to `Simulation`; while the card has no referrals of its own it shows this list and plays `Beats` once when it is 40% on screen (twice as fast under reduced motion), and moves the first address of each simulated send through the stages. trans-unit.source: A release gate: a few checks that must all be done before the one action unlocks. While it runs the button shows a spinner and the checks lock; on success the button reads `ReleasedText`, a status line opens under the footer and a reset button appears; on failure the error shows in the same line and the release can be tried again.
trans-unit.target: 發布關卡：若干檢查項目，必須全部完成後才能解鎖唯一的操作。標題列會列出發布名稱及其負責人，進度條隨檢查項目勾選而填滿（所有必要項目完成後變為綠色），開關決定是否通知頻道，按鈕執行 `ReleaseAction`。執行期間按鈕顯示載入指示，檢查項目會被鎖定；成功時按鈕顯示 `ReleasedText`，頁尾下方開啟狀態列，並出現重設按鈕；失敗時錯誤訊息顯示在同一列，且可再次嘗試發布。

trans-unit.source: Arc's reorderable list: organize items with direct drag and drop. Rows are dragged by their grip (pointer capture): the row lifts, follows the pointer, the rows it passes slide aside on springs and the drop settles on a quick spring with the release velocity; holding a row near the edge of a scrolling ancestor scrolls it. Keyboard: ↑/↓ on a grip moves the row one place at once (Arc), Space / Enter picks it up so arrows preview the move, Space / Enter drops it and Escape cancels; every step is announced. A mutable `ItemsSource` (or inline items) is reordered in place; `Reordered` reports each move. Drag motion is render transforms only.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可重新排序清單：透過直接拖放整理項目。列透過抓手拖曳（指標擷取）：列會抬起並跟隨指標，經過的列會以彈簧滑開，放開時以快速彈簧結合放開速度落定；將列按住在捲動祖先的邊緣附近會捲動它。鍵盤操作：抓手上的 ↑/↓ 會立即將該列移動一位（與 Arc 一致），Space / Enter 拾起該列，此時方向鍵可預覽移動，Space / Enter 放下，Escape 取消；每一步都會被通報。可變的 `ItemsSource`（或內嵌項目）會就地重新排序；`Reordered` 回報每次移動。拖曳動態效果僅使用渲染變換。

trans-unit.source: Title used in the grip's accessible name and in announcements (defaults to `Title` or the item text).
trans-unit.target: 用於抓手無障礙名稱與通報的標題（預設為 `Title` 或項目文字）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the list.
trans-unit.target: 清單的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: When true (default) a mutable source is reordered in place; otherwise only `Reordered` is raised.
trans-unit.target: 為 true（預設）時，可變的資料來源會就地重新排序；否則僅引發 `Reordered`。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a row was moved by dragging or from the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 透過拖曳或鍵盤移動某一列之後引發。

trans-unit.source: A row of a `ReorderableList` as Arc models it: an id, a title and an optional detail line.
trans-unit.target: Arc 建模的 `ReorderableList` 中的一列：包含一個 id、一個標題，以及一個可選的詳細資訊行。

trans-unit.source: An AI email reply drafter (Arc Reply draft, design reference): a received email with an AI reply streaming under it. Quick reply chips steer a fresh draft, which streams in chunks of 3 to 8 words that each fade in over 140ms while the draft box springs to its height. Tone (Friendly, Concise, Formal) and length (Short, Medium, Long) rewrite a finished draft with one crossfade: the old text dims, fades out in 100ms and the new one fades in over 160ms rising 2px. The finished draft is plain editable text; Regenerate writes a new one, and Insert (or Cmd/Ctrl+Enter anywhere in the card) hands the text, with the reader's edits, to `InsertHandler` and `InsertRequested`. Give it a `Message`, `Suggestions` and a `Generator` that streams your model's reply. Without a message it plays a `Simulation` (an email and the replies you wrote for it, nothing is sent) and, unless the reader touches it, tours tones, length, a second quick reply and Insert on a loop while it is on screen. With neither it shows an empty email and a draft box that cannot draft.
trans-unit.target: AI 郵件回覆起草器（Arc Reply draft，設計參考）：一封收到的郵件，下方串流寫出 AI 回覆。快速回覆標籤引導一份新的草稿，草稿以每塊 3 到 8 個詞的片段串流出現，每塊在 140ms 內淡入，同時草稿框以彈簧過渡到新高度。語氣（Friendly、Concise、Formal）與長度（Short、Medium、Long）以一次交叉淡化改寫已完成的草稿：舊文字變暗，在 100ms 內淡出，新文字在 160ms 內淡入並上升 2px。完成的草稿是可編輯的純文字；Regenerate 重新寫一份，Insert（或在卡片內任意位置按 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter）把包含讀者修改的文字交給 `InsertHandler` 與 `InsertRequested`。為它提供 `Message`、`Suggestions` 以及串流輸出模型回覆的 `Generator`。沒有郵件時，它播放 `Simulation`（一封郵件和你為它寫好的回覆，不寄出任何內容），並且只要讀者沒有操作它，就會在可見時循環示範語氣、長度、第二個快速回覆與 Insert。兩者都沒有時，顯示一封空白郵件和一個無法起草的草稿框。

trans-unit.source: Tours tones, length, a second quick reply and Insert on a loop. It stops for good on the first pointer or key press inside the card and pauses off screen. Null turns it on only while a `Simulation` plays; leave it off in products.
trans-unit.target: 循環示範語氣、長度、第二個快速回覆與 Insert。在卡片內第一次按下指標或按鍵後永久停止，離開畫面時暫停。為 null 時僅在播放 `Simulation` 時開啟；在產品中請關閉。

trans-unit.source: Starts the first draft when the card scrolls into view. When false the draft box shows an empty state with a Draft reply button.
trans-unit.target: 卡片捲動進入檢視時開始寫第一份草稿。為 false 時草稿框顯示帶 Draft reply 按鈕的空狀態。

trans-unit.source: The draft on screen, including the reader's edits; empty before the first draft.
trans-unit.target: 螢幕上的草稿，包含讀者的修改；第一份草稿之前為空。

trans-unit.source: Raised each time a draft or rewrite finishes. Cancelled and failed requests do not raise it. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 每當一份草稿或改寫完成時引發。被取消或失敗的請求不會引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Writes the draft as a stream of text deltas. Every new action cancels the previous request's token. Without it a message of yours cannot be drafted; a playing `Simulation` does not use it.
trans-unit.target: 以文字增量串流的形式寫出草稿。每個新操作都會取消上一個請求的權杖。沒有它時，你自己的郵件無法起草；正在播放的 `Simulation` 不會使用它。

trans-unit.source: Puts the draft into your composer. While its task runs, Insert shows a spinner. With neither this nor a handler that marks `InsertRequested` handled, Insert is simulated and says that nothing was sent.
trans-unit.target: 把草稿放入你的編輯器。其工作執行期間，Insert 顯示載入圈。既沒有它，也沒有把 `InsertRequested` 標記為已處理的處理常式時，插入是模擬的，並會說明沒有寄出任何內容。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Insert is pressed (or Cmd/Ctrl+Enter), with the final draft and the reader's edits, before `InsertHandler` runs. Mark it handled when you insert the text here, so the card does not say it was simulated. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 按下 Insert（或 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter）時，在 `InsertHandler` 執行之前引發，帶有最終草稿與讀者的修改。如果你在這裡插入文字，請將它標記為已處理，這樣卡片就不會說是模擬的。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Adds "Simulated, nothing was sent" to announcements and errors. Null turns it on while a `Simulation` plays or there is no `Generator`.
trans-unit.target: 在播報與錯誤中加上 "Simulated, nothing was sent"。為 null 時，在播放 `Simulation` 或沒有 `Generator` 時開啟。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或播報的每個詞。

trans-unit.source: The length (two-way). Works like `Tone`.
trans-unit.target: 長度（雙向）。行為與 `Tone` 相同。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the reader picks a length (not when the app or the tour sets it). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 讀者選擇長度時引發（應用程式或示範設定時不引發）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The received email; null plays `Simulation`, or shows an empty email without one.
trans-unit.target: 收到的郵件；為 null 時播放 `Simulation`，沒有模擬時顯示一封空白郵件。

trans-unit.source: The model credited on the reply, with its 16px mark; null credits the `Simulation`'s model while one plays, or none.
trans-unit.target: 回覆上署名的模型及其 16px 標記；為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間署名其模型，否則不署名。

trans-unit.source: The id of the quick reply steering the draft (two-way). Null, or an id that is not in the list, means the first suggestion. Setting it after the first draft writes a fresh one.
trans-unit.target: 正在引導草稿的快速回覆的 id（雙向）。為 null 或不在清單中的 id 時表示第一個快速回覆。在第一份草稿之後設定它會寫出一份新的草稿。

trans-unit.source: An email to play while the card has no `Message`: the message, quick replies, model and the replies written for them, streamed as a simulation (nothing is sent). Your own `Message` wins over it; null stops it and shows the empty card.
trans-unit.target: 卡片沒有 `Message` 時要播放的郵件：郵件、快速回覆、模型以及為它們寫好的回覆，以模擬方式串流輸出（不寄出任何內容）。你自己的 `Message` 優先於它；為 null 時停止播放並顯示空卡片。

trans-unit.source: The 24 × 24 stroked mark before the subject; null draws a generic mail glyph.
trans-unit.target: 主旨前的 24 × 24 描邊標記；為 null 時繪製通用的郵件圖示。

trans-unit.source: Where the card is: idle, drafting, rewriting, ready, inserting, inserted or failed.
trans-unit.target: 卡片所處的狀態：閒置、起草中、改寫中、就緒、插入中、已插入或失敗。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the reader chooses a quick reply chip, before its draft starts. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 讀者選擇快速回覆標籤時、在其草稿開始之前引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The quick replies shown as chips above the draft; choosing one streams a fresh draft steered by it. Null shows the `Simulation`'s while one plays; null or an empty list hides the row.
trans-unit.target: 以標籤顯示在草稿上方的快速回覆；選擇其中一個會串流寫出由它引導的新草稿。為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間顯示其快速回覆；為 null 或空清單時隱藏這一列。

trans-unit.source: The tone (two-way). Changing it rewrites a finished draft with one crossfade, or restarts a draft that is still streaming.
trans-unit.target: 語氣（雙向）。變更它會以一次交叉淡化改寫已完成的草稿，或重新開始仍在串流輸出的草稿。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the reader picks a tone (not when the app or the tour sets it). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 讀者選擇語氣時引發（應用程式或示範設定時不引發）。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `DraftCompleted` and `InsertRequested`: the text and how it was written.
trans-unit.target: `DraftCompleted` 與 `InsertRequested` 的引數：文字及其寫法。

trans-unit.source: Writes a `ReplyDraft` reply as a stream of text deltas. Yield chunks from your model's stream, or wrap a whole text with `FromText` to have it streamed locally in chunks. Throw to show the error state; honour `CancellationToken`.
trans-unit.target: 以文字增量串流的形式寫出 `ReplyDraft` 的回覆。從模型的串流中逐塊產出，或用 `FromText` 包裝整段文字，讓它在本機分塊串流輸出。擲回例外即顯示錯誤狀態；請遵守 `CancellationToken`。

trans-unit.source: Puts a finished `ReplyDraft` reply into your composer. While the returned task runs, Insert shows a spinner; a fault shows the error in the status line and keeps the draft.
trans-unit.target: 把完成的 `ReplyDraft` 回覆放入你的編輯器。傳回的工作執行期間，Insert 顯示載入圈；出錯時在狀態列顯示錯誤並保留草稿。

trans-unit.source: Every word `ReplyDraft` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; the words that carry a name or a count are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraft` 顯示或播報的每個詞，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；帶有名稱或數量的詞是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: How long a `ReplyDraft` reply is.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraft` 回覆的長度。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `LengthChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `LengthChanged` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: The received email a `ReplyDraft` answers: who sent it, the subject, the body (blank lines split paragraphs) and when it arrived. Data only.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraft` 回覆的那封收到的郵件：寄件人、主旨、內文（空行分隔段落）以及送達時間。僅為資料。

trans-unit.source: What a `ReplyDraftRequest` asks the generator for.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraftRequest` 要求產生器寫什麼。

trans-unit.source: What a `ReplyDraftGenerator` is asked to write.
trans-unit.target: 要求 `ReplyDraftGenerator` 寫出的內容。

trans-unit.source: An email a `ReplyDraft` plays without a generator, from data you give it: the received message, the quick replies, the model credited and the replies you wrote for each quick reply, tone and length. Set it as `Simulation` while the card has no `Message`: the card shows the email, streams the matching reply after a short read (3 to 8 words every 34ms), says it is simulated (nothing is sent) and, unless `AutoPlay` is false, tours tones, length, a second quick reply and Insert on a loop.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraft` 在沒有產生器時依你提供的資料播放的郵件：收到的郵件、快速回覆、署名的模型，以及你為每個快速回覆、語氣和長度寫好的回覆。在卡片沒有 `Message` 時把它設為 `Simulation`：卡片顯示郵件，在短暫的閱讀之後串流輸出相符的回覆（每 34ms 3 到 8 個詞），說明這是模擬（不寄出任何內容），並且除非 `AutoPlay` 為 false，會循環示範語氣、長度、第二個快速回覆與 Insert。

trans-unit.source: Where a `ReplyDraft` is.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraft` 所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Streams for `ReplyDraft`: a wrapper that streams a whole text locally and the chunker it and `ReplyDraftSimulation` use (3 to 8 words every 34ms). Nothing is sent.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraft` 的串流：在本機串流輸出整段文字的包裝器，以及它和 `ReplyDraftSimulation` 共用的分塊器（每 34ms 3 到 8 個詞）。不寄出任何內容。

trans-unit.source: A quick reply chip of a `ReplyDraft`: a stable id the prompt understands and the label readers see.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraft` 的一個快速回覆標籤：提示詞能理解的穩定 id，以及讀者看到的標籤文字。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `SuggestionSelected`.
trans-unit.target: `SuggestionSelected` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: The voice of a `ReplyDraft` reply.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraft` 回覆的語氣。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ToneChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `ToneChanged` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: One reply of a `ReplyDraftSimulation`: the quick reply, tone and length it answers, and its text.
trans-unit.target: `ReplyDraftSimulation` 的一則回覆：它回應的快速回覆、語氣和長度，以及它的文字。

trans-unit.source: Fails an empty value (null, empty text).
trans-unit.target: 空值（null、空文字）不通過。

trans-unit.source: A deep-research run: the question, the plan, the sources being read with their progress, the notes taken from them, and the final report with numbered citations. Give it your run through `Question`, `Phase`, `Plan`, `Sources`, `Notes` and `Report`; the clock runs on its own until the report is ready. Without `Sources` it plays a built-in sample run. Once the report is ready the process folds into one line that opens again on demand. Citations and source rows raise `SourceInvoked`; when nobody handles it the source's address opens.
trans-unit.target: 一次深度研究：問題、計畫、正在閱讀的資料及其進度、從資料中記下的筆記，以及帶編號引用的最終報告。透過 `Question`、`Phase`、`Plan`、`Sources`、`Notes` 和 `Report` 提供你的研究；在報告完成前計時自動進行。未設定 `Sources` 時播放內建範例執行。報告完成後，過程收起成一行，可按需再次展開。引用和資料列會引發 `SourceInvoked`；沒人處理時會開啟資料的位址。

trans-unit.source: Whether the built-in sample run starts by itself when the control is shown (true).
trans-unit.target: 控制項顯示時內建範例執行是否自動開始（true）。

trans-unit.source: How many plan steps are done; the next one shows as current while the run works.
trans-unit.target: 已完成的計畫步驟數；執行中下一個步驟顯示為目前步驟。

trans-unit.source: The time the research has taken (two-way: it grows on its own while the run plans, reads or writes).
trans-unit.target: 研究已用的時間（雙向：計畫、閱讀或撰寫時自動增長）。

trans-unit.source: True while the run is at most 640 wide.
trans-unit.target: 執行寬度不超過 640 時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Whether the plan, sources and notes are open (two-way; they fold when the report is ready).
trans-unit.target: 計畫、資料和筆記是否展開（雙向；報告完成時收起）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the built-in sample run is shown (no `Sources` given).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示內建範例執行（未提供 `Sources`）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the run shows or reads out, with English defaults.
trans-unit.target: 執行顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。

trans-unit.source: The notes taken so far, oldest first; a collection that raises change notifications is followed.
trans-unit.target: 到目前為止記下的筆記，從舊到新；會跟隨能發出變更通知的集合。

trans-unit.source: Where the run stands (two-way: Stop sets Stopped, and the sample run sets every phase).
trans-unit.target: 執行所處的階段（雙向：Stop 設為 Stopped，範例執行會設定每個階段）。

trans-unit.source: The plan's steps in order.
trans-unit.target: 按順序排列的計畫步驟。

trans-unit.source: The question being researched. Default: the sample question.
trans-unit.target: 研究的問題。預設：範例問題。

trans-unit.source: The report: paragraphs separated by a blank line, citing sources by number in brackets ("[3]"). Set it as it is written; null or empty shows the report's place.
trans-unit.target: 報告：段落之間以空行分隔，用方括號中的編號引用資料（"[3]"）。邊寫邊設定；為 null 或空時顯示報告的佔位文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Research again. Start a new run and reset the properties here.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按下 Research again 時引發。請在這裡開始新的執行並重設屬性。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person opens a source from its row or a citation. Mark it handled to stop the address opening.
trans-unit.target: 使用者從資料列或引用開啟資料時引發。標為已處理即可阻止開啟位址。

trans-unit.source: The sources found, numbered by `Index`. A collection that raises change notifications is followed as sources arrive; each source's status and progress are followed too. Null (the default) plays the sample run.
trans-unit.target: 找到的資料，按 `Index` 編號。會跟隨能發出變更通知的集合中新到的資料，也會跟隨每份資料的狀態和進度。Null（預設）播放範例執行。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Stop (before the run is marked stopped). Cancel your research here.
trans-unit.target: 使用者按下 Stop 時引發（在執行被標為已停止之前）。請在這裡取消你的研究。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `ResearchRun` shows or reads out, with English defaults. Words built from values are functions, so an app can apply its own grammar. Assign a new instance to `Labels` to change them.
trans-unit.target: `ResearchRun` 顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。由值組成的文字是函式，應用程式可以套用自己的語法。給 `Labels` 指派一個新執行個體即可修改。

trans-unit.source: A note taken while reading: a finding and the numbers of the sources it rests on.
trans-unit.target: 閱讀時記下的一條筆記：一個發現以及它所依據資料的編號。

trans-unit.source: A source of a `ResearchRun`: an `AiSource` (title, domain, address, number) with how far it has been read. Change `Status` and `Progress` while the run is on screen and its row follows.
trans-unit.target: `ResearchRun` 的一份資料：一個 `AiSource`（標題、網站、位址、編號）以及已經讀了多少。執行顯示在螢幕上時修改 `Status` 和 `Progress`，對應的列會跟著變化。

trans-unit.source: How much of the source has been read, from 0 to 1.
trans-unit.target: 資料已經讀了多少，從 0 到 1。

trans-unit.source: Queued, reading, read or skipped.
trans-unit.target: 排隊、閱讀中、已讀或已捨棄。

trans-unit.source: One pane of a `ResizablePanels` group. It carries the pane's configuration (label, default share, limits, collapsibility) and shows its content. Below its minimum the content keeps its minimum size along the group's axis (width, or height in a vertical group), stays anchored to the moving edge and fades, so a closing pane slides away like a drawer instead of being crushed.
trans-unit.target: `ResizablePanels` 群組中的一個窗格。它承載窗格的設定（標籤、預設佔比、限制、是否可摺疊）並顯示其內容。低於最小尺寸時，內容在群組的方向上保持最小尺寸（寬度，垂直群組中為高度），錨定在移動的邊緣並淡出，因此關閉中的窗格會像抽屜一樣滑走，而不是被擠壓。

trans-unit.source: Starting share of the group; shares are relative and need not add up to 100.
trans-unit.target: 群組的起始比例；比例為相對值，不必加總為 100。

trans-unit.source: Stable id (dividers reference panes by id).
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id（分隔線透過 id 參照窗格）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the pane is hidden. Two-way; the initial value is Arc's defaultCollapsed (needs `IsCollapsible`).
trans-unit.target: 窗格是否已隱藏。雙向繫結；初始值取 Arc 的 defaultCollapsed（需要 `IsCollapsible`）。

trans-unit.source: Dragging well past the minimum, or flicking toward the edge, snaps the pane closed.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳明顯超過最小尺寸，或朝邊緣快速輕掃時，窗格會吸附關閉。

trans-unit.source: Names the pane for its divider, for example "Folders".
trans-unit.target: 為分隔線標示此窗格的名稱，例如 "Folders"。

trans-unit.source: Maximum size in px along the group's axis: width, or height in a vertical group (infinite by default).
trans-unit.target: 沿群組方向的最大尺寸，單位為 px：寬度，垂直群組中為高度（預設無限制）。

trans-unit.source: Size in px where the pane starts to resist (Arc: 80): its width, or its height in a vertical group. Its content never reflows below it.
trans-unit.target: 窗格開始產生阻力的尺寸，單位為 px（Arc 為 80）：寬度，垂直群組中為高度。低於此尺寸時內容不會重新排版。

trans-unit.source: Arc resizable panels: a split view whose panes, side by side or stacked (`Orientation`), trade space when the dividers between them are dragged, the way a mail or code editor window works. Dividers follow the pointer 1:1, resist past a pane's limits (rubber band up to 44px) and snap collapsible panes closed when dragged well past their minimum or flicked toward the edge; on release the panes settle on the smooth spring keeping the pointer's velocity. Each divider is focusable: arrows (Left / Right, or Up / Down when vertical) resize by 16px (Shift 64px) on the snappy spring, Home / End jump to the limits, Enter hides or restores a collapsible neighbour, Escape during a drag puts the divider back, and a double-click resets the layout. The group needs a definite height, whichever the orientation. `Sizes` (two-way, percent) persists the layout.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可調整大小的窗格：分割檢視，窗格並排或上下堆疊（`Orientation`），拖曳其間的分隔線時窗格之間相互讓出空間，與郵件或程式碼編輯器視窗的方式相同。分隔線以 1:1 緊隨指標，超出窗格限制時產生回彈（最多 44px）；拖到明顯超過最小尺寸，或朝邊緣快速輕掃時，可摺疊窗格會吸附關閉。放開後，窗格會以保留指標速度的平滑彈簧穩定下來。每條分隔線都可取得焦點：方向鍵（Left / Right，垂直時為 Up / Down）每次調整 16px（按住 Shift 為 64px），使用靈敏彈簧；Home / End 跳到限制位置；Enter 隱藏或還原可摺疊的相鄰窗格；拖曳過程中按 Escape 會將分隔線復位；雙擊會重設版面配置。無論哪個方向，此群組都需要確定的高度。`Sizes`（雙向，百分比）用於儲存版面配置。

trans-unit.source: Space in px between adjacent panes (default 1: the one pixel divider line). A wider gap shows no line at rest; the line and grip appear centred in it while the divider is hovered, focused or dragged, and the whole gap grabs.
trans-unit.target: 相鄰窗格之間的間距，單位為 px（預設 1：一像素的分隔線）。間距較寬時靜止狀態下不畫線；分隔線懸停、聚焦或拖曳時，線與握把出現在間距中央，並且整個間距都可以抓取。

trans-unit.source: Names the group for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 為此群組命名，供輔助技術使用。

trans-unit.source: Raised with each pane's share in percent after a resize settles.
trans-unit.target: 調整大小完成並穩定後引發，附帶每個窗格的比例（百分比）。

trans-unit.source: Horizontal (default) lays the panes out left to right with vertical dividers; Vertical stacks them top to bottom with horizontal dividers, sizes, limits and shares then being heights and the arrow keys Up / Down.
trans-unit.target: Horizontal（預設）從左到右排列窗格，分隔線為直線；Vertical 從上到下堆疊窗格，分隔線為橫線，此時尺寸、限制與佔比都指高度，方向鍵為 Up / Down。

trans-unit.source: Each pane's share in percent. Updated after every resize settles; set it (for example from saved settings) to restore a layout. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 每個窗格的比例（百分比）。每次調整大小完成後更新；設定它（例如從儲存的設定中讀取）即可還原版面配置。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: An AI reply card with its feedback (Arc Response feedback, design reference): the person's message in a bubble, the model's mark and name, the reply and an action row with copy, an optional regenerate and the thumbs of `FeedbackActions`. Thumbs down opens an inline panel with reason chips and an optional note, thumbs up fills and asks what was good, and a submit shows a short thank-you before the panel folds back into the row. With no data it shows the frame alone: the model's mark, an empty reply and the action row, whose feedback is simulated until you set a `FeedbackHandler`. Every property of `FeedbackActions` except `Leading` is available here.

trans-unit.source: Arc's light rich text editor: Markdown shortcuts as you type, a floating selection toolbar that morphs into a link field, a slash menu for blocks, its own undo history, and HTML plus Markdown output. Blocks are paragraphs, three heading levels, nested bulleted and numbered lists, quotes, code blocks and dividers; inline marks are bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code and links. The `Docs` profile adds images and tables: `ImageSourceRequested` lets the host decide where a picked, pasted or dropped picture is kept, and `ImageLoading` lets it load the pictures itself.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的輕量富文字編輯器：輸入時支援 Markdown 快速語法，浮動的選取工具列可變形為連結輸入框，斜線選單用於插入區塊，擁有獨立的復原歷程，並支援 HTML 與 Markdown 輸出。區塊包括段落、三級標題、巢狀的無序與有序清單、引用、程式碼區塊與分隔線；行內標記包括粗體、斜體、刪除線、行內程式碼與連結。`Docs` 設定檔還支援圖片與表格：`ImageSourceRequested` 讓主機決定選取、貼上或拖入的圖片存放在哪裡，`ImageLoading` 讓主機自行載入圖片。

trans-unit.source: A ridgeline (joy plot, Arc "Ridgeline"): one smoothed density curve per group, overlapping like ridges and shaded by median. Every curve is sampled on a shared 96-point grid, so a new dataset or domain morphs each ridge from its on-screen shape on one 0.7s spring; the first view rolls the rows in from the top. Hover or ↑ / ↓ lifts a ridge (a copy drawn above the rest) with its middle half and median; ← / → move a reading cursor along the values.
trans-unit.target: 山脊圖（joy plot，即 Arc 的 "Ridgeline"）：每組一條平滑的密度曲線，像山脊般相互重疊，並依中位數著色。所有曲線都在共享的 96 點網格上取樣，因此新的資料集或取值範圍會透過一個 0.7s 的彈簧，使每條山脊從目前螢幕形狀變形過渡；首次顯示時各列會從頂部滾入。懸停或按 ↑ / ↓ 可抬起一條山脊（在其他山脊上方繪製一份副本），並顯示其中間一半與中位數；← / → 沿數值移動讀數游標。

trans-unit.source: A workspace's roles × permissions matrix. Columns are roles, rows are permissions in collapsible groups; each cell is a switch and each group row has one tri-state checkbox per role that switches the whole group (the changed cells ripple one after another). Locked roles (the owner) always have everything. Changes are not applied at once: changed cells and their role headers get an unsaved dot, and a review bar slides up with the count, the roles they touch and the people they reach, Discard and Save. Save awaits `SaveHandler` with a spinner, reads "saved" for a moment and closes; a failed save keeps the changes and offers to try again. Each role header opens a menu to copy the role (inserted on its right as a new role), undo its edits, or remove a new role.
trans-unit.target: 工作區的角色 × 權限矩陣。欄是角色，列是可摺疊群組中的權限；每個儲存格是一個開關，每個群組列為每個角色提供一個三態核取方塊，用來切換整個群組（變更的儲存格會依序泛起漣漪）。鎖定的角色（擁有者）一律擁有全部權限。變更不會立即套用：變更的儲存格及其角色標頭會出現未儲存圓點，審閱列會從底部滑出，顯示變更數量、涉及的角色與受影響的人數，以及 Discard 和 Save。Save 會等待 `SaveHandler` 並顯示載入動畫，短暫顯示「saved」後關閉；儲存失敗時會保留變更並提供重試。每個角色標頭都會開啟一個選單，可複製該角色（作為新角色插入到其右側）、復原其編輯，或移除新角色。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a role's edits were undone, or every change was discarded.
trans-unit.target: 在某個角色的編輯被復原，或所有變更被捨棄時引發。

trans-unit.target: 繪製帶邊框、圓角半徑為 16 的卡片（true）；false 則平鋪該區塊並留出頁面邊距（依寬度為 16–32）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the role headers open their menu (copy, undo edits, remove).
trans-unit.target: 角色標頭是否開啟其選單（複製、復原編輯、移除）。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 該區塊顯示或朗讀的每一個詞。

trans-unit.source: The member count in the subtitle; null counts the members shown in the header.
trans-unit.target: 副標題中的成員數；為 null 時統計標頭中顯示的成員。

trans-unit.source: The workspace members shown as avatars in the header (`AvatarGroupMember`, names, ...), when you give them as a list; it wins over `Members`.
trans-unit.target: 在標頭以頭像顯示的工作區成員（`AvatarGroupMember`、名稱等），當你以清單提供時使用；優先於 `Members`。

trans-unit.source: The number the review bar shows: one per changed cell, plus one per new role.
trans-unit.target: 審閱列顯示的數字：每個變更的儲存格計一，每個新角色計一。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a new role was removed (its menu, or Discard).
trans-unit.target: 在某個新角色被移除時引發（透過其選單或 Discard）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a role was copied.
trans-unit.target: 在某個角色被複製時引發。

trans-unit.source: The roles (columns), when you give them as a list to follow (observed when it raises collection changes); it wins over `Roles`.
trans-unit.target: 角色（欄），當你以可跟隨的清單提供時使用（在其引發集合變更時被觀察）；優先於 `Roles`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the save handler threw.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存處理常式擲回例外時引發。

trans-unit.source: Stores the changes: awaited when Save is pressed (or `SaveAsync` is called) with what to save and a token that `CancelSave` or the block leaving the window cancels. While it runs the matrix takes no changes. An exception keeps the changes and shows the failure; a cancellation returns to the review bar quietly. Null saves at once.
trans-unit.target: 儲存變更：按下 Save（或呼叫 `SaveAsync`）時被等待，傳入要儲存的內容與一個權杖，`CancelSave` 或該區塊離開視窗時會取消該權杖。執行期間矩陣不接受變更。發生例外會保留變更並顯示失敗；取消則安靜地回到審閱列。為 null 時立即儲存。

trans-unit.source: Raised before a save runs; set `Cancel` to keep it from starting.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存執行之前引發；將 `Cancel` 設為 true 可阻止其開始。

trans-unit.source: Where the save stands.
trans-unit.target: 儲存目前所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the save handler finished without an error.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存處理常式無錯誤完成時引發。

trans-unit.source: The saved grants: the baseline unsaved dots compare against. A successful save writes the new baseline back (two-way). Locked roles need no grants.
trans-unit.target: 已儲存的授權：未儲存圓點用來比較的基準。儲存成功後會將新的基準寫回（雙向）。鎖定的角色不需要授權。

trans-unit.source: How long the review bar reads "saved" before it closes; null uses the token's 1.6 s.
trans-unit.target: 審閱列在關閉之前顯示「saved」的時間；為 null 時使用權杖中的 1.6 s。

trans-unit.source: The heading.
trans-unit.target: 標題。

trans-unit.source: The workspace named in the subtitle ("Northwind Studio · 31 people in 5 roles"); null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 副標題中提到的工作區（"Northwind Studio · 31 people in 5 roles"）；為 null 時省略。

trans-unit.source: One granted permission: the role `RoleKey` may do `PermissionKey`.
trans-unit.target: 一項已授予的權限：角色 `RoleKey` 可以執行 `PermissionKey`。

trans-unit.source: A group of permissions in a `RolesPermissions` matrix: a row with a disclosure button and one "whole group" checkbox per role (on when every permission of the group is on, mixed when some are), followed by its permissions.
trans-unit.target: `RolesPermissions` 矩陣中的一個權限群組：一列包含展開按鈕與每個角色一個「整個群組」核取方塊（該群組的所有權限都開啟時為勾選，部分開啟時為混合狀態），其後是它的權限。

trans-unit.source: Whether the group's permissions are shown (two-way: the disclosure button writes it back).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示該群組的權限（雙向：展開按鈕會將其寫回）。

trans-unit.source: A stable id the app can match the group by (events); null when it has none.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式可用來比對該群組的穩定 id（用於事件）；沒有時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The group's name.
trans-unit.target: 群組的名稱。

trans-unit.source: One permission of a `RolesPermissionsGroup`: a row with one switch per role.
trans-unit.target: `RolesPermissionsGroup` 的一項權限：每個角色一個開關的一列。

trans-unit.source: A longer explanation, read as the row's switches' help text; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 較長的說明，作為該列開關的說明文字被朗讀；為 null 時省略。

trans-unit.source: The stable id grants refer to (`PermissionKey`); unique in the matrix.
trans-unit.target: 授權所參照的穩定 id（`PermissionKey`）；在矩陣中唯一。

trans-unit.source: The permission's name: the row's label, also read in the switches' names ("Manager: Send invitations").
trans-unit.target: 權限的名稱：該列的標籤，也會在開關的名稱中被朗讀（"Manager: Send invitations"）。

trans-unit.source: Every word `RolesPermissions` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance (an object initializer that sets only what changes) to translate or reword. Formats use `{0}`, `{1}` placeholders; a malformed format shows as written instead of throwing.
trans-unit.target: `RolesPermissions` 顯示或朗讀的每一個詞，預設為英文。替換該執行個體（使用只設定有變更項目的物件初始設定式）即可翻譯或改寫。格式使用 `{0}`、`{1}` 預留位置；格式錯誤時會依原樣顯示而不是擲回例外。

trans-unit.source: One role of a `RolesPermissions` matrix: a column with its name, how many people hold it and a line for the header's menu. A locked role (the workspace owner) always has every permission: its cells show a muted check and cannot be changed. Roles the person duplicates in the block are new (`IsNew`) until the changes are saved.
trans-unit.target: `RolesPermissions` 矩陣中的一個角色：一欄包含其名稱、持有它的人數，以及供標頭選單使用的一行說明。鎖定的角色（工作區擁有者）一律擁有所有權限：其儲存格顯示柔和的勾選，且無法變更。使用者在區塊中複製的角色在變更儲存之前都是新角色（`IsNew`）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the name in the header's menu (who holds it); null shows the member count.
trans-unit.target: 標頭選單中名稱下方的一行（誰持有它）；為 null 時顯示成員數。

trans-unit.source: Whether the role always has every permission (a lock leads its name and its cells cannot change).
trans-unit.target: 該角色是否一律擁有所有權限（名稱前有鎖頭圖示，其儲存格無法變更）。

trans-unit.source: True for a role duplicated in the block and not saved yet; it reads "New role" and can be deleted.
trans-unit.target: 對在區塊中複製且尚未儲存的角色為 True；它顯示為 "New role" 並且可以移除。

trans-unit.source: The stable id grants refer to (`RoleKey`); it must be unique in the matrix.
trans-unit.target: 授權所參照的穩定 id（`RoleKey`）；在矩陣中必須唯一。

trans-unit.source: How many people hold the role: the header's second line ("4 people") and the reach in the review bar.
trans-unit.target: 持有該角色的人數：標頭的第二行（"4 people"）以及審閱列中涉及的人數。

trans-unit.source: The role's name: the column header and the menu's title.
trans-unit.target: 角色的名稱：欄標題和選單的標題。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app wants to keep with the role.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式希望與該角色一同保存的任意物件。

trans-unit.source: What a save of a `RolesPermissions` matrix carries: passed to `SaveHandler` and the save events. Everything is a snapshot taken when the save started.
trans-unit.target: 儲存 `RolesPermissions` 矩陣時攜帶的內容：傳給 `SaveHandler` 與儲存事件。所有內容都是儲存開始時的快照。

trans-unit.source: Where the save of a `RolesPermissions` matrix stands.
trans-unit.target: `RolesPermissions` 矩陣的儲存目前所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: A ticket that landed in a lane of a `TicketRouter`.
trans-unit.target: 落入 `TicketRouter` 某條泳道的工單。

trans-unit.source: Arc ruler slider: a precise value input shaped like a tape measure. A ruler of ticks slides under a fixed needle: drag it 1:1, flick it and it coasts onto a tick, pull it past either end and it rubber-bands back, or tap a spot to glide it there. The readout rolls each digit as the tape passes. Arrows step one tick, Shift+arrows and PageUp / PageDown move `LargeChange`, Home and End go to the ends, and horizontal trackpad scrolling moves the tape. `SmallChange` is the value of one small tick, and the tape always rests on a tick.
trans-unit.target: Arc 刻度尺滑桿：形如捲尺的精確數值輸入。一條刻度在固定指針下滑動：1:1 拖曳，輕掃後滑行到一個刻度上，拉過任一端後以橡皮筋方式彈回，或點按某處讓它滑到那裡。刻度帶經過時，讀數的每一位數字都會捲動。方向鍵移動一個刻度，Shift+方向鍵和 PageUp / PageDown 移動 `LargeChange`，Home 和 End 轉到兩端，水平觸控板捲動也會移動刻度帶。`SmallChange` 是一個小刻度代表的值，刻度帶總是停在刻度上。

trans-unit.source: The visible label; it also names the control.
trans-unit.target: 可見的標籤，同時也是控制項的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Small ticks between labelled ticks.
trans-unit.target: 帶標籤的刻度之間的小刻度數。

trans-unit.source: Pixels between small ticks. Wider spacing gives finer control.
trans-unit.target: 小刻度之間的像素數。間距越寬，控制越精細。

trans-unit.source: The unit shown after the readout and spoken with the value, such as "cm".
trans-unit.target: 顯示在讀數後面並與值一起朗讀的單位，例如「cm」。

trans-unit.source: Raised once the tape comes to rest after a drag or a flick, and at once for a tap or a key.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳或輕掃後刻度帶靜止時觸發一次；點按或按鍵時立即觸發。

trans-unit.source: Formats the readout, the tick labels and the spoken value (default: en-US with the decimals of the step or the minimum).
trans-unit.target: 格式化讀數、刻度標籤和朗讀的值（預設：en-US，小數位取自步長或最小值）。

trans-unit.source: A line of text that crumbles into grains of sand and drifts away on the wind, then gathers back grain by grain into the same letters.
trans-unit.target: 一行文字碎成沙粒、隨風飄走，然後又一粒一粒聚回原來的字母。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the last grain has blown away.
trans-unit.target: 最後一粒沙被吹走時觸發。

trans-unit.source: How far a typical grain travels before it has faded, in px.
trans-unit.target: 一粒沙在消失前通常飄出的距離，單位為 px。

trans-unit.source: The way the wind blows the grains (right by default).
trans-unit.target: 風吹沙粒的方向（預設向右）。

trans-unit.source: How long the text takes to blow away completely, and to gather again.
trans-unit.target: 文字完全吹散所用的時間，聚回也用同樣的時間。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the last grain is back in its letter.
trans-unit.target: 最後一粒沙回到字母中時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The side of one grain in px; long or large text uses larger grains to stay within `MaxGrains`.
trans-unit.target: 一粒沙的邊長，單位為 px；文字較長或較大時會用更大的沙粒，以不超過 `MaxGrains`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the text has blown away (true) or stands gathered (false). Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 文字是已被吹散（true）還是聚在一起（false）。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: The most grains the text is broken into.
trans-unit.target: 文字最多碎成的沙粒數。

trans-unit.source: The text to show.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的文字。

trans-unit.source: What sets the text off: a click (the default), hovering, or nothing but code.
trans-unit.target: 由什麼觸發：點擊（預設）、懸停，或只由程式碼觸發。

trans-unit.source: A flow diagram: stages in columns, ribbons between them with a thickness proportional to their value, and particles drifting along the ribbons. Hovering or focusing a node or ribbon traces its share through the whole journey in the accent color while everything else dims. Below 420 px wide the columns become rows, read from top to bottom.
trans-unit.target: 流向圖：各階段排成欄，欄之間的色帶粗細與其值成正比，粒子沿色帶飄移。懸停或聚焦節點、色帶時，會以強調色追蹤其占比貫穿整段旅程，其他內容變暗。寬度低於 420 px 時欄變成列，由上到下閱讀。

trans-unit.source: Stage names drawn above each column, from the first column on.
trans-unit.target: 繪製在每欄上方的階段名稱，從第一欄開始。

trans-unit.source: Message shown while there are no flows (default "No flows yet").
trans-unit.target: 沒有流量時顯示的訊息（預設 "No flows yet"）。

trans-unit.source: Shows the switch that turns particles on and off (default true). Reduced motion removes it.
trans-unit.target: 顯示開啟或關閉粒子的開關（預設 true）。減少動態效果時會移除它。

trans-unit.source: Whether particles drift along the ribbons (two-way, default true). Reduced motion never draws them.
trans-unit.target: 粒子是否沿色帶飄移（雙向，預設 true）。減少動態效果時不繪製粒子。

trans-unit.source: What flows, such as "Trial journey, March"; names the chart for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 流動的內容，例如 "Trial journey, March"；為輔助科技命名圖表。

trans-unit.source: The flows between nodes: add them inline in XAML, or assign any list. Repeated pairs add up; self loops and values that are not positive are ignored.
trans-unit.target: 節點之間的流量：可在 XAML 中內嵌加入，也可指定任意清單。重複的節點對會累加；自我迴圈和非正數的值會被忽略。

trans-unit.source: The stages' nodes: add them inline in XAML, or assign any list. Link ends with no node here get a node named after their id.
trans-unit.target: 各階段的節點：可在 XAML 中內嵌加入，也可指定任意清單。在這裡沒有對應節點的連結端會得到一個以其 id 命名的節點。

trans-unit.source: Text of the particle switch (default "Particles").
trans-unit.target: 粒子開關的文字（預設 "Particles"）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `IsParticlesEnabled` changes.
trans-unit.target: `IsParticlesEnabled` 變更時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Height of the plot in pixels (default 340). The upright layout grows past it when its rows need more room.
trans-unit.target: 繪圖區高度，單位為像素（預設 340）。直向版面的列需要更多空間時會超過此高度。

trans-unit.source: Names the whole in share readouts: "42% of the total" (default "the total").
trans-unit.target: 在占比讀數中命名整體："42% of the total"（預設 "the total"）。

trans-unit.source: Text after each value, such as "k" or " users" (default empty).
trans-unit.target: 每個值後面的文字，例如 "k" 或 " users"（預設為空）。

trans-unit.source: Formats values (default: grouped, one decimal at most, then `Unit`).
trans-unit.target: 格式化數值（預設：千位分組，最多一位小數，然後是 `Unit`）。

trans-unit.source: One flow of a `SankeyFlow`, drawn as a ribbon from its source node to its target node.
trans-unit.target: `SankeyFlow` 中的一股流量，繪製為從來源節點到目標節點的色帶。

trans-unit.source: One stage node of a `SankeyFlow`.
trans-unit.target: `SankeyFlow` 中一個階段的節點。

trans-unit.source: One axis of a `ConnectedScatter`. The range and the step are used exactly as given (no rounding to nice numbers, not forced to start at zero); leave them unset to derive them from the data of every series.
trans-unit.target: `ConnectedScatter` 的一條座標軸。範圍和步長按給定值原樣使用(不會取整為好看的數字,也不會強制從零開始);不設定則由所有系列的資料推算。

trans-unit.source: Raised when any property of the axis changes.
trans-unit.target: 座標軸的任何屬性變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: The highest value shown; NaN (default) takes it from the data.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的最大值;NaN(預設)時取自資料。

trans-unit.source: The lowest value shown; NaN (default) takes it from the data.
trans-unit.target: 顯示的最小值;NaN(預設)時取自資料。

trans-unit.source: The short name in the readout and the card ("CAC").
trans-unit.target: 讀數卡和卡片中使用的簡稱("CAC")。

trans-unit.source: The distance between ticks; NaN (default) picks a step that gives four to six ticks.
trans-unit.target: 刻度之間的間距;NaN(預設)時選取能得到四到六個刻度的步長。

trans-unit.source: Formats a tick; null gives "$2k" for steps that are multiples of 1,000 and the block's value format otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 格式化刻度;為 null 時,步長是 1,000 的倍數則得到 "$2k",否則使用該區塊的數值格式。

trans-unit.source: The title of the axis ("Customer acquisition cost").
trans-unit.target: 座標軸的標題("Customer acquisition cost")。

trans-unit.source: Which side of its point an annotation (or a first / last month label) is written on.
trans-unit.target: 註解(或第一個/最後一個月的標籤)寫在其點的哪一側。

trans-unit.source: Reports that the head point settled on a month (released, a key, a tap, the end of playback), never while it moves.
trans-unit.target: 回報頭部的點已停在某個月上(放開、按鍵、點按、回放結束),移動過程中不會回報。

trans-unit.source: A short text written next to one month of a series ("Pricing change"), shown while the viewport is wide enough.
trans-unit.target: 寫在系列某個月旁邊的一段短文字("Pricing change"),視口足夠寬時顯示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when any property of the note changes.
trans-unit.target: 註解的任何屬性變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: The month's index in the series, from 0.
trans-unit.target: 該月在系列中的索引,從 0 開始。

trans-unit.source: Which side of the point the text goes on.
trans-unit.target: 文字位於點的哪一側。

trans-unit.source: The text.
trans-unit.target: 文字。

trans-unit.source: One month of a `ScatterSeries`: the two values that move together.
trans-unit.target: `ScatterSeries` 中的一個月:一同變化的兩個值。

trans-unit.source: Raised when any property of the point changes.
trans-unit.target: 點的任何屬性變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: The month's name ("Mar 2025"); it is also what the scrubber, the readout and the card say.
trans-unit.target: 月份的名稱("Mar 2025");拖曳條、讀數卡和卡片也使用它。

trans-unit.source: The short name under the scrubber ("Mar"); null derives it from `Label`.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳條下方的簡稱("Mar");為 null 時由 `Label` 推算。

trans-unit.source: The value on the horizontal axis (acquisition cost in the reference).
trans-unit.target: 水平座標軸上的值(參考設計中為獲客成本)。

trans-unit.source: The value on the vertical axis (customer value in the reference).
trans-unit.target: 垂直座標軸上的值(參考設計中為客戶價值)。

trans-unit.source: One channel of a `ConnectedScatter`: a name and one `ScatterPoint` per month in time order. Every series of a block should have the same number of months, so that switching between them can morph point by point; with different counts the block replaces the drawing instead.
trans-unit.target: `ConnectedScatter` 的一個管道:一個名稱,以及按時間順序排列、每月一個的 `ScatterPoint`。一個區塊的所有系列應有相同的月數,這樣在它們之間切換時才能逐點變形;月數不同時,該區塊會改為替換繪製內容。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the series, its points or its notes change.
trans-unit.target: 系列、其點或其註解變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: A stable identifier (selection, events); defaults to the name.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼(用於選取和事件);預設為名稱。

trans-unit.source: The channel's name, on the switch and in the legend.
trans-unit.target: 管道的名稱,顯示在切換器和圖例中。

trans-unit.source: Anything you want to carry along (it comes back in the events).
trans-unit.target: 任何你想隨帶的內容(它會在事件中原樣返回)。

trans-unit.source: Reports that another series was chosen.
trans-unit.target: 回報已選取另一個系列。

trans-unit.source: Arc scroll area: native scrolling (wheel, keyboard, touch inertia, snap points) with thin overlay scrollbars that appear while scrolling or hovering and fade away at rest, and edge fades that appear only where content continues, each exactly as long as the content hidden past that edge (up to `FadeLength`). The thumb thickens under the pointer, can be dragged, and pressing the track pages toward the pointer.
trans-unit.target: Arc 捲動區域：原生捲動（滾輪、鍵盤、觸控慣性、貼齊點），搭配細窄的覆蓋式捲軸，捲動或懸停時出現、靜止時淡出；邊緣淡出僅在內容仍延伸處出現，每段淡出的長度與該邊緣之外被隱藏的內容相符（上限為 `FadeLength`）。捲軸滑塊在指標下會變粗、可拖曳，按下軌道會朝指標方向翻頁。

trans-unit.source: Which edges still have content beyond them.
trans-unit.target: 仍有內容延伸到其外的邊緣。

trans-unit.source: Raised when content starts or stops extending past an edge.
trans-unit.target: 內容開始或停止延伸越過某個邊緣時引發。

trans-unit.source: Length of each edge fade in px (Arc: 28). 0 turns the fades off.
trans-unit.target: 每個邊緣淡出的長度，單位為 px（Arc 為 28）。0 表示關閉淡出。

trans-unit.source: How long scrollbars linger after scrolling stops (Arc: 900ms).
trans-unit.target: 停止捲動後捲軸保留顯示的時長（Arc 為 900ms）。

trans-unit.source: Turns vertical wheel movement into horizontal scrolling for horizontal areas, only while there is room.
trans-unit.target: 僅在仍有空間時，將水平區域中的垂直滾輪移動轉為水平捲動。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name; a named area is announced as a region.
trans-unit.target: 無障礙名稱；具有名稱的區域會被朗讀為一個區域。

trans-unit.source: Axes that scroll. Defaults to `Vertical`.
trans-unit.target: 可捲動的軸。預設為 `Vertical`。

trans-unit.source: When the overlay scrollbars show.
trans-unit.target: 覆蓋式捲軸的顯示時機。

trans-unit.source: A scroll-driven story: steps of text on one side and a pinned stage on the other. As the page scrolls, the stage stays in view and changes its picture to the step crossing the reading line, while the other steps dim. Place it in a page that scrolls (any ancestor `ScrollViewer`); below 760 the steps stack in one column, each with its own picture.
trans-unit.target: 隨滚動講述的故事：一侧是文字步驟，另一侧是固定在視野中的舞台。頁面滚動時舞台始終可見，並切換到越過閱讀線的步驟的畫面，其他步驟變暗。請放在會滚動的頁面中（任何祖先 `ScrollViewer`）；寬度小於 760 時步驟排成一列，每一步帶自己的畫面。

trans-unit.source: The index of the step on the stage (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 舞台上步驟的索引（只讀）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when another step becomes the active one.
trans-unit.target: 另一個步驟成為當前步驟時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Below this width of the block (760) the steps stack in one column, each with its own picture.
trans-unit.target: 區塊寬度小於此值（760）時步驟排成一列，每一步帶自己的畫面。

trans-unit.source: The paragraph under the heading; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的段落；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: The small line above the title; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題上方的小字；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the invented sample story shows while `Steps` is empty.
trans-unit.target: `Steps` 為空時是否顯示虛構的示例故事。

trans-unit.source: The section's heading; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 區塊的標題；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Arc's Scrub input: a compact, Figma-style number field for inspectors and property panels. Drag the label sideways to scrub the value (Shift ten times coarser, Alt ten times finer, switching live and shown in a tag above the field), or click in and type an exact value: entries accept arithmetic such as `12*2` or `(100-24)/2` and a unit from `Units` such as `50%` (see `ScrubExpression`). Arrow keys step, Enter commits, Escape restores the last value, and a double click on the label restores `ResetValue`. At `Minimum` and `Maximum` the field strains past the limit with rubber band resistance and springs back on release; a rejected entry shakes and turns the edge red for 900ms. The row has no label or message rows of its own (the label is the drag handle) and fills its column by default.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的 Scrub 輸入框：緊湊的 Figma 風格數字欄位，適用於檢查器與屬性面板。橫向拖曳標籤即可調整數值（按住 Shift 時粗 10 倍，按住 Alt 時細 10 倍，切換時即時生效，並在欄位上方的提示中顯示），也可點入後輸入精確值：輸入內容支援 `12*2` 或 `(100-24)/2` 等算術運算式，以及 `Units` 中的單位，例如 `50%`（參見 `ScrubExpression`）。方向鍵逐步調整，Enter 提交，Escape 還原上一個值，雙擊標籤會還原 `ResetValue`。到達 `Minimum` 與 `Maximum` 時，欄位會以橡皮筋式阻力越過限制，放開後彈回；被拒絕的輸入會晃動，並將邊緣變紅 900ms。此列本身沒有標籤或訊息列（標籤即拖曳把手），預設填滿其所在欄。

trans-unit.source: Step with Shift held (null: ten times `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Shift 時的步進值（null：為 `Step` 的 10 倍）。

trans-unit.source: Step with Alt held (null: a tenth of `Step`).
trans-unit.target: 按住 Alt 時的步進值（null：為 `Step` 的十分之一）。

trans-unit.source: True for 900ms after a rejected entry.
trans-unit.target: 輸入被拒絕後的 900ms 內為 true。

trans-unit.source: Arc's `pointerLock`, kept for API parity (default true). Avalonia has no pointer lock, so scrubbing always uses normal pointer capture, as Arc does when a browser refuses the lock: a long drag can reach the screen edge.
trans-unit.target: 對應 Arc 的 `pointerLock`，僅為維持 API 一致而保留（預設為 true）。Avalonia 沒有指標鎖定，因此調整數值時一律使用一般的指標擷取，與瀏覽器拒絕鎖定時 Arc 的做法相同：長距離拖曳可能會到達螢幕邊緣。

trans-unit.source: True while the label is being dragged.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳標籤期間為 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value's position between the limits as a quiet wash (null: on when both limits are finite).
trans-unit.target: 以柔和的底色顯示數值在上下限之間的位置（null：兩個上下限皆為有限值時顯示）。

trans-unit.source: Values wrap from the maximum to the minimum instead of stopping (needs both limits, Maximum > Minimum).
trans-unit.target: 數值從最大值回繞到最小值，而不是停止（需要兩個上下限，且 Maximum > Minimum）。

trans-unit.source: The label, which is also the drag handle: text (weight 500) or a control such as a 14px `ArcGlyph`.
trans-unit.target: 標籤，同時也是拖曳把手：文字（字重 500）或控制項，例如 14px 的 `ArcGlyph`。

trans-unit.source: Upper limit (default positive infinity: none).
trans-unit.target: 上限（預設為正無窮：無上限）。

trans-unit.source: Lower limit (default negative infinity: none).
trans-unit.target: 下限（預設為負無窮：無下限）。

trans-unit.source: Pointer travel in px for one step while scrubbing (default 2).
trans-unit.target: 拖曳時指標移動多少 px 變化一步（預設 2）。

trans-unit.source: Decimal places kept (null: the larger of the decimals of `Step` and the fine step).
trans-unit.target: 保留的小數位數（null：取 `Step` 與細步進值中較大的小數位數）。

trans-unit.source: A double click on the label returns here (null: no reset).
trans-unit.target: 雙擊標籤後返回的值（null：不重設）。

trans-unit.source: Small (30px, 12px text) or Medium (36px, 14px text, default). Arc has no large size: Large renders as Medium.
trans-unit.target: Small（30px，12px 文字）或 Medium（36px，14px 文字，預設）。Arc 沒有 Large 尺寸：Large 會渲染為 Medium。

trans-unit.source: One step for arrows and scrubbing (default 1).
trans-unit.target: 方向鍵和拖曳時每次變化的步進值（預設 1）。

trans-unit.source: The unit after the number (two-way). Null shows the first of `Units`, or none.
trans-unit.target: 數字後方的單位（雙向繫結）。為 null 時顯示 `Units` 中的第一個單位，或不顯示單位。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the unit button; `{0}` is the unit (Arc: "Unit: px. Change unit").
trans-unit.target: 單位按鈕的無障礙名稱；`{0}` 為單位（Arc 為 "Unit: px. Change unit"）。

trans-unit.source: Units a typed value may carry; with more than one the unit becomes a button that cycles them.
trans-unit.target: 輸入值可攜帶的單位；多於一個時，單位會變為按鈕，點擊即可循環切換。

trans-unit.source: The value (two-way, default 0).
trans-unit.target: 數值（雙向繫結，預設 0）。

trans-unit.source: Raised for every real change of `Value`: each step of a scrub, typed entries, key steps and resets (Arc's `onValueChange`), and values set from code or a binding (`Programmatic`).
trans-unit.target: `Value` 每次實際變更時引發：拖曳的每一步、鍵入的輸入、方向鍵步進與重設，以及由程式碼或繫結設定的值（`Programmatic`）（對應 Arc 的 `onValueChange`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once when a change settles: a scrub ends (or is cancelled), Enter or blur commits typing, a key step lands, or a reset. Like Arc it also fires when a commit leaves the value unchanged (a clamped entry at the limit).
trans-unit.target: 變更穩定後引發一次：拖曳結束（或取消）、按下 Enter 或失去焦點提交輸入、方向鍵步進完成，或重設時。與 Arc 一致，即使提交後值未變（例如在上限被夾限的輸入），也會引發。

trans-unit.source: A date range over `Date`, edited with a two-thumb slider. The range spans `Minimum` to `Maximum` (the oldest and newest item date when null); `Start` and `End` are the chosen ends (null: that end of the range). Items of kinds outside `AppliesTo` pass the filter, so a range over documents does not hide people.
trans-unit.target: 依 `Date` 的日期範圍，以雙滑桿編輯。範圍從 `Minimum` 到 `Maximum`（為 null 時取最早與最新項目的日期）；`Start` 與 `End` 為所選的兩端（為 null 時該端取範圍邊界）。不在 `AppliesTo` 所列類型之內的項目不受此篩選影響，因此針對文件的日期範圍不會隱藏人員。

trans-unit.source: The kinds the range applies to, as a comma separated list ("Docs, Files"). Empty: every item. Also words the default caption ("Applies to docs and files").
trans-unit.target: 此範圍適用的類型，以逗號分隔的清單表示（"Docs, Files"）。為空時適用於所有項目。也用於預設註腳的文字（"Applies to docs and files"）。

trans-unit.source: The chosen end of the range (two-way). Null: the maximum.
trans-unit.target: 所選的範圍結束端（雙向繫結）。為 null 時取最大值。

trans-unit.source: The newest date the slider reaches. Null: the newest item date.
trans-unit.target: 滑桿能到達的最新日期。為 null 時取最新項目的日期。

trans-unit.source: The oldest date the slider reaches. Null: the oldest item date.
trans-unit.target: 滑桿能到達的最早日期。為 null 時取最早項目的日期。

trans-unit.source: The chosen start of the range (two-way). Null: the minimum.
trans-unit.target: 所選的範圍起始端（雙向繫結）。為 null 時取最小值。

trans-unit.source: Arc search field: a labeled search input with a leading glass that wakes up (full contrast) while the field is focused or filled, and a clear button that pops into a reserved slot, so the field never changes width. Every keystroke updates the two-way `Text` (debounce expensive filtering yourself); Escape clears the field, Enter raises `SearchSubmitted`, and clearing with the button returns focus to the field.
trans-unit.target: Arc 搜尋欄位：帶標籤的搜尋輸入框，前導的放大鏡圖示在欄位取得焦點或已填入內容時會亮起（全對比），清除按鈕會出現在預留的位置，因此欄位寬度永遠不變。每次按鍵都會更新雙向繫結的 `Text`（開銷大的篩選請自行防抖）；Escape 清空欄位，Enter 引發 `SearchSubmitted`，使用按鈕清空後焦點會回到欄位。

trans-unit.source: Name of the clear button.
trans-unit.target: 清除按鈕的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Enter is pressed in the field.
trans-unit.target: 在欄位中按下 Enter 時引發。

trans-unit.source: A way to narrow the results of a `SearchResults`: a `SearchValueFilter` (a group of checkbox values) or a `SearchDateFilter` (a date range). Filters AND together; the values of one value filter OR.
trans-unit.target: 用於縮小 `SearchResults` 結果的一種方式：`SearchValueFilter`（一組核取方塊值）或 `SearchDateFilter`（日期範圍）。各篩選器之間為且關係；同一個值篩選器的各個值之間為或關係。

trans-unit.source: A muted line under the filter ("Applies to docs and files").
trans-unit.target: 篩選器下方的淡色提示行（"Applies to docs and files"）。

trans-unit.source: Names the attribute of `SearchResultItem` the filter reads (see `Attributes`).
trans-unit.target: 指定篩選器讀取的 `SearchResultItem` 屬性名稱（參見 `Attributes`）。

trans-unit.source: The heading above the filter ("Type", "Team", "Edited").
trans-unit.target: 篩選器上方的標題（"Type"、"Team"、"Edited"）。

trans-unit.source: One value of a `SearchValueFilter`: a checkbox with a label and a count.
trans-unit.target: `SearchValueFilter` 的一個值：帶文字標籤與數量的核取方塊。

trans-unit.source: The results behind the value. `SearchResults` writes it while it filters; with `IsFilteringEnabled` false it is yours (a server's facet counts) and the control only reads it. A value with a count of 0 is dimmed and cannot be ticked, but keeps its place.
trans-unit.target: 此值對應的結果數量。`SearchResults` 在篩選時寫入此值；當 `IsFilteringEnabled` 為 false 時由你設定（例如伺服器的分面計數），控制項只讀取它。數量為 0 的值會變暗且無法勾選，但仍保留其位置。

trans-unit.source: Whether the checkbox is ticked (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 核取方塊是否已勾選（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: The text beside the checkbox; `Value` when null.
trans-unit.target: 核取方塊旁的文字；為 null 時使用 `Value`。

trans-unit.source: What an item's attribute has to equal (ignoring case).
trans-unit.target: 項目的屬性必須等於的值（忽略大小寫）。

trans-unit.source: One key/value row of a result's detail sheet.
trans-unit.target: 結果詳情面板中的一行鍵值。

trans-unit.source: A person's photo for the avatar before the value.
trans-unit.target: 人物的照片，顯示在值之前的大頭貼中。

trans-unit.source: A person's name: a small avatar with their initials is shown before the value.
trans-unit.target: 人物的姓名：值之前會顯示一個帶其姓名首字母的小型大頭貼。

trans-unit.source: The muted name on the left ("Team").
trans-unit.target: 左側淡色顯示的名稱（"Team"）。

trans-unit.source: A muted remark after the value ("3 weeks ago").
trans-unit.target: 值之後淡色顯示的備註（"3 weeks ago"）。

trans-unit.source: The value on the right.
trans-unit.target: 右側顯示的值。

trans-unit.source: One searchable entry of a `SearchResults`: a document, a person, a file or anything else your workspace holds. `Kind` and `Attributes` feed the filters, the text properties are searched and shown, and the detail properties fill the sheet that opens when the result is chosen.
trans-unit.target: `SearchResults` 中一個可搜尋的項目：文件、人員、檔案或工作區中的任何其他內容。`Kind` 與 `Attributes` 供篩選器使用；文字屬性會被搜尋並顯示；詳情屬性會填入選取結果時開啟的詳情面板。

trans-unit.source: A photo for a person: the row and the detail show a round avatar instead of the icon.
trans-unit.target: 人物的照片：列與詳情中會顯示圓形大頭貼而非圖示。

trans-unit.source: A person's name: the avatar shows its initials (and the photo's fallback). Setting it switches the row to an avatar.
trans-unit.target: 人物的姓名：大頭貼會顯示其姓名首字母（也是照片載入失敗時的備用內容）。設定後該列會切換為大頭貼。

trans-unit.source: The paragraphs shown in the detail sheet, separated by blank lines. Searched and marked there.
trans-unit.target: 詳情面板中顯示的段落，以空白行分隔。在此處進行搜尋並醒目標示。

trans-unit.source: A last, muted line under the snippet, such as an email address. Not searched.
trans-unit.target: 摘錄下方最後一行淡色顯示的文字，例如電子郵件地址。不參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: When the result was last edited; sorts "Newest" and feeds a `SearchDateFilter`.
trans-unit.target: 結果最後編輯的時間；用於 "Newest" 排序，並為 `SearchDateFilter` 提供資料。

trans-unit.source: A 20px icon: a 24×24 Lucide `Geometry` or a control. Default: Lucide FileText.
trans-unit.target: 20px 圖示：24×24 的 Lucide `Geometry` 或一個控制項。預設為 Lucide FileText。

trans-unit.source: Stable id; the title is used when it is empty.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id；為空時使用標題。

trans-unit.source: When false the result is listed dimmed, skipped by the keyboard cursor and cannot be opened.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時，該結果會以淡化樣式列出，鍵盤游標會略過它，且無法開啟。

trans-unit.source: Extra words that also find the result (synonyms, ids, tags).
trans-unit.target: 同樣可用於查找結果的額外詞語（同義詞、id、標籤）。

trans-unit.source: The type of the result ("Docs", "People", "Files"): the value of the filter whose key is `KindKey`.
trans-unit.target: 結果的類型（"Docs"、"People"、"Files"）：即鍵為 `KindKey` 的篩選器的值。

trans-unit.source: The singular name of the kind ("Doc") used in the subtitle and the detail sheet; `Kind` when null.
trans-unit.target: 該類型的單數名稱（"文件"），用於副標題與詳情面板；為 null 時使用 `Kind`。

trans-unit.source: Where the result lives: a path or a breadcrumb ("Engineering / Handbook"). Also searched.
trans-unit.target: 結果所在的位置：路徑或麵包屑（"Engineering / Handbook"）。同樣參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: A passage of the content; long passages are cut to a window around the first match. Searched.
trans-unit.target: 內容的一段文字；較長的段落會裁剪為圍繞第一個符合項的一個視窗。參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title (a person's role and city). When null the row shows "`KindLabel` in `Location`" (or just the location).
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行（人員的角色和城市）。為 null 時該行顯示 "`KindLabel` in `Location`"（或僅顯示位置）。

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back when the result is opened.
trans-unit.target: 任何你希望在開啟結果時取回的值。

trans-unit.source: The name of the result; searched first, marked where it matches and ranked by.
trans-unit.target: 結果的名稱；優先參與搜尋，符合處會醒目標示，並作為排序依據。

trans-unit.source: The address "Copy link" puts on the clipboard.
trans-unit.target: "複製連結"寫入剪貼簿的位址。

trans-unit.source: A search results page for a workspace (an original TKCode design, after Algolia InstantSearch's search box, hits, highlight, refinement list and stats). A large search field with a suggestions popup (recent and suggested searches), a filters column (checkbox groups whose counts follow the query and the other filters, and a date range), a results header with the count, the time it took and a sort switch, the active filters as removable chips, and the results: people and documents in one list, matches marked in titles and in a snippet cut around the first match. One cursor block glides between the results; Enter or a click opens a result in a detail dialog (a bottom sheet on narrow screens). Below 560 the filters move behind a button into a sheet.
trans-unit.target: 工作區的搜尋結果頁面（TKCode 原創設計，參照 Algolia InstantSearch 的搜尋框、命中結果、醒目標示、細化清單與統計資訊）。包含一個大型搜尋欄及建議彈層（最近搜尋與建議搜尋）、篩選欄（核取方塊群組，其計數隨查詢與其他篩選條件變化，另有日期範圍）、帶有數量、耗時與排序切換的結果標題列、以可移除標籤形式顯示的已啟用篩選條件，以及結果：人員與文件混合在同一清單中，標題與摘錄中的符合處會醒目標示，摘錄圍繞第一個符合處裁切。一個游標區塊在結果之間平滑移動；按 Enter 或點按可在詳情對話框中開啟結果（窄螢幕時為底部面板）。寬度小於 560 時，篩選器會收入按鈕後的面板中。

trans-unit.source: The number of filter values ticked plus date ranges narrowed (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 已勾選的篩選值數量加上已縮小範圍的日期範圍數量（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: The result under the cursor, or null.

trans-unit.source: A team's seats and what they cost, in one card: avatars and a seat meter show members, pending invites and open seats against the seats paid for; a stepper changes the seat count while today's prorated charge and the new recurring total roll live; pending invites can be resent, or revoked with an inline undo; and Update seats goes through a confirm step before anything is charged. When every seat is taken the card says so and offers to add one. The change is applied by `UpdateSeatsAsync`; without handlers the block simulates its backend and, by default, plays a short demonstration loop until someone touches it.
trans-unit.target: 團隊的席位及其費用集中在一張卡片中：頭像與席位條顯示成員、待處理邀請，以及相對於已購席位的空餘席位；步進器用於改變席位數，今天按比例計費的金額與新的週期性總額會即時滾動更新；待處理邀請可以重新傳送，或在行內撤銷並提供復原；“Update seats”會先經過確認步驟，然後才會扣款。當所有席位都已佔用時，卡片會說明這一點並提供新增一個席位的選項。變更由 `UpdateSeatsAsync` 套用；若未設定處理函式，該區塊會模擬其後端，並且預設播放一段示範循環，直到有人與它互動為止。

trans-unit.source: The message of the last failed update while `Phase` is Error, otherwise null.
trans-unit.target: 最近一次失敗更新的訊息，僅當 `Phase` 為 Error 時有值，否則為 null。

trans-unit.source: Whether the demonstration loop plays (add three seats, pay, resend, revoke, reset; 12.7 s, paused off screen). Null (default) plays it when none of the three handlers is set. Any pointer press or key press inside the card stops it for good and leaves the card as it is.
trans-unit.target: 示範循環是否播放（新增三個席位、付款、重新傳送、撤銷、重設；12.7 秒，移出畫面時暫停）。null（預設）時，若三個處理函式都未設定則播放。卡片內任何指標按下或按鍵按下都會永久停止播放，並保留卡片目前狀態。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text of `SeatManager`. Replace the whole object to localize the block. Entries whose text holds a rolling number are templates: `{0}` (and `{1}`) mark where the number rolls, and a function picks the singular or plural template from the count. Sentences without rolling numbers are functions that receive the counts and the already formatted amounts and dates. Amounts and dates use `Culture`.
trans-unit.target: `SeatManager` 的內建文字。取代整個物件即可在地化該區塊。文字含滾動數字的條目為範本：`{0}`（以及 `{1}`）標示數字滾動的位置，並由函式根據數量選擇單數或複數範本。不含滾動數字的句子為函式，接收數量以及已格式化的金額與日期。金額與日期使用 `Culture`。

trans-unit.source: The price of moving from `Current` to `Target` seats. Added seats are charged today for the days left in the period (`Delta` × price × `DaysLeft` ÷ `PeriodDays`, the total rounded to cents); removed seats cost nothing today and leave at `RenewsOn`.
