trans-unit.source: Choosing seats on a map of a venue or a cabin: sections of seats colored by their price tier, taken seats hollow, a legend with the prices, and a summary of the chosen seats with fees, a total and Continue. Seats are chosen with the pointer or with the arrow keys and Enter; at most `MaxSelection` at once. Every seat is drawn by one control, so large venues stay light.
trans-unit.target: 在場地或飞機的座位圖上選座：按價格檔次著色的座位分區、空心顯示的已售座位、帶價格的圖例，以及列出所選座位、費用、合計和 Continue 的摘要。可以用指標，或用方向鍵和 Enter 選座；同時最多 `MaxSelection` 個。所有座位由一個控制項繪製，大型場地也很輕量。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Continue is pressed with seats chosen.
trans-unit.target: 已選座位時按下 Continue 引發。

trans-unit.source: The symbol written before prices ("$").
trans-unit.target: 價格前面的貨幣符號（"$"）。

trans-unit.source: The block's built-in text.
trans-unit.target: 區塊內置的文字。

trans-unit.source: Most seats chosen at once (6).
trans-unit.target: 同時最多可選的座位數（6）。

trans-unit.source: The chosen seats, in the order they were chosen.
trans-unit.target: 所選座位，按選擇的先後順序。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a seat is chosen or released.
trans-unit.target: 選擇或釋放座位時引發。

trans-unit.source: The fee added per chosen seat (0 hides the fees row).
trans-unit.target: 每個所選座位加收的費用（為 0 時隱藏費用行）。

trans-unit.source: The ids of seats that are already sold ("ORC-C-12").
trans-unit.target: 已售座位的編號（"ORC-C-12"）。

trans-unit.source: The heading over the map (the venue and the date).
trans-unit.target: 地圖上方的標題（場地和日期）。

trans-unit.source: The price of the chosen seats plus their fees.
trans-unit.target: 所選座位的價格加上費用。

trans-unit.source: One seat of a `SeatMap`, as laid out.
trans-unit.target: `SeatMap` 中版面配置好的一個座位。

trans-unit.source: A block of seats of a `SeatMap`: rows of equal length placed in the map's own units (the map scales them to fit), optionally bent into an arc toward the stage, with aisles after given seat numbers.
trans-unit.target: `SeatMap` 的一個座位分區：以地圖自身的單位放置、長度相同的若干排（地圖會縮放以適應），可以朝舞台彎成弧形，並在指定座號之後留出過道。

trans-unit.source: A price tier of a `SeatMap` ("Premium", $120).
trans-unit.target: `SeatMap` 的一個價格檔次（"Premium"，$120）。

trans-unit.source: The account security page: a checkup of four safeguards (password, two-step verification, passkeys, recovery codes), the password with a change form that opens in place, the two-step methods, and every signed-in session with a way to sign it out. Each action happens on the page; the host hears about it through routed events.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶安全性設定頁面：檢查四項安全防護（密碼、兩步驟驗證、通行金鑰、復原碼），提供可就地展開的密碼變更表單、兩步驟驗證方式，以及所有登入工作階段，並可將其登出。每項操作都在頁面內完成，宿主透過路由事件得知。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "Add passkey" is pressed; the host runs the passkey ceremony and updates `PasskeyCount`.
trans-unit.target: 按下「新增通行金鑰」時引發；宿主執行通行金鑰流程並更新 `PasskeyCount`。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the meter moves under the summary text and "Sign out other sessions" moves under the list (default 560).
trans-unit.target: 低於此寬度時，進度條移至摘要文字下方，「登出其他工作階段」移至列表下方（預設 560）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the account has a password (default true). Without one the row offers "Set password" and the form asks only for the new password; a successful change sets it to true (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 帳戶是否已設定密碼（預設為 true）。未設定時，該設定列提供「設定密碼」，表單僅要求輸入新密碼；變更成功後會將其設為 true（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sign-ins ask for a code from an authenticator app (two-way, follows its switch).
trans-unit.target: 是否在登入時要求輸入驗證器應用程式中的驗證碼（雙向繫結，跟隨其開關）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the password form is open.
trans-unit.target: 是否已展開密碼表單。

trans-unit.source: Whether the security checkup card is shown at the top (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否在頂部顯示安全檢查卡片（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether sign-ins send a code by text message (two-way, follows its switch).
trans-unit.target: 是否在登入時透過簡訊傳送驗證碼（雙向繫結，跟隨其開關）。

trans-unit.source: Every built-in text and the culture for dates; replace the whole object to localize.
trans-unit.target: 所有內建文字以及日期地區設定；取代整個物件即可在地化。

trans-unit.source: Raised after "Sign out other sessions" was confirmed and every other session's row has left.
trans-unit.target: 在「登出其他工作階段」獲得確認且其他工作階段的各列均已移除後引發。

trans-unit.source: How many passkeys the account has.
trans-unit.target: 帳戶擁有的通行金鑰數量。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the password form is submitted. Set `ErrorMessage` to reject it.
trans-unit.target: 提交密碼表單時引發。設定 `ErrorMessage` 可拒絕此次提交。

trans-unit.source: When the password was last changed; null reads "Never changed". Set to the clock's time after a successful change (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 密碼最後一次變更的時間；為 null 時顯示「從未變更」。變更成功後設為時鐘的目前時間（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: The phone number for text messages; only its last four digits are shown ("•••• 4821"). Without one the text message switch is disabled.
trans-unit.target: 簡訊使用的電話號碼；僅顯示末四碼（「•••• 4821」）。沒有號碼時，簡訊開關會被停用。

trans-unit.source: How many of the four safeguards are on (0–4): a password, two-step verification by either method, at least one passkey, and recovery codes.
trans-unit.target: 四項安全防護中已開啟的數量（0–4）：密碼、任一方式的兩步驟驗證、至少一組通行金鑰，以及復原碼。

trans-unit.source: When the recovery codes were created; null means there are none.
trans-unit.target: 復原碼的建立時間；null 表示沒有復原碼。

trans-unit.source: Raised when "View codes" or "Create codes" is pressed; the host shows or creates the codes and updates `RecoveryCodesCreatedAt`.
trans-unit.target: 按下「查看復原碼」或「建立復原碼」時引發；宿主應用程式會顯示或建立復原碼，並更新 `RecoveryCodesCreatedAt`。

trans-unit.source: Which cards are shown (default all): show only the sessions, or only the password, on a page of your own.
trans-unit.target: 顯示哪些卡片（預設全部）。例如在自己的頁面上只顯示登入工作階段，或只顯示密碼。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a session's "Sign out" row has left and the session was taken off `Sessions`.
trans-unit.target: 登入工作階段的「登出」列離開，且該工作階段已從 `Sessions` 移除後引發。

trans-unit.source: The signed-in sessions, listed current first, then by most recent activity. A signed-out session leaves its row and is removed from this list when the list can be changed. Defaults to an empty observable list.
trans-unit.target: 已登入的工作階段，目前的工作階段排在最前，其餘依最近活動時間排序。已登出的工作階段會離開其列，並在列表可以變更時從此列表移除。預設為空的可觀察列表。

trans-unit.source: Arc segmented control: a row of buttons for switching between a small set of related views. One selection pill glides between them on the morph spring; segments never scale or change weight, only their label color follows. Arrows (wrapping), Home and End move the selection like a tab list and only the selected segment is a tab stop. When the options are wider than the control the row scrolls inside itself with faded edges, and the selected segment is always scrolled fully into view. `ItemIntent` fires when the pointer or focus reaches a segment before it is chosen (preload what it shows).
trans-unit.target: Arc 分段控制項：一排按鈕，用於在一小組相關檢視之間切換。被選取的膠囊會在變形彈簧上於各段之間滑動；分段從不縮放或變更字重，只有標籤顏色會跟著變化。方向鍵（循環）、Home 與 End 會像索引標籤清單一樣移動選取項，且只有被選取的分段才是 Tab 停駐點。當選項寬度超過控制項時，該列會在內部捲動並帶有淡出的邊緣，被選取的分段總是完整捲動到可見範圍內。`ItemIntent` 會在指標或焦點於分段被選取前到達時引發（可用於預先載入其內容）。

trans-unit.source: The pointer or keyboard focus reached a segment (it may not be selected yet).
trans-unit.target: 指標或鍵盤焦點已到達某個分段（該分段可能尚未被選取）。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `SegmentedControl` (Arc `Segment`): a short label and optional accessory. Its properties can be bound in XAML (for example a localized label); the control follows later changes.
trans-unit.target: `SegmentedControl` 的一個選項（Arc `Segment`）：簡短的標籤和可選的附加內容。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結（例如在地化的標籤）；控制項會跟隨之後的變化。

trans-unit.source: Optional content after the label, such as a badge or a count.
trans-unit.target: 標籤後可選的內容，例如徽章或計數。

trans-unit.source: A disabled segment cannot be selected and is skipped by the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 停用的分段不能被選取，方向鍵會略過它。

trans-unit.source: Segment text; falls back to `Value`. Keep it short: segments never wrap or shrink.
trans-unit.target: 分段文字；未設定時使用 `Value`。請保持簡短：分段從不換行或收縮。

trans-unit.source: The value reported as the control's `SelectedValue`.
trans-unit.target: 作為控制項 `SelectedValue` 回報的值。

trans-unit.source: Arc select: a labelled, compact choice field with a keyboard friendly menu (Radix Select semantics). The shown value rolls in the direction of the list, the menu drops from the trigger, a highlight glides between options and the chosen option carries a check. Use it for short, fixed lists such as regions or sort orders. Options come from `ItemsSource` (any objects, `SelectOption` records) or inline `SelectItem` children; labels use `TextSelector`, `DisplayMemberBinding` or `ToString()`, values use `ValueSelector`, `SelectedValueBinding` or the item. Keyboard: Enter, Space and the arrows open; arrows, Home / End and PageUp / PageDown move the highlight; Enter or Space picks; Escape closes without a change; typing jumps to the next matching option (and picks it directly while the menu is closed).
trans-unit.target: Arc 選取框：帶標籤的緊湊型選擇欄位，配有對鍵盤友善的選單（Radix Select 語意）。顯示的值會沿清單方向滾動切換，選單從觸發器處展開，反白會在選項之間滑動，被選取的選項會帶有勾選標記。適用於地區或排序方式等簡短的固定清單。選項來自 `ItemsSource`（任意物件，或 `SelectOption` 記錄）或內嵌的 `SelectItem` 子元素；標籤使用 `TextSelector`、`DisplayMemberBinding` 或 `ToString()`，值使用 `ValueSelector`、`SelectedValueBinding` 或選項本身。鍵盤操作：Enter、Space 和方向鍵可開啟；方向鍵、Home / End 和 PageUp / PageDown 移動反白；Enter 或 Space 選取；Escape 關閉且不做變更；鍵入字元會跳到下一個符合的選項（選單關閉時則直接選取該選項）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Description` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Description` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `DisabledSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `DisabledSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsOpen` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsOpen` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Label` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MaxDropDownHeight` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `MaxDropDownHeight` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Placeholder` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Placeholder` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SelectedText` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `SelectedText` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Trigger height: Small 36, Medium 44 (default), Large 50, as for the text fields.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器高度：Small 36、Medium 44（預設）、Large 50，與文字方塊一致。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `TextSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `TextSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ValueSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ValueSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: A list or table with a floating bar for what is selected in it. Put the list in `Content` and bind `SelectedCount` to its selection: while anything is selected, a pill rises from the bottom edge with the count (its digits roll as it changes), "Select all" for the rest, the bulk actions and a clear button; it sinks away when the selection empties. Escape clears the selection from anywhere inside, the bar is one toolbar with the arrow keys moving between its buttons, and the count is read out as it changes. Below `CompactWidth` the actions keep only their icons, with tooltips.
trans-unit.target: 帶浮動列的清單或表格，浮動列用於其中選取的內容。把清單放進 `Content`，並把 `SelectedCount` 繫結到它的選取：只要有內容被選取，就有一條膠囊形的列從底部邊緣升起，顯示數量（數字隨變化捲動）、用於選取其餘項目的「Select all」、批次操作和清除按鈕；選取清空時它會落下消失。在控制項內任何位置按 Esc 都會清除選取；這條列是一個工具列，方向鍵在其按鈕之間移動；數量變化時會被讀出。寬度小於 `CompactWidth` 時，操作只保留圖示並顯示提示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an action is chosen, with the action and the selected count (after its command runs).
trans-unit.target: 選擇某個操作時引發，帶有該操作和選取的數量（在其命令執行之後）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the clear button or Escape clears the selection (`SelectedCount` is already 0): deselect your items.
trans-unit.target: 清除按鈕或 Esc 清除選取時引發（此時 `SelectedCount` 已為 0）：請取消你的項目的選取。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the actions show their icons only (set by the theme from the token).
trans-unit.target: 寬度小於此值時，操作只顯示圖示（由主題依據權杖設定）。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text; replace the whole object to localize the bar.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字；替換整個物件即可在地化這條列。

trans-unit.source: Raised by "Select all": select every item, then set `SelectedCount`.
trans-unit.target: 由「Select all」引發：選取所有項目，然後設定 `SelectedCount`。

trans-unit.source: How many items are selected (two-way); the bar shows while it is above zero. Clearing sets it to 0.
trans-unit.target: 選取的項目數（雙向）；大於零時顯示這條列。清除時設為 0。

trans-unit.source: How many items there are; "Select all" shows while fewer are selected. Zero hides it.
trans-unit.target: 項目總數；選取的較少時顯示「Select all」。為 0 時隱藏它。

trans-unit.source: Declares one option of a `Select`, `Combobox`, `MultiSelect`, `MorphSelect` or `ChipGroup` inline in XAML: `<arc:SelectItem Content="United States" Value="us" />`. The owning control draws the option itself (virtualized and filtered without containers), so this element only carries data; set `IsEnabled` to false for an option that can be seen but not picked.
trans-unit.target: 在 XAML 中以內嵌方式宣告 `Select`、`Combobox`、`MultiSelect`、`MorphSelect` 或 `ChipGroup` 的一個選項：`<arc:SelectItem Content="United States" Value="us" />`。所屬控制項自行繪製選項（虛擬化且篩選時無需容器），因此此元素只承載資料；若選項需要可見但不可選取，請將 `IsEnabled` 設為 false。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Content` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Content` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Group` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Group` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Icon` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Icon` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Keywords` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Keywords` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Meta` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Meta` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Value` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Value` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: A plain option record for `ItemsSource` lists that every select in this category understands without selectors: `new SelectOption("us", "United States")`.
trans-unit.target: 供 `ItemsSource` 清單使用的一般選項記錄，此分類中的所有選取框無需選取器即可辨識：`new SelectOption("us", "United States")`。

trans-unit.source: An organization map you can zoom into without losing your place: teams hold project cards, projects hold task blocks, tasks open into their details and checklist. Each zoom level shows different information (team leads and counts, then project titles and health, then task titles and due dates, then the task's summary, assignee and checklist), not the same picture larger. Scroll or pinch to zoom about the pointer, drag to pan, click anything to fly into it; the breadcrumbs, the details panel and the screen-reader text follow whatever is under the center of the view. A minimap, zoom buttons and a guided tour sit on the map; ticking a checklist item updates the task and every total above it.
trans-unit.target: 一張可以放大檢視的組織地圖，縮放時不會遺失你的位置：團隊承載專案卡片，專案包含任務區塊，任務可展開為詳細資訊和清單。每一級縮放顯示的資訊各不相同（先是負責人和數量，接著是專案標題和健康度，再是任務標題和到期日，最後是任務摘要、負責人和清單），而不是同一畫面的放大。捲動或雙指縮放會以指標為中心縮放，拖曳可平移，點擊任何內容即可飛入。階層導覽、詳細資訊面板和螢幕閱讀器文字都會跟隨檢視中心所在的內容。地圖上有小地圖、縮放按鈕和導覽；勾選清單項目會更新該任務以及上方的所有總計。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a checklist item is ticked or unticked on the map.
trans-unit.target: 在地圖上勾選或取消勾選清單項目時引發。

trans-unit.source: The node under the keyboard cursor (null when there is none, or when the cursor is on a checklist item).
trans-unit.target: 鍵盤游標所在的節點（沒有時為 null；游標位於清單項目上時也為 null）。

trans-unit.source: Where the details panel goes (default `Auto`).
trans-unit.target: 詳細資訊面板的位置（預設 `Auto`）。

trans-unit.source: Formats dates and percentages; null uses `Default` ("Sep 23", "59%").
trans-unit.target: 格式化日期和百分比；為 null 時使用 `Default`（"Sep 23"、"59%"）。

trans-unit.source: The heading above the map; hidden when null.
trans-unit.target: 地圖上方的標題；為 null 時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Shows the breadcrumbs in the map's top-left corner. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 在地圖左上角顯示階層導覽。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the gesture hint until the first interaction. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 在首次互動之前顯示手勢提示。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the minimap (bottom left) once the view leaves the whole organization. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 當檢視離開整個組織的視角後，顯示小地圖（左下角）。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Shows the tour button in the map's top-right corner. Default true.
trans-unit.target: 在地圖右上角顯示導覽按鈕。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: Whether the tour is playing (two-way). Any manual interaction with the map stops it.
trans-unit.target: 導覽是否正在播放（雙向）。對地圖的任何手動操作都會停止導覽。

trans-unit.source: Shows the zoom buttons and readout (bottom right). Default true.
trans-unit.target: 顯示縮放按鈕和讀數（右下角）。預設 true。

trans-unit.source: The largest zoom (default 53, deep enough to read a task's checklist); the smallest is always 1.
trans-unit.target: 最大縮放倍率（預設 53，足以看清任務的清單）；最小值始終為 1。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a node is clicked or chosen with Enter (the camera then flies into it).
trans-unit.target: 節點被點擊或按下 Enter 選擇時引發（隨後相機會飛入該節點）。

trans-unit.source: The organization to map: its teams, their projects and tasks.
trans-unit.target: 要繪製的組織：其團隊、團隊的專案以及任務。

trans-unit.source: The node in view (two-way): the organization, a team, a project or a task. It follows the camera (whatever is under the center at the current zoom); setting it flies there.
trans-unit.target: 檢視中的節點（雙向）：組織、團隊、專案或任務。它會跟隨相機移動（即目前縮放級別下位於中心的內容）；設定此屬性會飛入對應節點。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the node in view changes (camera flights, pans and zooms included).
trans-unit.target: 檢視中的節點變更時引發（包括相機飛行、平移和縮放）。

trans-unit.source: The chain from the organization down to `Scope` (what the breadcrumbs show).
trans-unit.target: 從組織到 `Scope` 的路徑鏈（即階層導覽顯示的內容）。

trans-unit.source: The map's height in px; when null it is 48% of the control's width between 400 and 580 (420 in containers narrower than 600 px).
trans-unit.target: 地圖的高度（px）；為 null 時取控制項寬度的 48%，並限制在 400 到 580 之間（在寬度小於 600 px 的容器中為 420）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading; when null it is built from `SubtitleFormat`; an empty string hides it.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的副標題列；為 null 時由 `SubtitleFormat` 產生；空字串則隱藏。

trans-unit.source: The automatic subtitle: `{0}` teams, `{1}` projects, `{2}` tasks.
trans-unit.target: 自動產生的副標題：`{0}` 個團隊、`{1}` 個專案、`{2}` 個任務。

trans-unit.source: Every label, button name and announcement (English defaults); assign a new instance to change wording.
trans-unit.target: 所有標籤、按鈕名稱和播報文字（英文預設值）；指派一個新實例即可變更文案。

trans-unit.source: How long the tour waits at each stop after arriving (default 1.5 s; 2.4 s at reduced motion).
trans-unit.target: 導覽抵達每個停靠點後停留的時間（預設 1.5 秒；減少動態效果時為 2.4 秒）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the tour starts.
trans-unit.target: 導覽開始時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the tour stops, at its end or interrupted.
trans-unit.target: 導覽停止時引發，無論是播放結束還是被中斷。

trans-unit.source: The tour's stops in order; the organization as a stop means the whole map. When null the tour visits a team, one of its projects, two tasks, a second team and one of its projects, then returns to the whole map.
trans-unit.target: 導覽的停靠點，依序排列；將組織本身作為停靠點即代表整張地圖。為 null 時，導覽依序造訪一個團隊、其中一個專案、兩個任務、第二個團隊及其中一個專案，然後回到整張地圖。

trans-unit.source: The zoom relative to the whole organization in view (1 = fit).
trans-unit.target: 相對於目前檢視中整個組織的縮放倍率（1 表示符合檢視）。

trans-unit.source: The zoom as the readout shows it: one decimal under 10 ("1.6×"), whole numbers above ("31×").
trans-unit.target: 讀數顯示的縮放值：小於 10 時保留一位小數（"1.6×"），10 以上取整數（"31×"）。

trans-unit.source: One line of a task's checklist. Ticking every item marks the task done; unticking one of a done task puts it back in review (`SemanticZoomTask`).
trans-unit.target: 任務清單中的一行。勾選全部項目即會將任務標記為完成；取消勾選已完成任務的某一項，任務會退回審查中（`SemanticZoomTask`）。

trans-unit.source: The item is ticked (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 此項目已勾選（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: What has to be done.
trans-unit.target: 需要完成的事項。

trans-unit.source: Tasks below this node that are blocked.
trans-unit.target: 此節點下受阻的任務。

trans-unit.source: A one-line description (teams: shown in the hover card; projects: used in generated task summaries).
trans-unit.target: 一行描述（團隊：顯示於懸停提示卡中；專案：用於產生任務摘要）。

trans-unit.source: Tasks below this node that are done.
trans-unit.target: 此節點下已完成的任務。

trans-unit.source: An optional identifier for your own bookkeeping.
trans-unit.target: 可選的識別碼，供你自行記錄使用。

trans-unit.source: Projects below this node that are not on track (teams and the organization).
trans-unit.target: 下方未按計畫推進的專案（團隊與組織）。

trans-unit.source: The earliest due date among the open tasks below this node (null when none is due).
trans-unit.target: 此節點下方未完成任務中最早的截止日期（沒有任務到期時為 null）。

trans-unit.source: Tasks below this node whose status is not done.
trans-unit.target: 此節點下方狀態不是已完成的任務。

trans-unit.source: The node above this one (null for the organization or a node not added anywhere yet).
trans-unit.target: 此節點的上一層節點（組織或尚未加入任何位置的節點為 null）。

trans-unit.source: Everyone involved, without repeats: leads first, then the assignees of the tasks below.
trans-unit.target: 所有相關人員，不重複：先列出牽頭人，再列出下方任務的負責人。

trans-unit.source: Completion from 0 to 1: a task's share of ticked checklist items (1 when done); a project, team or the organization averages every task below it.
trans-unit.target: 完成度，取值從 0 到 1：任務為其已勾選清單項所佔的比例（已完成時為 1）；專案、團隊或組織則對其下方每個任務取平均值。

trans-unit.source: Projects below this node (a project counts itself).
trans-unit.target: 此節點下方的專案數（專案計入自身）。

trans-unit.source: Tasks below this node (a task counts itself).
trans-unit.target: 此節點下方的任務數（任務計入自身）。

trans-unit.source: The name shown on the map, in breadcrumbs and in the panel.
trans-unit.target: 在地圖、階層導覽和面板中顯示的名稱。

trans-unit.source: The root of a `SemanticZoom` map: the organization and its teams.
trans-unit.target: `SemanticZoom` 地圖的根節點：組織及其團隊。

trans-unit.source: The key numbers of one node of a `SemanticZoom` map: its kind and name, open and blocked tasks and the next due date, progress as a large percentage with a bar, and the people involved as an avatar stack with a closing note. Numbers roll digit by digit when `Scope` or its totals change. `SemanticZoom` shows one beside or under its map; use it on its own by binding `Scope`.
trans-unit.target: `SemanticZoom` 地圖中某個節點的關鍵數字：其類型與名稱、未完成與受阻任務、下一個截止日期、以大字百分比加進度條顯示的進度，以及以頭像堆疊加結尾說明呈現的相關人員。當 `Scope` 或其總數變更時，數字會逐位滾動。`SemanticZoom` 會在其地圖旁或下方顯示一個面板；若要單獨使用，請繫結 `Scope`。

trans-unit.source: Formats the next due date and the percentage; null uses `Default`.
trans-unit.target: 格式化下一個截止日期與百分比；為 null 時使用 `Default`。

trans-unit.source: Two columns (under a wide map) or one (beside a map, or in narrow containers). Default two.
trans-unit.target: 兩欄（位於寬地圖下方時）或一欄（位於地圖旁或窄容器中）。預設為兩欄。

trans-unit.source: The node whose numbers are shown (the organization, a team, a project or a task).
trans-unit.target: 要顯示其數字的節點（組織、團隊、專案或任務）。

trans-unit.source: Labels and notes (English defaults).
trans-unit.target: 標籤與備註（英文預設值）。

trans-unit.source: A person on a `SemanticZoom` map: a team or project lead, or a task's assignee or reviewer. Without an `Avatar` the map draws a muted circle with the person's initials.
trans-unit.target: `SemanticZoom` 地圖上的一位人員：團隊或專案的牽頭人，或任務的負責人或審查者。未設定 `Avatar` 時，地圖會繪製一個淡色圓圈，內含此人的姓名首字母。

trans-unit.source: A picture drawn in a circle; null draws the initials instead.
trans-unit.target: 繪製於圓形中的圖片；為 null 時改為顯示首字母。

trans-unit.source: Initials for the fallback circle; null takes the first letters of the first two words of `Name`.
trans-unit.target: 後備圓圈中的首字母；為 null 時取 `Name` 前兩個詞的首字母。

trans-unit.source: The person's full name.
trans-unit.target: 此人的全名。

trans-unit.source: Job title, shown under the name in a task's details.
trans-unit.target: 職稱，在任務詳情中顯示於姓名下方。

trans-unit.source: A project: a card of task blocks with a lead, a health and a due date.
trans-unit.target: 專案：由任務區塊組成的卡片，包含牽頭人、健康度與截止日期。

trans-unit.source: When the project is due (shown on its card and in its hover card).
trans-unit.target: 專案的截止日期（顯示於其卡片與懸停提示卡中）。

trans-unit.source: How the project is doing (the dot beside its status line).
trans-unit.target: 專案的進展狀況（狀態列旁的點）。

trans-unit.source: The project lead.
trans-unit.target: 專案的牽頭人。

trans-unit.source: A task: a block on its project's card, and when zoomed in, a card with its status, summary, assignee and checklist. Ticking the last open checklist item marks the task `Done`; unticking an item of a done task puts it back `InReview`. Set `Status` yourself at any time.
trans-unit.target: 任務：專案卡片上的一個區塊；放大後，則顯示一張包含其狀態、摘要、負責人與清單的卡片。勾選最後一個未完成的清單項會將任務標記為 `Done`；取消勾選已完成任務的某個清單項，則會將其恢復為 `InReview`。您可隨時自行設定 `Status`。

trans-unit.source: Who is doing it.
trans-unit.target: 由誰負責執行。

trans-unit.source: How many comments it has.
trans-unit.target: 其評論的數量。

trans-unit.source: When it is due.
trans-unit.target: 截止時間。

trans-unit.source: The estimate in points.
trans-unit.target: 以點數表示的估算值。

trans-unit.source: Who reviews it (used in the generated summary of a task in review; null uses the project lead).
trans-unit.target: 由誰審查它（用於產生處於審查中的任務摘要；為 null 時使用專案牽頭人）。

trans-unit.source: Where the task stands.
trans-unit.target: 任務目前所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: The description in the task's details; null generates one from the status (`SemanticZoomTexts`).
trans-unit.target: 任務詳情中的描述；為 null 時依狀態產生（參見 `SemanticZoomTexts`）。

trans-unit.source: A team: a panel of project cards with a lead.
trans-unit.target: 團隊：由專案卡片組成的面板，並帶有牽頭人。

trans-unit.source: The team lead, shown in the team's header and hover card.
trans-unit.target: 團隊牽頭人，顯示於團隊的標題與懸停提示卡中。

trans-unit.source: How a service, a day or a whole page is doing; the order is the order of severity.
trans-unit.target: 一項服務、一天或整個頁面的運作情況;順序即嚴重程度的順序。

trans-unit.source: A settings command palette: one search field that finds any setting and changes it in place. Toggles flip, choices cycle through their options and actions run, all without leaving the keyboard; focus stays in the search field while the arrow keys move a highlight that glides between rows. A notice in the footer confirms each change. Write the settings inline (`SettingsCommandToggle`, `SettingsCommandChoice`, `SettingsCommandAction`) or bind `Items`. Their values are styled properties, so `IsChecked` and `SelectedOption` bind two-way and the rows follow changes made elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: 設定命令面板：一個搜尋欄，可以找到任意設定並就地修改。開關會切換，選項會在各個可選值之間循環，動作會直接執行，全程不必離開鍵盤；焦點保持在搜尋欄中，方向鍵移動高亮，高亮在各設定列之間滑動。頁尾的提示會確認每次變更。可以內嵌撰寫設定（`SettingsCommandToggle`、`SettingsCommandChoice`、`SettingsCommandAction`），也可以繫結 `Items`。它們的值是樣式屬性，因此 `IsChecked` 與 `SelectedOption` 支援雙向繫結，各設定列會跟隨其他地方的變更。

trans-unit.source: The highlighted setting that Enter acts on, or null when nothing is on show.
trans-unit.target: 高亮的設定，按 Enter 即對其執行動作；沒有可顯示的設定時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Escape is pressed with an empty query: close the palette. Mark it handled so a surrounding Dialog does not handle the same Escape again.
trans-unit.target: 在查詢為空時按下 Escape 時引發，用於關閉面板。將其標記為已處理，使外層的 Dialog 不會再次處理同一次 Escape。

trans-unit.source: Whether the palette draws its own panel (surface, border, radius and floating shadow). Turn it off inside a Dialog or another surface.
trans-unit.target: 是否由面板自行繪製外框（底色、邊框、圓角與浮動陰影）。在 Dialog 或其他容器中使用時請關閉。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an action is invoked with Enter or a click, after its command ran.
trans-unit.target: 透過 Enter 或點擊呼叫動作時引發，在其命令執行之後。

trans-unit.source: The settings to search, in the order they are listed when the query is empty.
trans-unit.target: 要搜尋的設定，查詢為空時依此順序列出。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text; replace the whole object to localize the palette.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字；如需在地化面板，請替換整個物件。

trans-unit.source: The text in the search field (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 搜尋欄中的文字（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: The tallest the result list gets before it scrolls.
trans-unit.target: 結果列表在出現捲動之前可達到的最大高度。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the user changes a toggle or a choice (not when the app sets the value).
trans-unit.target: 使用者變更開關或選項時引發（應用程式以程式碼設定值時不引發）。

trans-unit.source: A command such as "Change email" or "Sign out everywhere". Enter or a click runs `Command`, then the palette raises `ItemInvoked`. The row shows the `Shortcut` in key caps and, for links to another page, an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 一則命令，例如「變更電子郵件」或「在所有裝置上登出」。按 Enter 或點擊會執行 `Command`，然後面板引發 `ItemInvoked`。該設定列以鍵帽形式顯示 `Shortcut`；如果是連到其他頁面的連結，則顯示箭頭。

trans-unit.source: The command to run.
trans-unit.target: 要執行的命令。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 傳遞給 `Command` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Whether the action opens another page; the row shows an arrow.
trans-unit.target: 是否開啟其他頁面；設定列會顯示箭頭。

trans-unit.source: The app's shortcut for the action, shown in key caps, such as "mod+shift+d" (Command on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere) or "Ctrl+,". The palette only shows it; the app handles the shortcut itself.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式為該動作設定的快捷鍵，以鍵帽形式顯示，例如「mod+shift+d」（Mac 上為 Command，其他平台為 Ctrl）或「Ctrl+,」。面板只負責顯示，快捷鍵由應用程式自行處理。

trans-unit.source: A setting with a few named values. Enter or a click moves to the next option (after the last comes the first); the left and right arrow keys, and the arrows beside the value, step without wrapping.
trans-unit.target: 具有數個具名值的設定。按 Enter 或點擊會切換到下一個選項（最後一個之後回到第一個）；左右方向鍵以及值旁邊的箭頭逐項移動，不循環。

trans-unit.source: The values in order. In XAML a comma-separated string works: `Options="Light, Dark, System"`.
trans-unit.target: 依序排列的值。在 XAML 中可以使用逗號分隔的字串：`Options="Light, Dark, System"`。

trans-unit.source: The current value (two-way). When null it becomes the first option.
trans-unit.target: 目前的值（雙向繫結）。為 null 時會變為第一個選項。

trans-unit.source: One line under the header (trimmed to a single line); also searched.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行文字（會截為單行）；同時參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: The group the row is listed under, such as "Appearance"; also searched. Without one it is listed under "Settings" when other settings have a group.
trans-unit.target: 該設定列所屬的群組，例如「外觀」；同時參與搜尋。未指定群組時，若其他設定有群組，則歸入「設定」。

trans-unit.source: The setting's name, shown in the row and searched first.
trans-unit.target: 設定的名稱，顯示在設定列中，並優先參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) shown in a tile before the header.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成員），顯示在標題前的圖塊中。

trans-unit.source: Whether the setting can be changed. Disabled rows are dimmed and skipped by the keyboard.
trans-unit.target: 是否可以修改該設定。停用的設定列會變暗，並在鍵盤操作中被略過。

trans-unit.source: Other words that find the setting (synonyms separated by spaces or commas), such as "dark light appearance".
trans-unit.target: 其他能搜尋到該設定的詞語（以空格或逗號分隔的同義詞），例如「深色 淺色 外觀」。

trans-unit.source: An on / off setting. Enter or a click flips `IsChecked`; the row shows a switch.
trans-unit.target: 開 / 關設定。按 Enter 或點擊會切換 `IsChecked`；該設定列會顯示開關。

trans-unit.source: Whether the setting is on (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 是否開啟該設定（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: A group of related settings: an optional header with a description and actions, a stack of rows (usually `SettingsRow`, written inline or bound through `ItemsSource`), and an optional footer strip for a note or a save button. Drawn as a card by default, or plain inside a page. The rows sit in one column unless `Columns` or `MinColumnWidth` asks for more, and `LabelWidth`, `ContentAlignment` and `ContentSpacing` set the layout of every row in the group.
trans-unit.target: 一組相關設定：選用的標題（含說明和操作）、一組設定列（通常為 `SettingsRow`，可直接寫在 XAML 中，或透過 `ItemsSource` 繫結），以及選用的底部條，用於放置備註或儲存按鈕。預設以卡片形式繪製，在頁面中則為平鋪。除非 `Columns` 或 `MinColumnWidth` 要求更多欄，設定列排成一欄；`LabelWidth`、`ContentAlignment` 和 `ContentSpacing` 決定群組內每一列的版面。

trans-unit.source: The number of columns the rows are laid out in right now, after `MinColumnWidth` is applied.
trans-unit.target: 套用 `MinColumnWidth` 之後，設定列目前排成的欄數。

trans-unit.source: Card (default) or Plain.
trans-unit.target: 卡片（預設）或平鋪。

trans-unit.source: The horizontal gap between columns (32 by default).
trans-unit.target: 欄之間的水平間距（預設 32）。

trans-unit.source: How many columns a row of the group spans (default 1); 0 spans the whole line. A span wider than the current number of columns is cut to the whole line.
trans-unit.target: 群組中某個設定列跨越的欄數（預設 1）；0 跨越整列。跨度超過目前欄數時按整列處理。

trans-unit.source: The number of columns the rows are laid out in (default 1). With `MinColumnWidth` it is the most columns the group uses; 0 means as many as fit at `MinColumnWidth`, but no more than there are rows.
trans-unit.target: 設定列排成的欄數（預設 1）。與 `MinColumnWidth` 一起使用時，它是群組最多使用的欄數；0 表示依 `MinColumnWidth` 能放下多少欄就用多少欄，但不超過設定列的數量。

trans-unit.source: Where each row's control sits in the space beside a fixed `LabelWidth`, inherited by the rows of the group (default Right). A row's own `ContentAlignment` overrides it.
trans-unit.target: 每一列的控制項在固定 `LabelWidth` 旁邊空間中的位置，由群組內的設定列繼承（預設 Right）。設定列自己的 `ContentAlignment` 會覆寫它。

trans-unit.source: The gap between each row's text and its control, inherited by the rows of the group (default NaN: 16, or 12 above a control under the text). A row's own `ContentSpacing` overrides it.
trans-unit.target: 每一列的文字與控制項之間的間距，由群組內的設定列繼承（預設 NaN：16，控制項在文字下方時為上方 12）。設定列自己的 `ContentSpacing` 會覆寫它。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the header.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一句說明。

trans-unit.source: Content of the strip under the rows, such as a note and a save button.
trans-unit.target: 設定列下方底部條中的內容，例如備註或儲存按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Content at the right of the header, such as a button.
trans-unit.target: 標題右側的內容，例如按鈕。

trans-unit.source: The width from each row's left edge to its control, icon included, inherited by the rows of the group (default NaN: as wide as the text needs). A row's own `LabelWidth` overrides it.
trans-unit.target: 每一列從左邊緣到控制項的寬度（包含圖示），由群組內的設定列繼承（預設 NaN：依文字需要的寬度）。設定列自己的 `LabelWidth` 會覆寫它。

trans-unit.source: The narrowest a column may be (default 0, off). When set, the group drops columns while they would be narrower than this, down to one, so a two-column group becomes one column in a narrow window.
trans-unit.target: 欄的最小寬度（預設 0，關閉）。設定後，當欄寬將小於該值時，群組會減少欄數，最少一欄，因此兩欄的群組在窄視窗中變為一欄。

trans-unit.source: The vertical gap between lines of rows (default 0: rows carry their own padding and hairline).
trans-unit.target: 設定列各列之間的垂直間距（預設 0：設定列自帶內距和細線）。

trans-unit.source: A full settings page. The left column holds the page `Title`, one navigation item per `SettingsSection` (icon, header, badge) under a raised selection pill that glides between them, and a `Footer` such as an account card; the chosen section fills the rest of the page. While the chosen section is `IsDirty`, a save bar rises at the bottom with Discard and Save. Narrower than `CompactWidth`, the page becomes one column with the sections as a scrolling row of pills. Write the sections inline (`<arc:SettingsSection Header="Billing" Icon="...">…</arc:SettingsSection>`) or bind them through `ItemsSource`; the first enabled section is selected by default. `SelectedValue` (two-way) is the selected section's `Value`, so the shown section can be bound to an enum or a view model property; set `SelectedValueBinding` to read the value some other way.
trans-unit.target: 完整的設定頁面。左欄顯示頁面的 `Title`，每個 `SettingsSection` 對應一個導覽項目（圖示、標題、徽章），導覽項目之間有一個凸起的選取膠囊滑動切換；左欄底部是 `Footer`，例如帳號卡片。所選區段佔滿頁面其餘部分。所選區段有未儲存的變更（`IsDirty`）時，底部會升起儲存列，帶有捨棄和儲存按鈕。寬度小於 `CompactWidth` 時，頁面變為單欄，區段以一排可捲動的膠囊顯示。可直接內嵌撰寫區段（`<arc:SettingsSection Header="Billing" Icon="...">…</arc:SettingsSection>`），也可透過 `ItemsSource` 繫結；預設選取第一個已啟用的區段。`SelectedValue`（雙向）是所選區段的 `Value`，因此可以把目前顯示的區段繫結到列舉或檢視模型的屬性；設定 `SelectedValueBinding` 可用其他方式讀取值。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the page becomes one column with the sections as a row of pills (default 720).
trans-unit.target: 低於此寬度時，頁面變為單欄，區段以一排膠囊呈現（預設 720）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Discard is pressed in the save bar.
trans-unit.target: 在儲存列中按下「捨棄」時引發。

trans-unit.source: Content at the bottom of the navigation column, such as an account card. Hidden on compact pages.
trans-unit.target: 導覽欄底部的內容，例如帳戶卡片。在精簡版面的頁面中隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Whether the page is narrower than `CompactWidth` and shows one column.
trans-unit.target: 頁面是否窄於 `CompactWidth` 並顯示為單欄。

trans-unit.source: The built-in text (save bar, accessible names). Replace the whole object to translate it.
trans-unit.target: 內建文字（儲存列、無障礙名稱）。替換整個物件即可翻譯。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Save is pressed (or Ctrl/⌘+S) while the selected section has unsaved changes.
trans-unit.target: 所選區段有未儲存的變更時，按下儲存（或 Ctrl/⌘+S）時引發。

trans-unit.source: The page title above the navigation (default "Settings").
trans-unit.target: 導覽上方的頁面標題（預設為「設定」）。

trans-unit.source: One setting: an optional icon (or any `Leading` content, such as an avatar), a header and description on the left with optional `Details` under them, and the control that changes it (`Content`) on the right. Below `StackWidth` the control moves under the text. Rows in a `SettingsGroup` (or any panel) are separated by a hairline; the first row has none. When the control is a toggle (Switch, Checkbox), clicking the header or description toggles it too, and the control takes the header as its accessible name and the description as its help text unless it has its own. `LabelWidth`, `ContentAlignment` and `ContentSpacing` are inherited from the `SettingsGroup` that holds the row, so the controls of a group line up; set them on a row to override.
trans-unit.target: 一項設定：左側是選用的圖示（或任意 `Leading` 內容，例如頭像）、標題和說明，其下可有選用的 `Details`；右側是用於修改該設定的控制項（`Content`）。寬度小於 `StackWidth` 時，控制項會移到文字下方。`SettingsGroup`（或任意面板）中的設定列之間以細線分隔，第一列沒有分隔線。當控制項是開關（Switch）或核取方塊（Checkbox）時，點擊標題或說明也會切換它；除非控制項已有自己的名稱和說明文字，否則控制項會以標題作為無障礙名稱，以說明作為說明文字。`LabelWidth`、`ContentAlignment` 和 `ContentSpacing` 繼承自包含該列的 `SettingsGroup`，因此群組內的控制項會對齊；在設定列上設定它們即可覆寫。

trans-unit.source: Where the control sits in the space beside a fixed `LabelWidth` (default Right); Stretch fills it. Without a label width the control is as wide as it needs, at the right. Under the text the control is at the left, or fills the row with Stretch. Inherited from the `SettingsGroup`.
trans-unit.target: 控制項在固定 `LabelWidth` 旁邊空間中的位置（預設 Right）；Stretch 填滿該空間。沒有標籤寬度時，控制項依需要的寬度位於右側。控制項在文字下方時位於左側，使用 Stretch 時填滿整列。繼承自 `SettingsGroup`。

trans-unit.source: The gap between the text and the control: before the control beside the text, above it under the text (default NaN: 16 beside, 12 under). Inherited from the `SettingsGroup`.
trans-unit.target: 文字與控制項之間的間距：控制項在文字旁邊時位於控制項之前，在文字下方時位於控制項上方（預設 NaN：旁邊 16，下方 12）。繼承自 `SettingsGroup`。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the header that explains the setting; also the control's help text.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方說明此設定的一句話；同時也是控制項的說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Content under the header and description, such as a status line, an error or a row of tags. Text is shown small and muted; other content keeps its own look.
trans-unit.target: 標題和說明下方的內容，例如狀態列、錯誤訊息或一排標籤。文字以小號弱化樣式顯示；其他內容保持自身外觀。

trans-unit.source: The setting's name, shown in medium weight; also the control's accessible name.
trans-unit.target: 設定的名稱，以中等字重顯示；同時也是控制項的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) shown in a tile before the header. Not shown while the row has `Leading` content.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 線性圖示（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成員），顯示在標題前的圖塊中。設定列有 `Leading` 內容時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the control currently sits under the text (the row is narrower than `StackWidth`).
trans-unit.target: 控制項目前是否位於文字下方（即設定列寬度小於 `StackWidth`）。

trans-unit.source: The width from the row's left edge to the control, icon included, so controls line up across rows with and without icons (default NaN: as wide as the text needs). Inherited from the `SettingsGroup`. Ignored while the control sits under the text.
trans-unit.target: 從設定列左邊緣到控制項的寬度（包含圖示），因此帶圖示和不帶圖示的設定列中的控制項會對齊（預設 NaN：依文字需要的寬度）。繼承自 `SettingsGroup`。控制項位於文字下方時不生效。

trans-unit.source: Content before the header in place of the icon tile, such as an `Avatar` or a logo; it keeps its own size. When set, `Icon` is not shown.
trans-unit.target: 標題前取代圖示區塊的內容，例如 `Avatar` 或標誌；它保持自身尺寸。設定後不顯示 `Icon`。

trans-unit.source: Below this width the control moves under the header and description (default 440).
trans-unit.target: 低於此寬度時，控制項會移到標題與描述下方（預設 440）。

trans-unit.source: One section of a `SettingsPage`: its `Header`, `Icon` and `Badge` appear in the page's navigation, and while it is selected the section itself (header, `Description` and content) fills the page's content area. Set `IsDirty` while it has unsaved changes to show the page's save bar. `Value` is what the page reports as its `SelectedValue` while the section is selected.
trans-unit.target: `SettingsPage` 的一個區段：其 `Header`、`Icon` 和 `Badge` 顯示在頁面導覽中；選取時，區段本身（標題、`Description` 和內容）會佔滿頁面的內容區域。區段有未儲存的變更時，設定 `IsDirty` 即可顯示頁面的儲存列。區段被選取時，`Value` 就是頁面回報的 `SelectedValue`。

trans-unit.source: A short marker at the end of the navigation item, such as "New" or a count.
trans-unit.target: 導覽項目末端的簡短標記，例如「New」或數量。

trans-unit.source: The color of the `Badge`: Neutral (the default), Success, Info (the accent), Warning or Danger.
trans-unit.target: `Badge` 的顏色：Neutral（預設）、Success、Info（強調色）、Warning 或 Danger。

trans-unit.source: A sentence under the section title in the content area.
trans-unit.target: 內容區域中區段標題下方的一句說明。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon shown before the header in the navigation.
trans-unit.target: 導覽中標題前顯示的 24×24 線性圖示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the section has unsaved changes: the page shows its save bar while this section is selected.
trans-unit.target: 區段是否有未儲存的變更：選取此區段時，頁面會顯示其儲存列。

trans-unit.source: The value that identifies the section, such as an enum member or a route key: the page's `SelectedValue` while this section is selected, and setting the page's `SelectedValue` to it selects this section. Without a value the section reports itself.
trans-unit.target: 識別該區段的值，例如列舉成員或路由鍵：選取此區段時它就是頁面的 `SelectedValue`，把頁面的 `SelectedValue` 設為它則會選取此區段。沒有值時，區段回報它自己。

trans-unit.source: The share dialog of a document: invite people by email with a role, see everyone who has access and change or remove their role, choose who else can open the link (only the people listed, anyone in the organization or anyone with the link, each with its own role) and copy the link.
trans-unit.target: 文件的共用對話框：依電子郵件邀請成員並指定角色，檢視所有有權限的人並修改或移除他們的角色，選擇還有誰能開啟連結（只有清單中的人、組織內的任何人或擁有連結的任何人，各有自己的角色），並複製連結。

trans-unit.source: Raised after someone's access was removed from their row.
trans-unit.target: 從某人的行中移除其權限後觸發。

trans-unit.source: The address of the person using the dialog; their row says "(you)".
trans-unit.target: 使用對話框的人的地址；他的那一行會顯示「(you)」。

trans-unit.source: The document's name, used in the heading.
trans-unit.target: 文件的名稱，用於標題。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the Done button is pressed; close the dialog here.
trans-unit.target: 按下 Done 按鈕時觸發；在這裡關閉對話框。

trans-unit.source: Sends the invites (for example to your server) before the people are added; the button spins while it runs. When it throws, the message shows under the field and the chips stay. Null adds the people at once.
trans-unit.target: 在加入成員之前寄出邀請（例如寄到你的伺服器）；它執行期間按鈕顯示載入動畫。它擲回例外時，訊息顯示在地址欄下方，標籤保留。為 null 時立即加入成員。

trans-unit.source: The role the next invite gives (two-way). Owner is not allowed and reads back as Editor.
trans-unit.target: 下一次邀請給出的角色（雙向）。不允許 Owner，讀回時為 Editor。

trans-unit.source: The words the dialog shows and announces.
trans-unit.target: 對話框顯示和播報的文字。

trans-unit.source: The document's link, which the copy button copies.
trans-unit.target: 文件的連結，複製按鈕複製的就是它。

trans-unit.source: Raised after `LinkScope` or `LinkRole` changed.
trans-unit.target: `LinkScope` 或 `LinkRole` 改變後觸發。

trans-unit.source: What people who open the link may do (two-way). Owner is not allowed and reads back as Viewer.
trans-unit.target: 開啟連結的人可以做什麼（雙向）。不允許 Owner，讀回時為 Viewer。

trans-unit.source: Who can open the link besides the people listed (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 除了清單中的人以外，還有誰能開啟連結（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: The organization's name, used by the "Anyone at …" link scope.
trans-unit.target: 組織的名稱，用於「Anyone at …」這一連結範圍。

trans-unit.source: Raised after people were invited and added to `People`.
trans-unit.target: 成員被邀請並加入 `People` 後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Raised after someone's role was changed from their row.
trans-unit.target: 從某人的行中修改其角色後觸發。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `PeopleInvited`: the addresses invited and the role they were given.
trans-unit.target: `PeopleInvited` 的參數：被邀請的地址和給他們的角色。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `ShareAccess` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance or set its properties to translate; texts with names in them are functions so the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `ShareAccess` 顯示或播報的每一句文字，預設為英文。替換實例或設定它的屬性即可翻譯；帶有名字的文字是函式，因此可以改變語序。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `LinkAccessChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `LinkAccessChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: A person with access to the document, shown as one row of a `ShareAccess`.
trans-unit.target: 一個有權限存取文件的人，在 `ShareAccess` 中顯示為一行。

trans-unit.source: A picture for the avatar, or null for initials.
trans-unit.target: 頭像用的圖片，為 null 時顯示姓名首字母。

trans-unit.source: The person's email address; it identifies them (compared without regard to case).
trans-unit.target: 這個人的電子郵件地址；用它來識別這個人（比較時不區分大小寫）。

trans-unit.source: True while the invitation has not been accepted yet; the row says so under the address.
trans-unit.target: 邀請尚未被接受時為 true；這一行會在地址下方註明。

trans-unit.source: The person's name, or null to show the email address alone.
trans-unit.target: 這個人的名字，為 null 時只顯示電子郵件地址。

trans-unit.source: What the person may do.
trans-unit.target: 這個人可以做什麼。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `AccessRemoved`.
trans-unit.target: `AccessRemoved` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `RoleChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `RoleChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Shares one item from a Share button that stretches, on a spring, into a sharing panel: the item's name as a heading, its link with a Copy button, the access level that goes with the link, channel buttons for posting it, recent people to pick (each pick sends their avatar to a chip) and Send. A successful send turns the same surface into a small confirmation with Undo and Done, and Done shrinks it back to the button. When the viewport is 520 px wide or less, the panel is shown as a sheet at the bottom of a dimmed page instead and can be dragged closed by its grabber.
trans-unit.target: 從一個分享按鈕分享單一項目：按鈕藉由彈簧伸展成分享面板，裡面有作為標題的項目名稱、帶「複製」按鈕的連結、連結對應的存取權限、用來發布連結的管道按鈕、可以挑選的最近聯絡人（每選一人，其頭像就飛向一個標籤）以及「傳送」。傳送成功後，同一個表面變成一張帶「復原」和「完成」的小確認卡片，「完成」再把它縮回按鈕。視埠寬度為 520 px 或更窄時，面板改為顯示在變暗頁面底部的底部面板，可以拖曳把手將其關閉。

trans-unit.source: The `Value` of the chosen access level (two-way). Null, or a value no level has, means the first level.
trans-unit.target: 所選存取權限的 `Value`（雙向）。為 null 或沒有任何一項具有該值時，表示第一項。

trans-unit.source: Where the panel is anchored to the button as it opens: the top end corner (End, the default), the top start corner (Start) or the center (Center).
trans-unit.target: 面板展開時錨定在按鈕的哪個位置：頂部結尾端的角（End，預設）、頂部起始端的角（Start）或中心（Center）。

trans-unit.source: Posts the link to a channel. The channel's button spins while it runs, then shows the channel's done word, or "Failed" when it throws. Null finishes at once.
trans-unit.target: 把連結發布到一個管道。執行期間該管道的按鈕轉圈，之後顯示該管道的完成詞，擲回例外時顯示 "Failed"。為 null 時立即完成。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a channel finished posting (after `ChannelHandler` completed). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 某個管道發布完成時觸發（`ChannelHandler` 完成之後）。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: The 24 × 24 stroked glyph before the Share button's text; null shows the text alone.
trans-unit.target: 分享按鈕文字前的 24 × 24 描邊圖示；為 null 時只顯示文字。

trans-unit.source: Whether the panel (or the confirmation) is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 面板（或確認卡片）是否開啟（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: The Share button's text (default "Share").
trans-unit.target: 分享按鈕的文字（預設 "Share"）。

trans-unit.source: The words the sheet shows and announces.
trans-unit.target: 面板顯示和播報的文字。

trans-unit.source: The URL to share: displayed in its own row and copied by the Copy button; null leaves the row out.
trans-unit.target: 要分享的網址：單獨顯示在一列中，由「複製」按鈕複製；為 null 時不顯示該列。

trans-unit.source: Raised once Copy has put the link on the clipboard; the arguments say which access level was chosen at that moment. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 「複製」把連結放到剪貼簿上之後觸發；引數說明當時選取的是哪個存取權限。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Sends the item to the people picked (to your server, say). Send waits for it with a spinner; when it throws, an error shows over the Send button and the panel stays open; when it completes, the confirmation shows. Null sends at once.
trans-unit.target: 把項目傳送給選取的人（例如送到你的伺服器）。「傳送」會轉圈等待它；它擲回例外時，傳送按鈕上方顯示錯誤，面板保持開啟；它完成時顯示確認卡片。為 null 時立即傳送。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Undo on the confirmation takes the last send back; take it back in your app too. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 確認卡片上的「復原」撤回上一次傳送時觸發；請在你的應用程式中同樣撤回。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a send succeeded (after `SendHandler` completed), with who and under which access. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 傳送成功之後觸發（`SendHandler` 完成之後），附帶傳給了誰以及使用的存取權限。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Whether viewports 520 px wide or narrower get a sheet docked to the bottom, with the page dimmed behind it, instead of the floating panel (default true). The sheet slides up, tracks drags on its grabber, and is dismissed by Escape, a press on the dimmed page, a long drag or Done.
trans-unit.target: 視埠寬度為 520 px 或更窄時，是否用停靠在底部、後方頁面變暗的底部面板取代浮動面板（預設 true）。底部面板向上滑入，跟隨把手的拖曳，按 Escape、在變暗的頁面上按下、長距離拖曳或按「完成」都會讓它關閉。

trans-unit.source: The item's name, which the panel puts in its heading as Share “name”.
trans-unit.target: 項目的名稱，面板在標題中把它顯示為 Share “名稱”。

trans-unit.source: A stack of nested modal sheets for short drill-down flows (settings, filters, account details): each level opens on top of the last, and the levels below shrink by 5%, darken and keep a strip of their top edge in view. Below `Breakpoint` the levels are bottom sheets that can be dragged or flicked down to close; from it up they are centered dialogs. The page content is the control's `Content`; the levels are declared in `Sheets` and opened by id with `Push` or a button carrying `OpenSheetProperty`.
trans-unit.target: 用於簡短逐層深入流程（設定、篩選、帳戶詳細資料）的巢狀強制回應面板堆疊：每一層在上一層之上開啟，下方各層縮小 5%、變暗，並保留一條頂邊可見。寬度低於 `Breakpoint` 時各層是可向下拖曳或甩動關閉的底部面板；達到或超過它時則是置中的對話方塊。頁面內容是控制項的 `Content`；各層在 `Sheets` 中宣告，並透過 `Push` 或帶有 `OpenSheetProperty` 的按鈕依 id 開啟。

trans-unit.source: The presentation in use: `Sheet` or `Dialog`.
trans-unit.target: 目前使用的呈現方式：`Sheet` 或 `Dialog`。

trans-unit.source: The width from which `Auto` shows dialogs (default 640): the control's own width when `IsContained`, otherwise the window's.
trans-unit.target: `Auto` 開始顯示對話方塊的寬度（預設 640）：`IsContained` 時為控制項本身寬度，否則為視窗寬度。

trans-unit.source: Closes every level at once (they leave together).
trans-unit.target: 一次關閉所有層（它們一起離開）。

trans-unit.source: Gets `IsDragExcludedProperty`.

trans-unit.source: Arc shortcut recorder: a field that records a keyboard shortcut. Press it (Enter, Space or a click), then press the combination: held modifiers light up as key caps while the chord is built, the finished shortcut settles into place (caps pop in with a 35ms stagger), and a combination that is already taken (`Bindings`, or one the browser or system keeps such as ⌘W and ⌘C) asks before it is used. Escape cancels, Backspace / Delete clears, Tab stops recording and moves on, and the reset button restores `ResetValue`. Caps follow the platform: ⌘ ⇧ glyphs on a Mac, Ctrl+Shift names elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: Arc 快速鍵錄入框：記錄鍵盤快速鍵的欄位。按下它（Enter、Space 或按一下），再按下組合鍵：組合過程中，已按住的修飾鍵會以按鍵帽形式亮起；完成的快速鍵以 35ms 錯開的節奏彈出按鍵帽並定位。若組合鍵已被佔用（`Bindings` 中的，或瀏覽器、系統保留的如 ⌘W 與 ⌘C），使用前會先詢問。Escape 取消錄入，Backspace / Delete 清除，Tab 停止錄入並移到下一項，重設按鈕則還原 `ResetValue`。按鍵帽遵循平台慣例：Mac 上顯示 ⌘ ⇧ 符號，其他平台顯示 Ctrl+Shift 文字。

trans-unit.source: The app's main navigation (an original TKCode design): a header for a logo or a workspace switcher, an optional filter box, sections of pages with icons, counts and one level of nested pages, and a footer for the signed-in user. The selected page carries a muted block behind it and an accent-colored icon; the block glides between rows on a snappy spring. Parents open their pages with a height spring and a turning chevron. The sidebar collapses to a 64px icon rail on a width spring: labels and counts fade, counts become dots, every page gets a tooltip on the right and a parent shows its pages in a menu. Keyboard (WAI-ARIA tree model): the list is one tab stop; ↑ / ↓, Home / End move, → opens a parent or enters it, ← closes it or goes back to the parent, Enter / Space choose, typing jumps to a page by its first letters, and Cmd / Ctrl+B collapses or expands the sidebar while focus is inside it.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式的主導覽（TKCode 原創設計）：頂部區域放標誌或工作區切換器，接著是可選的篩選框、含圖示與計數並可支援一層巢狀頁面的頁面分區，以及顯示已登入使用者的底部區域。選取的頁面背後有一塊柔和色塊，圖示變為強調色，色塊會以輕快的彈簧動畫在各列之間滑動；父層頁面以高度彈簧動畫展開其子頁面，並附有旋轉的 V 形箭頭。側邊欄會以寬度彈簧動畫收合為 64px 的圖示窄欄：文字與計數淡出，計數變為圓點，每個頁面在右側顯示工具提示，父層頁面則以選單形式顯示其子頁面。鍵盤操作（WAI-ARIA 樹狀模型）：清單只佔一個 Tab 停駐點；↑ / ↓、Home / End 移動焦點，→ 展開父層或進入其中，← 收合或返回父層，Enter / Space 選擇，輸入字母可依頁面開頭字母跳轉，焦點位於側邊欄內時 Cmd / Ctrl+B 可收合或展開側邊欄。

trans-unit.source: The property path of an item's badge text. Resolved with reflection, so trimmed and NativeAOT apps use `BadgeMemberBinding` instead, which wins when both are set.
trans-unit.target: 項目徽章文字的屬性路徑。透過反射解析，因此修剪與 NativeAOT 應用程式請改用 `BadgeMemberBinding`，兩者都設定時以它為準。

trans-unit.source: Where the collapse button sits while the sidebar is open: in the header row (default) or beside the filter box. On the rail it always sits at the top.

trans-unit.source: Accessible name and tooltip of the collapse button while the sidebar is the rail. Unset, it is the localized "Expand sidebar", which follows the Arc language.
trans-unit.target: 側邊欄為窄欄時，收合按鈕的無障礙名稱與工具提示。未設定時為在地化的「展開側邊欄」，並跟隨 Arc 語言。

trans-unit.source: Width of the open sidebar (default 240, the theme's `ExpandedWidth` token); collapsing springs from it to the 64px rail and expanding springs back to it. Set this, not `Width`, to make the sidebar narrower or wider: the sidebar drives its own `Width` to animate the collapse, so a `Width` set on it fixes it at that width and it no longer collapses. The header, filter, rows and footer keep this width's layout while the width springs.
trans-unit.target: 展開時側邊欄的寬度（預設 240，即主題的 `ExpandedWidth` 權杖）；收合時從它以彈簧過渡到 64px 窄欄，展開時再回到它。要讓側邊欄更窄或更寬，請設定此屬性而不是 `Width`：側邊欄自行驅動 `Width` 來呈現收合動畫，在它上面設定的 `Width` 會把寬度固定下來，側邊欄也就不再收合。寬度變化期間，頭部、篩選欄位、各列與底部維持此寬度下的配置。

trans-unit.source: The filter text (two-way). Pages whose label contains it stay; a parent with a matching page opens.
trans-unit.target: 篩選文字（雙向）。標籤包含該文字的頁面會保留顯示；含有符合頁面的父層會展開。

trans-unit.source: Content at the bottom (the signed-in user, a storage meter), under a thin separator. It keeps its open-width layout on the rail, clipped to the rail; use the `:collapsed` pseudo-class to adapt it.
trans-unit.target: 底部內容（已登入的使用者、儲存空間用量條），位於一條細分隔線下。在窄欄上仍保持展開時的版面配置，並裁切至窄欄內；可使用 `:collapsed` 偽類進行調整。

trans-unit.source: Content at the top (a logo and title, a workspace switcher), beside the collapse button when that sits in the header row. It is hidden on the rail while the collapse button shows.
trans-unit.target: 頂部內容（標誌與標題、工作區切換器）；收合按鈕位於頭部列時，顯示在它旁邊。在窄欄上，收合按鈕顯示時此區域會隱藏。

trans-unit.source: The property path of an item's icon (a geometry or a control). Resolved with reflection, so trimmed and NativeAOT apps use `IconMemberBinding` instead, which wins when both are set.
trans-unit.target: 項目圖示的屬性路徑（幾何圖形或控制項）。透過反射解析，因此修剪與 NativeAOT 應用程式請改用 `IconMemberBinding`，兩者都設定時以它為準。

trans-unit.source: Binding that reads an item's icon (a geometry or a control); it wins over `IconMember`.
trans-unit.target: 讀取項目圖示的繫結（幾何圖形或控制項）；優先於 `IconMember`。

trans-unit.source: Shows the collapse / expand button (PanelLeft icon). Its place is `CollapseButtonPlacement`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示收合或展開按鈕（PanelLeft 圖示）。它的位置由 `CollapseButtonPlacement` 決定。

trans-unit.source: Whether the sidebar is the 64px icon rail (two-way). The width springs between the two.
trans-unit.target: 側邊欄是否為 64px 圖示窄欄（雙向）。寬度在兩種狀態之間以彈簧動畫變化。

trans-unit.source: The property path of an item's enabled state (a bool). Resolved with reflection, so trimmed and NativeAOT apps use `IsEnabledMemberBinding` instead, which wins when both are set.
trans-unit.target: 項目啟用狀態的屬性路徑（bool）。透過反射解析，因此修剪與 NativeAOT 應用程式請改用 `IsEnabledMemberBinding`，兩者都設定時以它為準。

trans-unit.source: Binding that reads an item's enabled state (a bool); it wins over `IsEnabledMember`.
trans-unit.target: 讀取項目啟用狀態的繫結（bool）；優先於 `IsEnabledMember`。

trans-unit.source: Shows the filter box under the header (it becomes a search button on the rail).
trans-unit.target: 在頭部下方顯示篩選框（在窄欄上變為搜尋按鈕）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a page is chosen (click, Enter or Space, or a page in a rail menu), also when it already was the selected page.
trans-unit.target: 選擇頁面時觸發（點擊、Enter 或 Space 鍵，或在窄欄選單中選擇頁面），即使該頁面已是目前選取的頁面也會觸發。

trans-unit.source: The pages as data. Each item becomes a row in a header-less section placed before the sections declared in `Sections`. An item that is a `SidebarItem` (or a subclass with your own fields) is used as it is; any other object is mapped through the `*MemberBinding` bindings (or the `*Member` paths), and its object is kept in `Tag`. Collection changes are followed when the source is an `INotifyCollectionChanged`.
trans-unit.target: 以資料形式提供的頁面。每一項成為一個無標題群組中的一列，該群組位於 `Sections` 中宣告的群組之前。屬於 `SidebarItem`（或帶有你自己欄位的子類別）的項目原樣使用；其他物件透過 `*MemberBinding` 繫結（或 `*Member` 路徑）對應，物件本身保存在 `Tag` 中。當資料來源是 `INotifyCollectionChanged` 時會跟隨集合變動。

trans-unit.source: The property path of an item's key, which `SelectedKey` matches against. Resolved with reflection, so trimmed and NativeAOT apps use `KeyMemberBinding` instead, which wins when both are set.
trans-unit.target: 項目鍵的屬性路徑，`SelectedKey` 與其比對。透過反射解析，因此修剪與 NativeAOT 應用程式請改用 `KeyMemberBinding`，兩者都設定時以它為準。

trans-unit.source: Binding that reads an item's key, which `SelectedKey` matches against; it wins over `KeyMember`.
trans-unit.target: 讀取項目鍵的繫結，`SelectedKey` 與其比對；優先於 `KeyMember`。

trans-unit.source: Name of the navigation landmark. Unset, it is the localized "Sidebar", which follows the Arc language.
trans-unit.target: 導覽地標的名稱。未設定時為在地化的「側邊欄」，並跟隨 Arc 語言。

trans-unit.source: The property path of an item's label (for items that are not `SidebarItem`s). Resolved with reflection, so trimmed and NativeAOT apps use `LabelMemberBinding` instead, which wins when both are set.
trans-unit.target: 項目標籤的屬性路徑（用於不是 `SidebarItem` 的項目）。透過反射解析，因此修剪與 NativeAOT 應用程式請改用 `LabelMemberBinding`，兩者都設定時以它為準。

trans-unit.source: Binding that reads an item's label, e.g. `{Binding Title, DataType=local:MenuNode}` (for items that are not `SidebarItem`s). A compiled binding stays trimming and NativeAOT safe; it wins over `LabelMember`.
trans-unit.target: 讀取項目標籤的繫結，例如 `{Binding Title, DataType=local:MenuNode}`（用於不是 `SidebarItem` 的項目）。編譯繫結在修剪與 NativeAOT 下都安全；優先於 `LabelMember`。

trans-unit.source: Text shown when the filter matches no page. Unset, it is the localized "No matches", which follows the Arc language.
trans-unit.target: 篩選沒有符合的頁面時顯示的文字。未設定時為在地化的「沒有相符項目」，並跟隨 Arc 語言。

trans-unit.source: How the width change between the open sidebar and the rail reaches the page next to it: `Overlay` (default) or `Push`.
trans-unit.target: 展開的側邊欄與收合的側欄之間的寬度變化，如何傳遞給相鄰頁面：`Overlay`（預設）或 `Push`。

trans-unit.source: Runs when a page is chosen; the parameter is the `SidebarItem`.
trans-unit.target: 選擇頁面時執行；參數為 `SidebarItem`。

trans-unit.source: The selected page (two-way). A parent cannot be selected: choosing it opens and closes its pages.
trans-unit.target: 被選取的頁面（雙向）。父項目不能被選取：選擇父項目會展開或收合其子頁面。

trans-unit.source: The `Key` of the selected page (two-way), kept in step with `SelectedItem`; bind it to your route.
trans-unit.target: 被選取頁面的 `Key`（雙向），與 `SelectedItem` 保持同步；可綁定到路由。

trans-unit.source: Builds the content at the end of each bound row. The control gets the item's data (the object in `ItemsSource`) as its `DataContext`, so a template can bind to your own fields, e.g. show an add button only while `CanAdd` is true. A `TrailingIcon` that is already set wins.
trans-unit.target: 產生每個繫結列末尾的內容。該控制項以項目的資料（`ItemsSource` 中的物件）作為 `DataContext`，因此範本可以繫結到你自己的欄位，例如僅當 `CanAdd` 為 true 時顯示新增按鈕。項目上已設定的 `TrailingIcon` 優先。

trans-unit.source: Added to the accessible name of a page that has `IsUnread` ("Inbox, unread"). Unset, it is the localized "unread", which follows the Arc language.
trans-unit.target: 附加到帶有 `IsUnread` 的頁面的無障礙名稱中（“Inbox, unread”）。未設定時為在地化的「未讀」，並跟隨 Arc 語言。

trans-unit.source: One page of a `Sidebar`: a row with an icon, a label and an optional count. An item with `Items` is a parent: it opens and closes its child pages instead of being selected (one level of nesting).
trans-unit.target: `Sidebar` 中的一個頁面：一列，包含圖示、文字和可選的計數。帶有 `Items` 的項目為父項目：它會展開或收合其子頁面，而不會被選取（僅支援一層巢狀）。

trans-unit.source: A short count at the end of the row (for example "12"); on the icon rail it becomes a dot on the icon. Null shows nothing.
trans-unit.target: 列尾的簡短計數（例如“12”）；在圖示窄欄上會變為圖示上的圓點。為 null 時不顯示任何內容。

trans-unit.source: Runs when the page is chosen (with `CommandParameter`).
trans-unit.target: 選擇頁面時執行（使用 `CommandParameter`）。

trans-unit.source: The parameter passed to `Command`.
trans-unit.target: 傳遞給 `Command` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: The 16px leading icon: a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` (for example an `ArcIcons` glyph) or any control.
trans-unit.target: 16px 的前置圖示：24x24 的 Lucide `Geometry`（例如 `ArcIcons` 圖示），或任意控制項。

trans-unit.source: Makes the row an action instead of a page: muted, never selected. Choosing it raises `ItemInvoked` and runs the commands, but `SelectedItem` stays (for example "New project", "More").
trans-unit.target: 讓該列成為動作而不是頁面：顏色柔和，永遠不會被選取。選取它會觸發 `ItemInvoked` 並執行命令，但 `SelectedItem` 保持不變（例如“New project”“More”）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the page can be chosen. Disabled rows are dimmed and skipped by the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 頁面是否可以被選取。停用的列會變淡，並在方向鍵操作時被略過。

trans-unit.source: Whether the child pages of a parent are shown (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 父項目的子頁面是否顯示（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Marks the page as having something new: a small accent dot at the end of the row, a stronger label, and a dot on the icon on the rail.
trans-unit.target: 把頁面標記為有新內容：列尾顯示一個小的強調色圓點，名稱更醒目，在窄欄上圖示上會出現一個圓點。

trans-unit.source: A stable id for the page (a route or view name); `SelectedKey` selects by it.
trans-unit.target: 頁面的穩定識別碼（路由或檢視名稱）；`SelectedKey` 透過它進行選取。

trans-unit.source: The row text; also the tooltip on the icon rail and the text that typing and the filter match.
trans-unit.target: 列文字；同時作為圖示窄欄上的工具提示，並用於輸入搜尋和篩選時的比對。

trans-unit.source: Any value you want back when the page is chosen.
trans-unit.target: 選擇頁面時取回的任意值。

trans-unit.source: An icon after the label, in the label's muted color (for example a chevron on a "More" row): a 24x24 Lucide `Geometry` or any control.
trans-unit.target: 名稱之後的圖示，顏色與名稱的柔和色相同（例如“More”列上的箭頭）：24x24 的 Lucide `Geometry` 或任意控制項。

trans-unit.source: One group of pages in a `Sidebar`: an optional small heading over its `Items`. A collapsible section folds its pages away under the heading; on the icon rail sections are separated by a thin line instead.
trans-unit.target: `Sidebar` 中的一組頁面：`Items` 上方可選的小標題。可收合群組會在標題下收合其頁面；在圖示窄欄上，群組之間改以細線分隔。

trans-unit.source: The small heading over the pages; null shows no heading (for example the first group: Home, Inbox).
trans-unit.target: 頁面上方的小標題；為 null 時不顯示標題（例如第一個群組：Home、Inbox）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the heading is a button that folds the pages away (it shows a small chevron). Needs a `Header`.
trans-unit.target: 標題是否為用於收合頁面的按鈕（會顯示一個小箭頭）。需要設定 `Header`。

trans-unit.source: Whether the pages of a collapsible section are shown (two-way). Ignored when the section is not collapsible.
trans-unit.target: 可收合群組的頁面是否顯示（雙向）。群組不可收合時會被忽略。

trans-unit.source: A sign in card that morphs from an email address to a six digit code to the signed in account, with a passkey button and single sign-on buttons (Arc's free sign-in block, the "Email code" variant of Login). Each step slides in from the side it is heading to while the card's height follows on a spring; the account's avatar grows from the code step into the signed in state, where a ring draws around it and a check pops in.
trans-unit.target: 登入卡片：從電子郵件地址變為六位數驗證碼，最後變為已登入的帳號，並附有通行密鑰按鈕與單一登入按鈕（Arc 的免費登入區塊，即 Login 的 "Email code" 變體）。每個步驟從其前往的一側滑入，卡片高度依彈簧動畫跟隨調整；帳號頭像從驗證碼步驟放大為已登入狀態，此時頭像周圍繪製一圈環線，並彈出勾選標記。

trans-unit.source: The account being signed in to (code step) or signed in (done), or null (read only).
trans-unit.target: 正在登入的帳號（驗證碼步驟）或已登入的帳號（完成）；唯讀時為 null。

trans-unit.source: The known accounts; when set, it is used instead of `Accounts`.
trans-unit.target: 已知帳號；設定後將取代 `Accounts` 使用。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of that button ("Change email").
trans-unit.target: 該按鈕的無障礙名稱（"Change email"）。

trans-unit.source: The label of the button that goes back to the email ("Change").
trans-unit.target: 用於返回電子郵件的按鈕標籤（"Change"）。

trans-unit.source: Status while the code is checked ("Checking code").
trans-unit.target: 檢查驗證碼時的狀態（"Checking code"）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading of the code step.
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼步驟標題下方的說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the code. Null shows `DemoCodeHintFormat` while the check is simulated (no `VerifyCodeAsync`) and nothing otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼下方的輔助文字。為 null 時，在模擬檢查期間（無 `VerifyCodeAsync`）顯示 `DemoCodeHintFormat`，否則不顯示任何內容。

trans-unit.source: The label of the code field ("Verification code").
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼欄位的標籤（"Verification code"）。

trans-unit.source: The error for a wrong code.
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼錯誤時顯示的錯誤訊息。

trans-unit.source: Status once the code is sent ("Code sent").
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼送出後的狀態（"Code sent"）。

trans-unit.source: The heading of the code step ("Check your email").
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼步驟的標題（"Check your email"）。

trans-unit.source: The label of the button that sends the code ("Continue").
trans-unit.target: 傳送驗證碼的按鈕文字（"Continue"）。

trans-unit.source: The code the simulated email contains ("123456"); used only while `VerifyCodeAsync` is null.
trans-unit.target: 模擬郵件中的驗證碼（"123456"）；僅在 `VerifyCodeAsync` 為 null 時使用。

trans-unit.source: The helper copy of the simulated check; {0} is `DemoCode` ("For this demo, the code is {0}.").
trans-unit.target: 模擬驗證的輔助文字；{0} 為 `DemoCode`（"For this demo, the code is {0}."）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading of the email step.
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件步驟標題下方的說明文字。

trans-unit.source: The label of the second row ("This browser").
trans-unit.target: 第二列的標籤（"This browser"）。

trans-unit.source: The value of the second row ("Remembered for 30 days").
trans-unit.target: 第二列的值（"Remembered for 30 days"）。

trans-unit.source: The word in the divider ("or").
trans-unit.target: 分隔線中的文字（"or"）。

trans-unit.source: Status after going back to the email ("Edit your email").
trans-unit.target: 返回電子郵件後的狀態（"Edit your email"）。

trans-unit.source: The email address in the field; two-way. Signing out puts the account's address back.
trans-unit.target: 欄位中的電子郵件地址；雙向繫結。登出後會恢復為帳號的位址。

trans-unit.source: Status after the suggestion is taken; {0} is the address ("Email changed to {0}").
trans-unit.target: 採納建議後的狀態；{0} 為位址（"Email changed to {0}"）。

trans-unit.source: The name of the email code method ("Email code").
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件驗證碼方式的名稱（"Email code"）。

trans-unit.source: How the signed in status names the email code method ("an email code").
trans-unit.target: 已登入狀態中如何稱呼電子郵件驗證碼方式（"an email code"）。

trans-unit.source: The label of the email field ("Email").
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件欄位的標籤（"Email"）。

trans-unit.source: The placeholder of the email field ("name@example.com").
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件欄位的預留位置文字（"name@example.com"）。

trans-unit.source: The error for an empty email field.
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件欄位為空時的錯誤訊息。

trans-unit.source: The name of an account whose address gives none ("Arc member").
trans-unit.target: 帳號的位址無法提供名稱時所使用的名稱（"Arc member"）。

trans-unit.source: The error for an incomplete code ("Enter all 6 digits.").
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼不完整時的錯誤訊息（"Enter all 6 digits."）。

trans-unit.source: The error for an incomplete address.
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件地址不完整時的錯誤訊息。

trans-unit.source: True while a code is being sent or checked, or a passkey or provider is pending (read only).
trans-unit.target: 正在寄送或檢查驗證碼，或密碼金鑰、第三方登入待處理時為 True（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the passkey button shows (true).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示通行密鑰按鈕（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the single sign-on buttons show (true).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示單一登入按鈕（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the footer's "No account? Sign up" shows (true).
trans-unit.target: 頁尾的 "No account? Sign up" 是否顯示（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: How the account signed in, once it has (read only).
trans-unit.target: 帳號的登入方式（登入後才有值，唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: Status after a wrong code ("Code didn't match").
trans-unit.target: 輸入錯誤驗證碼後的狀態（"Code didn't match"）。

trans-unit.source: Status after a new code is sent ("New code sent").
trans-unit.target: 傳送新驗證碼後的狀態（"New code sent"）。

trans-unit.source: Status while a provider is pending; {0} is the provider ("Opening {0}").
trans-unit.target: 第三方登入等待期間的狀態；{0} 是第三方登入方式（"Opening {0}"）。

trans-unit.source: The label of the passkey button ("Sign in with a passkey").
trans-unit.target: 密碼金鑰按鈕的標籤（"Sign in with a passkey"）。

trans-unit.source: The name of the passkey method ("Passkey").
trans-unit.target: 密碼金鑰登入方式的名稱（"Passkey"）。

trans-unit.source: Status while a passkey is pending ("Waiting for your passkey").
trans-unit.target: 密碼金鑰待處理時的狀態（"Waiting for your passkey"）。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of a provider button; {0} is the provider ("Continue with {0}").
trans-unit.target: 第三方登入按鈕的無障礙名稱；{0} 為第三方登入方（"Continue with {0}"）。

trans-unit.source: The single sign-on providers; when set, it is used instead of `Providers`.
trans-unit.target: 單一登入的第三方登入方式；設定後將取代 `Providers` 使用。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name while waiting; {0} is the seconds ("Resend code, available in {0} seconds").
trans-unit.target: 等待期間的無障礙名稱；{0} 為秒數（"Resend code, available in {0} seconds"）。

trans-unit.source: The words before the countdown ("Resend code in").
trans-unit.target: 倒數計時前的文字（"Resend code in"）。

trans-unit.source: The resend button once a new code can be sent ("Resend code").
trans-unit.target: 可再次寄送新驗證碼時的重新寄送按鈕（"Resend code"）。

trans-unit.source: Seconds before a new code can be sent (30).
trans-unit.target: 再次傳送新驗證碼前需等待的秒數（30）。

trans-unit.source: The error when `SendCodeAsync` fails.
trans-unit.target: `SendCodeAsync` 失敗時的錯誤訊息。

trans-unit.source: Status while a code is sent ("Sending a code").
trans-unit.target: 傳送驗證碼時的狀態（"Sending a code"）。

trans-unit.source: Status when a passkey or provider fails; {0} is the method ("Couldn't sign in with {0}. Try again.").
trans-unit.target: 密碼金鑰或第三方登入失敗時的狀態；{0} 為登入方式（"Couldn't sign in with {0}. Try again."）。

trans-unit.source: The label of the sign out button ("Sign out").
trans-unit.target: 登出按鈕的標籤（"Sign out"）。

trans-unit.source: Runs after `SignUpRequested` when "Sign up" is pressed.
trans-unit.target: 按下 "Sign up" 時，於 `SignUpRequested` 之後執行。

trans-unit.source: The label of the sign up button ("Sign up").
trans-unit.target: 註冊按鈕的標籤（"Sign up"）。

trans-unit.source: The words before the sign up button ("No account?").
trans-unit.target: 註冊按鈕前的提示文字（"No account?"）。

trans-unit.source: "Sign up" was pressed. Mark it handled when you open sign up; otherwise the card says "Sign up opens in your app".
trans-unit.target: 按下了 "Sign up"。開啟註冊頁面時請將其標記為已處理；否則卡片會顯示 "Sign up opens in your app"。

trans-unit.source: Arc's signature field with real ink: width follows pen pressure, or speed for a mouse or finger, and the ends taper like a nib lifting off. It keeps undo and redo, clears with a wipe across the pad, replays the signature in its original rhythm, and exports a cropped PNG or SVG. A "Sign here" hint rests on the baseline until the first stroke.
trans-unit.target: Arc 簽名板，帶有真實墨跡：線寬隨筆壓變化；使用滑鼠或手指時則隨速度變化，筆畫兩端像筆尖離紙一樣逐漸收細。支援復原與重做，以一次擦拭橫越整個畫板即可清除，並能依原有節奏重播簽名，還可匯出裁切後的 PNG 或 SVG。在第一筆落下之前，基線上會保留一個「在此簽名」提示。

trans-unit.source: True when an undone change can be redone.
trans-unit.target: 存在可重做的已復原變更時為 true。

trans-unit.source: True when a change can be undone (the last 60 are kept).
trans-unit.target: 存在可復原的變更時為 true（保留最近 60 次）。

trans-unit.source: File name for exports, without extension (default "signature").
trans-unit.target: 匯出檔案的檔名，不含副檔名（預設為 "signature"）。

trans-unit.source: The resting hint on the baseline before the first stroke (default "Sign here").
trans-unit.target: 第一筆落下之前，基線上的靜置提示（預設為「在此簽名」）。

trans-unit.source: The ink for new strokes (default black). Each stroke keeps the ink it was drawn with.

trans-unit.source: The nib for new strokes (default medium).
trans-unit.target: 新筆畫使用的筆尖（預設為 medium）。

trans-unit.source: True before the first stroke and after a clear.
trans-unit.target: 第一筆落下之前以及清除之後為 true。

trans-unit.source: True while the signature is being replayed.
trans-unit.target: 簽名正在重播時為 true。

trans-unit.source: Printed under the baseline, such as the signer's name.
trans-unit.target: 印在基線下方的內容，如簽署人姓名。

trans-unit.source: The strokes of the signature, in pad units (600 × 260).
trans-unit.target: 簽名的筆畫，以畫板單位表示（600 × 260）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after every change: a stroke drawn, undo, redo or clear (Arc's `onChange`).
trans-unit.target: 每次變化後觸發：畫出一筆、復原、重做或清除（Arc 中為 `onChange`）。

trans-unit.source: An account creation card (Arc's Sign up block): Google, Apple and GitHub buttons, then the full name, a work email and a password with a four-bar strength meter, a product updates opt-in and Create account. When the account is made, the card slides to a completion panel whose check draws itself in, with how the account was made and Start over; the card's height glides between the two.
trans-unit.target: 帳號建立卡片（Arc 的註冊區塊）：包括 Google、Apple 和 GitHub 按鈕，接著是全名、工作電子郵件和密碼（附四格強度列）、產品更新訂閱選項，以及 "Create account" 按鈕。帳號建立完成後，卡片會滑動到完成面板，面板中的勾號會逐步繪製出現，並顯示帳號的建立方式以及 "Start over" 按鈕；卡片高度會在兩個檢視之間平滑過渡。

trans-unit.source: A recognizer that never touches the microphone: it speaks the `Scripts` you give it as scripted speech with interim guesses, corrections and speech-like levels. Set it as the `Simulation` of a `DictationControl` or a `DictationButton` (where the composer can loop it) for demos and design reviews, or use it as a recognizer in tests. Each start plays the next script; with no scripts the voice stays silent.
trans-unit.target: 從不存取麥克風的辨識器：把你提供的 `Scripts` 以附暫定猜測、更正與類似語音音量的腳本化語音朗讀出來。可把它設為 `DictationControl` 或 `DictationButton` 的 `Simulation`（輸入框可以循環播放它），用於展示與設計審查，也可以在測試中當作辨識器使用。每次啟動會播放下一段腳本；沒有腳本時聲音保持靜默。

trans-unit.source: A website footer in three layouts: link columns with a newsletter signup (`Columns`), a single quiet row (`Minimal`), and a closing layout where the Arc arch rises in, oversized and cropped by the bottom edge, fading into the page (`Logo`). The newsletter validates in place, keeps its width while the button morphs, and confirms without a toast. Every text, link, column and the status line can be replaced; with nothing set the footer shows Arc's sample footer.
trans-unit.target: 網站頁尾，提供三種版面：帶電子報訂閱的連結欄（`Columns`）、單行簡潔版面（`Minimal`），以及收尾版面（`Logo`），在此版面中 Arc 的拱形圖案從底部升起，尺寸放大並被底邊裁切，漸隱於頁面之中。電子報訂閱會就地驗證，按鈕變形時保持寬度，並在不跳出提示的情況下確認。所有文字、連結、欄和狀態列都可以替換；未設定時顯示 Arc 的範例頁尾。

trans-unit.source: A website header in three layouts (Arc's site header block): it sticks to the top of its scroll view and turns solid once the page scrolls, marks the current section with an indicator that glides between links, opens springy mega menu panels whose content slides in from the side you moved toward, and folds into a menu sheet when it is narrower than `CollapseWidth` (the block's own width, not the window's). Data driven: the links are `SiteHeaderItem`s (or `ItemsSource`); without items the header shows Arc's example set. Choosing any destination raises `Navigate` (and runs `NavigateCommand`); when nobody handles the event and the destination has an absolute http, https or mailto address, it is opened.
trans-unit.target: 網站標頭，提供三種版面（Arc 網站標頭區塊）：它會黏附在捲動檢視的頂部，頁面捲動後轉為實色背景；以會隨連結滑動的指示器標示目前區段；開啟具彈性的大型選單面板，其內容從你移動的方向滑入；當寬度小於 `CollapseWidth`（區塊本身的寬度，而非視窗寬度）時，會收合為選單面板。資料驅動：連結為 `SiteHeaderItem`s（或 `ItemsSource`）；未提供項目時，標頭顯示 Arc 的範例組合。選取任一目的地都會引發 `Navigate`（並執行 `NavigateCommand`）；若沒有任何處理常式處理該事件，且目的地為絕對 http、https 或 mailto 位址，則會開啟它。
