trans-unit.source: Reserves space while content is still loading (Arc Skeleton): an optional round avatar and 1–6 text lines that pulse top to bottom in a calm, finite wave. With `Content` it crossfades into the content when `IsLoading` turns false (the content rises 4px into place) while the height springs from the placeholder to the content. Without content the placeholder always shows.
trans-unit.target: 在內容仍在載入時預留空間（Arc 骨架屏）：可選的圓形頭像與 1–6 行文字佔位，以平穩有限的波浪由上而下脈動。設定 `Content` 後，當 `IsLoading` 變為 false 時，內容會淡入取代佔位（內容上移 4px 就位），同時高度以彈簧由佔位過渡到內容的高度。沒有內容時始終顯示佔位。

trans-unit.source: Adds a round avatar placeholder before the lines.
trans-unit.target: 在文字行之前加入一個圓形頭像佔位。

trans-unit.source: Keeps the placeholder visible while true; only used when `Content` is set.
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時保持佔位可見；僅在設定了 `Content` 時生效。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the placeholder (Arc `label`, "Loading content").
trans-unit.target: 佔位的無障礙名稱（Arc 中為 `label`，即「正在載入內容」）。

trans-unit.source: Placeholder text lines (Arc clamps to 1–6). Defaults to 3.
trans-unit.target: 佔位文字行數（Arc 會限制在 1–6 之間）。預設為 3。

trans-unit.source: A loading region whose skeleton blocks grow into the real content, block by block, instead of swapping (Arc Skeleton morph, design reference). Wrap every visible piece of the loaded layout in a `MorphBlock`. While `IsLoading` is true the blocks show size-matched skeletons that breathe together and the region reports itself busy; when it turns false the blocks resolve in reading order, `Stagger` apart, each stretching from its skeleton to the content's measured box. The region eases to its new height and clips while it does, so its border never jumps; add the `card` style class to make the region the card. Going back to loading is immediate for the blocks while the height still eases.
trans-unit.target: 載入區域，其骨架區塊逐塊長成真實內容，而不是直接替換（Arc Skeleton morph，設計參考）。把載入後版面中每個可見部分都包在一個 `MorphBlock` 裡。`IsLoading` 為 true 時，各區塊顯示與內容同尺寸、一起呼吸的骨架，區域回報自己忙碌中；轉為 false 時，各區塊依閱讀順序相隔 `Stagger` 依序解析，每塊從自己的骨架伸展到內容量得的方框。區域平滑調整到新高度並在期間裁切，因此邊框從不跳動；加上 `card` 樣式類別可讓區域本身成為卡片。回到載入時各區塊立即復原，高度仍會平滑調整。

trans-unit.source: While true, blocks show their skeletons and the region is busy. Turning it false resolves the blocks.
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時各區塊顯示骨架，區域處於忙碌狀態。設為 false 會解析各區塊。

trans-unit.source: True from the moment loading ends until every block has resolved and its skeleton has faded.
trans-unit.target: 從載入結束到每個區塊都已解析、骨架都已淡出之間為 true。

trans-unit.source: Status text screen readers say while the region loads ("Loading" by default).
trans-unit.target: 區域載入時螢幕閱讀器讀出的狀態文字（預設 "Loading"）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the blocks have finished resolving after loading ended (also when there was nothing to animate).
trans-unit.target: 載入結束後各區塊解析完成時觸發（沒有需要動畫的區塊時也會觸發）。

trans-unit.source: Time between blocks as they resolve in reading order (40 ms by default; zero resolves them together).
trans-unit.target: 各區塊依閱讀順序解析時相鄰兩塊的間隔（預設 40 ms；為零時一起解析）。

trans-unit.source: An image generation visual that paints the way an artist does (Arc Sketch to image, design reference). Pencil lines sketch the scene stroke by stroke with a pen tip that lifts and travels between strokes, a round brush sweeps flat color blocks in region by region from back to front, two soft detail passes, film grain and a warm light refine it, and it resolves into the finished picture. Under the canvas a stage label with an icon crossfades above the prompt, beside a thin progress line, a percent and a Replay button. Give it a `Scene` (what gets drawn) and, optionally, the finished `Image`. With no `Status` it loops on its own over them; set `Status` (or `Progress`) to follow a real generation. Nothing is generated: it is a simulated preview over your scene. Without a scene or an image it rests on blank paper, waiting. One clock drives a single 0 → 1 timeline; a frame redraws the ink layer and sets layer opacities, and allocates nothing.
trans-unit.target: 像畫家一樣作畫的影像生成視覺效果（Arc Sketch to image，設計參考）。鉛筆線條一筆一筆勾出場景，筆尖在筆畫之間抬起並移動；圓頭畫筆由後往前逐個區域掃過，鋪上平塗色塊；兩層柔和的細節、底片顆粒與暖光加以潤飾，最後呈現完成的畫面。畫布下方，帶圖示的階段標籤在提示詞上方交叉淡入淡出，旁邊是一條細進度線、百分比和「重播」按鈕。給它一個 `Scene`（要繪製的內容），也可以再給完成的 `Image`。不設定 `Status` 時它在這些內容上自行循環；設定 `Status`（或 `Progress`）即可跟隨真實的生成。這裡並不生成任何東西：它是在你的場景上播放的模擬預覽。沒有場景也沒有圖片時，它停在空白畫紙上等待。一個時鐘驅動唯一一條 0 → 1 的時間軸；每一影格重繪墨跡層並設定各層的不透明度，不配置任何記憶體。

trans-unit.source: Raised each time the picture is fully revealed. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 每次畫面完全呈現時引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: One full pass from blank paper to the picture. Sketching takes about 38%, blocking 24%, refining 26% and the final crossfade 12%.
trans-unit.target: 從空白畫紙到完成畫面的完整一遍所需時間。勾線約占 38%，鋪色 24%，潤飾 26%，最後的交叉淡入 12%。

trans-unit.source: The finished picture (your real result), stretched to fill the canvas; it overrides the scene's own.
trans-unit.target: 完成的畫面（你的真實結果），延展以填滿畫布；它會取代場景自帶的畫面。

trans-unit.source: When it plays on its own, holds the picture for about two seconds, fades back to blank paper and paints again.
trans-unit.target: 自行播放時，在畫面上停留約兩秒，淡回空白畫紙後再畫一遍。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: Where the pass should be, from 0 (blank paper) to 1 (the picture), in place of `Status`'s stage ends (sketching ends at 0.38, blocking at 0.62, refining at 0.88). The painting still travels there at its own pace.
trans-unit.target: 這一遍應到達的位置，從 0（空白畫紙）到 1（畫面），用來取代 `Status` 的各階段終點（勾線在 0.38 結束，鋪色在 0.62，潤飾在 0.88）。繪畫仍依自己的節奏前往那裡。

trans-unit.source: The prompt under the stage label, on one line with the full text in a tooltip. Empty or null (the default) hides it.
trans-unit.target: 階段標籤下方的提示詞，單行顯示，完整文字在提示框中。為空或 null（預設）時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Replay is pressed, for example to rerun a real request. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 按下「重播」時引發，例如用於重新發出真實的請求。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: What gets drawn and the picture it resolves into. Null (with no `Image`) leaves blank paper: the card waits and does not loop.
trans-unit.target: 要繪製的內容及其最終呈現的畫面。為 null（且沒有 `Image`）時維持空白畫紙：卡片等待，不會循環。

trans-unit.source: Shows the Replay button, which fades to blank paper and paints again up to the current stage.
trans-unit.target: 顯示「重播」按鈕，它會淡回空白畫紙，再重新畫到目前階段。

trans-unit.source: The card's maximum width (340, 520 or 720px) and pencil weight. Small shows only Replay's icon.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的最大寬度（340、520 或 720px）與鉛筆粗細。Small 只顯示「重播」的圖示。

trans-unit.source: The stage on screen (it can trail `Status` while the painting travels there).
trans-unit.target: 螢幕上顯示的階段（繪畫前往目標期間可能落後於 `Status`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised once each time the stage on screen changes, never per frame. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 螢幕上的階段每變化一次引發一次，從不逐影格引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The generation stage. Null (default) plays the whole pass on its own and loops (a card with no scene and no image waits on blank paper instead). A stage plays to its end and holds there with a shimmering label until the next one arrives; moving back (for example to idle for a new request) fades the canvas to blank paper first. Showing the control with done shows the picture straight away.
trans-unit.target: 生成階段。null（預設）時自行播放完整一遍並循環（沒有場景也沒有圖片的卡片則停在空白畫紙上等待）。每個階段播放到結尾並停在那裡，標籤保持閃爍，直到下一個階段到來；往回走（例如為新請求回到 idle）時會先把畫布淡回空白畫紙。以 done 顯示控制項時直接呈現畫面。

trans-unit.source: The color of the pencil lines, pen tip, stage icon and progress line.
trans-unit.target: 鉛筆線條、筆尖、階段圖示與進度線的顏色。

trans-unit.source: Every word `SketchToImage` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; the percent, the canvas name and the stage announcement are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `SketchToImage` 顯示或朗讀的所有文字，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；百分比、畫布名稱與階段播報是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: One region of a `SketchToImageScene`: shapes the brush sweeps in together through one rectangle.
trans-unit.target: `SketchToImageScene` 中的一個區域：畫筆在同一個矩形內一起掃入的若干形狀。

trans-unit.source: What a `SketchToImage` draws and the picture it resolves into, on a 600 × 400 canvas: the pencil `Lines` drawn in order, the `Regions` a brush paints back to front, the point the warm light comes from, and the finished picture. Trace the lines and regions from your picture so the sketch matches it.
trans-unit.target: `SketchToImage` 在 600 × 400 畫布上繪製的內容及其最終呈現的畫面：依序繪製的鉛筆 `Lines`、畫筆由後往前上色的 `Regions`、暖光的來源位置，以及完成的畫面。依你的畫面描出線條與區域，讓草圖與之吻合。

trans-unit.source: One shape of a `SketchToImageRegion`.
trans-unit.target: `SketchToImageRegion` 中的一個形狀。

trans-unit.source: Arc slider: a value or a range on a track. The thumb follows the pointer 1:1, rubber-bands up to 9px past its limits and settles on the step grid with the velocity of the release (on a coarse grid the release may carry it one step further); pressing the track springs the nearest thumb there. A bubble with rolling digits rides the thumb while it is dragged or keyboard focused and lingers 700ms after a release. Arrows, Shift+arrows, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End work as in a native range input; a key at a limit makes the thumb strain toward the press and spring home. Unlike `Slider`, `SmallChange` is the step the value snaps to. Set `IsRange` for two thumbs (`LowerValue` / `UpperValue`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 滑桿：在軌道上選擇一個值或一個範圍。滑塊跟隨指標 1:1 移動，超出限制時會有 9px 的回彈，並以放開時的速度落到步進網格上（在粗網格上，放開時可能再多移動一步）；按下軌道會使最近的滑塊彈到該處。拖曳或鍵盤聚焦時，一個帶滾動數字的氣泡會跟隨滑塊，放開後再保留 700ms。方向鍵、Shift+方向鍵、PageUp / PageDown 以及 Home / End 的行為與原生範圍輸入一致；在極限處按鍵時，滑塊會朝按壓方向拉伸，然後彈回原位。與 `Slider` 不同，`SmallChange` 是數值吸附的步長。設定 `IsRange` 可使用兩個滑塊（`LowerValue` / `UpperValue`）。

trans-unit.source: Content after the track, such as an icon or a button.
trans-unit.target: 軌道之後的內容，例如圖示或按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Two thumbs: `LowerValue` and `UpperValue` instead of `Value`.
trans-unit.target: 兩個滑塊：使用 `LowerValue` 與 `UpperValue`，而不是 `Value`。

trans-unit.source: Shows the value beside the label. The bubble still appears while dragging or keyboard focused.
trans-unit.target: 在標籤旁顯示數值。拖曳或鍵盤聚焦時，氣泡仍會出現。

trans-unit.source: Visible label; also names the thumb (or, with " minimum" / " maximum", the range thumbs).
trans-unit.target: 可見標籤；同時作為滑塊的名稱（若為範圍滑塊，則加上 " minimum" / " maximum" 後綴分別命名兩個滑塊）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the lower range thumb; when null it is the Label with ", minimum" appended.
trans-unit.target: 下限滑塊的無障礙名稱；為 null 時為 Label 加上 ", minimum" 後綴。

trans-unit.source: Lower end of the range when IsRange is true (two-way, default 0).
trans-unit.target: IsRange 為 true 時範圍的下限（雙向繫結，預設 0）。

trans-unit.source: Ticks on the track; labeled marks also print under it and are clickable.
trans-unit.target: 軌道上的刻度；帶標籤的刻度也會印在軌道下方，並且可以點按。

trans-unit.source: The closest the two range thumbs may sit, in steps.
trans-unit.target: 兩個範圍滑塊之間可以靠近的最小距離（以步數計）。

trans-unit.source: Raised on every step of a range (drag or keys), like `ValueChanged` for one thumb.
trans-unit.target: 範圍的每一步變化（拖曳或按鍵）時觸發，與單一滑塊的 `ValueChanged` 相同。

trans-unit.source: Content before the track, such as an icon or a mute button.
trans-unit.target: 軌道前的內容，如圖示或靜音按鈕。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the upper range thumb; when null it is the Label with ", maximum" appended.
trans-unit.target: 上限滑塊的無障礙名稱；為 null 時為 Label 加上 ", maximum" 後綴。

trans-unit.source: Upper end of the range when IsRange is true (two-way, default 100).
trans-unit.target: IsRange 為 true 時範圍的上限（雙向繫結，預設 100）。

trans-unit.source: Runs once a drag is released, a key changes the value or a mark label is clicked.
trans-unit.target: 拖曳放開、按鍵改變數值或按一下刻度標籤後執行一次。

trans-unit.source: Formats the readout, the bubble and the spoken value (default: en-US with the step's decimals).
trans-unit.target: 格式化讀數、氣泡及朗讀的數值（預設：en-US，並保留步長的小數位數）。

trans-unit.source: A mark on a `Slider` or `ElasticSlider` track. A mark without a label draws a tick; a mark with a label also prints it under the track, and clicking the label moves there. On an elastic slider marks are detents the dragged thumb clicks into. Its properties can be bound in XAML; the slider follows later changes.
trans-unit.target: `Slider` 或 `ElasticSlider` 軌道上的刻度。沒有標籤的刻度只畫一條刻度線；帶標籤的刻度還會把標籤印在軌道下方，點按標籤會移動到那裡。在彈性滑桿上，刻度是拖曳滑桿時會卡入的停駐點。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結；滑桿會跟隨之後的變化。

trans-unit.source: Text printed under the track; without it the mark is a bare tick.
trans-unit.target: 印在軌道下方的文字；沒有它時刻度只是一條刻度線。

trans-unit.source: Where the mark sits, in the slider's value units.
trans-unit.target: 刻度所在的位置，使用滑桿的數值單位。

trans-unit.source: A before / after comparison on two shared axes (Arc "Slope chart"). Lines draw in from the first column to the second on first view; labels push apart instead of overlapping and connect back to their dots with thin leaders; rank movement sits beside each end value. A new dataset slides every line, dot and label to its new place on the shared morph spring. Hover or the arrow keys (in end-value order) bring one line forward and show a tooltip.
trans-unit.target: 在兩個共享座標軸上進行的前後比較（Arc「斜率圖」）。首次顯示時，線條由第一欄向第二欄逐漸畫出；標籤會互相推開而不是重疊，並以細引線連回各自的圓點；每個端點數值旁邊顯示排名變化。新資料集會以共享的變形彈簧，將每條線、每個圓點和每個標籤滑動到新位置。懸停或使用方向鍵（依終點數值順序）可將某條線置於前方並顯示提示。

trans-unit.source: Arc slot text: text and numbers that spin into their new value like slot machine reels. Every character is a reel; digits count through the wheel in the direction the number moved, letters shuffle through the alphabet, and reels stop one after another from left to right with a soft landing that never passes the target. Drawn in one control: a reel is a few numbers and cached glyphs, so a change runs no layout unless a width changes.
trans-unit.target: Arc 老虎機文字：文字和數字像老虎機轉輪一樣轉到新的值。每個字元都是一個轉輪；數字沿數值變化的方向在輪上計數，字母在字母表中洗牌，轉輪從左到右依次停下，落地柔和且絕不越過目標。全部在一個控制項中繪製：一個轉輪只是幾個數字和快取的字形，因此除非寬度變化，否則變化不會觸發版面配置。

trans-unit.source: Which end reels are matched from when the length changes. Null uses End for numbers and Start for text.
trans-unit.target: 長度變化時從哪一端比對轉輪。為 null 時，數字用 End，文字用 Start。

trans-unit.source: Announces new values politely to screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 讓螢幕閱讀器禮貌地朗讀新值。

trans-unit.source: How long the first reel spins. Later reels add `Stagger` each.
trans-unit.target: 第一個轉輪轉動的時長。之後的轉輪各加一個 `Stagger`。

trans-unit.source: The font of the reels.
trans-unit.target: 轉輪的字型。

trans-unit.source: The font size of the reels; their geometry scales with it.
trans-unit.target: 轉輪的字級；轉輪的幾何尺寸隨它縮放。

trans-unit.source: The font weight of the reels.
trans-unit.target: 轉輪的字重。

trans-unit.source: The color of the text.
trans-unit.target: 文字的顏色。

trans-unit.source: Formats a number. Null uses en-US grouping with up to three decimals, so 12480 reads 12,480.
trans-unit.target: 格式化數字。為 null 時使用 en-US 分組，最多三位小數，因此 12480 顯示為 12,480。

trans-unit.source: Extra full turns a digit makes before it lands. 0 rolls straight to the new digit.
trans-unit.target: 數字落定前額外轉動的整圈數。0 表示直接捲到新的數字。

trans-unit.source: The time between reels stopping, left to right.
trans-unit.target: 轉輪從左到右依次停下的間隔。

trans-unit.source: The text shown now, after formatting.
trans-unit.target: 現在顯示的文字（已格式化）。

trans-unit.source: The value to show. A number goes through `Format`; anything else shows as text. A value written in XAML is text, so bind a number or set it from code to get grouping.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的值。數字經過 `Format` 處理；其他值按文字顯示。寫在 XAML 中的值是文字，因此需要分組時請繫結數字或在程式碼中設定。

trans-unit.source: Many small line charts on one grid, one per group (a market, a plan, a product), all over the same periods, so the grid is read like a single chart. Pointing at one panel moves a crosshair through all of them and the readout shows that period's total; a toggle puts every panel on its own range (compare shapes) or on one range from zero (compare sizes), with the axes springing between them; the order follows the latest value, the growth or the name, and panels fly to their new places; each panel carries a faint dashed outline of the grand total; flat groups can be faded.
trans-unit.target: 排在一個格狀圖上的許多小折線圖，每個分組一張（一個市場、一個方案、一個產品），都涵蓋相同的期間，因此整張格狀圖讀起來就像一張圖。指向任一面板，十字線會穿過所有面板，讀數顯示該期間的合計；一個開關讓每個面板使用自己的範圍（比較形狀），或使用從零開始的同一範圍（比較大小），座標軸在兩者之間以彈簧過渡；順序可依最新值、成長或名稱排列，面板會飛到新位置；每個面板都襯著總量的淡淡虛線輪廓；變化不大的分組可以淡化。

trans-unit.source: After the growth in each panel; {0} is the comparison period's short label ("vs Sep 2025").
trans-unit.target: 位於每個面板的成長之後；{0} 為比較期間的短標籤（"vs Sep 2025"）。

trans-unit.source: Announced when the crosshair moves by keyboard; {0} period, {1} total, {2} the highest series, {3} its value.
trans-unit.target: 以鍵盤移動十字線時播報；{0} 為期間，{1} 為合計，{2} 為最高的序列，{3} 為它的值。

trans-unit.source: The period under the synced crosshair; null while it is hidden.
trans-unit.target: 同步十字線所在的期間；十字線隱藏時為 null。

trans-unit.source: Occurs each time the crosshair lands on another period; the index is null when the crosshair goes away.
trans-unit.target: 十字線每次落到另一個期間時觸發；十字線消失時索引為 null。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading (what is measured, over which periods); null hides it.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行文字（量測的是什麼、涵蓋哪些期間）；為 null 時隱藏。

trans-unit.source: The dimming switch's text.
trans-unit.target: 淡化開關的文字。

trans-unit.source: Announced when flat trends are shown at full strength again.
trans-unit.target: 平緩趨勢恢復完整顯示時播報。

trans-unit.source: Announced when flat trends are dimmed.
trans-unit.target: 平緩趨勢被淡化時播報。

trans-unit.target: 下降時螢幕閱讀器讀出的趨勢文字；預留位置與 `UpFormat` 相同。

trans-unit.source: The trend text of a flat series, before its growth ("Flat +0.6%").
trans-unit.target: 平緩序列的趨勢文字，位於其成長之前（"Flat +0.6%"）。

trans-unit.source: The flat band: a growth whose size (up or down) is under this fraction is flat. 0.05 means ±5%.
trans-unit.target: 平緩區間：成長幅度（無論升降）小於這個比例即視為平緩。0.05 表示 ±5%。

trans-unit.source: The legend's name for the dashed ghost of the total.

trans-unit.target: 成長往前比較多少個期間：最新值與它之前這麼多期間的值相比（預設 12，對月度資料就是一年）。資料較短時，使用第一個期間。

trans-unit.source: Beside the period in the readout while the crosshair is shown; {0} is its position, {1} the number of periods.
trans-unit.target: 顯示十字線時，讀數中期間旁的文字；{0} 為它的位置，{1} 為期間數。

trans-unit.target: 面板縱軸的設定方式（雙向）：`Independent`（預設）讓每個面板使用自己的範圍，便於比較形狀；`Shared` 讓所有面板使用從零開始的同一範圍，便於比較大小。

trans-unit.source: Occurs once the y axes have switched to the other scale.

trans-unit.source: Turns a tick value into the short label at the right of each plot; without one, `ValueFormatter` is used.
trans-unit.target: 把刻度值轉成每個繪圖區右側的短標籤；未提供時使用 `ValueFormatter`。

trans-unit.source: The heading of the block; null hides it.

trans-unit.source: The label of the total in the readout.

trans-unit.source: Screen reader trend words; {0} is the unsigned percentage and {1} the comparison text ("Up 19.9% vs Sep 2025").
trans-unit.target: 螢幕閱讀器讀出的趨勢文字；{0} 為不帶正負號的百分比，{1} 為比較文字（"Up 19.9% vs Sep 2025"）。

trans-unit.source: Turns a value into text for the panel headings, the total and what screen readers hear. Without one, values are taken to be thousands of US dollars and written "$412k" or "$1.71M".
trans-unit.target: 把數值轉成文字，用於面板標題、合計以及螢幕閱讀器朗讀的內容。未提供時，數值被視為千美元，寫作 "$412k" 或 "$1.71M"。

trans-unit.source: A step of the x axis that every panel of a `SmallMultiples` shares, named twice: briefly ("Oct 2026"), where a panel says what its growth is measured against, and in full ("October 2026"), in the readout and for screen readers.
trans-unit.target: `SmallMultiples` 所有面板共用的橫軸上的一步，有兩個名稱：簡稱（"Oct 2026"），用於面板說明成長與何時比較；全稱（"October 2026"），用於讀數與螢幕閱讀器。

trans-unit.source: The full name for the readout and screen readers ("October 2026"); without it, `Short` is used.
trans-unit.target: 用於讀數與螢幕閱讀器的全稱（"October 2026"）；未提供時使用 `Short`。

trans-unit.source: The brief name, as in "vs Oct 2025" under a panel's value.
trans-unit.target: 簡稱，例如面板數值下方的 "vs Oct 2025"。

trans-unit.source: How the panels of a `SmallMultiples` scale their y axis.
trans-unit.target: `SmallMultiples` 的面板如何設定縱軸刻度。

trans-unit.source: A group shown in a `SmallMultiples`, which gets a panel of its own. Give it a key, a name and its values, one for each of the block's periods in the same order.
trans-unit.target: 在 `SmallMultiples` 中顯示的一個分組，擁有自己的面板。為它提供鍵、名稱與數值，與區塊的期間一一對應、順序相同。

trans-unit.source: A stable id that keeps the panel (and its animation) when the list is rebuilt; null uses `Name`.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的識別碼，在清單重建時保留面板（及其動畫）；為 null 時使用 `Name`。

trans-unit.source: The panel's heading ("United States").
trans-unit.target: 面板的標題（"United States"）。

trans-unit.source: One value per period, oldest first; a missing or non-finite value leaves a gap in the line.
trans-unit.target: 每個期間一個值，由舊到新；缺漏或非有限的值會在折線上留下缺口。

trans-unit.source: The order of the panels of a `SmallMultiples`.
trans-unit.target: `SmallMultiples` 中面板的順序。

trans-unit.source: A paste-to-fill form card (Arc Smart form fill, design reference). People paste an email signature, a forwarded message or messy notes into the well; AI reads it and fills the contact form field by field. Each value fades in with a confidence dot, the text it came from lights up in the pasted text, fields below `ReviewThreshold` ask for review (and hold Save until they are checked or edited), and Undo puts the values from before the fill back. Give it your model through `Extract`: it receives the text and a cancellation token (Stop, Escape and a new paste cancel) and returns a `SmartFormFillResult` with a value, a confidence, the exact source substring and an optional note per field id. With no extractor the card uses a simulated reader (a sample's known result, a small rule-based parser for anything else) and plays a `Simulation` if you give it one: its samples behind Try sample and, when motion is full, a loop until someone touches it. `Submit` saves the form.
trans-unit.target: 貼上即填的表單卡片（Arc Smart form fill，設計參考）。使用者把電子郵件簽名、轉寄的郵件或零散筆記貼到貼上區；AI 讀取後逐一填寫聯絡人表單的欄位。每個值淡入時附上一個信心度圓點，它所來自的文字在貼上的內容中醒目標示；信心度低於 `ReviewThreshold` 的欄位需要複核（在核對或修改之前無法儲存），復原會還原填寫之前的值。透過 `Extract` 接入你的模型：它接收文字和一個取消權杖（Stop、Escape 和新的貼上會取消），並回傳一個 `SmartFormFillResult`，依欄位 id 提供值、信心度、原文子字串和選用的備註。沒有擷取器時，卡片使用模擬讀取器（範例的已知結果，其他文字由以規則為基礎的小型剖析器處理），並在你提供 `Simulation` 時播放它：Try sample 背後的範例，以及動態效果為完整時的自動循環示範，直到有人操作它。`Submit` 儲存表單。

trans-unit.source: Loops paste, fill, review and undo while the card is on screen, and stops for good on the first pointer or key press inside it. Null (default) plays while a `Simulation` plays. Never plays with reduced motion.
trans-unit.target: 卡片在畫面上時循環示範貼上、填寫、複核和復原，卡片內第一次指標按下或按鍵後永久停止。為 null（預設）時，在播放 `Simulation` 時播放。減少動態效果時從不播放。

trans-unit.source: Whether Undo can restore the values from before the last fill.
trans-unit.target: 復原是否能還原上一次填寫之前的值。

trans-unit.source: Starting values keyed by field id, applied when the card is built and whenever this changes.
trans-unit.target: 依欄位 id 指定的初始值，在卡片建立時以及此屬性變更時套用。

trans-unit.source: One line under the title; an empty string hides it.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的一行說明；空字串會隱藏它。

trans-unit.source: Reads the pasted text: receives it and a token that is cancelled by Stop, Escape, a new paste or the card leaving the tree, and returns a value per field id. Null uses the simulated reader (a sample's known result, a local parser for anything else) and plays `Simulation` when one is set.
trans-unit.target: 讀取貼上的文字：接收文字和一個權杖（Stop、Escape、新的貼上或卡片離開視覺樹時取消），並依欄位 id 回傳值。為 null 時使用模擬讀取器（範例的已知結果，其他文字由本機剖析器處理），並在設定了 `Simulation` 時播放它。

trans-unit.source: Raised once every field from a read has been filled. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 一次讀取的所有欄位都填寫完成後觸發一次。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Every other word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或朗讀的其他所有文字。

trans-unit.source: The model's mark beside its name (a 24 × 24 stroked glyph); the sparkle by default.
trans-unit.target: 模型名稱旁的標誌（24 × 24 描邊圖示）；預設為閃光圖示。

trans-unit.source: The model named beside the paste area; null names the `Simulation`'s model while one plays, or none.
trans-unit.target: 貼上區旁顯示的模型名稱；為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間顯示其模型，否則不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Where the card is: idle, reading, filling, filled, saving, saved or failed.
trans-unit.target: 卡片目前所處的階段：閒置、讀取中、填寫中、已填寫、儲存中、已儲存或失敗。

trans-unit.source: The logo for the company field, from the company's name; null or a null result falls back to a monogram, and an empty company shows a building.
trans-unit.target: 依公司名稱回傳公司欄位的標誌；為 null 或回傳 null 時顯示首字母，公司為空時顯示建築圖示。

trans-unit.source: How many filled fields still ask for review.
trans-unit.target: 仍需複核的已填寫欄位數量。

trans-unit.source: Fields whose confidence is below this ask for review and hold Save until checked or edited. Default 0.8.
trans-unit.target: 信心度低於此值的欄位需要複核，在核對或修改之前無法儲存。預設 0.8。

trans-unit.source: The texts behind Try sample, cycled in order. Null uses the `Simulation`'s while one plays; null or an empty list hides the button and the autoplay.

trans-unit.source: Texts a `SmartFormFill` plays without an extractor, from data you give it: the samples behind Try sample, each with the result a read returns, and the model named beside the paste area. Set it as `Simulation` while the card has no `Extract`: Try sample pastes the samples in turn, a read returns the sample's result after a short wait (other text is read by a few plain rules), and unless `AutoPlay` is false the card loops paste, fill, review and undo until someone touches it. Nothing is sent.

trans-unit.source: Finds a meeting time with an assistant: pick who comes and how long it takes, say what matters in plain words ("afternoons, not Friday, keep lunch free"), and the best slots appear on a week view next to everyone's busy times, each with the reasons it was picked. With no data set it shows an invented team and week.

trans-unit.target: 可選的會議時長，單位為分鐘（15、30、45、60）。

trans-unit.target: 排程器顯示或讀出的所有文字，預設為英文。

trans-unit.source: Everyone who could join, with their busy times for the shown week; `IsInvited` sets who starts invited.

trans-unit.source: The chosen slot; null when none is.
trans-unit.target: 所選的時段；沒有選中時為 null。

trans-unit.source: How many slots to propose (3).

trans-unit.source: Finds the slots; null uses `Find` after a short simulated wait. An exception shows as no times.

trans-unit.source: The proposed slots, best first; empty before a search.

trans-unit.target: 找到時段時觸發（沒有找到時也會觸發）。

trans-unit.source: Where the scheduler stands.

trans-unit.source: The first day of the shown week.
trans-unit.target: 所顯示這一周的第一天。

trans-unit.target: 某人一周中的一段忙碌時間：所顯示這一周中的某一天（0 為第一天），時間以小數表示的小時（13.5 即下午 1:30）。

trans-unit.source: Where a `SmartScheduler` stands.

trans-unit.source: One entry in a `SocialProofToast` feed: a person or a company, what they did, and when. Feed it real, recent events from your billing or analytics backend.
trans-unit.target: `SocialProofToast` 動態中的一筆紀錄：一個人或一家公司、他們做了什麼，以及何時發生。請使用來自計費或分析後端的真實、近期事件。

trans-unit.source: A stack of social proof notifications for landing and pricing pages (Arc Social proof toast, design reference): recent trials, upgrades and verified purchases from people and companies arrive every few seconds. A new toast rises in at the front while the others step back and shrink; hovering or keyboard focus pauses the cycle and fans the stack out, and visitors can dismiss any toast. Give it the feed in `Events` (oldest first) and it shows one every `Interval`, or call `Push` to show an event the moment it happens. With no events it plays its `Simulation`, if any, and otherwise shows nothing until you push one. Inline it fills its container's width; a corner `Position` pins the stack to the window instead.
trans-unit.target: 用於到達頁與定價頁的社會認同通知堆疊（Arc Social proof toast，設計參考）：來自個人與公司的最新試用、升級與已驗證購買每隔幾秒出現一則。新通知從前方升起，其他通知後退並縮小；懸停或鍵盤焦點會暫停輪播並展開堆疊，訪客可以關閉任何一則通知。在 `Events` 中傳入動態（從舊到新），它會每隔 `Interval` 顯示一則；或呼叫 `Push` 在事件發生時立即顯示。沒有事件時播放它的 `Simulation`（如果有），否則在你推送之前不顯示任何內容。內嵌時它填滿容器寬度；設定角落 `Position` 則把堆疊固定在視窗上。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a visitor dismisses a toast. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 訪客關閉一則通知時引發。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Fans the stack out while it is hovered or holds keyboard focus.
trans-unit.target: 堆疊被懸停或持有鍵盤焦點時將其展開。

trans-unit.source: Time before the first toast.
trans-unit.target: 第一則通知出現前的時間。

trans-unit.source: Time between toasts. The countdown keeps its remaining time across hover and focus pauses.
trans-unit.target: 兩則通知之間的時間。懸停與聚焦暫停期間，倒數會保留剩餘時間。

trans-unit.source: Pauses the cycle from outside, for example while a modal or cookie banner is open.
trans-unit.target: 從外部暫停輪播，例如在強制回應視窗或 Cookie 橫幅開啟期間。

trans-unit.source: Makes each toast a button that raises `Selected`, for example to open pricing or a customer story.
trans-unit.target: 讓每則通知成為一個引發 `Selected` 的按鈕，例如用來開啟定價頁或客戶案例。

trans-unit.source: Every word the stack shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 堆疊顯示或朗讀的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: Stops after this many toasts in a session, so the page stays calm. Null shows toasts for as long as the feed lasts.
trans-unit.target: 一個工作階段顯示這麼多則通知後停止，讓頁面保持安靜。為 null 時只要動態還有內容就繼續顯示。

trans-unit.source: Starts the feed over when it ends. False stops after the last event.
trans-unit.target: 動態播完後從頭開始。為 false 時在最後一個事件後停止。

trans-unit.source: How many toasts stack at once. Older ones fade out from the back.
trans-unit.target: 同時堆疊的通知數量。較早的通知從後方淡出。

trans-unit.source: Inline in the layout (default), or pinned to a window corner 24px from the edges (16px and full width on narrow windows).
trans-unit.target: 內嵌在版面中（預設），或固定在視窗角落、距離邊緣 24px（窄視窗上為 16px 並佔滿寬度）。

trans-unit.source: How many toasts already show when the stack appears, without an entrance. Useful for previews and screenshots.
trans-unit.target: 堆疊出現時已經顯示的通知數量，不播放進場動畫。適合預覽與螢幕截圖。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a visitor presses a toast while `IsSelectable` is set. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 設定 `IsSelectable` 時，訪客按下一則通知時引發。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Raised each time a toast appears, for impression tracking. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 每當一則通知出現時引發，用於曝光統計。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: A simulated feed to play while `Events` is empty, with times measured back from each pass. Null (the default) leaves the stack empty until an event is pushed. Give each stack its own simulation.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Events` 為空白時播放的模擬動態，時間從每一輪開始時往回計算。為 null（預設）時，堆疊在推送事件之前維持空白。請給每個堆疊各自的模擬執行個體。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Shown`, `Dismissed` and `Selected`.
trans-unit.target: `Shown`、`Dismissed` 與 `Selected` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Every word `SocialProofToast` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; the relative times and the names that include the toast's sentence are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `SocialProofToast` 顯示或朗讀的所有文字，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可在地化或改寫；相對時間以及包含通知句子的名稱都是格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: A simulated feed for a `SocialProofToast` that has no `Events`, for demos and prototypes: the events it plays, oldest first, with their times measured back from the start of each pass. The stack plays it like a feed of its own (prefill, interval, limit and loop included). Create one per stack.
trans-unit.target: 用於展示和原型、供沒有 `Events` 的 `SocialProofToast` 使用的模擬動態：它播放的事件依從舊到新排列，時間從每一輪開始時往回計算。堆疊會像播放自己的動態一樣播放它（包括預先填入、間隔、上限與循環）。請為每個堆疊建立一個執行個體。

trans-unit.source: One entry of a `SocialProofToastSimulation`: an event and how long before each pass it happened.
trans-unit.target: `SocialProofToastSimulation` 中的一則：一個事件，以及它發生在每一輪開始之前多久。

trans-unit.source: A row of cited sources under an AI answer (Arc Source cards, design reference). Each card shows the site's mark, its domain, the citation number and a two-line title. While searching, cards stream into reserved slots under "Searching 3 of 7"; past `Max` the rest collapse into a stack of overlapping marks ("+4 more"). Hovering or focusing a card lifts a preview with the passage, and a `SourceCitation` in the answer highlights its card. Give it the sources in citation order in `Sources` (append as results arrive), set `Status` and, while searching, `Total`. Put the answer in `Content`: it sits between the status line and the cards, and its height springs as it streams so the cards glide down. With `Sources` null the cards show the state you set (by default "No sources found"), or play a `Simulation` you pass in.
trans-unit.target: AI 回答下方的一排引用來源（Arc Source cards，設計參考）。每張卡片顯示網站標記、網域、引用編號和兩行標題。搜尋時，卡片在 "Searching 3 of 7" 下方流入預留的位置；超過 `Max` 的部分收攏為一疊相互重疊的標記（"+4 more"）。懸停或聚焦卡片會浮出帶原文片段的預覽，回答中的 `SourceCitation` 會醒目標示它的卡片。依引用順序在 `Sources` 中提供來源（結果抵達時附加），設定 `Status`，搜尋時還要設定 `Total`。把回答放進 `Content`：它位於狀態列和卡片之間，串流輸出時高度以彈簧變化，卡片隨之平滑下移。`Sources` 為 null 時，卡片顯示你設定的狀態（預設為 "No sources found"），或播放你傳入的 `Simulation`。

trans-unit.source: Shows Retry after a failed search and Search again when nothing was found; both raise `RetryRequested`.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋失敗後顯示 Retry，找不到結果時顯示 Search again；兩者都會引發 `RetryRequested`。

trans-unit.source: The search time, shown after the count when done ("7 sources · 2.1s").
trans-unit.target: 搜尋耗時，完成時顯示在數量之後（"7 sources · 2.1s"）。

trans-unit.source: The detail shown after "Search failed", such as "The search provider timed out after 8s."
trans-unit.target: 顯示在 "Search failed" 之後的詳細資訊，例如 "The search provider timed out after 8s."

trans-unit.source: Raised when the stack, the Show all toggle or a citation opens or closes the stack. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 疊放、Show all 開關或引用展開或收起疊放時引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a citation highlights its card, and when that highlight ends. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 引用醒目標示它的卡片時，以及該醒目標示結束時引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The highlighted source number (1-based), or null (two-way). A citation press sets it and clears it again after 2.6s unless it has changed meanwhile; set it yourself to hold a highlight.
trans-unit.target: 醒目標示的來源編號（從 1 開始），或 null（雙向繫結）。按下引用會設定它，並在 2.6 秒後清除（除非期間已改變）；自行設定它可以保持醒目標示。

trans-unit.source: Whether the stack is open and every card shows (two-way). The stack, the Show all toggle and a citation that points into the stack change it and raise `ExpandedChanged`.
trans-unit.target: 疊放是否展開、所有卡片是否都顯示（雙向繫結）。疊放、Show all 開關以及指向疊放內部的引用會改變它並引發 `ExpandedChanged`。

trans-unit.target: 是否顯示狀態列；介面已顯示搜尋進度時可將其關閉（Show all 開關和 Retry 仍保留）。

trans-unit.target: 搜尋查詢，搜尋時或找不到結果時以淡化樣式顯示在狀態之後。

trans-unit.source: A simulated search for a `SourceCards`, for demos, prototypes and tests. In the `Live` scenario the `Sources` you pass stream into their slots (the first after 0.45s, then one every 0.33s), the search finishes, the `Answer` streams a word every 70ms with its [n] citations, the cards tour two citations, close the stack and start over, looping until someone interacts. In `Error` the search fails after two sources with `ErrorText`; in `Empty` it finds nothing for `EmptyQuery`. Nothing is searched, and simulated cards open no address. Set it as the cards' `Simulation`: it plays while `Sources` is null and only while the cards are on screen, and starts over when its `Scenario` changes or the person presses Retry or Search again. The other values take effect at the next start. Use one simulation per `SourceCards`.
trans-unit.target: 為 `SourceCards` 提供的模擬搜尋，用於展示、原型和測試。在 `Live` 情境中，你傳入的 `Sources` 依序流入各自的位置（第一個在 0.45s 後，之後每 0.33s 一個），搜尋完成，`Answer` 每 70ms 流出一個詞並帶有 [n] 引用，卡片依序醒目標示兩個引用，收起疊放後從頭開始，一直循環到有人操作為止。在 `Error` 中，搜尋在兩個來源之後以 `ErrorText` 失敗；在 `Empty` 中，它為 `EmptyQuery` 什麼也找不到。不會進行任何搜尋，模擬的卡片也不會開啟任何網址。把它設為卡片的 `Simulation`：它在 `Sources` 為 null 且卡片顯示在畫面上時播放，在 `Scenario` 改變或使用者按下重試、重新搜尋時從頭開始。其他值在下次開始時生效。每個 `SourceCards` 使用一個模擬。

trans-unit.source: The answer the live scenario streams, words separated by spaces; a word written as `[n]` (optionally followed by punctuation, as in `[3].`) becomes a `SourceCitation` of source n.
trans-unit.target: 即時情境串流輸出的回答，詞與詞之間用空格分隔；寫成 `[n]` 的詞（後面可以帶標點，如 `[3].`）會變成來源 n 的 `SourceCitation`。

trans-unit.source: An inline [n] chip for answer text, styled like the number on each card of a `SourceCards`. Inside the cards' content it names its source for screen readers ("Source 2: Request: text() method, webref.example"), turns accent while its card is highlighted, and pressing it highlights the card (opening the stack when the card is in it). Its hit area reaches a few pixels past the chip without pushing the text around it. Put it in a text block with `InlineUIContainer`; the regular `Click` event runs first, for example to scroll the cards into view.
trans-unit.target: 回答文字中的行內 [n] 標籤，樣式與 `SourceCards` 每張卡片上的編號相同。在卡片的內容中，它為螢幕閱讀器說出自己的來源（"Source 2: Request: text() method, webref.example"），在其卡片醒目標示時變為強調色，按下它會醒目標示該卡片（卡片在疊放中時會先展開）。它的點擊區域比標籤多出幾個像素，但不會推開周圍的文字。用 `InlineUIContainer` 把它放進文字區塊；一般的 `Click` 事件先執行，例如用來把卡片捲動到可見範圍內。

trans-unit.source: Arc's sparkline: a compact trend beside a value, for cards, table rows and KPI blocks. Scrub it with the pointer or the arrow keys: the cursor springs between points, the stretch after it dims as if it has not happened yet, and the headline and aside roll to the scrubbed point. The line draws once like a pen the first time it is half visible; the fill follows the tip, then the end dot lands. New data morphs the line from the shape on screen. Motion is code-driven because the pen tip, cursor and morph are coordinates inside the self-drawn plot.
trans-unit.target: Arc 迷你趨勢圖：緊接數值旁的精簡趨勢圖，適用於卡片、表格列與 KPI 區塊。可用指標或方向鍵拖曳瀏覽：游標在各資料點之間彈動，其後的區段會變暗，彷彿尚未發生；標題與附註會滾動到所瀏覽的資料點。首次半數可見時，折線會像畫筆一樣繪製一次；填滿區隨筆尖跟進，然後末端圓點落定。新資料會從畫面上的形狀變形為新折線。由於筆尖、游標與變形都是自繪繪圖區內的座標，因此動態效果由程式碼驅動。

trans-unit.source: An animated explainer of speculative decoding in one card. A small draft model proposes a few ghost tokens quickly; the large target model checks them in one sweep. Accepted guesses get a check and fly into the answer, the first miss is struck through and replaced by the target's own token, and the guesses after it fade. When every guess is kept the target adds a bonus token. Rounds repeat until the sentence is written; a switch races a line where the target writes one token per pass on the same clock, and the speedup, the share of drafts accepted and the tokens per pass roll up below. Every token of the answer is underlined in the color of the model that wrote it. With `Tokens` the run is simulated from each token's ease and the `Seed`; with `Rounds` a recorded run is replayed. The numbers are illustrative. The run plays once when the card comes into view (never on its own under reduced motion, where tokens appear in place and the sweep steps a cell at a time).
trans-unit.target: 單張卡片中推測解碼的動畫講解。一個小型草稿模型快速提出幾個幽靈 token；大型目標模型在一次前向運算中檢查它們。被接受的猜測會打上勾並飛入答案，第一個未命中的被劃掉，並由目標模型自己的 token 取代，其後的猜測淡出。若所有猜測都被保留，目標模型會再加一個獎勵 token。每輪重複，直到句子寫完；一個開關會讓一條線與之並行競速，其中目標模型在同一時鐘下每次前向運算寫出一個 token，其加速比、草稿接受率與每次前向運算的 token 數彙總於下方。答案的每個 token 都以寫出它的模型的顏色加底線。使用 `Tokens` 時，演示依每個 token 的難易度與 `Seed` 模擬；使用 `Rounds` 時，則重播一次記錄的運行。數字僅為示意。該演示在卡片進入視野時播放一次（在減少動態效果下永不自動播放，此時 token 原地出現，掃過則逐格推進）。

trans-unit.source: Every word `SpeculativeDecoding` shows or announces, apart from the title, the lane names (`DraftLabel` and the others) and the playback buttons (`PlaybackLabels`). English by default; replace the instance to translate or reword. Texts with numbers are functions so that word order can change.

trans-unit.source: What your text to speech service returned: the playback, the word timings and the length. Each part is optional: without `Audio` the player keeps time itself (simulated, no sound); without `Timings` they are estimated from the text and fitted to the length.
trans-unit.target: 文字轉語音服務傳回的內容：播放、逐字時間與總長度。每個部分都是選用的：沒有 `Audio` 時播放器自行計時（模擬，無聲音）；沒有 `Timings` 時會根據文字估算，並依總長度伸縮對齊。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of the `SpeechPlayer` playback events: where playback is, with which voice and speed.
trans-unit.target: `SpeechPlayer` 播放事件的引數：播放到哪裡、使用哪個聲音與語速。

trans-unit.source: Read aloud for an AI reply (Arc Speech player, design reference). The reply sits above an action row with Read aloud, Copy, Good response and Bad response. Read aloud crossfades the row into a compact player of the same height: play and pause, the elapsed time, a thin scrubbable progress bar, the total time, a speed button (1×, 1.5×, 2×), a voice picker and Stop reading. As it plays, one rounded highlight glides from word to word along a line and cuts to the next line, while the words still to come stay dimmed; a click on a word jumps there. Give it the reply in `Text` and your text to speech service in `Synthesize`: it receives a `SpeechRequest` (abort when its token is cancelled) and returns a `SpeechAudio` with the playback (`ISpeechAudio`, whose position becomes the player's clock), the word timings and the length. Without `Synthesize` the player is a timed simulation that plays no sound. With no text, a `Simulation` is read once the player is in view and loops through two voices until someone interacts; with neither, the action row waits with Read aloud disabled.
trans-unit.target: 為 AI 回覆朗讀（Arc Speech player，設計參考）。回覆下方是含有 Read aloud、Copy、Good response 與 Bad response 的操作列。Read aloud 會把這一列交叉淡化為同樣高度的精簡播放器：播放與暫停、已播放時間、可拖曳的細進度列、總長度、語速按鈕（1×、1.5×、2×）、聲音選擇與 Stop reading。播放時，一個圓角醒目標示會在一行內逐字滑動，到下一行時直接切換，還沒唸到的字詞維持淡化；點選一個字詞即跳到那裡。把回覆放在 `Text` 中，把文字轉語音服務放在 `Synthesize` 中：它會收到一個 `SpeechRequest`（權杖取消時中止），並傳回一個 `SpeechAudio`，包含播放（`ISpeechAudio`，其位置成為播放器的時鐘）、逐字時間與總長度。沒有 `Synthesize` 時，播放器是不發出聲音的定時模擬。沒有文字時，會在播放器進入可視範圍後朗讀 `Simulation`，並在兩個聲音之間循環，直到有人操作；兩者都沒有時，操作列等待，Read aloud 維持停用。

trans-unit.source: Buttons after Read aloud in the action row, in place of the default Copy, Good response and Bad response.
trans-unit.target: 操作列中 Read aloud 之後的按鈕，取代預設的 Copy、Good response 與 Bad response。

trans-unit.source: The last sentence said through the polite status region.
trans-unit.target: 透過禮貌模式狀態區域播報的最後一句話。

trans-unit.source: The author's mark: a 24 × 24 stroked glyph drawn at 16px (the sparkle by default).
trans-unit.target: 作者標誌：一個 24 × 24 的描邊圖形，以 16px 繪製（預設為閃光圖示）。

trans-unit.target: 作者標誌的顏色；預設為強調色。

trans-unit.target: 播放器進入可視範圍後開始朗讀。為 null 時：播放 `Simulation` 時開啟，設定了 `Text` 時關閉。

trans-unit.source: Stop reading was pressed and the action row returned. Fetched speech is kept, so Read aloud starts again at once. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 按下了 Stop reading，操作列已恢復。已取得的語音會保留，因此 Read aloud 會立即重新開始。會冒泡。

trans-unit.target: 播放已暫停。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Fetches speech from your text to speech service. Return the playback, the word timings (one start and end per word, from the provider's alignment data) and the length; missing timings are estimated and fitted to the length. Throw with a short, human message to show it next to "Couldn't generate audio". Null: a simulation with no audio.

trans-unit.target: 要朗讀的回覆。空行開始新段落；每個以空白分隔的字詞是一個標示步驟。為 null 時朗讀 `Simulation`（如果有）。

trans-unit.source: A self-playing reading for the `Simulation` of a `SpeechPlayer`, for demos and prototypes: the reply to read, its author and the voices to offer. A player that has no `Text` reads it once it is in view and, with full motion, reads it again with the other of the first two voices after a short pause, until someone interacts. It is also the stand-in text to speech behind every player without `Synthesize`: `SynthesizeAsync` waits like a network round trip, then answers with estimated word timings and no audio. Nothing is sent anywhere. `EstimateTimings` and `FitTimings` are what the player uses when a real service returns audio without alignment data.
trans-unit.target: 用於展示和原型的 `SpeechPlayer` 的 `Simulation` 自動朗讀：要朗讀的回覆、它的作者與提供的聲音。沒有 `Text` 的播放器在進入可視範圍後朗讀它，在完整動效下，短暫停頓後會改用前兩個聲音中的另一個再唸一次，直到有人操作。它也是所有未設定 `Synthesize` 的播放器背後的替身文字轉語音：`SynthesizeAsync` 像一次網路往返那樣等待，然後傳回估算的逐字時間，不含音訊。不會向任何地方傳送內容。真實服務傳回的音訊沒有對齊資料時，播放器使用的就是 `EstimateTimings` 與 `FitTimings`。

trans-unit.target: `SynthesizeAsync` 的選項。

trans-unit.target: `SpeedChanged` 的引數。

trans-unit.target: 帶提醒的消費預算：本期已花費金額與預算的對比、本期的節奏、為每個提醒畫出刻度的進度條、預算與提醒的編輯器，以及消費越過提醒時出現的橫幅。`Spent` 上升並越過一個已打開的提醒時，會顯示橫幅、讀出內容並引發 `ThresholdCrossed`。

trans-unit.source: One horizontal bar split into parts in proportion to their values, with a legend of labels, values and shares under it. When a value changes, a segment is added or one is removed, every part springs to its new share (the springs keep their speed when interrupted, so live data never jumps). Pointing at a part, or moving through the parts with the arrow keys, lifts it and dims the others; a click or Enter raises `SegmentInvoked`. A `Total` larger than the sum leaves the rest of the track empty, shown in the legend as `RemainderLabel`.
trans-unit.target: 一條按各部分數值比例分段的水平條，下方有顯示標籤、數值和占比的圖例。當某個值變化、新增或移除一個分段時，每個部分都會以彈簧動畫過渡到新的占比（彈簧在被打斷時保持速度，因此即時資料不會跳變）。指標指向某個部分，或用方向鍵在各部分間移動時，該部分會浮起，其餘部分變暗；點擊或按 Enter 會觸發 `SegmentInvoked`。`Total` 大於總和時，軌道的剩餘部分留空，在圖例中顯示為 `RemainderLabel`。

trans-unit.source: The part that is lifted while the others dim; -1 for none. Pointing and the arrow keys set it.
trans-unit.target: 浮起而其餘部分變暗的那個部分；-1 表示無。指標指向和方向鍵會設定它。

trans-unit.source: Shows the legend under the bar (default true).

trans-unit.source: The parts from a view model; when set it replaces `Segments`.

trans-unit.source: Raised when a part is clicked, or chosen with Enter or Space on the focused bar.

trans-unit.source: Shows each part's share as a percentage in the legend (default true).

trans-unit.source: The amount the full bar stands for. NaN (the default) makes the bar the sum of its parts; a larger total leaves the rest empty. A total smaller than the sum is ignored.

trans-unit.source: Digits after the decimal point in values (0 to 6).

trans-unit.source: Text after every value, such as " GB".

trans-unit.source: One part of a `SplitBar`: a label, a value and an optional color. Changing `Value` springs the bar to the new shares; the bar listens to its segments while it is on screen.

trans-unit.source: One default action joined to a chevron menu of nearby alternatives (Arc split button): Merge pull request with Squash and merge or Rebase and merge, an export with its usual format, Copy page that answers Copied in place. The whole pill presses in for the main action; the chevron half anchors the menu, so it answers in color only and turns while the menu is open. The main label morphs letter by letter (shared runs glide, changed letters rise out of a soft blur), a new `Icon` grows in while the old one shrinks away, and the main half springs to the new width. Menu rows are `MenuEntry` items declared inline or supplied with `ItemsSource`; the menu opens 4px below the chevron, aligned to the end. Keyboard: Enter or Space runs the main action on the main half and opens the menu on the first row from the chevron (ArrowDown too); arrow keys move through the rows and loop, Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the chevron. Label changes are announced politely.
trans-unit.target: 將一個預設動作與一個相近替代項的下拉選單（Arc 分割按鈕）合併：例如「合併拉取要求」帶有「Squash 並合併」或「Rebase 並合併」，匯出操作帶有其常用格式，「複製頁面」操作則會就地顯示「已複製」。主操作時整個膠囊形按鈕會按下；下拉箭頭部分用於錨定選單，因此僅以顏色作出回應，並在選單開啟時旋轉。主標籤逐字母變形（相同的部分平滑滑動，變化的字母從柔和的模糊中升起），新的 `Icon` 會淡入而舊圖示縮小消失，主區域則以彈簧過渡到新寬度。選單行為內嵌宣告的 `MenuEntry` 項目，或由 `ItemsSource` 提供；選單在箭頭下方 4px 處開啟，並靠末端對齊。鍵盤：Enter 或 Space 在主區域執行主操作，從箭頭處開啟選單並定位到第一行（ArrowDown 同樣可以）；方向鍵在各行之間移動並循環，Escape 關閉選單並將焦點返回箭頭。標籤變化時以禮貌方式朗讀。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the main half is activated (before `Command` runs).
trans-unit.target: 主區域被啟用時觸發（先於 `Command` 執行）。

trans-unit.target: 主操作的命令。

trans-unit.target: 主要操作執行時傳遞給 Command 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Visual weight: Primary (default, a filled button) or Secondary (a compact outlined pill).
trans-unit.target: 視覺權重：Primary（預設，實心按鈕）或 Secondary（緊湊的描邊膠囊）。

trans-unit.source: A grid of feature cards lit by a spotlight: a soft accent light follows the pointer across the whole grid, warms the cards under it and makes their borders glow, neighbours included, as if one lamp moved over the page. Keyboard focus carries the light to the focused card. Each card has an icon, a title, a sentence and an optional badge.
trans-unit.target: 由聚光照亮的功能卡片網格：一束柔和的強調色光隨指針在整個網格上移動，照暖下方的卡片並讓邊框發亮，相鄰卡片也會亮起，就像同一個光源在頁面上移動。鍵盤焦點會把光帶到聚焦的卡片。每張卡片有圖示、標題、一句說明和可選的標記。

trans-unit.source: The empty state of an AI app (Arc Starter prompts, design reference): a greeting, starter cards filtered by category tabs, a Shuffle that swaps the cards with a short staggered crossfade, and a composer the cards fill. Picking a card places its full prompt in the composer, focuses it and raises `PromptSelected`; Enter sends and raises `SubmitRequested`. Cards that use a connected app show its mark and name. With no `Prompts` it shows the greeting, the All tab and the composer with no cards, and with no handler that supplies `Sending` it simulates the send. Set `ShowsComposer` to false to pair the cards with a composer of your own: picks still set `Text` and raise the event.
trans-unit.target: AI 應用程式的空狀態（Arc Starter prompts，設計參考）：問候語、依分類分頁篩選的起始卡片、以短暫錯開的交叉淡化切換卡片的「換一批」，以及由卡片填入的輸入框。選擇卡片會把它完整的提示詞填入輸入框、讓輸入框取得焦點並引發 `PromptSelected`；按 Enter 傳送並引發 `SubmitRequested`。使用已連結應用程式的卡片會顯示該應用程式的標誌與名稱。沒有 `Prompts` 時顯示問候語、「全部」分頁和輸入框，但沒有卡片；沒有處理常式提供 `Sending` 時模擬傳送。將 `ShowsComposer` 設為 false，可以把卡片與你自己的輸入框搭配：選擇卡片仍會設定 `Text` 並引發事件。

trans-unit.source: Shows where someone is in a strict multi-step flow and which steps are done (Arc Stepper). Drive it with `CurrentIndex` (the step count marks the whole flow complete). When progress jumps across several steps the connectors fill one after another (80ms apart) from the previous current step, then the halo grows around the new current step; numbers turn into drawn checks or alerts. With `IsNavigable` completed steps can be chosen by click or keyboard (arrows between reachable steps, Home / End, Enter / Space). Horizontal steppers narrower than 30rem fold into markers with the current step named underneath. Steps come from `ItemsSource` or the inline `Steps`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示使用者在嚴格的多步驟流程中所處的位置，以及哪些步驟已完成（Arc 步驟條）。使用 `CurrentIndex` 驅動（步驟數表示整個流程已完成）。當進度跨越多個步驟時，連接線會從上一個當前步驟起逐一填滿（每隔 80ms），然後光暈在新的當前步驟周圍擴散；數字則變為繪製出的勾號或警示圖示。設定 `IsNavigable` 後，已完成的步驟可透過按一下或鍵盤選取（方向鍵在可到達的步驟之間移動，Home / End，Enter / Space）。寬度小於 30rem 的水平步驟條會摺疊為標記，並在下方標明當前步驟名稱。步驟來自 `ItemsSource` 或內嵌的 `Steps`。

trans-unit.source: Announced, and shown in the compact caption, once every step is complete.

trans-unit.source: A surface of stickers (Arc Sticker peel, design reference). Hovering lifts the nearest corner a few pixels, pulling folds the sticker back along a real fold with its paper backing showing, pulling far enough peels it off to carry around, and letting go sticks it down where it was dropped. It works with the keyboard and with touch, and `PositionsChanged` gives the layout to save.
trans-unit.target: 一面貼紙表面（Arc 貼紙撕起，設計參考）。懸停會把最近的一角翹起幾個像素，拉動會沿真實的摺線把貼紙折回並露出紙質背面，拉得夠遠就會整張撕下並可以拿著走，放手後貼紙貼在放下的位置。支援鍵盤和觸控，`PositionsChanged` 給出可儲存的版面。

trans-unit.source: Keeps an element in scrolling content at the top of the viewport once it scrolls there, like CSS `position: sticky; top: N`: `arc:Sticky.IsEnabled="True"` (and optionally `arc:Sticky.Offset`). The element moves with a render translation only, so the content's layout and height never change, and it never leaves its parent: when the parent's bottom edge reaches it, it scrolls away with the parent, so the next sticky header in a grouped list pushes the previous one out. While stuck, `arc:Sticky.IsStuck` is true (select it with `[(arc|Sticky.IsStuck)=True]` to add a shadow or background) and the element's ZIndex is raised to `arc:Sticky.ZIndex`. Only vertical scrolling is followed. The element must not have a RenderTransform of its own.
trans-unit.target: 讓捲動內容中的元素捲到檢視區頂端後停住，就像 CSS `position: sticky; top: N`：`arc:Sticky.IsEnabled="True"`（可選 `arc:Sticky.Offset`）。元素只透過轉譯位移移動，所以內容的版面配置與高度從不改變；它也不會離開父容器：父容器的下緣抵達它時，它隨父容器一起捲走，因此分組清單中下一個吸頂標題會把上一個推走。吸頂期間 `arc:Sticky.IsStuck` 為 true（用 `[(arc|Sticky.IsStuck)=True]` 選中它來加上陰影或底色），元素的 ZIndex 提升為 `arc:Sticky.ZIndex`。只跟隨縱向捲動。元素不能有自己的 RenderTransform。

trans-unit.source: Makes the element stick to the top of its scrolling viewport; off by default.
trans-unit.target: 讓元素吸附在所在捲動檢視區的頂端；預設關閉。

trans-unit.source: True while the element is held at the top of the viewport (read-only; style it with `[(arc|Sticky.IsStuck)=True]`).
trans-unit.target: 元素停在檢視區頂端期間為 true（唯讀；用 `[(arc|Sticky.IsStuck)=True]` 設定樣式）。

trans-unit.source: Distance in pixels between the viewport's top edge and the stuck element; default 0.
trans-unit.target: 吸頂時元素與檢視區上緣之間的距離（像素）；預設 0。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the element (bubbling) when `IsStuck` changes.
trans-unit.target: `IsStuck` 變化時在元素上引發（冒泡）。

trans-unit.source: The element's ZIndex while it is stuck, so it draws over the content scrolling under it; default 1.
trans-unit.target: 吸頂期間元素的 ZIndex，讓它繪製在下方捲過的內容之上；預設 1。

trans-unit.source: Arc's streamgraph: layers stacked on a wiggle baseline, flowing over time. Hovering a layer isolates it and reads every layer at that moment; switching ranges blends every layer from the shape on screen on a shared 161-point grid, a hidden layer thins to nothing while the others close over it, and the first time the chart is seen the whole stream swells out of a hairline along its center. Motion is code-driven (a per-sample spring array and `MotionValue`) because every layer edge is recomputed from the stack each frame inside one self-drawn plot.
trans-unit.target: Arc 的串流圖：各圖層堆疊在擺動基線上，隨時間流動。懸停某一圖層會將其單獨突出，並讀取該時刻每個圖層的數值；切換範圍時，所有圖層會從螢幕上的形狀出發，在共用的 161 點網格上過渡融合，隱藏的圖層會收縮至消失，其餘圖層隨之閉合；圖表首次出現時，整個串流從中線處的細線舒展開。動畫由程式碼驅動（每個取樣點的彈簧陣列加 `MotionValue`），因為每個圖層邊緣都要在單一自繪繪圖區內逐格根據堆疊結果重新計算。

trans-unit.source: Keys of the series hidden from the plot; the legend toggles them (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 從圖中隱藏的系列鍵；圖例會切換它們（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the legend shows or hides a series.
trans-unit.target: 圖例顯示或隱藏某個系列時引發。

trans-unit.source: How the layers stack.
trans-unit.target: 圖層的堆疊方式。

trans-unit.source: Names each layer inside its widest stretch when it is thick enough to hold the text.
trans-unit.target: 當圖層夠厚、能容納文字時，在其最寬處直接標示圖層名稱。

trans-unit.source: Layer toggles above the plot (shown by default when there is more than one layer).

trans-unit.source: A feed that refreshes when it is pulled down past its top (Arc Stretch refresh, design reference). A header with the title, a short status and a round refresh button sits over a well; the rows lie on a sheet that covers the well. Pulling the sheet down at the top of the feed (mouse, pen, touch, or the wheel and trackpad scrolling up) moves it with growing resistance while the rows spread apart, and a line in the gap grows from its centre until it reaches full length exactly at `Threshold`. Letting go past it runs `RefreshHandler`: the sheet rests 60 px down, the line runs back and forth and the header glyph spins; when the work ends, the result shows with a check, new rows drop in from the top while the others slide down, and the sheet springs back. The refresh button (and `RefreshAsync`) does the same without a pull. The rows come from `ItemsSource`; give the new items to the collection before the handler returns (the list matches rows by `ItemKeySelector`, by `Id`, or by the item itself). Without an `ItemTemplate`, `StretchRefreshActivity` items show as `StretchRefreshActivityRow`s. Give the control a height (or a parent that sizes it): the feed scrolls inside.
trans-unit.target: 下拉超過頂端即可重新整理的動態串流（Arc Stretch refresh，設計參考）。帶標題、簡短狀態和圓形重新整理按鈕的標頭位於底槽之上；列放在蓋住底槽的列表層上。在動態串流頂端向下拉列表層（滑鼠、筆、觸控，或向上捲動的滾輪和觸控板）時，它帶著越來越大的阻力下移，各列隨之拉開，缺口中的線從中間向兩側伸長，恰好在 `Threshold` 處達到滿長。超過該處放開即執行 `RefreshHandler`：列表層停在下方 60 px，線來回跑動，標頭圖示旋轉；工作結束後顯示帶勾號的結果，新列從頂端落入，其餘列向下滑動，隨後列表層彈回。重新整理按鈕（以及 `RefreshAsync`）不需下拉即可完成同樣的過程。列來自 `ItemsSource`；請在處理常式返回前把新項目放入集合（列表依 `ItemKeySelector`、`Id` 或項目本身比對列）。沒有 `ItemTemplate` 時，`StretchRefreshActivity` 項目顯示為 `StretchRefreshActivityRow`。請給控制項一個高度（或能決定其尺寸的父層）：動態串流在內部捲動。

trans-unit.source: True while the refresh work runs (from the start of a refresh until its result shows).
trans-unit.target: 重新整理工作執行期間為 true（從重新整理開始到顯示結果）。

trans-unit.source: A stable key for each item, so a row keeps its place and view across refreshes. Null: `Id`, else the item itself.
trans-unit.target: 每個項目的穩定索引鍵，使列在多次重新整理之間保持位置與檢視。為 null 時：`Id`，否則為項目本身。

trans-unit.source: Builds one row from an item. Null shows `StretchRefreshActivity` items as activity rows and other items as text.
trans-unit.target: 從一個項目建立一列。為 null 時，`StretchRefreshActivity` 項目顯示為動態列，其他項目顯示為文字。

trans-unit.source: The rows, newest first. An observable collection animates its changes: new rows drop in, the others slide.
trans-unit.target: 各列，最新的在前。可觀察集合的變化會帶動畫：新列落入，其他列滑動。

trans-unit.source: Every word the control shows or announces (English by default).
trans-unit.target: 控制項顯示或播報的所有文字（預設為英文）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the refresh work has ended (the result is showing), with the result text or the error.
trans-unit.target: 重新整理工作結束（正在顯示結果）時引發，帶有結果文字或錯誤。

trans-unit.source: The refresh work, run after a pull past the threshold or a press of the refresh button. Update `ItemsSource` before it returns, and return a short result such as "3 new updates" (null or empty shows `Done`). If it throws, the result is `Error`. The token is cancelled when the control leaves the visual tree. Keep it at least about half a second, so the running line can be read.
trans-unit.target: 重新整理工作，在下拉超過門檻或按下重新整理按鈕後執行。請在它返回前更新 `ItemsSource`，並返回簡短的結果，例如 "3 new updates"（null 或空白則顯示 `Done`）。若它擲回例外，結果為 `Error`。控制項離開視覺樹時取消該 token。請讓它至少持續約半秒，以便看清跑動的線。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a refresh starts, before `RefreshHandler` runs.
trans-unit.target: 重新整理開始時、`RefreshHandler` 執行之前引發。

trans-unit.source: Where the control is in its pull and refresh cycle.
trans-unit.target: 控制項在下拉與重新整理循環中所處的位置。

trans-unit.source: A short status under the heading, such as "Updated 12 min ago". A change rises in.
trans-unit.target: 標題下方的簡短狀態，例如 "Updated 12 min ago"。變化時會升起替換。

trans-unit.source: The pull, in px after resistance, that arms a refresh: 72. The line reaches full length exactly there.
trans-unit.target: 經阻力換算後、能觸發重新整理的下拉距離（px）：72。線恰好在此處達到滿長。

trans-unit.source: The heading above the feed; it also names the feed region for screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 動態串流上方的標題；它也為螢幕閱讀器命名動態串流區域。

trans-unit.source: One entry of an activity feed, shown by `StretchRefreshActivityRow` (the row `StretchRefresh` uses when it has no `ItemTemplate`): a sentence "Actor action Target", an optional quote and photo, a meta line ("Billing · 12 min ago") and an unread dot. `IsUnread` is a styled property, so marking an entry read fades its dot on screen.
trans-unit.target: 動態串流中的一則，由 `StretchRefreshActivityRow` 顯示（`StretchRefresh` 沒有 `ItemTemplate` 時使用的列）：句子 "Actor action Target"、選用的引用和相片、meta 行（"Billing · 12 min ago"）以及未讀點。`IsUnread` 是樣式屬性，因此把一則標記為已讀會讓螢幕上的點淡出。

trans-unit.source: Whether the entry is new to the reader: the row shows an accent dot and reads "New." first.
trans-unit.target: 該則對讀者是否為新：列顯示強調色圓點，並先讀出 "New."。

trans-unit.source: An activity feed row for `StretchRefresh` (its default row for `StretchRefreshActivity` items): a 32 px avatar or status glyph, the sentence with the actor and target in the emphasis weight, an optional quote and 4:3 photo, the meta line, and an 8 px accent dot while the entry is unread. Marking the entry read fades the dot (240 ms) while it shrinks to 0.4 (580 ms spring curve).
trans-unit.target: `StretchRefresh` 的動態列（它對 `StretchRefreshActivity` 項目的預設列）：32 px 頭像或狀態圖示、主詞和受詞以強調字重呈現的句子、選用的引用和 4:3 相片、meta 行，以及該則未讀時的 8 px 強調色圓點。標記為已讀時圓點淡出（240 ms）並縮小到 0.4（580 ms 彈簧曲線）。

trans-unit.source: The entry the row shows.
trans-unit.target: 該列顯示的項目。

trans-unit.source: The brush of the actor and target (Foreground by default; the rest of the sentence uses TextSecondary).
trans-unit.target: 主詞和受詞的筆刷（預設 Foreground；句子其餘部分使用 TextSecondary）。

trans-unit.source: What a screen reader hears before an unread entry: "New.".
trans-unit.target: 螢幕閱讀器在未讀項目前讀出的內容："New."。

trans-unit.source: Data of `RefreshCompleted`.
trans-unit.target: `RefreshCompleted` 的事件資料。

trans-unit.source: Every word a `StretchRefresh` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance (or set its properties before the control is shown) to translate or reword.
trans-unit.target: `StretchRefresh` 顯示或播報的所有文字，預設為英文。替換該執行個體（或在控制項顯示前設定其屬性）即可翻譯或改寫。

trans-unit.source: The simulated backend of the `StretchRefresh` samples, replaying the reference preview: every refresh takes `Latency` (1150 ms), marks the entries shown so far as read, puts the next batch of `CreateBatches` on top (3, 1, 2, then nothing), sets the subtitle to `RefreshedSubtitle` and returns the result line. Pass its `RefreshAsync` as `RefreshHandler`; replace it with real work in an app. Time comes from a `TimeProvider`, so tests can step it.
trans-unit.target: `StretchRefresh` 範例的模擬後端，重播參考預覽：每次重新整理耗時 `Latency`（1150 ms），把已顯示的項目標記為已讀，把 `CreateBatches` 的下一批放到頂端（3、1、2，之後沒有），把副標題設為 `RefreshedSubtitle` 並返回結果行。把它的 `RefreshAsync` 當作 `RefreshHandler` 傳入；在應用程式中換成真實的工作。時間來自 `TimeProvider`，因此測試可以逐步推進。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `Subtitle` or `IsChanged` changes.
trans-unit.target: `Subtitle` 或 `IsChanged` 變化時引發。

trans-unit.source: Data of `RefreshStarted`.
trans-unit.target: `RefreshStarted` 的事件資料。

trans-unit.source: A testimonial stage: one quote at a time, set large, with the person and their company under it. The stage moves on by itself after `Interval` (a thin bar per quote shows the time), and pauses while a pointer is over it, while the keyboard is inside it, or after the pause button. The old quote blurs out as the new one rises in; the person changes a beat later.
trans-unit.target: 評價舞台：一次展示一條引言，大號排版，下方是說話人和公司。舞台在 `Interval` 之後自動切換（每條引言一根細進度條顯示時間），指針停在舞台上、鍵盤焦點在舞台內或按下暫停按鈕後會暫停。舊引言模糊消失，新引言上升出現；人物稍晚一拍切換。

trans-unit.source: What is announced when a person changes the quote; {0} position, {1} count, {2} name, {3} byline.
trans-unit.target: 讀者切換引言時播報的文字；{0} 位置，{1} 總數，{2} 姓名，{3} 職位與公司。

trans-unit.source: Below this width of the block (640) the quote steps down a size.
trans-unit.target: 區塊寬度小於此值（640）時引言缩小一級。

trans-unit.source: How long each quote stays before the next one (7 seconds).
trans-unit.target: 每條引言停留多久後切換到下一條（7 秒）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the stage moves on by itself.
trans-unit.target: 舞台是否自動切換。

trans-unit.source: Whether the stage is paused by its pause button (read-only; `Pause` and `Play` change it).
trans-unit.target: 舞台是否被暫停按鈕暫停（只讀；由 `Pause` 和 `Play` 改變）。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the next button.
trans-unit.target: 下一條按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the pause button while the stage moves on by itself.
trans-unit.target: 舞台自動切換時暫停按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the pause button while the stage is paused.
trans-unit.target: 舞台暫停時暫停按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: The position line ("02 / 04"); {0} is the position, {1} the count, both two digits.
trans-unit.target: 位置文字（「02 / 04」）；{0} 是位置，{1} 是總數，都是兩位數。

trans-unit.source: The position line for the template (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 供模板顯示的位置文字（只讀）。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name of the previous button.
trans-unit.target: 上一條按鈕的螢幕閱讀器名稱。

trans-unit.source: Raised when another quote comes on stage.
trans-unit.target: 另一條引言上台時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The index of the quote on stage (two-way); clamped to the quotes.
trans-unit.target: 舞台上引言的索引（雙向）；限制在引言范圍內。

trans-unit.source: Whether the invented sample quotes show while `Quotes` is empty.
trans-unit.target: `Quotes` 為空時是否顯示虛構的示例引言。

trans-unit.source: The small heading above the stage; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 舞台上方的小標題；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: A hierarchy drawn as concentric rings. Clicking a segment makes it the new centre: every arc moves to its new angles on one shared spring while rings grow or shrink as levels appear and leave. A breadcrumb, the centre and the legend lead back and forth, the centre rolls the current total digit by digit, and labels show only where they fit their arc.
trans-unit.target: 以同心圓環繪製的階層結構。點擊扇區使其成為新的中心：每段圓弧在同一個共用彈簧上移動到新的角度，圓環隨層級出現和離開而變大或變小。麵包屑、中心和圖例用於來回導覽，中心逐位捲動顯示目前總計，標籤只在放得下圓弧時才顯示。

trans-unit.source: How many rings are visible at once (at least 1, default 3).
trans-unit.target: 同時可見的圈數（至少 1，預設 3）。

trans-unit.source: Message shown when the total is zero.
trans-unit.target: 總計為零時顯示的訊息。

trans-unit.source: Id of the node at the centre (two-way; null is the root). A leaf's id shows its parent at the centre, and an unknown id shows the root.
trans-unit.target: 中心節點的 id（雙向；null 表示根節點）。設為葉節點的 id 時中心顯示其父節點，未知的 id 顯示根節點。

trans-unit.source: Raised when another node moves to the centre, from a segment, the breadcrumb, the legend, the centre or code.
trans-unit.target: 另一個節點移到中心時引發，來源可以是扇區、麵包屑、圖例、中心或程式碼。

trans-unit.source: Whether the legend of the centre's children shows, with values and shares (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示中心子節點的圖例，包含數值和佔比（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: What the whole is, such as "Annual costs": the accessible name of the chart, and the first breadcrumb when the nodes come from `Items`.
trans-unit.target: 整體是什麼，例如 "Annual costs"：圖表的無障礙名稱；節點來自 `Items` 時也是第一個麵包屑。

trans-unit.source: The whole hierarchy; its label names the first breadcrumb. Wins over `Items`.
trans-unit.target: 整個階層結構；其標籤作為第一個麵包屑的名稱。優先於 `Items`。

trans-unit.source: Largest diameter of the ring in pixels (default 340); it scales down to fit its container.
trans-unit.target: 圓環的最大直徑，單位為像素（預設 340）；會縮小以符合容器。

trans-unit.source: Formats values in the centre, legend, tooltip and accessible reading (default: grouped, at most one decimal).
trans-unit.target: 格式化中心、圖例、工具提示和無障礙朗讀中的數值（預設：數字分組，最多一位小數）。

trans-unit.source: A node of a `Sunburst`: a leaf with a value, or a branch whose value is the sum of its children.
trans-unit.target: `Sunburst` 的節點：帶數值的葉節點，或值為其子節點總和的分支。

trans-unit.source: A saved reply an agent can drop into the composer. `{name}` in `Text` becomes the customer's first name.
trans-unit.target: 客服可以插入輸入區的常用回覆。`Text` 中的 `{name}` 會換成客戶的名字。

trans-unit.source: What the composer of a `SupportConversation` writes.
trans-unit.target: `SupportConversation` 的輸入區寫的是什麼。

trans-unit.source: A support agent's view of one customer conversation: the messages (a `ChatThread`), a composer that writes either a reply or an internal note, saved replies one press away (or type "/" in an empty composer), the status (open, pending, resolved), and a side panel with the customer's details, tags and the team's notes. Replies are added to `Messages` and notes to `Notes`; both raise `ReplySent` so your server can deliver them. A conversation with no messages when it first loads shows a sample.
trans-unit.target: 客服人員查看一位客戶對話的界面：消息（一個 `ChatThread`）、可寫回覆或內部備注的輸入區、一按即可插入的常用回覆（或在空輸入區輸入“/”）、狀態（處理中、等待中、已解決），以及顯示客戶信息、標籤和團隊備注的側面板。回覆加入 `Messages`，備注加入 `Notes`；兩者都會觸發 `ReplySent`，便於服務器發送。首次加載時沒有消息，會顯示一個示例。

trans-unit.source: The `Id` of the agent using the view; their messages sit on the right.
trans-unit.target: 使用此視圖的客服的 `Id`；其消息顯示在右側。

trans-unit.source: The name notes are signed with ("You").
trans-unit.target: 備注的署名（“You”）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the composer writes a reply or an internal note (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 輸入區寫回覆還是內部備注（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: The customer; null shows the sample customer while sample data is used, else a blank panel.
trans-unit.target: 客戶；為 null 時，使用示例數據則顯示示例客戶，否則面板為空。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a reply or a note was added.
trans-unit.target: 添加回覆或備注後觸發。

trans-unit.source: The status (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 狀態（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the status changes.
trans-unit.target: 狀態改變時觸發。

trans-unit.source: What the conversation is about, shown in the header.
trans-unit.target: 對話的主題，顯示在標題區。

trans-unit.source: Whether a conversation with no messages when it first loads gets the sample (default true).
trans-unit.target: 首次加載時沒有消息是否顯示示例（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Where a `SupportConversation` stands.
trans-unit.target: `SupportConversation` 的進度。

trans-unit.source: The customer in a `SupportConversation`: who they are and the facts an agent needs at a glance.
trans-unit.target: `SupportConversation` 中的客戶：是誰，以及客服需要一眼看到的信息。

trans-unit.source: An internal note on a `SupportConversation`: seen by the team, never by the customer.
trans-unit.target: `SupportConversation` 上的內部備注：團隊可見，客戶永遠看不到。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ReplySent`.
trans-unit.target: `ReplySent` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `StatusChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `StatusChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: The floating help widget a customer opens from the corner of a site: a round launcher that turns into a panel with a greeting, a search over help articles, the most recent articles, a way to start a chat with the team (with a typing indicator and the reply), and the history of earlier conversations. It sits in the bottom-right corner of the space it is given, so put it over the page. Messages the visitor sends are added to the conversation and raise `MessageSent`; add the team's replies to `Messages`. Without your data it shows a sample and answers on its own.
trans-unit.target: 客戶在網站角落打開的浮動幫助窗口：一個圓形啟動按鈕，打開後變成面板，有問候語、幫助文章搜索、最新文章、與團隊開始聊天的入口（能看到正在輸入和回覆），以及以前的對話記錄。它停在給它的空間的右下角，所以請把它放在頁面上層。訪客發送的消息會加入對話並觸發 `MessageSent`；把團隊的回覆加入 `Messages`。沒有你的數據時，它顯示示例並自己回答。

trans-unit.source: The greeting on the home screen ("Hi there").
trans-unit.target: 首頁的問候語（“Hi there”）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the panel is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 面板是否打開（雙向）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the visitor sent a message.
trans-unit.target: 訪客發送消息後觸發。

trans-unit.source: The line under the greeting ("How can we help?").
trans-unit.target: 問候語下方的一行文字（“How can we help?”）。

trans-unit.source: How fast the team answers ("We usually reply in a few minutes").
trans-unit.target: 團隊回覆有多快（“We usually reply in a few minutes”）。

trans-unit.source: The screen showing now.
trans-unit.target: 當前顯示的屏幕。

trans-unit.source: Whether the widget answers the visitor itself (default true): the sample team types, then replies. Turn it off when your team answers.
trans-unit.target: 浮窗是否自己回答訪客（預設 true）：示例團隊先輸入再回覆。由你的團隊回答時請關閉。

trans-unit.source: The team's name in the panel header ("Support").
trans-unit.target: 面板標題中的團隊名稱（“Support”）。

trans-unit.source: Whether a widget with no articles when it first loads gets the sample (default true).
trans-unit.target: 首次加載時沒有文章是否顯示示例（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: The `Id` of the visitor ("visitor").
trans-unit.target: 訪客的 `Id`（“visitor”）。

trans-unit.source: A help article a `SupportWidget` can show and search.
trans-unit.target: `SupportWidget` 可以顯示和搜索的一篇幫助文章。

trans-unit.source: One conversation between the visitor and the team in a `SupportWidget`.
trans-unit.target: `SupportWidget` 中訪客與團隊之間的一次對話。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `MessageSent`.
trans-unit.target: `MessageSent` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: The screen a `SupportWidget` shows while open.
trans-unit.target: `SupportWidget` 打開時顯示的屏幕。

trans-unit.source: One action of a `SwipeActionsRow`: revealed under the row's edge by a swipe (icon over label), committed by a full swipe on the outermost action, a tap on the revealed action, or the row's More actions menu. An action that removes its item (the default) runs once the row has slid away and collapsed, so the handler can remove the item without a jump; set `KeepsRow` for actions such as Mark as unread, which run at once while the row springs home.
trans-unit.target: `SwipeActionsRow` 的一個動作：以水平滑動顯示在列的邊緣下方（圖示在上、文字在下），完整滑動最外側的動作、輕觸已顯示的動作，或列的「更多動作」選單即可執行。會移除其項目的動作（預設）會在列滑開並收合後執行，因此處理程式可以移除項目而不跳動；對於「標示為未讀」等動作，請設定 `KeepsRow`，這類動作會立即執行，而列則以彈簧彈回原位。

trans-unit.source: Runs after `Invoked`; its parameter defaults to the row's data item.
trans-unit.target: 在 `Invoked` 之後執行；其參數預設為該列的資料項目。

trans-unit.source: Parameter passed to Command; when null the row's data item is used.
trans-unit.target: 傳遞給 Command 的參數；為 null 時使用該列的資料項。

trans-unit.source: 24×24 Lucide geometry drawn at 20px (Arc: required), for example `ArcIcons.Archive`.
trans-unit.target: 以 20px 繪製的 24×24 Lucide 圖形（Arc：必填），例如 `ArcIcons.Archive`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the action runs (full swipe, tap on the revealed action, or the menu).
trans-unit.target: 動作執行時引發（完整滑動、輕觸已顯示的動作或選單）。

trans-unit.source: The row springs home after the action instead of sliding away and collapsing.
trans-unit.target: 動作之後該列以彈簧彈回原位，而不是滑開並收合。

trans-unit.source: Shown under the icon and in the menu (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 顯示在圖示下方以及選單中（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: Fill of the revealed action: Neutral (default), Accent or Danger.
trans-unit.target: 露出操作的填色：Neutral（預設）、Accent 或 Danger。

trans-unit.source: A list whose rows reveal actions on a horizontal swipe, the way a mail inbox does (Arc swipe actions): short, touch-first triage lists such as mail, notifications or tasks. Rows are `SwipeActionsRow`s declared inline or generated from `ItemsSource` (with `LeadingActions` / `TrailingActions` shared by every row that declares none, and `RowLabelBinding` naming each row). Only one row stays open at a time; pressing anywhere else or Escape puts it away. Every row also has a More actions menu with the same actions, so keyboard and screen reader users never need the gesture. Remove the item in `ActionInvoked` (or the action's own handler or command): removing actions run once their row has slid away and collapsed. The surface fades with the last row and hides when the list is empty. Rows are not virtualized; paginate long lists.
trans-unit.target: 一個清單，其列可以像郵件收件匣一樣透過水平滑動顯示動作（Arc 滑動動作）：適用於以觸控為先的簡短分類清單，如郵件、通知或任務。列為 `SwipeActionsRow`，可以內嵌宣告，也可以由 `ItemsSource` 產生（`LeadingActions` / `TrailingActions` 由未宣告自身動作的所有列共用，`RowLabelBinding` 用於為每列命名）。同一時間只有一列保持展開；按下其他任何位置或按 Escape 即可將其收起。每列還提供「更多動作」選單，包含相同的動作，因此鍵盤和螢幕閱讀器使用者無需使用手勢。請在 `ActionInvoked`（或動作自身的處理程式或命令）中移除項目：會移除項目的動作會在該列滑開並收合後執行。表面隨最後一列淡出，清單為空時隱藏。列不做虛擬化；長清單請分頁。

trans-unit.source: Raised (bubbling from the row) after an action ran.
trans-unit.target: 動作執行後從列引發（並冒泡至清單）。

trans-unit.source: Lets a long swipe commit the outermost action of rows that do not decide for themselves (default true).
trans-unit.target: 允許長距離滑動為不自行決定的列提交最外側的動作（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the list (Arc: required), such as "Inbox".
trans-unit.target: 清單的無障礙名稱（Arc：必填），例如 “Inbox”。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of each row's More actions button; {0} is the row's label.
trans-unit.target: 每列「更多動作」按鈕的無障礙名稱；{0} 為該列的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Binding that names generated rows (their `Label`), such as the message subject.
trans-unit.target: 為產生的列命名（其 `Label`）的繫結，例如郵件主旨。

trans-unit.source: One row of `SwipeActions` (Arc SwipeActionsRow): its content follows a horizontal swipe to reveal `LeadingActions` under the left edge and `TrailingActions` under the right. Past the last stop the row still follows with rubber-band resistance; a full swipe commits the outermost action (the action stretches across the row, the row slides away and collapses), and a release settles open or closed on a spring that carries the release velocity. Vertical drags pass through to the page. Every row also has a More actions button with the same actions in a menu, so the gesture is never required: Enter or Space opens it on the first row, arrows move, Escape closes the menu or puts an open row away. Pressing outside an open row closes it, and only one row of a list is open at a time. Use it on its own or inside a `SwipeActions` list (whose actions it uses when it declares none of its own).
trans-unit.target: `SwipeActions` 的一列（Arc SwipeActionsRow）：其內容隨水平滑動移動，以顯示左邊緣下方的 `LeadingActions` 和右邊緣下方的 `TrailingActions`。超過最後一個停駐點後，列仍會以橡皮筋阻力跟隨；完整滑動會提交最外側的動作（該動作橫跨整列，列滑開並收合）；鬆手後，列會以帶有釋放速度的彈簧停駐在展開或收合位置。垂直拖曳會傳遞給頁面。每列還提供「更多動作」按鈕，選單中包含相同的動作，因此手勢並非必需：Enter 或空白鍵在第一列上開啟選單，方向鍵移動，Escape 關閉選單或收起已展開的列。在已展開的列外按下即可將其關閉，清單中同一時間只有一列展開。可單獨使用，也可置於 `SwipeActions` 清單中（未宣告自身動作時使用清單的動作）。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the row (and bubbled to its list) after an action ran.
trans-unit.target: 動作執行後在該列引發（並冒泡至其清單）。

trans-unit.source: Lets a long swipe commit the outermost action without a tap; null follows the list (default on).
trans-unit.target: 允許長距離滑動無需輕觸即可提交最外側的動作；null 則跟隨清單（預設開啟）。

trans-unit.source: Names the row in its More actions button, for example the message subject (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 在其「更多動作」按鈕中為該列命名，例如郵件主旨（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: The side resting open (or heading there), or `None`.
trans-unit.target: 保持展開（或正在展開）的一側，或 `None`。

trans-unit.source: Left inset of the hairline separator under the row (Arc `--swipe-actions-inset`, default 16).
trans-unit.target: 列下方細分隔線的左側縮排（Arc `--swipe-actions-inset`，預設 16）。

trans-unit.source: Arc switch: a tactile toggle for settings that take effect immediately. While pressed the thumb widens toward the other side (far edge anchored); on release it glides on a critically damped spring. Toggles that did not come from a press (keyboard, code) play a brief stretch instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 開關：用於即時生效設定的觸感切換。按下時，滑塊會向另一側拉寬（遠端固定）；鬆開後，它以臨界阻尼彈簧滑動。非按下觸發的切換（鍵盤、程式碼）則改為短暫拉伸。

trans-unit.source: Arc's sortable data table: compare structured records with sortable columns. Click a header (or press Enter / Space on it) to sort ascending, again for descending; rows slide to their new places on a smooth spring and the sort arrow flips on a snappy one. `IsSelectable` adds a checkbox column, row-click selection, Shift range selection, Escape to clear and a count line with Clear selection. Rows are drawn as light text cells, virtualized for thousands of records, sorted by index (never by container), and the header sticks to the top of the visible area. Below 620px rows fold into two lines and the header becomes a strip of sort pills, as in Arc.
trans-unit.target: Arc 可排序資料表格：以可排序的欄位比較結構化記錄。點按表頭（或在表頭上按 Enter / Space）升冪排列，再點一次降冪；列以平滑的彈簧滑動到新位置，排序箭頭以更靈敏的彈簧翻轉。`IsSelectable` 會加入核取方塊欄、點按列選取、Shift 範圍選取、Escape 清除選取，以及帶「清除選取」的計數列。列以輕量文字儲存格繪製，對數千筆記錄進行虛擬化，依索引（而非容器）排序，表頭會黏附在可見區域頂端。寬度低於 620px 時，列會摺疊為兩行，表頭則變為排序膠囊條，與 Arc 一致。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the table.
trans-unit.target: 表格的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Text of the Clear selection action in the count line (default "Clear selection").
trans-unit.target: 計數列中「Clear selection」操作的文字（預設 "Clear selection"）。

trans-unit.source: Text shown when there are no rows (default "No rows to show").
trans-unit.target: 沒有列時顯示的文字（預設 "No rows to show"）。

trans-unit.source: Shows a spinner over the body (in place of the empty message when there are no rows).
trans-unit.target: 在表格主體上顯示載入指示器（沒有資料列時取代空狀態提示）。

trans-unit.source: Adds the checkbox column, row-click selection and the count line with Clear selection.
trans-unit.target: 加入核取方塊欄、點按列選取，以及帶「清除選取」的計數列。

trans-unit.source: When true a third click on a sorted header clears the sort (Arc toggles between ascending and descending).
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時，對已排序的表頭第三次點按會清除排序（Arc 中僅在升冪與降冪之間切換）。

trans-unit.source: Singular noun of the count line, as in "1 project".
trans-unit.target: 計數列中的單數名詞，如「1 個專案」。

trans-unit.source: Plural noun of the count line, as in "6 projects".
trans-unit.target: 計數列中的複數名詞，如「6 個專案」。

trans-unit.source: Row items (any enumerable; `INotifyCollectionChanged` sources are followed).
trans-unit.target: 資料列項目（任意可列舉物件；會追蹤 `INotifyCollectionChanged` 資料來源）。

trans-unit.source: Text shown with the loading spinner (default "Loading rows").
trans-unit.target: 載入旋轉圖示旁顯示的文字（預設 "Loading rows"）。

trans-unit.source: Row identity (Arc `rowKey`); defaults to the item itself. Selection and row motion follow keys across source changes.
trans-unit.target: 資料列的識別（Arc 中為 `rowKey`）；預設為項目本身。資料來源變化時，選取狀態與列的移動仍依據該鍵。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the select-all checkbox in the header (default "Select all rows").
trans-unit.target: 表頭全選核取方塊的無障礙名稱（預設 "Select all rows"）。

trans-unit.source: Selected row items in display order (two-way). A bound mutable list is updated in place.
trans-unit.target: 依顯示順序排列的已選資料列項目（雙向）。繫結的可變清單會被原地更新。

trans-unit.source: Word for the selected rows in the count line, as in "2 selected" (default "selected").
trans-unit.target: 計數列中已選取列的用詞，例如 "2 selected"（預設 "selected"）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the user changes the selection (checkboxes, row clicks, Select all, Clear, Escape).
trans-unit.target: 使用者變更選取時觸發（核取方塊、點按列、全選、清除或 Escape）。

trans-unit.source: When true (the default) a click anywhere on a row toggles it; when false only the checkbox cell does, and clicks on the rest of the row are left to the app. Keyboard selection is the same either way.
