trans-unit.source: Raised when the user sorts (header click or keyboard) or `Sort` is called.
trans-unit.target: 使用者排序（點按表頭或使用鍵盤）或呼叫 `Sort` 時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The sorted column (two-way). Setting a column while `SortDirection` is None sorts ascending.
trans-unit.target: 已排序的欄（雙向）。在 `SortDirection` 為 None 時設定欄，將依升冪排列。

trans-unit.source: Sort direction of the sorted column (two-way): None, Ascending or Descending.
trans-unit.target: 已排序欄的排序方向（雙向繫結）：None、Ascending 或 Descending。

trans-unit.source: The sorted column's `EffectiveKey` (two-way, for view models).
trans-unit.target: 已排序欄的 `EffectiveKey`（雙向，供檢視模型使用）。

trans-unit.source: Arc tabs: switch between related views of the same object. A single selection pill glides between the triggers on a morph spring, the incoming panel slides 8px in from the side of travel while the outgoing one is pinned in place and fades, and the panel area springs from the old panel height to the new one so the content below glides. Long tab lists scroll horizontally with soft edges and edge scroll buttons, and the selected or focused tab is always scrolled into view. Items are `TabItem` containers written inline (`<arc:TabItem Header="Overview">…</arc:TabItem>`) or generated from `ItemsSource`: `ItemTemplate` renders the trigger and `ContentTemplate` the panel.
trans-unit.target: Arc 分頁：在同一物件的相關檢視之間切換。單一選取的膠囊形指示器在觸發器之間沿彈簧曲線滑動，進入的面板從移動方向的一側滑入 8px，而離開的面板固定在原處並淡出；面板區域從舊面板高度以彈簧過渡到新高度，使下方內容平滑滑動。分頁較多時，分頁列可水平捲動，帶柔和邊緣和邊緣捲動按鈕，且選取或聚焦的分頁始終捲動到可見範圍內。項目可以內嵌寫為 `TabItem` 容器（`<arc:TabItem Header="Overview">…</arc:TabItem>`），也可由 `ItemsSource` 產生：`ItemTemplate` 渲染觸發器，`ContentTemplate` 渲染面板。

trans-unit.source: Whether arrow keys select the tab they move to (`Automatic`, Arc default).
trans-unit.target: 方向鍵是否同時選取移動到的分頁（`Automatic`，Arc 預設）。

trans-unit.source: Margin around the panel; its top edge is the space between the trigger list and the panel (Arc: 16px).
trans-unit.target: 面板外邊距；其上邊距即觸發器列表與面板之間的間距（Arc：16px）。

trans-unit.source: Template for the panel of data items (the trigger uses `ItemTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 資料項目面板的範本（觸發器使用 `ItemTemplate`）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the left scroll button.
trans-unit.target: 左側捲動按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the right scroll button.
trans-unit.target: 右側捲動按鈕的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: The panel content of the selected tab.
trans-unit.target: 選取分頁的面板內容。

trans-unit.source: The template of the selected tab's panel.
trans-unit.target: 選取分頁面板的範本。

trans-unit.source: Arc tag input: turns short typed values into removable tags. Enter or a comma adds the trimmed draft (a duplicate, compared case-insensitively, pulses the tag that exists instead); Backspace at the start of the field picks the last tag and the next Backspace removes it; the arrow keys move the pick and a ring glides to it; leaving the field commits the draft. New tags blur in where they were typed, removed tags leave their slot and the rest glide in, and the shell follows wrapped rows on a spring; the field never scrolls sideways.
trans-unit.target: Arc 標籤輸入框：將簡短輸入的值轉換為可移除的標籤。按 Enter 或逗號可新增去除前後空白後的草稿（重複的標籤（不區分大小寫比較）會改為使既有的那個標籤閃動）；插入點位於欄位開頭時按 Backspace 選取最後一個標籤，再按一次 Backspace 將其移除；方向鍵移動選取項，光圈會滑動到該處；離開欄位時提交草稿。新標籤在輸入位置淡入，被移除的標籤離開原位，其餘標籤滑動補位；外殼隨換行的列以彈簧跟隨調整，欄位本身從不橫向捲動。

trans-unit.source: Announced after an add; `{0}` is the tag (or the tags, comma separated, after a paste).
trans-unit.target: 新增後播報；`{0}` 為標籤（貼上後則為以逗號分隔的多個標籤）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the field; it describes the editor for assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 欄位下方的輔助文字；為輔助技術描述編輯器。

trans-unit.source: Announced when the draft repeats a tag; `{0}` is the existing tag.
trans-unit.target: 草稿與既有標籤重複時播報；`{0}` 為既有的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the field; non-empty makes the field invalid.
trans-unit.target: 欄位下方的錯誤提示；非空時欄位為無效狀態。

trans-unit.source: Invalid state (danger border). Always true while `ErrorMessage` is not empty.
trans-unit.target: 無效狀態（危險色邊框）。`ErrorMessage` 不為空時一律為 true。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is hidden visually but still names the editor.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時標籤在視覺上隱藏，但仍為編輯器命名。

trans-unit.source: The visible label (Arc: required). Also the accessible name of the editor.
trans-unit.target: 可見標籤（Arc：必填），同時也是編輯器的無障礙名稱。

trans-unit.source: Announced when `MaxTags` refuses an add; `{0}` is the limit.
trans-unit.target: `MaxTags` 拒絕新增時播報；`{0}` 為上限。

trans-unit.source: The most tags a user can add (extension; null = unlimited, as Arc). Negative values read as 0.
trans-unit.target: 使用者可新增的最多標籤數（擴充；null 表示無限制，與 Arc 一致）。負值按 0 處理。

trans-unit.source: Announced when a tag is picked; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 選取某個標籤時播報；`{0}` 為該標籤。

trans-unit.source: Shown while there are no tags and no draft (Arc default "Add a tag").
trans-unit.target: 沒有標籤且沒有草稿時顯示（Arc 預設文字為「新增標籤」）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of a tag's remove button; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 標籤移除按鈕的無障礙名稱；`{0}` 為該標籤。

trans-unit.source: Announced after a removal; `{0}` is the tag.
trans-unit.target: 移除後播報；`{0}` 為該標籤。

trans-unit.source: The tags (two-way). Never null: setting null reads back as an empty list.
trans-unit.target: 標籤（雙向繫結）。永不為 null：設定為 null 時讀回為空清單。

trans-unit.source: Raised (bubbling) whenever `Value` changes, by the user or in code.
trans-unit.target: `Value` 變更時引發（冒泡），無論由使用者還是程式碼引起。

trans-unit.source: Breaks a large task into subtasks: a title and a description, a Suggest button that proposes subtasks from the description (the built-in suggester, or your own `SuggestAction`), and an ordered list where each subtask has an editable title, an estimate in hours and an assignee, can be dragged (or moved with the keys) into a new order and removed. The footer adds up the hours, shows each person's load and creates the subtasks. While `IsSampleDataEnabled` is true and nothing was given when it is first shown, the block fills in an invented task, team and suggestion so it looks finished on a page.
trans-unit.target: 把一個大任務拆成子任務：標題和描述、一個根據描述建議子任務的 Suggest 按鈕（內置的建議功能，或你自己的 `SuggestAction`），以及一個有序清單，每個子任務都有可編輯的標題、以小時計的估時和負責人，可以拖曳（或用按鍵移動）到新的位置，也可以刪除。底部合計時長，顯示每個人的工作量，並創建子任務。 當 `IsSampleDataEnabled` 為 true 且第一次顯示時沒有提供任何內容，區塊會填入一個虛構的任務、團隊和建議，所以放在頁面上就是完整的樣子。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the create button is pressed (or `Create` is called) with the subtasks in order.
trans-unit.target: 按下創建按鈕（或調用 `Create`）時引發，按順序帶上所有子任務。

trans-unit.source: The task's description (two-way); the description field edits it and the suggester reads it.
trans-unit.target: 任務的描述（雙向）；描述輸入框編輯它，建議功能讀取它。

trans-unit.source: How many working hours make a day in the total line (6).
trans-unit.target: 合計行中一天算多少個工作小時（6）。

trans-unit.source: Draws a bordered card (true); false lays the block flat on the page.
trans-unit.target: 繪制帶邊框的卡片（true）；false 時區塊平鋪在頁面上。

trans-unit.source: Fills in the invented sample when the block is first shown with no title, description, people or subtasks.
trans-unit.target: 第一次顯示時如果沒有標題、描述、人員和子任務，就填入虛構的示例。

trans-unit.source: True while suggestions are being worked out.
trans-unit.target: 正在計算建議時為 true。

trans-unit.source: The words the block shows and reads out.
trans-unit.target: 區塊顯示和讀出的文字。

trans-unit.source: Proposes subtasks for a request; awaited when Suggest is pressed (or `SuggestAsync` is called). An exception shows a short failure line; null uses the built-in suggester.
trans-unit.target: 為一個請求建議子任務；按下 Suggest（或調用 `SuggestAsync`）時等待它完成。出現異常時顯示一行簡短的失敗說明；為 null 時使用內置的建議功能。

trans-unit.source: The task's title (two-way); the title field edits it.
trans-unit.target: 任務的標題（雙向）；標題輸入框編輯它。

trans-unit.source: The subtasks' estimates added up, in hours.
trans-unit.target: 所有子任務估時的合計，以小時計。

trans-unit.source: What the suggester is asked to break down.
trans-unit.target: 要求建議功能拆分的內容。

trans-unit.source: One subtask of a breakdown: a title, an estimate in hours and who does it.
trans-unit.target: 拆分出的一個子任務：標題、以小時計的估時和負責人。

trans-unit.source: A company directory: a searchable list of people with team filters on one side and the profile of the person picked on the other (bio, status, team, current work, location and an email address to copy). Search matches the name, role, team and city as you type; the team buttons show fixed totals; the selection is kept by `Id`, so when the picked person is filtered out the first match shows and the picked person comes back when they match again. Rows that stay glide to their new places, rows that leave fade where they were, and the profile cross-fades. Narrow blocks stack the profile under the list.
trans-unit.target: 公司通訊錄：一個可搜尋的人員清單，一側是團隊篩選，另一側是所選人員的個人檔案（簡介、狀態、團隊、目前工作、所在地與可複製的電子郵件地址）。搜尋會在輸入時比對姓名、角色、團隊與城市；團隊按鈕顯示固定的總數；所選內容依 `Id` 保留，因此當所選人員被篩掉時會顯示第一個符合項，待其再次符合時所選人員會回來。保留的列會滑動到新位置，離開的列會在原處淡出，個人檔案則交叉淡入淡出。窄的區塊會把個人檔案堆疊在清單下方。

trans-unit.source: Copies an email address: awaited when the copy button is pressed, with the address and a token that is cancelled when the block leaves the window. An exception shows Retry; null copies to the system clipboard.
trans-unit.target: 複製電子郵件地址：按下複製按鈕時被等待，傳入該地址與一個權杖，該權杖會在區塊離開視窗時被取消。發生例外會顯示 Retry；為 null 時複製到系統剪貼簿。

trans-unit.source: How long the copy button shows Copied or Retry before it rests again.
trans-unit.target: 複製按鈕顯示 Copied 或 Retry 多久之後恢復原狀。

trans-unit.source: The person whose profile shows: the picked person while they match, otherwise the first match, otherwise null.
trans-unit.target: 其個人檔案正在顯示的人員：符合時為所選人員，否則為第一個符合項，再否則為 null。

trans-unit.source: Raised after the copy button tried to copy an email address, whether it worked or not.
trans-unit.target: 在複製按鈕嘗試複製電子郵件地址後引發，無論是否成功。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the profile's email address is pressed; unless a handler sets Handled, a mailto: link opens.
trans-unit.target: 在按下個人檔案中的電子郵件地址時引發；除非處理常式將 Handled 設為 true，否則會開啟 mailto: 連結。

trans-unit.source: Whether the team buttons show under the header.
trans-unit.target: 團隊按鈕是否顯示在標頭下方。

trans-unit.source: Draws a bordered card with rounded corners (true); false lays the block flat at the container's width.
trans-unit.target: 繪製帶圓角的邊框卡片（true）；false 則以容器的寬度平鋪該區塊。

trans-unit.source: Whether the header shows the search box.
trans-unit.target: 標頭是否顯示搜尋方塊。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or announces.
trans-unit.target: 該區塊顯示或朗讀的每一個詞。

trans-unit.source: How many people match the team filter and the search.
trans-unit.target: 與團隊篩選和搜尋相符的人數。

trans-unit.source: The people, when you give them as a list to follow (observed when it raises collection changes); it wins over `People`.
trans-unit.target: 以清單形式提供、需要跟隨的成員（當它引發集合變更時會被觀察）；優先於 `People`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person picks someone from the list (click, Enter or Space) and the pick changes. Not raised when the shown person changes because of the filter or the search, nor for `SelectPerson`.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者從清單中選擇某人（點擊、Enter 或空白鍵）且所選對象發生變化時引發。因篩選或搜尋而使顯示的人員改變時不會引發，`SelectPerson` 也不會引發。

trans-unit.source: Run when the person picks someone from the list, with the `TeamDirectoryPerson` as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者從清單中選擇某人時執行，以 `TeamDirectoryPerson` 作為參數。

trans-unit.source: Decides whether a person matches the search text (the untrimmed text as typed); null matches the trimmed text, ignoring case, as one piece of the name, role, team or city.
trans-unit.target: 決定某人是否與搜尋文字相符（傳入的是使用者輸入的未裁剪文字）；為 null 時，將裁剪後的文字忽略大小寫，作為姓名、角色、團隊或城市的一部分進行比對。

trans-unit.source: The search text (two-way), applied on every keystroke; the team filter is kept when it changes.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋文字（雙向），每次按鍵都會套用；其變化時保留團隊篩選。

trans-unit.source: The `Key` of the person picked (two-way); only a pick or code changes it. Null, or a person not among the matches, shows the first match (see `DisplayedPerson`) without changing it.
trans-unit.target: 所選人員的 `Key`（雙向）；只有使用者選擇或程式碼才會改變它。為 null，或所指人員不在符合結果中時，顯示第一個符合項（見 `DisplayedPerson`），但不會改變該值。

trans-unit.source: The team shown (two-way); null shows every team. The search is kept when it changes.
trans-unit.target: 目前顯示的團隊（雙向）；為 null 時顯示所有團隊。其變化時保留搜尋。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `EmailCopied`: whose address was copied and whether it worked.
trans-unit.target: `EmailCopied` 的參數：複製的是誰的地址，以及是否成功。

trans-unit.source: Every word `TeamDirectory` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; texts with values in them are functions so that word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `TeamDirectory` 顯示或播報的每一個詞，預設為英文。取代該執行個體即可翻譯或改寫；帶有值的文字是函式，以便調整語序。

trans-unit.source: One person in a `TeamDirectory`: who they are, which team they belong to and how to reach them. The name, role, team and city are searched; the other fields only show in the profile. Changing a field updates the block.
trans-unit.target: `TeamDirectory` 中的一個人：他是誰、屬於哪個團隊以及如何聯絡他。姓名、角色、團隊和城市可被搜尋；其他欄位僅顯示在個人檔案中。變更任一欄位都會更新該區塊。

trans-unit.source: Whether the person is available (the avatar's dot and the profile's Status field).
trans-unit.target: 此人是否有空（頭像上的圓點和個人檔案的狀態欄位）。

trans-unit.source: The portrait; null shows the initials of `Name`.
trans-unit.target: 肖像照片；為 null 時顯示 `Name` 的首字母。

trans-unit.source: A sentence or two about the person, under the profile heading (not searched).
trans-unit.target: 關於此人的一兩句話，顯示在個人檔案標題下（不參與搜尋）。

trans-unit.source: Where the person works (searched; the profile's Location field).
trans-unit.target: 此人工作的地點（可搜尋；個人檔案的位置欄位）。

trans-unit.source: The email address: a mail link in the profile and what the copy button copies (not searched).
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件地址：個人檔案中的郵件連結，也是複製按鈕所複製的內容（不參與搜尋）。

trans-unit.source: What the person works on now, a few words (the profile's Working on field; not searched).
trans-unit.target: 此人目前所做的工作，幾個詞即可（個人檔案的正在做欄位；不參與搜尋）。

trans-unit.source: The stable key the selection is kept by; null or empty uses `Name`.
trans-unit.target: 用於保持選取狀態的穩定鍵；為 null 或空時使用 `Name`。

trans-unit.source: The full name (searched; the first line of the row and the profile heading).
trans-unit.target: 全名（可搜尋；列的第一行和個人檔案標題）。

trans-unit.source: The job title (searched; the second line of the row and the line under the profile heading).
trans-unit.target: 職位名稱（可搜尋；列的第二行和個人檔案標題下的那一行）。

trans-unit.source: The team (searched; the key of the team filter and the profile's Team field).
trans-unit.target: 團隊（可搜尋；團隊篩選的鍵和個人檔案的團隊欄位）。

trans-unit.source: A short time zone name shown after the city ("CET"); plain text, not a clock, not searched.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在城市之後的簡短時區名稱（"CET"）；純文字，不是時鐘，不參與搜尋。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of an event about one person (`EmailLinkClicked`).
trans-unit.target: 關於某一個人的事件的參數（`EmailLinkClicked`）。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `PersonSelected`: the person picked and the one shown before.
trans-unit.target: `PersonSelected` 的參數：所選的人以及之前顯示的人。

trans-unit.source: The members page of a workspace's settings. A header (title, a line of text and a seat meter: "7 of 10 seats" over a thin bar that turns to the warning color when every seat is taken); an invite form where typed or pasted addresses become chips (Enter, comma, semicolon or space commits; Backspace on an empty field removes the last chip; invalid text stays with an error, duplicates drop silently, members and pending invites drop with an error), a role picker and a send button that counts the invites and refuses to go over the free seats; the members (avatar, name, email, last active, role menu, remove with an inline confirmation) and the pending invites (resend, revoke), both filtered by one search; and a footer that reports the last action. Sending flies each address from its chip into a new pending row while the seat count rolls. Every server call is an async handler you supply; a handler that throws keeps the old state and shows the error.
trans-unit.target: 工作區設定中的成員頁面。包含：頁首（標題、一行文字和席位計量條："7 of 10 seats" 位於一條細條之上，當所有席位都被占用時細條變為警告色）；邀請表單，輸入或貼上的地址會變成標籤（Enter、逗號、分號或空白鍵確認；在空欄位中按 Backspace 會刪除最後一個標籤；無效文字會保留並顯示錯誤，重複項會靜默捨棄，已是成員和待接受的邀請的地址會捨棄並顯示錯誤）；角色選擇器和傳送按鈕，傳送按鈕會統計邀請數，並拒絕超出空閒席位；成員清單（頭像、姓名、電子郵件、最近活躍時間、角色選單、帶列內確認的移除）和待接受的邀請（重新傳送、撤銷），兩者都由同一個搜尋進行篩選；以及報告上一次操作的頁尾。傳送時，每個地址會從其標籤飛入新的待接受列，同時席位數滾動變化。每個伺服器呼叫都是由你提供的非同步處理常式；擲回例外的處理常式會保留舊狀態並顯示錯誤。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a handler threw (the block keeps the old state and shows the error).
trans-unit.target: 當處理常式擲回例外時引發（該區塊保留舊狀態並顯示錯誤）。

trans-unit.source: Saves a role change; the new role shows at once and goes back if it throws. Null keeps the change at once.
trans-unit.target: 儲存角色變更；新角色會立即顯示，如果擲回例外則恢復原狀。為 null 時立即保留該變更。

trans-unit.source: The line under the heading; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題下的那一行；為 null 時省略。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the built-in address check (one @, a dotted domain, a last part of at least two letters).
trans-unit.target: 取代內建的地址檢查（一個 @、帶點的網域、最後一部分至少兩個字母）。

trans-unit.source: Turns a handler's exception into the error text; null uses the exception's message (or a built-in text when it has none).
trans-unit.target: 將處理常式的例外轉換為錯誤文字；為 null 時使用例外的訊息（例外沒有訊息時使用內建文字）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an invite was sent again.
trans-unit.target: 當邀請被再次傳送時引發。

trans-unit.source: Run after an invite was sent again, with the `TeamMembersInviteEventArgs` as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 在邀請被再次傳送後執行，以 `TeamMembersInviteEventArgs` 作為參數。

trans-unit.source: Raised when an invite was withdrawn.
trans-unit.target: 當邀請被撤回時引發。

trans-unit.source: Run after an invite was withdrawn, with the `TeamMembersInviteEventArgs` as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 在邀請被撤回後執行，以 `TeamMembersInviteEventArgs` 作為參數。

trans-unit.source: The role key new invites get (two-way; the picker next to the invite field writes it).
trans-unit.target: 新邀請所獲得的角色鍵（雙向；邀請欄位旁的選擇器會寫入它）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when invites went out (they are in the list already).
trans-unit.target: 當邀請發出後引發（它們已在清單中）。

trans-unit.source: Run after invites went out, with the `TeamMembersInvitesSentEventArgs` as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 在邀請發出後執行，以 `TeamMembersInvitesSentEventArgs` 作為參數。

trans-unit.source: The pending invites, when you give them as a list to follow; it wins over `Invites`. When it is a writable list the block adds and removes invites in it.
trans-unit.target: 待接受的邀請，以清單形式提供、需要跟隨；優先於 `Invites`。當它是可寫入清單時，該區塊會在其中新增和刪除邀請。

trans-unit.source: Whether the footer with the status line shows (the status is announced either way).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示帶有狀態列的頁尾（無論是否顯示，狀態都會被播報）。

trans-unit.source: Draws the block as a bordered card with rounded corners (true); false lays it flat at the container's width.
trans-unit.target: 將該區塊繪製為帶圓角邊框的卡片（true）；false 時以容器的寬度平鋪。

trans-unit.source: Whether the invite form shows.
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示邀請表單。

trans-unit.source: A view for people who cannot manage the team: no invite form, roles as plain text, no remove, resend or revoke buttons. The search still works.
trans-unit.target: 面向無法管理團隊的使用者的檢視：沒有邀請表單，角色顯示為純文字，沒有移除、重新傳送或撤銷按鈕。搜尋仍然可用。

trans-unit.source: Whether the search field shows in the members section's head.
trans-unit.target: 是否在成員部分的標頭顯示搜尋欄位。

trans-unit.source: Whether the seat meter shows in the header.
trans-unit.target: 是否在頁首中顯示席位計量條。

trans-unit.source: True while the send handler runs.
trans-unit.target: 傳送處理常式執行期間為 True。

trans-unit.source: Every word the block shows or announces; replace it to translate or reword.
trans-unit.target: 該區塊顯示或播報的每一個詞；取代它即可翻譯或改寫。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a member was removed.
trans-unit.target: 當成員被移除時引發。

trans-unit.source: Run after a member was removed, with the `TeamMembersMemberEventArgs` as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 在成員被移除後執行，以 `TeamMembersMemberEventArgs` 作為參數。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a role change was saved.
trans-unit.target: 當角色變更已儲存時引發。

trans-unit.source: Run after a role change was saved, with the `TeamMembersRoleChangedEventArgs` as the parameter.
trans-unit.target: 在角色變更儲存後執行，以 `TeamMembersRoleChangedEventArgs` 作為參數。

trans-unit.source: The members, when you give them as a list to follow; it wins over `Members`. When it is a writable list the block removes members from it.
trans-unit.target: 成員，以清單形式提供、需要跟隨；優先於 `Members`。當它是可寫入清單時，該區塊會從中移除成員。

trans-unit.source: Removes a member after the inline confirmation, while Remove spins; an exception keeps the row. Null removes at once.
trans-unit.target: 在列內確認之後移除成員，期間 Remove 按鈕旋轉；擲回例外則保留該列。為 null 時立即移除。

trans-unit.source: Sends a pending invite again while its Resend button spins; an exception shows an error in the footer. Null resends at once.
trans-unit.target: 重新傳送待接受的邀請，期間其 Resend 按鈕旋轉；擲回例外則在頁尾顯示錯誤。為 null 時立即重新傳送。

trans-unit.source: Withdraws a pending invite while its Revoke button spins; an exception keeps the row. Null withdraws at once.
trans-unit.target: 撤回待接受的邀請，期間其 Revoke 按鈕旋轉；擲回例外則保留該列。為 null 時立即撤回。

trans-unit.source: The search text (two-way); it filters members and invites by name or email.
trans-unit.target: 搜尋文字（雙向）；依姓名或電子郵件篩選成員和邀請。

trans-unit.source: How many seats the workspace has; members and pending invites each take one.
trans-unit.target: 工作區擁有的席位數；成員和待接受的邀請各占一個。

trans-unit.source: Seats free: `SeatLimit` minus `SeatsUsed` (never below zero).
trans-unit.target: 空閒席位：`SeatLimit` 減去 `SeatsUsed`（不會低於零）。

trans-unit.source: Seats taken: members plus pending invites.
trans-unit.target: 已占用席位：成員加上待接受的邀請。

trans-unit.source: How many invites Send would send now: the chips plus a valid address being typed.
trans-unit.target: Send 現在會傳送的邀請數：標籤加上正在輸入的有效地址。

trans-unit.source: Sends the invites: awaited when Send is pressed (or `SendInvitesAsync` is called) while the button spins. An exception keeps the chips and shows its message; a cancellation keeps the chips silently. Null sends at once.
trans-unit.target: 傳送邀請：按下 Send（或呼叫 `SendInvitesAsync`）時被等待，期間按鈕旋轉。擲回例外會保留標籤並顯示其訊息；取消會靜默保留標籤。為 null 時立即傳送。

trans-unit.source: The footer's text: the result of the last action (it stays until the next one).
trans-unit.target: 頁尾的文字：上一次操作的結果（保留到下一次操作為止）。

trans-unit.source: The heading; null leaves it out.
trans-unit.target: 標題；為 null 時省略。

trans-unit.source: The workspace's name, used in the removal confirmation and its status line; null leaves it out of them.
trans-unit.target: 工作區的名稱，用於移除確認及其狀態列；為 null 時在其中省略。

trans-unit.source: An invite that was sent and not accepted yet: shown by `TeamMembers` under the members with a dashed avatar (initials from the address), the address, "role · detail" and the Resend and Revoke buttons. It takes a seat.
trans-unit.target: 已傳送但尚未被接受的邀請：由 `TeamMembers` 顯示在成員下方，包含虛線頭像（首字母取自地址）、地址、"role · detail" 以及 Resend 和 Revoke 按鈕。它占用一個席位。

trans-unit.source: The text after the role ("Invited Oct 7"); the block writes its own after a send or a resend.
trans-unit.target: 角色之後的文字（"Invited Oct 7"）；傳送或重新傳送之後，該區塊會寫入自己的文字。

trans-unit.source: The invited address.
trans-unit.target: 被邀請的地址。

trans-unit.source: A stable key; null uses the email.
trans-unit.target: 穩定鍵；為 null 時使用電子郵件。

trans-unit.source: The avatar's letters; null takes the first letters of the address's name part (split at . _ -), at most two.
trans-unit.target: 頭像上的字母；為 null 時取地址名稱部分（依 . _ - 拆分）的首字母，最多兩個。

trans-unit.source: The key of the role the person will get.
trans-unit.target: 此人將獲得的角色的鍵。

trans-unit.source: Every word `TeamMembers` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; texts with values are functions so that word order can change. Role names come from `Label`.
trans-unit.target: `TeamMembers` 顯示或播報的每一個詞，預設為英文。取代該執行個體即可翻譯或改寫；帶有值的文字是函式，以便調整語序。角色名稱來自 `Label`。

trans-unit.source: One member of the workspace shown by `TeamMembers`: an avatar (photo or initials, with a presence dot), the name and email, when the person was last active, and the role, which can be changed from the row's menu (the owner's cannot).
trans-unit.target: 由 `TeamMembers` 顯示的工作區的一名成員：頭像（照片或首字母，帶線上狀態圓點）、姓名和電子郵件、此人最近活躍的時間，以及角色，角色可透過該列的選單變更（擁有者的角色不可變更）。

trans-unit.source: The photo; null (or a photo that fails to load) shows the initials.
trans-unit.target: 照片；為 null（或照片載入失敗）時顯示首字母。

trans-unit.source: The email address, shown under the name and matched by the search and the invite field.
trans-unit.target: 電子郵件地址，顯示在姓名下方，可被搜尋和邀請欄位比對。

trans-unit.source: A stable key (rows keep their state across list changes); null uses the email.
trans-unit.target: 穩定鍵（列在清單變化時保持其狀態）；為 null 時使用電子郵件。

trans-unit.source: The person looking at the page: a muted "You" follows the name.
trans-unit.target: 正在檢視該頁面的人：姓名後會跟一個淡色的 "You"。

trans-unit.source: Whether the presence dot shows on the avatar.

trans-unit.source: A workspace switcher for multi-tenant apps (Arc Team switcher, design reference). The trigger shows the current workspace's tile, its name and its plan; the menu under it has a search field, your role in each workspace and a Cmd/Ctrl+1 to 9 shortcut for each of the first nine, and lets you create or join a workspace inline. One highlight glides between rows, and switching crossfades the trigger to the new workspace through a short loading state. Give it your workspaces in `Workspaces` and the active id in `Value` (two-way). Loading a workspace, creating one and joining one are your async delegates (`SwitchHandler`, `CreateHandler`, `JoinHandler`); each one left out is simulated. With no workspaces, a `Simulation` supplies demo workspaces and the invites its simulated join accepts; with neither, the trigger says there is no workspace. The root is up to 360px wide and fills narrower containers.
trans-unit.target: 面向多租戶應用程式的工作區切換器（Arc Team switcher，設計參考）。觸發器顯示目前工作區的圖塊、名稱與方案；其下的選單有搜尋欄位、你在每個工作區中的角色，並為前九個工作區各提供一個 Cmd/Ctrl+1 到 9 的快速鍵，還能就地建立或加入工作區。一個醒目提示在列之間滑動，切換時觸發器會經過短暫的載入狀態交叉淡化到新的工作區。把你的工作區放進 `Workspaces`，把目前工作區的 id 放進 `Value`（雙向）。載入、建立與加入工作區都由你的非同步委派完成（`SwitchHandler`、`CreateHandler`、`JoinHandler`）；未提供的委派會被模擬。沒有工作區時，`Simulation` 提供展示用的工作區以及模擬加入所接受的邀請；兩者都沒有時，觸發器顯示沒有工作區。根元素最寬 360px，在更窄的容器中填滿寬度。

trans-unit.source: A text filter condition: an enable checkbox with the label, an operator (∋ ∌ = ≠ ^ $ .*) and an `Input` for the filter text. It holds the condition (`IsActive`, `Operator`, `Text`, `IsCaseSensitive`) and never filters data itself; read the properties in your view model, or test texts with `Matches` or `Condition`. With `Regex` the text is a regular expression: a pattern that does not parse shows its error under the field, sets `IsPatternValid` to false and the `:invalid` pseudo-class.
trans-unit.target: 文字篩選條件：帶標籤的啟用核取方塊、運算子（∋ ∌ = ≠ ^ $ .*）和輸入篩選文字的 `Input`。它保存條件（`IsActive`、`Operator`、`Text`、`IsCaseSensitive`），本身從不過濾資料；請在檢視模型中讀取這些屬性，或用 `Matches` 或 `Condition` 判斷文字。使用 `Regex` 時文字是規則運算式：無法剖析的模式會在輸入框下方顯示錯誤，把 `IsPatternValid` 設為 false 並加上 `:invalid` 虛擬類別。

trans-unit.source: The filter text, or the pattern with `Regex` (two-way, default empty: matches everything).
trans-unit.target: 篩選文字，使用 `Regex` 時為模式（雙向，預設為空：符合所有內容）。

trans-unit.source: A text condition as plain data: operator, filter text and case sensitivity. It has no UI, so a view model can build one from its own state and test texts with `Matches`; build it once per change, not once per item, so a pattern is parsed once. An empty filter text constrains nothing: every text matches. With `Regex` the filter text is a .NET regular expression run by the interpreter (no code is generated, so it is safe for AOT); an invalid pattern sets `IsValid` to false and `Error` to the parser's message, and then constrains nothing either. A match that runs past `MatchTimeout` counts as no match.
trans-unit.target: 以純資料表示的文字條件：運算子、篩選文字和是否區分大小寫。它不含介面，檢視模型可以用自己的狀態建構一個，再用 `Matches` 判斷文字；每次變化建構一次，而不是每項建構一次，這樣模式只剖析一次。空的篩選文字不構成任何限制：所有文字都符合。使用 `Regex` 時篩選文字是由直譯器執行的 .NET 規則運算式（不產生程式碼，因此相容 AOT）；無效的模式會把 `IsValid` 設為 false、`Error` 設為剖析器的訊息，此時同樣不構成限制。比對超過 `MatchTimeout` 即視為不符合。

trans-unit.source: Morphs one short label into the next in place (P4): letters both strings share glide to their new positions, new letters sharpen in with a short stagger, removed letters blur away, and the width follows on a spring. Single line; assistive technology reads the plain text. Rendered directly: no control per letter.

trans-unit.source: A headline that reveals itself once as it appears (Arc TextReveal): each word rises out of its own feathered clip while it sharpens from a soft blur and fades in, word after word (P20, P29). A title that mounts on screen starts with the first frame like Arc; one that mounts below the fold waits until it enters the viewport (S6, once). Whenever the animation cannot run (motion off, detached), the text shows at rest. Use `\n` for a deliberate line break; lines are at most `MaxWidthInChars` wide and balanced. Drawn as one control: no per-word controls.
trans-unit.target: 標題在出現時只播放一次的顯現動畫（Arc TextReveal）：每個詞從各自帶羽化邊緣的裁剪區中升起，同時由柔和模糊逐漸清晰並淡入，逐詞依序進行（P20、P29）。掛載於螢幕上的標題從第一格開始，與 Arc 一致；掛載於視口之下的標題會等到進入視口後才播放（S6，僅一次）。無法播放動畫時（動畫關閉、已分離）文字直接以靜止狀態顯示。使用 `\n` 來刻意換行；每行最多為 `MaxWidthInChars` 寬，且行寬均衡。作為一個控制項繪製：沒有逐詞控制項。

trans-unit.source: A calm light sweeping across a short status line (Arc TextShimmer), such as "Thinking" or "Generating summary": a bell-shaped band of the text color crosses a muted base, then pauses briefly before the next pass (P21). The sweep runs only while `IsActive`, within 64px of the viewport and visible, and resumes where it stopped. Turning `IsActive` off lets a band in flight glide off while the text settles to solid. A new label rises in place from a soft blur while the line springs to its width (P2, P5). Drawn as one control: the band is the text drawn again through a sliding opacity mask, so a frame allocates nothing.
trans-unit.target: 一道平靜的光帶掃過簡短的狀態列（Arc TextShimmer），例如 “Thinking” 或 “Generating summary”：一條鐘形的文字顏色光帶穿過靜止的底色，然後在下一輪開始前短暫停頓（P21）。掃光僅在 `IsActive` 為 true、距視口 64px 以內且可見時執行，並從停止處繼續。關閉 `IsActive` 時，進行中的光帶會滑出，文字則平穩過渡為實色。新標籤從柔和的模糊中原地升起，同時該列以彈簧調整至其寬度（P2、P5）。作為一個控制項繪製：光帶是透過滑動不透明度遮罩再次繪製的文字，因此每格不配置任何記憶體。

trans-unit.target: 靜止的底色；未設定時為文字顏色的 12%，與次要文字顏色混合。

trans-unit.source: Arc textarea: a labeled multiline field (Enter adds a line) with the same helper / error rows as `Input`; a live count in the description ("120 characters") rolls only the digits that change. It fills its column with a 110px minimum height and, like Arc's `resize: vertical`, can be made taller by dragging the corner grip (`IsResizable`). Focus draws Arc's 3px focus ring around the border. Arc's textarea does not grow with its content, so neither does this one; it scrolls instead.
trans-unit.target: Arc 多行文字方塊：帶標籤的多行欄位（Enter 新增換行），其輔助文字列和錯誤列與 `Input` 相同；描述中的即時計數（如 “120 characters”）只捲動變化的數字。它以 110px 的最小高度填滿所在欄，並且與 Arc 的 `resize: vertical` 一樣，可透過拖曳右下角把手（`IsResizable`）加高。聚焦時在邊框周圍繪製 Arc 的 3px 焦點環。與 Arc 的多行文字方塊一樣，此控制項不隨內容增長，而是改為捲動。

trans-unit.source: Smallest height of the field's frame, border and padding included, in px. The theme sets Arc's 110px; lower it for a short note or prompt box (two lines of text at the default size need 66px). The grip never drags below it.
trans-unit.target: 欄位外框的最小高度（含邊框和內距，單位 px）。佈景主題設為 Arc 的 110px；簡短的備註框或提示詞框可將其調低（預設尺寸下兩行文字需要 66px）。把手不會拖到它以下。

trans-unit.source: A single light / dark switch for a header: a secondary button that swaps sun and moon on a shared turn and names the next appearance. Pressing it raises `ThemeChangeRequested`; unless a handler marks it handled, the switcher applies the change through `ArcThemeManager` (changing the appearance and keeping the rest of the current theme) inside the page transition of its `Variant`. Arc hands that transition to the View Transitions API; here the old window is snapshotted into an overlay whose animated clip reveals the new theme beneath (`RunTransitionAsync`, also usable from a handler). Reduced motion switches without a transition.
trans-unit.target: 用於頁首的單一明暗切換：一個次要按鈕，在共用的轉動動畫中切換太陽與月亮圖示，並標示下一種外觀。按下時引發 `ThemeChangeRequested`；除非處理程式將其標記為已處理，否則切換器會透過 `ArcThemeManager` 套用變更（只改變外觀，保留目前主題的其他設定），並在其 `Variant` 的頁面過渡中進行。Arc 將該過渡交給 View Transitions API；此處則將舊視窗擷取為覆蓋層，由其動畫裁剪區在下方顯示新主題（`RunTransitionAsync`，也可在處理程式中使用）。減少動態效果時直接切換，不做過渡。

trans-unit.source: The appearance shown; null follows the control's actual theme variant (default).
trans-unit.target: 顯示的外觀；null 則跟隨控制項實際的主題變體（預設）。

trans-unit.target: 圖示旁可見的文字（預設為「切換主題」）。

trans-unit.source: One incoming support message for a `TicketRouter`. Data only, safe to read from any thread (your classifier may run off the UI thread).
trans-unit.target: `TicketRouter` 的一則傳入支援訊息。僅為資料，可在任何執行緒讀取（你的分類器可以在 UI 執行緒之外執行）。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ReviewConfirmed`: a review ticket sent to its suggested lane.
trans-unit.target: `ReviewConfirmed` 的參數：一張複核工單被送往其建議的泳道。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `TicketRouted`: the ticket that landed in a lane.
trans-unit.target: `TicketRouted` 的參數：落入某條泳道的工單。

trans-unit.source: A support ticket router card (Arc Ticket router, design reference). Messages from several channels (email, chat, messages, help desk) arrive one at a time, an AI classifier labels each with an intent, a sentiment and a confidence, and the ticket travels into a team lane where it gets the next assignee in turn. Tickets below `ReviewThreshold` wait in the review lane with the classifier's pick as a suggestion; one click routes them there. Give it `Tickets` and a `Classifier` (your model call); handle `TicketRouted` to assign in your help desk. With no tickets of its own it plays its `Simulation`, an inbox you supply, with a simulated classifier and loops; with neither it rests on "No tickets yet" in empty lanes. About two seconds per ticket at `Speed` 1; the flow pauses with `IsPaused`, off screen and when unloaded, and each pause cancels a running classifier call.
trans-unit.target: 支援工單路由卡片（Arc Ticket router，設計參考）。來自多個管道（電子郵件、聊天、訊息、服務台）的訊息逐則送達，AI 分類器為每則訊息標註意圖、情緒與信賴度，工單隨後移入團隊泳道，由輪到的下一位負責人接手。低於 `ReviewThreshold` 的工單在複核泳道中等待，以分類器的選擇作為建議；點一下即可送往該處。傳入 `Tickets` 與一個 `Classifier`（你的模型呼叫）；處理 `TicketRouted` 以在你的服務台中指派。自己沒有工單時，它以模擬分類器播放它的 `Simulation`（由你提供的收件匣）並循環；兩者都沒有時，它會停在空泳道中的「No tickets yet」。`Speed` 為 1 時每張工單約兩秒；流程會在 `IsPaused`、離開畫面與卸載時暫停，每次暫停都會取消進行中的分類器呼叫。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the classifier throws. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 分類器擲出例外時觸發。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Your classifier: return the intent, sentiment and confidence, or throw to show the error state with Retry and Send to review. The token cancels on pause, off screen and unload. Null reads each message's `Sample`.
trans-unit.target: 你的分類器：傳回意圖、情緒與信賴度，或擲出例外以顯示帶有 Retry 與 Send to review 的錯誤狀態。權杖在暫停、離開畫面與卸載時取消。為 null 時讀取每則訊息的 `Sample`。

trans-unit.source: Tickets already in the lanes on first show, newest first. Null uses the simulation's while it plays.
trans-unit.target: 首次顯示時已在泳道中的工單，最新的在前。為 null 時，播放模擬期間使用模擬中的工單。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.

trans-unit.source: The lanes left to right. Null uses the simulation's lanes while it plays, else the default lanes: Billing, Engineering, Success and Needs review (the ids `DefaultRoute` picks), with no assignees.
trans-unit.target: 由左到右的泳道。為 null 時，播放模擬期間使用模擬中的泳道，否則使用預設泳道：Billing、Engineering、Success 與 Needs review（`DefaultRoute` 挑選的 id），沒有負責人。

trans-unit.source: Starts over when the queue runs out. Null loops a simulation and stops after your own tickets ("All caught up").
trans-unit.target: 佇列用完時從頭開始。為 null 時循環播放模擬，而你自己的工單處理完後停止（"All caught up"）。

trans-unit.source: Rows shown per lane. Narrow cards show at most 2.

trans-unit.target: 標題前的標記（24 × 24 描邊圖形）；預設為閃光圖示。

Null rests on the empty state instead.

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `PausedChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `PausedChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: An inbox a `TicketRouter` plays on its own while the app sets no `Tickets`: the classifier model's name, the lanes, the stream of messages with the answer the simulated classifier gives for each (`Sample`) and the tickets already in the lanes. The router reads, labels and routes one message at a time, sends the ones below the review threshold to the review lane, and loops when the stream runs out; it pauses off screen and with `IsPaused`. Nothing is sent. Set the data before handing the simulation to the router; to play another inbox, give the router a new simulation.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式沒有設定 `Tickets` 時 `TicketRouter` 自行播放的收件匣：分類器模型的名稱、泳道、訊息流（每則附有模擬分類器給出的答案 `Sample`）以及已在泳道中的工單。路由器一次讀取、標註並路由一則訊息，把低於複核門檻的訊息送入複核泳道，訊息流用完時循環；離開畫面時以及 `IsPaused` 時暫停。不會送出任何內容。請在把模擬交給路由器之前設定好資料；要播放另一個收件匣，就給路由器一個新的模擬。

trans-unit.source: An event ticket with a stub you tear off (Arc Ticket tear, design reference). Pulling the stub down or away tears the perforation hole by hole, following the hand; letting go early springs the loose flap most of the way back, and once free the stub falls, spins and fades. Enter or Space, or setting `IsTorn`, finishes the tear on its own.
trans-unit.target: 一張可以撕下票根的活動門票（Arc Ticket tear，設計參考）。向下或向遠離票身的方向拉動票根，齒孔會隨手一孔一孔撕開；提前放手時鬆開的紙片回彈大部分距離，脫落後票根下落、旋轉並淡出。Enter 或 Space，或設定 `IsTorn`，都會自動撕完。

trans-unit.source: Whether the stub is off. Setting true tears it off; setting false puts a fresh stub on. A ticket that starts true shows no tear.
trans-unit.target: 票根是否已撕下。設為 true 會撕下票根；設為 false 會換上新票根。初始即為 true 的門票不顯示撕開過程。

trans-unit.target: 印在票根上的內容。要簡短：一個座位、一個登機門或一個代碼。

trans-unit.source: Paper of the stub. By default it stands out from the body: light on a dark theme, dark on a light one.

trans-unit.source: Text on the stub.

trans-unit.source: Template for `Stub`.

trans-unit.source: Width of the stub in px. The body takes the rest of the ticket.
trans-unit.target: 票根寬度（px）。票身佔據門票的其餘部分。

trans-unit.source: Raised once the stub comes off the ticket.
trans-unit.target: 票根從門票上脫落時觸發一次。

trans-unit.source: A tile grid like a start screen: the panel is divided into equal cells, each child covers RowSpan × ColumnSpan of them, and children go, in order, to the first place where they fit without overlapping. Usable on its own or as an `ItemsPanel`.
trans-unit.target: 類似開始畫面的磁磚格線：面板被分成相等的儲存格，每個子元素涵蓋 RowSpan × ColumnSpan 個儲存格，子元素依序放到第一個放得下且不重疊的位置。可單獨使用，也可作為 `ItemsPanel`。

trans-unit.source: How many columns a child covers (at least 1; attached).
trans-unit.target: 子元素涵蓋的欄數（至少為 1；附加屬性）。

trans-unit.source: Number of columns; 0 fits as many columns of at least `MinCellSize` as the width allows.
trans-unit.target: 欄數；0 表示依寬度放下盡可能多、至少 `MinCellSize` 寬的欄。

trans-unit.source: Lets tiles grow into empty cells after placement: to their right and below them, then from any side into the holes left (see the remarks of `TilePanel`).
trans-unit.target: 放置之後讓磁磚延伸到空的儲存格：先向右、向下，再從任一側延伸到剩下的空洞（見 `TilePanel` 的說明）。

trans-unit.source: Lets the panel size the children that set neither `RowSpan` nor `ColumnSpan`: 1×1, 1×2, 2×1 or 2×2, picked from the child's index and `Seed` (see the remarks of `TilePanel`).
trans-unit.target: 由面板決定既沒有設定 `RowSpan` 也沒有設定 `ColumnSpan` 的子元素大小：1×1、1×2、2×1 或 2×2，依子元素的索引和 `Seed` 選取（見 `TilePanel` 的說明）。

trans-unit.source: The most columns a tile may span; 0 means no limit beyond the grid.
trans-unit.target: 磁磚最多可跨的欄數；0 表示除格線外不設限制。

trans-unit.source: The most rows a tile may span; 0 means no limit beyond the grid.
trans-unit.target: 磁磚最多可跨的列數；0 表示除格線外不設限制。

trans-unit.source: The narrowest cell when `Columns` is 0, and the cell size when neither side is otherwise sized.
trans-unit.target: `Columns` 為 0 時儲存格的最小寬度；兩邊都沒有其他尺寸來源時，它就是儲存格尺寸。

trans-unit.source: How many rows a child covers (at least 1; attached).
trans-unit.target: 子元素涵蓋的列數（至少為 1；附加屬性）。

trans-unit.source: Number of rows the height is shared between (tiles that do not fit continue on further rows); 0 sizes rows like columns. Also fixes the row count when the grid grows sideways (unbounded width and `Columns` 0).
trans-unit.target: 平分高度的列數（放不下的磁磚繼續排在後續的列中）；0 表示列的尺寸與欄相同。格線橫向增長（寬度無界且 `Columns` 為 0）時，它也固定列數。

trans-unit.source: Picks the arrangement when `IsAutoSpan` is on: the same seed always gives the same tiles; another seed gives another arrangement.
trans-unit.target: 開啟 `IsAutoSpan` 時決定排列：同一個種子一律得到同樣的磁磚，換一個種子得到另一種排列。

trans-unit.source: The gap between neighbouring cells.
trans-unit.target: 相鄰儲存格之間的間距。

trans-unit.source: A round dial for picking a time of day or a length of time: drag the handle around the face, press anywhere on the track to jump there, or use the arrow keys. The value snaps to `Step`, the handle follows on a spring, and the readout in the middle shows the value.
trans-unit.target: 用來選擇時間點或時長的圓形錶盤：沿錶盤拖動手柄，按在軌道上任意位置跳到那裡，或使用方向鍵。數值對齊到 `Step`，手柄隨彈簧跟隨，中間的讀數顯示目前的值。

trans-unit.source: Text for times before noon.
trans-unit.target: 中午以前的時間使用的文字。

trans-unit.source: Unit shown under a duration of an hour or more.
trans-unit.target: 一小時及以上的時長下方顯示的單位。

trans-unit.source: Shows a time of day as 19:05 instead of 7:05 PM (time mode only).
trans-unit.target: 把時間顯示為 19:05 而不是 7:05 PM（僅時鐘模式）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the dial, such as "Alarm time" or "Focus length".
trans-unit.target: 錶盤的無障礙名稱，例如「Alarm time」或「Focus length」。

trans-unit.source: What Page Up and Page Down move by. Default 1 hour.
trans-unit.target: Page Up 和 Page Down 每次移動的量。預設 1 小時。

trans-unit.source: The longest duration (duration mode only). Default 2 hours.
trans-unit.target: 最長的時長（僅時長模式）。預設 2 小時。

trans-unit.source: The shortest duration (duration mode only). Default zero.
trans-unit.target: 最短的時長（僅時長模式）。預設為零。

trans-unit.source: Unit shown under a duration of less than an hour.
trans-unit.target: 不到一小時的時長下方顯示的單位。

trans-unit.source: Text for times from noon on.

trans-unit.source: The value snaps to multiples of this while dragging, and the arrow keys move by it. Default 5 minutes.
trans-unit.target: 拖動時數值對齊到它的倍數，方向鍵每次也移動這麼多。預設 5 分鐘。

trans-unit.source: How much one full turn of the handle adds (duration mode only). Default 1 hour.
trans-unit.target: 手柄轉滿一圈增加的量（僅時長模式）。預設 1 小時。

trans-unit.source: The picked value: a time of day (0:00 to 23:59) or a length of time, depending on `Mode`.
trans-unit.target: 選中的值：時間點（0:00 到 23:59）或時長，取決於 `Mode`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a drag ends, a key moves the value, or AM and PM are switched.
trans-unit.target: 拖動結束、按鍵改變數值或切換上午下午時觸發。

trans-unit.source: Arc time field: a trigger over a scrolling list of times generated every `MinuteStep` minutes. The list opens centred on the chosen time, arrow keys move the highlight (the list glides to keep it in view, wrapping at both ends), Enter or a click chooses and closes, Escape closes. The shown time rolls like a clock face: a later time rises from below, an earlier one drops from above. 12- or 24-hour display follows the culture unless `ClockFormat` says otherwise; the value is always a 24-hour `TimeOnly`.
trans-unit.target: Arc 時間欄位：觸發器下方是一個可捲動的時間清單，每隔 `MinuteStep` 分鐘產生一項。清單開啟時以所選時間為中心，方向鍵移動反白（清單會滑動以保持其可見，兩端循環），Enter 或按一下選取並關閉，Escape 關閉。顯示的時間如同鐘面一樣滾動：較晚的時間從下方升起，較早的時間從上方落下。除非 `ClockFormat` 另有指定，否則 12 小時制或 24 小時制顯示跟隨文化設定；值一律為 24 小時制的 `TimeOnly`。

trans-unit.source: 12- or 24-hour display (Auto follows the culture).
trans-unit.target: 12 小時制或 24 小時制顯示（Auto 跟隨文化設定）。

trans-unit.source: Culture for the clock format and the AM / PM designators (null = current UI culture).
trans-unit.target: 時鐘格式及上午/下午標示所使用的文化（null = 目前 UI 文化）。

trans-unit.source: Helper copy under the trigger.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的輔助文字。

trans-unit.source: Error copy under the trigger; non-empty makes the field invalid.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的錯誤提示；非空時欄位為無效狀態。

trans-unit.source: Whether the list is open (two-way).
trans-unit.target: 清單是否展開（雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: When false the label is hidden but still names the field.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時標籤隱藏，但仍為欄位命名。

trans-unit.source: The visible label above the trigger (Arc: required).
trans-unit.target: 觸發器上方的可見標籤（Arc：必填）。

trans-unit.source: Tallest the list grows before it scrolls (Arc: 250px).
trans-unit.target: 清單增長的最大高度，超過後捲動（Arc：250px）。

trans-unit.source: Minutes between options (Arc: 1, 5, 10, 15 or 30; default 15).
trans-unit.target: 選項之間的分鐘間隔（Arc：1、5、10、15 或 30；預設 15）。

trans-unit.source: Shown while there is no time (Arc: "Select a time").
trans-unit.target: 沒有時間時顯示（Arc 預設文字為「選擇時間」）。

trans-unit.source: The chosen time (two-way). Arc's default is 09:00; null shows the placeholder.
trans-unit.target: 所選時間（雙向繫結）。Arc 的預設值為 09:00；null 時顯示預留位置文字。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SelectedTime` changes.
trans-unit.target: `SelectedTime` 變更時引發。

trans-unit.source: Trigger height: Small 36, Medium 44 (default), Large 50.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器高度：Small 36、Medium 44（預設）、Large 50。

trans-unit.source: A vertical activity feed grouped by day, newest first (Arc's `Timeline`), for project history, audit logs and deploy streams. Day labels stay pinned while their updates scroll, the connecting line draws itself as rows come into view, rows with a `Detail` expand in place, and new updates slide in at the top while the rest glide down. ↑ / ↓ / Home / End move between expandable rows; Enter or Space expands one.
trans-unit.target: 依日期分組的垂直活動動態，最新的在前（Arc 的 `Timeline`），適用於專案歷程、稽核記錄和部署串流。日期標籤在其更新捲動時保持固定，連接線會隨列進入視口而自行繪製，帶有 `Detail` 的列會原地展開，新的更新從頂部滑入，其餘內容滑動下移。↑ / ↓ / Home / End 在可展開的列之間移動；Enter 或空白鍵展開一列。

trans-unit.source: Culture of day headings and clock times; null uses en-US (Arc's default locale).
trans-unit.target: 日期標題與時鐘時間所用的文化；null 則使用 en-US（Arc 的預設地區設定）。

trans-unit.source: A row opened or closed by the user (click, keyboard, assistive technology or the methods).
trans-unit.target: 使用者（按一下、鍵盤、輔助技術或方法）開啟或關閉某列時引發。

trans-unit.source: Ids of the expanded rows (Arc's `defaultExpanded`, two-way).
trans-unit.target: 已展開列的 ID（Arc 的 `defaultExpanded`，雙向繫結）。

trans-unit.source: Background of the day labels, which cover the updates scrolling under them (Arc's `--timeline-surface`, Surface by default). Set it to the surface the feed sits on.
trans-unit.target: 日期標籤的背景，覆蓋在其下方捲動的更新內容之上（Arc 的 `--timeline-surface`，預設為 Surface）。請將其設為資訊流所在的表面。

trans-unit.source: Heading level of the day labels (2 to 6; default 3).
trans-unit.target: 日期標籤的標題層級（2 到 6；預設為 3）。

trans-unit.source: Scroll back to the top when a new newest update arrives while the feed is scrolled down.
trans-unit.target: 當資訊流捲動到下方時，若有新的最新更新抵達，則捲動回頂部。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the feed (Arc's required `label`).
trans-unit.target: 資訊流的無障礙名稱（Arc 必要的 `label`）。

trans-unit.source: Reference time for relative labels ("9m") and day groups ("Today"). Pass a ticking clock (about once a minute) to keep labels fresh; the default (`MinValue`) reads the system clock when labels are built.
trans-unit.target: 相對時間標籤（“9m”）與日期分組（“Today”）所用的參考時間。傳入約每分鐘更新一次的時鐘可讓標籤保持最新；預設值（`MinValue`）會在建立標籤時讀取系統時鐘。

trans-unit.source: Time zone for day groups and clock times. Fixed (UTC) by default, like Arc, so every viewer agrees.
trans-unit.target: 日期分組與時刻所用的時區。與 Arc 一樣預設為固定的 UTC，使所有檢視者看到的時間一致。

trans-unit.source: One update in a `Timeline` (Arc's `TimelineEvent`): who did what and when, with optional context and a detail revealed in place. Events are read when they are added; replace an event to change it.
trans-unit.target: `Timeline` 中的一則更新（Arc 的 `TimelineEvent`）：誰在何時做了什麼，可附帶上下文，並可在原位展開詳細資訊。事件在新增時讀取；如需修改，請取代該事件。

trans-unit.source: The title bar of an `ArcWindow`: an icon and the window title, then three areas for your own controls (left, center and right) and the caption buttons. Its empty part moves the window and a double click maximizes or restores it; controls placed in the three areas take their own input. On Windows the bar is the system caption (system menu, Aero Snap) and the maximize button is the system's (Snap Layouts). The center content is centered on the whole bar while it fits between the sides. Only the window's own bar drives the window; one placed anywhere else is a preview.
trans-unit.target: `ArcWindow` 的標題列：圖示和視窗標題，接著是放置你自己控制項的三個區域（左、中、右）以及標題列按鈕。拖曳空白部分移動視窗，按兩下最大化或還原；三個區域中的控制項自己處理輸入。在 Windows 上，它就是系統標題列（系統選單、Aero 貼齊），最大化按鈕就是系統按鈕（貼齊版面配置）。中間內容在兩側放得下時置中於整個標題列。只有視窗自己的標題列會控制視窗；放在其他位置的只是預覽。

trans-unit.source: Who draws minimize, maximize and close: the bar (`Drawn`), the system (`System`, the macOS traffic lights, with room left for them) or neither (`None`). `Auto` picks `System` on macOS and `Drawn` elsewhere.
trans-unit.target: 由誰繪製最小化、最大化和關閉按鈕：標題列（`Drawn`）、系統（`System`，即 macOS 紅綠燈，標題列為其留出位置）或都不繪製（`None`）。`Auto` 在 macOS 上選擇 `System`，其他系統選擇 `Drawn`。

trans-unit.source: Content in the middle of the bar (a search field, tabs). It is centered on the whole bar while it fits between the sides; give it a `Width` or `MaxWidth`.
trans-unit.target: 標題列中間的內容（搜尋框、索引標籤）。在兩側放得下時置中於整個標題列；請為它設定 `Width` 或 `MaxWidth`。

trans-unit.source: The icon before the title, such as an `Image` or an `ArcGlyph`; none by default.
trans-unit.target: 標題前的圖示，例如 `Image` 或 `ArcGlyph`；預設沒有。

trans-unit.source: Content after the title, at the left of the bar (a menu, navigation).
trans-unit.target: 標題之後、標題列左側的內容（選單、導覽）。

trans-unit.source: Content before the caption buttons, at the right of the bar (tool buttons, a theme switcher).
trans-unit.target: 標題列按鈕之前、標題列右側的內容（工具按鈕、主題切換）。

trans-unit.source: Shows a pin toggle before the caption buttons that keeps the window above other windows: it is checked while the window's `Topmost` is true and sets it when toggled. Off by default. It shows whatever `CaptionButtons` is, and only the window's own bar drives the window.
trans-unit.target: 在標題列按鈕之前顯示一個圖釘開關，讓視窗保持在其他視窗之上：視窗的 `Topmost` 為 true 時開關處於選取狀態，切換開關會設定它。預設關閉。無論 `CaptionButtons` 取何值都會顯示，而且只有視窗自己的標題列會控制視窗。

trans-unit.source: The title. Follows the window's `Title` unless set.
trans-unit.target: 標題。未設定時跟隨視窗的 `Title`。

trans-unit.source: Who draws minimize, maximize and close (see `CaptionButtons`).
trans-unit.target: 由誰繪製最小化、最大化和關閉按鈕（參見 `CaptionButtons`）。

trans-unit.source: The article a `TldrToggle` shows and summarizes: its title, its paragraphs (with stable ids) and the optional source, author, date and reading time of the header. Data only; give the card a new article to change it.
trans-unit.target: `TldrToggle` 顯示並摘要的文章：標題、段落（帶穩定的 id），以及頁首中選用的來源、作者、日期和閱讀時間。僅為資料；要更換文章，請給卡片一篇新文章。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Completed`: a finished result.
trans-unit.target: `Completed` 的參數：一個完成的結果。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Jumping`.
trans-unit.target: `Jumping` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: A key point: its text and the id of the paragraph it came from.
trans-unit.target: 一則重點：它的文字和它所出自段落的 id。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `LengthChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `LengthChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ModeChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `ModeChanged` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: One paragraph of a `TldrArticle`. Its `Id` is what key points link back to.
trans-unit.target: `TldrArticle` 中的一個段落。重點透過它的 `Id` 連結回來。

trans-unit.source: What a `TldrToggle` asks its summarizer for.
trans-unit.target: `TldrToggle` 向其摘要器請求的內容。

trans-unit.source: One event of a summary stream: a piece of text, or the start of a key point with its source paragraph.
trans-unit.target: 摘要串流中的一個事件：一段文字，或一則重點的開始及其出處段落。

trans-unit.source: Streams for a `TldrToggle`: the stand-in summarizer behind an article of yours with no summarizer, and pacing for a provider that returns whole results. Both send chunks of 3 to 8 words every 30 to 40ms and stop when the request's token is cancelled. Nothing is sent anywhere.
trans-unit.target: `TldrToggle` 的串流：沒有摘要器時你的文章背後的替身摘要器，以及為一次傳回完整結果的服務提供的節奏控制。兩者都每 30 到 40ms 傳送一塊 3 到 8 個字詞的內容，並在請求的權杖被取消時停止。不會向任何地方傳送內容。

trans-unit.source: An article card with a Full, Summary and Key points switch and a length slider (Arc TL;DR toggle, design reference). Switching streams an AI summary in place of the article in chunks of 3 to 8 words while the body's height follows on a bounce-free spring. Key points arrive as a checklist: each point ticks when it is written, and once the list is done its ¶ jump link switches back to the article, scrolls the source paragraph into view, focuses it and highlights it. Results are kept per mode and length, so switching back is instant; Regenerate asks again, Stop or Escape ends a stream and keeps what arrived, and a failure shows the message with Try again. Give it an `Article` with stable paragraph ids and a `Summarizer` that streams `TldrStreamEvent`s; without a summarizer the summaries are simulated from the article's lead sentences. Without an article it plays a `Simulation` (an article and its written summaries you pass, opening the summary by itself once it has been half in view for a second); with neither it shows the quiet empty state.
trans-unit.target: 一張文章卡片，具有全文、摘要和重點切換以及長度滑桿（Arc TL;DR toggle，設計參考）。切換後，AI 摘要以每塊 3 到 8 個字詞的節奏在原文位置串流出現，內文高度以無回彈的彈簧跟隨。重點以清單形式出現：每則重點寫完時打勾，整份清單完成後，它的 ¶ 跳轉連結會切回文章，把出處段落捲動到視野中、聚焦並醒目提示。結果依模式和長度保留，所以切回去是即時的；重新產生會再次請求，停止或 Escape 會結束串流並保留已收到的內容，失敗時顯示訊息和「Try again」。為它提供段落 id 穩定的 `Article`，以及以串流傳回 `TldrStreamEvent` 的 `Summarizer`；沒有摘要器時，摘要由文章的首句模擬。沒有文章時它播放 `Simulation`（你傳入的文章及其寫好的摘要，在至少一半進入視野滿一秒後自動開啟摘要）；兩者都沒有時顯示安靜的空狀態。

trans-unit.source: The article to show and summarize; null plays `Simulation`, or shows the quiet empty state without one.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示並摘要的文章；為 null 時播放 `Simulation`，沒有模擬時顯示安靜的空狀態。

trans-unit.source: Opens the summary by itself once the card has been half in view for a second, unless the reader has already touched it. Null turns it on only while a `Simulation` plays.
trans-unit.target: 卡片至少一半進入視野滿一秒後自動開啟摘要，除非讀者已經操作過卡片。為 null 時，僅在播放 `Simulation` 時開啟。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a result finishes, for analytics or a server-side cache. Stopped and failed runs do not raise it. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 一個結果完成時引發，可用於分析或伺服器端快取。被停止或失敗的執行不會引發它。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Adds "Simulated, nothing was sent" to announcements and error text. Null turns it on while a `Simulation` plays or there is no `Summarizer`; set it when you wrap `Simulate` or `Summarize` yourself.
trans-unit.target: 在播報和錯誤文字中加上 "Simulated, nothing was sent"。為 null 時，在播放 `Simulation` 或沒有 `Summarizer` 時開啟；自行包裝 `Simulate` 或 `Summarize` 時請設定它。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a key point's jump link is used, before the card scrolls to the paragraph. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 某則重點的跳轉連結被使用時引發，在卡片捲動到段落之前。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Every word the card shows or says.
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示或播報的所有文字。

trans-unit.source: The length from 1 to 5 (two-way): summaries aim for about 35, 60, 85, 100 and 130 words; key points return 3 to 7 items.
trans-unit.target: 長度，從 1 到 5（雙向）：摘要分別以約 35、60、85、100 和 130 個字詞為目標；重點傳回 3 到 7 則。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a slider drag is released or a key moves it (not on every step of a drag), so each change makes one request. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 滑桿拖曳放開或按鍵調整時引發（不會在拖曳的每一步引發），所以每次變更只發出一個請求。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: What the body shows (two-way): the article, a summary or key points.
trans-unit.target: 內文顯示的內容（雙向）：文章、摘要或重點。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the switch, a jump link or autoplay changes `Mode` (not when the app sets it). Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 切換控制項、跳轉連結或自動播放變更 `Mode` 時引發（應用程式自行設定時不引發）。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: The model credited in the footer, with its 14px mark; null credits the `Simulation`'s model while one plays, or none.
trans-unit.target: 頁尾中署名的模型，附帶 14px 標誌；為 null 時，播放 `Simulation` 期間署名為其模型，否則不署名。

trans-unit.source: An article to play while the card has no `Article`: the article, the model and the summaries and key points written for it, streamed as a simulation (nothing is sent). Your own `Article` wins over it; null stops it and shows the quiet empty state.
trans-unit.target: 卡片沒有 `Article` 時要播放的文章：文章、模型以及為它寫好的摘要和重點，以模擬方式串流輸出（不會傳送任何內容）。你自己的 `Article` 優先於它；為 null 時停止播放並顯示安靜的空狀態。

trans-unit.source: Produces summaries and key points as a stream. Null simulates them from the article's lead sentences (`Simulate`), which sends nothing. The request's token is cancelled on Stop, Escape, a mode or length change, a new article, or when the card leaves the window. A playing `Simulation` does not use it.
trans-unit.target: 以串流的形式產生摘要和重點。為 null 時根據文章的首句模擬（`Simulate`），不會傳送任何內容。在停止、Escape、切換模式或長度、換了文章，或卡片離開視窗時，請求的權杖會被取消。正在播放的 `Simulation` 不會使用它。

trans-unit.source: Every word `TldrToggle` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; counts and names go through format functions.
trans-unit.target: `TldrToggle` 顯示或播報的所有文字，預設為英文。取代整個物件即可在地化或改寫；計數和名稱透過格式化函式產生。

trans-unit.source: An article a `TldrToggle` plays without a summarizer, from data you give it: the article, the model credited, a summary written for each length and key points ranked by weight. Set it as `Simulation` while the card has no `Article`: the card shows the article, streams the written summary or points after `ThinkTime` in chunks of 3 to 8 words, says it is simulated (nothing is sent) and, unless `AutoPlay` is false, opens the summary by itself once it has been half in view for a second. A length without a written summary gets the article's lead sentences, and without `KeyPoints` each paragraph's lead sentence is a point (the same stand-in as `Simulate`; not a model).
trans-unit.target: `TldrToggle` 在沒有摘要器時依你提供的資料播放的文章：文章、署名的模型、為每個長度寫好的摘要，以及依重要性排序的重點。在卡片沒有 `Article` 時把它設為 `Simulation`：卡片顯示文章，在 `ThinkTime` 之後以每塊 3 到 8 個字詞串流輸出寫好的摘要或重點，說明這是模擬（不會傳送任何內容），並且除非 `AutoPlay` 為 false，會在至少一半進入視野滿一秒後自動開啟摘要。沒有寫好摘要的長度會使用文章的首句；沒有 `KeyPoints` 時，每段的首句就是一則重點（與 `Simulate` 相同的替身，不是模型）。

trans-unit.source: Arc toast: a brief confirmation for a completed background action (one locally controlled success message such as "Changes saved"). It rises from its edge on the morph spring while its check mark draws itself, closes after `Duration` (the timer does not pause, so keep the copy short), and can be swiped away in either direction with velocity. Text changes rise in place while the height springs to fit. For app-wide notifications (types, actions, updates, stacking) call `Show` from anywhere: it goes to the window's `ToastStack` (see `ToastHost`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 通知提示（Toast）：用於已完成背景操作的簡短確認（一則本地控制的成功訊息，如“Changes saved”）。它沿邊緣升起，依托形變彈簧運動，同時其勾號逐步繪出；經過 `Duration` 後關閉（計時器不會暫停，因此請保持文案簡短），並可依速度向任一方向滑動移除。文字變化時原位上浮，高度以彈簧方式調整至合適大小。若需應用程式層級的通知（類型、操作、更新、堆疊），請在任意位置呼叫 `Show`：它會進入視窗的 `ToastStack`（參見 `ToastHost`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the toast starts closing.
trans-unit.target: 提示開始關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: Optional second line.
trans-unit.target: 可選的第二行文字。

trans-unit.source: Time before the toast closes itself (default 4.5s); zero or less keeps it until closed.
trans-unit.target: 提示自動關閉前的時間（預設 4.5s）；為零或負值時會保持顯示，直到手動關閉。

trans-unit.source: Whether the toast is shown (default true). Closing, swiping or timing out sets it to false. Two-way.
trans-unit.target: 提示是否顯示（預設為 true）。關閉、滑動移除或逾時後會設為 false。雙向繫結。

trans-unit.source: The message. A new title rises in while the old one lifts away.
trans-unit.target: 訊息內容。新標題上浮出現，舊標題向上移出。

trans-unit.source: What to show in a new toast (`Show`).
trans-unit.target: 新提示的顯示內容（`Show`）。

trans-unit.source: Arc toast stack: short, non-blocking results of what someone just did, stacked at the edge of the window until they reach for them. New toasts rise from the bottom edge, older ones tuck 14px behind and shrink by 5% per step; hovering or focusing the stack fans it out into a list (Alt+T moves focus in). Toasts pause while the stack is open, dragged or the window is minimized, swipe right to dismiss, and morph in place when updated (`Update`): a loading toast becomes its result. Place one in the window (over the content, for example as the last child of the root panel) or let `ToastHost` create one on the window's overlay layer; then call `Show` or this control's `IToastService` methods from anywhere.
trans-unit.target: Arc 通知堆疊：對某人剛完成操作的簡短、非阻塞結果，堆疊在視窗邊緣，直到使用者主動查看。新提示從底部邊緣升起，較舊的提示向後收入 14px 並每層縮小 5%；懸停或聚焦到堆疊區時會展開為清單（Alt+T 可將焦點移入）。開啟、拖曳或視窗最小化時提示會暫停；向右滑動可關閉；透過 `Update` 更新時會原位變形（載入中的提示會變為其結果）。可將其放置在視窗中（覆蓋在內容之上，例如作為根面板的最後一個子元素），或讓 `ToastHost` 在視窗的覆蓋層上自動建立；之後在任意位置呼叫 `Show` 或此控制項的 `IToastService` 方法即可。

trans-unit.source: How many toasts are queued (shown or waiting behind).
trans-unit.target: 排隊中的提示數量（顯示中及等待中的）。

trans-unit.source: Base lifetime (default 5s). Warnings and errors stay 1.6 times longer; loading toasts wait for an update.
trans-unit.target: 基礎顯示時長（預設 5s）。警告和錯誤的時長為其 1.6 倍；載入中的提示會等待更新。

trans-unit.source: Pins the stack 16px inside its own bounds (panels and previews) instead of 24px from the window edge.
trans-unit.target: 將堆疊固定在其自身邊界內 16px 處（適用於面板和預覽），而非距視窗邊緣 24px。

trans-unit.source: True while the stack is fanned out (hover, keyboard focus or a tap).
trans-unit.target: 堆疊展開時為 true（懸停、鍵盤焦點或點按時）。

trans-unit.source: Alt+T moves keyboard focus into the stack (default true).
trans-unit.target: Alt+T 將鍵盤焦點移入堆疊（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Accessible name of the notification region (default "Notifications").
trans-unit.target: 通知區域的無障礙名稱（預設為“Notifications”）。

trans-unit.source: Oldest toasts beyond this count are dropped (default 12).
trans-unit.target: 超出此數量的最舊提示會被捨棄（預設 12）。

trans-unit.source: Edge position (default bottom right). Windows narrower than 480px always center the stack.
trans-unit.target: 邊緣位置（預設右下）。寬度小於 480px 的視窗會始終將堆疊置中。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a toast is shown, updated or dismissed.
trans-unit.target: 提示被顯示、更新或關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: How many toasts show at once (default 3); older ones wait behind and return as the front ones close.
trans-unit.target: 同時顯示的提示數量（預設 3）；較舊的提示在後方等待，前方的提示關閉後再依序出現。

trans-unit.source: A table of contents for a long article that follows the reader. The section being read is highlighted, the sections above it read as done, and a rail along the list fills down to the reader's place inside the current section, with the percentage of the article read beside the heading. Choosing a section scrolls the article to it.
trans-unit.target: 跟隨讀者的長文章目錄。正在閱讀的章節被醒目標示，上面的章節顯示為已讀，清單旁的一條軌道向下填充到讀者在目前章節中的位置，標題旁顯示文章已讀的百分比。選擇一個章節會把文章捲動到那裡。

trans-unit.source: Where the reading line sits, as a share of the viewport's height from its top (0 to 1).
trans-unit.target: 閱讀線所在的位置，以視口高度從頂部算起的比例表示（0 到 1）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the reader moves into another section.
trans-unit.target: 讀者進入另一個章節時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The section being read, or -1 before the first heading (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 正在閱讀的章節，在第一個標題之前為 -1（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: The full list, the compact button, or either one by viewport width.
trans-unit.target: 完整清單、精簡按鈕，或按視口寬度二選一。

trans-unit.source: Marks an element inside the article as a section heading; the value is the words shown in the list.
trans-unit.target: 把文章中的一個元素標記為章節標題；值是清單中顯示的文字。

trans-unit.source: True while the compact button shows instead of the list (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 顯示精簡按鈕而不是清單時為 true（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: The words the list shows and announces.
trans-unit.target: 清單顯示和播報的文字。

trans-unit.source: The depth of a heading marked with `TocProgress.Heading`: 1 (the default), 2 or 3.
trans-unit.target: 用 `TocProgress.Heading` 標記的標題的層級：1（預設）、2 或 3。

trans-unit.source: How much of the article has been scrolled through, 0 to 1 (read-only).
trans-unit.target: 文章已捲動過的比例，0 到 1（唯讀）。

trans-unit.source: The room left above a heading when the list scrolls the article to it.
trans-unit.target: 清單把文章捲動到某個標題時，在標題上方留出的空間。

trans-unit.source: Whether the percentage read shows beside the heading.
trans-unit.target: 是否在標題旁顯示已讀百分比。

trans-unit.source: The article's scroll viewer, whose position the list follows and which it scrolls when a section is chosen.
trans-unit.target: 文章的捲動檢視，清單跟隨它的位置，選擇章節時也捲動它。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `ActiveChanged`: the section now being read.
trans-unit.target: `ActiveChanged` 的參數：現在正在閱讀的章節。

trans-unit.source: One section of a `TocProgress`: the words it shows, its depth and the heading it scrolls to.
trans-unit.target: `TocProgress` 的一個章節：它顯示的文字、層級以及要捲動到的標題。

trans-unit.source: The depth: 1 for a top-level section, 2 and 3 for sub-sections (indented). Values are kept between 1 and 3.
trans-unit.target: 層級：1 是頂層章節，2 和 3 是子章節（會縮排）。值保持在 1 到 3 之間。

trans-unit.source: The heading element inside the scrolled article that starts this section.
trans-unit.target: 捲動的文章中開始這一章節的標題元素。

trans-unit.source: The words shown in the list (usually the heading's own text).
trans-unit.target: 清單中顯示的文字（通常就是標題本身的文字）。

trans-unit.source: The words a `TocProgress` shows and announces, in English by default. Replace the instance or set its properties to translate; texts with numbers in them are functions so the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `TocProgress` 顯示和播報的文字，預設為英文。替換實例或設定它的屬性即可翻譯；帶有數字的文字是函式，因此可以改變語序。

trans-unit.source: Where a reader is in an article, worked out from the scroll position and the tops of its headings.
trans-unit.target: 讀者在文章中的位置，由捲動位置和各標題的頂部算出。

trans-unit.source: Arc toggle group: a flat row of toggle buttons on the surface. In single mode one pressed fill glides from option to option on the morph spring; in multiple mode each fill fades in on its own and neighbours that are both on join into one shape. The arrow keys move focus without pressing, Home and End jump to the ends, Space and Enter toggle, and the group is one tab stop: the last focused option, else the first pressed one, else the first.
trans-unit.target: Arc 切換按鈕組：表面上一排扁平的切換按鈕。單選模式下，一個按下填色以 morph 彈簧在選項之間滑動；多選模式下，每個填色各自淡入，相鄰且都按下的選項連成一個形狀。方向鍵只移動焦點而不按下，Home 和 End 跳到兩端，Space 和 Enter 切換。整個組是一個定位停駐點：上次取得焦點的選項，否則是第一個按下的選項，否則是第一個選項。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the group, such as "Text style" or "Alignment".
trans-unit.target: 組的無障礙名稱，例如「Text style」或「Alignment」。

trans-unit.source: Whether one option or any number of options can be pressed.
trans-unit.target: 只能按下一個選項，還是可以按下任意多個選項。

trans-unit.source: The values of the pressed options, in the order they were pressed. In XAML, a comma-separated list. A value with no option yet is kept and applies when the option arrives.
trans-unit.target: 已按下選項的值，按按下的先後排序。在 XAML 中寫成逗號分隔的清單。還沒有對應選項的值會保留，等選項出現時生效。

trans-unit.source: The height of the options: Small is 28 px; Medium, the default, and Large are 36 px.
trans-unit.target: 選項的高度：Small 為 28 px；預設的 Medium 和 Large 為 36 px。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a person toggles an option, not when code sets the value.
trans-unit.target: 使用者切換選項時觸發，程式碼設定值時不觸發。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `ToggleGroup`: an optional icon and the option's content. The group creates one for each option. For a `ToggleGroupOption` the item takes its content, icon, disabled state, accessible name and tooltip from the option; for any other item the content is the group's `ItemTemplate`, and a style on `arc|ToggleGroupItem` (or the group's `ItemContainerTheme`) can bind `Icon`, `IsEnabled`, `AutomationProperties.Name` and `arc:Tooltip.Tip` to the item. A click, Space and Enter ask the group to toggle it; the shared item base would only select, which cannot press several options or turn one off. The item box never scales, so neighbours stay put; only its content gives a small press.
trans-unit.target: `ToggleGroup` 的一個選項：選用圖示和選項的內容。群組為每個選項建立一個。對於 `ToggleGroupOption`，該項目從選項讀取內容、圖示、停用狀態、無障礙名稱和工具提示；對於其他項目，內容由群組的 `ItemTemplate` 產生，並且可以用針對 `arc|ToggleGroupItem` 的樣式（或群組的 `ItemContainerTheme`）把 `Icon`、`IsEnabled`、`AutomationProperties.Name` 和 `arc:Tooltip.Tip` 繫結到項目。點擊、Space 和 Enter 會要求群組切換它；共用的項目基底類別只會選取，無法按下多個選項或把一個選項關閉。項目的方框從不縮放，因此相鄰選項保持不動；只有其內容會產生輕微的按壓效果。

trans-unit.source: A 24×24 stroke icon (for example an `ArcIcons` member) drawn before the content.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 線性圖示（例如 `ArcIcons` 的成員），繪製在內容之前。

trans-unit.source: One option of a `ToggleGroup` (Arc `ToggleGroup.Item`): an icon, content or both. Its properties can be bound in XAML; the group follows later changes.
trans-unit.target: `ToggleGroup` 的一個選項（Arc `ToggleGroup.Item`）：圖示、內容或兩者都有。它的屬性可以在 XAML 中繫結；組會跟隨之後的變化。

trans-unit.source: What the option shows, usually a short text.
trans-unit.target: 選項顯示的內容，通常是一段短文字。

trans-unit.source: A stroked 24 by 24 glyph, drawn at 16 px (14 px in the small size) before the content.
trans-unit.target: 24×24 的描邊圖形，以 16 px（小尺寸為 14 px）繪製在內容之前。

trans-unit.source: A disabled option cannot be pressed and is skipped by the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 停用的選項無法按下，方向鍵會跳過它。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name, required when the option shows only an icon. It is also the tooltip unless `Title` is set; with no icon or content it is the visible text.
trans-unit.target: 無障礙名稱，選項只顯示圖示時必須提供。除非設定了 `Title`，它也是工具提示；沒有圖示和內容時，它就是可見文字。

trans-unit.source: The tooltip, when it should differ from `Label`.
trans-unit.target: 工具提示，需要與 `Label` 不同時使用。

trans-unit.source: The value reported by the group's `SelectedValue` and `SelectedValues`.
trans-unit.target: 由組的 `SelectedValue` 和 `SelectedValues` 回報的值。

trans-unit.source: Whether the item is selected. The group sets it; change the group's selection to change it.
trans-unit.target: 該項目是否被選取。由群組設定；要變更它，請變更群組的選取。

trans-unit.source: The colors of one token kind in a `TokenTextEditor`. Null brushes use the editor's defaults.
trans-unit.target: `TokenTextEditor` 中某一種權杖的顏色。畫筆為 null 時使用編輯器的預設值。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Fill` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Fill` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Foreground` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Foreground` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Kind` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Kind` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: A multi-line text editor whose tokens (commands, mentions, variables) act as single units: arrow keys hop over a token, one Backspace or Delete next to it removes all of it, and a click inside lands on its nearest edge. Typing a trigger symbol (`Triggers`, such as `/` or `@`) opens a query that the owner turns into a list (`TriggerChanged`) and answers with `InsertToken`. The value is plain `Text` plus `Tokens` with offsets.
trans-unit.target: 多行文字編輯器，其中的權杖（命令、提及、變數）作為單一單位處理：方向鍵可跨過一個權杖，在其旁按一次 Backspace 或 Delete 即可刪除整個權杖，點擊權杖內部時游標會落在最近的邊緣。輸入觸發符（`Triggers`，例如 `/` 或 `@`）會開啟一個查詢，由擁有者將其轉為清單（`TriggerChanged`），並以 `InsertToken` 回應。值包括純文字 `Text` 以及帶位移量的 `Tokens`。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `CaretBrush` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `CaretBrush` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Raised when assistive technology collapses the owner's list (the expand / collapse pattern).
trans-unit.target: 輔助技術收合擁有者清單時引發（展開/收合模式）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ExpandSelectionToTokens` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ExpandSelectionToTokens` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `HeightMotion` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `HeightMotion` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `IsReadOnly` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `IsReadOnly` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `LineHeight` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `LineHeight` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MaxLines` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `MaxLines` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `MinLines` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `MinLines` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Placeholder` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Placeholder` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `PlaceholderForeground` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `PlaceholderForeground` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `SubmitOnEnter` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `SubmitOnEnter` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Raised when Enter (without Shift, outside an IME composition) asks to send the text.

trans-unit.source: A brand voice card (Arc Tone tuner, design reference): a customer reply with Friendly, Confident and Empathetic voice chips and two sliders, formality and detail, that rewrite it. Each change waits `Debounce` and then asks `Rewrite` for a new version; the sentences that changed crossfade in place while the rest stay still, words that are new against the original can be highlighted (the Changes switch), and Copy takes the version on screen. The status says where the text comes from: Original draft, Rewriting with the model (shimmering), Rewritten, or Couldn't rewrite with Retry. Give it the draft in `Text` and your model call in `Rewrite`; without `Rewrite` the rewrites are simulated by a few plain rules. Without a draft it plays a `Simulation` (a draft and its versions you pass, toured by itself until someone touches it); with neither, it shows an empty card whose dials are off.
trans-unit.target: 一張品牌語氣卡片（Arc Tone tuner，設計參考）：一封客戶回覆，配有 Friendly、Confident 與 Empathetic 語氣標籤以及正式程度與詳略兩個滑桿，用來改寫它。每次調整等待 `Debounce` 後向 `Rewrite` 要求新版本；改動過的句子原地交叉淡化，其餘保持不動，相對原稿新增的詞可以醒目提示（Changes 開關），複製按鈕取走螢幕上的版本。狀態說明文字的來源：Original draft、Rewriting（附模型名稱，閃爍）、Rewritten，或附重試按鈕的 Couldn't rewrite。把原稿傳給 `Text`，把模型呼叫傳給 `Rewrite`；沒有 `Rewrite` 時，改寫由幾條簡單規則模擬。沒有原稿時它播放 `Simulation`（你傳入的原稿及其各個版本，在有人操作之前自動輪流展示）；兩者都沒有時，顯示一張空卡片，其中的調節控制項處於關閉狀態。

trans-unit.source: Tours the voices while the card is on screen, until the first pointer press or focus inside it. Null (default) tours only while a `Simulation` plays. Reduced motion never tours.

trans-unit.source: A tuning session a `ToneTuner` plays without a model, from data you give it: a draft, who it is for, the model the status names and the rewritten versions per tone. Set it as `Simulation` while the card has no `Text`: the card then tunes `Text`, answers each tone with its version after `Latency`, says the rewrites are simulated (nothing is sent) and, unless `AutoPlay` is false, tours the voices by itself until someone touches it. A tone with no version in `Versions` is written by a few plain rules (contractions and greetings for formality, fewer sentences or a closing offer for detail, an opening line for the voice). That is a stand-in so the dials do something in a demo, not a language model.
trans-unit.target: `ToneTuner` 在沒有模型時依你提供的資料播放的調整過程：一份原稿、收件人、狀態中顯示的模型，以及每種語氣改寫後的版本。在卡片沒有 `Text` 時把它設為 `Simulation`：卡片會調整 `Text`，在 `Latency` 之後用對應版本回應每種語氣，說明改寫是模擬的（不會送出任何內容），並且除非 `AutoPlay` 為 false，會在有人操作之前自動輪流展示各種語氣。`Versions` 中沒有版本的語氣會用幾條簡單規則改寫（正式程度對應縮寫和問候語，詳略對應減少句子或加一句結尾提議，語氣對應一句開場白）。這只是讓調節控制項在示範中有所反應的替身，不是語言模型。

trans-unit.source: One rewritten version of a `ToneTunerSimulation`'s draft: the tone it is written in and its text.
trans-unit.target: `ToneTunerSimulation` 原稿的一個改寫版本：它所用的語氣及其文字。

trans-unit.source: One tool call of an agent transcript (Arc Tool call, design reference): the tool's mark, the call as a verb phrase, quiet meta ("4 results · 1.2s") and a status icon. The whole row is a button: it springs open into Input (the arguments as a mono key / value list) and Output (the result as a list, a table, tinted JSON or text, folding long ones behind "Show N more lines"), each with a copy button. A running call shimmers its title next to a spinner; a failed one shows its reason and Retry; one that waits for approval sits on an accent outline with Deny and Allow; a denied one is muted. Bind `Item` and change the item in place as the call moves on. Allow, Deny and Retry raise `ApproveRequested`, `DenyRequested` and `RetryRequested` (they bubble, so a `ToolCallGroup` or any parent can handle them): update the call's status yourself and set `Handled`. When nothing handles them, Deny marks the call denied here; Allow and Retry go to the `ToolCallSimulation` that appended the call, and change nothing otherwise. With no item the row is empty: a wrench and "No tool call" (`EmptyTitle`) without a status, and it does not open. On its own the row sits in a 1px bordered Surface frame (radius 16, 4px in); inside a group it is flush.
trans-unit.target: 代理轉錄中的一次工具呼叫（Arc Tool call，設計參考）：工具的標記、以動詞片語表示的呼叫、低調的中繼資訊（"4 results · 1.2s"）以及狀態圖示。整列是一個按鈕：點選後以彈性動效展開為輸入（引數，等寬的鍵／值列表）和輸出（結果，以列表、表格、著色的 JSON 或文字呈現，過長內容摺疊在"Show N more lines"之後），兩者都附複製按鈕。執行中的呼叫會在旋轉指示器旁讓標題閃爍；失敗的呼叫會顯示原因與重試；等待核准的呼叫帶強調色輪廓，並顯示拒絕與允許；被拒絕的呼叫會變為淡化顯示。繫結 `Item`，呼叫推進時就地修改該項。允許、拒絕與重試會引發 `ApproveRequested`、`DenyRequested` 與 `RetryRequested`（它們會冒泡，因此 `ToolCallGroup` 或任何父層都可以處理）：由你自行更新呼叫的狀態並設定 `Handled`。若無人處理，拒絕會在此處將呼叫標記為已拒絕；允許與重試會交給加入該呼叫的 `ToolCallSimulation`，其他情況下不做任何改變。沒有項目時，該列為空：一個扳手與 "No tool call"（`EmptyTitle`），沒有狀態，也無法展開。單獨使用時，該列位於 1px 帶邊框的 Surface 外框中（圓角 16，內縮 4px）；在群組中則與邊緣齊平。

trans-unit.source: Every tool call of one assistant turn in one quiet card (Arc Tool call group, design reference): a header with the tools' overlapping marks, "Used 4 tools" (or "Using 3 tools" with a shimmer while the agent works, or "Waiting for approval") and, on the right, "1 failed" or the total duration; below it, one `ToolCall` row per call. Append calls to `Items` (or an observable `ItemsSource`) as the agent starts them and change them in place: a new row grows in from zero height, a new tool's mark joins the stack on a spring. Opening the header staggers the rows in. While the agent works the group stays open; 450ms after every call finished it folds itself away (`AutoCollapse`) unless the person opened or closed the group or a row. A call that needs a decision (a failure, an approval) opens a folded group. An empty group takes no space; its first call grows it in. With neither `Items` nor `ItemsSource` it plays its `Simulation` when one is set, and otherwise stays empty. Allow, Deny and Retry bubble up from the rows as `ApproveRequested`, `DenyRequested` and `RetryRequested`; see `ToolCall` for what happens when nothing handles them.
trans-unit.target: 將一個助理回合的所有工具呼叫放在一張安靜的卡片中（Arc 工具呼叫群組，設計參考）：標題列包含工具的重疊標記，"Used 4 tools"（代理工作時為帶閃爍效果的 "Using 3 tools"，或 "Waiting for approval"），右側為 "1 failed" 或總時長；下方每個呼叫對應一列 `ToolCall`。代理開始呼叫時將其追加到 `Items`（或可觀察的 `ItemsSource`），並原地修改它們：新列從零高度展開，新工具的標記以彈簧動畫加入標記堆疊。展開標題列時各列依序錯開進入。代理工作期間該群組保持展開；每次呼叫完成後 450ms，若使用者未展開或收合該群組或任一列，它會自動摺疊（`AutoCollapse`）。需要決定的呼叫（失敗、需要核准）會展開已摺疊的群組。空群組不佔用空間；其第一個呼叫會使其展開。若既未設定 `Items` 也未設定 `ItemsSource`，則在設定了 `Simulation` 時播放它，否則保持為空。列中的允許、拒絕和重試會以 `ApproveRequested`、`DenyRequested` 和 `RetryRequested` 冒泡上傳；未被處理時的行為見 `ToolCall`。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row's Allow is pressed (it bubbles from the row).
trans-unit.target: 按下某列的允許時引發（從該列冒泡）。

trans-unit.source: Folds the list `AutoCollapseDelay` after every call finished, so the answer reads right under "Used 4 tools"; skipped once the person opened or closed the group or any row.
trans-unit.target: 每次呼叫完成後等待 `AutoCollapseDelay`，然後摺疊列表，使答案緊接在 "Used 4 tools" 下方顯示；若使用者已展開或收合該群組或任一列，則略過。
