trans-unit.target: 代理在本回合中是否仍在工作，使標題在呼叫之間保持"Using"的狀態；null（預設）表示"任一呼叫執行期間"。

trans-unit.source: Whether the list is open (two-way). Until it is set, the group opens while any call runs, waits or failed, and a finished transcript starts folded.
trans-unit.target: 列表是否展開（雙向繫結）。在設定之前，只要有任一呼叫在執行、等待或失敗，該群組就會展開；已完成的紀錄預設摺疊。

trans-unit.source: An observable list of calls that wins over `Items` and `Simulation`.
trans-unit.target: 可觀察的呼叫列表，優先於 `Items` 與 `Simulation`。

trans-unit.source: Every word the group and its rows show or say.
trans-unit.target: 群組及其各列展示或說出的每一個文字。

trans-unit.source: A custom result view for every successful call (see `OutputTemplate`).
trans-unit.target: 每個成功呼叫的自訂結果檢視（參見 `OutputTemplate`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row's Retry is pressed (it bubbles from the row).
trans-unit.target: 按下某列的重試時引發（從該列冒泡）。

trans-unit.source: A simulated turn to play while the group has no calls of its own (no `ItemsSource` and no `Items`): the group shows its `Items`, says "Using" while it `IsWorking` (unless `IsActive` is set), starts it from the top when it comes on screen and stops it when it leaves or is replaced. Null (the default) leaves a group without calls empty. Give each group its own.
trans-unit.target: 在群組沒有自己的呼叫時（既無 `ItemsSource` 也無 `Items`）播放的模擬回合：群組顯示其 `Items`，在它 `IsWorking` 時顯示 "Using"（除非設定了 `IsActive`），出現在畫面上時從頭開始執行，離開或被取代時停止。為 null（預設）時，沒有呼叫的群組保持為空。每個群組各用一個。

trans-unit.source: The sum of the successful calls' durations (shown once nothing runs or waits).
trans-unit.target: 成功呼叫耗時的總和（在沒有任何呼叫執行或等待後顯示）。

trans-unit.source: One tool call of an agent turn: which tool ran, what it did in plain words, how it went, its arguments and what came back. Change `Status` (and the other properties) in place as the call moves on: a row keeps its place and its open state, and every change reaches the screen. Keep `Id` stable.
trans-unit.target: 代理回合中的一個工具呼叫：執行了哪個工具、用平實的語言說明其作用、結果如何、它的參數以及回傳了什麼。隨呼叫推進原地修改 `Status`（及其他屬性）：列會保持其位置和展開狀態，每次修改都會反映到螢幕上。保持 `Id` 穩定。

trans-unit.source: The phrase while waiting for approval, as a request ("Post a status note to #finance-ops"); null uses `Title`.
trans-unit.target: 等待核准時顯示的片語，寫成請求的形式（"Post a status note to #finance-ops"）；為 null 時使用 `Title`。

trans-unit.source: How long the call took, shown as "760ms" or "1.2s"; a group adds up the successful ones.
trans-unit.target: 呼叫耗時，顯示為 "760ms" 或 "1.2s"；群組會將成功呼叫的耗時相加。

trans-unit.source: The phrase after a failure ("Could not read the export job log"); null uses `Title`.
trans-unit.target: 失敗後顯示的片語（"Could not read the export job log"）；為 null 時使用 `Title`。

trans-unit.source: A stable id. A group keys its rows by it, so a call whose status changes keeps its row.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id。群組按此 id 為各列建立索引，因此狀態變化的呼叫會保留其列。

trans-unit.source: One line under the title while the call failed (the reason) or waits for approval (what allowing will do). Not shown in the other statuses.
trans-unit.target: 呼叫失敗（原因）或等待核准（允許後將發生什麼）時，標題下方的一行文字。其他狀態下不顯示。

trans-unit.source: What came back: a list, a table, JSON or text. Shown under Output once the call succeeded.
trans-unit.target: 回傳的內容：列表、表格、JSON 或文字。呼叫成功後顯示在"Output"下方。

trans-unit.source: The phrase while running, in the present tense ("Searching tickets in finance/close"); null uses `Title`.
trans-unit.target: 執行期間顯示的現在式片語（"Searching tickets in finance/close"）；為 null 時使用 `Title`。

trans-unit.source: Where the call stands. Change it in place as the call runs, fails, waits or finishes.
trans-unit.target: 呼叫目前所處的狀態。隨呼叫執行、失敗、等待或完成而原地修改。

trans-unit.source: Quiet meta before the duration, such as "4 results". Null derives it from `Output` (results, rows, fields, items).
trans-unit.target: 耗時之前的次要中繼資訊，例如 "4 results"。為 null 時從 `Output` 推導（結果、列、欄位、項目）。

trans-unit.source: The settled verb phrase in the past tense, such as "Searched tickets in finance/close". One line; it truncates.
trans-unit.target: 已完成的過去式動詞片語，例如 "Searched tickets in finance/close"。一行；超出時截斷。

trans-unit.source: The tool's mark: a 24 × 24 stroked glyph such as a Lucide icon, drawn at 16px in the row and 12px in a group's mark stack. Null draws a wrench.
trans-unit.target: 工具的標記：一個 24 × 24 的描邊圖示（例如 Lucide 圖示），在列中以 16px 繪製，在群組的標記堆疊中以 12px 繪製。為 null 時繪製扳手。

trans-unit.source: The mark's color; null uses the text color, which follows the theme.
trans-unit.target: 標記的顏色；為 null 時使用隨主題變化的文字顏色。

trans-unit.source: The tool's name, read before the title by screen readers ("Search: Searched the web …").
trans-unit.target: 工具的名稱，螢幕閱讀器會在標題之前讀出（"Search: Searched the web …"）。

trans-unit.source: A JSON result (an API response): indented two spaces, tinted (keys, strings, numbers, literals and punctuation in their own colors), 20px lines, folding after ten lines behind "Show N more lines". Wide lines scroll inside the well. Built on `Nodes`, so no reflection is involved.
trans-unit.target: JSON 結果（API 回應）：以兩個空格縮排，帶顏色標示（鍵、字串、數字、常值和標點各有其顏色），每行 20px，超過十行後摺疊，並顯示"Show N more lines"。過寬的行在結果區域內捲動。基於 `Nodes` 建構，不涉及反射。

trans-unit.source: Every word `ToolCall` and `ToolCallGroup` show or say, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; sentences with numbers or names are format functions.
trans-unit.target: `ToolCall` 和 `ToolCallGroup` 展示或說出的每一個文字，預設為英文。若要在地化或改寫，請替換整個物件；包含數字或名稱的句子使用格式化函式。

trans-unit.source: One entry of a `ToolCallListOutput`: a short mono lead (an id such as "#482"), a title and a tag.
trans-unit.target: `ToolCallListOutput` 的一個項目：簡短的等寬前導（如 "#482" 之類的 id）、標題和標籤。

trans-unit.source: A list result (search hits, tickets): a lead, a title and a tag per row, 32px rows, folding after five.
trans-unit.target: 列表結果（搜尋命中、工單）：每列一個前導、標題和標籤，列高 32px，超過五列後摺疊。

trans-unit.source: What a tool call returned, shown under Output once the call succeeded: a `ToolCallListOutput`, a `ToolCallTableOutput`, a `ToolCallJsonOutput` or a `ToolCallTextOutput`. Assign a new output to change what a row shows; an output is read when the row opens.
trans-unit.target: 工具呼叫的回傳內容，在呼叫成功後顯示在"Output"下方：`ToolCallListOutput`、`ToolCallTableOutput`、`ToolCallJsonOutput` 或 `ToolCallTextOutput` 之一。指定新的輸出即可更改該列顯示的內容；列在開啟時才讀取輸出。

trans-unit.source: Plays a scripted agent turn into `Items` on a clock: calls are appended one after another, run for their time and settle; a failing call waits for `Retry` and a call that needs approval waits for `Approve` or `Deny`. Your app writes the `Script`; nothing ships with the package. Give it to `Simulation` (the group shows `Items`, follows `IsWorking`, starts the run when it is on screen and stops it when it leaves), or bind a group's `ItemsSource` to `Items` and its `IsActive` to `IsWorking` yourself. Allow, Deny and Retry on the rows reach the simulation when nothing else handles them. Time comes from a `TimeProvider`, so tests can step it; callbacks run on the UI thread. Create one per group: it keeps the playback state.
trans-unit.target: 按時間順序將腳本化的代理回合播放到 `Items` 中：呼叫依序追加，執行其耗時後結束；失敗的呼叫等待 `Retry`，需要核准的呼叫等待 `Approve` 或 `Deny`。`Script` 由你的應用程式撰寫，套件不附帶任何腳本。把它交給 `Simulation`（群組顯示 `Items`、跟隨 `IsWorking`，出現在畫面上時啟動執行，離開時停止），或自行將群組的 `ItemsSource` 繫結到 `Items`、將其 `IsActive` 繫結到 `IsWorking`。各列上的允許、拒絕和重試，若無其他處理方，會傳遞給模擬。時間來自 `TimeProvider`，因此測試可以逐步推進；回呼在 UI 執行緒上執行。每個群組各建一個：它保存播放狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the UI thread at every beat of the run (a call appended, settled, failed, retried, allowed, denied; the start and the end).
trans-unit.target: 在執行的每個節拍時於 UI 執行緒上引發（呼叫被追加、完成、失敗、重試、允許、拒絕；以及開始和結束）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the agent is working (appending or running calls): bind a group's `IsActive` to it, so its header keeps saying "Using" between calls.
trans-unit.target: 代理是否正在工作（追加或執行呼叫）：將群組的 `IsActive` 繫結到它，使其標題在呼叫之間保持"Using"的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Where the run stands.
trans-unit.target: 執行所處的狀態。

trans-unit.source: Data of `Changed`.
trans-unit.target: `Changed` 的資料。

trans-unit.source: One scripted call of a `ToolCallSimulation`.
trans-unit.target: `ToolCallSimulation` 的一個腳本化呼叫。

trans-unit.source: A table result (database rows): column headers and mono cells, 30px rows, folding after five rows. A null cell reads "null". A wide table scrolls inside its well.
trans-unit.target: 表格結果（資料庫列）：欄位標題和等寬儲存格，列高 30px，超過五列後摺疊。空儲存格顯示為 "null"。過寬的表格在其結果區域內捲動。

trans-unit.source: A text result (a sent message, a short log): one paragraph that keeps its line breaks.
trans-unit.target: 文字結果（已傳送的訊息、簡短日誌）：一個保留換行的段落。

trans-unit.source: A floating toolbar for an editor's frequently swapped tools and modes, such as select, pan and draw on a canvas. The tool in use sits on a soft accent tint that moves when the choice changes; a small label above the dock names the slot under the mouse or keyboard focus and follows it along; and variants of one tool can share a slot that opens a tray of them above the dock. The whole dock is drawn with a single thin outline. With `CanReorder`, people can rearrange the slots by dragging or with Alt and the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 一條浮動工具列，放著編輯器裡經常切換的工具與模式，例如畫布上的選取、平移與繪製。正在使用的工具襯著一塊柔和的強調色底，選擇改變時這塊底隨之移動；工具列上方的小標籤寫出滑鼠或鍵盤焦點所在槽位的名稱，並一路跟隨；同一工具的幾個變體可以共用一個槽位，在工具列上方開啟裝著它們的托盤。整條工具列只用一條細描邊勾勒。開啟 `CanReorder` 後，使用者可以拖曳槽位或用 Alt 加方向鍵重新排列它們。

trans-unit.source: Whether people may reorder the slots by dragging them sideways or with Alt and the left and right arrow keys. A changeable source (the inline items, or an `ItemsSource` that is an `IList`) is reordered in place and `Reordered` reports each move.
trans-unit.target: 是否允許使用者橫向拖曳槽位，或用 Alt 加左、右方向鍵重新排列槽位。可修改的來源（行內的項目，或是 `IList` 的 `ItemsSource`）會被就地重新排序，`Reordered` 回報每一次移動。

trans-unit.source: Raised when someone chooses an entry or a group member (by pointer, keyboard or assistive technology).
trans-unit.target: 使用者選取一個項目或群組成員時引發（透過指標、鍵盤或輔助技術）。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the dock (a toolbar), "Tools" by default.
trans-unit.target: 工具列（一個 toolbar）的無障礙名稱，預設為 "Tools"。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a slot moved: once for every neighbour it passes while dragged, and on Alt + an arrow key.
trans-unit.target: 槽位移動後引發：拖曳時每越過一個鄰居引發一次，按 Alt 加方向鍵時也會引發。

trans-unit.source: The `Value` of the chosen entry or group member; null chooses nothing.
trans-unit.target: 選取的項目或群組成員的 `Value`；為 null 時不選取任何項目。

trans-unit.source: One entry of a `ToolDock`: a tool or mode with a glyph, a name, an optional key hint and an optional badge. With members in `Items` the entry is a group: its slot shows the member it holds (the selected one, else the one chosen last, else the first) and choosing it opens a tray of the members above the dock.
trans-unit.target: `ToolDock` 的一個項目：一個帶有圖示、名稱、可選快速鍵提示與可選徽章的工具或模式。`Items` 中有成員時這個項目就是群組：它的槽位顯示它持有的成員（選取的成員，否則是上次選的，否則是第一個），選取它會在工具列上方開啟裝著成員的托盤。

trans-unit.source: A count shown on the slot's corner; its digits roll when it changes and it leaves at 0.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在槽位角落的計數；變化時數字捲動，歸零時退場。

trans-unit.source: A 24 × 24 stroked glyph. A group's slot shows the glyph of the member it holds.
trans-unit.target: 24 × 24 的描邊圖示。群組的槽位顯示它持有的成員的圖示。

trans-unit.source: Whether this entry holds the dock's value (for a group: whether one of its members does).
trans-unit.target: 這個項目是否持有工具列的值（對群組而言：是否有某個成員持有）。

trans-unit.source: Whether this group's tray is open.
trans-unit.target: 這個群組的托盤是否開啟。

trans-unit.source: The name shown in the floating label and read by assistive technology.
trans-unit.target: 浮動標籤中顯示、輔助技術朗讀的名稱。

trans-unit.source: A key hint such as "V", shown in the floating label and added to the accessible name. Display only: the page handles the key.
trans-unit.target: 快速鍵提示，例如 "V"，顯示在浮動標籤中並加入無障礙名稱。僅供顯示：按鍵由頁面處理。

trans-unit.source: For a group, the member its slot shows: the selected member, else the one chosen last, else the first.
trans-unit.target: 對群組而言，槽位顯示的成員：選取的成員，否則是上次選的，否則是第一個。

trans-unit.source: What the dock reports when this entry or member is chosen (`SelectedValue`).
trans-unit.target: 選取這個項目或成員時工具列回報的值（`SelectedValue`）。

trans-unit.source: A short label on hover or keyboard focus. Attach it to any control with `arc:Tooltip.Tip="Copy link"` (and optionally `arc:Tooltip.Side`). The first tooltip waits 250ms and rises 3px from its trigger; while any tooltip is open, and for 300ms after the last one closes, the next opens at once with a fade only. String content that changes while open crossfades and the bubble springs to the new size. The `Tooltip` instance itself is the bubble shown in the popup.
trans-unit.target: 懸停或鍵盤聚焦時顯示的簡短標籤。使用 `arc:Tooltip.Tip="Copy link"`（可選 `arc:Tooltip.Side`）即可將其附加到任意控制項。第一個提示會等待 250ms，並從其觸發點上浮 3px；當任一提示開啟時，以及最後一個提示關閉後的 300ms 內，下一個提示會立即開啟，僅做淡入淡出。開啟期間變化的字串內容會交叉淡入，氣泡以彈簧方式調整到新尺寸。`Tooltip` 實例本身即為彈出層中顯示的氣泡。

trans-unit.source: Shows or hides the tooltip on the element at once, without ShowDelay.
trans-unit.target: 立即顯示或隱藏該元素上的提示，不經過 ShowDelay。

trans-unit.source: Wait before the first tooltip opens after hover or focus; default 250 ms. Open tooltips skip the wait.
trans-unit.target: 指標懸停或取得焦點後，第一個提示開啟前的等待時間；預設 250 ms。已開啟的提示會跳過等待。

trans-unit.source: Shows the tooltip while the target is disabled, for example to say why a button cannot be used. A disabled control gets no pointer input, so the tooltip follows the pointer over its bounds instead. Default false. Put the reason in `AutomationProperties.HelpText` as well: a keyboard cannot focus a disabled control.
trans-unit.target: 在目標控制項停用時也顯示工具提示，例如說明按鈕為何不能使用。停用的控制項收不到指標輸入，因此工具提示改為追蹤指標是否位於其範圍內。預設為 false。也請把原因寫進 `AutomationProperties.HelpText`：鍵盤無法聚焦停用的控制項。

trans-unit.source: Side of the trigger the bubble opens on: Top (default), Bottom, Left or Right.
trans-unit.target: 氣泡相對於觸發元素開啟的一側：Top（預設）、Bottom、Left 或 Right。

trans-unit.source: Tooltip content: a string, or any object (bind it when the text comes from the view model).
trans-unit.target: 提示內容：字串或任意物件（當文字來自檢視模型時進行繫結）。

trans-unit.source: A fine-tuning job card (Arc Training run, design reference): the base model with its mark and the job's name, a live train and validation loss curve drawn across a fixed step axis that doubles as the epoch progress bar, the step, learning rate, elapsed time and ETA, the newest three events (evals, checkpoints, warnings), Pause and Cancel while it runs, and the results with a Deploy button once it completes. Drive it from your job: set `Status`, `TotalSteps` and `Epochs` from the job config so the axis is right from the first sample, then keep `Step`, `LearningRate`, `Elapsed` and `Eta` current and append to `Loss` and `Events` as they stream (no need to throttle: the card eases toward each sample), or hand it updates with `Apply` or `FollowAsync`. The buttons raise events; Deploy calls `DeployHandler`. With no `Status` it plays its `Simulation`, a job you describe, as `Scenario` says, freezing while the card is off screen; with neither it shows a queued job with no data yet.
trans-unit.target: 微調任務卡片（Arc Training run，設計參考）：附標誌的基礎模型和任務名稱、沿著固定步數軸即時繪製的訓練與驗證損失曲線（這條軸同時也是訓練週期進度列）、步數、學習率、已用時間和預估剩餘時間、最新的三則事件（評測、檢查點、警告）、執行時的暫停和取消，以及完成後附 Deploy 按鈕的結果。由你的任務驅動它：依任務設定設置 `Status`、`TotalSteps` 和 `Epochs`，讓座標軸從第一個樣本起就正確；接著持續更新 `Step`、`LearningRate`、`Elapsed` 和 `Eta`，並在資料串流進來時附加到 `Loss` 和 `Events`（不需要節流：卡片會緩動到每個樣本），或以 `Apply` 或 `FollowAsync` 傳入更新。按鈕會引發事件；Deploy 呼叫 `DeployHandler`。沒有 `Status` 時，它會依 `Scenario` 播放它的 `Simulation`（由你描述的任務），卡片離開畫面時暫停；兩者都沒有時，顯示一個排隊中、尚無資料的任務。

trans-unit.source: Which action buttons may show (all by default; None for a read-only monitor). A button also needs the right status.
trans-unit.target: 哪些操作按鈕可以顯示（預設全部；唯讀監控設為 None）。按鈕還需要對應的狀態。

trans-unit.source: A line over the empty chart while queued or starting, such as "Waiting for 8× H200 · 2nd in queue".
trans-unit.target: 排隊或啟動時顯示在空白圖表上的一行文字，例如 "Waiting for 8× H200 · 2nd in queue"。

trans-unit.source: The base model and its 24px mark (a monogram when the model has no mark); null shows the simulation's while it plays.
trans-unit.target: 基礎模型及其 24px 標誌（模型沒有標誌時顯示首字母）；為 null 時，播放模擬期間顯示模擬中的模型。

trans-unit.source: Raised on the second press, on Confirm cancel, within 3 seconds of the first. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 在第一次按下後 3 秒內第二次按下（即 Confirm cancel）時引發。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: The training data, shown in the footer with its 14px mark and size.
trans-unit.target: 訓練資料，顯示在頁尾，附 14px 標誌和規模。

trans-unit.source: Deploys the completed model: called when Deploy is pressed, with a token that is cancelled when the card unloads or the run leaves Completed. Return the endpoint (or null). The button loads while it runs; a thrown exception shows its message and Retry deploy. Deploy shows only when this is set (or while simulating).
trans-unit.target: 部署已完成的模型：按下 Deploy 時呼叫，傳入的權杖會在卡片卸載或執行離開 Completed 時取消。傳回端點（或 null）。執行期間按鈕顯示載入狀態；擲回的例外會顯示其訊息和 Retry deploy。只有設定了它（或處於模擬時）才顯示 Deploy。

trans-unit.source: Short facts after the model name, such as "LoRA r16" and "8× H200".

trans-unit.source: A transfer list (shuttle box): two lists side by side and the actions that move items between them. Moving edits the bound `SourceItems` and `TargetItems` collections themselves (the same object references leave one and join the other), so a view model reads the result directly. Each list selects like a list box (click, Ctrl and Shift, Ctrl+A), has a select-all box and an optional search filter; Enter or a double click moves the selection, and the move commands are public for buttons of your own.

trans-unit.source: A select field over a tree: pick one node, or check several with three-state checkboxes, in a dropdown that shows the hierarchy as an indented, virtualized tree (only the visible rows are built, so thousands of nodes stay fast). Typing in the field filters the tree, keeps every ancestor of a match, opens down to it and marks the matched text. The field, menu surface and clear button follow `Cascader`; the chips of the multiple mode follow `MultiSelect`; the rows follow `TreeView`; the checkboxes draw like `Checkbox`. Nodes are any objects: `ChildrenSelector` gives the children, `TextSelector` the label and `ValueSelector` the value, which must be unique across the tree. Everything goes through delegates, so nothing is reflected. Checking a parent checks its enabled descendants; a parent whose children are partly checked shows a dash. Disabled nodes keep their state when a parent changes. `CheckStrategy` decides which checked nodes `SelectedItems` and `SelectedValues` report. Keyboard: Enter, Space and Down open; typing searches; Up and Down move the highlight, Right opens a parent or enters it, Left closes it or goes to the parent, Home and End jump; Enter picks (single) or toggles the check (multiple), Space toggles the check while the search is empty; Escape clears the search, then closes; Backspace in an empty search removes the last chip.
trans-unit.target: 樹上的選擇欄位：在下拉選單中選擇一個節點，或用三態核取方塊勾選多個節點；選單以縮排、虛擬化的樹顯示層級（只建立可見的列，數千個節點也流暢）。在欄位中輸入會篩選樹，保留每個符合項目的所有祖先、展開到符合處並標示符合的文字。欄位、選單表面和清除按鈕與 `Cascader` 一致；多選模式的標籤與 `MultiSelect` 一致；列與 `TreeView` 一致；核取方塊的繪製與 `Checkbox` 一致。節點可以是任意物件：`ChildrenSelector` 提供子節點，`TextSelector` 提供標籤，`ValueSelector` 提供值，值在整棵樹中必須唯一。一切都透過委派完成，不使用反射。勾選父節點會勾選其可用的子孫；子節點部分勾選的父節點顯示短橫線。父節點變化時停用節點保持原狀態。`CheckStrategy` 決定 `SelectedItems` 與 `SelectedValues` 回報哪些已勾選的節點。鍵盤：Enter、Space 與 Down 開啟；輸入字元即搜尋；Up 與 Down 移動醒目提示，Right 展開父節點或進入其中，Left 收合或回到父節點，Home 與 End 跳到兩端；Enter 選取（單選）或切換勾選（多選），搜尋為空時 Space 切換勾選；Escape 先清除搜尋再關閉；搜尋為空時 Backspace 刪除最後一個標籤。

trans-unit.source: Which checked nodes a multi-select field reports: leaves only, fully checked parents in place of their subtree, or all.
trans-unit.target: 多選欄位回報哪些已勾選的節點：只回報葉節點、以全選的父節點代替其子樹，或全部回報。

trans-unit.source: Children of a node; same shape as the one of `Cascader` and `TreeView`. Null or empty means a leaf.
trans-unit.target: 節點的子節點；簽章與 `Cascader`、`TreeView` 的相同。為 null 或空表示葉節點。

trans-unit.source: Muted hint under the trigger; also the accessible help text.
trans-unit.target: 觸發器下方的淡化提示；也是協助工具說明文字。

trans-unit.source: Returns true for nodes that are shown dimmed and cannot be picked or checked; a disabled parent still opens.

trans-unit.source: Levels open when the data arrives: 0 keeps every parent closed, 1 opens the roots, -1 opens everything.

trans-unit.source: Returns true when a node matches the search text; when null, a node matches when its label contains the text, ignoring case.

trans-unit.source: Raised when `SelectedItems` changes: by the user, by a binding or by clearing.

trans-unit.source: Pick one node (`Single`) or check several (`Multiple`).
trans-unit.target: 選擇一個節點（`Single`）或勾選多個節點（`Multiple`）。

trans-unit.source: In single mode, show the whole path in the field (true) or only the selected node (false).
trans-unit.target: 單選模式下，在欄位中顯示完整路徑（true）或只顯示選取的節點（false）。

trans-unit.source: Label of a node; when null, `ToString()`. Searching matches this text.
trans-unit.target: 節點的標籤；為 null 時使用 `ToString()`。搜尋比對的就是這段文字。

trans-unit.source: Value of a node; it must be unique across the tree. When null, the node itself is the value.
trans-unit.target: 節點的值；在整棵樹中必須唯一。為 null 時節點本身就是值。

trans-unit.source: Which checked nodes a `TreeSelect` in `Multiple` reports.
trans-unit.target: `Multiple` 模式的 `TreeSelect` 回報哪些已勾選的節點。

trans-unit.source: Whether a `TreeSelect` picks one node or checks several.
trans-unit.target: `TreeSelect` 是選擇一個節點還是勾選多個節點。

trans-unit.source: Data of `SelectionChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `SelectionChanged` 的資料。

trans-unit.source: A table whose rows nest. Rows expand and collapse on a spring with indent guides, parents carry tri-state checkboxes (`IsSelectable`), sorting reorders siblings without breaking the hierarchy, and children can load on first expand (`ChildrenLoader`). The first column shown holds the tree. Keyboard follows the treegrid pattern: ↑/↓ move, → opens or enters, ← closes or goes to the parent, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown move ten rows, `*` opens all siblings, Space selects, Enter toggles a parent or activates a leaf, Ctrl/Cmd+A selects all. Rows come from `ItemsSource` and `ChildrenSelector`; each row is identified by `KeySelector` (the item itself when not set), which is what `ExpandedKeys` and `SelectedKeys` hold. Like Arc, rows are not virtualized: every visible row exists and animates, so keep an expanded tree to a few hundred rows and load deeper levels on demand.
trans-unit.target: 列可以巢狀的表格。列在彈簧上展開和收合並帶有縮排參考線，父列帶有三態核取方塊（`IsSelectable`），排序會重排同層列而不破壞階層，子列可以在第一次展開時載入（`ChildrenLoader`）。顯示出來的第一欄承載樹。鍵盤遵循樹狀格線模式：↑/↓ 移動，→ 展開或進入，← 收合或轉到父層，Home/End，PageUp/PageDown 移動十列，`*` 展開所有同層列，Space 選取，Enter 切換父列或啟動葉節點，Ctrl/Cmd+A 全選。列來自 `ItemsSource` 和 `ChildrenSelector`；每一列由 `KeySelector` 識別（未設定時為列項目本身），`ExpandedKeys` 和 `SelectedKeys` 儲存的就是這些索引鍵。與 Arc 一樣，列不做虛擬化：每個可見列都存在並帶有動畫，因此展開的樹請保持在幾百列以內，更深的層級按需載入。

trans-unit.source: The accessible name of the table (Arc `label`).
trans-unit.target: 表格的無障礙名稱（Arc 的 `label`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when `ChildrenLoader` faults; the row shows a retry line.
trans-unit.target: 當 `ChildrenLoader` 發生錯誤時觸發；該列顯示重試列。

trans-unit.source: Loads the children of a row with `HasChildrenSelector` the first time it expands (Arc `loadChildren`). A faulted task shows a retry row.
trans-unit.target: 當帶有 `HasChildrenSelector` 的列第一次展開時，載入它的子列（Arc 的 `loadChildren`）。發生錯誤的工作會顯示重試列。

trans-unit.source: Children of a row item (Arc `children`). Return null when the children are not loaded; an empty list means a leaf.
trans-unit.target: 列項目的子列（Arc 的 `children`）。子列尚未載入時傳回 null；空清單表示葉節點。

trans-unit.source: Shown when there are no rows (Arc `emptyState`).
trans-unit.target: 沒有列時顯示的文字（Arc 的 `emptyState`）。

trans-unit.source: The keys of the expanded rows (two-way; Arc `expanded` / `defaultExpanded`).
trans-unit.target: 已展開列的索引鍵（雙向；對應 Arc 的 `expanded` / `defaultExpanded`）。

trans-unit.source: Marks a row whose children are not loaded yet (Arc `hasChildren`); needs `ChildrenLoader`.
trans-unit.target: 標記子列尚未載入的列（Arc 的 `hasChildren`）；需要 `ChildrenLoader`。

trans-unit.source: Adds a checkbox column. Checking a parent checks everything under it (Arc `selectable`).
trans-unit.target: 加入一個核取方塊欄。勾選父列會勾選其下的所有內容（Arc 的 `selectable`）。

trans-unit.source: The top-level rows.
trans-unit.target: 頂層列。

trans-unit.source: Identifies a row; the keys of `ExpandedKeys` and `SelectedKeys` (Arc `id`). The item itself when not set.
trans-unit.target: 識別一列；即 `ExpandedKeys` 和 `SelectedKeys` 中的索引鍵（Arc 的 `id`）。未設定時使用列項目本身。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a row without children is clicked or gets Enter (Arc `onRowActivate`). Parent rows toggle instead.
trans-unit.target: 點選沒有子列的列或在其上按 Enter 時觸發（Arc 的 `onRowActivate`）。父列則會切換展開狀態。

trans-unit.source: Raised when rows expand or collapse (Arc `onExpandedChange`).
trans-unit.target: 列展開或收合時觸發（Arc 的 `onExpandedChange`）。

trans-unit.source: Names a row for its checkbox and for assistive technology (Arc `rowLabel`), such as the file or team name.
trans-unit.target: 為一列命名，用於它的核取方塊和輔助技術（Arc 的 `rowLabel`），例如檔案名稱或團隊名稱。

trans-unit.source: The keys of the selected rows (two-way; Arc `selected` / `defaultSelected`). Parents are added or removed to match their children.
trans-unit.target: 已選取列的索引鍵（雙向；對應 Arc 的 `selected` / `defaultSelected`）。會依子列的狀態加入或移除父列。

trans-unit.source: Raised with the new selection (Arc `onSelectedChange`).
trans-unit.target: 以新的選取狀態觸發（Arc 的 `onSelectedChange`）。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a header cycles the sort (Arc `onSortChange`).
trans-unit.target: 當某個表頭循環切換排序時觸發（Arc 的 `onSortChange`）。

trans-unit.source: The sort direction (two-way; Arc `sort.direction`). A header cycles ascending, descending, none.
trans-unit.target: 排序方向（雙向；對應 Arc 的 `sort.direction`）。表頭依序循環：遞增、遞減、關閉。

trans-unit.source: The key of the column rows are sorted by, or null (two-way; Arc `sort.columnId`).
trans-unit.target: 列排序所依據的欄位的索引鍵，或 null（雙向；對應 Arc 的 `sort.columnId`）。

trans-unit.source: One column of a `TreeTable`. The cell value comes from `ValueSelector` or `Binding` (compiled against the row item in XAML); `CellTemplate` hosts custom content. The first column shown holds the tree: its chevron, indent and guides sit before the cell content. A column is sortable when it has a value (`SortValueSelector` or `ValueSelector`) and `IsSortable` is true.
trans-unit.target: `TreeTable` 的一欄。儲存格的值來自 `ValueSelector` 或 `Binding`（在 XAML 中針對列項目編譯）；`CellTemplate` 承載自訂內容。顯示出來的第一欄承載樹：它的箭頭、縮排和參考線位於儲存格內容之前。當欄位有值（`SortValueSelector` 或 `ValueSelector`）且 `IsSortable` 為 true 時，該欄可排序。

trans-unit.source: Custom cell content (Arc `cell`); the data context is the row item.
trans-unit.target: 自訂儲存格內容（Arc 的 `cell`）；資料內容是列項目。

trans-unit.source: Column label; also the default `EffectiveKey`.
trans-unit.target: 欄位標題；也是預設的 `EffectiveKey`。

trans-unit.source: Hides the column while the table is narrower than this many pixels (0: never; Arc `hideBelow`).
trans-unit.target: 當表格窄於這個像素值時隱藏該欄（0：從不隱藏；Arc 的 `hideBelow`）。

trans-unit.source: Right-aligns the column and sets its figures in tabular width (Arc `align: "end"`).
trans-unit.target: 讓該欄靠右對齊，並使用等寬數字（Arc 的 `align: "end"`）。

trans-unit.source: When false the header is a plain label even though the column has a value.
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時，即使該欄有值，表頭也只是一般標籤。

trans-unit.source: Stable id reported by sort events and `SortKey`.
trans-unit.target: 排序事件和 `SortKey` 回報的穩定識別。

trans-unit.source: Format for cell text: a composite format (`{0:N0} MB`) or a format string (`C0`).
trans-unit.target: 儲存格文字的格式：複合格式（`{0:N0} MB`）或格式字串（`C0`）。

trans-unit.source: Arc's grid track: pixels (`96`), a share of the rest (`2*`). Defaults to `1*` (`minmax(0, 1fr)`).
trans-unit.target: Arc 的格線軌道：像素（`96`）、剩餘空間的份額（`2*`）。預設為 `1*`（`minmax(0, 1fr)`）。

trans-unit.source: A keyboard-navigable file tree with animated folders and a selection fill that glides between rows. Folders open with their space growing on a smooth spring while the new rows stagger in; the chevron turns on a snappy spring and the folder icon pops open. Keyboard: ↑/↓ move, → opens or enters, ← closes or goes to the parent, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown, Enter/Space select and toggle, and typing jumps to a matching row. Unlike `TreeView` (nested item containers), rows are a flat, virtualized list of pooled, self-drawn rows (see `TablesTreeRowsPanel`): thousands of open nodes cost one screenful of rows, and the open / close motion never relayouts the whole tree. Nodes come from inline `Items` (`TreeViewItem`) or from `ItemsSource` with `ChildrenSelector`.
trans-unit.target: 可用鍵盤導覽的檔案樹，資料夾帶動畫，選取填滿會在列之間平滑滑動。資料夾展開時其空間以平滑彈簧增長，新列依序交錯出現；箭頭以靈敏的彈簧轉動，資料夾圖示彈出展開。鍵盤操作：↑/↓ 移動，→ 展開或進入，← 收合或回到上層，Home/End，PageUp/PageDown，Enter/Space 選取並切換展開，輸入字元可跳到符合的列。與 `TreeView`（巢狀的項目容器）不同，列是扁平的虛擬化清單，由池化的自繪列組成（參見 `TablesTreeRowsPanel`）：數千個展開的節點只需繪製一螢幕的列，展開和收合動畫也從不重新配置整棵樹。節點可來自內嵌的 `Items`（`TreeViewItem`），或來自帶 `ChildrenSelector` 的 `ItemsSource`。

trans-unit.source: Children of a data item (null or empty: a file). Not needed for `TreeViewItem` nodes.
trans-unit.target: 資料項目的子項（為 null 或空時：表示檔案）。`TreeViewItem` 節點無需設定。

trans-unit.source: Returns true for data items that are shown dimmed and cannot be selected or invoked (inline nodes use `IsDisabled`). Keyboard focus can still reach them, so a disabled folder still opens.
trans-unit.target: 對顯示為變暗、不能被選取或啟用的資料項傳回 true（內嵌節點使用 `IsDisabled`）。鍵盤焦點仍可到達它們，所以停用的資料夾仍然可以展開。

trans-unit.source: Row label of a data item; `ToString()` when not set.
trans-unit.target: 資料項目的列標籤；未設定時使用 `ToString()`。

trans-unit.source: Optional icon of a data item (24x24 stroked glyph); folders and files get Arc's icons otherwise.
trans-unit.target: 資料項目的可選圖示（24x24 描邊圖示）；否則資料夾和檔案使用 Arc 的圖示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a branch item collapses.
trans-unit.target: 分支項目收合時引發。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a branch item expands.
trans-unit.target: 分支項目展開時引發。

trans-unit.source: A row was clicked or activated with Enter / Space (Arc `onSelect`), even when already selected.
trans-unit.target: 列被點按或透過 Enter / Space 啟動時引發（Arc 的 `onSelect`），即使該列已被選取。

trans-unit.source: Content of each row's label area (after the chevron and icon), built from the node: a data item or a `TreeViewItem`. The tree still draws the row: height, fills, indent, guides, chevron and icon. Rows are pooled, so a template is built once per pooled row and scrolling only changes its data. A template that does not match a node leaves it to the `DataTemplates` of the tree and its ancestors. When null the tree draws the header text. Type-ahead and screen readers use `HeaderSelector` either way.
trans-unit.target: 每列標籤區（箭頭和圖示之後）的內容，由節點建立：資料項或 `TreeViewItem`。列仍由樹繪製：高度、填色、縮排、參考線、箭頭和圖示。列是池化的，所以範本為每個池化的列只建立一次，捲動時只更換它的資料。不相符某個節點的範本會把該節點交給樹及其祖系的 `DataTemplates`。為 null 時樹繪製標題文字。無論哪種情況，鍵入跳轉和螢幕閱讀器都使用 `HeaderSelector`。

trans-unit.source: Root nodes from data; takes precedence over `Items`.
trans-unit.target: 來自資料的根節點；優先於 `Items`。

trans-unit.source: Height of every row in pixels, including the 2px gap above it (default 38, from the theme). All rows share it, so the tree stays virtualized; raise it for two-line content.
trans-unit.target: 每一列的高度（像素），包含其上方 2px 的間距（預設 38，來自主題）。所有列共用這個高度，所以樹仍然是虛擬化的；兩行內容時調高它。

trans-unit.source: The selected node (two-way). Setting it to a hidden node opens its ancestors.
trans-unit.target: 選取的節點（雙向繫結）。將其設為隱藏節點時會展開其祖系節點。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the selected item changes; the argument carries the old and new item.
trans-unit.target: 選取項目變更時引發；參數包含舊項目與新項目。

trans-unit.source: Shows each row's icon (16px slot before the label); when false the label starts at the indent.
trans-unit.target: 顯示每列的圖示（標籤前有 16px 的占位）；為 false 時標籤從縮排處開始。

trans-unit.source: Draws the short branch line beside nested rows (Arc's indent guide).
trans-unit.target: 在巢狀列旁繪製短的分支線（Arc 的縮排參考線）。

trans-unit.source: A node written inline in a `TreeView` (Arc's `TreeNode`): a label, optional icon and child nodes. A node with children is a folder. Not a control: the tree draws its rows itself (virtualized), so nodes stay cheap however many there are.
trans-unit.target: 在 `TreeView` 中內嵌撰寫的節點（Arc 的 `TreeNode`）：包含標籤、可選圖示和子節點。含子節點的節點即為資料夾。它不是控制項：樹會自行繪製其列（虛擬化），因此無論節點多少都很輕量。

trans-unit.source: Label of the row.
trans-unit.target: 列的標籤。

trans-unit.source: Optional 24x24 stroked glyph (for example an `ArcIcons` member) replacing the folder / file icon.
trans-unit.target: 可選的 24x24 描邊圖示（例如 `ArcIcons` 成員），用於取代資料夾或檔案圖示。

trans-unit.source: A disabled node is shown dimmed and cannot be selected or invoked. Keyboard focus can still reach it, so a disabled folder still opens and its children stay reachable.
trans-unit.target: 停用的節點顯示為變暗，不能被選取或啟用。鍵盤焦點仍可到達它，所以停用的資料夾仍然可以展開，其子項仍然可以存取。

trans-unit.source: Whether the folder is open (two-way; the tree keeps it in sync).
trans-unit.target: 資料夾是否展開（雙向繫結；樹會保持同步）。

trans-unit.source: A squarified treemap (Arc "Treemap") for a hierarchy of parts. Top-level branches take Series1–4 and, with `ColorLabel`, every tile deepens with a second measure. Clicking (or Enter on) a branch zooms in: the tile grows to fill the view while its siblings fly out and its children open inside it, all on one affine 0.62s spring; the breadcrumb, Escape or Backspace zoom back out along the same path. A data change morphs every tile in place. Labels never scale: each tile lays its text out at its size and shows it only when it fits.
trans-unit.target: 方塊化樹狀圖（Arc 的“Treemap”），用於呈現階層結構的各個部分。頂層分支使用 Series1–4；設定 `ColorLabel` 後，每個方塊會隨第二個度量值加深顏色。點按（或在分支上按 Enter）可放大該分支：方塊放大以填滿檢視，同層方塊飛出，其子項在其中展開，全部由一個 0.62s 的仿射彈簧驅動；麵包屑導覽、Escape 或 Backspace 會沿同一路徑縮小返回。資料變化時，每個方塊原位變形。標籤從不縮放：每個方塊以其自身尺寸排版文字，並僅在能放下時顯示。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ChildrenSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ChildrenSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ColorDomainMaximum` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ColorDomainMaximum` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ColorDomainMinimum` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ColorDomainMinimum` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ColorFormatter` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ColorFormatter` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ColorLabel` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ColorLabel` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ColorValueSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ColorValueSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `EmptyLabel` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `EmptyLabel` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Raised when another node fills the view (zoom in or out).
trans-unit.target: 另一個節點佔滿檢視時引發（放大或縮小）。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `FocusedNodeId` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `FocusedNodeId` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ItemsSource` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ItemsSource` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `KeySelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `KeySelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Label` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Label` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `LabelSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `LabelSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `PlotHeight` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `PlotHeight` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `Root` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `Root` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ValueFormatter` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ValueFormatter` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: Defines the `ValueSelector` property.
trans-unit.target: 定義 `ValueSelector` 屬性。

trans-unit.source: A node of a `Treemap`: a leaf with a value, or a branch whose value is the sum of its children.
trans-unit.target: `Treemap` 的節點：葉節點帶有一個值，或分支節點的值為其子節點之和。

trans-unit.source: A trial status banner (Arc Trial banner, design reference): a ring counts down the days left, the copy names what the workspace loses, and the upgrade path is one click away. It comes as a slim `Banner` row, a sidebar `Card` with the feature list, or a header `Pill` that opens the card in a popover. All three share one state model: active, the warning tone in the last `WarnAt` days (the copy then names the end day), expired (a lock) and upgraded (a check). Dismiss and snooze fold the banner into the trial pill, which opens it again. Give it `DaysLeft` from your billing provider, or `EndsAt` and let it count the local calendar days with `TimeProvider` (it recounts at local midnight). `AddPaymentHandler` opens your checkout: return once a payment method is on file to show the upgraded state, throw to show Try again. Without it the call is simulated (900ms). With neither `DaysLeft` nor `EndsAt` there is no trial to show: the banner reads "No trial in progress" over an empty ring, without actions. The plan, the workspace, the loss and the features are your app's data and start empty.
trans-unit.target: 試用狀態橫幅（Arc Trial banner，設計參考）：圓環倒數剩餘天數，文案說明工作區將失去什麼，升級只需點擊一次。它可作為細長的 `Banner` 橫幅、附功能清單的側邊欄 `Card`，或在彈出層中開啟卡片的標題列 `Pill`。三者共用一套狀態：進行中、最後 `WarnAt` 天的警告色調（文案會說出結束的那一天）、已結束（鎖頭圖示）和已升級（勾號）。關閉與稍後提醒會把橫幅收合為試用膠囊，點擊膠囊可再次展開。傳入來自計費服務的 `DaysLeft`，或傳入 `EndsAt`，由它藉助 `TimeProvider` 按本地日曆日計數（在本地午夜重新計數）。`AddPaymentHandler` 開啟你的結帳流程：付款方式登錄後傳回即顯示已升級狀態，擲回例外則顯示 Try again。沒有它時該呼叫為模擬（900ms）。`DaysLeft` 與 `EndsAt` 都沒有時沒有可顯示的試用：橫幅在空的圓環上方顯示 "No trial in progress"，沒有操作按鈕。方案、工作區、失去的內容與功能都是你的應用程式的資料，預設為空。

trans-unit.source: Opens checkout or the billing portal. Return once a payment method is on file to show the upgraded state; throw to show the error state with Try again. The token is cancelled when the banner leaves the window. Null simulates it (900ms).
trans-unit.target: 開啟結帳頁面或計費入口。付款方式登錄後傳回即顯示已升級狀態；擲回例外則顯示附 Try again 的錯誤狀態。橫幅離開視窗時權杖會被取消。為 null 時以模擬方式執行（900ms）。

trans-unit.source: After a dismiss or snooze: fold into the trial pill, which opens the banner again, or render nothing.
trans-unit.target: 關閉或稍後提醒之後：收合為試用膠囊（點擊可再次展開橫幅），或什麼也不顯示。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person presses Compare plans. Bubbles. Open your plans page and set Handled; unhandled, the banner shows a short simulated note.

trans-unit.source: Turns on two-factor sign-in in one card: choose an authenticator app or text messages, scan a real QR code of an `otpauth://` address (or enter a phone number), prove it works with a six-digit code, and save the backup codes. A four-step progress shows where the person is; steps slide in the direction of travel while the card's height follows. Without a `CodeVerifier` the card checks codes itself against `Secret` (RFC 6238, 30 second steps, one step of clock drift either way), so any authenticator app works with the built-in example. Enter runs the step's main action, Alt+Left goes back, and focus moves to the new step after every change.
trans-unit.target: 在一張卡片中開啟兩步驟驗證登入：選擇驗證器應用程式或簡訊，掃描一個 `otpauth://` 位址的真實 QR 碼（或輸入手機號碼），輸入六位驗證碼證明可用，並儲存備用碼。四步進度顯示使用者所在的位置；步驟依前進方向滑入，卡片高度隨之變化。沒有 `CodeVerifier` 時，卡片自己依 `Secret` 檢查驗證碼（RFC 6238，每步 30 秒，前後各允許一步的時間偏差），因此任何驗證器應用程式都能配合內建範例使用。Enter 執行目前步驟的主要操作，Alt+左方向鍵返回，每次切換後焦點移到新步驟。

trans-unit.source: The account the codes are for (usually the email address), shown in the authenticator app.
trans-unit.target: 驗證碼對應的帳號（通常是電子郵件地址），顯示在驗證器應用程式中。

trans-unit.source: A toast for an action that can be taken back: "Conversation archived" with an Undo button and a ring that counts the seconds left. The countdown holds while the pointer is over the toast or focus is inside it, and continues where it stopped. When it runs out (or the toast is dismissed) the action stands; Undo, or the platform's undo shortcut while the toast is open, raises `Undone` and runs `UndoCommand`. Showing a new action in an open toast lets the earlier one stand and restarts the countdown. `ShowAsync` answers with true when the action was undone, so the caller can defer the real work until the toast closes.
trans-unit.target: 用於可以撤回的操作的提示：「Conversation archived」，帶有復原按鈕和倒數剩餘秒數的圓環。指標停在提示上或焦點在其中時，倒數暫停，之後從停下的地方繼續。倒數結束（或提示被關閉）時操作保留；復原按鈕，或提示開啟時的系統復原快速鍵，會觸發 `Undone` 並執行 `UndoCommand`。在開啟的提示中顯示新的操作會保留之前的操作並重新開始倒數。`ShowAsync` 在操作被復原時回傳 true，所以呼叫端可以等提示關閉後再做真正的工作。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the toast closes, with the reason.
trans-unit.target: 提示關閉時觸發，帶有原因。

trans-unit.source: How long the action can be undone (5 seconds by default); time under the pointer or with focus inside does not count.
trans-unit.target: 可以復原的時間（預設 5 秒）；指標停在上面或焦點在其中的時間不計算在內。

trans-unit.source: Whether the countdown ring with the seconds left is shown (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示帶剩餘秒數的倒數圓環（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the toast is shown. Setting it to false dismisses the action (it stands). Two-way.

trans-unit.source: True while the countdown holds (pointer over the toast, or focus inside it).
trans-unit.target: 倒數暫停時為 true（指標在提示上，或焦點在其中）。

trans-unit.source: Whether the platform's undo shortcut (Ctrl+Z, Cmd+Z on macOS) undoes the action while the toast is open, unless a text field has focus (default true).
trans-unit.target: 提示開啟時，系統的復原快速鍵（Ctrl+Z，macOS 上為 Cmd+Z）是否復原操作，焦點在文字方塊中時除外（預設 true）。

trans-unit.source: The words the toast gives assistive technology (English by default).
trans-unit.target: 提示提供給輔助技術的文字（預設為英文）。

trans-unit.source: What just happened, in the past tense ("Conversation archived").
trans-unit.target: 剛剛發生了什麼，用過去式（「Conversation archived」）。

trans-unit.source: Runs when the action is undone.
trans-unit.target: 復原操作時執行。

trans-unit.source: The parameter of `UndoCommand`.
trans-unit.target: `UndoCommand` 的參數。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the action is undone.
trans-unit.target: 復原操作時觸發。

trans-unit.source: The undo button's label.
trans-unit.target: 復原按鈕的文字。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `Closed`.
trans-unit.target: `Closed` 的引數。

trans-unit.source: The words an `UndoToast` gives assistive technology, in English by default. Replace the whole object to translate or reword them.
trans-unit.target: `UndoToast` 提供給輔助技術的文字，預設為英文。替換整個物件即可翻譯或改寫。

trans-unit.source: The upgrade nudge shown the moment someone hits a limit (Arc Upgrade prompt, design reference): a title that says what was used, a usage meter, the next plan's price rolling between monthly and yearly with a billing toggle, the three things the plan unlocks, and Maybe later beside Upgrade. Upgrading runs `UpgradeHandler` and rolls into a success state with the new limits while the meter settles to the new limit; a failure shows its message under the price with Try again; Maybe later shows a calm reminder with See Pro again. Every state shares one cell, so the card never changes size between offer, processing, error, success and reminder and the buttons stay in place. Your app gives the plan and the usage: with no `Plan` the card is empty ("No plan to offer", no meter and no offer, Upgrade and Maybe later off). With no handler it simulates a 1.1s upgrade that charges nothing.
trans-unit.target: 在使用者用完額度的那一刻顯示的升級提示（Arc Upgrade prompt，設計參考）：說明用掉了什麼的標題、用量條、在月繳和年繳之間滾動並附計費切換的下一級方案價格、方案解鎖的三項內容，以及並排的 Maybe later 和 Upgrade。升級會執行 `UpgradeHandler`，並滾入列出新額度的成功狀態，同時用量條落到新的上限；失敗時在價格下方顯示訊息並提供 Try again；Maybe later 顯示一則安靜的提醒和 See Pro again。所有狀態共用一個儲存格，因此卡片在報價、處理中、錯誤、成功和提醒之間從不改變尺寸，按鈕也待在原位。方案與用量由你的應用程式提供：沒有 `Plan` 時卡片為空（"No plan to offer"，沒有用量條也沒有報價，Upgrade 與 Maybe later 無法使用）。沒有處理常式時，它模擬一次 1.1 秒、不收取任何費用的升級。

trans-unit.source: Raised by Continue on the success state, usually to close the prompt and retry the blocked action. Set `Handled` to keep the success state; left unhandled, the prompt resets to the offer. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 由成功狀態的 Continue 引發，通常用於關閉提示並重試被擋下的操作。設定 `Handled` 可保留成功狀態；未處理時，提示重設回報價狀態。會冒泡。

trans-unit.source: Replaces the line under the offer's title. Null writes it from the plan and the reset date.

trans-unit.source: Raised by Maybe later; record the snooze here. The prompt then shows the reminder. Bubbles.

trans-unit.target: 計費週期（雙向）。預設為 Yearly。

trans-unit.source: Raised when the person changes the billing toggle. Bubbles.

trans-unit.source: The current plan's limit. At or over it the meter reads Limit reached; below it, how many are left.

trans-unit.source: The plan offered. Null (the default) shows the empty card: nothing to offer.

trans-unit.source: When the current limit resets ("Nov 1"). Shown in the description, the meter and the reminder; empty by default.

trans-unit.source: Replaces the limit title of the offer, such as "You've used all 3 seats". Null writes it from the usage.

trans-unit.source: A status page: the overall state of a set of services at the top, each service's last 90 days as one bar per day with its uptime, the response time of the chosen service over the last day (p50 and p95 against a target) and the incident timeline. The page is derived from the data: give it `Services` (each with half-hourly `Latency` samples and a target) and `Incidents` (each naming the services it hit, when it began and how long it lasted); every day's bar, every uptime figure, the chart domain and the counts follow. Pointing at a day's bar (or moving the keyboard cursor over it) dims the others and opens a card with the day's uptime, status and incidents; choosing a service (its name, or Enter on its bars) glides the highlight to it and morphs the chart. Changing the data (a new incident, a resolution) fades the bars, rolls the numbers, swaps the header and grows or removes incident entries. Keyboard: Tab reaches the header action, then each service's name button and its bars, then the chart and each incident. A focused bar band inspects the newest day; ← → move by a day, PageUp and PageDown by seven, Home and End jump to the ends, Escape clears and Enter or Space charts the service. The focused chart moves a cursor by half hour with ← → (the first → shows the newest sample), Home and End, and Escape clears it.
trans-unit.target: 狀態頁:頂部是一組服務的整體狀態,每項服務最近 90 天依每天一根柱顯示並帶有可用性,所選服務最近一天的回應時間(p50 和 p95 對照目標),以及事故時間線。頁面由資料衍生:給它 `Services`(每項服務帶有每半小時一次的 `Latency` 取樣和一個目標)和 `Incidents`(每個事故指明受影響的服務、開始時間和持續時間);每天的柱、每個可用性數字、圖表範圍和計數都隨之而變。指向某一天的柱(或用鍵盤游標移到它上面)會讓其他柱變暗,並開啟一張顯示該天可用性、狀態和事故的卡片;選擇一項服務(點它的名稱,或在其柱上按 Enter)會讓醒目提示滑向它並使圖表變形過渡。資料變更(新增事故、事故解決)時,柱會淡入淡出,數字滾動,標題切換,事故項目增長或移除。鍵盤:Tab 先到達標題動作,然後依序到達每項服務的名稱按鈕及其柱,再到圖表和每個事故。取得焦點的柱區檢視最新一天;← → 以一天為單位移動,PageUp 和 PageDown 以七天為單位移動,Home 和 End 跳到兩端,Escape 清除,Enter 或 Space 為該服務繪製圖表。取得焦點的圖表用 ← → 以半小時為單位移動游標(第一次按 → 顯示最新的取樣),也可用 Home 和 End,Escape 清除游標。

trans-unit.target: 用量預測:一個計費週期對照一項預算。已測得的用量繪製為直到今天的折線,預測以虛線延續並帶有可能範圍的錐形區域,水平的預算線可以拖曳(或用按鍵移動),而一切隨之回應:標題說明預算何時會用完,三張卡片顯示迄今用量、最後一天的預測和超額費用,每條路徑高於預算的部分變紅,一個標記沿線跟隨交叉點,警示標籤(預算的 50%、80%、100%)回報各閾值何時已達到或將達到。一個開關用於切換指標;每條路徑、刻度、數字和文字都會變形過渡到新的指標。

trans-unit.source: Shows what fills a fixed allowance and how close it is to the limit (Arc UsageMeter): a title with a status badge, the rolling total, a bar of accent steps (one per category) and a legend that doubles as the keyboard path. The first time 40% of the meter is visible the categories grow in left to right; later changes re-flow every category on its own smooth spring (P18, P23) and the numbers roll the way they moved (P14). Past the limit the bar is struck through with a hatch beside a limit marker, so the overage reads without color. Hovering or focusing a category previews it (the others dim); a press pins it until pressed again or Escape. Categories come from `ItemsSource` or the inline `Segments`.
trans-unit.target: 顯示固定配額已佔用多少，以及距離上限還有多遠（Arc UsageMeter）：包括標題和狀態徽章、滾動的總量、依類別分段的強調色進度條，以及兼作鍵盤操作路徑的圖例。首次有 40% 的儀表可見時，各類別從左到右增長；之後的變化會以各自的平滑彈簧重新排列每個類別（P18, P23），數字也會依變化方向滾動（P14）。超過上限後，進度條會以斜線劃掉，並在旁邊顯示上限標記，即使沒有顏色也能看出超出部分。懸停或聚焦某一類別會預覽它（其餘變暗）；按下會將其固定，直到再次按下或按 Escape。類別來自 `ItemsSource` 或內嵌的 `Segments`。

trans-unit.source: A pricing calculator that picks the plan: two stepped sliders (seats and monthly usage) and a monthly / yearly switch drive a breakdown and a recommendation card. The recommended plan is the first whose seat and usage limits both cover the selection; the card morphs the plan name, says why (four reasons), rolls the monthly estimate, reflows the plan's features and offers a trial, which turns itself off when the plan changes. From 780px wide the card has its own column.
trans-unit.target: 一個挑選方案的定價計算器：兩個分級滑桿（席次數與每月用量）加上月付／年付切換，驅動明細與推薦卡片。推薦的方案是第一個席次上限與用量上限都涵蓋所選值的方案；卡片會變形顯示方案名稱、說明推薦理由（四種情形）、滾動更新每月估算、重新排列方案的功能列表，並提供試用，方案變更時試用會自動關閉。寬度從 780px 起，卡片佔有獨立的一欄。

trans-unit.source: The account menu behind a person's avatar in an app's top bar (Arc user menu): a compact identity header, a short group of account destinations (`Items`, keep it to three or four), an inline light / dark / system switch, an optional presence switch and sign out. Theme and status choices keep the menu open; everything else closes it and returns focus to the avatar. When `SignOutAction` returns an unfinished task the row shows a spinner and "Signing out", and the menu closes once it settles. Below a 640px wide window the menu opens as a bottom sheet that follows a downward drag. The panel scales out of the avatar on a spring that never overshoots, rows fade in 16ms apart, one highlight glides between rows and the switch thumbs slide on Arc's CSS spring.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式頂欄中位於使用者頭像後的帳戶選單（Arc 使用者選單）：包含精簡的身分標題、一組簡短的帳戶目的地（`Items`，建議保留三到四個）、內嵌的淺色 / 深色 / 跟隨系統切換、可選的線上狀態切換以及登出。主題和狀態選項會使選單保持開啟；其他操作會關閉選單並將焦點返回頭像。當 `SignOutAction` 回傳未完成的工作時，該列會顯示載入指示並顯示“Signing out”，待其完成後選單再關閉。視窗寬度小於 640px 時，選單會以底部面板形式開啟，並跟隨向下拖曳。面板以不會過衝的彈簧從頭像處縮放展開，各列每隔 16ms 依序淡入，一個反白區塊在列間滑動，開關滑塊依 Arc 的 CSS 彈簧滑動。

trans-unit.source: An animated semantic search: a question is typed, embedded into a vector, dropped into a map of document vectors, and its nearest neighbours by cosine similarity become the ranked answers. The search is real (hashed bag-of-words embeddings, cosine ranking, a principal-component map), so `Search` works with any question.
trans-unit.target: 動態語意搜尋：輸入一個問題，將其嵌入為向量，放入文件向量地圖中，並依餘弦相似度取出最近鄰作為排序後的答案。搜尋是真實的（雜湊詞袋嵌入、餘弦排序、主成分地圖），因此 `Search` 可處理任何問題。

trans-unit.source: A glowing fluid sphere for a voice assistant (Arc Voice orb, design reference). It breathes slowly at rest, swells with the user's voice and sends out ripples while listening, draws in with a bright band running around its rim while thinking, and grows lumpier and pulses with the assistant's voice while speaking. Muted while listening it goes quiet and gray. Every change of state glides on springs that keep their speed when interrupted.
trans-unit.target: 用於語音助理的發光流體球體（Arc Voice 光球，設計參考）。靜止時它緩慢呼吸；聆聽時隨使用者的聲音膨脹並發出漣漪；思考時一圈明亮的光帶環繞邊緣並向內收縮；說話時它變得更加凹凸不平，並隨助理的聲音脈動。靜音的聆聽狀態下，它會安靜下來並變為灰色。每次狀態變化都以彈簧滑動過渡，被打斷時仍保持原有速度。

trans-unit.source: The user's voice level from 0 to 1, read every frame while listening (for example a microphone meter). Not a number (the default) uses `LevelSource` or the built-in simulated voice.
trans-unit.target: 使用者聲音的音量電平，範圍 0 到 1，聆聽時每影格讀取一次（例如麥克風電平表）。非數值（預設值）時使用 `LevelSource` 或內建的模擬聲音。

trans-unit.source: Whether the microphone is muted: while listening the orb shrinks a little, drops its ripples and turns gray.
trans-unit.target: 麥克風是否已靜音：聆聽時光球會稍微縮小、停止發出漣漪並變為灰色。

trans-unit.target: 固定的無障礙名稱。為 null 時，依 `Labels` 中該狀態的文字為光球命名。

trans-unit.source: The accessible names per state (English defaults when null).

trans-unit.target: 未設定 `InputLevel` 或 `OutputLevel` 時，音量電平的來源。為 null 時使用 `Default`。

trans-unit.source: A simulated voice conversation that drives a `VoiceOrb`, a `VoiceTranscript` and a `VoiceControls` together, with the timing of the Arc Voice orb preview (design reference). It listens (the user's words appear 0.9 s in, then every 150 ms + 22 ms per character of the previous word), thinks 0.7 s after the last word for 1.5 s, speaks the answer word by word (pulsing the orb with each word), and listens again 1.3 s after the last word, looping through the `Script`. Muting pauses the conversation, not the call timer.
trans-unit.target: 一個模擬的語音對話，同時驅動 `VoiceOrb`、`VoiceTranscript` 和 `VoiceControls`，時序與 Arc Voice 光球預覽（設計參考）一致。它先聆聽（使用者的話在 0.9 s 時出現，之後每個詞的間隔為 150 ms 加上上一個詞每個字元 22 ms），在最後一個詞之後 0.7 s 開始思考，持續 1.5 s，然後逐詞朗讀回答（每個詞都使光球脈動），並在最後一個詞之後 1.3 s 再次聆聽，循環通過 `Script`。靜音會暫停對話，但不會暫停通話計時器。

trans-unit.source: Raised with each word the assistant speaks (the orb pulses with it).
trans-unit.target: 助理每說出一個詞時引發（光球隨之脈動）。

trans-unit.source: Raised after any of the session's properties changed.
trans-unit.target: 工作階段的任一屬性變更後引發。

trans-unit.source: The levels a `VoiceOrb` shows when the host pushes none: a deterministic, speech-like envelope (a pulse per syllable every 150 to 350 ms with a breath between phrases) for the input, and a steadier one for the output. Both are pure functions of time, so a seed always gives the same voice. No microphone is opened.
trans-unit.target: 宿主未推送音量電平時 `VoiceOrb` 顯示的音量電平：一種確定性的、類似語音的包絡（輸入每 150 到 350 ms 一個音節脈衝，片語之間有換氣停頓），輸出則是較平穩的包絡。兩者都只是時間的純函數，因此同一種子總是得到相同的聲音。不會開啟麥克風。

trans-unit.source: A voice note composer with its thread (Arc Voice recorder, design reference). The thread lists voice bubbles (theirs on the left with an avatar, yours on the right), each with play and pause and a waveform that fills in as it plays. Below it, the mic stretches into a recording bar with a breathing dot, a running timer and a live waveform; stop turns the bar into a review where the take plays back and can be scrubbed; send carries the bar up into the thread as your new bubble, and the trash (or Escape) folds it back into the mic. Recording is simulated: every take gets a deterministic voice (see `VoiceRecorderPeaks`) unless `LevelSource` supplies the levels. `MessageSent` and `Cancelled` carry the take (its length and bars); wire your own audio capture there. Sent takes are added to `Messages`.
trans-unit.target: 附帶對話串的語音留言輸入區（Arc Voice recorder，設計參考）。對話串列出語音泡泡（對方的在左側並附頭像，你的在右側），每則泡泡都可播放和暫停，波形會隨播放逐漸填滿。下方的麥克風會展開成錄音列，附呼吸的圓點、持續走動的計時和即時波形；停止會把錄音列變成回聽，可重播並拖曳定位這段錄音；傳送會把錄音列帶進對話串成為你最新的泡泡，垃圾桶（或 Escape）則把它收回成麥克風。 錄音是模擬的：除非 `LevelSource` 提供音量，否則每段錄音都會得到一個確定的聲音（見 `VoiceRecorderPeaks`）。`MessageSent` 與 `Cancelled` 帶著這段錄音（長度與長條）；請在那裡接上你自己的音訊擷取。傳送的錄音會加入 `Messages`。

trans-unit.source: A take was discarded with the trash button, Escape or `Discard`. Bubbles.
trans-unit.target: 一段錄音已透過垃圾桶按鈕、Escape 或 `Discard` 捨棄。會向上傳遞。

trans-unit.source: Every word `VoiceRecorder` shows or says, in English by default. Replace the whole object to localize or reword; sentences with a time or a name are format functions (times arrive as m:ss text).

trans-unit.source: One voice message in a `VoiceRecorder` thread: its length, its waveform and, for messages from someone else, who sent it. A message with a `From` name or an `Avatar` is incoming (left, muted bubble); one without is yours (right, dark bubble).
trans-unit.target: `VoiceRecorder` 對話串中的一則語音訊息：它的長度、波形，以及來自他人的訊息由誰傳送。帶有 `From` 名稱或 `Avatar` 的訊息是收到的（左側，柔和底色的泡泡）；兩者都沒有的是你的（右側，深色泡泡）。

trans-unit.source: Carries the take that was sent or discarded.
trans-unit.target: 帶著已傳送或已捨棄的那段錄音。

trans-unit.source: Deterministic waveforms for voice messages. `Levels` simulates the 90ms input levels of someone talking (phrases of syllables between pauses, now and then a murmur), `Generate` turns a seed and a length into a message's bars, and `Resample` shrinks any level series to a bar count by taking the loudest sample of each stretch. The same seed always gives the same voice. Values run from 0.12 (silence) to 0.98 in steps of 0.01.
trans-unit.target: 語音訊息的確定性波形。`Levels` 模擬一個人說話時每 90ms 的輸入音量（停頓之間是由音節組成的片語，偶爾有低語），`Generate` 把種子和長度變成一則訊息的長條，`Resample` 透過取每一段中最響的樣本，把任意音量序列縮減為指定的長條數。相同的種子永遠得到相同的聲音。值從 0.12（靜音）到 0.98，間距 0.01。

trans-unit.source: Invented sample content for `VoiceRecorder`: a short thread with a neighbour about a garden fence (14, 6 and 9 second messages, as in the reference preview) and a longer one for scrolling. No real people.
trans-unit.target: `VoiceRecorder` 的虛構範例內容：與鄰居討論花園圍籬的簡短對話串（14、6 和 9 秒的訊息，與參考預覽一致），以及一個用於捲動的較長對話串。沒有真實人物。

trans-unit.source: One category of a `WaffleChart`: a share of the whole drawn as countable cells.
trans-unit.target: `WaffleChart` 的一個類別：整體中的一份佔比，以可計數的方格繪製。

trans-unit.source: A unit chart (Arc "Waffle chart"): a rows × columns grid where every cell is one share of the whole (10 × 10 = one cell per percent), filled column by column from the bottom-left corner. Cells are persistent: when the data changes they stay put where they can and the rest fly, staggered, to their new block while dipping and changing color. The legend rolls each share to its new value; hovering or focusing a category dims the others, clicking pins it. Arrow keys walk the grid cell by cell, Page Up / Page Down jump between categories, Escape clears the reading.
trans-unit.target: 單位圖表（Arc“Waffle chart”）：列 × 欄的網格，每個方格代表整體的一份（10 × 10 = 每格一個百分比），從左下角開始逐欄填滿。方格是持久的：資料變化時，盡量保留在原位，其餘方格則交錯飛至新的區塊，過程中下沉並改變顏色。圖例會將各佔比滾動到新值；懸停或聚焦某一類別會使其他類別變暗，點按則將其固定。方向鍵逐格移動網格，Page Up / Page Down 在類別之間跳轉，Escape 清除讀數。

trans-unit.source: A payment card as it appears in a wallet: the drawn card face (masked number, holder, expiry and an invented network mark), the available balance with the month's spending against its limit, the latest transactions, and two actions. Freeze covers the face with frost and can wait for your server (`SetFrozenAsync`); Show details reveals the full number and security code, offers to copy the number and hides them again after `DetailsTimeout`.
trans-unit.target: 錢包裡的一張付款卡：繪製的卡面（遮住的卡號、持卡人、有效期和虛構的卡片組織標誌）、可用餘額與本月消費占限額的比例、最近的交易，以及兩個操作。凍結會讓卡面結霜，並可以等待你的服務器（`SetFrozenAsync`）；顯示詳情會顯示完整卡號和安全碼，提供複製卡號，並在 `DetailsTimeout` 之後再次隱藏。

trans-unit.source: The money available to spend.
trans-unit.target: 可以使用的金額。

trans-unit.source: The full card number; only its digits count. The face shows the last four unless details are shown.
trans-unit.target: 完整卡號；只計其中的數字。除非顯示詳情，卡面只顯示後四位。

trans-unit.source: The symbol written before amounts ("$").
trans-unit.target: 金額前面的貨幣符號（"$"）。

trans-unit.source: How long the details stay shown before they hide again (30 seconds); zero keeps them until hidden.
trans-unit.target: 詳情顯示多久後再次隱藏（30 秒）；為 0 時一直顯示到手動隱藏。

trans-unit.source: The expiry as printed ("08/29").

trans-unit.source: The printed finish of the face.

trans-unit.source: Raised when the card is frozen or unfrozen, by the button or by setting `IsFrozen`.
trans-unit.target: 通過按鈕或設定 `IsFrozen` 凍結或解凍卡片時引發。

trans-unit.source: The cardholder's name as printed.
trans-unit.target: 印在卡上的持卡人姓名。

trans-unit.source: True while `SetFrozenAsync` runs.

trans-unit.target: 是否顯示完整卡號和安全碼（双向）。

trans-unit.source: The issuer printed at the top left of the face (an invented bank by default).

trans-unit.source: The block's built-in text.

trans-unit.source: A masonry (waterfall) panel: children flow into equal-width columns (or equal-height rows), each going to the end of the lane that is currently shortest, so cards of different heights pack without row gaps. Usable on its own or as an `ItemsPanel`.

trans-unit.source: Number of columns when `Orientation` is `Vertical`; 0 fits as many as `MinLaneSize` allows.
trans-unit.target: `Orientation` 為 `Vertical` 時的欄數；0 表示依 `MinLaneSize` 放下盡可能多的欄。

trans-unit.source: Stretches the last child of every lane to the panel's end, so all lanes end together. The end is the longest lane, or the panel's arranged size when its parent gives it more; it never reaches past the panel.
trans-unit.target: 把每條通道的最後一個子元素拉伸到面板末端，讓所有通道一起結束。末端是最長的通道；父項給面板更多空間時則是面板的排列尺寸；永遠不會超出面板。

trans-unit.source: Where each child's size along the flow comes from: `Content` (default) measures the child, `Varied` picks a size between `MinItemSize` and `MaxItemSize` from the child's index and `Seed`.
trans-unit.target: 每個子元素沿排列方向的尺寸從哪裡來：`Content`（預設）測量子元素，`Varied` 依子元素的索引和 `Seed` 在 `MinItemSize` 與 `MaxItemSize` 之間選取。

trans-unit.source: The largest size a child gets along the flow; children are also measured within it.

trans-unit.source: The smallest size a child gets along the flow (its height in columns, its width in rows).

trans-unit.source: The narrowest lane (column width or row height) when `Columns` or `Rows` is 0.

trans-unit.source: A tester for the endpoints of a product that sends webhooks: pick an event, edit its JSON payload and send a signed test event. The request timeline walks from signed to sent to the answer, the response panel shows the body, the headers and the exact request, and a list of recent deliveries keeps the last attempts, failed ones with a Retry button. The block signs in the app (HMAC SHA-256 of `timestamp.body`, sent as `t=…,v1=…` in `SignatureHeader`) but never posts to your customer's endpoint itself: `SendAction` receives the signed `WebhookTestRequest` and passes it to your server, which does the real POST. Without a `SendAction` every delivery is simulated and says so in its announcements.
trans-unit.target: Webhook 端點測試器：選擇事件、編輯 JSON 負載並傳送帶簽章的測試事件。請求時間軸從已簽章走到已傳送再到回應，回應面板顯示本文、回應標頭和確切的請求，最近投遞清單保留最近的嘗試，失敗的帶有 Retry 按鈕。區塊在應用程式內簽章（對 `timestamp.body` 做 HMAC SHA-256，以 `t=…,v1=…` 放入 `SignatureHeader`），但它自己絕不會向客戶的端點發出請求：`SendAction` 收到已簽章的 `WebhookTestRequest` 並交給你的伺服器，由伺服器真正送出 POST。未設定 `SendAction` 時，每次投遞都是模擬的，並在播報中說明。

trans-unit.source: Sends one sample event about a second after the block scrolls half into view, unless someone used it first. Only while `SendAction` is null.
trans-unit.target: 區塊捲動到一半進入視窗約一秒後傳送一個範例事件，除非使用者已經操作過它。僅在 `SendAction` 為 null 時生效。

trans-unit.source: Raised after a send or a retry finished, with the new delivery (already at the top of the list).

trans-unit.source: The payload as it stands in the editor (two-way), valid JSON or not.

trans-unit.source: Sends a failed delivery again on your server: awaited when Retry is pressed, with the delivery's body under a fresh timestamp and signature. Null uses `SendAction`.
trans-unit.target: 在你的伺服器上重新傳送失敗的投遞：按下 Retry 時被等待，使用該投遞的本文，並帶上新的時間戳記和簽章。為 null 時使用 `SendAction`。

trans-unit.source: The signing secret. It is shown masked with its prefix visible; the body is signed with it in the app.
trans-unit.target: 簽章密鑰。顯示時會被遮罩，前綴可見；區塊在應用程式內用它對本文簽章。

trans-unit.source: The delivery whose response the panel shows (two-way); a send selects the new delivery.
trans-unit.target: 面板顯示其回應的投遞（雙向）；傳送後會選取新的投遞。

trans-unit.source: The chosen event (two-way); null selects the first one.
trans-unit.target: 目前選擇的事件（雙向）；為 null 時選取第一個。

trans-unit.source: Sends the signed request on your server: awaited when the person sends, with a token that leaving the window cancels. Return the endpoint's answer; a status of 0 with `Error` (and `TimedOut`) says no answer arrived, and an exception counts as a failed delivery. Null simulates the endpoint (a 200 after `SimulatedLatency`).
trans-unit.target: 在你的伺服器上傳送已簽章的請求：使用者傳送時被等待，並帶有離開視窗即取消的權杖。回傳端點的回應；狀態為 0 並帶有 `Error`（以及 `TimedOut`）表示沒有收到回應，擲回例外同樣算作失敗的投遞。為 null 時模擬端點（經過 `SimulatedLatency` 後回傳 200）。

trans-unit.source: The header that carries the signature (`x-webhook-signature`).
trans-unit.target: 攜帶簽章的標頭（`x-webhook-signature`）。

trans-unit.source: How long a simulated delivery takes to answer (0.65 s).
trans-unit.target: 模擬投遞的回應耗時（0.65 秒）。

trans-unit.source: The product that sends the events: its name and mark in the header.
trans-unit.target: 傳送事件的產品：頁首中顯示它的名稱和標誌。

trans-unit.source: Events sent in the slice, failed ones included.
trans-unit.target: 該時間片內傳送的事件數，包含失敗的事件。

trans-unit.source: A webhooks console for a developer settings page: the endpoints with their subscribed events, delivered rate and health; the selected endpoint's details and a 24-hour traffic chart you can hover; its recent deliveries with an inspector for the response, the payload and the headers; failed deliveries retried in place; and an "Add endpoint" pill that unfolds into a form and shows the new endpoint's signing secret once. Retries, new endpoints and test events call `RetryAction`, `CreateEndpointAction` and `SendTestAction`; without them the block simulates a server that always succeeds. Failures show in place: a failed attempt row, an error in the form, a failed test delivery.
trans-unit.target: 用於開發者設定頁的 Webhook 主控台：列出端點及其訂閱的事件、送達率與運作狀況；所選端點的詳細資料與可懸停檢視的 24 小時流量圖表；其最近的傳送，以及用於檢視回應、承載與要求標頭的檢查器；可就地重試失敗的傳送；還有一個 "Add endpoint" 膠囊，點擊後展開為表單，並只顯示一次新端點的簽章金鑰。重試、新增端點與測試事件分別呼叫 `RetryAction`、`CreateEndpointAction` 與 `SendTestAction`；未設定時，此區塊會模擬一個永遠成功的伺服器。失敗會就地顯示：失敗的嘗試列、表單中的錯誤、失敗的測試傳送。

trans-unit.target: 重試、新增端點或測試事件失敗時引發。

trans-unit.target: "Add endpoint" 面板關閉時引發。

trans-unit.source: Every word `Webhooks` shows or announces, in English by default. Replace the instance to translate or reword; texts with values are functions so that word order and plural forms can change.

trans-unit.source: A desktop-class week planner: a toolbar with Today, previous / next and a view switch; a sidebar with a month and the calendars to show (it folds into a Calendars popover on narrower calendars); a header of days, an all-day row and a scrolling time grid with the events of each day side by side, the current time and the past dimmed. Week, work week and day views; narrow calendars show three days, a day or an agenda. Changing the range slides the header, the all-day row and the grid together on one spring; changing the view crossfades. Events are data (`Events` or `EventsSource`) in absolute time, shown in `TimeZone`. Drag across empty time to draw an event and name it in a quick create popover, drag events between days and times, drag their bottom edge to resize, click one to edit its title, day, times and calendar; everything snaps to 15 minutes, and the last change can be undone.
trans-unit.target: 一款桌面級的週行事曆規劃器：工具列包含「今天」、上一個／下一個按鈕以及檢視切換；側邊欄包含迷你月曆和要顯示的行事曆（在較窄的行事曆中，它會收合進「行事曆」彈出層）；標題區包含日期列、全天列以及可捲動的時間格線，格線中每天的行程並排顯示，目前時間線與已過去的時段會變暗。提供週檢視、工作週檢視和日檢視；較窄的行事曆顯示三天、單日或議程。切換範圍時，標題區、全天列與格線會沿同一彈簧曲線一起滑動；切換檢視時則為淡入淡出的交叉過渡。行程是資料（`Events` 或 `EventsSource`），以絕對時間表示，並依 `TimeZone` 顯示。在空白時段上拖曳即可畫出一個行程，並在快速新增彈出層中為其命名；可在日期與時間之間拖曳行程，拖曳其底邊可調整時長；點擊行程可編輯標題、日期、時間和行事曆。所有操作都會對齊到 15 分鐘，最後一次變更可以復原。

trans-unit.source: The all-day lanes shown before the row collapses into "+N more" chips (3); 0 never collapses.
trans-unit.target: 全天列在收合為 "+N more" 標籤之前顯示的數量（3）；0 表示從不收合。

trans-unit.target: 日期、時間和星期名稱所用的地區文化；為 null 時使用目前的地區文化。

trans-unit.source: The focused day (two-way; today by default). The days shown always hold it: setting a day outside them moves the calendar to the range around it.

trans-unit.target: 一週的第一天（預設為星期一）。

trans-unit.source: Every text the calendar shows or reads to screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 行事曆顯示或唸給螢幕閱讀器的每一段文字。
