trans-unit.source: Raised when `View` changes.
trans-unit.target: `View` 改變時引發。

trans-unit.source: One event of a `WeekCalendar`. `Start` and `End` are instants (store them in UTC or with their offset); the calendar shows them in its `TimeZone`. An all-day event covers whole dates: the dates of `Start` and `End` as written, with `End` exclusive (midnight after the last day); its time zone is ignored. Changing any property moves or redraws the event at once.
trans-unit.target: `WeekCalendar` 中的一個行程。`Start` 和 `End` 是時間點（請以 UTC 或帶偏移量的形式儲存）；行事曆會依其 `TimeZone` 顯示它們。全天行程涵蓋完整的日期：`Start` 和 `End` 依所寫的日期取值，`End` 為開區間（即最後一天之後的午夜）；其時區會被忽略。修改任何屬性都會立即移動或重繪該行程。

trans-unit.source: The people invited; tall events show up to four avatars, the agenda three and a count.
trans-unit.target: 受邀的人員；較高的行程最多顯示四個頭像，議程中顯示三個並加上計數。

trans-unit.source: The screen reader name; null composes "title, day, start to end, calendar, location".
trans-unit.target: 螢幕閱讀器唸出的名稱；為 null 時由 "title, day, start to end, calendar, location" 組合而成。

trans-unit.source: The `Id` of its calendar; an unknown id draws the event in gray.
trans-unit.target: 其所屬行事曆的 `Id`；未知的 id 會使行程以灰色繪製。

trans-unit.source: When the event ends (exclusive); an end at or before the start shows a 15 minute event.
trans-unit.target: 行程結束的時間（開區間）；結束時間早於或等於開始時間時，顯示為 15 分鐘的行程。

trans-unit.source: A stable id: focus, selection and callbacks follow it across rebuilds.
trans-unit.target: 穩定的 id：焦點、選取狀態和回呼在重建後仍跟隨該行程。

trans-unit.source: True shows the event in the all-day row, spanning its dates.
trans-unit.target: 為 true 時，行程顯示在全天列中，跨越其日期。

trans-unit.source: Where it takes place: a line with a pin on tall events, the second line in the agenda.
trans-unit.target: 地點：較高的行程中為帶圖釘的一行，議程中為第二行。

trans-unit.source: When the event starts.
trans-unit.target: 行程開始的時間。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app wants to keep with the event.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式希望與該行程一同保存的任意物件。

trans-unit.source: The title shown on the event.
trans-unit.target: 行程上顯示的標題。

trans-unit.source: Arguments of `EventUpdated`: the event as it is now and a copy of it before the change.
trans-unit.target: `EventUpdated` 的參數：行程目前的狀態，以及變更前的副本。

trans-unit.source: Every word `WeekCalendar` shows or reads to screen readers, in English by default. Replace the instance (`Labels`) to translate or reword. Dates and times inside the formatted texts come from `Culture`; the functions only arrange them, so the word order can change.
trans-unit.target: `WeekCalendar` 顯示或唸給螢幕閱讀器的每個詞，預設為英文。取代該實例（`Labels`）即可翻譯或改寫。格式化文字中的日期和時間來自 `Culture`；這些函式只負責排列它們，因此詞序可以改變。

trans-unit.source: A calendar of a `WeekCalendar` ("Work", "Home"): its events take its color, and its toggle in the sidebar (or the Calendars popover) shows or hides them.
trans-unit.target: `WeekCalendar` 的一個行事曆（如 "Work"、"Home"）：其行程採用其顏色，側邊欄（或行事曆彈出層）中的開關可顯示或隱藏這些行程。

trans-unit.source: The palette color; `Custom` uses `CustomColor`.
trans-unit.target: 調色盤中的顏色；`Custom` 使用 `CustomColor`。

trans-unit.source: Any color for `Custom`; fills and text are mixed from it like the presets.
trans-unit.target: `Custom` 所用的任意顏色；填滿色與文字色會與預設顏色一樣由它混合而成。

trans-unit.source: The id events refer to through `CalendarId`.
trans-unit.target: 行程透過 `CalendarId` 參照的 id。

trans-unit.source: False hides the calendar's events (two-way; the toggle in the calendars list sets it).
trans-unit.target: 為 false 時隱藏該行事曆的行程（雙向繫結；行事曆列表中的開關會設定它）。

trans-unit.source: The name in the calendars list and in event names read by screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 行事曆列表中的名稱，以及螢幕閱讀器唸出的行程名稱中的名稱。

trans-unit.source: Any object the app wants to keep with the calendar.
trans-unit.target: 應用程式希望與該行事曆一同保存的任意物件。

trans-unit.source: Minimize, maximize / restore and close for a window whose content reaches the top (an `ArcWindow` with `IsTitleBarVisible="False"`), placed wherever the app draws its own header. The buttons drive the window they are in and follow it: maximize shows restore while the window is maximized and is disabled while the window cannot grow (`CanResize` or `CanMaximize` false), minimize while `CanMinimize` is false. On Windows they tell the system what they are, so the maximize button opens Snap Layouts. `TitleBar` draws its own caption buttons with this control; show one set per window.
trans-unit.target: 內容延伸到頂端的視窗（`IsTitleBarVisible="False"` 的 `ArcWindow`）所用的最小化、最大化 / 還原和關閉按鈕，可放在應用程式自己繪製的頁首中的任意位置。按鈕控制所在的視窗並跟隨其狀態：視窗最大化時最大化按鈕顯示為還原，視窗不能放大時（`CanResize` 或 `CanMaximize` 為 false）最大化按鈕停用，`CanMinimize` 為 false 時最小化按鈕停用。在 Windows 上，它們會告訴系統自己是什麼按鈕，因此最大化按鈕會開啟貼齊版面配置。`TitleBar` 也用這個控制項繪製自己的標題列按鈕；每個視窗只顯示一組。

trans-unit.source: True draws the buttons without driving the window: they minimize, maximize and close nothing and the system does not treat them as caption buttons. For previews, such as a mock-up of a window inside a page. False by default.
trans-unit.target: 為 True 時只繪製按鈕而不控制視窗：它們不會最小化、最大化或關閉任何視窗，系統也不會把它們當作標題列按鈕。用於預覽，例如頁面中的視窗示意圖。預設為 False。

trans-unit.source: Shows the close button. True by default.
trans-unit.target: 顯示關閉按鈕。預設為 True。

trans-unit.source: Shows the maximize / restore button. True by default.
trans-unit.target: 顯示最大化 / 還原按鈕。預設為 True。

trans-unit.source: Shows the minimize button. True by default.
trans-unit.target: 顯示最小化按鈕。預設為 True。

trans-unit.source: Shows a `WorkflowGraph` on a dotted canvas (visual rules from Arc's free hero-section block, HeroRelay): one card per step, edges between them, and a run played out step by step. Set the steps' states as your run goes; when a step finishes, the data draws along its edges in the accent before the next step shows as running, and the edges of a branch the run did not take turn dashed. Steps without a position are arranged in ranks; by default the whole workflow shows at actual size and shrinks like a screenshot when it does not fit. Pan with a drag or the wheel, zoom with Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel, a pinch or the keyboard, and move between steps with the arrow keys.
trans-unit.target: 在點陣畫布上呈現 `WorkflowGraph`（視覺規則來自 Arc 免費的 hero-section 區塊 HeroRelay）：每個步驟一張卡片，步驟之間是連線，執行過程逐步呈現。隨執行進度設定各步驟的狀態；一個步驟完成後，資料會以強調色沿其連線繪製，之後下一個步驟才顯示為執行中，執行未經過的分支連線會變成虛線。沒有位置的步驟按層排列；預設以實際大小顯示整個工作流程，放不下時像截圖一樣縮小。拖曳或捲動滾輪可平移，用 Ctrl / ⌘ + 滾輪、雙指縮放或鍵盤縮放，用方向鍵在步驟間移動。

trans-unit.source: How the workflow fits the canvas (default `ShrinkToFit`: actual size, centered, shrinking when it does not fit). Panning, zooming or setting `Zoom` or `Offset` stops fitting until `FitToContent`. In a container with unlimited height the canvas is as tall as the fitted workflow.
trans-unit.target: 工作流程如何符合畫布（預設 `ShrinkToFit`：實際大小、置中，放不下時縮小）。平移、縮放或自行設定 `Zoom`、`Offset` 後停止符合，直到呼叫 `FitToContent`。在高度不受限的容器中，畫布與符合後的工作流程一樣高。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a person drops a new connection on the empty canvas: show a list of steps there, add the chosen one and connect it yourself.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者將新連線拖放到空白畫布上時觸發：在此顯示步驟清單，由你自行新增所選的步驟並連接它。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a person connects two ports, after the workflow's own checks (`CanConnect`) and before the edge is added: set `Cancel` to refuse it, with a `Reason` to tell them why.
trans-unit.target: 當使用者連接兩個連接埠時觸發，位於工作流程自身的檢查（`CanConnect`）之後、連線新增之前：設定 `Cancel` 可拒絕該連線，並可搭配 `Reason` 告知使用者原因。

trans-unit.source: How edges are drawn: curves (default, as in Arc), right angles with rounded corners, or straight lines.
trans-unit.target: 連線的畫法：曲線（預設，與 Arc 相同）、帶圓角的直角，或直線。

trans-unit.source: The workflow to show.
trans-unit.target: 要顯示的工作流程。

trans-unit.source: Raised once after each edit a person makes (moving steps, deleting steps), when it is done: save the workflow or record the edit here.
trans-unit.target: 每次使用者完成一次編輯（移動步驟、刪除步驟）後觸發一次：在這裡儲存工作流程或記錄這次編輯。

trans-unit.source: Whether people can move and delete steps (default false). Selecting works either way.
trans-unit.target: 是否允許使用者移動與刪除步驟（預設 false）。無論是否開啟，都可以選取步驟。

trans-unit.source: Whether people can pan and zoom (default true): dragging pans, the wheel works per `WheelMode`, a pinch zooms, and the + / − keys zoom. Turn it off for a workflow shown inside a scrolling page that should only fit (Arc's hero). `ZoomTo`, `FitToContent` and `ScrollIntoView` work either way.
trans-unit.target: 是否允許平移和縮放（預設 true）：拖曳可平移，滾輪依 `WheelMode` 運作，雙指縮放可縮放，+ / − 鍵可縮放。對於放在捲動頁面中、只需符合的工作流程（如 Arc 的 hero），請關閉它。無論是否開啟，`ZoomTo`、`FitToContent` 與 `ScrollIntoView` 都可使用。

trans-unit.source: Which way the workflow runs: down (default, as in Arc) or across. Edges and arranging follow it.
trans-unit.target: 工作流程的執行方向：向下（預設，與 Arc 一致）或向右。連線與排列都隨之調整。

trans-unit.source: The largest zoom (default 2).
trans-unit.target: 最大縮放比例（預設為 2）。

trans-unit.source: The smallest zoom (default 0.25).
trans-unit.target: 最小縮放比例（預設為 0.25）。

trans-unit.source: Below this width (default 520, as in Arc; 0 never) the canvas is narrow: cards shrink to 344 × 52 and 108 × 72, and a workflow the canvas arranged itself is arranged again with tighter spacing, so it stays readable on a phone instead of shrinking like a screenshot. Steps placed by your code keep their places.
trans-unit.target: 低於此寬度（預設 520，與 Arc 相同；0 表示永不）時畫布為窄螢幕：卡片縮為 344 × 52 與 108 × 72，畫布自己排列的工作流程會以更緊湊的間距重新排列，在手機上依然清楚易讀，而不是像截圖一樣縮小。由你的程式碼放置的步驟維持原位。

trans-unit.source: Raised when a step is opened: double-clicked, or Enter pressed on its card. Open its settings here.
trans-unit.target: 開啟某個步驟時觸發：按兩下它，或在其卡片上按 Enter。在這裡開啟它的設定。

trans-unit.source: The canvas point shown at the top-left corner of the view.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在檢視左上角的畫布座標點。

trans-unit.source: Whether a step that starts while the data is still drawing toward it keeps showing as waiting until the data arrives (default true), so a run reads step, edge, step as in Arc even when your run sets the next step running at once. Only what is shown waits; the steps' states are untouched. Full motion only.
trans-unit.target: 當資料仍朝某步驟繪製時，即使該步驟已開始執行，是否仍顯示為等待，直到資料抵達為止（預設為 true）。如此一來，即使你的執行立即將下一個步驟設為執行中，畫面仍會依 Arc 的方式呈現步驟、連線、步驟的順序。只有顯示會等待，步驟的狀態不受影響。僅在完整動效下生效。

trans-unit.source: Raised once each time the selection changes, also when selected steps leave the workflow.
trans-unit.target: 選取每變化一次觸發一次，包括選取的步驟離開工作流程時。

trans-unit.source: Whether the dot grid shows (default true).
trans-unit.target: 是否顯示點陣（預設為 true）。

trans-unit.source: Whether moved steps snap to the dot grid when let go (default true); holding Alt while dragging skips it.
trans-unit.target: 移動的步驟放開時是否吸附到點陣（預設 true）；拖曳時按住 Alt 可略過吸附。

trans-unit.source: What the wheel does (default `Pan`: scrolling pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel zooms; `ModifierZoom` leaves plain scrolling to the page).
trans-unit.target: 滾輪的作用（預設 `Pan`：捲動平移，Ctrl / ⌘ + 滾輪縮放；`ModifierZoom` 把一般捲動留給頁面）。

trans-unit.source: Screen pixels per canvas unit; kept within `MinZoom` and `MaxZoom`.
trans-unit.target: 每個畫布單位對應的螢幕像素數；保持在 `MinZoom` 與 `MaxZoom` 之間。

trans-unit.source: A connection dropped on the empty canvas, for `ConnectionDroppedOnCanvas`.
trans-unit.target: 拖放到空白畫布上的連線，用於 `ConnectionDroppedOnCanvas`。

trans-unit.source: A connection a person is making, for `ConnectionRequested`.
trans-unit.target: 使用者正在建立的連線，用於 `ConnectionRequested`。

trans-unit.source: A connection from one step of a `WorkflowGraph` to the next: the data of a run flows from `Source` to `Target`. The ends are fixed; to reconnect, remove the edge and add a new one.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowGraph` 中從一個步驟到下一個步驟的連接：執行的資料從 `Source` 流向 `Target`。兩端固定；要重新連接，請移除該連線並新增一條。

trans-unit.source: How the edge shows the run. `Auto` (the default) follows its two steps, so a run only needs to set the steps' states.
trans-unit.target: 連線如何顯示執行情況。`Auto`（預設）會跟隨其兩端的步驟，因此執行只需設定步驟的狀態即可。

trans-unit.source: One edit a person made on a `WorkflowCanvas`, for `GraphEdited`.
trans-unit.target: 使用者在 `WorkflowCanvas` 上完成的一次編輯，用於 `GraphEdited`。

trans-unit.source: A workflow: its steps (`Nodes`) and the connections between them (`Edges`). Show it with a `WorkflowCanvas`; change the collections or any step and the canvas follows. Removing a step removes its edges; an edge whose steps are not in `Nodes` is refused.
trans-unit.target: 一個工作流程：由其步驟（`Nodes`）以及步驟之間的連接（`Edges`）組成。以 `WorkflowCanvas` 顯示它；變更集合或任何步驟，畫布都會隨之更新。移除步驟時會一併移除其連線；兩端步驟不在 `Nodes` 中的連線會被拒絕。

trans-unit.source: Whether a connection may close a loop (default false: people cannot connect a step to one before it).
trans-unit.target: 連線是否可以封閉形成迴圈（預設為 false：使用者不能將步驟連接到其前面的步驟）。

trans-unit.source: Undo and redo for the edits people make on a `WorkflowCanvas` showing the workflow: moving, deleting, connecting, disconnecting and pasting steps. Changes your code makes to the `WorkflowGraph` are recorded only inside `BeginGroup`. Keeps the last 100 edits.
trans-unit.target: 為使用者在顯示此工作流程的 `WorkflowCanvas` 上所做的編輯提供復原與重做：移動、刪除、連接、中斷連線與貼上步驟。你的程式碼對 `WorkflowGraph` 所做的變更只會在 `BeginGroup` 內記錄。保留最近 100 次編輯。

trans-unit.source: Raised when what can be undone or redone changes.
trans-unit.target: 當可復原或可重做的內容變更時觸發。

trans-unit.source: A small map of a `WorkflowCanvas`: every step as a block (running and selected steps in the accent, failed ones in red) and the part the canvas shows as a frame. Press to move the view there, drag to pan. Set `Target` to the canvas and place the map over a corner, like `WorkflowZoomControls`. It is a pointer shortcut: the canvas's own keys do the same, so the map takes no focus and screen readers skip it.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 的小地圖：將每個步驟畫成一個方塊（執行中與已選取的步驟使用強調色，失敗的步驟使用紅色），並以一個框標示畫布目前顯示的範圍。按下即可將檢視移至該處，拖曳則為平移。將 `Target` 設為畫布，並像 `WorkflowZoomControls` 一樣把小地圖放在某個角落。它只是指標捷徑：畫布本身的按鍵也能做到相同操作，因此小地圖不會取得焦點，螢幕閱讀器也會略過它。

trans-unit.source: The canvas the map shows and moves.
trans-unit.target: 小地圖所顯示並移動的畫布。

trans-unit.source: One step of a `WorkflowGraph`: what it is (title, description, icon), where it sits on the canvas, and while a run goes through the workflow its state, result and time. Every property is observed, so changing a step updates the canvas.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowGraph` 中的一個步驟：它是什麼（標題、描述、圖示）、在畫布上的位置，以及執行經過工作流程時的狀態、結果與耗時。每個屬性都會被監看，因此變更步驟會更新畫布。

trans-unit.source: One row (`Standard`) or two (`Compact`).
trans-unit.target: 一行（`Standard`）或兩行（`Compact`）。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title while nothing has run yet: what the step works on ("Plan, seats and owner").
trans-unit.target: 尚未執行時位於標題下方的一行：說明此步驟處理的內容（例如 "Plan, seats and owner"）。

trans-unit.source: How long the step took; shown next to the check once it is done ("118 ms").
trans-unit.target: 步驟耗時；完成後顯示在勾號旁邊（例如 "118 ms"）。

trans-unit.source: Why the step failed; shown under the title in the failed state and read by screen readers.
trans-unit.target: 步驟失敗的原因；在失敗狀態下顯示於標題下方，並會由螢幕閱讀器朗讀。

trans-unit.source: Whether the step has an implicit input when `Inputs` is empty (default true). Turn it off for a step nothing leads into, such as a trigger.
trans-unit.target: 當 `Inputs` 為空時，步驟是否具有隱含輸入（預設為 true）。對於沒有任何連線指向它的步驟（例如觸發器），請將其關閉。

trans-unit.source: The 20 × 20 mark at the start of the card: a Lucide geometry from `ArcIcons` (drawn as a stroke), an image, or any control.
trans-unit.target: 卡片起始處的 20 × 20 標記：來自 `ArcIcons` 的 Lucide 幾何圖形（以描邊繪製）、圖片或任意元件。

trans-unit.source: A locked step stays where it is and cannot be deleted on an editable canvas; it can still be selected and opened.
trans-unit.target: 鎖定的步驟在可編輯畫布上維持原位且無法刪除，但仍可以被選取與開啟。

trans-unit.source: Your own category of the step (trigger, action, condition); screen readers read it after the title.
trans-unit.target: 你自訂的步驟類別（如觸發器、動作、條件）；螢幕閱讀器會在標題之後朗讀它。

trans-unit.source: The card's top-left corner on the canvas. NaN (the default) lets the canvas place the step by arranging the whole workflow, and writes the place it chose back here.
trans-unit.target: 卡片在畫布上的左上角位置。NaN（預設值）表示由畫布透過排列整個工作流程來放置此步驟，並將其選定的位置寫回此處。

trans-unit.source: The line under the title once the step is done: what it found ("Enterprise, 212 seats"); null keeps the description.
trans-unit.target: 步驟完成後標題下方的一行：其查得的結果（例如 "Enterprise, 212 seats"）；為 null 時保留描述。

trans-unit.source: The card's size; null uses the size of its `Appearance` (300 × 60 or 200 × 84).
trans-unit.target: 卡片的尺寸；為 null 時使用其 `Appearance` 對應的尺寸（300 × 60 或 200 × 84）。

trans-unit.source: Where the step stands in the current run (`Idle` when there is no run).
trans-unit.target: 步驟在目前執行中所處的狀態（沒有執行時為 `Idle`）。

trans-unit.source: What the step does, on one line (it is cut with an ellipsis when it does not fit).
trans-unit.target: 步驟所做的事，佔一行（放不下時以省略號截斷）。

trans-unit.source: The card of one workflow step on a `WorkflowCanvas` (visual rules from Arc's free hero-section block, HeroRelay): icon, title, the description or result under it, and the run state at the end. A running card takes the accent, a skipped one fades, a failed one shows its error. The canvas creates one card per `WorkflowNode`; style it through the semantic part `arc.workflow.node`.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 上一個工作流程步驟的卡片（視覺規則取自 Arc 免費的 hero 區塊 HeroRelay）：圖示、標題、其下的描述或結果，以及末尾的執行狀態。執行中的卡片採用強調色，已略過的卡片淡出，失敗的卡片會顯示其錯誤。畫布會為每個 `WorkflowNode` 建立一張卡片；請透過語意部件 `arc.workflow.node` 為其設定樣式。

trans-unit.source: Content for the card in place of its icon, title, subtitle and state, built from the `Node` when the template matches it (a `WorkflowNodeTemplate` matches a step's `Kind`). The frame, the run's colors, the selection and the focus ring stay. Without `Size` the card is as tall as its content. On a canvas, set `NodeTemplates` instead.
trans-unit.target: 卡片的內容取代其圖示、標題、副標題與狀態，由 `Node` 建立，並在範本與其相符時套用（`WorkflowNodeTemplate` 會與步驟的 `Kind` 相符）。框、執行狀態的顏色、選取狀態與焦點環保留不變。未設定 `Size` 時，卡片高度與其內容相同。若在畫布上使用，請改為設定 `NodeTemplates`。

trans-unit.source: The state the card shows. It is the step's `State`, except that on a canvas a step that starts while the data is still drawing toward it keeps showing `Pending` until the data arrives (`QueueRunVisuals`).
trans-unit.target: 卡片顯示的狀態。它與步驟的 `State` 相同，但在畫布上，若某步驟在資料仍朝其繪製時開始，則會持續顯示 `Pending`，直到資料抵達為止（`QueueRunVisuals`）。

trans-unit.source: The step this card shows.
trans-unit.target: 此卡片所顯示的步驟。

trans-unit.source: A step of a `WorkflowCanvas`, for `NodeActivated`.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 的一個步驟，用於 `NodeActivated`。

trans-unit.source: Content for the cards of one kind of step, written in XAML: put it in `NodeTemplates`. It matches the steps whose `Kind` is `Kind` (every step when null), and its content replaces the card's icon, title, subtitle and state; the data is the `WorkflowNode`. Write `x:DataType="arc:WorkflowNode"` on it for compiled bindings.
trans-unit.target: 為某一類步驟的卡片撰寫的內容，以 XAML 寫成：將它放入 `NodeTemplates`。它會比對 `Kind` 為 `Kind` 的步驟（為 null 時比對所有步驟），其內容取代卡片的圖示、標題、副標題與狀態；資料為 `WorkflowNode`。在其上寫入 `x:DataType="arc:WorkflowNode"` 以使用編譯繫結。

trans-unit.source: A named connection point of a `WorkflowNode`, such as the "Yes" and "No" outputs of a condition. A step without ports of a direction has one implicit port there (an edge's port is then null).
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowNode` 的一個具名連接點，例如條件步驟的 "Yes" 和 "No" 輸出。若步驟在某個方向上沒有連接埠，則該方向會有一個隱含連接埠（此時連線的連接埠為 null）。

trans-unit.source: Your name for the kind of data the port carries; two ports with a data type connect only when the types are the same (null connects to anything).
trans-unit.target: 你為連接埠所承載的資料種類指定的名稱；兩個具有資料類型的連接埠只有在類型相同時才能連接（null 可與任何類型連接）。

trans-unit.source: A short name shown next to the port, such as "Yes"; null shows none.
trans-unit.target: 顯示在連接埠旁的簡短名稱，例如 "Yes"；為 null 時不顯示。

trans-unit.source: How many edges the port takes (default no limit).
trans-unit.target: 連接埠可接受的連線數量（預設不限制）。

trans-unit.source: A change of a `WorkflowCanvas`'s selection, for `SelectionChanged`.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 選取的一次變化，用於 `SelectionChanged`。

trans-unit.source: A small zoom bar for a `WorkflowCanvas`: zoom out, the current zoom (click it for 100%), zoom in, and fit. Set `Target` to the canvas and place the bar where it suits, usually over a corner of the canvas. It matches the library's other zoom bars: a 34px pill with 28px buttons.
trans-unit.target: `WorkflowCanvas` 的小型縮放列：縮小、目前縮放比例（點選可回到 100%）、放大與符合。將 `Target` 設為畫布，再把縮放列放在合適的位置，通常是畫布的一角。它與元件庫中其他縮放列一致：34px 的膠囊，內含 28px 的按鈕。

trans-unit.source: The canvas the buttons zoom.
trans-unit.target: 按鈕所縮放的畫布。
